Abass Akande Obesere (dem bon am for January 20, 1965)  wey pipul dey kol "Omo Rapala" na Naija Muzishan, singa an rekod produsa wey kom fom Ibadan, wey bi big ples for Naija. Obesere na pesin wey pipul no wel wel for im wok wey bi to dey sing fuji song. Meni pipul laik im wok bikos di kain mentod wey e dey yuz arenj im song dey mek pipul for maket, strit, vilej an garaj laik dem. E dey folo di Sikiru Ayinde Barrister ezampul wey pipul sabi wel wel for Naijá an for di wold, Obesere don kari im muzik go difren difren kontri sef. Sony Music giv am kontrat bot im komot wen dey no gree ontop moni mata, Obesere kon go du kontrat for anoda ples, Obesere an K1 D ultimate wey dey sing fuji muzik sef no dey gree for diasef. 

Na Mayor Ville Entertainment wey dey sign pipul wey dey sing na dem Obesere sign kontrat for now. Mayor Ville Entertainment dey onda Maxoglan Entertainment wey dey Lagos for Naijà.

Alhaji Obesere moto wey bi Lexus jeep Lx470 get asident for Ijebu wen im dey kom Lagos. Di asident hapun for Sunday April 8 2012, di taim wey di tin hapun na 7:30pm. Pipul wey dey tok niuz tok sey Obesere an two oda pesin dey for di moto wen di tin hapun an no bi sey dem dai as dey kari dem go hospitu for Orisunbare Hospital, Jakande Isolo, Lagos. Na wund di two pesin get for di moto.

Abayomi Adebayo Barber (dem bon am for October 23, 1928 an e dai for December 26, 2021) na Naija pesin wey dey draw fain fain tins for Naijá an e bi di oga for Barber Art School wey dey insaid Legos for Naija. E get koneshion wel wel for insaid Naijá muzik but plenti oyibo pipul no sabi am. Dem rili sabi am as pesin wey biliv sey evritin wey dey hapun for dis laif jost dey hapun an dem sabi am as pesin wey biliv sey dream dey hapun.Barber don rait som tins abaut di foma presido for Naija wey di nem na Murtala Mohammed an anoda pesin wey don bi Oba for Ile-Ife bifor wey im nem na Adesoji Aderemi. One of e wok wey pipul sabi wel wel na di one wey im yuz oil pent tek draw Shehu Shagari.

How im tek stat life
Dem born Barber for October 23, 1928 for Ile-Ife for Samuel Bamidele an Victoria Waleola Barber famili. Na for St Peter's Anglican School e tek stat im skul mata for Iremo wey dey inside Ife an na for 1948 im finish im skul for St Stephen's Skul for inside Modakeke for Ife. For 1949, Barber yuz stik du one fain tin an im kom du plenti kompitishon for insaid dat year. Na for 1952 pipu stat to sabi am for Legos wen im win one kompitishon wey Elder Dempster dey du wey di nem na Lines Silver Cup bikos na im win am as di pesin wey di tin wey im draw fain pas for di Nigeria Festival of the Arts. Afta dem giv am di prize, dem kom tel am to draw di oga kpata-kpata for Ikoyi klub wey wan stop to bi di oga kpata-kpata wey im nem na Harold Cooper. Dem giv Barber wok for Legos wen 1952 jost dey stat as pesin wey dey draw for buk an for pipul wey wan mek evribodi sabi wetin dem dey sel for one Naijá Kompini for Yaba insaid Legos. For 1955, Barber join one pipul wey de yuz stone do fain-fain tins for Yaba College of Technology wey di oga kpata-kpata na one man wey kom from Britain wey im nem na Paul Mount. For 1957, one of Barber papa broda wey e nem na Adesoji Aderemi kari am go mit Awolowo wey bi di oga kpata-kpata for Westa Naijá. Bikos of dis one, e kom join di pipul wey dey du plenti-plenti tins to see if dem go sabi as di Yoruba pipul tek stat.Barber wok as pesin wey bi dey folo pesin du plenti tins an dis one mek am see plenti big-big pipul laik Saburi Biobaku, William Fagg, Frank Willet an Dr Bradburty. For 1960 go rish 1962 di Govament kari am go Central School of Arts and Crafts for London. For dis skul, Barber len how to kip tins mek dem no spoil an e kom stil kontiniu di wok wey dem yuz stone tek mek Obafemi Awolowo. Wahala kom hapun for insaid di Govament wey kom mek govament stop to dey pay for im skul. As im dey for England e kontiniu to dey len how to dey draw, e len how dem dey yuz stone mek fain fain tins for  Mancini an Tozer studios wey dey inside London. Barber stil wok as di pesin wey folo di oga kpata-kpata for one studio wey Edward Delaney get an e kom stil wok for Oscar Nemon Studio for St James Studio for London.Barber wok wit Nemon to yuz stone do five difren difren fain design of Winston Churchill. Na im stil bi di sekond oga for di ples wey dem kip plenti tins wey don tey for laif for Britain. Na for 1971 e kom bak to Naijá an dem giv am wok as pesin we dey draw for insaid School of African And Asian Studies wey di nem now na Center for Cultural Studies for University of Lagos. Dem kom tel am to draw di pesin we dey rul for Ethopia wey im nem na Haile Selassie for di taim wen e kom Naijá. Wen Barber kom bak to Naijá, e no laik di way dem dey tek draw for hie bikos im biliv sey if pesin kontiniu to dey draw evritaim, di pesin go rili sabi di wok wel-wel.Barber stat to dey tich pipul di wok for 1973 an na Muri Adejim im fest tich for inside di yunivasiti.

Na for 1989 Barber fest sho plenti pipul im wok an e kol am Abayomi Barber A Retrospective. Som of im wok stil dey for insaid National Gallery of Modern Art laik di one wey im yuz stone design Ali Maigoro an Yemoja.

Barber kontiniu to dey draw fain fain tins wit pent an stone an for one buk insaid midu of 2017 e tok abaut im wok an wetin im biliv for laif.

Abba Musa Rimi, CON (dem bon am for 28 February 1940) na one man fom Naija wey pipul chuz mek e bi di pesin wey go rul dem for Kaduna Stet for 1979 wen Naija dey for dia Sekond Ripoblik, dis wan kon mek Rimi bi di pesin wey go dey du laik  gofnor for dat taim wey dem komot Gofnor Abdulkadir Balarabe Musa as di gofnor for June 23, 1981. Na wen im de insaid di pati for politis wey dem dey kol People's Redemption Party na im dem tek chuz am as di gofnor of Kaduna Stet.

Pope John Paul II kom Kaduna for February 1982. Bot som pipul wey dey rul di muslim pipul dat taim no gri kom grit am. Wen di Pope stil dey di airport bifo im kom enta plen go bak to Lagos, e rid one tin wey dem rait to Rimi an oda pipu wey dey wok for govament sey mek evribodi dey join bodi to do tins togeda, weda you bi muslim or kristen. For August 1982, Rimi yuz gra-gra tok to di Jama'atul Nasril Islam (JNI) sey mek dem si as dem go fit stop di fight-fight wey dey amog di smol smol muslim grup wey dem nem na Izala an Darika Muslim grup. For March 27 1982, dat taim, Rimi kom stat di IBBI Naija wey stil dey try wel wel to dey du drink for North side for Naija.

Afta General Muhammadu Buhari yuz gra-gra bigin rul Naija for  December 31 1983, E arest som of di pipul wey dey rul difren difren Stet for Naija. For March 28 1985, dem send Rimi go 21 years for insaid prisin. Dem sey im kari N500,000 dash 96 pipul for di Stet House of Assembly wey dey wok for ples wey dem dey join bodi rait evritin wey pipul sopos du an di one wey dem no sopos do. Rimi sey im giv dem di moni bikos dem "folo do evritin wey dem sopos du for dia difren difren aria.

Rimi wok as pesin we dey hep big big kompini laik UAC, NTC an G.B. OLLIVANT sel dia maket. Afta, e kom bi di oga kpata-kpata for African Circle Pollution Management.Rimi kom stil folo bi pat of di pipul wey get Commander Order of the Niger (CON). Na one wife im mari an dem don bon 7 pikin.

For October 1998, Rimi kom bi di pesin wey dey advais one soja-man wey bi dey rul Naija wey im nem na Abdulsalam Abubakar for di taim wey we chenj go di kind govament wey bi sey wu no bi ami fit rul Naija for di Nigerian Fourth Republic.

Abdu Gusau Polytechnic na one Stet Govament politeknik wey dey for Talata Mafara, Zamfara Stet inside Naija.

Tori abaut di skul
Di politeknik don dey sins 1992 afta di gofnor wey dey bifor for Sokoto Stet, Yahaya Abdulkarim sign di bill wey dem tek mek di "Talata Mafara Polythecnic". Di Sokoto Stet Govament chenj di nem of di Politeknik to "Abdu Gusau Polytechnic" in February, 1995. E du am to honor di late Enjinia Abdu Gusau wey dai in November, 1994 for all di tin wey e don du to divelop di Stet.Wen dey fom Zamfara Stet in 1996, dis one mek dem kari di Politeknik go a niu pamanet site in Talata Mafara. Di Sokoto Stet Govament no gree mek dey yuz dia moni to dey tekia of skul wey Zamfara get, an na dis risin mek dem kari Audi Gusau Politeknik fom Sokoto Stet to Zamfara Stet.

Abdullahi Mustapha (dem bon am for February 1, 1948) na Naija profesor of Medisinal kemistri an na forma fas shanselo for Ahmadu Bello Univasiti for Zaria. Na profesor Ibrahim Garba tek ova wen e komot as di fas shanselo (VC) for di Univasiti.

How e tek stat life
Dem bon profesor Mustapha for February 1, 1948.E papa am mama kom fom Katsina bot dem dey stey for Kano for Noth for Naija.
E go Ralmadadi Praimari skul for 1955 bifor e go Katsina sekondri skul. E kolet e West African Examination Certificate for 1968 for Gofment kolej, Keffi. E leta go Ahmadu Bello Univasiti for 1973 wia e kolet e bashelo digri for Pharmacy. E stil kolet e Doctorate degree(Ph. D) fom Chelsea College  wey dey leta join wit King's College for London in 1981.

How im tek wok
Na for 1974 Profesaw Mustapha stat e tishin wok for Ahmadu Bello tishin Ospital as Pupil Pharmacist. An na for 1982 dem promot am go Senior Lekshora for di Dipatment of famasitikal an medisinal kemistri. For 2010, dem giv am fas shanselo for Ahmadu Bello Univasiti. Bifor e bikom fas shanselo for Ahmadu Bello Univasiti, e bin dey saf as di fas shanselo for Umaru Musa Yar'adua Univasiti.

text:
Abia State na a Stet wey dey Saunt-East jiopolitikal zone of Naija. Di Stet na one of the 36 Stet for Naija and di kapita na Umuahia.Di ples wey Bizness dey pass na Aba for di Stet. Di state slogan na "God's Own State" and di governor of di state na Okezie Ikpeazu.Di Stet wey dey di North side an NorthEast of Abia Stet na Enugu Stet, an Ebonyi Stet.Di Stet wey dey for west side of Abia Stet na Imo Stet an Kross Riva Stey dey di East pat of Abia Stet.Na Rivas Stet dey di South of di Stet an Akwa Ibom Stet dey di Southeast.
Di wod ABIA kom fom di ples inside  Abia Stet wey pipul plenti pass. Di A stand for Aba, Di B stand for Bende, Di I stand for Isuikwuato an di A stand for Afikpo.
Na Abia Stet bi di nomba 32 stet wey big pass among all di Stet wey dey Naija an if we dey tok abaut Stet wey pipul plenti for Naija, Abia Stet kari nomba 27.Abia Stet get ova 3,720,000 as of 2016.Jiografikali, di Stet divide into two, di "Niger Delta Swamp forest" an di dry "'Crosss-Niger transition Forest" wit som Savana for di rest of the Stet.
Many tribe-dem don stey an liv for Abia Stet, but for now na Igbo pipul dey liv for Abia Stet.Bifor di Oyingbo pupil kom Naija, Abia Stet dey pat of Arochukwu-based Aro Union bifor di British souja fight di Arọ grup kom win Dem in 1900s.Wen di Oyingbo win di war finish, dey kom add di aria to Souta Naija wey dey go dey kontrol as pat of Naija. Abia Stet giv di Oyingbo pupil dem wahala biko dey no wan stey onda dem an di korse Wumen war wey hapun stat for Oloko.
Wen Naija free from Oyingbo in 1960, Dey kari Abia Stet join di Easta Rijion onti 1967 bifor dey kom add am to East Sentral Rijion.E no rush two month leta, Abia Stet pipul join di three years Naija Sivul war as Abia pipul tok sey dey komot from Naija go join Biafra Reploblik.Wen di War end, dey kom join Abia Stet bak to Stet wey dey Naija bak ontil 1976 wen forma Presidor Murtala Muhammed era wen dey kom komot Imo Stet fom Ábíá Stet.
Na petrol bizness, gas wit Agrikolshor like yam, maize, kasava, taro, red ooye dey bring Abia Stet moni.Anoda small aria wey dey giv Abia Stet moni na to dey mek tins wey pupil fit yuz an dis one plenti for Aba.
For Stet wey dey du di best for tins to beta for Naija in edukeshon, wok an dey wey e Stet dey hep e pipul-dem, Abia Stet kari nomba Eight posishion 
Di aria wey Abia Stet dey
Di land wey Abia Stet get na 6,320 square kilomitas.
Di Stet wey dey di North side an NorthEast of Abia Stet na Enugu Stet, an Ebonyi Stet.Di Stet wey dey for west side of Abia Stet na Imo Stet an Kross Riva Stey dey di East pat of Abia Stet.Na Rivas Stet dey di South of di Stet an Akwa Ibom Stet dey di Southeast. Di pat of Abia Stet wey dey south dey hey rain of 2,400 milimitas per years an rain dey plenti for April an October for di Stet.Di Rivas wey dey popula pass for di ples na Imo rivas an Aba rivas an dey flow enta Atlantik Osuhon for Akwa Ibom Stet.
Tori abaut Abia Stet an e populashion
Abia Stet na one of di 36 stet wey dey Naija an di Stet get 17 lokal govament aria out of di 774 lokal govament aria wey dey Naija.Na for August 27, 1991 dey kret Abia stet.Na Jeneral Ibrahim Babangida rijim time na e dey kret am.Di Stet dey South-Easta pat of Naija.Na for inside Imo Stet dey tek komot Abia Stet. Di Stet dey amog di Stet wey mek-up Niger Delta rijion.Umuahia bi di kapital of Abia Stet.Na Aba for Abia Stet Bizness dey hapun pass for di Stet. Di nik nem of Abia Stet na "Stet wey bi dey na God get am''". Di fest leta for di four ples for di Stet wey pipul plenti pass mek-up di nem ABIA dey bi 
Aba, Bende, Isuiwuato, Afikpo.If pesin divadi pipul wey dey Abia Stet into one hundred, ninety five of dem go bi Igbo pipul.Na Igbo langwej Abia pupil dey spik pass but dem dey spik Inglish too for bizness an govament mata. Pipul wey bi kristen for Abia pass 7 million.

Abibatu Mogaji FCM, OON (dem bon am for October 16, 1916 an e kpai for June 15, 2013) na Naija biznes wuman an di lyaloja of Lagos.

How  life tek stat
Dem born Abibatu Mogaji for October 16, 1916 for Lagos koloni weyt dey for di south pat of Naija.

Tori abaut e famili     
Shif Mogaji bi di mama of di National Leader of di All Progressive Congress (APC) an gofnor of Legos Stet one time wey e nem na shif Bola Tinubu.Shif Tinubu pikin wey bi gel wey e nem na Folashade an na Folashade tek ova fom di granma as di  lyaloja of Legos. 
Bifor dey chuz am as di lyaloja of di Association of Nigerian market women and men, e don saf as  tok tok lida of di maket women's association for Legos Stet.
For dis kapasiti, e saf as di pesin wey tek pawa fom di forma lyaloja wey e nem na Alimotu Pelewura.
Shif Mogaji kolet meni Nashional Awods for di tins wey e du fom Federal Government of Nigeria.E Kolet "Honorary Doctorate" digri fom Naijá Univasiti like Ahmadu Bello University" an University of Lagos''.

How e dai
Shif Mogaji dai for Saturday June 15, 2013 for 96 years old an na for e own house for lkeja di capital of Lagos State. Dey later bury her for lkoyi vaults and Garden s for Lagos state.

text:
Senator Isiaka Abiola Adeyemi Ajimobi (dem bon am for December 16, 1949 an e kpai for June 25, 2020) na  Naija politishian wey kom fom Oyo State, sauth-west of Naija. Im na bifor bifor oga kpatakpata for National Oil and Chemical Marketing Company wey dey onda di kompini wey Shell Petroleum, Nigeria dey kontrol.Ajimobi ritaya komot for orye mata for 2002 afta 26 years of koret savis an e kom kontest an win eleshion go senate to repisent  Oyo South Senatorial District on top di platfom of Alliance for Democracy (AD) party. Afta Ajimobi finish one term for senate, e kom join kolet gofnorship fom in 2007 wen e kontest bot e no win di gofnorship eleshion for Oyo Stet onda di parti of di All Nigeria People's Party. Ajimobi kontest again insaid di April 2011 gofnorship eleshions onda di Action Congress of Nigeria an dis taim e kom win di eleshion na so e tek bi di gofnor of Oyo Stet. Afta Ajimobi du two terms as gofnor fom 2011 go rish 2019, Ajimobi kolet senate fom for eleshion but e lost di eleshion.Ajimobi kpai on  25 of June 2020, an na COVID-19 sikness kos am.

How e tek stat life
Dem bon Isiaka Abiola Adeyemi Ajimobi for December 16, 1949 Insaid di Ajimobi famili of Ibadan for Oja-Iba, Ibadan. Isiaka Abiola Adeyemi Ajimobi stat e edukashion for Saint Patricks Primary School, Oke-Padre for Ibadan an e finish primari skul for Ibadan City Council Primary School, Aperin. E du e sekondri skul for Lagelu Grammar School. 
Ajimobi waka go du  univasiti edukashion for United States of America, wey e rid Business Administration and Finance for State University of New York, insaid Buffalo city for New York. E kolet  
Bachelor of Science degree satifiket for di Univasiti. Afta dat, Ajimobi go du MBA for Operations Research and Marketing as e put eye for Finance in Governors State University, University Park, for di city of  Illinois inside di United States of America.

How e tek du politis 
For 2003, Isiaka Abiola Adeyemi Ajimobi  bikom  Senator for Naija an e post for senate na Deputy Minority leader of the Senate. In 2007, Ajimobi kontest an lose di gofnor eleshion wit di parti All Nigeria Peoples Party. Ajimobi kontest again wit di parti Action Congress of Nigeria an dis time e win in 2011.

Pipul no Ajimobi as sombodi wey plan how Oyo Stet go tek fine wel wel.Evribodi no Ajimobi as fada of Oyo Stet. Wen Ajimobi win di sekond eleshion in April 11, 2015 as gofnor of Oyo Stet, dis mek am di fest pesin to du gofnor bak to bak in Oyo Stet. text:
Abraka na town for Delta State, Nigeria. Abraka na house for two of di main 24 urhobo kingdoms. Abraka kom dey popula because of Delta State University an di main campus of Delta State University dey for di town.

Abraka town na place wey difren kind of wok dey an na main ples for international tourist. Di Abraka beach kom dey popula bikos of di natural flow spring water an e get sport recreational facilities for outdoors activities like canoeing, fishing, swimming, barbeque an picnics.

Tori about di place 
Benin Prince wey e name na Avwraka na im find Abraka according to Abraka oral history. Avwraka (Abraka) na one of di few urhobo socio political units wey di predecessor live only with urhobo ethnic group befor dem settle for Urhoboland. Avwraka na prince for Edo-speaking political group wey come settle near other urhobo pipu. Di pipu wey live for di time of Avwraka (Abraka) wey get di main version of im history talk say e get two boys wey dere name na Aghwa and Ivie. Dem be distant ancestors of Umiaghwa and Oruarivie of Avwraka today.

Di main settlement of Abraka today na dem be: Ekrejeta, Ajalomi, urhuoka, Uruovie, Oria, Urhuagbesa, Umeghe, Otri (na di descendants of Oruarivie) Otorho-Avwraka (Avwraka inland) Dis na di traditional headquarters.

Di construction wey link di road from Agbo pass Abraka to sapele for 1901 increase di commercial activities and population for Abraka. For May 6 1978 di whole of Abraka pipu come together say make dem turn Abraka to kingdom like most urhobo kingdoms.

Dey decide to make chief David Oghenegueke Dafe as deir Ovie (king) and chief Joseph Ajarho Atagana from Umiaghwa as deir Otota (spokesman). D recent history show say  Avwraka (Abraka) don reach to divide di kingdom into Umiagwa Abraka and Oruarive Abraka kingdom. After di two separate Avwraka (Abraka) kingdoms Now dem form vital part wey be Ethiope-East local Government Area of Delta State wey di polity dey don live dere since 1976. Di main pipu wey dey di city of Abraka na di urhobo pipu.

Di kind weather wey dey dia 
Abraka get tropical wet and dry climate wey get long wet season and di temperature mostly dey constant truout di course of di year. Abraka wet season dey run from March go reach October. But because of August brake  di wet season nearly become two wet season di remaining months for di city form di dry season. Like for good portion for West Africa di months of November go reach February na di months wey Abraka dey experience harmattan.

Different-different school wey dey dia 
Abraka na house for University of Delta state Abraka. For 1992 dem establish Dealt state university and di main campus dey for town of Abraka and di oder campus dey Anwai Asaba. For 1995 di university make small amendment wey make dem bring out anoder campus for Oleh. Di university dey run Multi-campus system with three campuses wey get distance of about 200km apart. Currently di university get students of about 36000 (for 2007/08 session) di university dey do different programmes from di full certificate, diploma, and weekend degree programmes.

Di university dey offer post graduate studies go reach doctorial level. D staff/students counseling centre, e-learning centre, students accommodation and sport facilities with oder available support services.

Different-different place wey pipu fit visit for dia 
Abraka na favourite place for domestic and international tourism abraka attract many domestic and international tourists. Abraka Rivotel come dey popular because of di natural flowing spring water and e get recreational facilities for outdoor activities. Abraka Turf and country club nestles for di Delta state university town for Abraka.

Adamu Ncahama Baba-Kutigi (Dem bon am for June 10, 1956) na Naijá profesor an bifor bifor aktin Vice Chancellor for di Federal Univasiti of Dutsinma.Na for  inside Kutigi for Lavun loka govament inside Naija Stet dey tek bon am.

How e tek stat life 
Dem bon Baba-Kutigi for  June 10, 1956. E du e sekondiri skul for Government Secondary School Eyagi, Bida wey dey for Naijá Stet. Adamu bin kolet one satifiket for 1979 wey bi Nigerian Certificate in Education(NCE) fom Teachers Training College Minna wey dem don dey kol College of Education Minna. E go University of Sokoto wey dem don dey kol Usman Danfodio University. Na dia e get Bachelor of science degree for Physics. E leta du e  masta an Ph.D for Physics fom ABU Zaria. Adamu get esperiens for tishin an risahi, an e dey di Student Teachers Association of Nigeria (STAN) grup.Adamu stil dey di Nigeria Institute of Physics (NIP) grup, e dey di Nigeria Association of Teachers Technology (NATT) grup. Adamu don before bi di Deputi-Dareto Center for Preliminary and Extra Moral Studies an  stil bi memba of di Governing Council wey dey repiset di congregation for Federal University of Technology, Minna.

E life as Vice Chancellor 
Di pipul wey dem dey kol di Governing Council of di Federal University Dutsinma, Katsina mek di Professor Adamu Nchama Baba-Kutigi di niu Aktin Vice-Chancellor of di univasiti. Di senate of di univasiti nominate am for di 73rd emergency mitin wey dem du for March 2019. Bifor dem giv am dat posishion, Prof. Nchama Baba-Kutigi bi di forma Dean of di Faculty of Science an e bi di forma Head of Department of Physics for di univasiti.

text:
Gbadamosi Adegoke Adelabu (dem bon am for September 3, 1915 an e kpai for March 25, 1958) na Naija politishian wey kom fom Ibadan an put hand for Ibadan Politis bifor Naija get fredom (Indipendense) fom Inglish pipul in 1960.Ibadan na one big siti for Westan rijion of Naija. From 1955 go rish 1956, na Adegoke bi di oga kpata-kpata for Natural Resources and Social Services.E stil bi di oga for di pipul wey no dey sopot Western Regional Assembly ontil e dai for 1958.Adegoke famili no too get moni.Na Adegoke wok by imsef to get moni an bikom big pesin for Naijs politis mata. Na Gofment Kolej for Ibadan e tek go skul an e kom bi big biznesman.Adegoke for mek am big for politis mata if no bi sey e dai for moto asident an e no too tey wey Naija get indipendense bifo e dai so. Adegoke Adelabu na pesin wey rili biliv sey mek we dey du di tins wey go fevo Naija an mek Naija kontrol evritin wey we dey mek for insaid di kontri.

How e tek stat im laif 
Na 1915 dem bon Adegoke an na Sanusi Ashinyanbi an Awujola Adelabu bi im papa an mama. Na im mama bi di sekond waif an im mama dai wen Adelabu stil bi smol pikin. Na im papa sista kom leta tek kia of am. E skul for St David's C.M.S. School, Kudeti, Ibadan fom 1925 go rish 1929. Adegoke kom finish standard IV an V for C.M.S Central school, Mapo. Opon sey im papa sista na muslim, shi stil mek Adelabu go skul wey Kristen missionari dey kontrol an e kom get satifiket for pesin wet don baptais. Dis one kom mek Adelabu fit go oda skul wey CMS dey kontrol. E stat im sekondri skul for 1931 an im finish for 1936 as di hed boi. E rait im ezam to enta skul an e pas wel wel so tey UAC kom pay for im skul moni an buk for am to go rid Commerce for Yaba Higher College. Bot im no yuz di moni wey UAC pai for am for skul finish, na just 6 months e don yuz for di big skul for Yaba bifo e kom bigin wok for UAC as di sekond oga for Ibadan district.Adelabu oga na one oyinbo man wey e don fest mit di year bifo im enta skul for Yaba. Di fest tin wet dem tel am to du na to waka raund evri ples wey dem dey du di Kokakola drink for Ibadan. Afta im don waka finish, e kom bring plan for how dem go tek stat to dey kari di miniral go difren difren ples an how dem go tek sel am. Dis one kom mek dem giv am big posishion for UAC as di sekond oga for di Prodokshion Manija. Bot im no wok dia for long bikos na for 1937 e komot for dia an join di biznes wey pipul dey du to bai an sel tins. Dis biznes no fevo am at all an bifo im sabi wetin dey hapun, e don bigin faind gocment wok. For 1939, e kom dey wok as pesin wey dey chuk eye for pipul wey dey plant difren difren fud an wey dey tish animal-dem to mek suo sey dem dey du am wel. Afta dis one, e kom stil wok as pesin wey dey chek wetin pipul dey du for one smol join-bodi grup wey pipul inside dey hep diasef an na Akinpelu Obisesan bi di oga kpata-kpata for di grup. Adelabu dey for dis grup ontil 1945 wen e kom go bak to UAC. Dis time araund di work gud for am wel wel bot im liv di wok afta di pesin wey tish am di wok, wey e nem na Richardson, stop di wok sef. E kom put di plenti moni wey e mek fom UAC insaid klot biznes wit Levantine kompini for Ibadan. Bot Adegoke kom see sey di pipul wey dey rul for Ibadan wey dem dey kol Mogaji an Olubadan no go skul an dem no sabi rid an rait, so e kom mit dem an bigin wok for dem as di pesin wey go dey rid an rait evritin wey dem dey du for di ples wey dem dey fom rul an joj di Ibadan pipul.

How e du for politis mata 
1949–1953

Adegoke wok for politis stat wen e join som smol shif-dem mek dem join-bodi to komplen abaut Salami Agbaje. Plenti pipul sabi Adegoke as pesin wey sabi do tins kwik-kwik an bikos of sey e sabi rid an rait, di pipul wey dey rul dat taim nid am to tek fait Agbaje. Dem nid pesin wey go fit dey hep dem rait wetin dem nid to tek rait abaut wai dem no laik Agbaje an na Adegoke dem see as wu go hep dem. Adegoke gri sey e go bi di pesin wey go dey hep dem to dey rid an rait as dem dey fait Salami Agbaje wey dey du biznes an e get moni wel wel an e stil go skul an sabi rid an rait, an na im bi di nomba 3 pesin wey nia di king pas. Dis oda shif-dem wey dey fait am, no laik di way im dey do tins an plenti of dem dey own am moni. Di smol smol shif-dem an Mogaji-dem no wan mek Agbaje bi di Olubadan na im mek dem dey du evritin for dia pawa to fait am. Adegoke rili put bodi for di wok an e rili rait evritin wey di shif-dem nid to tek ripot Agbaje to di oyinbo pipul wey dey rul for dat taim. As dis tin-dem dey hapun, na Adegoke bi di pesin wey dey rait an rid for di Egbe Omo Ibile wey bi di main grup wey wan komot Agbaje. Na Bello Abasi bi di oga kpata-kpata for dis grup an na e papa wey e nem na Aleshinloye bi di foma Olubadan. As di mata kom rish di oyinbo pipul, dem kom tel Agbaje to komot bodi for di pipul wey dey rul for Ibadan dat taim. Bot dem kom stil yuz dis one chenj som kain tins for di ples wey dem tek dey rul. For ezampul, dem komot one grup wey di nem na Oshun division from di Ibadan area, dis one rili ves som of di Ibadan pipul an e kom mek som pipul join bodi for smol smol grup to join evribodi togeda so dat e go swit di Ibadan pipul.

Wen di taim rish for di pipul for Ibadan to selet wu an wu dem wan mek e dey lid dem for 1951, di grup wey Adegoke dey wey di nem na Egbe Omo Ibile join bodi wit one man wey e nem na Augustus Akinloye an som oda yong boi-dem an yong gel-dem wey dey anoda grup wey dia foma nem na Ibadan Progressive Union kom stat anoda smol grup wey e nem na Ibadan People's Party. Dem du dis one to yuz fait di Ibadan Progressive Union. Adegoke rili put bodi for dis one to fait di pipul wey no laik di Ijebu pat for Ibadan, espeshali as dem don fest komot Oshun division wey dem di oga for Action Congress laik Awolowo wey bi Ijebu man dey sopot an anoda man wey e nem na Akintola. Dis niu pati win all di 6 sit go rich di Western Regional Assembly. Bot Adegoke kom tok sey e go laik mek dem du one smol grup wey go dey sopot NCNC bot di grup skata an 4 pipul fom dis grup go join AG. Adegoke kom rili put bodi wel wel for insaid  NCNC for Ibadan, e kom bi di pesin wey dey hep di  Western Province Working Committee dey rid an rait for evritin wey dem dey tok for dia mitin. Pipul Kom bigin sabi am as di onli pesin wey dey joj mata for insaid kot for IPP wey kom stil dey wit NCNC. Bifo wi no wetin, pipul don bigin to sabi Adegoke for evriwia for Naijá so tey for 1952 e kom rait one buk wey e nem na Africa in Ebullition. E yuz dis buk tek tok evritin wey dey e mind abaut politis mata. E wan kom stil fom anoda grup wey go rili dey fait di pipul for AG for di taim wey pipul wan selet di pesin wey go dey lid dem for 1954. E kom stil fom anoda one wey dem dey kol Taxpayers Association so dat plenti pipul go laik am bikos of di way im tek arenj di tax mata. Dis grup kom stil join bodi wit som pipul wey dey do fam wok wey dia nem na Maiyegun. Dem fom di grup wey dem dey kol Mabolaje Grand Alliance.

1954–1958

Adelabu an e grup kom rili bi problem for di pipul wey dey di grup wey IPU an AG dey kontrol. E rili wahala dem wit di way im tek arenj di tax mata an di wok of di pipul wey dia famili dey rul (Mogajis) for gofment mata. E kom put imsef as pesin wey dey sopot di way dem dey rul dem an di tins bifo dem di oyinbo pipul kom tish dem dis niu sistem. Wen di taim rish for di pipul to selet wu di popul wey go lid dem for 1954, Adegoke kom win plenti of di posishon for di Ibadan District Council. Dis one kom mek Adegoke bi di oga kpata-kpata for dat aria. Im kon be di oga kpata-kpata for pipul wey dey kontrol moni an evri smol smol grup for dia. Wen di taim rish for pipul to chuz di pesin wey go dey rul dem for Naija for 1954, Adegoke kom win one posishon for House of Representatives an im grup sef dem win plenti-plenti post for di House of Representatives. E kom get one taim wey e kom bi di sekond oga for NCNC for Naija, dem kom stil mek am di oga kpata-kpata of pipul wey go dey giv Naija pipul all di beta-beta tin wey dem nid. E du dis one join di one wey e fest bi as di oga kpata-kpata for di Ibadan District Council fom January 1955 go rish January 1956. 

For 1955, dem kom bigin chuk eye insaid di way Adegoke an im pipul tek dey do moni mata, to see weyda dem dey chop di moni wey dem sopos yuz for di Naija pipul. Na di oga dem for Western Region Government du dis one an na AG kontrol am. Dis one kom mek Adelabu tok sey im no wan du di wok of pesin wey dey kontrol som pipul again. Na one man wey e nem na J.M. Johnson kom stat to dey du di wok as di oga kpata-kpata of di pipul wey go dey mek sure sey Naija pipul get beta beta tins. For 1956, Adelabu kom stil trai to mek di pipul chuz am as di oga kpata-kpata for NCNC for Western Region. Im biliv sey e go win, na so e kom go bai plenti klot kom rait "Adelabu, Premier of the Western Region"on top, bot im an im grup stil no win. Na Action Group win am. E kom bi di oga kpata-kpata for one grup wey dey allways tok sey dem no laik di way Western House of Assembly tek dey du tins. Afta e lus dis niu post, e kom trai to mek suo sey dem fom niu Stet komot from  Western Region. Dis niu Stet sopos bi for di pipul wey rili get maut for di NCNC an dem bi Oyo, Ibadan an Ondo side. Bot dem no sopot dis e idea for 1958 bikos dem see am sey im du am base on na wi-wi mata. For stil dat 1958, Adegoke stat to dey tok sey e no laik di way Azikiwe tek dey rul bikos di tin na 3-in-1 mata wey bi sey na AG, NCNC and NPC dey insaid. E rili pain am sey AG folo for di mata. E tok sey dat kind tin no pure at all.

How im tek kpai
Adegoke Adelabu dai for Mile 51 for Lagos-Ibadan Expressway for Shagamu said. Na im wit one man wey kom from Syria dai.Di man sabi how to dey bai and sel tins. Dia moto nak anoda moto as dem dey kom bak fom Lagos.

Pekulia mes 
Plenti pipul wey dey tok abaut wetin don hapun bifo nau for Yoruba an Naija dey allwes tok abaut di pesin wey stat dis tok wey dem dey kol  "penkelemesi". Dis tin na di Yoruba way to tek tok "peculiar mess". Adegoke na pesin wey evribodi sabi sey e sabi spik Inglish wel wel. One day wey im dey tel pipul abaut di way tins bi for Western Region House of Assembly, som pipul wey no sabi English Kom bigin tok sey Adelabu say  "penkelemesi".

Pipul no am wel wen e rilis Sade song fo 2015, na hi-laif song. E du kontrat wit Olamide YBNL Adekunle Gold rilis e albom wey bi Gold for 2015, wey dey Nomba 7 for Billboard Wod albom shat. How e tek stat life

Skul wey e go
Adekunle Gold get Higher National Diploma (HND) for Arts an Desain fom Legos Stet Politeknik.

How e tek wok
2010- 2014
Adekunle Gold karia Stat wen e dey smol.E tok sey na King Sunny Ade an Ebenezer Obey bi pésin wey endey luk up to.Adekunle dey for e chorch smol quaya wen e dey smol an e rait im fest song wen e dey 15 years old.For 2014, Adekunle komot for di grup wet e fom wen e dey skul kom stand alone. Meni pipul dey kol am King of Photoshop wen e du one foto wey e dey wit Tiwa Savage. For December 19, 2014, Adekunle rilis Sade an di song dey amog muzik wet fit win di Best Alternative Song for the Headies 2015.

2015- Present: Gold

Afta Adekunle rilis Sade, E kon rilis e fest sinu wey bi Orente an na for YBNL rekod e rilis di song afta e don du Kontrat wit dem on  March 5, 2015. Adekunle nem dey for singa wey fit win beta singa wey get beta futsho for City People Entertainment award 2015. On July 18, 2016, Adekunle Gold mek pipul no di songs wey dey insaid im album wey bi Gold. Di albom get 16 trak, beta produsa wey wok for di albom na Pheelz, Mastercraft, B Banks, Slekaamo, Oscar an Seyikeyz. Na July 25 dem rilis di albom. Wen e rilis di albom, di albom dey nomba 7 for Billboard Wold Albom shart fyo di week 13 August 2016. Adekunle Gold komot for YBNL Nation wen e kontrat finish, E kon go du niu band wey bi The 79th Element. On January 15, 2018, Unity Bank pik Adekunle Gold as dia ambassador. Adekunle Gold rilis 'Afro pop vol. 1' albom on August 21, 2020.
On February 4 2022, Adekunle Gold rilis e 4th albom wey bi "Catch Me if u Can", di Albom get 14 traks, an som oda singa wey sing insaid bi Davido, Fautoumata Diawara, Lucky Daye, Stefflon Don, Foushee, an TY Dolla $ign.
Adekunle Gold wok wit difren produsa laik: Seyifunmi, Davayo, Rymez, Lekka, TMXO, Tay Iwar, Blaise Beatz, Kali, Que Beats, an Spax for di "Catch me if u Can".

E pasonal laif
Adekunle mari Simi on January 2019 afta dey don dey date for 5 years. Dem bon baby in May 2020. 

Adekunle tok sey di fest moto wey e get na Honda 1999 'Baby Boy' (Accord) an na fom e frend for Ghana e buy am. Adekunle kon tok sey di moto skata wen im frend kari am Kombat. Gold tok sey e sel di moto for 400,000 naira, afta e don du di moto.

Som pipul tok sey Adekunle dey mari Teminikan, wey dey du muzik vidio, for Simi bak. Di nius fest kom out for insaid Gistlover nius, wey sho pipul di gel foto, kon tel am sey mek shi run fo am. Gistlover kon stil sho pipul wey dey for Instagram foto wey komfam sey Simi sef no abaut am. 

For July 15 2022, singa Adekunle Gold tel pipul sey e na sikla an sey na fom smol di disease don dey du am. Gold tok sey im du "5 star" song bikos of di sikla.

text:
Ademola Nurudeen Jackson Adeleke (dem bon am for May 13, 1960) na Naija politishian wey dem bon for   Enugu Siti. E na one taim senator wey bin don repiset Osun-West Senatorial District fom 2017 kom rish 2019.Adeleke bi memba of di popula Adeleke famili of Ede insaid Osun Stet. Na Adeleke win 2022 Osun State Gubernatorial Election afta e  win Adegboyega Isiaka Oyetola wey bi di preset  Gofnor. Adegboyega Isiaka Oyetola don fest win  Ademola Adeleke for di 2018 Osun State Gubernatorial Election rerun.

How e tek go skul
Adeleke du e pamari skul for Methodist Primary School, Surulere Lagos State bifor e go Oyo Stet wia e go Nawarudeen Primary School, Ikire.Adeleke fom dia enta Seventh Day Adventist Secondary School, Ede wey dey Old Oyo Stet an e leta go Ede Muslim Grammar School Ede, wia e finish e sekondiri skul. Afta Adeleke do e sekondiri skul finish, e go United States of America (USA) go join e two elda broda. Na for I said USA e go rid Criminal Justice an Political Science for Jacksonville State University, Alabama. 
Afta wen meni wahala bikos dey tok sey e no kolifae to bi gofnor bikos e no get satifiket, Adeleke go Atlanta Metropolitan State College insaid USA wie e go get e Bachelor of Science Degree in Criminal Justice for 2021.

How e tek wok

Pat of wok wey Govament no dey put hand
Adeleke na biznesman an administrator wey bin don saf as Executive Director of Guinness Nigeria Plc fom 1992 go rish 1999.Som of di oda pipul wey folo am daret di kompini bi General Theophilus Danjuma.Adeleke don also saf as Group Executive Director for Pacific Holdings Limited wey bi e broda kompini fom 2001 go rish 2016.Bifor Adeleke enta Pacific Holdings Limited, e don wok as Service Contractor for Quicksilver Courier Company in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, fom 1985 go rish 1989 an Vice presidor for Origin International LLC wey dey Atlanta, Georgia, US,A wey bi one flavours an pefume fragrance kompini fom 1990 go rish 1994.

Politis
Adeleke na komuniti memba an pesin wey dey dash moni an propati wey enta politis for 2001 with e late broda Senator Isiaka Adeleke wey dai for April 2017. E kontest di Osun west 2017 senatorial by-election afta e broda dai an dey kom pik am onda di parti People's Democratic Party.

For July 23 2018, PDP chuz Adeleke as dia kandidate for gofnor as e win Akin Ogunniyi with seven vote.E kontest to di gofnor  Alhaji Gboyega Oyetola of APC an Iyiola Omisore of SDP on September 22, 2018. Na dis eleshion wey Independent Electoral Commission (INEC) to sey nobodi win an sey dey go du anoda eleshion for September 27, 2018.Wen dey du anoda eleshion, na APC kandidate Oyetola win an Adeleke tok sey e no gree bikos wayo wayo dey di eleshion.

For March 22, 2019, di eleshion panel wey  wey sit for Abuja tok sey na Adeleke win di eleshion bot di kot wey big pass for Naija (Supreme Kot) kom tok sexy na Gboyega Oyetola na im win di 2018 Osun State Governorship Election on Friday, 5 July 2019.

Adeleke kom stil kontest di Governorship Election of Osun State on July 16, 2022 onda di PDP wit APC  gofnor Gboyega Oyetola an Adeleke kom win witb402,979 votes an Gboyega Oyetola get 375,077 votes. Di lokal Govament wey Adeleke win na 17 local govament arias an som of Dem na Olorunda, Ede South, Orolu, Osogbo, Odo Otin, Ifelodun, Atakumosa, and Ila.

Pasonal laif
Adeleke get eight pikin-dem an som of dia nem na B-Red, Ayootola, Goke, Sinarambo, Adenike, Folasade. Davido no bi e pikin bot family memba (e broda Pikin).

text:
Adeniran Ogunsanya, QC, SAN (Dem bon am for January 31, 1918 an e dai for November 22, 1996) na Naija lorya an politishan. E join bodi fom  Ibadan Pipul Parti (IPP). E saf as di oga kpata-kpata for pipul wey dey joj mata for kot an for skul mata for Legos Stet. For di sekond ripublik, im na di oga kpata-kpata for di Nigeria People's Party.

Tori of e laif 
Dem bon am for one pat of Legos wey bi Ikorodu for January 31, 1918 insaid one famili wey dey rul wey bi Omoba Suberu Ogunsanya Oguntade wey bi di Odofin of Ikorodu. E finish im primari skul for Hope Waddell Training Institute for kalabar an na one of im papa broda wey dey wok for govament train am.Wen dey rait di Govament Standard VI ezam for 1937, na Adeniran Ogunsanya get mark wet hi pas. Dis one kom mek govament pai for all e skul moni an buk as dem send am go King's College for Legos. Adeniran stil go rid  lo for big big skul laik University of Manchester an Gray's school of law.

How e tek wok 
Afta e kom bak fom United Kingdom, Adeniran fest stat to dey wok as pesin wey dey joj pipul mata for kot for Chief T.O.S Benson Chambers an e stil bi politishan. For 1956, e and im broda wey e nem na Sulu Ogunsanya join bodi togeda to stat Ogunsanya & Ogunsanya Chambers.

How e tek du politiks 
As dem dey for di middu of 1950, Adeniran Ogunsanya folo for pipul wey wok for di  National Executive Committee for inside di National Council of Nigeria and the Cameroons(NCNC). Na Adeniran bi di oga kpata-kpata for di Youth Association an e kom bi pat of di pipul wey go stand for Ikeja an Mushin pipul for parliament for 1959. Adeniran wok for plenti plenti post for insaid di politikal parti wey im dey an im kom stil wok for lokal govament for Legos. For insaid NCNC, e get one taim wey im bi di oga kpata-kpata for di pipul wey dey wok for di one wey dey Legos Stet.Adeniran stil bi di zonal oga for koloni provins an afta, e kom bi di seketri for di pipul wey bi sey na dem bi di oga dem for NCNC.E bi oga for smol smol politiks laik di Mushin District Council Management Committee. Bifor di fest ripublik finish, dem mek am di oga pata-pata for pipul wey dey du house and land mata for di hol Naija. Wen Mobolaji Johnson bi di lida, dem kom mek Adeniran di oga pata-pata for skul mata for di hol Legos stet. Im bi di oga pata-pata for di Legos progressives wey kom stil folo three oda grup join-bodi to form di Nigeria People's Party (NPP) for di Sekond Ripublik. Bifor Adenira Ogunsanya bi di oga pata-pata for di Nigeria People's Party (NPP), e don fest kontest wit Lateef Jakande bot Adeniran no win. Bot wen Olu Akinfosile don bi oga pata-pata for NPP finish, Adeniran kom bi di next oga pata-pata for NPP.Adeniran bi di fest Attorney General for di hol Legos an e kom lẹta  bi di oga pata-pata for skul mata  for di hol Legos.

How pipul tek dey rimemba am 
Bikos of di way im put bodi wel wel to mek Legos Stet beta, dem yuz im nem for one big skul for Legos wey dem dey kol Adeniran Ogunsanya College Of Education.
Adeniran na also  Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN) an stil get one beta tin as lorya wey dem dey kol Queen's kounsel.

Tolulope Adesua Etomi-Wellington wey pipul sabi as Adesua Etomi na Naijá aktres. Na for 2014 e du e fest fim wey bi Knocking on Heaven's Door.Etomi win di Best Actress for Drama awod for di 2016 Africa Magic Viewers Choice Awards for di e pat for di fim wey bi Falling for 2015.

Tori of e laif an skul wey e go
Dem bon Adesua Etomi for Owerri, Imo State in Naijá. Plenti niuz tok sey na 1988 dem bon am. For one intaviu wey Etomi du for January 2016, Etomi tok for Pulse Nigeria  sey e bi 29 years old. Anoda niuz wey bi Answers Africa for March 2016 tok sey e bi 30 years old.Etomi papa na souja wey kom fom Esan pipul an e mama na Engineer wey bi Yoruba pesin. Na im smol pas for di three pikin wey im papa an mama bon. Etomi go skul for Corona School wey dey for Victoria Island, Lagos bifo e kom go United Kingdom wen e bi 13 years old. Etomi kom leta get diploma for "Physical Theatre, musical theatre and performing arts" fom City College Conventry for 2014. Afta e don finish di kose for 2016, Etomi go rid drama an performance arts for University of Wolverhampton wie e finish wit First Class honours.

How e tek wok
Etomi du fim laik The Arbitration, The Wedding Party and Faling. Di way e tek  du for di fim wey get di nemFalling mek am win 2016 Africa Magic Viewers Choice Award for Best Actress in Drama. Oda fim wey Etomi du na A Soldier's Story (2015), Out of Luck (2015) an Couple of Days (2016). For di fourth and fifth season of Shuga wey bi fim abaut how pipul fit prevent HIV/AIDS, Etomi akt as Shiela for di fim.

Pasomal laif
Etomi du engagement with Banky W for February 2017. Dia two kom do dia traditional marriage for 19 November, court wedding for 20 November and white wedding for 25 November 2017. Dem do di white wedding for Cape Town, South Africa. For January 2021, Adesua and Banky bon boy pikin wey dem kol Hazaiah Wellington.

For 5 April 2021, Adesua and Banky tok about dia marriage for one tori wey dem kol Final Say Faith for inside Waterbook church.

Adewale Ayuba, wey pipul dey kol Mr Johnson na Naija muzishan. Som pipul stil dey kol am Bonsue-fuji masta.

How im tak stat laif an skul
Adewale Ayuba wey dem bon for May 6, 1966, for Ikenne Remo, Ogun Stet, Naijiria. E don tey for muzik an na for  eight year e don stat to dey sing for smol smol plaz. Afta, Ayuba kom go skul for Remo Secondary School e kon tek muzik as e karia. Wen im dey Ogun Stet politeknik Abeokuta, na muzik dey tek no am.Ayuba fest
abom na Ibere (Begining) wey e du wen im bi 17 years mek pipul sabi am wel wel.Ayuba du kontrat wit Sony Muzik for 1990.E du anoda rekod wey mek pipul sabi am wel wel wey bi Bubble. Na Bubble rekod mek am win awod for Nigerian Music Award (NMA). Di song wey im sing mek am win Artist of the Year Award, Abom of the Year, Song of the Year Award an Best Fuji Artist of the Year, Na four awod im kolet for di Bubble 
abom. 

Di way Ayuba dey yuz im vois dey sing difren fom oda Fuji pipul na dat one mek e fuji song difren. Pipul wey no laik fuji stat to dey laik am bikos di way wey Ayuba dey sing. Afta pipul don laik Bubble rekod wey im du, Ayuba kom du anoda one wey bi, Mr. Johnson Play for Me (wey dey for Sony Music Nigeria label), wey pipul laik wel wel for 1992. For 1993 Ayuba sign for Premier Muzik (Nigeria). Ayuba du sho for Afrika kontri. Im du wel for di sho for Afrika na im mek dem arenj anoda one for am for US, for dat same 1993. Dem like Ayuba wel wel sotay one Oyinbo buk salut am, di buk nem na Los Angeles weekly Magazine.

Tori of e futbol karia

Roma 
Wahab stat to plai bol for ovasee for Italy for one Klub wey di nem na Reggiana.E bin plai wit Obafemi Martins an som oda Naija pleya-dem. For July 2001, Roma bin sign Wahab an Obafemi Martins for 3 billion lire from Reggiana and dem kolet Giuseppe Di Masi for 2.5 billion lire. For 2001-02 seesin dem loan Wahab bak to Reggiana.For di 2002-03 seesin e plai for Roma Primavera team an for 2003-04 seesin dem promot di tim go fest tim.Wahab plai one taim for Serie A an one taim for di 2003-04 UEFA Cup wen e enta for Daniele De Rossi against FK Vardar. Wahab stil plai for Bologna for di 2001 Torneo Citta di Arco.

Bellinzona 
For 2007, AC Bellinzona sign Wahab. For di 2009-10 seesin, e go SE Eivissa-Ibiza an e plai smol frendili mash wit dem.Di Klub no du di transfa bikos dem komot di klub fom wey dem dey. Afta som taim dem vet pamishion to enta bot as niu klub wey dem dey kol UD Ibiza-Eivissa.

For October an November, Wahab plai two lig games for Bellinzona. For January 2010, dem no add e nem for di tim bot dey leta add am for di offishial tim rosta for 2010-11 seesin.

Ado Ahmad Gidan Dabino (MON) na Hausa langwej raita, buk meka, poblisha, Niuz ripota, fim produsa, dareto an aktor. E rait difren buk on top difren tins for abaut 30 years. E don poblish 15 buk. On September 29 2014, foma Presido Goodluck Ebele Jonathan gif am awod as The Member of the Order of the Niger  (MON) to honor am.

Tori abaut e life an skul wey e go
Dem bon Gidan Dabino for 1964 for Danbagina of Dawakin Kudu Lokal Govament aria of Kano Stet.Gidan Dabobo stat dis informashion edukashion fom e papa. E kom go Zangon Barebari go lens Quran. E get diploma in Mass Communication fom Bayero University Kano.

How e tek wok
Gidan Dabino di CEO of Gidan Dabino international Nigeria Ltd, na one big maketin konsota fam mey don dey sins 1990.E bi assistant editor/distribushion manija of Zamani one Hausa Magazine in 1997.Gidan Dabino bi di editor and poblisha of Mumtaz Magazine in 2000.In 2004 im bi Editor -in-Chief of Hantsi Magazine onda di Kano Chief Bureau Community.Di Niuzpepa wey dey hep pipul to rid an rait in nativ langwej. Fom 2012 kom rish now, na e bí di Contributin Editor of Muryar Arewa, na evri month Magazine of di Northern Communication and Media Service LTD.

Novel wey im poblish
 In Da So Da Kauna 1&2, Published by Gidan Dabino Publishers Enterprises, Kano. 1991.  and 
 Hattara Dai Masoya 1 & 2, Published by Gidan Dabino Publishers 
 Masoyan Zamani  1& 2, Published by Gidan Dabino Publishers Enterprises, Kano. 1993  and

Fim wok wey e du 
Gidan Dabino na one of di pipul wey stat Hausa fim indostrie in Northern Naija wey bi Kannywood.E don rait, produs an daret meni Hausa fim.Na e bi di main karata in Da So da Kauna (1995), fim wey dem du fom di novel wey e rait. Gidan Dabino las fim Juyin Sarauta na e kolet awox pass for Hausa Movie of the year 2017 and 2018. E akt as Sarki Yusufa of Jadarwa. Im win two aword of di best aktor and one nomination.

Awod 
Di following are among di awards received by Gidan Dabino:

Dis awod na bikos e hep to contribute to di kontrie.

How e stat  life an skul wey e go
Na for  Queens, New York,  United Stet dem tek bon Adunni Ade to German-Irish moda an Yoruba Naija fada. 
Adunni Ade bi Nollywood aktress and fashion model. E kom Naija wen e bi two years wit e perent to dey e grand fada beria.Adunni Ade grow for Legos Stet, Naija til e almost rish 20 years bifor e go bak to United State so dat e go fit go yunivasiti.
Adunni Ade go Chrisland primary School.E go Bells Comprehensive Secondary School Ota, Ogun Stet for e sekondiri skul.Im papa wey bi Legos-bes , an soseful bizinessman na im go rid akounting. Adunni Ade get im digri for akounting for Univasiti of Kentucky for 2008.  Bifor e kom bak to Naija, Adunni Ade Don wok wit di Stet of Kentucky for Housing sector wey dey gif living assistance an also State of Maryland  Medical Insurance Department wey dey gif medikal insurance (Medicare and Medicaid) to pipul wey nid am.

How e tek wok 
Adunni Ade don wok for Housing and Insurance sectors for United States bifor e chenj to entatement indostrie.Adunni enta fashion modelling an sho for America's Next Top Model. Afta Adunni go bak to Naija, e fest Nollywood rol wey e akt na one yoruba langwej fim wey get di nem You or I for  2013.E pass 170,000 wey luk di smol vidio komedi skesh “Date Gone Bad” wey Adunni rilis for  YouTube for  2014.Adunni don akt inside meni oda Nollywood fim both for Inglish an Yoruba langwej, inkludin som muzik vidio for Sound Sultan an Ice Prince.E risif Stella Awod fom di Nigerian Institute of Journalism for di wok e dey du to promot Nigerian Kolshor.
For 2017, Adunni Ade bikom di brand ambassador for OUD Majestic.
For 2018, Adunni rait an produs e fest yoruba fim: "Emi Mi - My Soul", na Saheed Balogun bi di dareto. Pipul wey dey di fim na Ibrahim Chatta, D'Marion Young, Sunkanmi Omobolanle, an Shola Kosoko .
Leta dat  year, e produs anoda Yoruba drama fim: "Ewa - Beauty", na Saheed Balogun bi di dareto an pipul wey akt inside di fim na Ibrahim Chatta, Yinka Quadri, Kunle Omisore, an Tayo Sobola. Adunni don akt insaid more dan 100 Fim for  Naija (bot for  Inglish an Yoruba pat of Nollywood).

E pasona life
Adunni get two son D'Marion an Ayden. E opun up sey e go dey tek kia of di pikin dem afta di marej skata.

Afang Soup 
Afang soup na vegetable soup wey originate from the Efik pipu of de Efik kingdom of Cross River State and de Ibibio pipu of Akwa Ibom in Southern Nigeria. E popular among Nigerians an som parts of Africa. E dey popular among di Ibibio an Anang pipu of Akwa Ibom and Cross river wey don mek dis soup part of their cultural identity. Dem dey serve am at home and fo ceremonies lik wedding, burials, festivals mostly fo di southern part of Nigeria. De soup dey very nutritious an di money wey dem dey use prepare am  depend on family needs.

Di ingredients wey dem dey use prepare afang soup bi dis: beef, fish, palm oil, crayfish, pepper, shaki, water leaf, okazi leaf, onions, periwinkle salt and other seasonings.

Agbassa na di nem of one of di two Urhobo kingdoms for Warri South Local Government, Delta State, Nigeria.  Di oda one na Okere-Urhobo. Oyinbo people wey bi British na dem form di name 'Agbassa' from him original nem wey be 'AGBARHA', wey dem still dey use till today. Di king wey dey on top throne for Agbassa kingdom presently be H.R.M Orhifi Ememoh II, (ovie Of Agbarha Kingdom Warri).

Communities Inside Di Kingdom
Na seven communities join together come make up Agbarha Kingdom (Agbassa):
Otovwodo ( Wey be traditional Headquarters)
Igbudu
Edjeba
Ogunu
Okurode (Okurode Urhobo)
Oteghele
Ukpokiti

For Agbassa, dem dey celebrate Iyerin,Esemor plus Iniemor festival every year. Another festival wey dem dey call Idju,  na him dem dey celebrate every two years for inside all the communities wey dey for Agbassa plus including Okere-Urhobo. This festival na him dem dey call Idju Owhurie Festival wey everybody sabi as Agbassa Juju wey get to do with the worship of Owurhie a god for Urhobo land.
title: Agbassa

text:
Agege na place wie pipul dey liv wey bi pat of Legos and na lokal govanment aria for di Ikeja pat of Legos Stet for Naija.

Histri of di wod Agege 
Di time wen di kolanut fam for Agege aria bigin dey gro wel wel e mek meni pipul for difren aria kom dia. Agege kom bigin dey divelop fast-fast an e kom bi one epotant ples to bai kolanut. Dis bizness dem mek difren kind of pipul to kom dia, for ezampul, pipul wey dey du jama jama (manual) wok wey no nid to go skul an Hausa plenti pass for dis one.Enitime wen di Yoruba pipul nid wokas wey dey du 
jama jama wok like to kut tree, dem go kol di Hausa pipul. Bikos of dis wok dey kom dey nem dat aria wie di Hausa pupul dey stey as "Ilu Awon Ageigi" wey di minin na 'Town (Ilu) of di pipul wey dey kut tress'. Na so dem tek fom di nem Agege fom di wod Ageigi.

Wie Agege land big rish
Fom di North pat of Legos, Agege long fom Dopemu road pass thru Anu-oluwapo strit to Olukosi down to Fagbola pass thru Osobu strit to Orile road down to Old Agege Motor Road wey dey opposite Nitel. 
Fom di South pat for Legos, e long fom Ashade retail market go rish Akilo strit. 
Fom di East pat of Legos, e long fom Oba Ogunji road up to Wis by-pass dey go rish Agege motor road for Nitel ofis. 
Fom di West pat of Legos, Agege long fom Abeokuta Express road fom Bandri with Ikeja Local government go rish Dopemu junshon.

How moni tek enta Agege bifor bifor
Di time wey Dasab Airlines stil dey wok, e ofis for Legos dey Agege.

Tins wey don hapun in di past for Agege
Na 1954 dem kret di Agege Lokal Govament an e bi dey wok ontil 1967 afta militiri Govament tek ova pawa for di fest time an kom join am wit di Ikeja District Council for 13 years. Dem remuv Agege fom di Ikeja Lokal Govament for 1980 an e bi like dat ontil 1983 wen di militiri Govament tek ova pawa again kom kansu Agege Lokal Govament.Again Agege kom dey onda Ikeja Lokal Govament for anoda six (6) years. Afta dat time, 3 oda Lokal Govament  don kom  out fom Agege Lokal Govament. Dem bi: Alimosho, Ifako Ijaye an Orile-Agege Lokal Govament Aria.

Pipul
Di pipul wey dey liv for Agege Lokal Govament Aria na difren-difren grup of pipul wey dem get dia kolshor an tradishion bot na di Awori bi di orijina pipul wey fest stat to dey liv for Agege.Som of di epotant grup of pipul wey dey liv for di sem ples for di Agege Lokal Govament na Ogba, Asade, Dopemu, Orile, Magbon, Oko-Oba, Atobaje, Gbogunleri, Isale Oja, Oke-Koto, Panada, Tabon-Tabon, Ajegunle, Sango, Keke, Puku/Olusanya, Oniwaya, Moricas, Iloro, Mangoro, Darocha, Onipetesi, Alfa Nla and Agbotikuyo. Di pipul wey dey liv for Agege Lokal Govament na pipul wey dey spik Yoruba an som nomba of pipul wey skata smol for dia wey no dey spik Yoruba.

Traditional rula
For Agege/ Orile Agege, di grup of pipul wey bi shif get three Oba wey dem no an accept, an six pipul wey bi part of di traditional grup.

Tins wey hapun
On 3 June 2012, Dana Air Flight 992 yuz speed tek fall on top plenti buildin wey pipul dey liv inside for Agege as e dey try to land for Muritala Muhammed International Airport and e kill all di 153 pipu wey dey inside di plane and 10 oda pipul wey dey for graund.

Education 
E kontan one campus of Lagos State University. 
National Youth Service Corps Orientation Camp wey dem no go change dey for Iyana-Ipaja Road for Agege.
title: Agege

text:
Ago-Oba na elektora wod 13 for di siti of Abeokuta Ogun stet Nigeria.

Location 
Ago-Oba (kamp of di Oba) na komuniti wey di Owu sektshon of Abeokuta pipul dey klem sey dem kom from di old oba kindom.E no kle weda dem form Ago-Oba 
wen dem muv kom dia during di 19th sentury Yoruba wori weda di pipul don kom there bifor dat time.

Di men ekonomik wok wey dem dey do na textile making, artisan wok an  to dry yus Moto dey Kari things. There houses for Ago-Oba na six to twenty dey stey an dem dey yus shalow well for wota. Dis wota no mit World health Organization standard an if dem no trit di wota e dey cos sirios health risk. For di past di wota get subject wey be perennial flooding but recently di komuniti don mek efot to see sey dem improve di drainage. Di Anglican community for Ago-Oba parish sav for st Michael's church.

Important pipul
Foma Ogun stet govnor Olusegun Osoba hod di tradishona title wey be Otun of Ago-oba among oders. For April 2011 presidential election Osoba kast im vote for Ago-Oba for kandidate Nuhu Ribadu of di Action Congress of Nigeria. Ribadu na dem tok di wina for di wod wit 142 votes to 65 for PDP and 5 for CPC. Foma president Olusegun Obasanjo im be Owu pipul. Wen im wife Stella Obasanjo die for 2005, dem kari di bodi from Legos kom winners chapel for Ago-Oba from there dem kom Kari ha go beri for Obasanjo famili kompound wey dey near ita-Eko. Alexander Adebayo Bada (1930-2000) sekond lida for di Celestial Church of Christ Worldwide im na son of di Baale or Paramount hed of Ago-oba foma president of di Ikeja customary court for Lagos. Di seriki of Egbaland, Dr. Lateef Adegbite get im Ofis for Ago-oba.

text:
For inside the city of Ibadan wey bi Mokola Hill, you go see Agodi Gardens. Originally, this gardens start in 1967 and na di western region dey manage am dat time. Di name of di garden bifore na Agodi Zoological and Botanical Gardens and na really high class recreational center e be  As case come bi, di Ogunpa flood disaster wey happen in 1980 for Ibadan really scatter di Garden and sweep away plenty animals for the place but thankfully in 2012, di government come decide to repair it and come re open the the place as the New Agodi Gardens.
Agodi gardens get better better features wey make the place dey nice, di correct features na di following; water park, children's play area, rides, picnic spots, restaurant, a lake and small zoo. Na correct and beautiful colours  wey good for photo like before wedding pictures,( pre wedding shoots), picnics, garden party, outdoor events, concerts plus include weddings. Agodi gardens na very beautiful place u go always like to visit.

Location
Agodi Gardens dey for Parliament road Ibadan, Oyo state. Na about ten minutes from di University College Hospital (UCH) Ibadan, wey come make am dey easy to find. Google maps and asking di local people around sef join to make am easy to find.

Entrance fee
Dis one na money wey you go pay before dem go allow you enter di place. Dis money or fee na 500 naira per person and another 500 naira if you want to use di swimming pool.

Refreshments
Di Agodi Gardens get a restaurant with plenty shops wey dey sell refreshments. Drinks from outside nor dey allowed into di park but food from outside dey allowed.
Dem get local shop wey dey sell palm wine, pepper soup,Asun and other local food dem.

Attractions
According to di tory, di garden get plenty side attractions wey come make am one of di reason why Agodi dey the list of tourist attractions for the country.

Water parks
Dis one na one of di ogbonge features wey Agodi gardens get. Na two water sides and three pools wey dey cater for children plus include adults dey there.

Lake
Agodi get a nice lake where visitors dey take a boat ride and enjoy other views around di garden.

Mini (small) zoo
Di mini zoo get lion, crocodile, monkey and duck. On top di entrance of di zoo dem write say di work still dey go on, so di number and di type of animals there dey excused.

Play area and rides for children
Children get plenty things to keep dem busy,so na perfect place to take children go for family outing and jolyment. Dem get swings, trampolines, a bouncy castle and plenty oda things wey children dey take jolly.

Picnic and gardens area
Everywhere for inside Agodi dey green and perfect for picnics, but them get some special picnic areas and this one naim bi one of di best thing about di place,  you go fit spread your mat, bring out your food and play games or even relax alone.
Recreational and relaxation spots na one importanta thing wey dey lack for Nigeria, therefore di Gardens don cover this gap wey dey lack.

Generally, Agodi Gardens na correct place to relax from all di noise and the hustling but e still get plenty work to bring am to the level of international standard so that e go dey kajiard for ideal destination.
Di visit to di Gardens wey never tey, dem show their plan to turn am into a very big resort wey go get hotel chalets, spas, a canopy waka plus include event center and other things   with di addition of all dis ogbonge facilities , Agodi Gardens go surely become a correct choice for holidays for Nigeria people and visitors from yonder in years wey go come.

Reference: Travel and Places.
Review of Agodi Gardens by Chiamaka Obuekwe.
28 June 2017.
Translated by Okochi Bosede (Iyawo Nna).
26 February 2022.
title: Agodi Gardens

Dey born Abimbola for Muslim familibl bot e chenj to kristen wey e gro up an na kristen e bi til e dai.For one niuzpepa wey bi New Telegram Neepaper, Abimbola tok sey na pastor e for bi if no bi sey e dey akt fim.

Abimbola go Ebute Elefun High School an na e bi di  Senior gel for the klass wey pass out for 1994.Afta e finish sekondri skul,e go Lagos State Polytechnic (LASPOTECH) an e kolet HND Satifiket for pipul wey fit mek fud  for plenti pipul an manej hotel wey Oyinbo dey kol Catering and Hotel Management.E go saf Naijiria as youth koppa in 2002.

How e tek stat  to akt fim
Abimbola stat to akt fim wen Wale Adenuga Production kom LASPOTECH, ( di skul wey Abimbola dey go) du one fim.Abimbola tok to di dareto of di fim Antar Laniyan sey e wan akt for di fim wey dem dey mek.Abimbola dey lorki sey one pesin wey soposs du one pat for di fim no kwik kom an dey sey mek e du am.E jost bi laik sey na Baba God buta e bread an Abimbola du di pat wit all e pawa na so door opun for am to dey akt fim.Di fim wey mek am popula na Omoge Campus wey Bola Igida du in 2001. Afta dat fim, Abimbola kom bi pesin wey pipul laik for yoruba an Inglish fim bikos e no how to akt.
Abimbola leta bikom pesin wey dey mek fim tu and im fest fim na T'omo T'ẹjẹ in 2016.Na for outsaid kontris for Atlanta wey dey Amerika na e dey tek fest sho di fim an na king Rokan pafom as singa dat taim.

text:
Omo n'Oba n'Edo Uku Akpolokpolo, Akenzua II  (January 7, 1899 – June 11, 1978) na Oba of Benin (di pesin wey dey rule di pipul wey kom from Edo for inside Naija) from 1933 to when e kom kpai for 1978.

Dem make Akenzua II di Oba of Benin for April 1933 afta im papa wey bi Ewekw II don kpai (r.1914-1933) for February dat year. Oba Akenzua II rili mek sure sey di Edo pipul go skul wel wel.

For 1936, e stat to dey among di pipul wey dey try mek dem riton di Bronze wey dey for Benin wey dem tif from di king haus an di ples wey dem tek dey serve dia gods bak to Naija wey hapun for di time wey dem atak di Benin pipul for 1897. Wen e stil bi di king, na onli two of di 3,000 royal court bronze dem riton bak to Naija. But dem riton two coral crown and coral bead garment wey dem biliv sey na Ovonramwen get dem an dem riton dem for di end of 1930. Di man wey riton dem na G.M. Miller an im papa folo pak dem di Benin propati an kom kari dem borrow di British Museum for 1935.

Oba Akenzua II kpai for June 11 1978 an im pikin wey dem dey kol Prince Solomon dat time kom tek ova. E kom chenj im title to Oba Erediauwa an kom bigin dey rule di Edo pipul wey dey inside Naija.

E famili 
E born im first pikin wey bi boi wey dem dey kol Prince Solomon Aiseokhuoba Igbinoghodua Akenzua for 1923. Di title wey e choose for imself na Ere, dem say d title na from one bifo bifo king wey dem dey kol Eresonye an pipul tok sey na king wey get moni an propati wel wel.

Na Princess Elizabeth Olowu bi Akenzua gel-pikin, na Peju Layiwola bi di gel wey im pikin bon an na Thompson bi di boi wey im pikin born.

Tori abaut e life an karia
Dem bon Akinsola Olusegun Faluyi for November 13, 1934.E midu nem na "Olusegun" wey if we chenj am to inglish e go min "Na Baba God win". Faluyi go Ibadan Boys High School, for Oyo Stet, Naijá wie e kolet e West Africa School Certificate (WASC) an e leta go Loughborough University wie  e kolet im fest digree (B.Eng) in Mekanika enninearin (1953-1985). Faluyi join di sarvis of di University College Hospital, University of Ibadan as Hospital Enjinia in 1960.E komot for di tishin hospital afta two years of sarvis as hospital enjinia to join di Lagos University Teaching Hospital (LUTH) in 1962 as Shif Enjinia. In 1975, Faluyi ritaya fom LUTH for 1975 go join Edison Group and Partners. E bikom di Presidor of di Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE) fom 1985 go rish 1986.Faluyi leta bikom di presidor of COREN.E kon still sav as Presidor of di Nigerian Academy of Engineering.

Akure na city wey dey for southwestern Naija an im bi di kapital siti. Na im big pas for Ondo stet. E get pipul wey rish like 484,798 for 2006 population census.

History 
De city na di trade senta for farming where dem dey grow foods like cocoa, yams, kasava, korn and tobako.dem dey grow grains like rice, beans, millet wey be the major sources of carbohydrates.

Geography 
E bi like 700 km southwest of Abuja an 311 km north of Lagos State. Di town dey for tropical rainforest zone of Naijá.

Religion 
Akure get various religions. Pipul wey dey live there dey pratis kristen, Islam an traditional religion. Churches plenti for di siti and di sentral mosque on di Oba Adesida Road na mejor for di city. Akure dey very pisful.

text:
Alex Ibru (1 March 1945 – 20 November 2011) na one time Naija biznesman, pésin wey é stat an dey publish The Guardian newspaper plus Minister of Internal Affairs from 1993 go rish 1995 for di time wey General Sani Abacha wey be soja dey contlo di kontry.

Background

Alex Ibru bi di son of Chief Janet Omotogor Ibru and brother of Chief Michael Ibru, wey bi di chairman of the Ibru Organization. Dem born Ibru for 1 March 1945 for Agbhara-Otor, inside Delta State. Him  attend di Yaba Methodist Primary School (1951–1957), Ibadan Grammar School (1958–1960), Igbobi College, Lagos (1960–1963) and Trent Polytechnic for United Kingdom (1967–1970), where him bin read Business Economics.

Business career

Ibru be di former chairman of Rutam Motors. For 1983, him bin join hands with newspapermen Stanley Mecebuh of Daily Times of Nigeria, Dele Cole also formerly of that paper and Segun Osoba, wey bin dey Nigerian Herald come start The Guardian in 1983 with 55% of the money coming from the Ibru family, wey Alex Ibru come be chairman.

The Guardian get many acada people on top him board, wey dey take style support Obafemi Awolowo's Unity Party of Nigeria, and the first editor Lade Bonuola bin get strong support the UPN. For the  other hand, Ibru bin come from a millionaire business family and Stanley Macebuh bin dey right wing in his views, so the paper try make dem balance things. As the paper bin promise to provide him readers news wey no get bias come keep to their promise,na him make The Guardian come dey successful and popular. Na this popularity make dem follow with the introduction of news magazines such as Newswatch. Di military regime wey dey dat time no too like the kind independence wey dat paper get,na him make dem begin trouble dem under military ruler General Muhammadu Buhari (January 1984 – August 1985).

Ibru carry money take sponsor Civil Liberties Organization (CLO),wey dem establish for the military regime of General Ibrahim Babangida. Dem appoint Ibru as Minister of Internal Affairs from 1993 to 1995 for inside the Sani Abacha government. Na this appointment by Abacha wey everybodi bin see as style to take beg the press. 

Ibru don tell his staff inside The Guardian say him no go ever join politics but apart from this, the man bin dey criticise the Abacha regime. For 14 August 1994,the government raid and shut down the office of the The Guardian offices although dem no comot Alex Ibru for his post. Dem no allow the newspapers to open until October 1994 after Ibru don apologise for any bad comment wey dem don make for inside the newspaper against government.

Alex Ibru kpai for 20 November 2011, for 66 yies.

text:
Aliko Dangote  GCON (dem bon am for April 10, 1957) na Naijá bizness man an pesin wey dash pipul moni an propati. Na im bi di chairman and oga pata-pata for Dangote Group wey bi difren-difren kompini an na im get moni pass for di hol Afrika.Dangote bi di pesin wey get moni bikos for September 2021, rekod sho sey e get moni an propati wey rish $12.4 Billion Dolla.

How im tek stat life
Aliko Dangote na Hausa man wey kom from Kano for insaid Kano Stet. Dem bon am on April 10, 1957 for insaid one muslim famili wey get moni well-well. Im Papa nem na Mohammed Dangote an im Mama na Mariya Sanusi Dantata, di female pikin of Sanusi Dantata. Na Aliko Dangote bi di grand-pikin of Alhassan Dantata, wey get moni pass for West Africa bifor e kom dai for 1955.
Sheikh Kumasi Madrasa na di skul wey Dangote go, an e stil go Capital High School for Kano. Wen e stil dey smol, e tok sey: I fit rimemba di taim wey I dey pamari skul, I dey go bui cartons of sweets (Candy) an I go stat to dey sell dem so dat i go fit mek moni. I laik bizness wel-wel, even for dat taim. For 1978, E finish fom di Government College, Birnin Kudu. E kolet Bachelor's degree in bizness stodies and administration from Al_Azhar university, Cairo.

About im bizness

Nigeria
Na for 1977 dem stat di Dangote grup laik smol bizness an na di sem year Dangote komot fom wia e dey bifor an go bak to Legos to mek di kompini big. Today, e don big an e get plenti moni an stil dey wok for oda kontri laik Benin, Ghana, Naijá, Zambia an Togo. Di bizness wey Dangote dey du wel wel na fud bizness, sement bizness an freight. Na Dangote grup stil bi oga for pipul wey dey du sugar for Naijá an na im stil dey gif am to plenti kompini wey dey du soft drinks laik beer an pipul wey dey yuz am. Di Dangote grup don komot fom kompini wey dem just dey bui an sell tins, but na dem bi di kompini wey big pass for Naijá an dem dey du shuga, sement an Dangote flour. For July 2012, Dangote go mit Nigerian Port Authority an tel dem sey mek dem rent their land gif am, an dem gree. Na dia e kom build im flour kompini put. For 1990, e go mit Central Bank of Nigeria an tel dem sey mek im transportation business dey manej dia staff bus, an dem gree. E stil dash Nigeria Sport Ministry moni so dat dem go fit repair di Nashonal Stadium wey dey for Abuja. For Naijá today, Dangote Grup don tek ova Sugar Market an Refineri Bizness an na im dey gif plenti kompini wey dey du Soft Drinks, Breweries an plenti pipu wey dey yuz Sugar for difrent-difrent way. (Na im dey gif out 70% of Sugar for di hol Naijá). Na im Refineri big pass for Afrika an na im stil bi di nomba 3 for di hol Wold, an e dey produs 800,000 tonns of Sugar evri year. Dangote Grup still get kompani wey dey du Salt, Flour Mills an dem still dey import Rice, Fish, Pasta, Cement an Fertilizer. Di kompini still dey kari Cotton, Cashew Nuts, Cocoa, Sesame Seeds an Ginger go meni kontri wey dey outside. E still dey du Oda important Bizness laik Real Estate, Bankings, Transportation, Textile, Oil and Gas. Na more dan 11,000 pipul dey wok for Dangote kompini an na di kompini big pass for West Afrika. Dangote don dey enta Telekominikashion bizness an e don dey du waya wey e long rish 14,000 kilometers so dat e go fit yuz am for di hol Naijá. Bikos of all dis one, for January 2009 dem trowey salute gif Dangote sey e try as e gif plenti pipul wok for Nigeria Construction Industry. E don tok sey:" Mek I tell una an I go still tell una egein sey notin gud pass to bring kontri moni kom bak to kom spend am for di kontri. If you gif me 5 Billion Naira today, na for Naijá hie I go yuz am du bizness no bi for anoda pesin kontri. So mek wi join hand togeda wok".

Odas tins wey e du
Na Dangote bi di bak-bone of Olusegun Obasanjo for di eleshion wey e du for 2003, na im mek am gif am moni wey pass 200 Million (US$2 Million). E giv 50 Million Naira (US$500 Thousand) to di National Mosque bikos Obasanjo an Atiku na im frend dem. E still gif ₦200 Million to di Presidential Library. Di gift wey e dey gif PDP parti pipul plenti so tey pipu kon dey komplain sey mek magomago wey di Presido promis sey e no go dey no go folo dia enta di kontiri oo. For 2013, Bloomberg Billionaires Index sho sey e don add $9.2 Billion to di moni an propati wey e get an na dat one kom mek am di nomba 30 pesin wey get moni pass for di hol Wold an na im get moni pass for Afrika.
For 2014, Naijá Gofment tok sey Dangote don dash Naijá 150 Million Naira ( US$750,000) mek dem yuz am tek fight Ebola. E stil dash Naijá 200 Million Naira (US$500,000) mek dem yuz am tek fight Coronal Virus (COVID19) so dat e no go kil pipul finish. Na Aliko Dangote an Femi Otedola stil promis sey dem go gif di Super Eagles Of Nigeria US$75,000 if dem skore goal for African Cup Of Nation(AFCON). Na Arsenal fans Dangote bi an e tok sey e wan bui di futbol klub, na Ingland di futbol klub dey.

Im famili laif
Dangote dey lif for Legos insaid Naijá. E don marri 2 taim an im waif dem don liv am go. E get 3 gel pikin dem wey día nem na Mariya, Halima, Fatimah an 1 boi pikin wey no bi im bon am bot na im dey tek kia of am, an di pikin nem na Abdulrahman Fasasi.

Awods an Grups Dem Wey E Dey

Awods wey dem tek trowey salute gif am
Dem gif Dangote di sekond awod wey hi pass for Naijá wey bi di Grand komanda of di Order of the Niger (GCON) by president Goodluck Jonathan.
Dem nem Dangote as di Forbes Africa Person of the Year for 2014.
For six years wey bi 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, an 2018 Forbes kaunt am as di "Most Powerful Man in Africa". 
For 2014, Im dey among CNBC's "Top 25 Businessmen in the World" wey chenj di wold for 100 years.
For April 2014, Time Magazine kaunt am amog di 100 most influential pipul in di wold.
For October 2015, Dangote dey amog "50 Most Influential Individuals in the World" by Bloomberg Markets.
Im win "Di Guardian Man of di Year 2015".
Im win di "2016 African Business Leader Awod" wey di Africa-America Institute (AAI) organize.
Dangote dey among di top 100 most influential Africans by New African magazine in 2015, 2017, 2018 and 2019.

Di difren difren grup wey e join 
Dangote na oga for Cooperate Council On Africa, an e stil bi memba for di Steering Committee Of United Nations-Secretary-General's Global Education First Initiative. Dangote stil dey Clinton Global Initiative an di International Business Council of the World Economic Forum. Dem gif am oga for US-Africa Business Center, for September 2016, na US Chamber Of Commerce mek am di oga. For April 2017, e stil join di pip wey dey kontrol di Chinton Health Access Initiative. E stil dey kontrol one grup wey dey du kampen.

text:
Alvan Azinna Ikoku (Dem bon am for August 1, 1900 an e dai for November 18, 1971) na Naija pesin wey bi politishan, pesin wey dey fight for pipul an pesin wey dey sopot edukeshon mata.

Tori of e laif
Dem bon Alvan Azinna Ikoku for August 1, 1900, for  Amanagwu Arochukwu, wey bi Abia Stet now.Fom 1911 to 1914, e go Arochukwu Government Primary School an fom 1915 to 1920,e go Hope Waddell College Calabar wia e bi len onda James Emmanuel Aggrey and na skul mates with Akanu Ibiam an Eyo Eyo Esua. For 1920, e get e fest tishin job wit The Presbyterian Church of Nigeria an Church of Scotland for Itigidi an two years leta, e bikom  sinio tisha for St. Paul's Teachers' Trainin College, Awka, Anambra Stet wen e dey tish for Awka. Ikoku get digri in Filosofi for University of London  for 1928, by di University External Programme.
For 1932, Ikoku stat  Co-Educational Secondary School for West Africa: t
The Aggrey Memorial Secondary School wey dey Arochukwu and nem am  afta di pesin wey e dey luk up to James E.K. Aggrey, wey bi impotant Ghana edukashon-pesin. For 1946, afta meni chenj for Konstitushion wey mek  more Naijá to join  di pat of govament wen fit mek law (legislative chamber), dey pik Alvan to join Eastern Nigeria House of Assembly an giv am Ministry of Education mek e kontro. For 1947, Alvan join pat of di Legislative Council for Lagos as one of three representatives for Eastern Region.

Ikoku mek di Govament to luk Nigeria Union of Teachers (NUT) side an na im mek Legislative Council gree di  44 NUT Proposals  to chenj meni law abajt  edukashon. E see meni shaleji for 1950s, wen di kolonial Govament no gree to kolet im NUT advais sey mek skull dey put on Unifom in Naijá. Afta wey Naijá get Indepedet, dey kom let mek skul.

For 1962, E kol for Education Bill of Rights sey mek Pipul no dey kolet moni for  pamari skul Edukashon wey bi six year in Naijá.  Fedira Militiri Govament kom gree in  1976. Todey, Pikin wey dey pamari skul Govament skul no dey pay skul fees. Dr Ikoku na big pesin wey Naijá Akademi an Edukeshon Pipul no fit forget bikos of e wok as e tey hep Edukeshon in Naijá.

Wen Ikoku no du Govament politis again, e wok join meni organasashion wey dey plan Edukeshon mata for Naijá. . E bi memba of Ghe West African Educational Council (WAEC) an The Council of the University of Ibadan. E stil bi Chairman, Board of Governors of the Aviation Training Centre''.

Honours wey dem give Alvan
Dem give Alvan honorary Doctorate in Law (1965) for special convocation for University of Ibadan, dem wan college after am,  Alvan Ikoku Federal College of Education, dem name one  major road, Alvan Ikoku Way, for Maitama, Abuja (Capital of Nigeria) and them put im name for Nigeria Ten Naira note. E die for November 18, 1971.
