text:
Ameyo Stella Adadevoh (dem bon am for October 27, 1956 an e kpai for August 19, 2014) na Naijá doktor wey pipul no wel wel for wetin e du mek Ebola no kash meni pipul for Naijá. When Patrick Sawyer enta Naijá wit Ebola, Adadevoh bi di doktor wey trit an mek suo Sawyer no komot fom di klinik as Liberia Govament dey shaut sey mek dey rilis Sawyer for dem bikos e na dia pipul an sey Sawyer get one mitin wey e wan du. Doktor Adadevoh no gre bikos Ebola wey dey Sawyer bodi fit kash poblik pipul if e rilis mek e dey waka abaut.Adadevoh bi di fest doktor wey no let pesin wey Ebola kommot for Hospitu in Naijá an dis one mek Ebola no kash meni pipul in Naijá.
For August 4 2014, Doktor Adadevoh sef kom kash Ebola an stat to tek tritment.Adadevoh dai in August 19, 2014.

Tori of e life
Dem bon Ameyo Adadevoh for Legos, Naija for October 27, 1956. Na Legos e stey most of e life.E papa na Babatunde Kwaku Adadevoh wey gud for Science mata an e papa papa na Herbert Samuel Macaulay. Herbert Macaulay na  one of di pipul wey fom Naija kontrie.E papa papa kom fom Adadevoh famili for Volta Region wey dey.Adadevoh papa Babatunde Kwaku Adadevoh na doktor an bifor bifor vas shaselor University of Lagos. Doktor Adadevoh stil famili wit Nnamdi Azikiwe. Nnamdi Azikiwe bi di fest Presido of Naija.Doktor Adadevoh bi grite-grite grand pikin of Sara Forbes Bonetta an grite-grite-grite grand pikin of Ajayi Crowther.
Adadevoh wok for First Consultant Hospital wia di imej of im grate-grandfada dey.

How e tek go skul
Adadevoh go Mainland Preparatory Primary School for Yaba, Legos for e noseri skul (1961-1962).E kom go yuz two years for Boston, Massachusetts bifor e kom bak to e famili in Legos. Adadevoh go Corona School, Yaba for Legos in Naija for e pamari skul (1964-1968) an go Queen's School; Ibadan for e sekondiri skull (1969-1974) 

Dr. Adadevoh rid Surgery ( how to du opurashion) in University of Lagos College of Medicine an dey giv am  di Satifiket Bachelor of Medicine/Bachelor of Surgery. E du e one-year komposerie housemanship for Lagos University Teaching Hospital for 1981.Dr Adadevoh spend e residensi for Lagos University Teaching Hospital an get e West African College of Physicians and Surgeons credential for 1983. Dr Adadevoh  go  London to finish e feloship for Endocrinology for Hammersmith Hospital.Dr Adadevoh yuz 21 years for First Consultants Medical Center for Lagos, Nigeria. E wok for dia na as di Lead Consultant Physician and Endocrinologist

E wok abaut swine flu
Na Dr Adadevoh fest warn Nigerian Ministry of Health wen H1N1 stat to kash Naija pipul for 2012.

E wok abaut Ebola virus
Na Dr Adadevoh  chek di Liberia man  Patrick Sawyer as di fest pesin wey get Ebola as Ebola fest enta Naija for e hospitu for First Consultant Hospital for Legos in Naija for July 2014. Adadevoh no gree mek Sawyer komot for di hospitu even dey Sawyer sey na onli malaria e get no bi Ebola.
Sawyer wan go bizness mitin for Kalabar bifor e kom di hospitu.Dr Adadevoh bi di lid doktor wey trit Sawyer.Di disishion to risk e life as e no let Sawyer komot for hospitu save Naija pipul mek Ebola no kash meni of dem.Wen dis happun, di Naija doktor don vex sey dey no wan wok again an dis wan mek mata bad wel well dat time.Adadevoh stil giv informashion an odas tins like nose mask to odas Doktor for dat Ebola piriod.

How e tek kpai an wetin dem tek honor am

Na Ebola Vairus kil Adadevoh on August 19, 2014 for Legos in Naija.Govament pipul kom burn e bodi an e famili kolet e ashes an du pravate berial serimoni on September 12, 2014. To honor am, dey fom Dr. Ameyo Adadevoh Health Trust (DRASA), wey bi one health Organasashion wey no bi sey na bikos of moni dey tek fom am.Di fim 93 Days tok di tori of how Dr Adadevoh an odas medikal pipul at  First Consultant Medical Center tek trit Sawyer an du so dat Sawyer no go waka komot for di Hospitu. Na Steve Gukas daret di  fim. For October 27, 2018, dem honour am wit Google Doodle for di day wey e bi selibrate 62 biday.
For February 2020, Naija Govament nem one road for Abuja wey bi Naija kapita siti afta Adadevoh. Di road "Ameyo Adadevo Way" join to Ahmadu Bello Way, one of Abuja's menjo an longest road. Dis  na one of the fest tins wey  Naija Govament tek  honor Dr Adadevoh for wetin e du for di kontrie bifor e kpai.

Aminu Bello Masari (dem bon am for May 29, 1950) na Naija politishan an na e bi di gofnor of Kastina Stet. Na Aminu Bello Masari bi komisiona for wok, haus an traspot for 1991 to rish 1993. Na Masari bi di bifor bifor Spika of Naijá haus of Rep for 2003 an 2007. Masari kom fom Masari vilej of Kafur Lokal Govment, Katsina Stet.

How e tek du politis
Masari kolet tiket wan bi govno of Katsina Stet for di 2011 eleshion onda Congress for Progressive Change (CPC) parti bot e no win di eleshon an na PDP kandidet wey bi Ibrahim Shehu Shema win am.

For December 2014, na Masari bi di kandidet wey All Progressives Congress chuz as dia Govno kandidet for di March 2015 eleshon.

Na im kon win for di April 11, 2015 for di Katsina Stet gofnor eleshon, im win Musa Nashina an Dr Dikko Umar Radda.

Aminu Massari enta ofis as gofnor of Katsina Stet on 29 May 2015.

Wen Masari enta ofis im kari di bifor gofnor Barista Shetima go EFCC bikos Masari tok sey Shetima don pak all di moni for Katsina Stet. Economic and Financial Crime Commission (EfCC) kon kari Shetima go kot. Gofnor Masari komot all lokal govment chairman wey kom fom anoda parti.

Aminu Bello Masari enta for sekond taim as gofnor of Katsina Stet for March 9, 2019  onda All Progressives Congress (APC) Masari get 1,178,864 vote for di Kastina Stet Govno Eleshon.

text:
Andrew Jonathan Nok, NNOM (11 February 1962 – 21 November 2017) bi Nigeria profeso for Biochemistry and di poblik afia seketri for di Nigerian Academy of Science. For 2010 na he bi di pesin wey dem giv di awod wey dem dey call National Order of Merit Award (NNOM), and fo 2013 e win anoda awod wey dem dey call  Alexander Humboldt Prize. E die for 21st November 2017 afta e sick smal.

Early life 
Dey bon Nok fo 11 February 1962 fo Kaduna State, Northern Nigeria. Im papa and mama com from Nok village fo Jaba Lokal Government Area of Kaduna State. He bi go skul fo LEA Primary School fo Kaduna before he com go Government Secondary School, Kafanchan, na fo dia e kolet di West African School Certificate for 1979, for di same year e enta Ahmadu Bello University and for their e kolet bachelor degree fo biochemistry for 1983, and e kolet master degree for 1988 and fo 1993 e kolet doctorate degree. E mari Amina Nok and togeda dem born three chidren: Anita, Amanda and Nathan Nok.

Political career 
For 29 July 2015, di governor of Kaduna state, Mallam Nasir Ahmad el-Rufai choose Nok and 12 oda pipu as commissioner for Health and Human services.

The Argungu Fishing Festival wey dem dey also call Argungu Dance Festival na one festival inside Kebbi state plus including oda northern states like Niger for north-western part of Northern Nigeria. The region dey blessed with fertile river areas plus plenty irrigation and orchards. Majority of fishermen  wey dey here be followers of Islam and farmers. Na Kanta Museum bi di main di main historical centre for Argungu for visitors wey dey travel from all over the world to see Argungu festival wey dem dey celebrate for four days in a year to promote fishing and unity.

Histri

Di festival wey dem dey take mark di beginning of fishing season for Argungu begin for 1934 to take mark di end of one hundred year war wey bin dey bitwin di Sokoto Caliphate and di Kebbi Kingdom. Dis festival wey dem dey celebrate between February and March every year na him don bring correct progress plus development to the states.
each every year.

for 2005, di fish wey win di competition bin weigh 75kg and big so tey na four men fit carry am put for scale. For 2006,di festival bin ban fishing on top safety concern for low water levels. As di festival dey important reach to the economy of the state, the government bin ban di use of gill and cast nets make dem take conserve fish stock. The Zauro polder project, wey bi one irrigation scheme on top Rima River floodplain wey dey south of Argungu, na him dem don criticize sake of say the reservoir wan flood di traditional site wia dem dey do di festival.

Activities

 Craft showcase
 Canoe race
 Agricultural showcase
 Cultural activities
 Wrestling matches
 Musical performances
 Fishing competition
 Swimming contest

Competition

Na di last day of di festival dem dey do competition where thousands of men go line up along di riverside, jump inside the river as dem hear the sound of gunshot come begin fish to see who go catch di biggest fish inside one hour. Di winner fit collect money wey reach $7,500 US dollars. Na only traditional fishing tools dem Competitors fit use and many people even like to  catch fish with ordinary hand to show say dem sabi.

Di person wey catch the biggest fish for 2020 Argungu Fishing Festival wey weigh around 78 kilograms na him dem give N10 million, two new cars plus two Hajj seats. Di person wey dey second and third position self get gifts. Na Over 50,000 fishermen dey participate for this yearly festival for Kebbi State and na di person wey catch the biggest fish be di winner. The President of Nigeria, Muhammadu Buhari bin attend the 60th edition of Argungu Fishing Festival for 2020 after dem don stop am for 10years.
title: Argungu Fishing Festival

Asisat Lamina Oshoala MON (dem bon am for 9 October 1994) na Naija fimeli futbola wey play as strika for Primera Division klob FC Barcelona Fimeli an kaptain fo Naija wumen's nashonal tim. Meni pipul agre say shi dey fo Afrika bes wuman futbola an one of di bes fo di wod, na shi get awod pas fo Afrika futbola, shi don get four Afrikan  women's futbola of di year awod. 

Oshoala don play fo klobs in England lik Arsenal an Liverpool, Chinese klob Dalian, an Naijà  Rivers Angels an FC Robo. Na shi win 2015 FA Women's kop wit Arsenal; two leaque championship  an a kup wit Dalian; an di 2019-20 Copa de la Reina an 2019-20 supercopa de Espańa Femenina wit Barcelona. Na shi bi di first Afrikan(an Naijà) playa wey go skore goal fo UEFA Women's Champions League final, an wey hep Barcelona reech final 3 times, an one final. On 16 May 2021, Na shi bi di first Afrika woman wey go win Uefa Champions League, Afta Barcelona win Chelsea 4-0 fo finals.

Na shi skore goal pas fo di 2014 FIFA U -20 Women's world cup an na shi bi di bes playa fo di tonament. Na shi bi di bes playa fo an sekond persin wey skore pas fo Supa Falcon teem who win di 2014 FiFA women's Afrika Championship.

Fo September 2014, dem mek Oshaola nem dey fo Member of the Order of —the Niger .Na foma president of Naijà, wey bi  Godluck Jonathan put Oshoala nem. Fo 2021 her nem dey insaid Forbes 30 onda 30.

Im Klob Karier
LIVERPOOL 2015 - 2016

Na 23 January 2015, Oshoala join Liverpool fo England's women's supa Leaque. Di klob manaja, Matt Beard, tok say shi bi one of di bes playa fo di wod. Na shi bi di fes playa wey go play fo England women's Leaque. 

Oshoala get wund fo leg an shi no play fo two month, Shi stil skore three goals fo Liverpool fo 2015. Di fes goal wey shi skore na di match dey play wit Brimigham City fo April 1. Wen Liverpool play wit Manchester City shi skore anoda goal. Shi kon skore di third goal fo Liverpool, wen dey play wit Arsenal fo 12 July.

Fo insaid January 2014, Liverpool tok say Oshoala don dey tok wit Arsenal fo niu kontract. 

Arsenal:: 2016-2017
Fo March 2016 Oshaola du kontract wit Arsenal. Arsenal manaja tok say Oshoala sabi skore gooal wel an shi bi beta playa for di teem.

Oshoala hep Arsenal win di 2016 FIFA women's kop final fo May 14. wey bi di 14 kop wey di klob don win. Oshoala play 13 times fo di klop fo 2016 an na two goals shi skore.

Dalian Quanjuian Na 10 February shi du kontrat wit Chinese klob wey bi Dalian. Na fo 2017 season, shi skore 12 goals wey shi tek hep Dalian Quanjuain win kop. Na Shi kolet awod fo persin wey skore goal pass. Na dat year shi stil skore four goals, wey shi tek hep im klop win Shanghai 5-3 mek dem fo tek kari kop wey bi Women's Supa kop. For October 2018 shi hep im klob win di Championship League fo di sekond time.

FC BARCELONA: 2019- Present Fo 31 January 2019, Fc Barcelona sign Oshoala fo loan til di season go end. Fo May 31, 2019, Barcelona kon tok say dey don du anoda kontrat wit am til di end of di 2022. Shi skore seven goals fo seven match wey shi play fo di 2018-19 season. Barcelona finish sekond fo di 
season wit 25-2-3 rekod. Na Oshoala skore di onli goal wen Lyon win dem 4-1 fo 2019 UEFA Women's Champions League Final. Na shi bi di fes Naijà an Afrika wey go skore fo Champions League Final. Fo di 2019-20 season, Oshaola paly 19 times fo Barcelona. Shi skore two goals fo im klob wen dey play Atletico Madrid fo 19 September 2019. Fo October, shi skore two goals wey im 
teem win Real Madrid. Fo January 11, 2020, Oshoala skore four goals fo insaid di 6-0 wey im teem win CD Tacon. Na Barcelona dey fo nomba 1 fo di table dat year. Na Oshoala bi di sekond person wey skore pas, shi skore 20 goals.

Oshoala Kain Gam
Oshaola dey play fo Naijà team as Atakin Midfielder. Pipul dey kol am Seedorf. Na Superzee som of im frend dey kol am.

Kontri Karia
Na September 2013 Oshoala fest play fo im kontri sinior teem.

Na Oshaola bi di bes playa fo di 2014 FIFA Onda 20 women wod kop, na shi kolet awod pas fo di 2014 women wod kop, shi skore seven goals. Na shi bi di bes playa fan sekond persin wey skore pas fo di Super Falcon teem wey win di 2014 Africa Women Championship. Na shi win di BBC awod fo women footballer of the year 2015. Fo September 2014, dem mek am Memba of di Order of Niger, na bifor Naijà president Ebele Godluck Jonathan give am.

Fo June 8 2015, Oshoala skore im fes 2015 FIFA Wumen's Wod kop goal, wen shi skore di sekond teem goal fo 3-3 draw wit Sweden insaid winnipeg. Oshaola dey amog di Supa Falcon teem wey win Afrika wumen championship fo 2016 an 2018. Shi skore three gaols fo di 2018 kup,wey dem play fo Ghana. Na Oshaola bi di sekond captain fo Supa falcon teem, fo di 2019 FIFA wumen's wod kop fo France. Na Oshaola skore fo di sekond match wey dey tek win South Korea 2-0. Na shi dem giv bes playa of di match. FIFA kol Oshaola nem fo insaid playa wey skore bes goal fo di Competition. Wit Oshaola di teem finish fo third fo grup A. Germany an Naijà play fo d nex stag,dem win Nigeria 3-0 fo di match.

text:
Babajide Olusola Sanwo-Olu (dem bon am for June 25, 1965) na Naija politishian an di korent Gofnor of Legos Stet. E bikom gofnor onda di All Progressives Congress (APC) pati. Wen e kontest for who go be gofnor primaries onda di All Progressives Congress egeinst di rulin Gofnor Akinwunmi Ambode of Legos Stet for October 2019, e no expet sey e go win. Sanwo-Olu finish from Univasiti of Legos, London Business School, Legos Bizinez Skul an di John F. Kennedy Skul of Govament. Bifor im kontest as gofnor, Sanwo-Olu bi manejin daretor an CEO of Legos Stet Propati Divelopment Corporation (LSPDC).

Skul dem wey e go
Sanwo-Olu get BSc for Surveying an MBA fom di Univasiti of Legos. Im bi alumnus of  John F. Kennedy Skul of Govament, di London Bizinez Skul an di Legos Bizinez Skul.

E bi associate memba for Chartered Institute of Pasona Manejment (CIPM) an fellow of di Nigeria Institute of Training an Divelopment (NITAD).

Im wok

How e tek wok for bank
Babajide Olusola Sanwo-Olu don bi treasura for foma Lead Merchant Bank fom 1994 to rish 1997.E kom muv to di United Bank for Africa as hed of Foreign Money Market. E stil muv to First Inland Bank, Plc (now First City Monument Bank) as deputi jeneral manija an divishional hed. E don be shairman of Baywatch Group Limited an First Class Group Limited.

How e tek wok for govament
Babajide Olusola Sanwo-Olu stat im politikal wok for 2003, wen e bi Speshial Advaisa for Koporet Matta for di den deputi govnor of Legos Stet, Femi Pedro. Dem kom mek am  aktin kommissiona for Ekonomik Planning an Budget ontil 2007.Afta dem mek am  kommissiona for commerce an Indostri by den Gofnor, Bola Tinubu. Afta di General Elekshon for 2007, dem chuz Sanwo-Olu as Kommissiona for Establishments, Training and Pensions. For 2016, Gofnor Akinwunmi Ambode mek Sanwo-Olu Manigin Daretor/CEO of di Legos Stet Divelopment an Propati korporation (LSDPC).
Som tins wey e du as poplik savant na di  supavishun of di Bureau of Public Enterprises (BPE) privatization projects. E still  set up an bi di Board shairman of Legos Sekuriti Trost Fond. Na Sanwo-Olu set up di LAGBUS Sistem an di kontrol & kommand senta for Alausa Ikeja.

Politis mata 
For September 2018, Babajide Olusola Sanwo-Olu tok sey e go kontest for gofnor of Legos Stet onda di platform of di All Progressives Congress (APC) egenst  di inkumbent govnor Akinwunmi Ambode. As e tok sey e go kontest, e get sopot fom pipul wey get mouth for Legos Stet politiks; inkludin di Gofnor’s Advisory Council of di Legos shapta of di All Progressives Congress and membas of di Legos Stet House of Assembly.
Na dis wan mek  Dr. Femi Hamzat, wey e sef wan bikom Gofnor bifor for di platform of  All Progressives Congress drop sey e no ron as govnor egen.
E win  di Legos primaries eleshon for kandidat wey wan bi Gofnor for di All Progressives Congress (APC) for October 2, 2018. 
Wen APC stat to kampan for January 8, 2019, di Govnor of Legos, Akinwunmi Ambode, an 63 politikal parti  sopot Mr Babajide Sanwo-Olu.
Sanwo-Olu yuz beta gap win im oponet, Jimi Agbaje for di 2019 Legos Stet jeneral eleshon. Dem chuz Sanwo-Olu as Gofnor of Legos Stet for 2019 jeneral eleshon for Legos Stet for March 9, 2019.
For May 29 2019, Sanwo-Olu tek oath to bikom di 15th Gofnor of Legos Stet for Tafawa Balewa Square (TBS) Legos Island.

Sanwo-Olu don du  difren divelopment  wok like road konstroshion akross mejor aria for Legos Stet. Sanwo-olu tok sey mek dem rimuv di imej of Fela Kuti wey  Akinwunmi Ambode put for  Allen Avenue for Ikeja  to mek how muvment beta for dat aria.
Dem go muv di imej to anoda aria for Legos Stet. Di Gofnor kommishon di Oshodi - Abule-Egba BRT Lane fo 2020.

Tins wey pipul dey ask
For April 2020, for di time of COVID-19 pandemik, dem sey Sanwo-Olu no manej di COVID-19 moni well.  PDP tok sey mek dem chek how di moni tek waka.
For January 2022, di Pipuls Gazette riport sey Sanwo-Olu administrashion don inkris di  monthly moni wey Legos dey pay to Alpha Beta LLC fom ₦800 million to ₦2.5 billion.Di desishun of di Govament to dey pay Alpha Beta big moni to handu tax mata don dey kos wahala tey tey bikos na di forma Legos Stet Gofnor Bola Tinubu dey kontrol Alpha Beta. Dem stil tok sey  di moni inkris bikos of Tinubu nid moni to du im 2023 presidenshial kampan.
Dem sey Sanwo-Olu agri to inkris di moni bikos E wan Tinubu soppot for e nest re-eleshion kampan.

Di kil-kil for Lekki
For October 20, 2020, wen End SARS protest dey happun, di gofnor tok set mek pipul for Legos no waka any how for 24-hour fom 4 p.m.,  E kom leta shift am to 9 p.m. bot jost bifor  7 p.m., souja an polis don kom skata pipul wey dey protest. Dem shoot an kil pipul wey dey protest an injor meni pipul for lekki Toll gate.
Bikos of di kil kil wey happun for lekki Toll Gate for End Sars protest  enta Niuz an pipul wan no wetin rilli happun, Sanwo-Olu set up judishial panel  to luk into di mata. Afta a year, for November 2021, di panel rilis ripot  abaut di shootin. Di ripot fom di panel  tok sey di shootin wey happun kill more dan nine pipul.
Dis ripot difren from wetin Armi tok, sey nobodi dai. Bot, Sanwo-Olu kwik-kwik set up kommittee to rait white pepar for di panel riport an di white pepa kommittee  deny sey any death happun.Dis white paper ripot wey deny di death kos kristism from civil society and protester.

Awod dem
Babajide Olusola Sanwo-Olu don kolet plenti awods, som of di awod inklud:
 Platinum awod fom di Legos Stet Poblik Savis klob.
 2009 Best for Human Capital Development awod fom di Industrial Training Fund (ITF).
 Merit awod fom di Association of National Accountants of Nigeria.
 Merit awod fom di Chartered Institute of Personnel Management in Nigeria (CIPMN).
 Merit Awod fom di Association of Professional Women Engineers of Nigeria (APWEN).
 LSDPC Impactful Leadership and Recognition Awod.
 Media Nite-Out Awod for Best Govnor of di Year (2020).

Babajide Olusola Sanwo-Olu marri Dr. Ibijoke Sanwo-Olu.

Babatunde Omidina (22 August 1958 – 22 November 2021) na Naija akto an comedian wen e dey alive an pipul sabi am as Baba Suwe.

How e stat life 
Na August 22 1958 dem bon am for Inabere Street, Lagos Island wie im grow bot im orijin na Ikorodu local government area of Lagos State, southwestern Nigeria. Omidina du im pramari skul for Jamaitul Islamial Primary School for Lagos an Children Boarding School, Osogbo bifor e go Adekanbi Commercial High School for Mile 12, Lagos State bot e get West African School Certificate from Ifeoluwa Grammar School, Osogbo for Osun State, southwestern Nigeria.

Omidina stat to dey du fim for 1971 but na pat wey him act for muvi wey di title na Omolasan wey Obalende produs, na e mek Omadina  popula. E Kom popula wel wel afta e act for muvi wey bi  “Iru Esin”  wey  Olaiya Igwe produs for 1997. E don act an produs plenti Naija muvi-dem like Baba Jaiye jaiye, wey  Funke Akindele an Femi Adebayo act inside. For 2011,  di National Drug Law Enforcement Agency tok sey im kari cocain wan travul komot. Bot afts dem kari di mata go court, di Lagos high court of law sey im no dey guilty, set evritin na lie lie. E lawer na di Bamidele Aturu, wey bi Naija lawyer and human rights activist.

text:
Badagry (we dem de call Gbagli for lokal langwej) na one tanwn wey dey near di riva an na Lokal Government Eria (LGA) wey dey inside Legos Stet, for Naija. I dey very klos to di siti of Legos, and i dey for di north sid of one smal wota for Porto Novo wey bi di kapital of Benin wey join bodi enta Legos for Naija. I com stil konet ples like Legos, Ilaro and Porto Novo together, an i shie boda wit Republic of Benin. Wen dem kount di pipu we live die for 2006, di nomba dat tiem na 241,093. Badagry  dey nie lagoon and ocean, dis one kom mek am bi di ples we plenti biznes hapun fo West Africa from 1736 to 1851, an bikos i get smal smal wota laik lakes we konet to the big wota, na im mek pipu com fit de bai and sel wel. For dat taim we dem dey bai an sel slev to oyinbo land, na di big sea we dem dey call ocean we de Badagry be di rod we konet di pipu wey dey buy an di pipu wey dey sel togeda.

Land we Badagry kova
Badagry dey for di saut-west of Nigeria, di Gulf of Guinea for saut, i de 43 mails sauteast of Legos an 32 mails west to seme we bi bod tawn fo Benin Republic. Laik legos Island, Badagry dey nie big wota like lagoon we get road we pesin fit folow go Legos an Porto Novo. Di distans bitwin di lagoon and di ocean dipend on hau di land bi, bot fo Badagry di distans no pas 1 mail. Di lagoons fit go dawn rich 3 mitas an e fit com up rish 1 mita. Di lagoons get difren taips of fish laik: Bonga, Croaker, Longfin, Pompano, Tilapia and Catfish. Di wota fo di lagoon de changi kolo as di sizin dey chanj, iven YEWA riva de flow enta di lagoon we de Badagry from di West.

Tori abaut Badagry
I get one Yoruba tori wey tok sey di fest pipu wey settle fo dis aria na Awori pipu we com from Ile-Ife. Robin Law, we sabi buk especialy fo West African histri tok se dis eria stat from pipu we run komot or we dem posu from die ples com setu fo die. Di Egun pipu, Ewe pipu an di yoruba pipu fo Oyo na pipu we com de live fo dis place.

Anoda tori tok se sum pipu we live fo one ples we dem de qcall Gberefu we de nie di Atlantic Ocean na di Ewe pipu we com from Oyo.

Hau Badagry bi from 1736 go reach 1840

One of di tori wey pesin no go quick foget na abaut di area na one oyinbo man we de do biznes and e com get  land for dis place. Di lokal pipu de cal di man YOVO HUNTOKONU, bot findings show se dis man na Hendrik Hertogh a biznes man we com from Holland.

Huntokonu e com to di west com setle fo dis eria bikos i de run from one African chief we de vex fo am. I rich the ples wie dem de cal Apa wie di Oba we be Alapa com give am land we i go use de do im bizness.

Badagry get i nem from di we pipu we de live die de survaive. Di main wok we pipu de do fo Badagry na Fishing, Farming an dem stil de do salt. Som pipu tink se di city get e nam from Agbede, one farmer we pipu no wel wel we giv im farm nam we bi Agbadarigi but di oyinbo pipu change am to Badagry. 

Badagry bi like passage wey di white pipu com kari slaves’ dem pas go difrent kontris fo di earli Eighteenth Century. Di ples we dem biwud to honor di slaves na im dem de cal “POINT OF NO RETURN”, an  dem put charm inside di wel we de die so dat if di slaves dem drink am, dem go forget hu dem bi.

Badagry gain from di fait ontop slave bizness we hapun between Porto Novo an Dahomey fo di end of Eighteenth Century. Bikos if fait hapun ontop any slave dat taim, na Badagry dem dey sel di slave come for chep pris. 

Chief Mobee na one of di African Chief we do slave bizness for 1983.
Dem biwud di fest two-storey for Marina, Badagry, for 1845.

Hau Badagry bi from 1840 go rich 1900

Bekos Badagry dey nie wota an e get road we pesin fit pas to enta Abeokuta and Oyo for im north side, i mek am posibu fo pipu from Sierra Leone an di Missionaries to enta am. Around 1837, sombodi we come from Sierra Leone we de go Methodist church rit one leta to de preach fo Badagry. Methodist church jus do missionary party finish for Gold Coast, so de com send som of dia membas to Badagry. The people we lid di parti na Thomas Birch Freman an Charles Degraft. Di Methodist Missionaries fest preach unda di Agia tree and leta de com biwud one bamboo church die.
 
For 1845, som pipu we bi de go CMS church an dey preach fo oda kontry dem com enta Badagry. Di group of pipu na Revs, Townsend, Crowther an Gollmer, two tisha from Sierra Leone, som kapentas an ol die waifs. Fo dia mind, dem bi won go Abeokuta bifo bot bikos one chief we im name na Sodeke die fo Abeokuta, de com dile for Badagry. Di group ste fo Badagry fo one an half year, de com biwud mission haus fo die wit two levuls. 

As tins bi, di wey pipu de change to Christian fo di fest half of Nineteenth Century no plenti fo Badagry bikos of di local wahala we hapun between 1851 go rich 1854 an bikos Legos don bicom strong group of pipu pas Badagry. So, as Legos don bicom strong colony and Nigeria sef don de gada pawa, Badagry com lose im power ova Legos.

Di diferent-diferent quarters fo Badagry

Dem divide Badagry to eight wods an ol di eight wods get tradisonal hed. Dem be  Jegba (Akran, Di  ruling  haus),Asago (Bala), Ganho (Agoloto), Posuko (Possu),  Boeko (Mobee), Ahoviko (Wawu), Ahwanjigo (Jengen), an Wharakoh (Vihento).

Hau Badagry be fo Twentieth  century
From 1953 go rich 1965, Badagry bi di divisional headquarters fo arias dem we dem fom fo Badagry laik Amuwo-Odofin, Ojo and Ajeromi-Ifelodun. Wen dem com bring Legos Stet Com fo 1967, dem use Badagry as one of di five administrative zone fo Legos Stet.

kulsure
Na plenti festiva dem de do fo Badagry, Dem dé dó Ajido Zangbeto Cult, Igunnuko Festiva an Badagry Diaspora and Heritage Festiva. Di Mama langueg of Badagry na Egun we Aja pipu de spik and dem stil de spik am fo Port-Novo. Badagry get religion we be laik vodum an dem stil get oda  religion we dem de do. Na eviri quarters get dia own juju haus, laik Nabruku at Ijegba, Vlekete at Posukoh, and Mathe at Adariko. Bot fo Badagry we don open eye nao, na Muslim and Christian ful eviriwie.

Di kind wok we dem de do
Di wok dem fo Badagry na Fishing, Trading and Tourism. Bikos Badagry nia di sea, an ol di slave Bizness we don hapun for die an ol di tori we pipu de hia de mek dem com Badagry to com si hau i bi di haus we Thomas Birch Freeman biwud na im bi Fest Storey Building an di Methodist church we bi di Fest ples we Missionary dem ste fo Nigeria. Di Governor of Legos Stet we be Sanwo-Olu  don tok se dem du one seaport fo Badagry. I tok say "ai don tel NPA say we nid 2 mor seaports fo Legos, one fo Lekki an one fo Badagry. Dem don Apruve di one fo Lekki but dem stil de tok abaut di one we go de fo Badagry".

Ples we de impotant fo Badagry
Di Royal Palace Of Mobee na Relics Museum haus we dem biud fo Nineteenth Century. Na die dem show wetin Chief Mobee do  abaut Slave mata fo Badagry an ol di tins we im son stil do to kontribut fo Slave mata fo Badagry.
Di Museum hausis dem show proof say oyinbo pipu rily com Badagry and com use tins laik Moni, Gin, an any oda tins take kari awa pipu go as Slave. So if pipu go die, dem de tel dem abaut hau dem tek yolks, chains an handkufs tek sufa awa pipu fo dat taim. Ol di tins we i hapen dat taim stil get sum foto an image we de show wetin hapen, an pipu stil de use am tel oda pipu tori til now. Infact dem stil de selibret am til tode say dem don Free. 
Anoda ples we de impotant na di Fest Storey Biwuding we bi di ples we dem ste tek translat English Baibu to Yoruba. 
Di Point Of No Ritun de fo Gberefu, an na im bi di road we dem kari Slaves pas go oyinbo Land.

text:
Bartholomew Nnaji na Naija engineer,innovator and one of di pipu wey invent di E-Design concept.

How i stat life
Dem bon am for Enugu State inside Naija and i go St John's University, New York USA where I kolet Bachelors of Science degree in physics. I kon go Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University for Masters and PhD in Engineering. I kon go Massachusetts Institute of Technology,(MIT) where I kolet Post Doctorate Certificate in Artificial Intelligence and Robotics. Nnaji join faculty of Engineering at University of Massachusetts, Amherst in 1983. Afta few years, I bikom di Founder and Direktor of di Automation and Robotics laboratory at di University. I bikom professor of Mechanical
and Industrial Engineering in 1992.Nnaji na persin wey like research, I focus on three major topics wey bi Computer Aided Design, Robotics and Computer Aided Engineering. Nnaji dey use di knowledge wey i gain from research create di word geometric reasoning, im believe sey most things wey we
dey operate get geometric configuration. Im bi one of di pipu wey invent di E-Design concept, 
wey dey mek produkt design engineers work together from different location to design,assemble and test di same product, with 
computer and internet/World Wide Web. Nnaji Move go University of Pittsburgh,
Pennsylvania in 1996 as ALCOA Foundation Distinguished professor of Engineering. Dem appoint am as di William Kepler Whiteford Professor of Engineering at di University of Pittsburgh, USA, where im still serve as di Founding Director of di U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) Center for e-Design – a five University-campus NSF Center of Excellence in e-design. Im officially komot for di University and return to Naija in 2007. In 1993, Nnaji kolet leave of absence from di University bikos im won kom bak Naija  and 
kon bikom Federal Minister of Science and Technology. Na im stat Geometric Power Limited, Naija fess indigenous-owned Power development company in 2000. In 2010 I serve as Special Adviser to di President on Power, and Chairman of di Presidential Task Force on Power. Im bikom Naija Minister of Power in 2011 and im resign for August 2012.Nnaji na persin wey get alot of experience inside technology. Some people dey du mistake dey think sey na im bi Dr. Iheanyichukwu Godswill Nnaji from Imo State, Nigeria wey bi Presidential Candidate in 2007,under di Better Nigeria Progressive Party (BNPP).

Naija Minister of Power
On 28 August 2012, Bartholomew Nnaji resign as Naija Minister of Power. Bifor im accept to serve as Naija Minister of Prof Nnaji com bak Naija from USA unda President Obasanjo's administration and im develop di Aba Intergrated Power Project (Aba IPP) base on di Lease Agreement with di Federal Government of Nigeria (FGN). Di Obasanjo Administration don stat di Power Sector reform in 2004 wey mek dem privatize di sector in 2011 unda President Goodluck Jonathan. Meanwhile, for politikal reason, di government break di promise wey dem agree with Nnaji and other project developers as dem fail to offer di ring-fence during di power sector privatization of state-run companies to end Naija power shortages. When Prof. Bart Nnaji resign from im position in 2012,di Economist magazine for one article "A Bright Spark is Extinguished" tok sey Mr Nnaji's supporters tok sey na pipu wey dey against privatization komot am form im position. One of di adviser of di presidential task-force on di reform of power "Nnaji na di best persin for di job but he was getting in di wey of other intrest. " One tok tok persin for Mr Nnaji tok sey im don face"totally wrongful accusations" and im decide to resign honorably.

text:
Benin (Ripoblik of Benin) wey plenti pipu sabi as Republic of Benin, na Dahormey Dem dey kol am bifor, na kontri wey dey West Africa. E dey klose to Togo for west, an Naija to di east, Burkina Faso to di north West, Niger to di north east. Wia dia pipu dey live pas na for south for Bright of Benin, pat of Guinea wey dey north of di Atlantic Ocean. Dia kapita na Porto Novo, nd wia dia Government sidon na insaid Cotonu, wey bi wia pipu plenti pas for di kontri an na plez wey dem dey du market tins pas for di kontri. Benin kova 114,763 square kilometas (44,310 sq mi) an di pipu wey dey sta dia for 2021 rich 13 million. Na smol kontri. Wey d economi na ontop Agrikosho, dem dey kari red oil cotton go oda kontri go sel. Wok wey dem dey du pas na fam wok.

Fom di 17th to di 19th centuri, pipu wey dey for pawa na di Kingdom of Dahormey. Wey dey for Porto-Novo an oda stet for di north. Dem dey kol di plez Slave Coast bikos Dem don du slaf biznes for dia in 17th centuri. France kolet di plez in 1894, kon add am insaid French West Afrika as French Dahormey. In 1960, Darhomey dey on dia own fom France. As dey stan on dia own, Benin don get dia govment wey dem chuz, dem get di own wey dem no vote for wey bi Military govment.

Di langwej wey dem dey uze wok for ofis dia na French, but dey get some oda lokal langwuej wey bi Fon, Bariba, Yoruba an Dendi. Christian wey dey kontri plenti pas oda religion pipu (52.2%), folo by Islam (24.6%) an tradishonal pipu (17.9%). Benin na United Nations memba, di Afrika Union, di Economic Community of West Africa State, di Organization of Islamic Cooperation, di South Atlantic Peace an Cooperation Zone, Francophonie, di Community of Sahel- Sahara States, di Africa Petroleum Producers Association, an di Niger Basin Authority membas.

Hau dey tek get dia nem
Wen French pipu dey rul dem an afta dem Stan on dia own on August 1 1960, dem nem am Dahormey, afta di Kingdom of Dahormey. On 30 November 1975, dem chenj di kontri nem to Benin wey hapun afta Maxist-Leninist wan uze by fors kolet pawa.

Bifor Oyibo pipu stat dey rule dem
For 1600, Benin wey dey todey get difren stai of politis an plenti tribe. Plez dey wey klose to water (Aja pipu, Yoruba an Gbe langwej pipu) an plez wey no klose to water (wey Bariba, Mahi, Gedevi, an Kabye pipu dey sta). Di Oyo Empire, wey dey east of Benin, na dem get solja pas, na dem dey kolet tins fom pipu of eni tribe. But tins chenj for 17th an 18th centuri as di Kingdom of Dahormey, wey get plenti Fon pipu, dey sta for Abomey an stat to dey kontrol wia pipu wey dey for water side dey sta. By 1727, king Agaja of di Kingdom of Dahormey, don dey kontrol Allada an Whydah. Dahormey don kon dey bi di sekond of Oyo Empire, but dem no faight pipu wey dey klose to Oyo for Porto-Novo. As Darhomey dey get pawa, an bi dey wan stil get pawa lik Oyo Empire, dey til wen an bifor Oyibo pipu kon dey kontrol dem. 

In di Dahormey, som smol smol pikin wey neva sabi faight dey len fom di old one wey don sabi. Dahormey stat to dey uze wuman solja faight wey Dem dey kol Ahosi (di king's waif), Mino (awa mama in Fongbe), or di "Dahomean Amazons". Bikos of hau dem dey tek dey len an win faight mek plenti pipu sabi dem as "Black Sparta", fom Oyibo pipu lik man wey live for 19th centuri Sir Richard Burton. 

King of Darhomey, dey sel pipu wey e karch for war giv pipu wey dey buy slav abi mek e uze dem du rishual wey dem dey du evri year. For 1750, King Dahormey don get lik €250,000 for one year on top Afrika pipu e dey sel giv Oyibo pipu. Dem dey kol di plez "Slave Coast" bikos of na dia dem tek du di selin biznes. But di nomba of pipu wey e dey sel go down bikos of wetin kourt tok. Di nomba fom 102,000 go down in ten years in di 1780's to 24,000 by 1860's. Anoda tin wey mek am go down na bikos of di Slave Trade Act 1807by Britian in 1808, wey stop selin of pipu.

Wen Oyibo pipu stat dey rule dem 
For di midu of di 19th centuri, Dahormey pawa don stat to dey go down, French don dey di land in 1892. In 1899, di French add Finland wey dem kol am French Dahormey. 

French dey get beta tins fom Dahormey an di plez wey dey around am. Wey mek dem kip am wel bikos dey blief sey dem fit ci more beta tins fom dem leta. 

French pipu kon du anoda lor for dem ontop land Mata, slef, Pipu wey don bai slef bifor go dey folo niu lor. Plenti pipu wey dey for Darhomey no lik di niu lor bikos e tok about dia wok Mata, e rish dia riligion sef. 

For 1958, French cheng dia nem to Repoblik of Darhomey an giv leef dem smol, kon leef dem kpata kpata mek dem dia own on 
1 August 1960, wey dem dey holways giv holiday for dat day to rimemba am. Di president wey kari dem enta dia na Hubert Maga.

Bold text'Charles W. Webb Jr.''' (dem bon am for April 17, 1910 an e kpai for May 15, 2010) na American Republican Party politishian fom one siti wey dem dey kol Essex County, New Jersey for inside United State of America.Tori of e life
Charles W. Webb Jr. bin finish fom Orange High School for year 1927. E kom wok as pesin wey dey kip moni for di Newark law office of George S. Hobart wey bi bifor bifor Spika of New Jersey General Assembly. Charles leta apliar mek New Jersey Supreme Court gif am Satifiket to fit wok as law clerk. E leta rid law for the firm wey dem dey kol Hobart and Minard (onda koret supervise of George Hobart) till wey e kom pass di exam wey im go tek to bikom  lorya for di siti of New Jersey for United State of America for 1934 an e don rait anoda two-days exam for counselors for 1937. 
For 1952, Gofnor Alfred Driscoll kom chuz Charles W. Webb Jr. mek im go saf as Prosecutor for Essex County.  Afta di Stet Senate don komfam am, Charles enta ofis on November 13, 1952 kom saf go rish February 16, 1959.

Charles kontest for New Jersey State Senate in 1959, as e shalenj  Donal C. Fox di Demokrat wey bi di pesin wey dey ofis dat taim.Charles kontest on top di Essex Republican Organization platform wit sopot of County Chairman William Yeomans bot e faze one strong opponent in di GOP primary: bifor bifor Stet Senator Alfred C. Clapp, who bin don gree to lid som kandidate wey bin get som reform agenda wey dey difren fom dat of William Yeomans. Na so Clapp kom tek win Webb wit votes wey passs 20,000(31,551 (72%) to 12,177 (28%)) an all his 12 Assembli kandidate kom win di primari. Na dis Webb defit for 1959 pamari kom klair road for Congressman Robert W. Kean to defit William Yeomans insaid di eleshion for Essex County Republican'' Chairman one week leta. 

After im don lose di Senate eleshion, Charles kom stat im own law firm, Webb, McDermott & McGee, wey bi sey na  medikal malpractice difense dem dey du. Charles W. Webb Jr. ritaya for 1975.  Im marry Rosemary T. Wiesel fom 1936 till shi dai for 1982.  Charles W. Webb Jr.dai for 2010, wey no rish one month afta im rish 100 years.

Chika Anadu na Naija fimmeka wey pipu no
for di fim wey i nem bi B for Boy (2013).Shi don writ and produce meni short fims.Pipu no Anadu fim for tackling issues of gender discrimination and culture pressure wey surround tradition for Naija.

How i stat life and edukashon 
Chika Anadu wey dem bon November 1980 for Lagos, Naija. Shi komot for Naija go 
du ha 'A' Levels, complete ha digree in law and criminology and shi kolet MA in African 
stodi;Human and sustainable Development. For one interview with New York fim Academy,Anadu tok sey shi like fim from smol but na 2016 shi reason to bikom fim direktor. Anadu kom Naija kom du ha youth service wey bi compulsory government work program for Naija Citizens with university digree. Shi  watch one Italian fim Cinema Paradiso (1988) na dis fim ginger ha to bikom fim direktor.

Karia
Anadu kom bak Naija in 2008 con work for TV and Fim produkshon, shi no tu like am so shi stat to dey writ and shoot ha own short fim in October and November 2009.Ha fest short fim "Epilogue (2009) wey dem sho for 2010 San Diego Black fim festival for united state of America Ava (2010) wey dem sho for Cannes Fim Festival's Short Fim Corner in 2010.For 2010, di New York Fim Academy kom Naija for di fest time, to train pipu for 1 month in direkting, akting, screenwriting and camera work.Anadu choose scriptwriting instead of direkting even as shi no sey na direktor shi won bi.During dis time, Anadu apply to di Cannes Cinéfondation Residence Program in Paris. Di 
14-page screenplay treatment dat was part of her submission was di basis for watin fit bikom ha fest feature-length film, B for Boy (2013).Anadu secure one of di six spots and 
moved to Paris to take part. She writ di screenplay for B for Boy (2013) during ha two-and-a-half-week stay.Anadu produce di fim with ha independent kompany No Blondes produkshon. Dey shot di fim for 17days, with Anadu working as direktor, writa, produsa, casting direktor, location scout, accountant, and lawyer. Na family money dem use du di fim.Anadu family contribute 70% of di cost, and ha producing partner Arie Esiri family contribute di remaining 30%. Dey sho B for Boy (2013) at di BFI London fim festival in 2013.Dem sho am for AFI where i win AFI fest 2013 Breakthrough Aword with $5,000 cash prize. Di fim premiere for Durban South Africa on July 19, 2014.

text:
Christopher Adebayo Alao-Akala (3 June 1950 – 12 January 2022) na one naija politician and police officer. Him bi one time Governor of Oyo State plus bifore bifore candidate of ADP for inside 2019 Governorship election for Oyo State.

How im tek stat life

Na June 3 1950 dem born Alao-Akala for Ogbomoso, inside Ogbomoso North Local Government Area of Oyo State. Alao-Akala bin start primary school for Osupa Baptist Day School, Ogbomoso wey him from there come go Kamina Barracks Middle School, 5th Battalion of Infantry for Tamale, Ghana. Alao-Akala bin join the Nigerian Police as Cadet Inspector for June 1974 inside Nigeria Police College, Ikeja. As dem see say him dey brilliant na him make dem recommended am for overseas training for Metropolitan Police Training School, Peel Centre, Hendon inside London. Alao-Akala don attend plenty trainings inside and outside Nigeria wey include Administrative Staff College, Topo, Badagry; Nigeria Institute of International Affairs (NIIA), Victoria Island, Lagos; Police Staff College, Jos; Command and Staff College, Jaji. Him also participate as delegate for two INTERPOL conference for inside Nice, France and Málaga, Spain.

Him pass Staff College (Psc) for 1990,get Diploma for Business Administration for 1998,Doctor of Civil Law (DCL) Honoris Causa for LAUTECH, Ogbomoso for 2006 come join Doctor of Science (Political Science) Honoris Causa, Lead City University, Ibadan for 2008.

Career

Alao-Akala bin join di Nigerian Police as Cadet Inspector for June 1974. Him climb from position of Station Officer to the post of Administrative Officer, Federal Operations at the Force Headquarters, Lagos. Him come later become Operations Officer, FEDOPS, Lagos from where dem come make am Personal Assistant to Assistant Inspector-General of Police then finally come become ADC to di Inspector-General of Police.

Him head plenty command posts for inside Nigerian Police Force wey include O/C Advanced Training Wing, Police College, Ikeja; Divisional Police Officer, Bode Thomas, Lagos; Divisional Police Officer, Iponri Police Station, Lagos; Railway Divisional Police Officer, Nigeria Railways, Ebutte Meta, Lagos; Area Commander, Western District, Nigeria Railway Police, Ibadan; CSP Admin. Gongola State Command, Yola; CSP Admin. Kwara State Command, Ilorin plus including Assistant Commissioner of Police, Agodi Area Command, Ibadan, Oyo State Police Command, Ibadan. For September 1995 Alao-Akala bin retire from Nigeria Police as Assistant Commissioner of Police in charge of Logistics and Supply, Oyo State Police Command, Eleyele, Ibadan. 

Apart from government work, Alao-Akala na businessman. Na him be the chairman of TDB Global Ventures plus including Parrot FM radio station inside Ogbomoso, Oyo State.

Political life

Alao-Akala bin enter politics as  member of New Dimension. Him participate in the zero-party local government election of 1996 come later join hand with some people to form UNP wey later join with UNC come become UNCP. Him bin participate in the Ogbomoso Federal Constituency (One) primary election of the UNCP in 1997 after him come win the chairmanship seat of the Ogbomoso North Local Government with seven councilors on top the platform of APP in 1998. Dem later elect am as vice-chairman of ALGON, Oyo State Chapter between 1999 and 2002. Alao-Akala form one political association wey dem call Ogbomoso Unity Forum, wey later jointhe PDP. Na him be Chairman of Ogbomoso North Local Government from 1999 to 2002.

Alao-Akala serve as Deputy Governor of Oyo State from May 2003 to January 2006. After dem comot him Oga that time wey be Governor Rashidi Ladoja, na him dem swear Alao-Akala put for office  of Governor in January 2006 and him serve for 11 months till December 2006 wen Supreme Court give order say make dem return Rashidi Ladoja back to office. Alao-Akala contest and win the gubernatorial election in 2007 on top the platform of People's Democratic Party (PDP) come become the Executive Governor of Oyo state for four years enter May 2011.

Alao-Akala bin defect to the Labour Party in Oyo State from the People's Democratic Party (PDP), then to All Progressive Congress, APC, Action Democratic Party (ADP) then finally back to All Progressive Congress, APC after 23 February 2019 Presidential and National Assemblies Elections.

Persona life and death

Alao-Akala sabi speak English, Yoruba, Hausa and Ghanaian languages (Tiv, Fanti and Dagbani) very well. He get seven children  and die on 12 January 2022, at age of 71.
title: Christopher Alao-Akala

text:
Computer Village na one information and Communications Technology (ICT)accessories market wey im location dey for one community wey dem call Otigba for inside Ikeja di capital of Lagos state Southwestern Nigeria. Di market na im be di largest ICT accessory market for Africa. Computer village na perfect competition market under di umbrella of di computer and Allied products Dealers Association of Nigeria (CAPDAN).
Apart say computer village dey sell information and Technology accessory di market also dey deal on repair of mobile phone and computers. Di computer and phone repairs fit either dey on software or hardware components depending on di nature of di faulty. Di market and di wide range of business activities give opportunities to computer engineers and technicians wey specialize for dem. Di market open everyday except for Sunday and public holidays. Dis daily business transactions and popularity don attract new investors and ICT dealers across Africa whereby e expand di market size and population with profound effects for Lagos state economy. Di ICT accessory market wey formerly dey for Ogunlana Drive surulere for early 1990s and di current location na mere residential area and offices. Recently Lagos state Government plan say dem go relocate over 3000 traders.

How dem take position Computer Village

Di market na perfect market wey be say no dealer get right to change di price of di product wey im dey sell or buy for inside di market. Di market get large number of buyers and sellers couple with large number of consumers wey ready to buy di product for certain price with respect to dia need and income. Di market no get Barriers to entry and exits from di market, dey permit long-term adjustment to changing for di market conditions. ICT dealers and consumers get di perfect knowledge of price,quality of di products and utility with zero incur cost for course of dia transactions. Di market also permit buyers make dem do rational purchases for di basis of information and price knowledge.

Di complain we follow Computer Village
       
Certain activities for di market wey no good or wey dey effect di progress of di market dis one make some number of good pipu across di country dey complain about 
am. some of dis pipu don painfully experience di loss of money and prize gadgets to di scheme of unqualified engineers and fraudsters wey dey use chaotic market as medium to rip off pipu or sell fake product and services like mobile phones, software, accessories etc.Di market get plenty stories about stolen phones wey be say finally dem go go see am for computer village for unregistered trader and retailers too. some of di transaction dey take place inside motor, walkway and display units instead of a proper brick and morter store. However dem get two major categories of traders for di market di registered and di unregistered or free traders wey dey sell for nomadic and uncountable fashion Do later category of readers na dem dey easily dey perpetrate di crime for do Market give dia drifting liberties OK now mechanism dey establish toward against dis unauthorized dealers, sellers and fixers.
title: Computer Village

How e tek stat life=
Na for Legos stet, Nigeria dem bon am for August 4, 1992. Im perent kom from Ile Ife for Osun stet. Na for Legos stet dem tren am an na thier e tek grow, na for their e do im primary an sekondri skul. Karier 
DJ Kaywise stat im karier as rekod  produsa na for leta e kon stat to dey du Disk Jockey. E stat in DJ wok for  2010. Na wen im rilis di mixtape "Emergency" na dat time pipul kon no am well well. E don rilis more dan 10,000 CD mixtape, over 50 online rilis mixtape an rilis meni muzik an visuals wit Nigerian an Afrika artist. 

Kaywise rilis im debut single for 2012, wey bi "hangover" wit Dammy Krane an Yung 6ix in 2013, e stil du song wit Iyanya wey bi "Loyalist". E Don rilis plenti single wit meni Naija musishan som of dem na Mayorkun, Naira Marley, Tiwa Savage, Olamide, Vector an Ice Prince. E stat im DJ akedemi for 2019 wet e lol do nem Kaywise Academi. Den rilis anoda mixtape wey bi "Revolution Mix Vol1" wey im du for EndSars 
Muvment wey hapun for Naija for 2020. For August 2020 E do anoda single "What Type of Dance" fishorin Mayorkun, Naira Marley, an Zlatan Ibile, di song dey for nomba 5 for Billboard Top Thriller Chat. Im letest song "high way" fishorin phyno komot for Desemba 2020. Do single dey for nomba 7 afta spendin two weeks for Billboard Top Thriller Global Chart''.

Di Joor Konsat
DJ Kaywise du di maiden edishon of im strit konsat wey im kol "The Joor Concert" for 2016. For one interview e tok sey di fes four of di konsat get plenti pipul wey kom  wey rish like 50,000(unverifiable). DJ Kaywise du di fifth edishon for January 2020. text:
Daniel Abibi (Dem bon am for di year 1942) na Congo politishian wey no Matimatiiki an e go skul wel well. For di year wey bi 1980s, Abibi wok for gofment for Congo-Brazzaville as di oga pata-pata for di pipul wey dey du announsiment to di hol kontri an as di oga pata-pata for sekondri an big-big skul. Afta dis one, in di 1990s, e kom bi di pesin wey dey stand for Congo pipul for United Nations.

Tori of e laif an e wok 
Abibi get e Ph.D in matimatiks fom Univasiti of Grenoble wey dey France in 1970. E folo for di fest pipul wey kom frlom Sentra Afrika wey get dis kain big pepa for matimatiks. Abibi folo for di pipul wey dey rili du politis wel-wel wey kom fom north side wey stil go skul for France. Dem mek suo sey dem sopot Marien Ngouabi  for di Congolese Students Association (AEC) for 1972. Dis kain join-bodi bitwin AEC an di gofment rili mek som pipul vex and dem no gree suport di Congolese Party of Labour (PCT). Di oga dem for di PCT kom kari Abibi by force go hide for wia pipul no go no. Dis one kom mek Ngouabi vex sey mek dem riliz am sharp-sharp.

For politis mata, Abibi rili sopot di Marxist idiya wey tok sey mek pipul for Afrika dey du tins wey go favor dem wel wel. E still wok as di oga pata-pata for one big skul wey dem dey kol Marien Ngouabi Univasiti. E kom bi pesin wey Denis Sassou Nguesso trust wel wel (e dey sopot enitin wey go favor Sassou).For 1983, dem kom dey kol am di oga pata-pata for pipul wey dey tell di pipul wetin dem nid to dey hear an tins wey dem go dey tell everibodi even if na far-far ples you dey liv. Dem komot di forma oga pata-pata wey e nem na captain Florent Ntsiba for día kom  put Abibi as di oga pata-pata. Dem come still chenj am as di oga pata-pata for di pipul wey go dey tell di hol kontri enitin dem nid to hear.Dem kom mek Abibi di oga pata-pata for sekondri an big-big skul for 1984. As dem kom arenj evritin bak for 1986, Abibi no kom du dis wok again.

Abibi kom bi di oga pata-pata for di pipul wey no dey sopot one kain bilif sey som pipul beta pass anoda pipul. Di nem na Congolese Anti-Apartheid Committee an for 1989 dem kom mek  am di oga pata-pata for dis kain tin for di hol Afrika. For dat sem 1989, dem put am join di PCT Politburo an dem tell am to dey tish pipul buk mata, plenti plenti tins, politis mata an mata wey go mek pipul no wetin dem sopos dey du an no du for dia kontri.

For di year wey bi 1990s, e kom join Pan-African Union for Social Democracy wey Pascal Lissouba bi di oga pata-pata. E stil wok as di pesin wey dey stand for di Congo pipul for 
United Nations for dis ten years.

Afta di Congo pipul don fight demself finish for October 1997 wey dem komot Lissouba an Sassou Nguesso kom begin rul again, Abibi komot hand for politis mata for Congo for meni years. E kom stil join Sassou Nguesso grup wey be PCT. For October 2011, dem chuz am mek e dey among di pipul wey dey bring di rul wey evribodi for Congo go folo, na  Senate of Congo-Brazzaville bi di nem. E join dem wen e dey wit PCT grup for Sangha Department. Wen dem dey chuz who and who go be di oga dem for Senate side, 61 pipu for Sangha chuz Abibi, na 87.14% of everibodi wey chuz who and who dem want mek e bí día oga dem. Dis one rili favor Abibi wel-wel, e kom mek win fest an kom stil mek am join one of di six post wey dey for Sangha.

text:
Dapo Abiodun (dem bon am for May 29, 1960) na Naijá politishian an biznessman. Dapo Abiodun bi di Gofnor for Ogun Stet afta wey e win di eleshion for 2019 onda di parti All Progressive Congress (APC). Di man bi di chairman for one govament oganasashion wey dey registar nem of kompini an biznes wey govament alao to dey wok. Di nem of di Organasashion bi Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC). Bifor Dapo Abiodun bi di gofnor of Ogun Stet e bi di Maniging Daretor (M.D) of one petrol compini wey di nem na Heydey petroleum an also e bi di pesin wey fest stat one kompini wey get di nem First Power Limited. For March 10 2019, di grup wey dey kotro eleshion for Naijá wey di nem bi Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) tok  sey Dapo Abiodun go bi di next gofnor for Ogun Stet.

Tori of e laif
Dem bon Dapo Abiodun for May 29, 1960 for Iperu Remo insaid Ikenne lokal govament for Ogun stet.Dapo kom for di famili wey dia papa papa dem bi king in Iperu.Dapo bi di pikin of Dr Emmanuel Abiodun an im mama bi Victoria Abiodun wey kom fom Iperu Remo insaid Ogun East wey bi  one of di  aria wey senator dey kom fom insaid Ogun Stet.

Tori about im skul
Di true Tori of how Abiodun tak go skul no too klear. Im be enta wan palava wen i remain small for di 2015 senatorial eleshion wen I tak fo di paper wen i wan tak do eleshion se i finish skul fo Obafemi Awolowo University, bot wen i wan go for govnor election in 2019, Dapo tak se na onli sekondiri skul i finish an se na di satifikat de i hand.

Tori of how e tek wok
Dapo Abiodun bi di owna an Oga for one kompini wey get di nem Heydey Petroleum Limited (HPL). Im bi also di pesin we fest stat di kompini wey di nem na First Power Limited.

How e tek wok for politis
Dapo Abiodun bi one of di pipul wey kari di parti People Democratic Party (PDP) kom Ogun Stet, bot for now i don join anoda parti we i name bi All progressive Congress (APC) wen i no win di election wey hapun for 2015. Abiodun onda di parti APC join odas kadidate tek fight for one position for govment wey den name Ogun East gubernatorial election but na the pesin wey People Democratic party carri kom  win the election.
Abiodun befo befo don bi sinato for Naijá onda wan  pati we no dey again in 1998.Di name of di party na United Nigeria Congress Party (UNCP). Naijá Govment don use Abiodun fo mani manibgroup and oganasashion.
For 2019, e use di party All Progressive Congress (APC) tek fight for the position for gofnor  and de pick am as governor.
For 29 of May 2019, dey give am pawa to bi di Gofnor of Ogun Stet.
Abiodun na confam kristian and i de go di church we i name na Mountain of Fire and Miracle Ministry.Abiodun tak se na God win becos bad bele pipul no wan make i bi  gofnor of Ogun Stet.

Palava
Fo 2018, wan newspepa we i name na Cable Newspape tak se Abiodun use wayo tek get pape se i don pass out for school.

Im personal laif
Dapo Abiodun bi di hosband of Bamidele Abiodun an dey get five pikin togeda.

text:
David Adedeji Adeleke (na for November 21 1992 dem bon am) wey pipul no wel wel as Davido na Naijá-Amerika singa, song raita an rekod produsa.Davido popula wel well wen e rilis di muzik "Dami Duro" di sekod muzik wet dey e fest muzik albom "Omo baba Olowo" (2012).Fat sem year 2012 for Headies awod, Davido  win di Next Rated Award. Insaid 2013 go rish 2015, Davido rilis plenti muzik wey popula wel wel. For January 2016, e go sign rekod diee wit Sony Music. Na Davido fom di rekod lebel kol Davido Music Worldwide (DMW) an musizishian laik Dremo, Mayorkun, Peruzzi an liya dey onda dis record label.
For July 2016, Davido sign anoda rekod diee wit "Sony's RCA Records". For October 2016, Davido rilis anoda five trak Ep "son of mercy" wey bi sey e sopot am wit songs laik "Gbagbo Oshi", "How long" an "Coolest kids in Africa"  for April 2017, bikos of di trobul for kreativ kontrol said, Davido go bak go tok abaut im kontrat wit Sony an dat sem year e rilis  anoda five singles wey  "If" and "Fall" dey amog di singu. Di song "If" kova di worldwide soshial media Hativiti an "Fall" kom bikom di Longest charting Nigerian Pop song for Billboard history.For di wold of muzic dem dey kol am King of our taim Afrobeats. For November 2019, Davido rilis e sekod studio albom "A Good Time" Davido                                     sopot am wit Muzik laik  "Blow My Mind".For insaid New African Magazine for 2019, Davido dey amog di 100 top strong  pipul wey dey kontrol Afrikans. On Friday 13 November 2020, Davido rilis e nomba three studio albom "A Better Time".As at August 2021, Davido bi di sekod person wey pipul dey folo pass for Afrika soshial media app Instagram.

Tori of e life
Dem bon David Adedeji Adeleke for November 21 1992 inside Atlanta Georgia wey dey Amerika.E papa Adedeji Adeleke na bizinessman an e mama Vero Adeleke na leshura for Univasiti.Na Davido smol pass for di five pikin-dem an na e bi di sekod boi of e papa. Davido go skul for British International School for Lagos in Naijá an as e rish 16 years old e go rid Business Administration for Oakwood University for Alabama. 

As Davido dey Oakwood, e get muzikal tins an e stat to dey mek beats wit e kosin B-Red an Sina Rambo wey dem kom fom dia  muzik akt KB International. Davido no finish Oakwood University as e put all e mind for muzik. E go lif for London an na dia e tek wok on e voesi.Afta e kom bak to Naijá for 2011, Davido stop smol for e muzik karia an go bak to skul to mek im papa happi as e enta Babcock University for July 2015. Davido get digree for Muzik Babcock University.Later, e Papa pay di Univasiti to stat muzik dipatment for di niu class of one student.

How e tek wok
Fom 2011 go rish 2012, Davido stat to dey wok on im fest rekod "Omo Baba Olowo".Di albom muzik na miss of Afrika beats an hiphop. Davido wok wit Jay Sleek, Maleek berry, GospelOnDeBeatz Spellz  Dokta, Franz, Mr Chidoo, Theory Soundz an Shizzi to produs di albom. Omo Baba Olowo Albom get meni muzishian laik  Neato-C, Sina Rambo, B-Red, Kayswitch, Ice prince an 2 Face Baba.Pipu no too laik di albom bikos of di wey dey tek rait di Muzik dem bot di Albom stil win diBest R&B/Pop of di year.For The Headies, di Albom dey amog albom of di year. Di sem Albom dey for di best album of di year for 2013 in Nigeria Entertainment Awards.
Di trak wey Naecto-C hep am wit wey bi "Back When" na im bi di lidin singu for di Albom for May 7, 2011. Na Davido produs am an pipu laik am wel wel as redio stashion plai am wel wel. Davido tok for Television channel Factory 78 sey  na im rekod "Back When" for London.  Na Clarence Peters daret di muzik vidio for "Back When" an dem put  am for YouTube on May 9 2011. Di albom sekod singu na  "Dami Duro" wey dem rilis for October 30, 2011 an na Davido an Shizzi produs am. For one intaviwu wey dem post for NotJustOk websait, Davido tok sey e rekod di song for August of dat year. Di song liki three mont afta e send am to e frend. Oda sopot Muzik vidio for "Dami Duro" dem rilis am for January 8 2012 dorin di Occupy Nigeria protests.
Di nomba three singu albom "Ekuro" na for Miami dem rekod an daret am  an na Antwan Smith du di wok.
Naijá singa Aramide rilis di soulful rendition of di song. The nomba four singu Albom "OverSeas" wey e rilis for May 6 2012 di unfinished version for  di song liki bifor di main rilis. Di GospelOnDeBeatz produs trak "All Of You" an dis na di nomba five singu albom wey dem rilis for September 28 2012. Davido tok for Factory 78 TV sey e rekod dis  song wit GospelOnDeBeatz afta dem mit am for Mall.

2013 - 2016
Standalone, The Baddest an Son Mercy.
On February 25 2013, Davido rilis di shizzi produs trak "Gobe" an dem rank am sekod for Premium Times for Top 10 songs for 2013. For one review for insaid Vanguard Newspaper, Charles Mgbolu sey di song "na fun fom stat to finish". Di muzik vidio for " Gobe" na im dey du for South Africa by Godfather productions. Davido tok for Twitter sey di song  "One of a kind" wey dem rilis for May 13 2013, na shizzi produs am bot na Tebza of Godfather productions du di vidio of di song.Di song tok of Africa wey bi laik one wit plenti kulture an muzik.
August 13 2013, Davido rilis "Skelewu" wey Premium Times rank as nomba 5  for di Top 10 songs of 2013. Davido promot skelewu for 18 August 2013 as e upload am for instructional dans vidio wey Jassy Generation daret to YouTube.Di skelewu dans kompetishion  folo dey di vidio wey dem rilis.
Skelewu get sopot wit two muzik vidio. Sedan daret di fest muzik vidio wey dem rilis for October 15 2013.Dem upload am put for YouTube tru Parody Account.Afta somtaims dey rilis vidio. Davido tok sey sombodi bitira am as dem rilis di vidio an for dis rison Davido go do anoda vidio wit Moe Musa na UK base muzik vidio dareto. Bikos  of wetin di tim tok sesan talk say Davido dey satisfy with di contributions to di music video. Sesan stil tok sey e go dey immature mek Davido an im manejiment inakurate statement to skata im brand. Di main Skelewu Vidio wey dem daret an rekod for London by Moe Musa an e rilis am for October 2013. Davido rilis di T-Spize-produs song "Aye" for February 1 2014. Di vidio for di song na Clarence Peter daret am an na for February 7 2014 dem rilis di vidio. For insaid di vidio Davido plai di poor fama wey dey love one king pikin wannabe waif. Davido du kolabo wit South Afrikan duo Mafikizolo title "Tchelete(Good life)" dem rilis am for April 30 2014. Na Oskido an Shizzi produs am while MTN plai an callertunez platforms distribute am. Bifor dem du di rekodin of Tchelete(Good life)". Davido Network wit Mafikizolo at MTN Nigeria Elite Night event for December 2013. Di muzik vidio for "Tchelete (Good life)" na Twenty Twenty media record an daret Oskido an Uhuru sho smol for di vidio. For June 2014, Davido du smol kolabo with Mi Case, Lola Rae, Sarkodie, Diamond Platnumz an Tiwa Savage for "Africa Rising" na song wey dem yuz for DSTV Eponymous Campaign to Ginger Afrikan mek dem patek for kommuniti-based social investment projects. Di folorin muzik vidio for Africa Rising " di south African production house callback Dreams record and direct di video. Di artist performed di song fodi Africa Rising launch ceremony for Mauritius for June 2015 Davido rilis di Meek Mill assisted trap song"Fans Mi" E yeye fans wit di audio an behind di scene fotogirafa of di vidio bifor e rilis am.
Davido 20 trak albom di Baddest na June 2015 e plan to rilis am bot leta  rilis am for October 10 dat sem year. Two days bifor dat date to di albom dem delay am bikos of di korporation interest for distribution no get nem. Davido don rilis di album kova akt an trackway dem tok earlier dat year di Baddest feature production fom Shizzi, DelB, Spellz, Jfem, P square, Don jazzy, Runtown, Uhuru, DJ Buckz, Akin, Meek mill, Wale an TreySongz. For January 2016, Davido announce for Twitter say E don sign record deal with Sony music Davido announcement go with mixed reaction di record label make press release am make pipu know di deal Davido record deal with Sony im go need to release two two albums and allow am make e retain di right to im music and performance Davido na im get di record label wey be Davido Music Worldwide (DMW) e create am few months after e sign with Sony. Dremo, Mayorkun, yonda and Peruzzi dem currently sign under di label. For July 2016 Davido sign record deal with RCA records.Davido record deal with Sony music affect di plans to release The Baddest according to pulse Nigeria. Davido agreement with Sony na say di album must meet international standard for am to go global distribution. For October 2016 e release di 5 track "EP son of mercy" wey support from di singles "Gbagbe Oshi" "How long" and "Coolest kid in Africa". The EP feature musicians like Simi,Tinashe, and Nacty C 
For 2017 to 2018 "If", "Fall", " Fia", and "Assurance" Davido win Best African Act for 2017 MOBO Award. E release "If" for  February 17 2017 na tekno produce am may while ghost write di track for Davido. Di song certified diamond for di recording industry of south Africa and di shop shipment na 200000 units. "If" win Best pop single and song of di year for The Headies 2018. As dem review am for OkayAfrica Sabo kpada describe di song as "slow burner" with di "unfussy beat wey sound hollow out and no clutter with instrument" Di music video of "If" dem release am for London wey Director Q do di directing while Tunde Babalola produce am. Davido team up with menswear designer Orange culture to release Capsule collection Ginger by "If"
Davido release "Fall"for June Africa e sample one line from kojo funds track "Dun Talking""Fall" na platinum certified wey be recording industry of south Africa dem be one of di top100 most Shazam searched singles in America in January 2019 and e dey for 10top record for Shazam for New York.For February 2019 e become di longest
Charting Nigerian pop song for Billboard history. Fall" dem rate am as 163 for Pitchfork list for di 200 Best songs of di year 2010.Di accompany music video for "Fall" na one born- Nigerian British video Director Daps direct di video. For December 2018di video get more dan 100 million viewers wey make am be di most viewed video for Nigerian artist for YouTube.
Davido release "Fia"for November 10 2017.The song describe neon highlife track and na fresh VDM produce am.For do second verse Davido address Im arrest and do role Caroline danjuma play fueling di rumors say e dey involve for di death of Tagbo Umenike Onemanager for native manager praise Davido songwriting and say di songs dey reflect some of im recent struggle but im dey put am in a way wey be say di sensitive details no go come out direct. One review for music Africa kayode faniyi say " Fia" give "existential conflict" and say"undoubtedly di songs of Davido career at least till e outdoes imself". Daniel Orubo of konbini channels describe "Fia" as "Coherent" track wey Davido use "Croaky voice"" Fia" dey among di songs wey dem nominate for Best pop single and song of di year for The Headies 2018. Di music video wey follow for "Fia" na Clarence peter direct am di assist remix of "Fia" na stefflon Don't do am and dem release am for March 30 2018. Dis remix carry many lyrics from di original recording but incorporate patois tinged flow. Davido win di Best Africa Act and na one of di Best Worldwide Act recipient for 2017 MTV Europe music Awards.
Davido release "Assurance" April 30 2018 .E dedicate di track to im girlfriend and release di song for di girl 23rd birthday.
Reviewing di native magazine Toys Sokunbi say di song talk plenty but for di importance of clarity for age of emojis,validation from ourlove ones and put love first against all odds. Davido win Best international Act for di 2018 BET Award wey make am di first African artist to collect Award for main stage and for Davido acceptance speech e advice dem make dem visit Africa and eat Africa food.
For September 2018 Davido sing with Meek mill, post Malone and Fat joe, for di made in American Festival. Before di Festival Davido go sing for House of Blues for Boston as part of im "The locked up Tour" wey e continue for August and end am for September.Dat same month Davido face accusations wey be say member of di Black Axe confraternity or Aye cult Group and of making cult gang gestures for im music and personal video. For September 5 2018 Daily post report say person wey Nigeria police catch as Aye cult member confess say e join because dem tell say if e be Aye e go meet music star Davido. On September 15 2018 for Davido chart with vanguard Davido country manager ASA Asika deny say e no know whether Davido dey any secret cult group. On August 10 2019 information Nigeria report make trouble for no dey Davido share video for Im  insta-story to reassure di Aye cult group say e dey loyal o!
For 2019=Present: 02 Arena Concert "Blow MY MIND"" RISKY" "A GOOD TIME" and "A Better Time".For January 2019 Davido sell all the 02 Arena for London wey come become do first solo African artist to do am after wizkid headline concert for 2018.Idris Elba introduce Davido for stage and Davido perform many of im hit singles wey di life band The Compozer back am up. Caroline Sullivan of di Guardian give di concert four star out of five dey call Davido di " alpha"and say "many of di behavior wey Davido dey dis play e learn am from American rappers and some of dem wey e don work with E.g: Young Thug and Swea Lee.
Di Chris Brown assist track " Blow My Mind" e release am for July 26 2019 and Shizzi produce am "Blow My Mind" na im dem be wan release as di leading single album. "Blow my mind" carry lyrics wey talk of one sweet girl wey dey bounce Davido dada!
For di Edgar Esteves direct visuals for "Blow My mind" Davido and Chris Brown spend good time for di motel with deir lovers.Di video catch one million views for 11hours did wan pass wizkid Fever and come closer wey make am become di Nigeria music video wey achieve di most quickly. E still be di Nigeria music video to gain di most views for only 24hours for di time wey dem release di album. For October 23 2019 e release "Risky" e feature guest vocals from Jamaican singer Popcaan wey tell Davido make show for im 2018 single "Dun Rich" Di music video for "Risky" na meji Alabi direct am and e pay homage to di crime drama Television series TopBoy.For di video one female member of Davido and Popcaan crew inform upon dem to police.
"A Good Time" wey be Davido second studio albums e release am for November 22 2019. Di album features di before release single like "If" "Fall" "Assurance" "Blow My Mind" and "Risky". Davido record A Good Time for Atlanta. E tell Vibe magazine e go like record for new environment. Davido describe do album as body of work for everybody and say e go get mouth for afrobeats for years but go incorporate elements of oder genres.Davido tell pipu di title of di album during wan event for Lagos for September 2019 and say e go  release am for di following month. E again open excerpts of four songs from di album during di event As Davido dey perform for power house 2019 e talk with Power105.1 DJ seif e say di album go feature collaboration artists wey include Summer Walker,Gunna, A Boogie and Chris Brown. One of di track for di album "A Good Time" na platformproducer do am Di album cover art feature Davido papa and picture of im mama. A Good Time currently di most streams for African album of all time. For streaming platform Davido na di first to cross one billion streams.
For May2020 Davido announce im third studio album wey e title  A Better Time and e include 11tracks wey go feature musicians like Nicki Minaj and Tiwa Savage. For July e perform for Tonight show starring Jimmy Fallon and pipu see am for studio with one rapper Nas. For August 31 2020.Davido go back to social media after e take three months break make e chat with di Grammy museum for Instagram live about di rise of Afrobeats and oder issues wey concern di industry. During di live session Davido talk say e don finish work for A Better Time. For 10 September 2020 Davido return with di single FEM" with di music video wey Dammy Twitch produce. Davido single FEM video hit 1.8 million YouTube view forless dan 24hours e break e own record for d fastest Nigeria music video wey hit 1million views for YouTube di record wey dey top before na still Davido song Blow My Mind wey e feature Chris Brown Na di song be number one for di Nigeria turntable top 50 chart for im second week of eligibility dethroning WizKids Ginger. Di album dem release for 13 November 2020. Di album feature pipu like Lil Baby, Nicki Minaj,Nas, Chris Brown and Young Thug among oders. For December 14 2020 Davido announce im 3rd studio album A Bitter Time don achieve over 213.2 million streams for one month

text:
Deji Akinwande na Naija-American professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering wit courtesy affiliation with Material Science for University of Texas at Austin. Dem giv am Presidential Early Career Aword for Scientists and Engineers for 2016 from Barack Obama. Im bi Fellow of di American Physical Society,di African Academy of Sciences, an di IEEE.

How e stat life an edukashon
Akinwande wey dem bon for Washington, DC an im kom stat life for Naija. Im gro op for 
ikeja wit im perents. Im papa na di financial controller of Guardian News an im mama wok for Ministry of Edukashon. E go Federal Govment College, Idoani an e get interest 
for science an engineering. E go bak America for 1994, where e go Cuyahoga community  college bifor e transfer go Case Western Reserve University go stodi Electrical engineering an applied physics. During im master's digri, im lead di design of near-field microwave tips for non-destructive imaging. Stanford University accept am as a graduate student, woking on di electronic of carbon-based materials. Dem select am as a Dare (Diversifying Academia Recruiting Excellence) Fellow in 2008. E komplit im PhD for 2009. Im join University of Texas for Austin for 2010 as Assistant Professor for January 2010, an dem awod am research grants from meni agencies like di National Science Foundation (NSF), Army Research Office (ARO), di Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA), DARPA, AFOSR, an Office of Naval Research, di latter focusing on high-frequency flexible 2D electronics.

Research and karia
Akinwande collaborate wit
Aixtron on wafer-scale growth of graphene, characterization andm integration, di collaboration demonstrated scalable growth of 
polycrystalline graphene using chemical vapour deposition, creating di fess 300 mm wafers. In 2011 im publish di fess textbook on Carbon Nanotube and Graphene Device Physics with Prof. Philip Wong of Stanford University. Dem mek am a sinior member of Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) for 2013.I don mek meni advances for two dimensional graphene electronics. For 2015 e 
demonstrate di fess two dimensional silicene transistor. Akinwande collaborate with 
Alessandro Melle's group for CNR, Italy, e achieve am by evaporating silicon onto a crystal of silver, monitoring di growth in real-time using scanning tunneling microscopy. 
This research breakthrough was selected as one of di top science stories of 2015 by Diskova magazine. Di silicene wok na di most cited Nature Nanotechnology publication of similar age.Im demonstrate di thinnest most transparent electronic tattoo sensors wey e use graphene for 2017, wey dey less Dan 500nm thick and 85% optically transparent. Dis research na collaboration wok with Nanshu Lu's group. Dem fit laminate di tattoos inside persin skin like temporary tattoo,but e fit measure electrocardiography, electroencephalography, temperature and hydration. Later dem develope graphene  tattoos to watin persin fit wear for bodi to monitor blood pressure continously using di 
bio-impedance modality published in neshor Nanotechnology in 2022.Im demonstrate di fess atomristor by investigating nonvolatile resistance switching using a 2D atomic sheet of molybdenum disulfide. Remarkably, di memory effect persists down to a single atom. Di devices fit dey as thin as 1.5 nm and hav applications in 5G an fushor 6G smartphones as zero-static power radio-frequency switches, 
internet of tinz and artificial intelligence circuits. Di discovery of memory in dis systems is expected to bi universal amongst 2D materials. Im dey among di board wey dey review editors For Science, im bi associate editor of ACS Nano and editor for Nature journal npj 2D Materials and Applications,an a past editor of IEEE Electron Devices Letters.Im don giv abaut a dozen plenary an
tok like di planay tok at di 2017 SPIE annual meeting Optics & Photonics, wia im discuss di progress, opportunities and challenges of 2D electronic devices. E bikom an American Physical Society Fellow in 2017 an a Fulbright Fellow in 2018.Im go visit di Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań in 2019. Two of im forma postdoctoral scholars don bikom professors, Dr. Shideh Kabiri at Queen's University in Canada,and Dr. Li Tao at Southeast University in Nanjing. Myungsoo Kim, a forma PhD student is now a Professor at UNIST in South Korea.Im bi finalist for di University of Texas at Austin 'UT System Regents’ Outstanding Teaching' Award for meni years, di highest teaching recognition in Texas.Im don du chairman for meni mejor conferences an program committees in nanoelectronics/nanotechnology like:
