Ayòbámidélé Àbáyòmí Ojútelégàn Àjàní Momodu (Dem bon am for 16 May 1960) wey pipul sabi wel wel as Dele Momodu na Naija jornalist, raita, poblik spika an biznesman.Na e bi di oga pata-pata of "Ovation International" magazine.Ovation international magazine dey kari big pipul parti an pikshon wey dey hapun all ova di wold espeshiali for Afrika.For 2015, Dele Momodu stat "Ovation TV" an also stat e niuz Pepa "The Boss Newspapers".Dele Momodu don kolet meni awod bikos of e wok wey dey tok abaut bizness, politics, buks, Muzik indostrie an Fashon indostrie.
Dele Momodu dey rait evri Saturday inside Thisday Niuz Pepa onda di topik "Pendulum"

How e tek stat life
Dem bon Dele Momodu in May 16, 1960.One of e nem wey bi Ayobamidele mins "my joy don folo me go house". E bi di las out of di 3 pikin wey e mama bon.Wen Dele Momodu bi 13 years old, e papa kpai. Na Dele Momodu mama an famili memba-dem sopot am.Dele Momodu mama sef kpai on May 18, 2007.One of di lesin wey e mama tish am bi sey mek e no giv up wen tins rili hard.Dis lesin e len from e mama as e mama no gri giv up on sopotin Dele wen oda pipul don giv up on im.Even as Dele no pass e WAEC di fest an sekod time, e mama stil pay for di nes WAEC even sey no peti peti maket e dey sel an na onli am dey tekia of di oda two pikin-dem.Di nem of Dele sinior bi Dr. Oladele B. Ajayi an Debbie Ajayi.

How e tek go skul an wok
Dele Momodu go rid Yoruba langwej for Yunivasiti of Ife ( now na Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife).E finish e bashelor digri in 1982. E stil rid Inglish litishor an get e Masta satifiket in 1988 from Yunivasiti of Ife.Wen Dele dey du e Your kopa bitwin 1982 an 1983, na Oyo Stet Kolej of Hat an kolsho dey post am go as tisha.
In 1983 to 1985, Dele Momodu bi di pamanet seketiri to di forma deputi govno of Ondo Stet, Shif Akin Omoboriowo.
Dele Momodu hep manej Oba Okunade Sijuwade Olubuse II wey bi di Ooni of Ife hotel in 1986.Di nem of di hotel na "Motel Royal Limited". Dele stop to wok for di hotel so dat e go fit go forda e edukeshon as e go du e masta in Inglish Litirashor.
Na wen e dey du e masta e stat to dey rait hatikul for "[The Guardian]]", "Sunday Tribune" an odas Naija niuz pepa.
Yunivasiti of Profeshional Stodies wey dey Accra in Ghana on July 30, 2016, awod Dele Momodu honorary doctorate degree(Ph.D). Di taitu of e Ph.D awod bi Doctor of Humane Letters.
In May 1988, Dele Momodu stat to wok as staff raita for African Concord Magazine wey Moshood Kashimawo Olawale Abiola get.In 1989, dey transfa am go Weekend Concord as pahoniha raita.Na for March 1989 e fest rait di kova tori of Weekend Concord. Dele Momodu stil rait for odas pepa like National Concord, Sunday Concord, Business Concord an Yoruba Niuzpepa Isokan.

Sir Demola Aladekomo (bon 31 December 1957) na Naija Computer Engineer. Aladekomo na di Chairman of SmartCity Resorts Plc, Card Centre Nigeria Limited, Treasure-nest Limited, Crops Nigeria Limited, Chams Consortium Limited, Insida Concepts Limited, and di founda of Chams Plc. Im bi Fellow of di Nigerian Computer Society (FNCS) and di Computer Professional Registration Council (CPN); a memba of di Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE),and di immediate past President of di Lagos Business School Alumni Association (LBSAA) and di Nigeria Computer Society, respectively. Aladekomo don serve as
di Vice Chairman of di Board of Trustees of SmartCard Society of Nigeria. Na im bi di founda of DATA Foundation and Volunteer Corps, non-governmental organizations engaged in corporate social investments for Nigeria

How i stat life and family
Sir Aladekomo graduate from di University of Ife (now Obafemi Awolowo University) for 1982 with digree in Computer Engineering and im kolet MBA from di University of Lagos in 1984. Im bi one of di fess Chief Executive Programmer at di Lagos Business School (LBS) from 1991-1992. Im marri Titi Aladekomo, entrepreneur and philanthropist. Dem bon four pikin and three fine granddaughters.

Professional exploit
Sir Aladekomo founded Chams Limited (now Chams Plc, and dem list am for Naija Stock Exchange) as di fess indigenous computer maintenance outfit for Naija in September 1985, almost 30 years ago.Im Work as di Chief Engineer, I lid Company to deploy Nigeria's fess (Wide-Area-Network WAN) on personal computers, and to deploy di country's pioneer card technology. Na Sir Aladekomo bi di brain behind di fess e-payment card for Naija wey i nem bi Valucard project, wey dey work with five Naija banks.Under im watch, Chams chenj from a privately held company to public liability company listed on di Nigerian Stock Exchange, differentiating itself in di Nigerian market by focusing on di business of identity management, ceding di increasingly cluttered card technology and transaction payments segments to its subsidiaries, ChamAccess Limited, and Card Centre Nigeria Limited.Chams Plc is also di parent company of 
ChamsSwitch Limited, and ChamsConsortium Limited, and has a substantial interest in ChamsMobile.

Philanthropic activities
Sir Aladekomo na di founda and immediate past Chairman of, di Board of Trustees,Volunteer Corps, Chairman, DATA  Foundation; a non-governmental organization committed to profeshonal volunteerism for publik skool edukashon. Im establish Volunteer Corps in 1992 out of di nid to offer edukashonal opportunities to less privileged membas of di society. Im later found DATA Foundation wey don dey aword student scholarships for publik skools.
Sir Aladekomo serve for meni position like;
 Council Member, Osun State University Board Member, Osun State University Advancement Board Board Member, 
 Obafemi Awolowo University (OAUTECHEXCEL) the Foundation implementing a knowledge park at the university Patron, Lagos City Chorale Group
'' Memba, Nigerian Economic Summit Group (NESG) from inception/Vision 2010 and Vision2020

Eddie Ugbomah (dem bon am December 19, 1940 an e kpai for May 11, 2019) na bifo bifo Naija fim dareto an produsa. Na im daret and produs fim The Rise and Fall of Oyenusi in 1979, The Boy is Good an Apalara. Apalara na  fim wey tok abaut di life tori of Alfa Apalara for Oko Awo, Lagos. Most of e fim na wetin dey happun for life like The Rise and Fall of Oyenusi wey tok abaut di bad tiff, Ishola Oyenusi.

Tori of e life an wok wey e du
Ugbomah papa kom fom Ashaka Vilej aria for Aboh in East Ndokwa lokal Govament in Delta Stet but na for Obalende an Lafiaji aria of Lagos e tey du e smol pikin.E go St Matthias, Lafiaji, Lagos an City College school.Leta, Ughomah traful go London for e haya edukashion wey e go rid tins abaut Niuz, drama an fims dem. Afta e finish, Ughomah wok wit BBC an e du smol rol inside Dr.No, Guns at Batasi an Sharpeville Massacre. Ughomah bi memba of one Afro-Caribbian drama grup an e daret som of di grup pla like This is Our Chance an na for Stoke Newington Theatre Hall dey du di pla.Ughomah kom bak to Naijá for 1975.Wen e kom bak to Naijá,E du sho promoshion bifor e stat ' Edifosa wey bi fim produkshon kompani.Ugbomah fim dey tok abaut tins wey dey happun for life an Politiks. For 1979, e produs Dr Oyenusi dat fim dey fim tok abaut di notorious robber is Isola Oyenusi wey terrorize Lagosians in di early 1970's. Di fim also tok abaut armed robbery for Naija. For di fim "Oyenusi" Ugbomah feature as di lead aktor.  Ugbomah release i next fim, "The Mask" for 1979. Di fim tok abaut di histori of Naija
during di Benin Expedition of 1897 and how dem take tiff artifacts from di Benin palace. For di fim Ugbomah play di rol of Obi wey try to secretly tiff di Benin ivory mask and return am to Naija. Some pipu link di character of Obi to di MI6 agent James Bond.Ugbomah karia flourished into di early 1980s, I produce fim like Oil Doom, Bolus '80
and The Boy is Good. Dem shot Most of i fim with 16mm with di exception of The Mask.  Later for i karia Ugbomah turned to Yoruba video fim. For 1988, Dem appoint am as di chairman of di Nigerian Film Corporation. Ugbomah kpai for 11 May 2019, for di age of 78.

text:
Chief Dr Edet Amana (dem bon am for December 11, 1938) na Naijá enjinia.

Tori of e laif an skul wey e go
Na December 11, 1938 dey bon Edet James Amana for Akwa Ibom Stet for Naijá. E go Methodist College, Uzuakoli an king's College, Lagos. E go Imperial College London (1961-1966) wey im get fest klass digree for Civil Engineering an na e bi ovarall best graduatin student. Edet wok for British Firm of Consulting Engineers. Wen e kom bak to Naijá e wok as Service Engineer for Shell-BP (1968-1972).

How e tek wok
Edet fom Amana Consulting Engineers in 1972.
For Ova 15 years di kompini dey du di disign and implementation of projects of abaut $2bn. Di engineering services division held services for A.W. Chesterton of Boston, Mass and Hewlett Packard (1982). For 1981 dem kolabo with Earth Technology Corporation of California for geotechnical and geophysical surveying and mapping. Anoda venture wey involve Israeli cover architectural planning. Di kompini kolet 30 enjinias  an 10 experts to wok for dem.Fom 1980, di grup bigin dey divelop robas farms and dey don establish one roba makin kompini. Di grup also dey into Insurance brokerage an tradin for di oil indostri. Dem stil get hand  for banking, poblishin an propati. Edet Amana na di founding dareto of Citybank Nigeria Limited an im saf for di board of di Bank fom 1985-2010. Todey, Edet Amana na di Chairman of Amana Group of Company an na im  
bi di bifor bifor Presidor of di Nigerian Academy of Engineering. Im bi fellow of di Nigerian Society of Engineers, na im bi di forma Presidor of di Association of Consulting Engineers Nigeria, fellow Nigerian Institute of Management an fellow International Institute of Director. Im bi memba of American Society of Civil Engineers an di Association of African Development Experts.Pasona laif
Edet Amana fest waif na Mrs Doris Edet Amana an dem bon six pikin.Doris Edet dai for December 11,2004.E marri anoda waif wey bon two pikin for am an di waif nem na Lady Hilda Edet Amana.

 Knight of John Wesley awarded by Methodist Church Nigeria 2004 Doctor of Science DSc (Honoris Causa) by University of Uyo 2010

How e tey stat life an di skul wey e go
Emem na di nomba 4 pikin of di 5 pikin wey im papa an mama bon.Na September 5 dem bon Emem an e papa kom fom Ikono Lokal Govament Aria of Akwa Ibom Stet in Naijá.Emem rid Theater Art an kolet Bachelor digri fom University of Calabar. Isong get diploma Satifiket in Computer Science fom di Computer Science Institute (NCR).

Tori of e karia
Emem Isong Karia in fim mekin stat in 1994 wen e rait an dey amog di produsa of di fim Jezebel. Di fest fim wey Emem produs by imsef na Breaking Point (1996). Emem yuz 8 years  wok wit Remmy Jez to produs Remmy Jez fims.For  2008, e stop to dey wok wit Remmy Jez. Afta dat, Emem join produs Feloaded(2008).Emem don rait an produs meni fims laik:

Dat last fim na im dey sho for African Fim Festival in New York City. Pipul wey no Yoruba langwej fim no sey Emem na koret produsa.Di fim wey Emem dey mek dey mek niu aktress popula bikos e mek aktress like Stephanie Okereke, Dakore Egbuson an odas popula wel wel. In 2014, Emem daret e fest long fim Champagne wey dem sho for Silverbird Galleria in Victoria Island, Lagos. In August 2015, Emem rilis e  sekond long fim wey e daret Code of Silence an e wok wit di Royal Arts Academy an Nollywood Workshop an intanashional Organisashion wey Govament no dey chuk mouth put (NGO) wey dey try wan chenj di sosaeti wit fim wey dem dey du.Di fim tok abaut to dey pawa slip with wumen  wey Oyinbo dey kol Rape for Naijá.Di pipul wey akt insaid di fim na Makida Moka, Patience Ozokwor, Ini Edo, an Omoni Oboli an odas.Emem Isong’s brain an sens for fim mek dem chuz am as Spika for expertise in di muvie  industri don allow ha bi chosen as a spika in di  Afrinolly masterclass seris an also as a jorgi maga for di MTN Afrinolly short flim completion in 2013.Evri fim wey Emem Isong du, e dey wan mek pipul enjoi am wel wel.

text:
Erastus Bankole Akingbola MON, FCIB, FNIM (Dem bon am for  October 26, 1950) na Naijá banka, bizines man an pesin wey dey hep di pipul wey no get moni.Erasmus bi di big boss( maniji dareto) Intercontinental Bank an oda kompini like Tropics Finance and Investment Company an Inspiration 92.3 FM.Erasmus bifor bifor na shihaman of Associated Discount House limited.Wen West Afrika kontris wan chuz pesin wey go tok for dem in The Executive Board of the African Bankers Forum in 2004 (AFREXIMBANK), na Erasmus dey chuz.Dat AFREXIMBANK na to mek suo sey bank wey no bi Govament bank go dey wok wel an go dey strong to dey du bizness for Afrika.
 
How e tek stat Life an go skul
Dem bon Erastus Akingbola for October 26, 1950 in Ilesa, Osun Stet for insaid Westa Naijá.Erasmus papa na Shif Samuel Orogbode Akingbola wey bí Choch katekist an Tisha an im mama na Mrs Christiana Akingbola wey bi buksella.Erasmus kom fom Oke-Igbo insaid Ondo Stet for Westa Naijá. Erastus bin go Christ's School, Ado Ekiti bitwin 1965 an 1969. Fom dia, e rid buk kom kolet diploma satifiket kol Associate Diploma of the Institute of Bankers, AIB, London for 1975.Erasmus go University of Lagos go du post graduate kouse for Business Administration wey e finish for 1986, kom get  Master of Business Administrations, MBA, insaid General Management. Afta dis, e kom stil get satifiket for OPM for Harvard Business School for year 2000.

E karia
Erastus Akingbola stat im karia insaid banking wit Union Bank of Nigeria Ltd for 1971, wey im join as klark.E leta join NAL Merchant Bank in 1977.By December 1984, Erastus Akingbola don bikom senior manija, International operations and correspondent banking. Na dis posishion wey e dey till February 1987 wey e waka go join anoda investment bank wey bi First City Merchant Bank Limited, as kontrolla of operashions. Na fom dia e tek join oda pipul fom Nigerian Intercontinental Merchant Bank Limited wey leta chenj to Commercial Bank wey dem kol Intercontinental Bank Plc an dem kom mek am di Maniji Dareto (M.D). By di taim wey CBN komot am fom ofis for 2009, Erasmus don kari di bank enta Ghana an United kingdom an di bank don get ova  12,000 woka wey dey wok di bank.

=Awods an wetin e ashif
Erastus Akingbola na Fellow of Chartered Institute of Bankers of Nigeria(CIBN) wia e bi  one taim Presido of di Association of Bankers dem for Naijá. Erasmus folo saf as Presido of Institute of Chartered Secretaries and Administrators of Nigeria (ICSAN) inkludin dat of Lagos Business School Alumni Association (1998).Erasmus bi Fellow of the Nigerian Institute of Management, plus di Chartered Institute of Bankers, London. Na im bin repisent West Afrika for 2004 for di Executive Board of the African Bankers Forum, wey bi one arm of di AFREXIMBANK, wey dey wok to mek suo sey banks wey no bi govament own dey strong wel wel to du koret  bizness for insaid di kontinent. For 2001, forma Presido Olusegun Obasanjo bin kari Member of the Order of the Niger (MON), wey bi nashional awod giv am tek praise am for di koret koret kontribushion wey im dey kontribute on how to divelop Naijá.Erasmus also kolet di Kwame Nkrumah Award fom di Nkrumah Foundation insaid Ghana for 2004 as oga kpatakpat of one of di lidin financial institushions in Afrika. For insaid 2004 again, dem bin kari Zik Leadership Award giv am.

How e tek dash pipul tins an Moni
Erastus Akingbola don du koret kontribushion to pipul an e don also yuz e Organisashion wey e head tek hep pipul tu to hep mek buildin insaid Hiya institushions for Naijá. Na one of dis kontribushion bi di 120-Bed, 60 Room Post Graduate Hostel wey e build an put beds for  University of Lagos in 2006.Intercontinental Bank, wen e bin dey in charge, also build and donate Hostel komplex plus  oda buildin to meni Univasiti all ova Naijá, inkludin di University of Lagos, University of Benin, Bayero University, Kano etc.

E don also hep to mek pipul no about gospel wel wel as e don rilis moni to tek mek buk wey dey prich gospel. Sins 2008, Erasmus don yuz e moni dey poblish di magazine The Word for Today a daily divoshion buk wey pupil fit kolet without moni for evriwie for Naijá an som oda kontris.Na Grace So Amazing Foundation dey share di buk an na Erasmus an e waif fom di Foundation.
Erasmus bi memba for The Bible Society of Nigeria an e dey hep mek baibu fit dey meni meni langwej.

Personal life

Erastus Akingbola mari Anthonia Tolulope Odesanya an dem bon 4 pikin.
title: Erastus Akingbola

text:
Etim Okon Inyang (dem bon am for December 25, 1931 an e dai for September 26, 2016) na Naijá polis man an e bin big pesin for Naijá polis dat taim wen e dey alaif. Na for 1983 dey mek am bi di oga kpata-kpata for polis afta Sunday Adewusi. Afta Inyang du e own finish in 1986, na Muhammadu Gambo Jimeta kom kontinu. Inyang dai wen e bi 84 years for Lagos for Naijá.

Tori of e laif an skul wey e go
Na for Enwang Mbo for Akwa Ibom dey tek bon Inyang. Okon Iyang wey bi e papa bi di king for Enwang Mbo. Inyang go Roman Catholic Skul for Uko-Akpan (1936 - 1937).E stil go Methodist  skul for Oron (1939 - 1940) an Oyubia Sekondiri Skul for Oron (1941 - 1945). Na tisha wok Iyang dey du for 1946 go rish 1949 bifor e stat to du polis wok.

How e tek wok
Inyang stat polis wok for Naijá as Constable for October 1949.E kom bi Lans Corporal for 1957 an de mek am Corporal for 1958. For 1958, Inyang bi Inspector an e kom bi Assistant Superintendent of Police for 1960 go rish 1963.E kom bi Deputy Superintendent of Police (1963 - 1965) an Superintendent of Police for 1965. For 1967 go rish 1971, Inyang bi Chief Superintendent of Police, E bi Assistant Commissioner of Police (1971 - 1974).Inyang kom bi Commissioner of Police (1975 - 1980). For inside 1961 go rish 1971, E wok for INTERPOL ofis for di side wey dey chuk eye for pipul wey dey du bad tin wel-wel. For 1974, Inyang bi di oga for di pat for polis wey dey kontrol di wey moto an pipul dey yuz road. Inyang kom bi Assistant Inspector General of Police (1980 - 1984) an Inspector General for 1984.

text:
Fela Aníkúlápó Kuti (dem bon am for Octorber 15, 1938 an e kpai for August 2, 1997) na Naija muzishian, komposa and aktivist. Fela ril nem na Olufela Olusegun Oludotun Ramsome-Kuti an pipul no am wel wel as Abami Eda.Fela dey amog di fest muzishian wey stat Afrobeat. Afrobeat na one mettod of Muzik wey join Afrika muzik an Amerika funk an jazz.Pipul sabi Fela as muzishian wey dey yuz tins wey dey happun for politiks sing for e muzik.
Fela na son to one Naija wuman wey dey fight for human right wey e nem na Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti. Afta e eli espiriens for obodo Oyinbo, Fela an e band Africa 70 kolabo wit drum pesin and muzikal dareto Tony Allen, dey kom popula wel wel for Naija for 1970s, na dat time Naija sojas sey im bi dey against dem and e kom bi target for dia mitin. For 1970, E fom di Kalakuta Republic Commune, to sho sey e  no dey onda di militri rul. Dem skata di Commune for di raid wey dem du for 1978. Dey put Fela for prisin onda di Govament of Muhammadu Bihari for 1984, bot dem free am afta e yuz 20 month for prisin. E Kontiniu to rekod an dey pafom for difren time for 1980s an 1990s. Sins wen e don dai for 1997, E pikin wey bi Femi Kuti don dey yuz im muzik style.

How im tek stat life an wok

Na for October 15, 1938 dem bon Olufela Olusegun Oladotun Ramsome-Kuti to di Ransome-Kuti famili.Ransome Kuti famili get moni  an na Abeokuta for Ogun Stet in Naija dey dey stey.Fela mama na Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti an Fela mama no sopot di Oyinbo rul ova Naija dat time.Fela papa na Reverend Israel Oladotun Ransom-Kuti wey bi prinsipa for Anglican minister skul an na di fest presido for Naija Union of Tishas. E brodas dem na medikal doktor an dia nem na Beko Ransome-Kuti an Olikoye Ransome-Kuti. Kuti na kozin to Wole Soyinka wey bi Noble laureate an na Wole Soyinka bi di fest blak raita to kolet Nobel Prize for Literature awod. Fela go Abeokuta Grammar School. For 1958, dem send am go London mek e go rid medisine bot na Muzik e chuz to rid for Trinity College of Music . Fela like to yuz trumpet pass eni oda instrument. Wen e neva dai, Fela fom di band koola Lobitos an e dey play jazz and highlife togeda. For 1960, Kuti mari e fest wife, Remilekun (Remi) Taylor wey bon three pikin for  am ( Femi, Yeni and Sola). For 1963, Fela kom bak to di "newly independent Federation of Nigeria" an e kom fom di koola Lobitos again, and risiv trenin to bi Radio Produsa for "Nigerian Broadcasting Corporation". E folo Victor Olaiya pafom for som time wit all e stars. For 1967, Fela trafu go Ghana to luk for a niu muzik dareto, Even kom kol im musik style Afrobeat wey bi di combinashon of highlife, funk, jazz, salsa, calypso, an tradishonal Yoruba muzik. For 1969, Fela kari di band enta  United States an e dey for Los Angeles for ten month. Na dia e tek see di Black Power movement by Sandra Smith now dem sabi Sandra Smith as (Sandra 'Izsadore abi Sandra Akanke Isidore), na strong soporta for di Black Panther Party. Dis espiriens kom  afekt how e tek see muzik and politiks. Fela leta nem e band Nigeria 70. E no kom tey wey one promota giv di Immigration and Naturalization Service informashon say Fela an e band dem dey for US and dem no get wok pamits. Di band kom du one kwik rekod seshon for  Los Angeles wey dem go leta rilis wit di nem  The 69 Los Angeles Sessions.

For 1970s
Afta Fela an e band kom reton to Naijá, dey nem di grup The Africa 70 an na dat taim  di muzik style chenj fom love to wetin dey happun for Naijá. E fom di Kalakuta Republic wey bi grup of pipul wey de  share di sem bilif and di sem responsibilitis, rekoding studio, an home for meni pipul wey get koneshon to di band. Fela tok sey Kalakuta Replublic no dey pat of Naijá Govament. Fela dey pafom for e own Nightklub wey e leta nem Africa Shrine. Fela dey giv praise to e Gran papa papa dem wey don dai. E leta chenj e nem to Anikulapo wey di minin na (pesin we death dey im poket), wey di intapritashon na (Na me go chuz wen I go dai). Fela refuse to yuz e papa nem Ramsom bikos e tok sey di nem na  slave nem. Pipul no Fela  muzik for Naijá an Afrika wel Fela chuz to dey sing for pidgin bikos e wan mek pipul wey no go skul wel wel fit onda standn e muzik tu. Bikos Fela laik to dey tok to Govament enihow, Govament pipul no laik e muzik at all an dem dey kol arrest am for e Kalakute Republic. For 1972, Fela an e band mek one rekod wit Ginger Baker Bobby Tench. Na for dat taim, Fela wit e band Africa 70 kom mek di rekod albom Zombie wey tok enihow to Naijá sojas an di way dem dey du.  Di albom mek Govament vex so tey dey kom wit 1,000 sojas kom beat Fela no bi smol an dey kari Fela mama troway fom upstair window an e mama wey don old rili injor.Di sojas put faya for di ples inkludin di studio, muzik instrument an masta tape. Fela tok sey na dat day e for dai if no bi one ofisa wey tok sey mek dey jost beat am and liv am.Fela no du enitin dan to kari e mama kofin go  Dondan Barracks for Legos, an na dia General Olusegun Obasanjo dey stay dat time.Fela dat taim  rait songs wey bi Coffin for Head of State an Unknown Soildier. Di taitu of Unknown Soldier dey refar to di unknown sojas wey kom skata di commune. Fela and e band kom go dey stay for Crossroads Hotel afta dem skata di shrine wit di Commune.

Di marej no onli mark di anivasri for di attack for di Kalakuta Republic but na to protet Kuti an e waif dem fom di lie lie wey di otoriti dey klem sey Fela dey kidnap wumen. Leta, e adopt one roteshona sistem for mentenin 12 wife for di sem taim. Fela du one sho for Akra an wahala happun for di sho wen Fela stat to sing di Zombie. For 1979, Fela fom im politikal parti, wey e kol am Movement of the People (MOP), to klin up di sosaeti laik di mop. Bot govment for dat taim konfront am kwik kwik an mek di parti no dey aktiv again. Na Nkrumahism and Africanism MOP dey prish dat taim.

Fom 1980 kom down
For 1983, Fela wan kari elekshion to bi di presido of Naijá bot di Govament no gre mek e bi kandidet.For  dis time, Fela kom fom one band wey get Di nem Egypt 80 an e plan na to sho afrika  how di Egypt pipul tey get sivilaizashon, nolej, filosofi, matimatis and dia rilijion sistem na Afrikans and dey most klem am like dat. For one intaviu, Kuti tok sey Im dey stress di point sey im hav to mek di Afrika pipul dey awie sey na dem get how di Egypt pipu tek sivilais. E kom tok sey na di resin why e chenj di band nem to Egypt 80 bi dat.Fela Kontiniu to rekod meni albom an dey waka rand di kontri. E kom mek di politikal establishment vex wen e impliket di ITT Corporation's vice-president, Moshood Abiola and Obasanjo for di popula 25-menit politikal sikret wey e kol I.T.T (International Thief-Thief). For 1984, Fela muzik dey tok enihow to  Muhammadu Buhari govment. Di govment kom jail am sey dem charge am for money smuggling. One join bodi wey be Amnesty International an oda join bodi dem kom tok sey wetin govment charge am for na politikal motivashon. Amnesty kom chuz am as pesin wey dey for prisin bikos of konshens, and oda human right join bodi kom sopot an tek im kes up. Afta 20 monts, General Ibrahim Babangida kom relis am fom prisin. Fela kom divos Im remenin 12 waif afta dey rilis am, e tok  sey e marej na e bring jelosi and sefishnes. Fela Kontiniu to relis alboms wit Egypt 80 and dey waka arand di United States an Europe and e Kontiniu to dey aktiv for politiks. For 1986, e dey for pipul wey pafom for Giants Stadium in New Jersey as pat of di  Amnesty International's A Conspiracy of Hope concert wit Bono, Carlos Santana an di Neville Brothers. For 1989, Kuti an Egypt 80 rilis di anti-apartheid album wey bi  Beast of No Nation dat sho di U.S. President Ronald Reagan, UK Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, an di South African President Pieter Willem Botha for di kova. Di nem wey e giv di song na from wetin Botha tok sey: This uprising [against the apartheid system] will bring out the beast in us. Fela albom kom dey slow for di taim of 1990, and e stop to dey rilis albom togeda. Wen e rich January 1993, dey arrest im wit four of e membas for Africa 70 and dey chaj dem for 25 January sey dem kill one elektrishian. Pipu com stat to kari rumo sey im get one siknes wey e dey tek tritment.No bodi don konfam  am wetin pipul dey tok.

How e tek dai
For 3 August 1996, Fela broda wey e nem na 
Olikoye Ransome-Kuti na 
prominent AIDS activist an na foma minista for health, tok sey na AIDS kill Fela bot Fela an e waif dem no gree sey e get AIDS wen Fela  dey alive. Im yonges pikin wey bi Seun  e kom tek ova di rol to dey lid Fela foma band wey bi Egypt  80. For 2020, di band still dey aktiv, wey e dey rilis muzik  onda di Moniker  Seun Kuti & Egypt 80.

Im Musik
Fela muzik style na Afrobeat. Afrobeat get jazz, funk, highlife, tradishonal Naijá, Afrika chant an rhymes. Na muzik wey konten elements of psychedelic soul an wan resembu how James Brown dey kompos e song. Afrobeat borrow fom di natif wey bj
tinker pan. Tony Allen wey bi druma for twenty years.Fela don tok am for one taim sey  if no bi Tony Allen, Afrobeat for no dey. Fela band dey popular bikos e bi dey yuz  two baritone saxophones wen meni oda group dem be dey yuz one. Dis na komon teknik for Afrika-influenced musical styles wey you fit see for funk and hip hop.Somtaims for e band, e dey yuz two pesin wey sabi play drum wey bi base for di sem taim an two of dem dey play interlocking melodies and rhythms. E dey always yuz two or more pipul wey dey play gitar.  The electric West African style gita for Afrobeat band na paramont bot e bi dey yuz to gif basik strukture, and to dey repit chordal/melodic stetment, riff, or groove. Som element wey dey for Kuti musik na di call-and-response inside di korus and figurative bot di liriks dem na simpu liriks. Im song dey long for like 10 to 15 minits, and meni of e song long rech 20 to 30 minits, and som of e trak wey e no rilis dem dey last rech like 45 minits wen Im dey pafom for live stej. How im musik be dey long na e be one rizin wey make e musik no reach di digri of
popularity for outside Afrika. Im LP rekod be dey get one 30 minits trak. E get som of e musik introdokshon part wey long reach like 10-15 minits befor e go com start to sing di song wit Im liriks dem, for anoda 10-15 minits. For som of e rekods dem, e devaid Im song to two pats: pat 1 na di instrument pat, and di pat 2 na di vokal pat wey e go add to di instrument pat. Kuti sing meni of e song for Naija pidgin English, and e also pafom small of Im song wit  trumpet, electric guita, and di  occasional drumsolo. Kuti no gri sing song agen afta e com sabi Yoruba languaj. Im mein instrument dat time na di saxophone and di key board, but e de also play di one wey e don alredy rekod dem, na e make Im song no too dey popular for outside Afrika. Dem sabi Kuti for im show dem, and im konsat dem wild show e dey be. E call Im akt wey e do for stej di Underground Spiritual Game. Meni pipu espet am to pafom for di western part, but for di time of 1980, e no com get interest for eni show. E pafomans for Europe dey represent wetin dey hapun for im time an im oda inspiration dem. E tink of di art sey e musik go get minin for politiks. Kuti na part of di Afro-Centric consciousness movement wey start date time and diliva from e musik wey sopos get effect. Wetin Afrika musik dey about be say, wen you dey play musik and pipu no dey feel enitin, e show say you no sabi be dat. For one intaviu wey e do wit Hank Bordowitz Noise of the World, Kuti tok say: Muv! I wan muv pipu to dance, but mek we tink of am. Musik nid to show a beta laif agenst a bad laif. Wen you dey listen to somtin wey dey tok about beta laif and you no get beta di laif, e sopos show for di kind pesin wey you be. Kuti musik, an im e no go gri behevio na becos of wetin dey hapun for e area. For one intaviu rekod wey show for di Faces of Africa for CGTN Afrika, e kompie bitwin di Oyinbo languaj love musik and e own musik say: Yes, wen you dey for England,
di musik fit be di tin of enjoiment. You fit sing about love, you fit sing about wu you wan folo sleep nest. But for awa own envairoment hia, my sosaeti never develop becos of di strenj sistem wey dey wit awa pipu. Notin wey be like love. Na wetin dey hia, na how pipu be dey try struggle for dia laif for dem to fit live.

E politika viu and e invovment
E politika invovment: Kuti invov e sef for politiks in Afrika from 1970 till di time wey e dai. E kritisais di koropshon fo Naija govment woka an au dem tek dey trit sitizin fo bad way. E tok about how strenja tek bi di rut for di ekonomi Kraisis for Naija, an aw dem tek be di yawa fo politiks wey di pipu fo Afrika dey fes.
Koropshon na won wos problem fo politik wey Afrika dey fes fo 1970s an Naija dey for di kontri wey koropshon sidon. Govment dey dabaru eleshon an dey pafom kup wey kom wos povati mata, e kom mek ekonomi mata sef drop, emploiment no dey, an di mata fo politiks no dey stebu, koropshon wit kraim kom plenti well well. Kuti protes musik taitu, na di rialiti fo wetin dey hapun to Afrika ekonomi an koropshon mata. Na all Afrika kontri go don hie about Kuti stetment fo politiks. Kuti song dey tok about di bad tins an di kain way wey shitin de fo how dem dey kontro Naija an e no dey kom witaut konsikwens. E pass 200 diferens time wey dem arest Kuti and e spend time fo jail, wit e 20 mont for jail afta dem arest am for 1984. For dat time, di koropt govment send sojas to bit Kuti, e family an frends, an distroi wie e dey stay wit e instrument dem an e rekods dem.
For di time of 1970, e bigin tok for politiks for deli an wikli nius pepa advat like The Daily Times and The Punch, livin di editorial censorship in Nigeria's predominantly state-controlled media.
Dem poblish am for di time of 1970 and for eli 1980 onda di taitu Chief Priest Say, dis kolums na Kuti estenshon for im femos Yabi Sessions-consciousness-raising word-sound rituals wit e sef as chief priest
for e nite klob for Lagos wey de oganise for militantly Afrocentric for e histri and di
esens for black beauty, Chief Priest tok say focused on the role of cultural hegemony in the continuing subjugation of Africans.
Kuti tell plenti topiks on kondemin di Naija govment krimina behavio,how Islamik and Kristen
don koropt reach, and bad bad plenti koporeshon dem; E tok abaut di brek down of Western medicine, Black Muslims, Sex,      Pollution, and Poreverty. Chief Priest
tok sey The Daily Times and The Punch Kansu all e ripot dem. Plenti oda pipu sef tok  sey dem preshor di pepa editors dem to stop to dey rait dis tins inside pepa wit di e trets of
vawulens dem.

E viu for Politiks
Kuti musik dey tok abut wetin e be get for mind. How e tek popula for 1970s show di shenj 
wey dey for Naija musik art and for di tok tok wey dey for Naija politiks dat time. For 1984, e tok and yab di Naija presido wey dey for  pawa dat time wey bi President Muhammadu Buhari. 
Beast of No Nation, na one of di most popula song wey e refar to Buhari sey e bi anima wey dey for mad man bodi. E tok am for Naija pijin sey: No bi outside Buhari dey ee,
na craze man, na craze man bi dat, animal in craze man skini. Kuti get strong belief for Afrika and e dey alwes preash pis among e pipu.
E tink sey to fight agenst Europe pipu korshor and to sopot tradishona riligion dem and e lifestyle for dia kontinent. Di American Black Power movment also show how Kuti tek viu politiks, how e tek sopot di Pan - Africanism and Socialism wey e call for how dem go dey as one wey bi di   Democratic African Republic. Kwame Nkrumah and Thomas Sankara dey among di leeda for Afrika wey Kuti be dey sopot wen e still dey alaif. Kuti na pesin wey strong for human rite mata, and meni of e musik  na direkt atak agenstdi diktetors for politiks mata, espeshiali di militiri govment wey dey rule Naija for 1970s and 1980s. E also yab im felo Afrika pipu espeshiali di upper klas pipu for di wey dem tek dey bitre di Afrika tradishon and korshor. For 1978 Kuti bekom man wit meni wife, wey e mari to 27 wumen one afta di oda.Na di popula wedin dat time wey serv meni porpos: e mark di one year anivasri for how Kuti and e wife tek sovaiv di atak wey hapun for Kalakuta Republic by di militri govment for 1977, naso e fomalise di rileshon wey de betwin di wumen wey e dey liv wit dis lega status privent di Naija govment wey dem no fit kom e kompand, on to sey im kidnap di wimen dem. Kuti also tok about meni wife as wetin bi sens and dey norma. Man dey go for wumen for di fest ples. laik for Europe, wen a man don mari, 
wen di wife dey sleep, e go dey go out go dey slip around. E go kari di wuman kom haus, and di man go dey kom dey liv wit am and e go stop to dey run around di strit. Som pipu tok sey im viu for wuman mata na di kain filin wey mek e sing song like Mattress for foda pruf for mor esampu, e mok di African women's aspiration to European standards of ladyhood wai e prais di valu of di market wumen for e song wey bi Lady. Kuti also tok agenst wetin e konsida say e bi strong displa for Afrika karakta for men. For e song wey bi J.J.D.(Johnny Just Drop) and Gentleman,
Kuti mok di men for how dem tek dey do dia kulshor and politiks wey Erop pipu kari enta Afrika and e kom deklie e sef say im bi African man: Original, Kuti na pesin wey dey tok well well agenst di United States. For one mitin wey e go wen e waka for Amsterdam, e komplen abaut di kind mind for war wey Amerika join bodi  like ITT and di CIA tek agenst di nashons dem wey de divelop for languaj. Bekos word wey be like  Third World, undeveloped, or di wons wey even wos kontris dem wey no gri wit wetin e tok na fek e bi. Kuti fill say mek dem stop to dey yus dem.

Wetin dem tek de rimemba am
Den dey rimemba Kuti for how e tek bi important pesin wey dey tok e aidia for mata wey de afekt
di nashon wit e musik. Na from 1998, na im di Felabration festival wey bi one aidia wey im dohta wey bi Yeni Kuti start, dem de do am evri year for di New Afrika Shrine to selibret di laif of dis musik ogbonge pesin and e betday. Sins di taim wey e dai for 1997, na im dem don de
do e revaiva for how e musik tek dey impotant and e tok abaut awa popula kolshor, dey kom rilis  plenti of e musik from e list wey UMG dey kontro, for big ples and ples  wey no bi opun ples, dem pafom e shos dem and niu band dem  laik Antibalas, wey kari di Afrobit bana for di niw genereshon to di pipu wey de hie di musik. 
For 1999, Universal Music France, wey dey onda  Francis Kertekian, wey mek a niu 45 albom saund rekod wey dem rilis am for 26 kompat disk. Dem kom giv laisens for
di song taitu for di world, esept for naija and Japan, wie oda kompani get kuti musik. For 2005, di UMG opereshon for Amerika giv laisens to all e world musik taitu to  di UK-Based label wey bi Wrasse Records, wey ripakej di sem 26 disk wey dem go distribut for di  United States
(Na die dem riples di taitu wey MCA giv) and di one wey UK giv. For 2009, Universal kom kriet one niu deal for US and Europe, wit Knitting Factory Records  and. . PIAS, wey get di  Broadway cast record rilis for di Fela musik. For 2013, FKO Ltd, na di join bodi wey get di rite to all song wey Kuti rait, and na BMG Rights Management na dem get am. For 2003, dem displey di 
Black President  as di fest tin for di niu Musiom for Contemporary Art for New York and mek atrakshon konsat dem, different parti dem, fim dem, and intanashona
art wok wey rish 39. Bilal wey bi Amerika singa rekod
and do som song wey Kuti sing for 1997 wey bi Sorrow Tears and Blood and for e sekond albom, Love for Sale e fishor one rappa wey jus kom. Bilal see Kuti song kombinashon wey be jazz and folk sey na e

(Haaz Sleiman) na e tell di profesor sey e no go

ples dem, dem do prodokshon abaot laif wey Kuti liv wey 
dem koll  Fela! and na e mek di Fela laif tori wey dem do for 1982, wey bi Fela! Frederick Isiotan Fasehun (Dem bon am for September 21, 1935 an e dai for December 1, 2018) na Naijá pesin wey bi medikal doktor.E get hotel an e bi oga for Oodua Peoples Congress (OPC).

Tori about di skul wey e go 
E rid science for Blackburn College an  kontinu im skul matta for Aberdeen University College of Medicine.Fasehun stil go skul for Liverpool Postgraduate School an afta dis one e kom stil du Fellowship or trainee for Royal College of Surgeons. For 1976, e go stodi how China pipul dey yuz nidu an pin dey trit pipul ( Acupuncture) for China. Na World Health Organizashon an United Nations Development Scholarship Program pai for evriitin dia.

How e tek wok an join politiks
For 1977, Fasehun stat one smol grup for  pipul wey dey du Acupuncture for Lagos University Teaching Hospital. E stop dis one for 1978 an kwik kwik stat Besthope Hospital and Acupuncture Centre for Lagos. E get one taim wey di Acupuncture get one awod as di fest for di hol Afriks wey dey du dis tin wey China pipul dey du.
OPC na one yoruba grup wey dem fom to mek wetin Chief Moshood Kashimawo Olawale Abiola tok bikos im bi yoruba pesin wey win di elekshion to bi di presido for Naijá wey dem du for June 12, 1993 bot dem skata am as dis one no mek Abiola fit bi Presido. Dem put Faseun for prizin for 19 months from December 1996 to June 1998 for di taim wey Sani Abacha bi di hami Presido in Naija, dis one na 18 days afta Abacha don die
E dai for di ward of di hospital wey dem dey trit pipu wey dia sickness bad wel-wel for insaid Lagos State University Teaching Hospital for Ikeja inside Legos.

How im take dai
E dai on December 1, 2018.

How e tek stat e life an go iskuls
Dem born Odutokun for Nsawan, Ghana bot na Naijá pipul  bi im papa an mama. E paret bi Yoruba pipul wey bí sey na fom Offa, Kwara stet dey tek kom an na kooko bizness dem dey du. Wen e frend see am sey e gud for art, dey advais am to go skul more an Odutokun chuz Ahmadu Bello University for Zaria an dem pik am. Odutokun finish for di skul wit Bachelor an Masters digree in fine art in 1975 an 1979. E Kon go join fine art dept for A.B.U as a graduate assistant.

Im wok
Odutokun wok popula wel wel bikos e wok dey sho fine fine tins of life. Som of e wok somtaim dey taku wetin Oyinbo pipul-dem wan see for Afrika art. Odutoku dey also yuz e wok tekb tok abaut Politiks tu.

Adegboyega Isiaka Oyetola ( Dem bon am for September 29, 1954) na Naijá politishian an Di gofnor of Osun Stet in Naijá.Na for Iragbiji, Boripe Lokal Govament Aria for Osun Stet e tek kom fom.Oyetola bi di gofnor of Osun Stet  afta e win di September 22, 2018 eleshon onda di pati  All Progressives Congress(APC).E bi foma Shif of Staff for Rauf Aregbesola wey bi gofnor bifor e kom bikom gofnor tu.

Tori of e life an skul wey e go
Na for September 29, 1954 in  Iragbiji, inside Boripe Lokal Govament Aria of Osun Stet dey tek bon Adegboyega Isiaka Oyetola.E du e sekondiri skul Ifeoluwa Grammar School, Osogbo  in 1972.
Afta e sekondiri skul, Oyetola go rid Insurance for Unilag ( University of Lagos) an kolet Bachelor of Science satifikat (Bsc) in 1978. Na for Potiskum, Yobe Stet Oyetola tekbdu e Youth Korpa(NYSC), an na ticha wok for  Staff Training Centre e du fom 1978 to 1979. 
Oyetola get im Masta(Master of Business Administration MBA) fom Unilag (University of Lagos) in 1990.Oyetola dey inside Associate Member, Chartered Insurance Institute for London and Nigeria an Member of Nigeria Institute of Management (NIM).

How e tek wok

Adegboyega Isiaka Oyetola join Leadway Assurance Company Limited as Aria Manija in 1980 an e wok for dia til e find anoda wok for in 1987 as Underwriting Manija for  him work there till 1987 when him move to 
Crusader Insurance Company Limited 
fom 1987 to 1990. Oyetola Join Alliance and General Insurance  as Teknika Kontrola an e wok for one year.In 1999, Oyetola stat e own kompini Silvertrust Insurance Brokers Limited.E bi di M.D of im kompini til 2011 wen dey pick am as Shif of Staff to Osun Stet Gofnor, Rauf Aregbesola.
Oyetola don bin saf as Exeutive Vice Chairman,  Paragon Group of Companies bitwin 2005 go rich 2011. E don also saf Chairman of Ebony Properties Limited. Oyetola bi di dareto of Him be Director for Pyramid Securities Limited, ontil 2011.

Political career
Oyetola na memba of di Alliance for Democracy (AD) an na dat parti e dey til di parti kom chenj Action Congress (AC), Action Congress of Nigeria (ACN) an finali All Progressives Congress (APC). For July 2018, e bin fight for di All Progressives Congress (APC) Governorship primaries with Osun Stet House of Representatives deputi Spika Yusuf Lasun, Spika of di Osun House of Assembly Nojeem Salaam, Dr Samuel Ibiyemi; Publisher Nigerian NewsDirect Newspapers'', Adelere Oriolowo, Moshood Adeoti plus many others for the  September 22, 2018 gubernatorial election in Osun state. Him win the primaries come follow go win the election proper after him defeat Ademola Adeleke of People's Democratic Party(PDP). Dem do swear in for am as governor on November 27, 2018.

Personal Life

Gboyega Oyetola dey happily married to Alhaja Kafayat Oyetola and the marriage dey blessed with children. Kafayat na him be the founder plus President of Ilerioluwa Development Initiative,wey be NGO wey dey assist less privileged women and children for Nigeria.

text:
Gregory Ngaji (dey bon am for November 17, 1946) na Naijá politishian an foma memba of Nashional Sinate for Kross Riva North Constituency of Kross Riva Stet from 2003 go rich 2011.

Tori abaut im life 
Dem bon Gregory Nnaji on November 17, 1946. E go skul for Mary Knoll College for Okuku, for Yala for inside kross Riva fom 1962-1965, e kom get one satifikate wey dem dey kol LL.B, fom one big skul wey dem dey kol Univasiti of Nigeria for Nsukka for di year 1977. Gregory  Nnaji kom stil get anoda BL satifikate  as pesin wey go len how dem dey jorge pipul mata for inside kot. E get dis one fom Nigerian Law School for 1978. Bifo dem chuz am to stand for di pipul for Sinate, im be di oga pata-pata for di Yala Local Government Area and e stil folo saf as pat of di pipul wey dey kontrol dat aria (1994-1995).

How im wok as Sinator 
Gregory Ngaji kom out mek dem chuz am wen im dey wit di grup wey dem dey kol People's Democratic Party (PDP) an dem chuz am to wok as pesin wey go stand for pipul for govment side for di  5th National Assembly fom  1962-1965. E stand for di kross Riva North Sinatorial District an dem kon stil chuz am again to du dis kind tin again for April 2007. Gregory Nnaji dey wok as pat of di joinbodi wey dey kontrol wota mata, Sayense & teknoloji, how pipul tek dey travu on top wota, medisine for bodi pain mata, to fight pipul wey wan chop govment moni  and pipul wey dey wok as pesin wey dey plant food and train animal.

Im dey among di pipul wey sitdowm jorge Mrs Farida Waziri for June 2008 sey mek shi no bi di oga pata-pata for di Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC). Gun langwej (Gun: gungbe) na langwej wey Ogu pipul wey dey for Benin Replublic an Naija dey tok. Gun langwej dey amog di langwej grup wey dem dey kol Gbe. Di langwej nia oda langwej laik Fon, Agbome, Kpase, Maxi and Weme (Ouémé). Na dis langwej dem dey tok pas for Benin an dem dey yuz am tich for som skul-dem for Ouémé Department for Benin.

Na Gun langwej dem dey tok pas for di pat of Benin Republic wey dey for South for Porto-Novo, Sèmè-Kpodji, Bonou, Adjarra, Avrankou, Dangbo, Akpro-Missérété, Cotonou an ples-dem wey di Ogu pipul dey liv. Som smol Ogu pipul wey dey for South-West side for Naija sef dey spik Gun, espeshali for Badagry, Maun, Tube.

Dem don rait di langwej for 3 difren difren rul wey dem tek dey rait an evri of dem stand on top di Latin alfabet. For Naija, dem don yuz som rul wey resembu di kain rul wey dem yuz rait Yoruba an oda langwej for Naija tek rait dis Gun langwej an dem dey yuz one smol dot for onda di wetin dem rait so dat pipul go no how to rid am. For Benin, dey yuz anoda rul tek rait Bibul for 1923 an dem kom du am wel wel for 1975 an now dem dey yuz am tich pipul how to rid an rait for skul. E wan jost bi like di langwej wey dem dey kol Fon, e dey yuz alfabet like ⟨ɛ⟩ and ⟨ɔ⟩. E get som pipul wey dey du dia best to bring som kain rul for how to yuz di langwej. For ezampul, di one wey Hounkpati Capo tok for 1990.

text:
Chief Hannah Idowu Dideolu Awolowo (November 25, 1915-September 19, 2015) wey pipul no wel wel as HID na Naijá bizness wuman an politishian.Dey stil no am as Adelana.

Dem bon am inside one beta famili inside small kominiti wey dem dey kol Ikene wey dey inside Ogun stet for Naijá. Adelana go skul for Methodist Girls' High School for Legos. E mari one man wey dey du politiks matta wey bi Obafemi Awolowo from December 26, 1937 ontil e kom dai for 1987.Awolowo dey always kol im waif  "shine-shine stone wey dem no fit talk about talk finish". Hannah still bi wuman wey sabi du biznes an kom stil get beta sens for politiks matta. E rili put bodi for di Western Nigeria politiks. Wen dem jorge e hosband matta for kot, dey kom put am for inside prizin, na Hannah stand for im hosband for di taim wey NCNC and AG join-bodi kom be United Progressive Grand Alliance (UPGA).

Di plan bi sey, if e win for di big elekshon, e go komot mek im hosband kontinu wen dem du small elekshon. Hannah wan mek sure sey na  hosband rul for di Sekond Repoblik na im mek am folo e hosband waka rich evriwie for Naijá dey beg pipul mek dey vote for e hosband. Na Hannah kom dey arenj evriitin wey dey happun for di wumen dem side for dis dia politiks grup wey dem dey an e dey always dey for all di meetin wey dem dey du. E rili mek am for di biznes wey dem dey du, she kom bí di fest pesin for Naijá wey dey supply maket for Nigerian Tobacco Company (NTC) for 1957. Na Hannah bi di fest pesin wey buy lace material and oda matiria wey dem dey yuz sow klot fom anoda kontri enta Naijá. Hannah get plenti taitu, dem kom stil giv am di taitu wey bi Yeye Oodua of Yorubaland. Na  September 19, 2015 e dai.By den Hannah dey 99 years an na jost two month rimain for am to du im 100 years birthday. Dem beri am near im husband for Ikene for  November 25, 2015. Di sekond pesin for Naijá afta di presido wey dem dey kol Yemi Osinbajo mari e granpikin wey e nem na Dolapo Soyode.

text:
Ibrahim Agboola Gambari CFR ( dem bon am for November 24, 1944) na Naijá pesin wey bi di Shif of Staf for di Presido of Naijá.

=Tori of e life an skul wey e go
Dem bon Ibrahim Agboola Gambari for  November 24, 1944 for Ilorin for inside Kwara stet in a Fulani Roya famili. Na im broda pikin wey dem dey kol Ibrahim Sulu Gambari bi di Emir for Ilorin.
Gambari go skul for King's College for Legos. Afta dis wan, e kom go one big skul for London wey di nem bi London School of Economics. Na dia e kom get one satifiket wey dem dey kol B.Sc(Economics) in 1968.Gambari kom rili len abaut how pipul dey du tins wit demsef for di hol wold. E kom stil get anoda satifiket wey bi M.A(1978) an ph.D(1974) fom Columbia University wey dey for New York inside USA afta e don rid politiks mata/how pipul tek dey do tins wit demselfs for di whole world.

How e tek stat to tich for skul
Gambari stat to dey tich for 1969 for siti Univasiti of New York bifo e kom wok for Univasiti of Albany. Afta, e kom ticb for Ahmadu Bello Univasiti wey dey for Zaria inside Kaduna Stet. From 1986 go rich 1989,e bi Professor wey dey tich for three difrent big big skul for inside Washington, D.C. Their nem na Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies, Georgetown Univasiti an Howard Univasiti. E don stil join pipul to du one kain wok wey dem dey fain out abaut som kain tins for Brookings Institution still inside Washington D.C. and e stil dey du one wok wey dem dey kol Resident Scholar for Bellagio Study and Conference Center an for Rockefeller Foundation-run center for Italy. E don rait plenti buk an put dem for ples wey get levul wel wel abaut how pipul tek dey du tins wit demself for di hole wold.One of di buk nem na Theory and Reality in Foreign Policy: Nigeria after second Republic.

=How e tek wok
Gambari wok as di oga pata-pata for enitin wey konsain Naijá an oda kontri fom 1984 to 1985 for di taim wey bi sey na General Muhammadu Buhari bi di Army pesin wey dey rul di hole Naijá. Afta dis one, e kom bi di oga pata-pata for Nigerian Institute of International Affairs (NIIA) fom 1990 rich 1999. Na im bi di onli pesin wey don tey wel-wel as pesin wey go stand for Naijya for inside United Nations, e wok onda five different pipul wey rul Naijá.

United Nations

Gambari wok for diffrent-different ples inside United Nations. For 1999, na im bi di oga pata-pata for UNICEF, afta e kom bi di UN  Under-Secretary-General. Gambari bí di pesin wey dey giv di oga pata-pata for UN wey e nem bi Kofi Annan advais abaut Afrika fom 1999 to 2005. E stil bí di fest Under-Secretary-General for di United Nations abaut Politiks mata from 2005 to 2007 wen di oga pata-pata bi Kofi Annan and Ban Ki-Moon. Di last wok wey dem giv am for inside UN na for 2012 wen Ban Ki-moon and di oga pata-pata for di Arican Commission mek am di Joint African Union-United Nations Special Representetiv for Darfur.

Tins wey dem giv am as respet an grup wey im join

 Na im stat Savannah senta and na im bi di oga pata-pata.
 Gambari stil folo bi di oga for Albright-Gambari Commission.
 E dey for one grup wey dem dey kol Johns Hopkins University's Society of Scholars.
 Naijá govment giv am one taitul wey dem dey kol  Commander of the Federal Republic (CFR).
 University of Bridgeport giv am one satifiket wey dem dey kol  honoris kourse an one taitul wey dem dey kol taitul of Doctor of Humane Letters (D.Hum.Litt.).
 For March 4 2013,  di Govnor of Kwara wey im name be Abdulfatah Ahmad mek Ibrahim Gambari di oga pata-pata for  Kwara State University.
title: Ibrahim Gambari

Na for kontri-dem for Africa wet pas 50 dem see di fim an dis one mek Akogo stat to du sho go plenti televishon an fim prodoshon. Inumidun kom get transfa to di Nashonal Assembly for Legos as di sekond Oga for di grup wey dey fom law giv pipul wey go put am for law in 1989.
For September 8,2009 dey chuz am as di shif Judge of Legos Set two years afta Babatunde Fashola don be Govnor for Legos Stet. Di time wey e bi 65 years old, Inumidun stop to dey wok and dat day wey e stop to wok for govment bi June 10, 2012. Isidore de Souza (Dem bon am for April 4, 1934 an e dai for March 13, 1999) na one priest wey kom fom Benin an e bi Arkbishop of Cotonou fom 1990 go rish 1999. Dem bon am inside one rich famili wey dem dey kol De Souza famili of Ouidah for April 4 1934. Na e broda bon Chantal Yayi wey bi di Benin Presido waif fom 2006 to 2016 an Marcel Alain de Souza (1953–2019) wey don dai. E wok for bank an e  bi di oga pata-pata for ECOWAS Commission. De Souza stil go skul for Abidjan an Rome. Na for July 8, 1962 dem mek am priest. For July 8 1962, dem mek De Souza di Coadjutor Archbishop of Cotonou an e kom bi Arkbishop on di 27 of December 1990. Na e bí di lida for di Nashional Konferens for February 1990 wey dem plan to yuz am tok abaut di wey tins bí for di kontri bot e chenj Benin back to demokrasi. E rili put bodi for dis one so dat armi no go kom skatta dis one. De Souza wok as di oga pata-pata for di Hi kansu  of di Republic fom February 28, 1990 to March 31, 1991. E kom stat di taim wey pipul go chuz di pésin wey go rul dem for Benin and di niu law wey go tok abaut all di tins wey evribodi supoz du anbdi one wey dem no go du. Isidore de Souza beg Presido Mathieu Kerekou to assept di tin wey dem don agree for di Kansu an stil riton Benin bak to Demokrasi. De Souza na di oga pata-pata for di Regional Episcopal Conference of Francophone West Africa fom 1997 ontil e kom dai. E die for March 13, 1999 for Ouidah.

Alice Iyabo Ojo (dem bon am December 21, 1977) na  Naija fim aktress, dareto an produsa. Shi don du pas 150 fims an produs more dan 14 fim-dem.

How e stat life an go skul
Iyabo Ojo wey pipul no as Alice Iyabo Ogunro wey dem bon am for Decemba 21, 1977 for Legos Stet, Naija, Iyabo Ojo papa kom from Abeokuta,Ogun stet.
Na shi smol pas inside di three pikin wey ha papa bon an shi kon get two sinior boda for front.Shi go skul for Legos Nashonal kolej Gbagada, bifor shi Kon go stodi Estet Manejment for Legos Stet Politeknik.

Karier

Iyabo Ojo don join drama skul since shi Don dey sekondri skul, shi stat her Aktin karier for 1998. Shi rejista wit di Aktor Guild of Nigeria (AGN), na Bimbo Akintola an som oda pipul hep ha for di rejista.

Ojo don write an akt for plenti Naija fim. Ha fest pley na for 1998's Satanic na inglish languaj fim. For 2002, shi du ha fest Yoruba languaj fim wey bi Baba Darijiwon. For January 2015, ha fim Silence wey shi fishure Josef Benjamin Alex Usifo, Fatia Balogun, an Doris Simon, wey dem show for silvabed sinimas, Ikeja for Legos.

For 2004 Ojo stat dey produs ha fims by ha sef. Ha fest fim na Boluwatife afta dat one shi kon do Bofeboko, Ololufe,  Esan an  Okunkun Biribiri. Shi an ha hosband don fight bifor Shi popula.

Pasona life

Shi mari a Legos bes klearin ajent for 1999, wen shi dey 21 years , Iyabo no Kom rest smol for aktin. Shi Kom bon one son an one dota (shi bon for 1999 an 2001) wey their nem na Felix Ojo an Priscilla Ajoke Ojo, bot Iyabo an their papa no dey togeda again. Shi tok set na bikos sey shi too smol wen shi mari na why di marej skata. Shi kon stil tok say Shi no go dey use ha bifor bifor hosband nem, wey bi Ojo.

Pinkies Foundeshon

Iyabo Ojo opun ha NGO, Pinkies Foundeshon, wey dey sopot smol smol child wey nid hep an speshial pikin dem, in May 2011. Shi selibret di fifth anivasri for di foundeshon for May 1, 2016 for R&A siti hotel,Ikeja,Legos.

For April, 2021, Shi kondem anoda aktor wet bi Yomi Fabiyi bikos im dey piti Olanrewaju Omikunle(Baba ijesha) wey polis arest bikos im molest one smol pikin for may 12, 2021.shi kon tek legal action egenst Yomi Fabiyi ( wey donn dey fait sey mek dem rilis Baba ijesha) sey Iyabo don use mouth dey spoil di man. DIS tin wey Iyabo du no mek everibodi for Theatre Art and Motion Pictures Practitioner Association of Nigeria (TAMPAN) hapi so tey dem tok sey mek nobodi kol am for fim for Jun 28, 2021.  Aktor Jide Kosoko tok dis one insaid legit.ng  di time wey im dey reprisent TAMPAN sey Noliwood fimmeka unda di asosiashon go stop to dey wok wit ha.

text:
Chief Jacob Sogboyega Odulate (1884–1962) wey pipul no wel wel as Blessed Jacob na  Naijá pesin wey dem mek medisine, dey mek niu-niu tins, rait abaut diferent tins. E get im own biznes an na im du one medisine wey dem dey kol Alabukun.

How im tek stat life
No bí only one waif Jacob papa marri an dem dey kol im papa Pa Odulate. Na for 1884 dem tek bon Jacob for Ikorodu. Di man wey bon im mama nem na Chief Aina Odukanmade  di fest Moslim wey e papa kom fom Senlu wey bí one pat of  Ranodu famili for Imota, wey dey near Ikorodu. Wen Jacob dey 14 years, e komot for e papa house for Ikorodu go Abeokuta for Ogun stet. Na 3 month e tek yuz leg waka rich where e dey go. Wen e rich Abeokuta, e meet one man wey dey du medisine. Di man nem na Dr. Sapara. Na dis man tich am di smol-smol sens wey dey help pesin fit du medisine. 

Na wen Jacob dey as yong man, e opun e own kompini wey dem dey kol Alabukun an di kompini dey du diferent-diferent medisine.

Alabukun medisine
Na for 1918, (di year wen di British Pipu rili wan rule us), for one evinin for inside e smol kompini wey e  like wel wel wey e dey kol "headquaters" for Sapon for inside Abeokuta wie e fest build di headquaters of e kompini wey get bot wie e dey wok, e ofis, di room wey pipul fit kom tok to am abaut dia problem an di ples wey im tek dey mek im medisine. Jacob kom try to du di Alabukun dat veri day. Na im waif an im pikin-dem join am du dis medisine. E kom stil du oda tins like Alabukun Mentholine an one buk wey im dey sel every year wey dem dey kol Alabukun Almanac wey rili sell wel-wel fom 1920 to 1950 for Abeokuta an odas ples near Abeokuta.

Wen e dey du di medisine, almost all di tins wey dem yuz du di medisine kom fom Liverpool for United Kingdom. Na  acetylsalicylic acid an caffeine bi di main tins wey Alabukun pauda get. One paket of Alabukun get 760 mg of acetylsalicylic acid and 60 mg of caffeine wey kom mek  evritin bi 820 mg and odas tins wey dey mek di medisine last long and evritin kom get 1000mg pauda an di total weight go rich 1400mg. Som of di tins di medisine dey wok for headik, pesin wey teeth dey pain, pesin wey throat dey pain, e dey hep mek blood no gum togeda for bodi like sey na akamu, pesin wey bodi dey pain, heart attak, pesin wey im blood no dey flow wel for bodi an pesin wey no dey breet wel. Dis medisine dey wok wel wel an e dey hep put adenosine for inside bodi. E dey hep stop pain for bodi an hep pesin to dey breath fine. If pesin no yuz am wel, e fit kos mek plenti tins like wota plenti for pesin bodi, e fit no mek pesin breet wel, e fit dey mek pesin vomit, an e fit mek pesin belle dey du am one kind and e go mek pesin eye dey see doubu

For 100 years now, dis podut don dey sel wel wel for evriwia for Naijá, for Benin Republic, Cameroon, Ghana an som pat of Europe. For now, na one of di grand pikin of Chief Jacob Odulate wey e nem bí Koye Odulate dey manej di kompini.

Im Family
Jacob Odulate waif bi Sekumade Abiodun Odulate. E let all im pikin go skul wel wel. E yuz di moni wey e gain from im bizness tek send  im pikin-dem go skul for Durham, Newcastle, United States an London so dat dem go bikom pipul wey dey tich odas pipul, dokto, loya an enginia. One of e pikin na Chief Mrs. Folake Solanke née Odulate wey bi di fest wuman to be SAN for Naijá.

text:
Japan na kontri for di Pacific Ocean. E ste bai Asia.

Di Prime Minista na Fumio Kishida.

Tori abaut di ples
For AD 794, Kyoto di kapital. Di Emperor don get no big pawa. Families (clans) wey tek pawa  don rul di kontri. Di Fujiwara clan don tek di kontri, den di Taira clan don tek di kontri. Den Yoritomo don tek di kontri, na e don mek militiri Gofment. Di Emperor don se e dey shogun (Great General). Den di Hojo clan don take di kontri.

Di Mongols don invade Japan for 1274. Dem win a few battles den go comot. Dem invade Japan again for 1281 na fail.

For 1338 di Ashikaga clan don tek di kontri.

For 1582 Hideyoshi Toyotomi don tek di kontri. E dey "regent". E don unify di kontri. For 1592 na 1597 e don invade Korea. When e don die, Japan don go comot Korea.

Den di Tokugawa clan don take di kontri.

For di 16th century, oyibo don go to Japan. Dem don trade an preach  For di 17th century, Japan don kill many Christians na don make di oyibo go comot. Dem se only one ship fit come a year, na Japanese no fit go comot.

For 1857, di USA don make Japan open dem ports.

For 1868 Emperor Mutsuhito don take power from di shogun. E don move di kapital to Edo (Tokyo). Im court don modernize di kontri. Dem don make a constitution for 1889, wey don mek di Emperor di only power.

For 1904, Japan don fight Russia. Japan don win for 1905. 

For World War I, Japan don take some colonies of Germany wey be for Asia na di Pacific Ocean.

For 1931, Japan don take Manchuria, wey be for China.

For World War II, Japan don be Axis Power. Di USA don no fit trade oil with Japan. For 1941, Japan don attack di USA for Pearl Harbor. Den di USA don se war on di Axis Powers. Dem go fight Japan a little, go fight mostly for Europe. After Germany don surrender, di USA go fight Japan more. For 1945, di USA don drop two atomic bombs on cities for Japan. Dem se 129,000-226,000 pipul don die. Den Japan don surrender.

After di war, Japan don become industrial na di economy don go well-well.

Politics
Japan dey get Emperor, wey bi Head of State. Di Emperor no get big big power. Im name bi Akihito.

Nashonal Diet
Di Nashonal Diet na di Legislative branch for Japan. Japan first get di Diet for 1889. Di Diet dey get two houses: di House of Representatives na di House of Councillors.

Executive branch
Di Nashional Diet go fit name di Prime Minister. Di Prime Minister go fit name di Ministers in di Cabinet.

Judicial branch
Di Judicial branch get di Supreme Court and four oda courts.

Esomugha na im bi di pesin wey get Jim lyke foundashon for pikin dem wit speshial  bodi wahala. Iyke go Kenya for December 2012 go sopot di "Make a Change Campaign" na shariti projet wey bi sey di owna na Christopher Grey, an Jamaican dans hol artist Cecile.

Dem bon Jumoke George on February 18, an na for Ibadan, in Oyo stet. Im papa bin souja fo Naijá an im stepmama na norse wey don wok for hami.

Wen George bi 8 years old, one famili frend hep am stat to dey du Aktin. Shi do aktin for stage wit NTA ( National Television Authority), Ibadan. Shi enta a drama klass for Ibadan wen Victor Ashaolu pay for. Jumoke kom stat to dey akt Yoruba fim.
Wen aktin bi laik se no shoo, George kom bi memba of FIBAN (Freelance and Independent Broadcasters Association of Nigeria).
Jumoke don bi di tok tok pesin for Fauve live shoo an dis one de mek am bizi wen shi no de akt.

text:
Kayode Adebowale (Dem bon am for January 11, 1962) na  Naijá scientist wey bi di niu Vice-Chancellor of di  'University of Ibadan, Oyo State.

How e tek stat life an go Skul
Dem bon am on 11 day of January, 1962 inside  famili of late Mr. and Mrs. Adebowale Esuruoso. Im go pamari Skul for St. Marks Primary School, Oke-Ijaga, Ijebu-Igbo fom 1967 enta 1972 afta wey im kom go dj im sekondiri edukashion for Ayedaade Grammar School, Ikire fom 1973 enta 1978. Afta Adebowale finish sekondiri Skull, im fom dia enta University of Ibadan for September 1980, na dia im kom get B.Sc degree inside Chemistry for June 1984; M.Sc degree inside Industrial Chemistry for September, 1985, kom join Ph.D inside Industrial Chemistry for October, 1991.

How e tek work
Professor Adebowale bin stat work inside University of Ibadan as Graduate Assistant for 1987 enta 1991. For October 1991, e see work for Federal University of Technology, Akure wey dem bin giv am  Leshora II, kom promot am enta di grades of Leshora I for 1994 plus Senior Leshora in 1997.Adebowale kari transfa tek kom  bak to University of Ibadan for February 1999 as Senior Leshora an na so dem kom tek promot am enta di grades of Reader for 2003 and Professor for October 2006.

Professor Adebowale bin hold plenti plenti administrative posts as im don wok inside meni komitees for University of Ibadan''. Dem be 
Examinations Officer, Department of Chemistry, 2003-2005; Postgraduate Coordinator, Department of Chemistry, 2000 – 2002; Sub-Dean (Postgraduate), Faculty of Science, 2002-2004; Dean, Faculty of Science, 2009-2011; Member, Komitees of Provosts and Deans, 2009-2011; Member Komitees on di Appointment of Emeritus Professors, 2012 to date. The Director, Special Duties, Office of the Vice-Chancellor, between 2015 and 2016.

Awards wey im don win
Professor Adebowale don win plenti plenti awods wey inklud: Fellow, Nigerian Academy of Science, FAS 2012; Fellow of di Institute of Chartered Chemists of Nigeria, FICCON, Research Fellow, Alexandra von Humboldt Foundation, Germany 1996 to date; Regular Associate, Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics, (ICTP) Trieste, Italy, 2003-2006; recipient, International Foundation for Science (IFS) Grant, 2002-2004; and recipient, African Union Kwame Nkrumah Continental Scientific Award for Science, Technology and Innovation, 2013.

Achievements
As im wan promote original research inside Chemical Sciences among young scientists  for Nigeria, Prof. Adebowale come put for ground two awards in 2014 for people wey bi members of di Nigerian Young Academy (NYA): Prof. Kayode Adebowale National Scientist Prize for Wumen in Chemical Sciences and Prof. Kayode Adebowale National Scientist Prize.

Professor Adebowale bí ogbonge akada man wey don do external examiner for meni universities for inside Naijá an abroad. Universities wey Adebowale bin dey do external examiner include Federal University of Technology, Akure; Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta; Delta State University, Abraka; Olabisi Onabanjo University, Ago-Iwoye; Federal University of Technology, Yola; Bells University of Technology, Ota; Ladoke Akintola University of Technology, Ogbomoso; Vaal University of Technology, Vanderbijlpark, South Africa and University of Botswana, Gaborone.

Professor Adebowale bi reviewer of plenti international journals wey include: Journal of Hazardous Materials; Chemistry and Ecology; Food Research International; Journal of Food Composition and Analysis; Thermochimica Acta, Biochemical Engineering, Carbohydrate Polymers, Agriculture and Food Chemistry; International Journal of Biological macromolecules and Starke.

Im bi representative for Physical Sciences group inside di kouncil of di Nigerian Academy of Science for 2016 enta 2018 kom bi oga Chairman for Chemical Society of Nigeria (CSN), Oyo State Chapter for 2016 til now.

As ogbonge acada wey im bi, im don supervise plenti plenti B.Sc projects, M.Sc dissertations wey don pass 150 come join 15 doctoral students. 
Im don publish articles wey pass 120 for inside koret local an international journals, kom get one patent wey him don register.

Im pasonal life
Professor Adeboye du marej with  Dr. ‘Yemisi Ajibola Adebowale anbGod don bless di marej wit three pikin: Temitayo, Ayobami an Ayomitunde.

Hau e stat life
Dey bon Ken Erics on February 28, 1985 for Kano Stet.E bi di six pikin inside di seven Pikin-dem wey e papa an mama bon.E papa na Eric Chukwuemeka Nwenweh an e mama na Grace Ifeyinwa Nwenweh an bot of dem na kom fom Enugwu-Ukwu for Anambra Stet, Southeast Naijá. Na from smol pikin Eric don like akt.Erics sho passion for aktin an na dis one mek am go rid Theatre Arts for Nnamdi Azikiwe University Awka, Anambra Stet. How e tek wok
For 2001, as a fest year student for Univasiti, Erics get im fest muvee rol  for one fim wey Chris Ubani daret wey di nem na  Holy Prostitute. Na smol rol e akt for di fim an na medikal doktor e akt wit jost three scenes. As e finish Univasiti, e stat to go orditions an get smol smol rol for home muvee. Na for 2012 wey e akt "Ugo" for di muvee The Illiterate na e mek am blow wey dareto an podusa kom dey you am wel wel dey akt.
As raita, Erics fest buk  wey e rait wey di nem na Cell an dem don  dey yuz am for som Skul in Naijá for stage podukshon an akademi tins.
Erics sabi plai kiboard an guitar an  bi get musical band, im stil don du orijinal muvee soundtracks for som fim-dem.

How e tek stat life
Kafidipe wey dem bon July 29, 1980 kom fom Ikereku, Abeokuta Ogun Stet, Southwestern Naijá. Shi go Abeokuta Grammar School for im sekondiri skul bifor e go rid Mass Communication for  Olabisi Onabanjo University.

How e tek wok
Di fest fim wey Kabirah akt inside na The White Handkerchief.Di fim na smol fim inside one buk The Virgin wey Bayo Adebowale fest rite.Na Tunde Kelani bi di podusa an Dareto of di fim.Pipul stat to no e nem wel wel afta Kabirah du Saworoide wey Tunde Kelani mek an podus.Saworoide na 1999 Naijá fim wey Kunle Afolayan, Peter Fatomilola, Kola Oyewo, Yemi Shodimu dey inside. Kabirat leta akt inside one 2004 Naijá fim, wey di nem na The Campus Queen. Im dey inside The Narrow Path, a 2006 fim wey  Sola Asedeko, Beautiful Nubia akt inside an na  Tunde Kelani du di fim for Mainframe Films and Television Productions.Di pat wey e akt for Iwalewa mek Kabirat win one awod for di Africa Movie Academy Awards as di Best Aktress in a lidin Rol in 2006. Kabirat akt inside .Shi Dazzling Mirage, a 2014 Naijá drama fim, wey Tunde Kelani podus an daret an Kunle Afolayan, Bimbo Manuel, Yomi Fash Lanso, Taiwo Ajai Lycett also dey inside di fim.Kabirat mek one fim wey get di nem  Bintu an dey fest sho di fim for R & A Hotel at Opebi in Ikeja, Lagos Stet.

Chief Sunday Adeniyi Adegeye MFR (Dem bon am for September 22, 1946) wey pipul sabi wel wel as King Sunny Ade na Naijá juju singa, song rita. Na pesin wey dem sabi for Afrika, bikos e dey amog Afrika musishian wey dem fest sabi for di  wold wey dey sing Afrikan pop.
Sunny Ade gada e band for 1967, wey pipul kom leta no as African Beats. Afta dey don no am wel wel for Naijá, Sunny Ade kom get e own own  label for 1970s. Na 1982 Sunny Ade sign for Island rekods an pipul sabi am wel well wit di album Juju Music(1982) an sychro system (1983); wey mek e nem dey for pipul wey fit win Grammy awod, wey bi fest for Naijá singa. Sunny Ade 1998 album wey bi Odu stil mek dem kol e nem for singa wey fit win Grammy awod. Na Sunny Ade bi di chairpersin for Musical Copyright Society of Nigeria.

How e tek stat life
Dem bon Sunny Ade for Osogbo. Im mama an papa na fom King famili an dey kom fom Ondo an Akure an dat one kom mek sunny a prince (Omoba) in Yoruba land. Sunny Ade papa na Organist for choch an im mama wey bi Maria Adegeye (neè Adesida) dey sel tins for maket.

Tori about e wok
Sunny Ade komot for gramma skul for Ondo like sey e wan dey go Univasiti of Legos (Unilag). Na for Legos e stat e Musika karia.Sunny Ade karia stat wit Moses Olaiya's Federal Rhythm dandies, wey bi hilife band. E kom go fom anoda band wey bi The Green Spot for 1967. Bikos of e kind muzik an biznes, Sunny Ade bkom  chenj di band nem fest  to Afrikan Beats an leta kon chenj am to Golden Merkury.
King Sunny Ade dey luk pipul lik Tunde Nightingale ezampul wey mek am kopi som of im 'so wa nbe'  way of juju music.

King Sunny Ade get King Sunny Ade Foundation wey niu pipul dey len how to sing, di foundation stil get studio an room wey pesin wey dey len musik fit stey.

King Sunny Ade na ticha for Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife. Im stil get Order of the Federal Republic.

How im tek pafom
Afta dey don no Sunny Ade wel wel for Naijá, dem lik am for Europe an North America. Dey kol Sunny Ade nem as pesin wey sabi sing for di wold inside  New York papar.
Na July 16 2017, Sunny Ade tok sey e go du sho wit Ebenezer Obey for London, dey kol di sho Night to remember with the Legend.

Pipul wey im don wok wit
Sunny Ade don wok wit plenti pipul lik Manu Dibango(Wakafrika) an Steve Wonder, im stil folo Wasiu Alabi pasuma an Bola Abimbola wok.

Kontrat wey Sunny Ade folo Island Rekod label du mek am wok wit Youssou N'Dour, Mali's Salif Keita. an plenti oda pipul.

Im Fim karia
Inside 1980's, Sunny Ade wok for Hollywood.
E song dey for 1983 Breathless, wey Richard Gere dey inside an 1986 komedi One More Saturday Night. Sunny Ade dey Robert Altman's 1987 komedi O.C. and Stiggs. Im du fim inside Naijá Nollywood sef.

Im Awods
Sunny Ade kolet meni awod for im karia.Fod  November 2016, e kolet Afrima awod. Inside December 2016, Sunny Ade dey amog Hard Rock Cafe hall of fame. For February 2021, e nem enta Headies Hall of fame 2020.

Layiwola Lai Mohammed (Dem bon am December 6, 1951) na Naijá lorya an politishian. Im bi di Minista for informashon an kolture, im don dey di ples sice November 2015.Lai Muhammad stil bi di forma  All Progressives Congress  National Publicity Secretary. 
Tori abaut Life
Dey bon Lai Muhammed inside Alhaji Mohammed Adekeye famili. E kom fom Oro for Kwara Stet.E rid French for Obafemi Awolowo University wey e tek get e Bachelor Degree in di year 1975.Lai Muhammed rid Law for  University of Lagos kon leta go Nigeria Law School in 1986. As lorya wey dey wok, e folo stat di Legal Firm of Edu & Mohammed for 1989.

Bizness
Lai Mohammed na biznesman an na e bi di chairman for Opmedia Limited, wey bi pat of Afromedia Plc wey don dey sice 18 December 2008. Na im bi di Dareto for Afromedia Plc sice May 2011. Lai Mohammed na memba of Nigeria Institute of Public Relations (NIPR) an e wok  as pesin wey dey folo pipul tok as ofisa for 10 years wit di Naijá Airpot, wey kon bi Federal Airport Authority of Nigeria (FAAN).

Politis
For October 2002, na Alhaji Lai Mohammed bi di pesin wey stand as Kwara State govnor 2023 for Alliance for Democracy parti. Lai Mohammed don sarf as Chief of staff for Tinubu wen im bi di govnor.

Lai mohammed na politishian an forma National Publicity Secretary for All progressives Congress'' (APC) for Naijà. Na November 11, 2015, im enta ofis as minista for infomashon an kolture onda President Mohammed Buhari govment for Naijá, afta Naijà Senate don chek am. Lai Mohammed stil enta ofis di sekond tim for 21 August 2019.

beliefs. Imasuen get am for mind to du don  one fim wey di nem bi Nogbaisi Ovonramwen for 2013,wey go dey abaut di last Oba of Benin.

Nollywood Babylon

In 2008 a Canadian documentary Nollywood Babylon co-direkted by Ben Addelman an Samir Mallal, an produs by AM Pictures an di National Film Board of Canada in association with di Documentary Channel, followed Lancelot Oduwa Imasuen while he was shooting his 157th film Bent Arrows. Di dokumentary played in di Offishal kompetishon at di Sundance Fim Festival in January 2009. Bent Arrows was rilised into di Nigerian home market in 2010.

text:
Lateef Oludare Raji (dem bon am for October 12, 1962 an e dai for August 14, 2017) na Naijá Politishian wey wok as di pesin wey dey giv Babatunde Fashola advais for infomashon on how to du plenti plenti plan for som kind mata for di time wey Fashola bi di gofnor of Legos Stet. Wen Bola Tinubu stil bi gofnor for Legos Stet, Lateef stil wok as wan big oga for Legos. Bifo e dai, im join di pipul wey dey wok for Lagos State Independent Electoral Commission committee (LASIEC).

Tori abaut e life an how e tek go skul  
Dem bon Raji for Ondo Ste for October 12, 1962. Na for inside 1974 go rish 1978 e stat e skul for Irekari Grammar School, Idoani. Raji stil go Church High School, Owo for 1978 an na for 1980 e get e Ordinary Level School Certificate. Afta dis one, Raji kom stil go big skul wey dem dey kol yunivasiti of Legos to len abaut tins wey don hapun bifor (History). Di skul kom giv am Bachelor of Arts (Hons) for 1997.For 2000, e kom get im Masters degree for tins wey don hapun bifor (History).

How e tek wok an du politis 
For inside 1996 go rish 2000, Raji stat to dey rait buk for Ahrada West African Publishing. Na for dia e fest stat to dey wok. Dem leta mek am di oga kpata-kpata for di kompini bitwin year 2000 go rish 2003. Raji stil wok as pesin wey dey stand for Naijá for di World Education Resources Centre, United Kingdom fom 2003 go rish 2007. E kom stil bi di oga kpata-kpata for Thrazel Naijá.
Na for 1999 im stat to du politis. Na Raji bi di Seketri for di Alliance for Democracy for Legos Stet. Wen wahala hapun for dis parti, di parti kom skata an Raji kom bi di oga kpata-kpata for one of di grup wey skata from di Alliance for Democracy. Pipul stil like am for di way wey im disain di logo for di All Progressive Congress. Na im hand bi dat hand wey hold brum for di flag sins di time wey dia nem bi Action Congress of Nigeria an ivun afta dem chenj their nem to APC.Raji try kontest to bi di pesin wey go dey stand for Oshodi/Isolo pipul for di Govament side for Naijá onda APC but e no si di tiket kolet. Dem kom leta ton am to pesin we go dey advais Gofnor Babatunde Fashola on infomashon an plenti plenti plan for som kind mata. For 2015, Raji stil try to stand for di pipu for Oshodi/Isolo for House of Representatives bot no bi e win am, na Hon. Timothy Olumuyiwa Olubintanwin win di tiket. Raji stil try to bi di person we go bikom di gofnor of Ondo Stet for 2016 onda APC. For 29 June 2016, Gofnor Akinwunmi Ambode mek Raji join pipu wey dey wok for di ples wey dem dey du alk di mata wey konsan vot for Legos Stet wey their nem bi Lagos State Independent Electoral Commission committee (LASIEC).

E pasonal life
Raji na muslim an e mari Alhaja Raji. Na four pikin-dem e bon.

How e tek dai
Raji dia for eli monin on August 14, 2017 afta e don try to trit kansa of di trot. Bikos na muslim e bi, na dat sem day dey beri am for e vilej for Idoani, Ondo Stet.

Na for Osogbo for Osun Stet, in Naijá Omoniyi tek kom fom bot na Lagos e tek gro up.Na Legos shi do all im Primari, Sekondiri and Univasiti.Lepa Shandy go Ire Akari Primari Skul, an kom go Isolo kompihesive Hi Skul for im Sekondiri Skool.Shi go Unilag ( University of Lagos) go rid Data Processing. Omoniyi enta Naijá in 1995.Na fom ledis wey dey do Fashion for stage e tek stat bikos Lepa Shandy no tu get bodi.Shi kom dey do mek-up  for aktor bifor shi kom stat to akt fim in Naijá Nollywood indostree in 1996. Wen Omoniyi wan du e 45th years old on  April 16, 2016, shi tek dat opotuniti tel pipul of im niu fim Eri Ife Leyifor di parti wey shi dey du for im baday.Meni of Omoniyi frend an aktors kom di parti an di bifor bifor fest ledi of Lagos Stet, Abimbola Fashola.

Mrs Agnes an dey sho di fim for two years on NTA Netwok.In 1994, di pat wey bi ashewo wey e akt for di home vidio Glamour Girls mek pipul no am wel wel as wuman wey fit akt fim wel wel .Benson don ritaya to dey du fim sice 1996.

By di taim Benson go kom bak to aktin for Nollywood, e don bi bon-again Kristen an e don stat to dey tok abaut God as ful time wok.
