text:
Mejai Bola Mike Avoseh na profeso for one yunivasti wey dem dey kol University of Dakota. Di tins wey im dey tich na abaut skul wey pipul wey no bi smol pikin dey go, how difren pipul dey du dia difren difren kolsho for di wold an abaut som patikula ples-dem. Avoseh folo for di join-bodi for di grup wey dem kol American Association for Adult and Continuing Education (AAACE) sins 2016 an e stil folo dey for International Society for Comparative Adult (ISCAE) from 2020 go rich 2023 an na im bi di oga kpata-kpata for di Commission for International Adult Education (CIAE) for inside AAACE.

How e tek go skul
Avoseh get im bachelor satifiket for 1982 an masta digri satifiket for Philosophy for 1984. E kom stil get anoda satifiket afta skul for how dem tek dey tich for 1987 an anoda one wey dem dey kol Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D) for pipul wey no bi smol pikin wey stil dey go skul for 1991. Avoseh get ol of dem for yunvasti wey bi  University of Ibadan. Im stil get anoda satifiket wey bi Master of Science for Educational Leadership and Administration for College of Saint Rose wey dey for Albany for 2006. Avoseh na konfam K-12 ticha an na big pesin for New York State. E stil get satifiket for SAS (School Administrator and Supervisor) an SDA (School and District Administration).

How e tek wok
Fom 1986 go rish 1995, Avoseh stat to dey tich pipul wey don finish sekondiri skul as lekshora for di dipatment wey konsan pipul wey no bi smol pikin but stil de go skul for University of Ibadan an Saints Peter and Paul Seminary for Ibadan. E kom from dia go tich for di University of Namibia from 1998 go rish 2001. Afta dis one, e kom go tich for USA for inside New York Public School System from 2001 go rish 2004. Dem mek am as pesin wey go dey asist anoda profeso for inside University of South Dakota for 2004 an las-las dem mek am ful profeso for 2015.

Avoseh don rili wok wel wel and tich for difren-difren pat wey konsan pipul wey no bi smol pikin again wey wan stil go skul espeshali how dem tek de len, to dey shwo sey nobodi du enibodi wayo an difren difren way to yuz tich pipul an skul wey dem dey inside wey dey tich abaut ods ples for di wold for Naija, Namibia, United States an for Botswana (dem mek am Fulbright Scholar).
For 2019, dem giv am one awod wey dem dey kol Outstanding Service Medallion for inside American Association fo Adult and Continuing Education (AAACE). Na two times Avoseh don kolet one awod wey be J. Williams Fulbright Core Award for U.S Scholars for di wey e tek dey tich an du risach. Di last Fulbright awod wey im kolet na for March 2019 to tich an du risach for Naija. As dem si sey e rili put bodi for di mata we konsan pipul wey no bi smol pikin wey wan go skul, for September 2021, dem put Avoseh nem for one big grup wey dem dey kol International Adult and Continuing Education (IACE) Hall of Fame an na October 6 2021 dem go put am las-las fo inside . E don rait wel-wel abaut difren-difren tins wey konsan pipul we no bi smol pikin wey wan go skul, abaut how pipu de du dem own type of skul for difren-difren pat of di word, how pipul tek dey bikom pat of anoda kontri, how to divelop ples wey neva opun, how to rid an rite, how pesin kolsho tek bi an how man an wuman tek sopoz dey si demsef an som kind rul wey go dey kontrol skul mata, wit difren-difren buk wey bi sey di pipul wey print dem na pipul wey dem sabi wel-wel. E get one tin wey im rait for inside one buk wey dem dey kol Africa for lifelong learning. Pipul dey always tok abaut dat tin bikos e mek sens wel-wel.

Afta di anouncement , dem kom stat diskushun wit AS Trenčín; Ajax patna klub for Slovakia, wey di ona na Tschen La Ling wey don pley for Ajax bifor.

text:
Mount Evarest na di monten wey hi pas for di wold. E dey  for one ples wey get bandri bitwin China an Nepal, an e tol rich 8,848.86m (29,031.7ft). Na di govament wey dey China an Nepal tok di meshoment for 2020. Na bikos of how Mount Evarest tol rich mek plenti pipul wey dia wok na to klaimb monten an oda pipul trai to klaimb am. Dis monten get two koret rod wey dem dey folo klaimb am. Di fest one na rod wey fez South for Nepal wey dem dey kol standard route wey bi di beta rod, an di sekond rod dey for North side for di smol siti for Tibet for China. Evun as e bi sey di beta road standard route no tu get plenti wahala to fit kliamb di maunten, na plenti danger dey for di oda road dem to tek kliamb di maunten like, strong wind, iceblok and oda wahala dem. Until di year 2019, pipul wey don pas 300 don die ontop di maunten an their bodi stil dey there. Pipul wey dia wok na to de kliamb maunten fom Britain bi di fest Pipul for rekod wey don trai to kliamb di maunten rish top kpatakpata.
For dat time, di kontri of Nepal no giv stranja shans to enta their kontri, na dis one mek pipul we dey kliamb maunten from Britain go pas di road we dey for Tibet for China. For 1921, pipul from Britain try to kliamb am and dem rish di ples wey hi rish 7000m (22,970ft) for north side. Afta one year for 1922, di same pipul from Britain stil try kliamb am pas wia dem rish bifor. Dem rish 8,320m (26,247ft). Dis na di fest time wey enibodi go go up pas 8,000m (26,247ft). For 1924, somtin wey rili konfus pesin hapun wen dem dey kliamb di maunten an na somtin wey no neva de klear rish today. George Mallory an Andrew Irvine trai for di las taim to rish di top kpatakpata for June 1924, bot dem no kom bak. Dis wan kom kos plenti agument weda na dem fest rish di top or no bi dem.
Tenzing Norgay an Edmund Hillary  go dia fest jonni wey di kontri giv dem pamishon to kliamb di maunten Evarest for 1953. Dem pas di koret road standard route wey dey for Nepal.Norgay don fest climb di maunten rish 8,595m (28,199ft) for 1952, wen Im an oda pipul fom di same kontri for Swiss kliamb am.

Tenzing an Hillary klamb Rish up Kpatakpata
For di year 1953, pipul wey dey kliamb maunten from Britain kom bak Nepal for di 9th time wit their oga John Hunt to try rish di top. Hunt selet two (2) pipul wey dem nem na Tom Bourdillon and Charles Evans. Dem kliamb am and e remain smol like 100m (330ft) to rish di top for May 26 1953, bot dey kom bak bikos dem no get briz again. Two (2) days afta, Edmund Hillary wey kom fom New Zealand an Tenzing Norgay wey kom fom Nepal kliamb di maunten rish di top kpatakpata for (11:30) May 29, 1953. Afta som years don pas, Tenzing tok sey na Hillary fest put im leg for di top bifor am. Dem wait tek picture bifor dey kom daun. Di time wey di nuiz rish di queen Elizabeth II for Britain eye, E sey mek dey honor dem.

Oda Names Wey Dem Dey Kol Maunt Evarest
Maunt Evarest for Tibet langwej na Qomolangma wey mean Holi Moda. Dem write dis nem down for di fest time for China langwej for 1721 di time wey Emperor Kangxi Qing of China dey rul. Anoda nem for di maunten for China langwej—— na Shèngm ǔ Fēng (Holi Moda pik), Deodungha (Holi Maunten). But dey don komot all dis nem dem for 1952. For di stat of 1960, Nepal giv am one nem wey bi Sagarmāthā or Sagar-martha. Di nem mean di head of di sky. Sagar na skai and māthā na head for Nepal languej.

Mudashiru Obasa (Dem bon am for November 11, 1972) na Naijá lorya, Politishian, memba of All Progressives Congress (APC) an na Spika for di Lagos State House of Assembly.

How e tek stat Life
Na for Agege wey dey Legos stet inside Naijá dey bon Mudashiru. E du pamari skul for St Thomas Acquinas Pry School, for Surulere, Legos bifor e kom go du sekondiri skul for Archbishop Aggey Memorial Secondary school for Mushin, Ilasamaja, Legos. Na dia e kolet im satifiket for di West African School. E kolet im Bachelor digri for law in di University of Lagos State for 2006.

Im Politika Karia
For 1999, Mudashiru join bodi kontest for kounselo posishion for Agege lokal govament onda one parti for politiks wey bi Alliance for Democracy party (AD) and e win an dis mek am fit serve araund 1999 go rish 2002.
For 2019, E join bodi kontest again for eleshion for e aria win. E kom bi memba for Lagos State house of Assembly. Na Mudashiru bi di fest pesin to dey dat sit for three times, an di fifth term rekod. Di time wey dem dey du  EndSARS for e stet, dey rekod for live TV wey e tok sey di LSHA no go fit
For di time wey dem dey du EndSARS  for im stet, wey be Legos dem rekod am for live TV wey e say di LSHA no go fit konfam di pipu wey dai for polis hand wen dem dey du di one minit silence for di pipul wey dem kil for Lekki an oda pipul for Naijá.

Im koropshon kes
For 2020, di ripot for Sahara Kari out one mata sey e du magomago abaut one poblik moni. Bot e no gri wit wetin dem put for e hed. Ripot pipul kom leta sey dat Economic and Financial Crimes Commission kari Obasa to
ask am som tins for 8 and 9 Octorber 2020. Fom wetin inside pesin tel di Sahara pipul, dem say Obasa du like pesin wey no wel for di EFCC wen dem dey ask am som kwesions, an dis mek dem stop to ask am oda tins. Dem nid to Kari Obasa go dia sick bay bifor dey kom free am. Obasa kom ask for im passport for am to go for tritment for obodo Oyinbo bifor e go du Umrah wia e mit Bola Tinubu for Saudi Arabia. Obasa dey onda alligeshon by di EFCC for Kes of moni magomago.

Muhammadu Gambo Jimeta (Dem bon am for 15 April 15, 1937 an e dai for January 21, 2021) na forma oga kpatakpata for di Naijá Police Force. Dem giv am di wok for 1986 afta Etim Inyang don komot an na Aliyu Attah kolet di wok afta e sef komot. Na e stil bi Nashonal Sekuriti Advaisa to Ibrahim Babangida Wey bi Naijá foma presido.

Tori of e laif
Dem bon am for Jimeta for  April 15, 1937.

How e tek go skul
Gambo na nem wey dem dey kol am an na Jimeta Elementary skul(1947-49) an Yola Middle Skul(1950-55) e go wen e stil smol.

Afta, e go Bauchi Provincial Sekondri skul(1956 - 1958) an Govment koleg for (1958-1959) bifo e go Naijá Police koleg Kaduna an Police koleg Ikeja for (1959).

E stil go Detective Training School, Wakefield for Uk(1962), Bramhill Police koleg for Uk(1963), Intanashona Police Akademi, for Washington DC, USA(1980) an Nashona Police Akademi for Cairo, Egypt.

How e tek wok
Afta e komot foy Police koleg, Gambo stat to wok as Cadet sub-Inspector. For 1963, dem promot am go Assistant Superintendent of Police(ASP). An for 1967 dem giv am Deputy Superintendent of Police(DSP). For 1969, dem giv am full Superintendent.

For 1972, dem promot am to Chief Superintendent of Police an for 1974 dem promote am to Assistant komishona of police. For 1977 dem promot am to komishona of police an na Lagos dem post am go. Dem giv am national fame as crack police offisa wey dey kach arm robas for di Stet.

For 1982, dem promot am to AIG an dem transfa am to Force Criminal Investigation Division for Alagbon Klose Lagos. For 1984, dem promot am go DIG an for 1986 dem promote am go Inspekto Genera of Police.

Afta e don ritaya
For 2011, Goodluck Jonathan wey bi di presido chuz am as memba of di Presidential Advisory Committee on Prerogative of Mercy.

How e tek dai
E dai for Thursday January 21, 2021.

text:
Naija/Naijiria/Nigeria (Inglish: Nigeria) na one kontri for Afrika. Di Federal Republic of Nigeria, wey evribodi dey kol Naija, na kontri wey dey bitwin sentra and West Afrika. Naija get  borda with Niger for di north, Chad for di northeast, Cameroon in di southeast, an Benin in di west. E kom jam wota for saut on top di Gulf of Guinea wey dey Bar-beach (Atlantic Ocean). Naija get 36 stet an Fediral kapita Teritiri, wey di kapital dey Abuja. Naija no get govament riligion an na chuz di pipul  dey chuz dia god or oga.

Naija bi di aria of plenti plenti kindom an tribal stets for meni years. Bot dat na bifor, as e dey todey, na as how di oyinbo pipul put am dat time for 19th senturi wen British join Southern Naija an Northern Naija. Na dem arenj di administrative an lega sistem wen dem dey yuz shiefs du indiret rulaship. Naija komot for Britain hand inside 1960 an bigin waka sepirate waka. Dem kom fight broda-broda war fom 1967 go rish 1970. Wen war finish dem kom dey chenj  fom sivilian president with elektion to militiri govament wey dey yuz pawa dey rul.Las las for 1999, dem kom chuz president by democrasi.Di elekshion wey Naija pipul du for 2011 bi di fest taim wey evribodi gree se di elektion no get kalo kalo or wuru wuru.

Pipul dey like kol Naija di "Giant of Africa", bikos  e get plenti pipul an big ekonomi.  As 186 million human-bein dey inside, Naija Kari pipul pas for Afrika an na nomba 7 e dey for the wold. And na Naija bi di nomba 3 for kontri wey get yong yong boiz and gel pass; e get more dan 90 million pipul wey neva rish 18 years. Di kontri na moultinashional stet as e get 250 ethnic grops. The 3 grop wey plenti pas na Awusa, Ibo and Yoroba; all dis ethnic grop get pass 250 langwej an evri ethnic grop get difrent parole and tradishions. Federal govament dey yuz English langwej, an Ibo, Yoroba and Awusa na for inside regions dem. Like half of Naija pipul na Kristian an meni if dem dey stey south of di kontri an di oda half na Muslims for north of di kontri. Naija stil get smol pipul wey dey go lokal shrine ples like di Babalawo shrine or Dibia.

text:
National Arts Theatre, Igamu, lagos. Di Nashional Tiata, Naijá na di major ples for pipul wey wan sing, dans an akt fim for stage. Di Tiata dey for Iganmu, Surulere, Legos. Na for 1976 deyb komplet am so dat dey
go yup am for di Festival of Arts and Culture (FESTAC) wey happun for 1977.Anoda nem for Nashional Tiata na  Nigeria  Home of Entertainment. Di pipul wey dey arenj tins dia wan protet, kip an promot Naijá art an Kulture. As na partially commercial and Federal Government  project, Dem dey do many things to dey creative and competitive fo di market.

How them Design am
Construction of The National Theatre start during the military regime of General Yakubu Gowon and complete during the military regime of Olusegun Obasanjo.  For the year  2021, different people done manage this Edifice, some of then na,  Jimmy Folorunso Atte (1991 – August 1999), Prof Babafemi A. Osofisan (2000 – 2004), Dr. Ahmed Parker Yerima (2006 – Aug 2009), Kabir Yusuf (2009 – 2016), George Ufot, (Late) Dr. (Mrs.) Stella Oyedepo, Professor Sunday Enessi Ododo, fsonta, FNAL.
The way them design the outside of the structure look like a military hat. The original  capacity na 5,000-seater Main Hall with  stage wey them fit collapse, and two capacity cinema hall, all this hall dey equip with the thing wey fit make translation of 8 language at thesame time possible, among others.
Na Bulgarian construction company (Techno Exporstroy) build the National Arts.

Disagreement wey happen
For  2005, President Olusegun Obasanjo announce sey them wan privatize the National Theatre. This on cause diagreement amongst Nigerian entertainers and playwrights like Wole Soyinka On 30 December 2014,  report come sey  them done sell  National Theatre to one  Dubai-based conglomerate for the sum of $40million, and them go  convert the building to duty-free shopping mall.

Appearance for media
•	Filming for the "Keys to the Kingdom" video for  Beyonce's visual album Black is King  happen for National Arts Theatre, Lagos.
•	Burna Boy perform a medley of his hits "Level Up", "Onyeka" and "Ye" for  front of and inside the building, during the Premiere ceremony of the 63rd Grammy Awards, for  March 2, 2021. Later that week, him album Twice as Tall  win the Grammy Award for Best Global Music Album.
. Alhaji Sule Katagum  na co-owner  and  chairman. It resemble the Palace of Culture and Sports for Varna, Bulgaria (complete for 1968); the National Theatre Lagos, Nigeria na im big pass.

Dem build di stadiom for 1972 and di stadiom get kapaciti wey bi 55,000 leta di kapaciti dem com reduce to 45,000 for 1999. Di rekord attendance  na 85,000 an na for di final match of Afrika kup of Nashions for 1980 bitwin Naijá an Algeria dem get di record.
For no rison  di Nashional Stadiom don dey spoil bikos nobodi dey tekia of am again sice 2000s.Di last  game wey dey du Insaid di stadiom na Nashional team games  for 2004. Eni futbal match for Legos nowadaz dey happun for Teslim Balogun wit futbal matches wey dem move go nearby Teslim Balogun Stadiom. Na Religion tins an Aria Boys dey yuz di Stadiom now.People wey dey kontrol Sport ( National Sports Commission)  gada to arenj di ples sice 2009.

Dem also know am for im song wey bi "Know Me Wen Am Poor" abaut soshal rileshonship. For 26 March 2023, Isaiah Ogedegbe bin rait say akording to "both Akbishop Arikoro and Nkem Owoh tok", gud soshal rileshonship bitwin rich and poor pipo bifor di taim of nid na key to beta laif.

Oba Claudius Dosa Akran, na foma Naijá Politishian an foma tradishional rula for Badagry wey dey Lagos Stet Naijá.Na Akran dey go tok for Badagry pipul for Gofment paliment in 1951. Di nem of e taitu as king na Alolu Jiwa II of Jegba.Akran na memba of Action Congress bifor Naijá get indipendence an e na Minista for Lokal Gofment an Economik Plannin fom 1962 to 1996.   
Dem bon Akran for 1899 into di Kopon famili, an di Kopon famili dey wok as di head of Jegba quaters for Badagry. Di katolik priest dat time  by force mek Akran go skul.Im papa kom send am go St Gregory's College for Obalende an e Kom finish im sekondri skul for  King's College. For plenti years, e wok for di Ples wey pipul dey yuz  send message an leta go meet anoda pesin for far ples. Im stat di wok for 1926, e kom komot for 1947. As im papa die for 1946, dem chuz am to bi di lida for  Jegba quarters for 1948 an dem mek am Oba Akran of Badagry for 1950. Im fest join di pipul wey dey di Badagry Town kounsu and Egun-Awori Native Authority, e later bi di oga pata-pata for dis grop.
Akran du evritin so dat dey go opun Badagry Grammar School for 1955 wey be di fest sekondri skul for Badagry an oda beta-beta tins like fine-fine ples for Badagry like wetin pipul fit kom yuz dey send message an leta go meet anoda pesin for far place, e stil mek  sure sey dem kárí light kom Badagry an stil du beta-beta road.
title: Oba C. D. Akran

Obafemi Lasode (bon 4 December 1955) na
one Naija ogbonge musician, fim direktor, producer, songwriter, music producer,and playwright. Na im bi di chief executive di aword winning movie wey i nem bi sango for 1997.

How i take stat life
Obafemi Bandele Lasode wey dem bon 4 December,1955 for Port Harcourt, di kapita of Rivers State, Naija. Shi kom from Abeokuta,Ogun-state southwestern Naija. I go St.Gregory's College at Obalende in Lagos State,where im obtain di West African Senior School Certificate. Im later obtain a Bachelor
of Science degree in Business administration from Kogod School of Business, Washington, D.C. Im obtain im Master of Science degree in Communication art from Brooklyn College, City University of New York.

Karia
Im join di service of Inner City Broadcasting Corporation, New York City, in 1983 as a  Promotion Coordinator, where im host Sonny Okosuns in 1984 at di world-famous Apollo Theater in Harlem. Im produce di African music programme Afrika in Vogue for Radio Naija, wey dem dù from di fest quarter of 1989 to 1999. In 1995 I'm stat Afrika 'n Vogue/Even-Ezra Studios.For 1997, im produce and direkt one aword winning Afrikan epic wey i nem bi Sango, fim Wey dem select to open di Minneapolis - Saint Paul International fim festival for 2002. Im writ one book wey i nem bi Television
Broadcasting: The Nigerian Experience (1959–1992). Dem still dey use di book for Naija universities.

Di Okpalauku for Obiaruku na im bi di  pesin wey old pass for the hole town. Obiaruku get meni communiti an smol smol communiti wey dem dey kol quarters and dey bi Okuzu, Umusume, Ogbeaka, Ogwezi and meni like dat. Every communiti quarters get Okpalauku wey bi di oldest male as di tradishional head of di communiti

Di Okpalauku get e own kabinet and na di chief (inotu) form di kabinet.Som of di Shief-dem na Onotu-uku (tradishional prime minista) Ugo (speaka) Onueze like dat. Dem get general assembly for tradishional rulas wit di oldest Okpala-uku as di Okpala-uku generally.

Obudu Mountain Resort (wey i bifor bifor men na Obudu Cattle Ranch) na one ogbonge relaxashion ples for Obudu Plateau inside Cross River Stet, Naijá.

Tori of di ples
Na M. McCaughley, one Oyibo man fom Scotland bi di fest man to waka round di montain in 1949 an e join hand wit Mr. Hugh Jones an Dr. Crawfield to stat Obudu Cattle Ranch for 1951.

Na Sins 2005 wey dem don put kebu waya wey dey klimb 870 metres (2,850 ft) fom di  bottom go rish di top of di plateau an dis one dey  giv visitors koret  view for di ples.

Di Lokashion Of Di Ples

Di ples dey on top Obudu Plateau, wey dey near Cameroon border for northeast pat of kross Riva Stet wey be around 110 kilometer (68 mi) east of the town of Ogoja an 65 kilometers (40 mi) fom di town of Obudu inside Obanliku Lokal Govment Aria of kross Riva Stet. Di Ples dey about 30 minutes drive fom Obudu town kom dey about 332 kilometers (206 mi) drive fom kalabar, wey bi di kapital of kross Riva Stet
Transport

Dem get Charter air service wey dey reach Bebi Airport wey dey bitwin Di vilej of Obudu an di resort bot di airstrip no kom wok again an Di kable kar self don spoil for som time now.

Weda of di ples
Di weda for di Ranch bi semi-temperate mountain weda, wey bi di jeneral welda condishon on top Obudu Plateau bikos di ples dey about 1,600 metres (5,200 ft) elivashon.

Ples Wey Pipul Like To Go Enjoi
For somtime now, bikos sey di Govment of kross-Riva Stet don divelop facilities for di ranch wey don mek di ranch dey popula as tourist an relasashon ples for Naijá, plenti plenti Naija pipul an internashional tourist don dey waka enta di ranch go enjoi demself as di klimate for di ples dey kul pass odas region for Naija.
title: Obudu Mountain Resort

Oghara na town wey dey for Ethiope West Lokal Guvment Aria of Delta Stet in Naijá. Di town na house for Urhobo ethnic grup of Delta Stet. Pipul no di town for deir rich meniral resources. Oghara pipul wok na farm wok an to  dey tek kia of Anima.Dey sabi mek robba, kasava, palm trie, plantain, banana, yam an fish making. Pipul stil no di town for produkshion of crude oil.Anoda nem for Ogbara na Oghara.
Di town get  bondiries to di East with Mosogar Kindom wey dey riva Ethiope go rich south for sapele lokal Gofment Aria wey adjoin tributary for Ethiope riva to di North for Edo stet near di Osiomo/ologbo rivas and to di South West for koko for warri North lokal Gofment Aria of Delta stet. Populashion for Oghara go rich abaut 400000.
Pipul wey get Oghara town na two famili-dem wey deir nem na Ogharefe and Oghareki.  Ogharefe tribe get oda smol smol famili or quarters like Edjemwoyavwen, Adagboyerin, Ijomi, Otefe, an Ovade.Oghareki tribe get di smol smol famili wey mek up di town Udurhie an Uduaka pat. Oghara pipul dey share hu go bi di rula bitwin Ogharefe-dem an Oghareki-dem.  Di Iyasere wey bi di tok tok pésin for di king and sekond pésin wey get pawa pass tok sey abeg make una know sey dis posishion dey muve bitwin di two famili an di tok tok pesin no dey kom from di tribe wey dey produse di next king for Oghara kindom.  Ogharefe an Oghareki pipul-dem dey do chieftaincy system and dem get independent traditional councils and community halls(Oguedion) wey be say Unugbrogodo dat is traditional prime minister na im be di head of di komuniti. Di  king of di kindom na Noble Eshemitan wey get titles like Orefe 111 an di kurrent Unugbrodo of Ogharefe clan na im be di high chief Stephen Egbivwie of di Ogbojere lineaga from Adegboyerin.  Oghara get plenti makets wey som of Dem na Ogharefe maket, Oghareki maket, Oghara junction maket, Ugbenu maket and di cattle maket with oders.

Tins wey dey Oghara
Oghara dey ples whey Gofment porperti dey like  di Nigerian Naval Logistics Headquarters for South, Mopol 51 Base for Nigerian Police Force and Local Government Council headquarters. Di town na hause for different pan ocean flow station and Gas plant like Pamol, precos and Jk.

Festivals
Di pipul for Ogharefe get smol smol clan for Oghara kingdom dem dey du di Iyerin festival evri year for dem to rememba di kustoms and tradishion for Ogharefe pipul for Oghara kingdom.

Dem born De Coque for Ezinifite wey dey inside Anambra Stet for Naijá for 1947. Im papa an mama na Igbo pipul. Im stat to dey play muzik wen e dey 11 years an na one pesin wey kom from Congo wey dey play guitar tich am. De Coque bin dey wok wit 
Sunny Agaga wey dey play juju muzik an Jacob Oluwale wen im be boy. Dem begin sabi am everiwia for di wold afta im do sho for London for 1973 an im wok for guitar dey part of Prince Nico Mbarga album wey e kol Sweet Mother for 1977. E komot im first albom, Messiah Messiah for 1977. All di albom wey De Coque rekod na· 93. Plenti of im songs wey im rekod na ogene style, as e blend modan and tradisiona Igbo saund togeda. Som of im singu songs na "People's Club of Nigeria", "Nempi Social Club", "Biri Ka Mbiri", "One Enwe", "Nnukwu Mmanwu" and "Identity". Di Identity uz 2 weeks for Radio Nigeria top ten for 1981.
Apat from im wok, De Coque dey alweyz play wit Igede International Band, wey im broda Eugene be dia oga.

Im Pasona Life And How E Tek Die
De Coque get Four boyz wey be: Solar De
Coque, Safin De Coque (Darlington Akanite), Edu De Coque (Chinedu Akanite), and Ikenna Akanite.Dem giv De Coque Degree for muzik for University of New Orleans.. De Coque die for June 20 2008 afta e bin get di sicknes wey Dem dey kol cardiac arrest.. Im pikin tok sey De Coque don ready sey im want paform for 2008 bot e don Plan sey e go go for medika advise for di month afta im don die.

text:
Oliver O. Mbamara na one ogbonge fimmeka, aktor, writa, lawyer and publisher from Naija, West Africa.

Law karia
Afta graduating in Law from di University of Lagos Naija and di Naija Law Skool, im work for Naija as a lawyer, Scriptwriter, Poetic pieces wey im perform as i dey travel around  
Naija with a theater troupe wey dem dey call
Prime Circle. Im later travel go United States where im pass New York bar exam and i con bikom attorney. Na im bi di current administrative law judge with di State of New York.

Work wey i write
Apart from i professional training as a lawyer, Mbamara na published writa, poet, publisher, editor, aktor, fimmeka, direktor and more. Im kontinue to dey du all dis work togeda. Mbamara na international freelance writa and columnist with meni national, international and regional newsmagazines,news journals, newspapers, and online magazines. Pipu wey like am plenty around di world and cuts across tribe, race, gender, and profession. Mbamara's articles, poems, and editorials editorially are regularly featured in newspapers, magazines, and websites around di world. Im don write at least six books "Why Are We Here? 2004, Flame of Love, The Unrestricted,2004, Flame of Love, The Spark of God, 2002, Love Poems and Quotes,
2003, Poems of Life, 2nd Edition, 2002, and Poems of Life, 2001.

Theater and fim
In 2001, a few years afta arriving in di United States, Mbamara launch i fest book Poems of Life and pla di lead-aktor rol in an 
off-Broadway dance drama, Prof. Chudis' Prisoner of the Kalakiri. In 2003, Mbamara direkt and pla di lead rol for one stage recreation of Zulu Sofola's Wedlock of the Gods, in New York.Mbamara feature for two fims: This America and Slave Warrior. Na im bi di writa, Assistant Direktor and Co-Producer of This America. Na im bi di writa and direktor of di feature fim Slave Warrior, an African historical action thriller. Im dey currently work on releasing a book version of di story as a novel or historical literature piece.

New fims
Oliver Mbamara don release some fims and im don produce meni more. Some fim wey i write and direkt bi: 
Slave Warrior
This America
The Return of the Spade
Spade: The Last Assignment (2008)
'' On the Run Again (2010 sequel to This America)

Telivishon produkshon
Mbamara Don enta telivishon produkshon and im don finish one new TV siris wey i nem 
bi Cultures, wey im create, write, and direkt.
Culture aims at tolerance among different cultures using humor. For di fim di kinsmen send one African chief from Africa to meni meni year for America with out coming home im reach America con find out sey Ozobio don engage one American woman, di chief's persistence lead to a conflict of cultures with di American woman and ultimately to Ozobio's dilemma

text:
Olumo Rock na montain wey dey inside di south western pat  of Naijá in di Citi of Abeokuta wey dey Ogun stet.Di vilej pipu dey hid inside Olumo Rock wen fight-fight hapun bitween oda tribe-dem for potenshion in di 19th Senturi. To sho how  important dis rock be, di Yoruba pipu from Abeokuta see dis OLUMO as their Orisha(god).
"Olu" mean god wey "Mo" kom mean mold ( mek pesin dey mold somtin).

Where E Dey
Abeokuta bi di lokashion an from legos to Abeokuta na just one hour pesin go use forbroad and naso Legos sef be like home to di airport wey near Abeokuta wey bi di Murtala Muhammed International Airport. Hotels dem wey dey around di rock bi Gateway hotel plus Olumo Guest House.

For earli 2006, som kain repair wok wey sho for dat aria kom bring life enta  di site. Tins like  new musihum, ples wey pipul fit chop, waterfalls plus even sef di old Itoku maket wey market pipu plus pipu wey dey do handwork kom mek koret bizines for there. Tins kon stat begin swit weluwelu as kustomars and sella go just dey drag to mek sure sey  dem get di best  prise to sel an buy so dat nobodi go luze.

Even sef dis veri maket dey outside di Olumo Rock kompound. Dis sem veri spot gongon bi where di Abeokuta indostri of tie-an-dye wey plenti pipu sabi as Adire tek stat. Dis Adire maket wey bi say na wuman dem plenti  ( bot old & young) inside di bizines, dem dey du different different design , sho-kase am for their shop wey dey along di road so dat kustomars go see-am buy.

For di bak of di shop wey these wuman dem dey do their bizines bi house where dem do stay , wey stil serve as  their factory where dem dey die their matirihas, naso their papa & mama wey bon dem sef tek run tins bifor dem kaput.

Pipu wey dey stey klose to  dis Olumo Rock sabi Welkom visitors veri wel anitime dem sho,  ansa their kweshons welwel  even sey no bi their work to do so but their own Tori dey swit pass di pesin wey sopoz tek dem waka.
Oda popula tins  wey pesin fit see buy for there bi lokal beads wey belelekie, bracelets, sculptures plus musical instruments like di sekere an toking drum.

Trip Inside Olumo Rock
As you dey enta  inside di rock, e get dis man-made stairkase wey dem kut wey go hep you waka inside  an as you dey klimb naso your leg go just dey jam smol smol rock webi different different size of stones na you go dey match as steps (somtaims sef ladda fit dey to hep you waka inside di rock) through one small tight korrido wey go mek you Waka  go di top of di rock. As you even dey klimp go up, your eyes go dey see different different tins wey dem carve put for di bodi of di rock like kowries statue plus di olden daizs hause of the priestesses for di montain wey bi stey for hut dat taim.

Tourism
Dis very montain na one  popular ples for inside  obodo Naijá an even visitos all ova  the world dey kom visit dis wondaful rock. And na for di centa of Abeokuta wey mean  "Under the rock" you fit find am. E get hight of 137 mitas wey far from sea level. An e go shok you to know say  na di egbas bi the fest set of pipul to dey stey around the rockside bikos dem see there as ples wey  dey veri safe plus say from dat side, dem fit to monitor their enimes. But as d town of Abeokuta kom dey grow, na so new settlers begin waka comot from the location.
title: Olumo Rock

text:
Oluremi Tinubu (Dem bon ha fo September 21 1960). Shi kom from Ogun State, Nigeria. shi don bi fes ledi of Lagos State an shi bi di kurent  senator wey dey represent Lagos Central Senatorial District fo National Assembly.
Shi bi member of  All Progressives Congress (APC) political party.

Hau shi stat laif
Pastor Oluremi Tinubu na di  youngest of 12 pikin for di family, na fo Ogun State shi grow.

Skool-dem wey shi go
Pastor Oluremi Tinubu go Lady of Apostles Sekondary Skool Ijebu-Ode
where shi get West African Senior Secondary School Certificate (WASSC) fo 1979.
Tinubu get e B.S. in Education from the University of Ife, an National Certificate of Education fo Botany and Zoology from Adeyemi College of Education.

Wok fo politik
Pastor Tinubu bikom di fes lady of Lagos State wen her husband, Bola Tinubu, bikom govnor. As fes lady, shi stat di New Era Foundation, di fokus of di foundeshun na to bring "all round development of young ones and promote public awareness on environmental health and community service."
Wen dem elekt Tinubu, dem been  challenge am fo di Legislative House Election Petition Tribunal -  but di result of di tribunal fo 2012 bi sey Tinubu win.
Tinubu dey among over 100 senator-dem wey dem elect fo di 8th assembly fo 2015. Six of of dem na  women. Aside from Tinubu, di other woman-dem na Stella Oduah, Uche Ekwunife, Fatimat Raji Rasaki, Rose Okoji Oko and Binta Garba.
Fo di 2019 general election, shi win her senatorial seat again, fo di ted taim.
Fo 2016, Senator Tinubu tok sey e nid beta  security from di Inspector General of Police.
Dis na bikos of di gbege wey shi get from ha colleague and fellow party member Dino Melaye wen dem do wan senate close-door miting.
Shi dey among pipu laik Babajide Sanwo-Olu, Tony Elumelu and other  Ogbonge  pipu wey dem pik fo di Eko Excellence Awards fo 2019.
2020, Tinubu tok sey mek state police dey as e go hep reduce di insekurity wey dey di kontry.
Fo March 2021, Senator Tinubu tok sey mek dem mek  bill to chenj Nigerian Postal Service (NIPOST) to mek e dey more useful. Di Guardian organized International Women's Day Summit 2021 give Tinubu di  award as woman senator wey de  mek thing happen wel-wel.

Plenti-Plenti Award and honor
Pastor Oluremi Tinubu win plenti award and Dem give plenti honor,
di plenti-plenti award and honor wey Dem give ha na: National award of the Officer of the Order of the Niger [OON], Member, Board of Trustees of Kings’ University, Ode-Omu; Ghana Noble International Award for Leadership (2004), Gambian Diamond Award fo di ogbonge  suppot to free  Pipu from Poverty.

Pesona laif
Pastor Oluremi Tinubu na waif  to former Governor and Senator of Lagos State, Bola Tinubu. Senator Oluremi Tinubu na Christian.
Tinubu na ordain pastor of the Redeemed Christian Church of God.
Na 2018 dem ordain am fo di Old Arena of RCCG, Lagos/Ibadan Expressway where dichurch do 66th annual convention wey title na “Dominion”. Shi still bi Grand Matron of di Committee of Wives of Lagos Sate Officials (COWLSO)

Stanley Omah Didia  (dem bon am for 19 May 1997), wey pipul sabi wel wel as Omah Lay, na Naija singa, song raita an Produsa. Pipul sabi am wel fo im song "Bad Influence" wey e du for year 2020. Meni pipul sabi am for di song wey Masterkraft du wit am an Alpha P, di song na remix for Justin Bieber 2021 "Peaches", anoda song wey som pipul sabi am wit na "Attention" wey dem rilis 2022. Na Omah Lay win di Next rated awod fo 2020 Headies Awods.

Hau e tek stat life
Dem bon Stanley Omah Didia on 19 May 1997 for inside Port Harcourt. Na fom Ikwerre Lokal Govment inside Rivers State. E go Comprehensive High Skul insaid Rivers State, E kon leta go University of Port Harcourt. E kom fom famili wey lik musik, im granpapa dey pley musik instruments fo singa Celestine Chukwu bifor e die fo 1977. Na Lay's Papa dey pley di drums.

Hau e tek du im wok
Lay stat im karier wit rap group, im nem na "Lil King" for di grup. E com leta dey writ song an dey produs musik. E rilis "Do not Disturb" in April 2019. E rilis "Hello Brother" afta one month wey e don rilis di first song.

E du kontrat wit KeyQaad rekod Label inside June 2019, bifor e kom rest for seven month. Wen e dey res, e dey wok on im EP, Get Layd. E tel OkayAfrika sey, Na sins August[of 2019] e don dey wok. E tok sey e no dey too uze im fone, no dey du wetin e dey du bifor so dat im go fes di projects wey e dey du wel. E tok sey di first song wey e rekod for di Layd project na 'Bad Influence'. Afta di rest, e rilis 'Bad Influence', wey dey inside song wey pipul see pas for Naijà Apple Music for inside 2020. 

For February 2020, Lay rilis "You", wey bi im first single. E rilis im five trak EP, Get Layd on 22 May 2020. Di EP dey Nomba 1 for Naijà Apple Music Charts. Na all di five songs for di EP dey for top 15 fo Apple Music Chart for Naijà an na You dey fo nomba one.

For October, Lay dey for Olamide's album Carpe Diem, for di trak "Infinity", wey dey for top on Apple Music Chart fo Naijà.

On 20 November, Lay rilis im sekond five trak EP, What Have We Done. All di five trak EP riich di top 12 fo di Apple Musik Chart for Naijà, wit "Godly" wey dey nomba one.

For 3 July 2020, na Lay bi di first singa wey Apple kol to dey hep dem disease niu singa for Afrika. Inside December 2020, e dey fo BBC Radio 1Xtra's Hot 2021, na im bi di first Afrika singa for Audiomack's #Up Now wey dem du for niu singas. E dey fo Montreux Jazz festival's wey dey fo 20 singa pipul dey lik ci for 2021. Dem im win di BET's Amplified singa for di month of November 2020. Na Dvpper Music wey dey Naijà im sign for now, an kon stil sign fo Sire rekod fo im wok wey dey go outsaid Naijà. Im nem dey amog Singa wey fit win four Awods fo 2020 Headies, na im win di Next Rated Awod.

For June 25 2021, Lay dey folo sing for Naijà produsa Masterkraft song, "Peaches" remix of Justin Bieber. Na 8 July 2021, Lay rilis niu song, "Understand". On 3 March 2022, e rilis song wey e du wit Justin Bieber, "Attention", wey mek am bi di sekond song wey dem du togeda.

Diferen view
On 14 December 2020, dem aress Lay an Tems fo Uganda. Di Uganda polis tok sey dey no folo Covid-19 law fo dia kontri. Di singa no gree wit dem bicos dey tok sey na pesin arenj dia aress.  Afta two days Uganda polis rilis dem, kon stil beg dem.

Politis view
Lay tok sey e dey sopot di #EndSARS campaign fo Naijà. E tel Harper's Bazaar, pipul sopos no sey di EndSARS na abaut Naijà pipul, no bi fo politis. Polis dey kill, beat pipul an dey du as dem lik. E stil tel dem sey mek Govment du somtin fo di mata.

text:
Onitsha na one town wey dey for di Easta aria of Riva Niger wey dey inside Anambra Stet for Naija. Pipu wey dey live an du bizness for Onitsha plenti wel-wel an difren difren maket wey dem de make difren tins full Onitsha. Na inside Onitsha di main maket wey dem dey kol "Onitsha Main Maket" dey.

How Onitsha tek stat
Bifor bifor, dem no "Onitsha mmili" as "Onitsha Ado na Idu".Dis Igbo town don de dia for meni years bifor dem pak fom Riva Niger kom go live for inside Onitsha kommuniti. Wen dem rish di East-bank, dem kom stat to kom togeda an smol smol dem kom fom one kindom. Dem chenj fom pipul wey jost bi roya vilej to pipul wey odas pupil wey no bi loya vilej stil kom fit stey.

How Onitsha tek popula
Smol smol, Onitsha kom bi impotat tradin park for "Royal Niger Company " for mid-1980s. Afta dey stop to dey sel pipul as slave bikos of stim enjin wey dey transport pipul from Europe move into di hinterland.To sel an bai pam-kanel an pam-oil an odas plant kom inkris for di koast wey dey  kol "Bight of Biafra" halong di Riva side for 19th century. For di year 1857, British pam-oil trada fom dia stashion for di siti an di Kristen missionari join dem for di bizness. Di pipul wey dey lid di kristen missionari na Bishop Samuel Ajayi Crowder an Reverend John Taylor. For year wey bi 1900, Onitsha kom bi pat of di aria wey British Govament dey protet. British government an Kristen missionari enta Igbo-land kom bi administrative for skul an choch araund Riva port inside Onitsha. For year wey bi 1965, dem build di Niger-Riva Bridge to riples di yuz of boat to kross di wota.Dis one kom mek bayii an Selina wit Westa Naija wasi an koneshion wit Binin siti an Legos kom dey posibu.Di Naija sivu war skata meni tins for Onitsha bikos na fom Onitsha Westa dorar tek enta Biafra.Di oil bizness wet hapun in di 1970 an earli 1980s mek meni pipul mov to Onitsha.As pipul dey plenti for Onitsha, dey kom stat to build enihow house for di town an dis one kom mek di livin kondishion for Onitsha bad wel wel.

Onitsha Pipul an díá Kolshor
Onitsha bin get nine vilej wey Dem no as "Ebo-Itenani".Dis pipul kom fom  Umuezechima wey get Isiokwe, Olosi, Umuezearoli, Okebunabo, Obikporo an Ogbeotu wey sey dia orijin na fom Igala for inside Kogi Stet, Awada (Ogbeozoma), Obamkpa wey stil get Umuasele, Iyiawu and Odoge-Ndugbe, an Odumegwu-Gbuagu, Ubulu na Ikem, Ulutu, Ubene, Ogboli-Eke, Obior and Ogbeotu. For di grup, dem get six Administrative wards wey dem dey kol: Okebunabo, Umuezearoli, Ogbeolu, Isiokwe na Ogboli Olosi, Obamkpa, and Eke na Ubeme.
Onitsha dey operate tradishonal sistem of govamet wey dia lida na Obi. Di Obi get pipul wey dey assist am wey dia taitu bi Ndi-Ichie, Red cap eldas or shifs. Amov di Ndi-Ichie, we get di Ndi-Ichie Ume wey bi di fest klass shifs. Dem put  Ndi-Ichie into six katigori, dem bi: Onowu Iyasele, Ajie Ukadiugwu, Odu Osodi, Onya Ozoma, Ogene Onira and Owelle Osowa. Onowu Iyasele na im bi di tradishional Prime Minista.
Dem stil get sekod klass Ndi-Ichie wey bi Ndi-Ichie Okwa an third klass Ndi-Ichie wey bi Ndi-Ichie Okwareze. Di Ndi-Ichie dey saf as kansu of advaisa   to di Obi.Enitime wey di Obi wan mek eni disison wey go konsain di kindom, e go kol di Ndi-Ichie for advais. 
Wen Obi kpai, na di Onowu-Iyasele go tek control onti dey chuz anoda Obi.
Once every year for di month of October, di kingdom of Onitsha de hold one festival wey dem dey call Ofala Festival. Dis festival dey happen di same time wey many part of Igbo-land dey celebrate dia New yam festival. Dis na one way wey di pipu of Onitsha de take keep dia culture alive and e don become big festival as pipu from different-different part of di world de come see am.

Geography
Onitsha dey for di East-west crossing point of di Niger River and e still de cover di north part wey big-big ship de pass. For di past, na dis things make Onitsha a major centre for buying and selling between di coastal regions and di north and between di eastern and Western Nigeria. Onitsha get one of di few roads wey mile-wide Niger-River. Plan still dey on ground to create a second bridge near am.
Di fast growth for di number of pipu wey de move to Onitsha don get bad effect on di natural vegetation and di general view of di land-scape.

How di place take turn to city
For early 1960s, before the Nigerian Civil war( check Biafra war) the total number of pipu wey dey for Onitsha na 76,000 according to census record. Onitsha town dey different in many ways,the great Chinua Achebe ( wey Dem born and raised for the town of Ogede) describe Onitsha as town wey get "esoteric region from which creativity sallies forth at will to manifest itself" "a zone of occult instability"(check Onitsha matters). Onitsha don really play important role for the creative change of urban life for eastern Nigeria wey de known as the setting for Onitsha market literature and one of the financing centre and distributor of Nollywood films for Nigeria. As the number of pipu de increase, building and housing problem come dey. Pipu come de build any how without proper zoning and arrangements this one come make catacata and over crowding for house with lawlessness come plenty. According to the World Health Organization Global urban Ambient Air pollution record update of 2016, Onitsha na im get pollution pass for Africa.
For recent times, as Onitsha start to expand enter other community arround am,them don start to get land ownership dispute with pipu of Obosi and Nkweche Ezunka. Fegge, Woliwo, Odoakpu, Awada, and 3-3 na the Metropolitan areas Onitsha dey drag with the communities of Obosi and Nkwelle Ezunanka.

How biznes be for dia
For 2012, the state government form a joint Venture wey bring SAB Miller Brewery come invest for Onitsha Brewery wey start for August 2012. Na the first big investment for inside Onitsha since when them establish Premier Brewery wey be the maker of Premier beer for the early part of1980. For January they announce sey if them upgrade the brewery with $110million, production of beer and malt drinks go triple.

Religion and Politics
Na Christianity almost everybody for Onitsha dey practice. Some persons from northern and western Nigeria dey practice Islam. For February 2006,armed militant kill up 24 ethnic Hausa Fulani(Muslim) and burn some Muslim sites and two mosques building. Wetin cause this one na the riot wey happen for Maiduguri wey be Muslim city. For that riot them kill at least 18 Christian and na the cartoon controversy for Denmark na im cause the riot for Maiduguri.
title: Onitsha

Oshodi Transport Interchange na him dem build for inside Oshodi area of Lagos State, Nigeria. Di terminal tanda gidigba between di Lagos-Apapa expressway and the Agege motor road. Dem divide the Terminal into three different terminals wey dem call: Terminal 1, Terminal 2, and Terminal 3.[1]

How dem build am 
Na di Construction firm wey dem dey call Planet Projects Limited build the Oshodi Bus Terminal for total money wey dem estimate to be around $70 million. Dem build di bus terminal make e fit accommodate about 820 mass transit buses.

Terminals and facilities wey dey inside 
Di Oshodi bus terminal na him dem been divide into  three terminals wey be: Terminal 1, Terminal 2, and Terminal 3. Each one of di bus terminals get 30000 square meters of land and get plenty better facilities like: loading bays, ticketing stands, driver lounge, parking areas, restrooms etceteram etceteram. Di Oshodi Bus Terminal begin work for   May 2019 as di contractor wey dey hadle di project  been announce.
Terminal 1 na for intercity travels and dem design am for journeys wey cover di  southwest, southeast, FCT, and Northern states. Na  Terminal two dey for intercity waka wey cover routes like. Ikeja, Agege, Iyana Ipaja, egbeda, Abule Egba etc. Terminal 3 na him cover route such as Mile 2/Festac, Airport road, Bariga/New Garage, Tincan, Orile, Apapa/Wharf, ejigbo, Ajegunle/Boundary, Ojodu/Berger, Gbagada/Anthony, Eko Ijumota, Iyana Isolo/Jakande Gate/ Itire, Ojota/Ketu/Mile 12, Adeniji, Eko Hotel.

Ha laif tori
Dem bon Olajide for Ibadan, Nigeria. Shi gro up for Lagos. Shi mov to Canada for 2001 wen shi bi 16yies. Ha mén plan na to studi law, but shi reject am. Na wen shi stat to sell ticket for wan  Canadian Opera Company, ha maind com enta akting. Shi komplit wan theatre arts course for Humber College Toronto, an di Soul Pepper Academy for Toronto. Shi stat to do small small   theater wok for Toronto, shi stil do  supporting rol for wan short fim, but shi no get any beta fim kontract. For one intaview, shi sey shi bin wan giv up akting wok. Last last shi tek advice of ha égent mek shi do vidio for casting part wé shi no sabi di fim.  na afta shi do di kastin na im shi get rol to akt bridge officer Joann Owosekun for Star Trek: Discovery. Paul Igwe  (dey bon 27 November 1977) na Naija awod-winni televishon daretor, raita, produsa and kreator. Paul bi di oga patapata of Whitestone Cinema Limited. Na e produs popula TV show like "Clinic Matters","The Benjamins", "Ojays" and "Asunder".

Hoe e tek wok
In 2000, Paul Igwe stat e prodonshon kompini, "Whitestone Cinema Limited". Paul don daret ova 20 fims-dem an ova 8 TV shows ."Outrageous" bi e fest fim wey e wan daret an na for 2000 e do am. Na im bi di main pesin for di 39 episodes TV drama siris "Extended Family", working as direktor/consulting produsa. Im stat i own televishon produsa. Im stat i own televishon 
sitcom"Clinic Matters" for 2009 siris wey win meni aword and nominations locally and internationally including di prestigious 2012 World Quality Commitment Award in Paris.
In February 2012, im produce i second television siris "The Benjamins" wey dem nominate at di 2014 Africa Magic Viewers Choice Awords for Best Televishon siris Comedy/Drama. In 2015, im stat one new family sitcom "Ojays" wey dem nominate for di Best Comedy aword in di Nafca Awards. Paul even stat culinary show for Igbo called "USEKWU IGBO" way mean "Igbo Kitchen". Di show win di Best Indigenous Movie/TV siris aword at di 2016 Africa Magic Viewers Choice Awards held at di Eko Hotel and Suites, Victoria Island, Lagos.In 2016, Paul stat anoda family sitcom wey i nem bi "House 6" with anoda family sitcom "Troubled Cottage". Paul Igwe also stat im analytical drama siris "Asunder" later dat year, which focus on di marital lives of differen family.In 2017, im produce anoda Igbo soap opera "Nkewa" showing on Africa Magic Igbo. Im also direkt "Dance To My Beat", a movie starring Joseph Benjamin, kehinde Bankole, Toyin Abraham, and Mary Remmy Njoku.

Shif Pete Edochie, MON (dem bon am for March 7, 1947) na Naijá aktor. Edochie na one of Afrika most talented akto, an im don get plenti plenti awod laik Industry Merit Award by Africa Magic an Lifetime Achievement by Africa Film Academy. Edochie bifor na  administrator an brodkasta but, na for 1980 wen NTA redu  Chinua Achebe buk Things Fall Apart as fim, Edochie akt as Okonkwo for di fim na im mek pipu no Pete Edochie wel wel. Edochie kom fom  Igbo traib of Naijá an na katolik e bi
For 2003, President Olusegun Obasanjo gif am nashunal honor wey bi "Member of di Order of the Niger"
==Pasonal laif==
Dem bon Pete Edochie for siti of Zaria wey dey norti of Naijá for March 7, 1947.Edochie selebret e 70 years biday   for 2017 an e tok sey e stil dey strong.Edochie stil tok sey na to dey tek laif  easi an dey plan wit purpos for evritin na im mek laif no taiya am as im dey old.

=How e tek wok
Edochie stat tok tok wok for redio wen e bi 20 years old.
Na Programme Assistant dem gif am wen e stat.Edochie kom gro to levu of  Dareto.E bi dareto of programmes, bot e dey akt as Managing Dareto.Edochie stop to wok for ABS bikos di govament stat to du politis for dia FM station mata an dis one kom mek dem poshu all di pipu wey dey manej di station wit Edochie join. Na Edochie for replas di MD bot e komot komot go join muvee indostrie. Bifo dis one, Edochie don akt foy di fim, Things Fall Apart, an win International Award. BBC flai kom Naijá to tok to Edochie abaut e rol for Things Fall Apart. Edochie don akt over 18 fim.
For September 2017, Edochie sopot Wikimedia Movement for Naijá wen e sho faze for vidio wey dem mek to hep pipu wey don old no how to yuz  Wikipedia.

8 big nem for Naijá fim
For 2005,  The Actors' Guild of Nigeria gif Pete Edochie, Genevieve Nnaji, Omotola Jalade Ekeinde, Nkem Owoh, Ramsey Noah, Stella Damasus Aboderin, an Richard Mofe Damijo  one-year ban fom aktin eni fim bikos of di plenti plenti moni we dem dey kolet fom produsa to dey I said fim. Dis ban sheik Naijá fim bizness wel wel, bot dem don komot di ban.

Dem Kidnap Edochie

For 2009, dey kidnap Edochie bot dey leta liv am wit out injuri.

Peson wey risembu Edochie

For 2019, pipu  tok sey Kingsley Abasili risembu Pete Edochie wel wel even pipu wey dey mek niuz kari am. Bikos  Kingsley  luk  laik Edochie, dem kom kol Kingsley Pete Edochie's look-alaik.

Im pat for Fatal Arrogance
For 2020, Pete Edochie akt a lid rol for di muvee wey di taitu bi "Fatal Arrogance". Dis fim kos trobul wit Islamic Movement in Nigeria (IMN) wey pipu still no as Shiites. Di pat wey Pete Edochie akt wan sho sey dia grup get leg for terrorist grup.
Di akto no gri sey na im get blem for di trobul di fim kos bot sey na di pipu we produs di fim dem sopos blem for di trobul wey di fim kos.

text:
Peter Gregory Obi (dem bon am for July 19, 1961) na Naija politishian and biznessman. Na Peter Obi bi di vas president kandidet for 2019 Naijá jeneral eleshion onda di People's Democratic Party (PDP). E wan bi di presidor for 2023 Naijá jeneral eleshon. Peter Obi bi di forma gofnor of Anambra Stet fom March 17, 2006 go rish November 2, 2006, wey dem  impish am. E kontiniu fom February 9, 2007 go rish May 9, 2007 afta dem kansu e impishment. Even sey dem du fresh eleshion for April 29, 2007, dem stil mek am gofnor afta kot tok sey e sopoz finish e four-year term. For February 6, 2010, e win di gofnor eleshion to bikom di gofnor of the stet for di sekond time.
Afta e liv offis for 2014, Obi go to Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) for 2014. For 2019, dey selet am as di  vas president for Atiku Abubakar bot dem loss to di preset presidor of Naijá Muhammadu Buhari an vas president Yemi Osinbajo. For 2022, Obi run for president imsef, fest in PDP bot leta move to Labour Party (LP) for May 2022.

How e stat life an skul wey e go 
Dem bon Peter Obi  for July 19,1961 for Onitsha. Na for Christ The King College, Onitsha, e finish  sekondri skul edukeshion. E go to University of Nigeria, Nsukka in 1980 to rid Filosofi an get  B.A (Hons) in Filosofi in 1984.

Peter Obi go Lagos Business School, Naijá, wie e du e  Chief Executive Program, Harvard Business School, Boston, USA, wie e du  two program, London School of Economics, Columbia Southwest School, New York, USA, Institute for Management Development, Switzerland, wie e get two Sertifiket in Senior Executive Program an Chief Executive Officers program. E also go Kellogg Graduate School of Management, USA, Oxford University:Said Business School an Cambridge University, George business school.

How e tek wok
Obi don wok for dis ples dem:
  Next International Nigeria Ltd.
 Chairman an daretor of Guardian Express Mortgage Bank Ltd, Guardian Express Bank Plc,
 Future View Securities Ltd
 Paymaster Nigeria Ltd
 Chams Nigeria Ltd
 Data Corp Ltd and Card Centre Ltd.
 Fidelity Bank PLC.(Peter Obi don bi di smolest chairman of di Bank for age til nau).
Forma presido Goodluck Jonathan yuz am as di Chairman of the Security and Exchange Commission (SEC)  afta di 2015 jeneral eleshion.

Tori abaut how e tek bi gofnor
 First term
Peter Obi kontest for Anambra Stet gofnor eleshion as kandidet for the All Progressives Grand Alliance (APGA) parti for 2003, bot e  oponet, Chris Ngige of di People's Democratic Party, (PDP) na e di Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) diklai as winna.
Afta almost three years wey e chalenj di eleshon risot for kot, di kot  tok sey na Peter Obi  sopoz bi gofnor no bi Chris Ngige for March 6, 2006.  For March 17, 2006 Obi bikom gofnor of Anambra Stet. For November 2,  2006,   di State House of Assembly impish 
Peter Obi afta seven months for ofis an dey put Peter Obi deputi Virginia Etiaba di folowin day as gofnor an dis mek Virginia Etiaba di fest wuman to bi gofnor for Naijá. Peter Obi  tok sey e no grie an shanlej di impishment an e win. Dem kom put peter Obi as di gofnor for  February 9, 2007 by di "Court of Appeal" wey dey Enugu. Etiaba hand ova pawa bak to Obi afta di kot ruling.

Dem komot Peter Obi fom offis again for May 29, 2007 afa jeneral general eleshion wey Andy Uba win. Obi go kot again go sey e four-year wey e sopoz bi gofnor neva finish. Even dey na 2003 e win eleshion, na for March 2006 dem put am as gofnor an e sopoz finish e four-year bifor anoda eleshion. For June 14, 2007, di "Supreme Court of Nigeria" sopot wetin Obi tok an e kontiniu to bi gofnor of Anambra Stet. Dem drop Andy Uba as gofnor  sey di April 14, 2007 eleshion no sopoz happun.

E sekond time as gofnor
For February 7, 2010, di "Independent National Electoral Commission" (INEC) tok sey Peter Obi bi winna for di 2010 Anambra Stet gofnorship eleshion wey e win Professor Charles Chukwuma Soludo wey bi forma gofnor of CBN. As Gofnor Peter Obi win, e kom get anoda four years to bi di gofnor of Anambra Stet.  For March 17 2014, Peter Obi finish e sekond term an  hand ova di gofnorship  to Willie Obiano.

2019 presidential election
For  October 12, 2018, dem pik Peter Obi as di pesin wey go bi vas to Atiku Abubakar as dem dey kampan to bi presidor of Naijá onda di parti "Peoples Democratic Party's" for di 2019 president eleshion. Na sekod PDP kom kari for di eleshion.

Awod-dem wey e don kolet
Di awod-dem wey e don kolet na:

 Golden Jubilee Award (2015)

Tins wey Pandora Paper rait abaut am
Ontop di informashion wey lik from Pandora Paper, Di Premium Times talk sey Obi get hand for som kompini for British Virgin Islands wey no dey pay tax. For 2010, Obi yuz Acces International to stat  an manej Gabriella Investments Limited, kompini wey dey British Virgin Islands wey dem nem afta Obi' gel pikin bikos dem no wan mek dem no sey  na Obi get am.One of the dareto of dis kompini na daretor for anoda Shell kompini wey dey for Belize an dis Belize kompini get 50,000 shares for Gabriella Investments. For 2017, Obi arrenj di kompini onda  niu nem PMGG Investments Limited an kirate Trust an nem am The Gabriella Settlement. Na dis Trust kom bi di mejo shareholder for PMGG Investments Limited. Anoda ripot tok sey, e bilike sey  Obi get anodaShell kompini-dem for 1990s , "Beauchamp Investments Limited" for Barbados and  "Next International (UK) Limited"for UK wey dem link to Obi an e famili.

If pesin luk Obi rekod of gettin kompinifor ovasea, jonalists kom tok sey sey Obi brek meni law bikos of di way e dey du bizness. Fest, Obi rimain as daretor of Next International (UK) Limited wen e bi gofnor of Anambra Stet an dis one na ofens for di "Code of Conduct Bureau and Tribunal Act". Sekod, as Obi no diklai  im ovasea kompini-dem, e brek  di "Nigerian Constitution Provision" wey say poblik ofisa must diklai all dia propati. Last, both di "Constitution"an di "Code of Conduct Bureau and Tribunal Act" tok sey poblik ofisa wey get bank akaunt outside Naijá don brek di law an wetin Pandora pepa tok an di wey Peter Obi dey ansa sho sey e get forin bank akaunt wen e bi gofnor.

Afta wey dis informashion don lik, pipul an grups push mek dem chek Obi an ripot-dem queri EFCC to chek Peter Obi wel wel. Few daiz afta di ripot, Peter Obi sey e no brek eni law. EFCC kol Peter Obi for som kweshon in October 2021 fom di orda wey Buhari giv sey mek dey chek evribodi wey dia nem dey di Pandora pepa link.

E Pasonal life
Obi mari Margaret Brownson Usen for 1992, an togeda dey get two pikin.Peter Obi na Katolik memba.

text:
Polo Park (corporately styled as CF Polo Park) na shopping centre for Winnipeg manitoba Canada. Di polo park dey for di former polo park Racetrack near di junction for portage Avenue and St James street. Polo park ground also include scotiabank theatre (formerly Silver city).

Na di largest Mall for di 8 malls for di city and di 15th largest Shopping centre for Canada ranking between Guildford Town centre and laurier Quebec.
For census purposes Polo park na also di name wey dem give di neighborhood including di surrounding for di shopping centre.

How polo park take start 
Di polo park Mall start for Thursday 20, August 1959 and become one of di first enclosed shopping malls for Canada wey dem add roof for 1963, di oder wey be di park Royal Shopping hubs of Winnipeg with di Winnipeg Arena, Canad Inns stadium and Winnipeg velodrome all of dem dey for polo park neighborhood. For 1990s di velodrome dem stop to use am come make way for strip mall wey include Home Deport and chapters. Fot long time di Arena and stadium dem break am down and replace am with new retail and office complexes.

Di former CKY building be di next for di mall. CKY house di city television Network affiliate, CKY-TV, CKY-Radio and FM 92 CITI before CKY be di original house for WTN network. Corus Entertainment and Cadillac Fairview. Studios for CJOB 680, CFPG-FM99.1 and CJKR-FM 97.5 dey for di second floor for di three story building.

How Polo park start to dey expand 
For spring of 1968 dem use $7.5million to take complete di expansion of polo park. Dis addition bring three storey Eaton's department store to di mall wey make polo park di second largest shopping centre for Canada for that time.

For 1986 di mall go tru renovation wey cost $75 million wey give di building second level. Di downtown Winnipeg merchant no dey  happy with di plan so dem carry di matter go city council go talk dia mind after di meeting for 1984 council still approve di expansion of di building even as dem no gree. Di expanded shopping centre open for mid- August 1986.

A new $49 million expansion to polo park open for 1 October 2014 for di former Zellers space for di mall second level. Di redeveloped space include 114000 sq ft(10600m) of retail space and e create 17 new stores.

Areas Wey Polo Park Cover 

Polo park don add new retail complexes wey di location of di properties dey adjacent to di north of di mall.

Pilo North dey for di site of di former Winnipeg Arena and e get Marshalls, marks, Atmosphere and di new head office of western financial.

Di plaza wey dey polo park for canad inns stadium ground adjacent to scotiabank Theatre na mixed use development wey spans over 600000 sq ft (5600m) wey carry di following  Winners, Homesense Urban Behavior, Winnipeg metropolitan Region inc and di first P.F chang's restaurant for  Winnipeg with parking capacity wey fit carry over 1200 vehicles, dem build di plaza originally to house Target Canada wey come later go out of businesses tru out Canada.

text:
Queen Oronsen na goddess wey bi Orisha for di bilif of Yoruba pipu dem. Im na di waif of Olowo Rerengejen. Di Igogo Festival wey dem dey du evri year for Owo na to honor Queen Oronsen.

Tori wey dey Owo rekod
For som 600 years wey don pas, king Renengejen of Owo see one fain gel wey e nem na Oronsen for di taim wey im dey one of im hontin wok.
Bikos of sey Oronsen fain well wel, King Renengejen kari am go Palas an mek am queen as one  of e waif-dem.
Afta dia marej, Orensen sho e hosband di kain pesin wey im bi: insted mek Queen Oronsen bi nomal pesin, Orensen infakt  na Orisha. Dem tok bad tin konsan di king. An as e dey
du evritin wit di queen, di king supos don dai. Oronsen tel am mek e no fiar am an sey e  dey hapi to dey wit am an e go dey hapi to rimen for dis laif as one of e waif-dem.Di onli tin na mek e no spoil di 3 law wey im get. King Rerengejen promis sey e go folo di three law an sey e go mek di two sinior waif to folo di law.Di king an im wait laik demsef wel wel ivin afta e don no di kain pesin wey e waif bi.Orensen kom bless di hosband an al di pipu for di haos wit plenti moni. One dey, wen King Rerengejen de insaid bush dey kash anima, Orensen get smol fait wit oda waifs dem, an dem brek im tri (3) law dem jost to mek am vex. As Oronsen bigin krai as e dey vex, e ron komot for palas. Di Shif an palas sikoriti dem bigin dey luk for am to fit kari am bak to palas bot all dia wahala to tek see am no wok. Wen di king kom bak fom insaid bush wia e go kash anima, dem tel am wetin hapun wen im no dey haous. Di tin pen am sotey e sef stat to fain am bai imsef. Afta 4 deys an 4 nait wey e don dey luk for am,e kom fainali see am for insaid fores.King Rerengejen beg Oronsen sey mek e folo am go bak, bot Orensen tel am sey as dem don brek im law e  no go eva liv insaid dis laif wit pipul agein. Oronsen kom tel am mek e de du one serimoni to tek dey rimemba am,so dat e go bless Owo land an e go dey protet am evritaim . Di king no dey hapi bot e gri to du am.An afta e gif law sey mek dem kriet di serimoni afta di king go bak to di palas. Dis na di risin wai di Owo pipu dey selibret  Igogo festiva sins dat dey rish todey.

text: The Niger River ( ;  ) is the main river of West Africa, extending about . Its drainage basin is  in area. Its source is in the Guinea Highlands in south-eastern Guinea near the Sierra Leone border. It runs in a crescent shape through Mali, Niger, on the border with Benin and then through Nigeria, discharging through a massive delta, known as the Niger Delta (or the Oil Rivers), into the Gulf of Guinea in the Atlantic Ocean.  The Niger is the third-longest river in Africa, exceeded by the Nile and the Congo River. Its main tributary is the Benue River.

text:
Rivers State na one of di 36 state for Naija. Di governor of di state na Nyesom Wike.

River State 
River state, also Rivers na one state for di Niger Delta region of Southern Nigeria. Na for 1967 dem form River State wen dem divide am from di eastern region, River state dey share border wit Imo and Abia States from dia north side, Akwa Ibom State from east, and Bayelsa and Delta states from di west. Port Harcourt na di state capital and na also di commercial center of  Nigeria oil industry.

With population of 5,198,716 according to di 2006 censors, River state na the 6th most populous state for Naija.

Territory 
River state na home for many ethnic groups with igbo or igboid as the people wey many pass but dem also get other ethnic groups like ogoin and Ijaw.

River State as dem call am becos of di plenty river wey dey di area bin dey part of oil Rivers protectorates from 1885 to 1893 wey e come later be part of Niger Coast Protectorate. For 1900, dem join di region with chartered territories of Royal Niger Company wey form di colony of Southern Nigeria. For 1996 River State loose one territory wey come present day Bayelsa.

Geography 
River State dey for di southern part of Nigeria, and also for di eastern part Niger Delta and e expand reach di oceanward extension of Benue Trough. Wetin oyinbo call tropical rainforest plenty inside di state and for di area. River State get 11,077km² (4,277sq mi) as e total area and day one make am di 26th largest state for Nigeria. States like Imo, Abia and Anambra surround am from di north side, Bayelsa and Delta follow from di west side why Akwa Ibom sef join from east side. Atlantic Ocean na im take the southern part.

limateEdit 
Ogoni Climate activists and others in Port Harcourt protesting environmental degradation in 2015.

Rainfall is generally seasonal, variable, as well as heavy, and occurs between the months of March and October through November. The wet season peaks in July, lasting more than 290 days. The only dry months are January and February having little to no effect.

The inland part of the state consists of tropical rainforest, and towards the coast, the typical Niger Delta environment features many mangrove swamps. Rivers State has a total area of 11,077 km2 (4,277 sq mi), making it the 26th largest state in Nigeria. Surrounding states are Imo, Abia and Anambra to the north, Akwa Ibom to the east and Bayelsa, Delta to the west. On the south, it is bounded by the Atlantic Ocean. Its topography]ranges from flat plains, with a network of rivers to tributaries.
title: Rivers State

Dis tin happun wen Yoruba pipu dey fight,for d owu war for (1822 - 1829) wey dem scatter im village (oshogun) Dem lata sell Ajayi Crowther to pipu we dey buy and sell slave for Portuguese,[3] wey dem put am on top boat for water wey dem call Atlantic,to go New world.
Dem later free Ajayi from slavery for coastal port for d Royal Navy's west Africa squadron,wey dey Force d British ban against the Atlantic slave trade. D people wey dem free,go Sierra Leone,go stay. For Sierra Leone Ajayi begin dey call him name Samuel Crowther,he con start skool with English. he turn Christian and Sierra Leone country persin. He con turn big persin for Krio Ethnic Group. He con sabi read different languages,so dem pick am as minister for England, where he later collect doctorate degree from Oxford university. He prepare Yoruba grammar, con change d Anglican buk of prayer wey everibodi know to Yoruba,he don dey turn the English Bible to Yoruba and Even many languages.Crowther mari his skool student, Asano (i.e. Hassana; wey be Muslim bifor bifor), baptised Susan. text:
Science im a systematic enterprise wey builds and organizes knowledge in the form of testable explanations and predictions about the universe.

The earliest roots of science fit be traced to Ancient Egypt and Mesopotamia in around 3500 to 3000 BCE. Their contributions to mathematics, astronomy, and medicine entered and shaped Greek natural philosophy of classical antiquity, whereby formal attempts were made to provide explanations of events in the physical world based on natural causes. After the fall of the Western Roman Empire, knowledge of Greek conceptions of the world deteriorated in Western Europe during the early centuries (400 to 1000 CE) of the Middle Ages but was preserved in the Muslim world during the Islamic Golden Age. The recovery and assimilation of Greek works and Islamic inquiries into Western Europe from the 10th to 13th century revived "natural philosophy", which was later transformed by the Scientific Revolution wey began in the 16th century as new ideas and discoveries departed from previous Greek conceptions and traditions. The scientific method soon played a greater role in knowledge creation and it was not until the 19th century wey many of the institutional and professional features of science began to take shape;along with the changing of "natural philosophy" to "natural science."

Modern science is typically divided into three major branches wey consist of the natural sciences (e.g., biology, chemistry, and physics), which study nature in the broadest sense; the social sciences (e.g., economics, psychology, and sociology), which study individuals and societies; and the formal sciences (e.g., logic, mathematics, and theoretical computer science), which study abstract concepts. There is disagreement, however, on whether the formal sciences actually constitute a science as they do not rely on empirical evidence. Disciplines wey use existing scientific knowledge for practical purposes, such as engineering and medicine, are described as applied sciences.

Science im based on research, which is commonly conducted in academic and research institutions as well as in government agencies and companies. The practical impact of scientific research has led to the emergence of science policies wey seek to influence the scientific enterprise by prioritizing the development of commercial products, armaments, health care, and environmental protection.

text:
Oluseyi Abiodun Makinde (dem bon am for 25 December 1967) be Naija businessman, politician plus including philanthropist who be di Governor of Oyo State inside Naija since 29 May, 2019 .Him be engineer wey dey gbaski and get correct experience for wetin dem dey call fluid and gas metering. Na him be di oga kpatakpata for Makon Group Limited wey be local oil and Gas Company for inside Nigeria. Oluseyi Makinde been start his first oil and gas business wey him call Makon Engineering and Technical Services, (METS) when him be 29years of age for year 1997, after him don get correct correct  work experience when him dey work with international oil and gas companies. 
Makinde bin contest and lose di 2015 Oyo State gubernatorial election on top the platform of  Social Democratic Party (SDP) .

How e take start
Dem born Oluseyi Makinde inside di family of one correct teacher wey later becom accountant, late Pa Olatubosun Makinde and Madam Abigail Makinde for Aigbofa Compound inside Oja’ba for Ibadan. Na him be di third pikin inside di family. 
Makinde bin start primary school for St Paul Primary School come finish am for St Michael Primary School, Yemetu, Ibadan.  Him do secondary school for Bishop Phillips Academy, Monatan, Ibadan. For 1985, him get admission to University of Lagos (Unilag) dat na where e get di certificate wey dem call bachelor's degree for Electrical Engineering.

For 1998, Oluwaseyi waka go Industrial Control Services inside Houston, Texas go get correct training on top wetin dem call Safety Shutdown System; come join Development of Analytical Competence for Managing Operations for Lagos Business School (now Pan-Atlantic University)in 1999. For year 2000, he bin get training for another area wey dem call automation. For year 2002, him waka go study wetin dem call Fundamentals of Crude Sampling for Jiskoot Auto Control Training Centre,inside Kent, England. Again for year 2005, Oluseyi Makinde waka go study Understanding and Solving Complex Business Problems for Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), inside USA.

How im take work and do business
Makinde bin do national service (NYSC) for Shell Petroleum Development Company (SPDC) Nigeria, where dem later give am work as pupil engineer. Him serve for different capacities come handle and join hands on top several key projects between 1990 and 1992. Him bin work as field Engineer (Eket operations) for Rebold International Limited from 1992 to 199 where dem later make am Field Manager in 1995. 
For inside year 1997, Makinde start his first business, Makon Engineering and Technical Services Limited (METS), after him don work for five years (1992-1997) with many international oil and gas companies (IOCs), as Engineering Manager. Na him come be the oga kpatakpata for Makon Group of Companies. 
Makinde be member of  many correct national and international professional bodies wey include: Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE), Council for Regulations of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN), Oil and Gas Design Engineers of Nigeria (OGDEN), International Society of Automation (ISA), Institute of Measurement and Control UK; and American Measurement Institute (AMI).

How im take do politics
For year 2007, Makinde bin contest and lose election for the Oyo South Senatorial seat on top the platform of the All Nigeria Peoples Party (ANPP) to People's Democratic Party candidate- Kamoru Adedibu. Makinde no allow that loss to shake am as him come try try contest in 2010 under the People's Democratic Party, PDP for Oyo South 2011 Senatorial seat but lose inside primary to the Senator wey bin dey represent Oyo South. 
For year 2014, Makinde make up him mind to fight for Oyo State 2015 governorship ticket on top  the platform of the People's Democratic Party (PDP) but for  December 2014 when dem finish party's primary election,dem no gree give am the governorship nomination ticket. Na this mata plus to achieve his ambition make Oluseyi makinde waka comot for People's Democratic Party PDP) go join Social Democratic Party (SDP), where him contest for governor of Oyo State in year 2015. 
For September 2017,after many talk talk with the Caretaker National Chairman of PDP, Senator Ahmed Makarfi wey come visit am for Ibadan plus including many many meetings National Leaders, Oyo State leaders plus elders of the Social Democratic Party for inside Oyo State, Engineer Seyi Makinde return to his before before political party, People's Democratic Party (PDP) where him talk say him no return for personal gain but na becos him wan join contribute to the development of the state.
For September 29, 2018, Makinde comot as People's Democratic Party (PDP) candidate wey go contest for the governorship election for 2019 general elections for Oyo State, after him get polling 2772 votes at the primary election that took place at liberty stadium, Oke-Ado in Ibadan.

Mr. Seyi Makinde was elected into the Office of the Governor of Oyo State for inside the Gubernatorial elections for Oyo State wey dem do on March 9, 2019 after him get 515,621 votes come take defeat his rival, Mr Adebayo Adelabu of the All Progressive Party wey get 357,982 votes.

Sir Darnley Alexander

Sir Darnley Arthur Alexander

Sir Darnley Alexander, QC, SAN, GCFR (28 January 1920 – 10 February 1989) him be Naija Jurist and former Chief Justice of Naija.
Dem born am for Castries, St Lucia on 28 January 1920. Him go University of London and nah dere him take get Bachelor of Law degree for year 1942. Him con work as crown counsel and legal draftsman for Jamaica as magistrate for Turks and Caicos Islands. Him come Naija for year 1957 wen de premier for de Western Region tell am make him come. Obafemi Awolowo dat time don beg de Colonial Office for London say make dem help am find legal draftsman; Alexender come work for de region for different capacities wey him fit. Him be Legal draftsman for the Western Region Naija for year 1957 – 1969 and him come be de acting Director of Naija Public Prosecutions for year 1958. For 1969 dem choose am as de Solicitor General and Permanent secretary for de regional Ministry of Justice, for year 1963, dem make Queen Counsel. For 1964, dem choose am make him be Judge for Lagos High Court and wen e con reach 1969, dem choose am make him be de Chief Justice for South Eastern State wey be Cross River and Akwa Ibom State now. Dem Choose am as Chief Justice for 1975 over dem de senior members for court. Wen him still be Judge, Dennis Osadebay choose am say make him be commissioner wey go torchlight de Owegbe secret cult, him still be de chairman wey dey oversea de Tribunal wey dey torchlight de examination wey leak comot.
Wen him retire, him come be de chairman for Commission wey go rearrange Naija Law.

Soil

Soil na di mixture of organic matter, gases, liquids, minerals and organisms wey support life. Di soil wey on top earth get four functions:

•E dey help plant grow

•E dey help store, supply and purify water

•E dey serve as habitat for organisms

•E also dey modify earth atmosphere

Soil na di product of plenty factors wey include climate, relief and materials in dey for the parent soil wey dey interact over time. E dey develop by many physical, chemical and biological processes, wey include weathering with associated erosion.
