Stephen Keshi
Dem bon Stephen Okechukwu Keshi for 23 January 1962. For 7 June 2016, im be one of di player for Naija football club and na manager too. Na defender Im be wen e be dey play ball for Naija foot ball team, and E get 60 caps for Naija national team, na im make am be di Naija second player wey get cap well well for di time wey e retire.
E represent Naija for 1994 FIFA World Cup and for the 1994 Africa Cup of Nations,
For Dat time wey Super Eagle win, na im be captain of dem. E play for klub for country
wey reach five, E play for Belgium club well well, where im win di Belgian league championship with R.S.C. Anderlecht for 1991.
Keshi na manager wey dey lucky to qualify for Togo FIFA World Cup wey e show face for their for im histori for 2006.
But im later comot for di position for di tournament and dem com carri Otto Pfister put for e position. And E com later be coach for im contri wey be Naija, na for their e take be one for the two
pesins wey be Mahmoud ElGohary, wey win diAfrica Cup of Nations wen e bin dey as player and wen e bin coach. Afta Im playing Karia for klub where e win the Belgian league championship wit R.S.C. Anderlecht in 1991. E come go for im coach training for United States.

Im Karia wen E be Coach 
For 1996, Augustine Eguavoen wey don be coach for Naija football team before com join am. Dem play togeda for California as backbone for di short-lived Sacramento Scorpions.
 
Keshi don be staff coach for Naija foot ball team, and na head coach Im be for di Junior Eagles for the 2001 African Youth Championship wey make dem qualify for di 2001 FIFA World Youth Championship wey dem no win am.

For 2004 go reach 2006 Keshi be coach for di Togo national team, and na surprise e be for dem for di number one time  wey dem fit show face for di World Cup tournament, Germany 2006 wen Im be dia coach. Togo com change am wit one coach wey com from Germany wey be Otto Pfister becos of say E no meet up wit dem want from am, before dem go di World Cup finals, wit how Togo show dia self for strong way, dem later fail for di  knock out stage for di   2006 Africa Cup of Nations in Egypt. Pfister no com teh for Togo coach wen e be say na one World Cup campaign wey nealy reach not to pay am again, im com comot, and Togo com just dey like dat reach February 2007 wen dem call Keshi back for di friendly match wit Cameroon.

E com gree to be manager for two year for Mali national team wen dem don collect am for April 2008. Dem comot Keshi as manager for Mali national team for 2010 wen Mali quick drop for di group stage for 2010AfricaCup of Nations.

For  2011, Keshi com be coach for Naija national team. E com make dem to fit go for di 2013 Africa Cup of Nations and dem beat Burkina Faso wit 1–0 for di final. For di second day Keshi drop Im letter say Im wan resign, but e com later change e mind and e no resign again. Na dat one com make am fit carri Naija team go for di 2013 Confederations Cup, dem com beat Tahiti 6-1, and Uruguay com beat dem 2-1 for di second game, and Spain com beat dem 3-0 for di World Cup winners, for dia final group game.

For 16 November 2013, Keshi make Naija qualify to fit go play di 2014 World Cup afta dem don win Ethiopia 4-1 for dia aggregate for dia play-off.

For Africa, Keshi make a record to be di first coach to qualify for two nation wey wey (Naija and Togo) wey qualify to go for di World Cup Finals for 2005 and for 2013. Dem start di World Cup wit 0-0 draw wit Iran, And dem win Bosnia and Herzegovina 1-0. Argentina come beat dem 3-2 for di final group stage, but dem still make am to di knockout stage afta dem wit 3-1 over Iran. France com win di Super Eagle for di first knockout round. Na afta di match Keshi com talk say Im don resign to be Super Eagle coach, but Im no com later resign again wen di Naija Football Federation com sign anoda new contract wit am. For di Morocco 2015 African Cup of Nations Im team no so well for dia, na e com make e talk say Im wan resign for coach work go look for anoda work to do if to say the pressure dey plenti for am more more from som bad mouth pipu wey e no mention dia name becos dem de try spoil e name. Afta di Naija team be don come back from World Cup for July 2014, na im di contract wey Keshi get wit di Naija Football Federation finish and dem no renew am again. Di NFF Executive Committee com talk say dia decision na afta dem don check Im report and look Im matter well well for di NFF Disciplinary Committee and for di NFF Technical and Development Committee wey dem chek well for di tins dem wey Stephen Keshi don do and for e performance wen Im be dey as Super Eagles' Head Coach, NFF see say Im no put bodi for di work well wey go don make e fit get wetin di Federation want wen dey be wan give am di contract of coach.

She com die on di 10 December 2015, on top say she get one bad sickness wey dem dey call cancer and na for three years she take fight wit di bad sickness before she com die put, Dem bon four pikin. Toyin Sokefun-Bello (bon 14 January 1978),wey people popularly know as TY Bello, na Naija singer, songwriter, photographer and philanthropist. Before she begin solo career for music, she be member of one gospel band wey dem bin know as Kush. TY Bello na member Nigerian photography collective, Depth of Field. Dem sabi am well well for her singles "Greenland", "Ekundayo", "This Man", "Freedom" and "Funmise".

Early life and education

Dem born TY Bello for Ogun State. She bin get degree for Economics from University of Lagos, come do journalism before she come enter photography.

Music career
 Kush

She enter Naija's musical stage as member of the group wey dem dey call Kinetically Ushering Salvation into Hearts and Homes(KUSH).Other members bin include Lara George, Dapo Torimiro and rapper Emem Ema. Di group bin gain popularity for early 2000s with the single "Let's Live Together"; and na only one album dem manage to release before dem disband.

2008: Greenland

For 2008, Bello release her first studio album Greenland wey Mosa Adegboye produce and di work bin take  two years to develop. Na the album come make am collect one Nigeria Music Award come join Sound City Award. Bello bin describe di album as journey of her everyday life. Di album get correct messages about love, family and nation and di title track na song of inspiration wey dem write to take  motivate Naija people onto hope.

2011–13: Di Future, Di Jubilee Collection and anti-rape campaign

Bello bin talk about plans for her second studio album, Di Future, wen she dey yarn on top Ariya Today. Di album wey dem plan to release for 2011 na him dem rank 12th on top Nigerian Entertainment Today's list of 12 Albums to Buy in 2011. Di singer talk say she bin work with producer Mosa record the album in a few months. For 19 February 2011, Bello bin release "The Future" as the lead single inside di album of di wey bin get di same name. Di song wey bin advice Naija youth to be di change wey dem dey look for. Di music video of "The Future" wey Kemi Adetiba bin direct na him den release on 3 April 2011. 
People like Tara Fela-Durotoye, Sound Sultan, Chude Jideonwo and Banky W bin feature for inside di video. Ore Fakorede bin rate the song 7 stars out of 10 as him talk say its "soft tribal drums, synths and a piano na him provide correct backdrop for TY to contrast her unmistakable voice against. Makeup brand House of Tara bin launch The Jubilee Collection, wey be limited edition line of makeup wey "The Future" single the inspire.

For October 2011, Bello be one of di celebrities wey dem feature for one eight-minute anti-rape video wey Nigerian Ministry of Youth Development bin compile. Na this anti-rape video dem take trowey light on top the victim of a gang rape inside Abia State University for 2011. For December 2013, Bello bin release her single "Yahweh" wia she bin feature Wale Adenuga. The song bin get  additional vocals from Nwando Okeke plus including Nosa. She bin write the first line of the song inside photoshoot for 2004.

2014: The Morning Songbook

For October 10 2014, TY Bello bin release her third studio album wey dem call di Morning Songbook for free digital download on top SoundCloud. the album wey dem release without any promotion na him get 10 tracks, including "Yahweh", "Thirsty" and "Jesu Jesu" come feature collaborations with M Sugh and Fela Durotoye. Udochukwu Ikwuagwu of the Breaking Times bin rate di album 7 out of 10 come talk say "TY Bello and Mosa deserve credit for the superb songwriting and production employed on this".

Photography career

TY Bello be official photographer to former President Goodluck Jonathan for di time wey him dey for office; she also dey do work for Thisday fashion magazine.

2016: Olajumoke Orisaguna's discovery

TY Bello bin get hand for di success of hairstylist/bread seller Olajumoke Orisaguna wey she bin mistakenly discover inside one  photo shoot for Lagos with British rapper Tinie Tempah. After dem don do am makeover and correct professional photo session, Bello bin arrange make dem put Orisaguna's picture on the cover of This Day's Style magazine, and since that time, Orisaguna don turn model as she don sign with one agency.

Humanitarian work

TY Bello dey organise annual exhibition for photography to take raise funds for orphans inside Naija. Na she be the director of Link-a-child, one NGO wey dey work for circulation of information on orphanages inside Naija and wey dey seek sponsorship for them. In July 2011 the non-profit Communication For Change organisation bin honour Ty Bello inside one five-part documentary film wey dem title RedHot.

Personal life

TY Bello don marry and she get twin boys named Christian and Christopher on 10 October 2014.

Titanik  na wan inglish pipu big ship we skata for inside Atlantik oshon for April 14,1912  wen I go nak wan aisblok  wey dey for di midu of di oshon wen I dey Joni from Southampton to New York.
For inside abaot 2,224 pipu we dey inside di ship, pesin wey pas 1,500 na dem their,na dis wan mek am wey I bi sey di nomba of pipu we die na im don plenti pas for inside wan ship wey don skata. Dis tin wey hapun rili kash pipu ai sote dem du im foto an ivun du di fim mek pipu fo wosh. Taitanik na di ship we big pas fo ol di ship we dey ontop wota for dat time, an na im bi di sekond ship wey big pas for ol di big big ship wey dem do dat time. Na di kompini wey I nem na Harland an Wolff Shipyard we dey for Belfast mek Taitanik. Edward Smith wey bi di oga for di pipu wey dey drive di ship for dat dey sef die for wota. Di Taitanik ship Kari som of di pipu we rish for dat time an pipu de pak komot frm Great Britain, Ireland an plenti oda ples for Europe dey go United States to stat niu life their.
Di Taitanik ship big sotey di ples wey rish pipu stey difrent frm where puo pipu dey stey. For di rish pipu side, fain fain tins  dey like: suimin pu,laibri,daini tun an plenti oda enjoiment tins dey their.
Titanik na wan ship sef wel wel for di wey we dey mek am, wota no go fit pas eni ples enta. As I big rish, I de Kari 48 smo smo bot for bodi wen I dey travu to sef pipu inkes katakata wan bos ontop wota. Bot for di dey wey I wan skata na jos 20 smol bot I Kari an na jos 1,178 pipu di 20 bot fit Kari join togeda we bi haf of di pipu (2,224) we Titanik Kari for dat dey wey pesin no fit foget.

Ao I Tek Hapun
Afta Titanik ship komot for Southampton for April 10 1912, I stop for Cherbourg we dey
inside Frans. Afta, i stop egen for Queenstown inside Ireland bifo i bigin travu  go New York, bot for Apri 14 1912, as I de travu dey go i jos nak wan aisblok wey dey inside di oshon arand 11:40 for nait. Wota bigin rosh enta shapshap. Na du smol smol pikin an wumen dem de fes stat to put
fo di smo smo not dem bikos na wetin di law tok bi dat. Arand 2:20 for midnait, Titanik brek into tu wen pleti pipu stil dey inside am, an I sink bitwuin tu awas. Na jos 710 pipu dem fit sef for inside di kasala afta anoda big ship kom di pipu wey sovaiv.

text:
Di UK (English: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland) or Britain na free stet for Europe. E dey get four kontri-dem: England, Scotland, Wales, an Northern Ireland. Na English dem dey tok. Di kontri na for di Atlantic Ocean.
Dem get kwin. Di pawa no plenti like bifo again. Di Parliament and di courts na dem dey get pawa pas.
Di king wey dey rule now na Charles III, an di Prime Minister kom be Rishi Sunak.

Histri
Dem don dey yuz di ful nem United Kingdom of England and Northern Ireland fest for 1945, wey be di year wey di kontri join di UN. Di Royal Titles Act 1953 don mek di name official.

Unions an annexations
Di four kontri-dem don get in di UK for different taims.

Æthelstan don unite di Kingdom of Ingland for 927.

Di King for Ingland don take Wales for di middle ages. Edward I don invade for 1277, na di war don end for 1283. Afterwards, some land for Wales don be ruled by Edward, na oda land be ruled by di supporters of Edward. Di Statute of Rhuddlan (1284) don say di land for Edward be "annexed and united" to di Inglish crown, but no be part of Kingdom of Ingland. For 1536, Henry VIII don mek union between Wales na Ingland.

Scotland don get united with Ingland with di Treaty of Union (1707).

Ireland don get united with Ingland with di Acts of Union 1800. Dem don be two acts wey don get passed by di Parliament of Great Britain na di Parliament of Ireland.

Most of Ireland don get independence for 1922. Northern Ireland don remain part of di UK.
title: UK

Di fedral (nashonal) govament for USA get three branches: di Executive, Legislative, na Judicial branches.

Congress go mek statutes, na di Prezident go sign dem, wey mek dem law. Laws dey give fedral agencies powers, so dem go mek regulations.

Executive
Di Prezident for USA dey Joe Biden, wey don get elected for 2020.

Legislative
Di Congress get two houses: di House of Representatives na di Senate.

Judicial
Di Judicial branch get di Supreme Court na oda courts.

Uche Lilian Ekwunife (dem bon ha fo Ogudebe family fo January 12, 1970), na Nigerian politishian, and member of the 9th Nigerian Senate wey represent  pipu of Anambra Central Senatorial District of Anambra State, an dem sabi her as one of di most active woman senator fo di Haus.

Hau shi stat laif an edukashun
Dem bon Ekwunife fo December 12, 1970 fo Igbo-Ukwu, Anambra to Emmanuel and Lucy Ogudebe. Ekwunife attend University of Calabar and graduate with  bachelor degree in Business and Accounting fo 1993.Shi still get  MBA degree from Nnamdi Azikiwe University in 2002.
Ekwunife don wok fo bank an dem promote ha to  area manager.

Politikal wok
Ekwunife don kontest fo Anambra governorship election two taim but shi no win. Dem elekt Ekwunife fo 2007 to represent Anambra's Anaocha/Njikoka/Dunukofia constituency. Shi bi one of 11 women wey dem elekt fo 2007, wey dem still  re-elekt fo 2011 wen di lower haus almost bi  95% men.Oda women wey dem elekt na Juliet Akano, Mulikat Adeola-Akande, Abike Dabiri, Nkiru Onyeagocha, Nnena Elendu-Ukeje, Olajumoke Okoya-Thomas, Beni Lar, Khadija Bukar Abba-Ibrahim, Elizabeth Ogbaga and Peace Uzoamaka Nnaji.
Fo 2015, dem elekt ha to  Nigerian Senate. Shi bi  one of the six women wey den elekt to the 8th Nashonal Assembly. The orda women na Rose Okoji Oko, Stella Oduah, Fatimat Raji Rasaki, Oluremi Tinubu and Binta Garba. Na as Ekwunife move from one politikal Pati to another one na im shi tek win. Bicos dem chalenj di  elektshon fo Dizemba 2015 dem kom declare ha seat vacant. As Ekwunife no get di  suppot of former politikal party (The All Progressives Grand Alliance) fo di bye-elekshon , na Victor Umeh dem kom  elect as Senator. Shi win di 2019 Anambra State senatorial elekshon under the platform of di People's Democratic Party wey  represent Anambra central Senatorial District, Nigeria.

text:
University of Lagos wey pipul dey kol UNILAG na one  big yunivasiti wey dey for Naija. Pipul sabi di yunivasiti wel wel for Naijá an Afrika, Dem stat di skul for 1962. Di skul kolo na maron an gold.
UNILAG na one of the fest yunivasiti wey dey fom in Naijá an e dey top amog di univasiti wey dey put mouth for edukeshion mata for di wold. UNILAG vet three kampos in Lagos Mainland. Two of di three kampus dey Yaba (di main kampos dey Akoka an di niu one dey for wie School of Radiography dey bifor bifor), UNILAG kolej of medisin dey Idi-Araba for Surulere. Na lagun wota raund di main kampus an all di land for dia na 802 acres of land. Di yunivasiti dey kolet ova 9,000 niu student evri year an na ova 57,000 student dey di skul.
One komiti wey luk into moni mata from 2016 go rish 2020 tok sey di oga kpata-kpata for di skul dey chop moni an du mago-mago an dey kom sey mek di skul klos all di akaunt wey dey for bank.
For 7 October 2020, Folasade Ogunsola bikom di fest wuman to bi di Vice Chancellor of UNILAG

text:
Velekete Slave Market na one maket for Badagry for Lagos State. Na for 1502 dem opun am an dem giv am one juju nem wey dem dey kol Vlekete, wey bi di wuman-god for big big wota and briz. Dem yuz dis maket wel wel for dat time wey slave stil dey for Naija. Na for here som Afrika pipul dey sel slave-dem giv dem oyibo-dem wey kom from  Europe, dis one kom mek dis slave maket be di slave maket wey pipul sabi pas for West Afrika.

How e tek stat
Na one man wey bi Deutch wey im nem bi Hendrik Hertog but dem dey kol am Yovo Huntokonu bi di pesin way stat dis Velekete Slave Market. E buy plenti land from di pipul-dem an e turn am to wia dem dey buy an sel tins wey di chif-dem go like. Dem dey sel tins wey oyido pipul-dem get wit wetin Afrika pipul-dem get. Dem stat to dey sel slave wel wel wen dem si say di biznes get plenti moni an bikos oyibo-dem nid pipul wey go kom dey wok for dem big big fam.

Tins wey dem dey do there
For 1805, di Europe-pipu kash one man wey e nem na Scipio Vaughan wey kom from Owu Kingdom for Abeokuta for Naija an kari am go dis Vlekete slave maket for Badagry wit oda slave-dem an dem put dem for ship kari go America.
Dem stil kari slave-dem from di ples dem dey kol Abia State today for Naija an kari dem kom dis Vlekete Slave maket. Dem first dey put dem for prizin wey near di slave maket. Na evri 5 days dem dey yuz sel slave-dem. Dem de yuz tins like drink, gunpowda, big-big gun-dem, brekin plet, miror, umbrela, iron tins an plenti plenti tins dem tek chenj wit slave-dem.

Pipul dey like to kom si dis ples wel wel so dat dem go rili undastand how dem tek dey sel for part of West Afrika wit;
di Mobee Famili house an relic muzium we dem kip di rilijon tins wey show how di famili tek join dey sel slave-dem,
di Gberefu Island way bi di side wey dem de pas go whete dem dey kol Point of No Return where dem dey tok se na dat kind 500,000 bois, gels, yong man and wuman-dem wey dem don kach pas dis ples.
one wel wey bi sey if di slave-dem drink di water dem go swear sey dem no go do gra-gra with di oyibo-dem and dem go foget where dem kom from and
point of No return we dem de kari di slave giv di Europe pipul-dem wey go kom kari di slave-dem enta ship.
title: Velekete Slave Market

How e take stat 
Dem bon Pasuma, wey im real nem be Wasiu Alabi Odetola, on November 8,  1967 for Mushin inside Lagos State and im  come gro op for Kwara State, Western Nigeria. Im mama na before before actress wey bikom trader, while im papa bi general manager for one local company. Pasuma's papa and mama separate when im bi teenager.

How im take work 
As young boy, Pasuma like to dey listen to King Wasiu Ayinde Marshall (KWAM 1) album 'Talazo' and im talk say na di album make im decide to becom Fuji musician. Pasuma bin release "Recognition" wey bi im first album in 1993. Since di time,im don release over 30 albums,wey make am dey among the most successful Fuji musicians in Nigeria. 
Im don also do collabo with plenty recording artists wey include Bola Abimbola and King Sunny Ade. Apart  from singing, Pasuma don also feature for some Nigerian movies wey include Iyanje plus Alenibare. 
For September 6, 2015, Pasuma beat people like Olamide, Phyno, Flavor come become di winner of  Best Indigenous Artist of di year for inside Nigeria Entertainment Awards. Dem also nominate Pasuma, Saheed Osupa, Sule Alao Malaika, Shefiu Alao, Taye Currency, Muri Thunder for Best featured Non-Islamic Artiste in Islamic album for 2016.

Pasuma be philanthropist wey don help many artiste wey just dey come up.

text:
K1 De Ultimate wey dem bon on March 3, 1957 as  Wasiu Omogbolahan Olasunkanmi Adewale Ayinde Marshal na Naija Fuji musician.Na him popularize  the  brand of fuji music(based on the work of di fuji creator Ayinde Barrister) wey people  know as Talazo fuji wey everibodi both old and young bin dey like.

Background 
Di King of Fuji Music: Olasunkanmi Ayinde Marshal, K1 De Ultimate bin discover at di age of 8 say him get interest for music. Him papa and mama for dat time no too support dat kind thing but im continue to dey pursue his passion and by di time wey him reach 15 e don win plenty local musical competitions. im lata join Ayinde Barrister's band, di Supreme Fuji Commanders from 1975 to 1978 after im don serve under Ayinde Barrister as instrument packer. im kukuma adopt di name of Ayinde into his nem after im don ask for permission and blessing of im master Ayinde Barrister.  Wasiu Ayide release the first album wey him titled Iba wey get special track 'Abode Mecca' in 1980, and after dat one come realease  his most successful album Talazo '84 in 1984. He don win many titles and many many music awards.

Music career 
K1 De Ultimate bin start his global tour between North America and Europe for 1986 and him perform for Hammersmith Town Hall in 1987. Na New York city, United States wey him take follow dat one with him complete Talazo Band for September 28 1990, London Yuppie 1 & 2 Nights 1991/92, European Tour 1995, Berlin 1997, North America (USA & Canada '98), Canada 2000, plus including USA Tour 2003. Since dat time,him don dey continue non-stop with annual tour. For 1995,him bekom di first Musician wey go ever sing Fuji Music for  WOMAD Festival. Na him too be di only Fuji musician wey go perform at Troxy, WOMEX.

Chieftaincy titles and Awards 
Badabarawu of Ogijo in 1985

Ekerin Amuludun of Ibadanland in 1986

Golden Mercury of Africa Title in 1986,

Honoris Causa of Music at Saint John University Bakerfield California USA in 1989.

Crown as King of Fuji, (Oluaye Fuji Music) at NTA ibadan in 1993.

The Oluomo of Lagos by King Adeyinka Oyekan of Lagos in 1999

For  Monday, January 13, 2020, Alaafin of Oyo, Oba Lamidi Adeyemi carry chieftaincy title give Wasiu Ayinde as the first Mayegun of Yoruba Land.

Ayefele bin attend Our Saviours Anglican Primary School inside Ipoti-Ekiti for im primary and secondary education before e lata waka go Ondo State College of Arts and Science for Ikare Akoko, Ondo State, Nigeria.

Ayefele work small as journalist and broadcaster for Federal Radio Corporation of Nigeria, Ibadan, wia im dey produce jingles and musical works for radio.

Na after about 9 months wey im don dey inside hospital na im Kola Olootu wey be im friend visit am come advise make im  try arrange some songs put together. Na this advice  make Ayefele come release im first album wey be, Bitter Experience for 1998 wey come catapult am enter limelight. Im come release another album follow  Bitter experience wey im call Sweet Experience. Other albums wey im release be Something Else, Divine Intervention and Life after death, wey im take honor Gbenga Adeboye, a Naija radio presenter, musician and comedian. The title Bitter Experience na im torchlight his experience wen im get accident wey  Sweet Experience come be the sweetness wey follow the "Bitter Experience".

Ayefele don collect over 200 awards. Some of the awards wey im don collect be:

 Member of the Order of the Niger awarded by Goodluck Ebele Jonathan, the president of the Federal Republic of Nigeria (2011)

Im radio station 
Yinka Ayefele be the owner of Fresh FM 105.9 FM radio station wey dey Ibadan for inside Oyo state. The radio station bin start operations in 2015 after NBC give dem licence on the 30th April, 2015.

Ayefele's Music House,wia im dey operate im radio station Fresh FM plus including studio, na im Oyo State Government demolish on August 19, 2018 on top say wia the building dey no follow the laws of the town planning authority.

Zangbeto na one juju way di pipu of Ogu or Egun for Benin, Togo and Nigeria tok sey e dey luk dem for night. Dem stil dey kol am polis an sekuriti. Na wetin dem tek dey yuz to let pipu obey di law an to mek sur sey everibodi dey sef an sekuriti dey for di komuniti. Dem dey fear dis zangbeto wel-wel and na polis way no bi govment polis way dey protekt di pipu for naite and dey proteckt their propati and dey cash pipu wey do bad-bad tin and bring dem for di komuniti to ponish.

Hau e bi
Baze on aw di wok wey i dey do to dey protekt di pipu of Ogu sosayiti, for gun langwej, zangbeto min "men wey get naite" or "man-dem wey dey wok for night".

E get as dem dey uze smol-smol liv and som part of palm tree dem way dem don color. somtimes es sef dem fit jost bi like say dem no dey where dem dey egen. Som pipu biliv sey if dis one hapun like dis, e mean sey spirit don enta their bodi I get pawa to kontrol di way pipu dey do tins. But di Ogu pipu biliv sey no bi pesin dey their but na spirit wey dey kontrol night.

For dem Ogu komuniti, dem biliv sey na Zangbeto bi di sekuriti or polis for their kominity-dem. Dem even get som sikrit groop way bi say na onli di pipu we dey serve di juju fit join. Zangbeto get som kind pawa-dem, like to swalo glas and no bi sey i wan uze am do bad tin but i wan uze am porshu winch-dem. If e don bi like say e no know where im dey egen, dem say zangbeto fit kontrol some kind pawa wey don dey dis world bifor humanbin-dem kom and e de give sense to di Ogu pipu and mek di ogu pipu kontinu to de dis life. 

Dem de do plenti big-big zangbeto pati for plenti-plenti Ogu komuniti-dem for inside West Africa. Di one way pipu sabi pas na di one way dem dey do for Porto-Novo for Benin Republic and for Ajido for Legos for Naija. Na plenti-plenti tins dem dey do for dis pati-dem we dey swit wel-wel and dem dey do majik sef.

Geographically De state dey divided among Naija lowland forest and de dry Guinea forest-savanna mosaic for de North. Among the natural things nah false acreas, mona monkey, forest buffalo, come join with grey parrot dem, with de Naija-Cameroon chimpanzee wey remain,come join am bi troop wey reach 20 chimpanzee wey dem life no dey save for de Ise forest wey dey for animals to dey stay.

Fo 2011, di govment honor Genevieve as Member of the Order of the Federal Republic fo ha kontribushun to Nollywood. Di fes movie wey Shi direkt wey di taitu na Lionheart,
na di fes Netflix film from Naija an di fes Naija film submission fo di Oscars.
Dem  disqualify di fim bicos na English dem Tek tok fo most Pat of di fim instead of di lokal langwuej.Genevieve de among di celebriti dem an big big fo biznes wey di publisher an Editor in Chief of Yes International! magazine, Azuh Arinze,  wrait abaut fo 2020  fo e tu neu buk.

Hau Shi stat laif
Na Mbaise, Imo State, Nigeria, Dem bon Genevieve an Shi grow fo  Lagos. Shi bi number four of  eight children wey ha Mama an Papa bon. Ha father wok as engineer an ha mother wok as  nursery school teacher.

Edukashun
Shi attend Methodist Girls College (Yaba, Lagos), com go University of Lagos,were Shi get bachelor  degree fo creative arts. Na wen Shi dey  university, she don de audition fo  akting job fo Nollywood.

Kariar
Na from small pikin Nnaji don stat to akt, na di popula televishun drama Ripples na im bi di fes fim Shi akt wen Shi bi 8 year. Fo 1998, fo di age of 19 Shi  akt  fo di fim wey di nem na Wanted. Other fim dem wey Shi akt na Last Party, Mark of the Beast, and Ijele. Fo 2010,  Shi bi one of di main aktres fo di award-winning film Ijé: The Journey. She don akt fo over 200 Nollywood movi-dem. 
Fo 2004, Nnaji sign wan record contract with EKB Records; wey bi Ghanaian record label, an release her fes album wey di titu na One Logologo Line. Di song na  mix of R&B, Hip-Hop, and Urban music. Fo 2004, na Genevieve Nnaji get vote pass  other celebrity dem fo di search fo di face of Lux fo 2004.
Fo 2005, she win di Africa Movie Academy Award (AMAA) fo Best Actress fo Leading Role, na Shi bi di fes  aktor to win di award. Samuel Chimerenka Chukwueze  (bon 22 May 1999) na Naijà futbola wey dey pley fo Villarreal an Naijà teem.

Hau e tek stat lif
Dem bon Chukwueze fo Umuahia, Abia Stet. Na Igbo pesin an na fom Christian famili wit one broda an one sista. E go Government College Umuahia an Evangel Sekondri Skul. Na fom 8 years old e don stat to dey pley ball an e lik to dey pley lik as Okocha bikos e lik to bi lik am. E tok sey na Hon. Victor Apugo hep am an e ci am as im papa.

Im Klub Wok
Na Amaokwe Ugba Ibeku, Umuahia, Abia Stet, Chukwueze join Villarreal CF's youth teem, fom lokal Klub Diamond Futbol Academy. Afta dem sign am dey put am fo smol teem, wey dey kol juvenil A, E kon leta join senior teem wit reserves on 15 April 2018, E enta sekond half fo Sergio Lozano wen dem pley 1-1 draw wit Segunda Division B Klub CE Sabadell FC. 

Chukwueze first skore im senior goal on 20 May 2018, wen e skore sekond goal wen dem beat Atletico Bilbao 3-1. E hep im klub wit two goals an pley 11 times fo im first season, as im teem miss pley off to first Division. 

Chukwueze first sho fo first-teem on 20 September 2018, wen e enta fo Nicola Sansone in a 2-2 draw fo home wit Rangers, fo di 2018-19 UEFA Europa League. E sho first fo League on 5 November 2018, wen e pley fo 90 minutes in 1-1 fo home wit Levante, fo di 2018-19 La Liga. 

Fo April 2019, na im win di Naijà futbol Federation's young playa fo di year awod. On April 12 2022, Fo di sekond leg of 2021-22 UEFA Champions League quarter final away to Bayern Munich, na Chukwueze skore bak fo 88th minute 1-1 draw, na di goal hep Villarreal reech semi final fo di tournament.

Im wok fo Kontri
Afta e don pley fo Naijà fo onda 17, dem lol am fo sinor teem in October 2018. E fes pley fo Naijà sinor teem on 20 November 2018, wen e stat fo dem  on 0-0 draw match wit Uganda, di match na friendly match. 

Fo May 2019, dem kol Chukwueze mek e kon pley fo Naijà sinor teem fo di Afrika kop of Nations an di onda 20 teem fo onda 20 wod kop. Villarreal tok sey Chukwueze fit onli pley fo one tournament.E kon sey na Naijà sinor teem fo Afrika kop of Nations fo Egypt na im go pley. E skore im first goal fo Naijà sinor teem fo Naijà 2-1 win wit South Afrika fo quarter final.

Im kain style
Meni pipul don gree sey e dey pley lik Arjen Robben fo France bikos e get skil lik am.

text:
Moshood Abiola National Stadium (wey pipul sabi bifor as National Stadium, Abuja) na ples where dem dey du meni tins, wey dey insaid Abuja, Federal Capital of Naijà. Di ples na home fo Naijà National futbol teem, an na stil ples fo gadarin fo culture an chorch tins. Naijà Govment apruve di kontrat to du di Stadium on 18 July 2000. Dem du di Stadium bicos of 8th All Afrika games wey stet on October 2003. Fo 12 June 2019, President Muhammadu Buhari anours di chenj of nem fo di National Stadium, Abuja to Moshood Abiola National Stadium. President Muhammadu Buhari chenj di nem wen e dey giv Presidential spich  fo Democrgacy Day Celebrashion on Wednesday fo Moshood Abiola Stadium (wey pipul sabi bifor as National Stadium, Abuja) na ples where dem dey du meni tins, wey dey insaid Abuja, Federal Capital of Naijà. Di ples na home fo Naijà National futbol teem, an na stil ples fo gadarin fo culture an chorch tins. Naijà Govment apruve di kontrat to du di Stadium on 18 July 2000. Dem du di Stadium bicos of 8th All Afrika games wey stet on October 2003. Fo 12 June 2019, President Muhammadu Buhari anours di chenj of nem fo di National Stadium, Abuja to Moshood Abiola National Stadium. President Muhammadu Buhari chenj di nem wen e dey giv Presidential spich  fo Democrgacy Day Celebrashion on Wednesday fo Eagle Square, Abuja.

Hau dem tek du am 
Moshood Abiola National Stadium na one of di 50 Stadium wey cost pas fo di world

How di stadium luk like
Moshood Abiola National Stadium fit kolet 60,491 persin, dem kova am wit roof wey no too heavy. Di Stadium get two ples wey pipul wey dey wotch bol fit sit; Di wan wey dey low get 32,000 seats an di up kon get 28,000 seats. Di one wey dey low get 56 koporate ples wey persin fit dey wotch bol, di stadium kon stil get one ples difiren wey dey fo President or oda top pipul, na 50 persin di ples fit tek. All di ples wey dey fo Ceremony an oda tins floor na 25,000 m². Di ples fo pipul wey wan watch bol get one smol ples onda wey get diferen kiosk, banks, an toilet. Na concrete an situ dey uze du di stadium. Na 36 strong tol pole dey uze sopot di roof. Di tol tins wey hod am get 140 piles wit diameta of 1.30m an 1.50m.

Weyin dey inside di stadium
All di tins wey dem uze fo di stadium na origina an di International sport association, Federation International de Football Association (FIFA) an di International Association of Athletics Federation (IAAF) folo komfam am.

Di stadium get:
.60,491 persin fit dey insaid 

.Velodrome wey bicycle fit pas

.ples where President an oda impotant pipul fit dey    

.Post Ofis

.Banks

.where nius pipul fit dey (media)

.shops 

.3000 ples where dem fit du insaid sport 

.Swimming ples wey fit tek 2000 pipul

.Tennis ples (court) 

.Hockey ples wey fit tek 3000 pipul 

.ples where dem fit pley Baseball 

Di committee wey dey chek stadium fo di wod tok sey di Stadium na Wod klas bikos e stil gat ples lik: wen emergency hapun tins wey don dey redi, Camera wey dey ci everibodi, an e get fence wey dey pipul. Di stadium get tins wey dem fit uze kontrol fire an stil get somtin wey dey let dem no wen fire don stet.

Histri abaut di Stadium
Naijà get meni stadium fo di kontri, no bi hol of dem get wetin go mek dem standard fo di wod. Naijà capita citi Abuja, dem selet to host di 8th All Afrika Games in 2000 (sport wey dem dey du evri 4 years, wey Association of National Olympic Committee of Afrika dey oraganise). Federal Govment fo Naijà kon diside sey mek dem du one stadium fo Abuja bikos of di All Afrika Games. Na 18 July 2000 dem giv one kontrator di kontrat, na 80 kontractor tel govment sey dem won du di Stadium bifor govment giv one of dem.

Plenti pipul an sport pipul dey fear sey di stadium go finish bifor game go stet. Wok stet an finish bifor di game stet. Na di stadium sef dem tok sey dem go tek du Miss World Beauty Pageant wey hapun fo year 2002. But dem no lata du am fo di stadium bikos of di fight wey hapun fo Kaduna wey pipul die na im mek dem kari dey Miss World pageant go London, England. Dey stet to dey du di stadium fo September 2000 an kon finish am fo April 2003, bifor di game stet. Di game vilej kon Alstet fom September 2000 to August 2003. 

Dem open di stadium fo pipul to dey uze am on 8 April 2003. Afta dey open am dem pley match to yuz test am fo di game. Dat year bi di year wey pipul plenti pas fo All Africa Game histri; 6,000 pipul wey dey du sport fom 53 kontri wey tek pat fo 22 sports, 1,200 wey dem sabi sport persin see di game. E pass 1,500 pipul wey dey writ or tok abaut sport tok or writ abaut di game fo di wod. Di game stet on di 4th to 18 October 2003 an plenti pipul tok sey evritin go wel. Naijà wey bi di host kontri get 226 medals, na dem kolet medals pas dat year.

No bi onli All Africa Games, dem don du fo di stadium. Dey don pley big matches fo di stadium, ezampu na World Cup qualifiers wey Naijà an oda kontri don pley. Di first match wey dem pley fo di stadium na futbol match wit lokal klub wey bi: Shooting Stars of Ibadan an Sunshine Stars of Akure on 8 April 2003. Di first goal na fom  Shooting Stars playa Shakiru Lawal wey skore di onli goal fo di match afta 5 minutes. 

Di niu stadium wey di kontri get don hep dem host difren events lik; 2007 World Youth Championship wey bi fo Volleyball game.

Oda tins ewu dem de yuz am for
Som oda tins wey dey hapun fo Moshood Abiola National Stadium na cultural an chorch event. Bikos of how di Stadium bi pipul lik to dey yuz am fo event. somtims chorch event dey hapun bifor sport tins. For ezampu, insaid September 2006, Nigeria Football Federation no fit du enitin wen Naijà get match wit Rwanda, an President tok sey mek dem du event an mek foootball wait first. Plenti pipul don tok sey e no gud as dem dey yuz am fo event, but di moni wey dem dey pay fo di event na fo di stadium maintenance.

Maintenance
Meni pipul dey wori abaut how dem go tek maintain di stadium. National stadium fo Lagos wey dem du fo All Afrika Games 1973 no fine lik bifor bikos no maintenance. Amos Adamu wey bi forma Minista fo sport advis President sey mek dem giv privat pipul di Abuja National Stadium bikos dem go maintain am wel. 

Di money wey dey don yuz maintain d stadium sinc di time dey don du am don reech $7 millon, wey plenti pipul don tok sey e too much fo maintenance. Bikos of di plenti moni fo maintenance Federal Govment of Nigeria kon dside to find private compani wey go dey manaj am.

Chenj of nem
On June 12, 2019 President Muhammadu Buhari renem di national stadium Abuja afta 1993 Presidential election fo Naijà winna, Moshod Abiola. Meni pipul gree sey na Mr Abiola win di June 1993 election, but di forma Military Govment of Ibrahim Babangida kansu am. President Buhari fo 2018 giv Mr Abiola respet wen e giv am di Grand Commander of di Federal Republic wey bi di honor wey big pas fo Naijà. Wen President Buhari dey giv tok fo di chenj of nem event, wey stil bi Naijà 20th year of Democracy, President Buhari tok sey di niu stadium nem na Moshood Abiola National Stadium. Di event hapun fo Eagles Square an na plenti big pesin dey dia lik di president of Rwanda, Paul Kagame.

Panshak Henry Zamani (dem born am for 30 October 1984) wey plenti pipul sabi as Ice Prince Zamani or Ice Prince, na Naija hip hop rekoding artist an aktor. Plenti pipul sabi am wen e sing "Oleku", wey bi one of di songs wey Naijà artist du di remix pas. Na im win di 2009 Hennessy Artistry Club Tour. Im first album na Everybody loves Ice Prince, wey e riliz for 2011. For 2013 Ice Prince riliz fire of Zamani second studio album. Di album get song lik "Aboki", "More", "Gimme Dat" an "I Swear". For 1 July 2015, dey anous am sey na Ice Prince bi di vice president fo Chocolate City. E dey di post bifor e komot for di label for 2006.

How e tek stat life
Ice Prince mama an papa nem am Panshak Henri Zamani insaid Minna. E muve wit im famili to Jos, Pleateu Stet.

Edukashion
Wen e dey Jos e go St Murumba College. E stil kon go Di Science Tutorial Niger Stet College fo Jos.

Im wok
Na 1999, e don stet to dey sing an rap fo Skul; Fo 2001 e go dey rekod di songs. Fo 2002, Ice Prince an som frend go fom grup wey bi "ECOMOG squad" but di skata afta one year. Fo 2004, E konet wit MI, Jesse Jagz, Ruby, Lindsey, Eve, Taz, all of dem togeda na im bi di "Loopy Crew". E go stodi Zeology fo University of Jos, but e no finish di stodi bikos of moni.

2010-2011: Everybody Loves Ice Prince

Ice Prince tok sey e nem im album Everybody Loves Ice Prince, bikos pipul rili sho am sey dem love am wen im mama die. E tok sey na fom evri plez fo di wod di love dey kom, an sey na afta di mama burial e kon go dey du rekodin bak.

"Oleku", Ice Prince first song fo di album wey pipul lik fo Naijà. Na onda Chocolate City e rilis am. E don folo plenti artist du song. E du song wit Taikoon's "Respect My Husle" wit Banky W, DJ Neptune's "This Gbedu Reloaded" wit YQ an Shank, Bez's "Super Sun Remix" wit Eldee & Eva Alordiah, YQ's "Efimile (Remix)" wit Neato C, Pherowshuz's "Korrect (remix)" wit MI an Terri Tha Rapman, Dekunle Fuji's "Funmilayo" wit Jesse Jagz, Jamix's "My Party" wit Wizkid & Kel, Reminisce's "2 Mussh [Remix] wit Sauce Kid, an Knighthouse's "Make it better" wit Mo'cheddah, Funbi, & Mobie amog Odas. 

2012-2013: Fire Of Zamani

Fo Insaid 2012, E stet to dey du song wel Wel wit Grip Boiz City Produsa Chopstix, rilisin "Aboki" fo 2012. E kon rilis di vidio wit am. "Aboki" reech nomba 92 fo Afribiz's Top 100 chart. 

Fo August 2012, Ice Prince rilis "More" as di sekond single fom di album. Na Chopstix produs di song. Na Moe Musa du di vidio fo "More", na fo London dem du di vidio. Lola Rae, wey bi rekoding artist dey di vidio.

On 25 January 2013, Ice Prince rilis "Aboki (Remix)". E du di song wit Sarkodie, Mercy Johnson, Wizkid, MI, Khuli Chana. On 24 April 2013, Ice Prince an Chocolate City rilis "Gimme Dat" an "VIP" di same time. 

2015-2016: Jos To The World

In 2015, Ice Prince stet do dey rilis songs fo im third studio album. Na di album bi di first album e du, wey no bi onda Chocolate City rekod label. E tel Pulse sey e du som of di wok fo US.

Pipul wey e dey luk dia ezampu

Ice Prince kol som artist nem wey e dey luk as ezampu, wey bi: Notorious B.I.G, Rakim, Jay-Z, Common, Talib Kweli, Kanye West, Ludacris, Busta Rhymes, Lauryn Hill, M.I an Jesse Jagz.

text:
Victor James Osimhen (dem bon am for 29 December 1998) na Naija futbola wey pley as strika fo Seria A klob Napoli an di Naija nashional teem. 

Dem bon am for Naijà, Osimhen stet im sinior Karier fo Germany at VfL Wolfsburg in 2007. Afta one season an half fo di klob, e kon go Belgian side Charleloi fo loan in 2018-19, bifor e kon go France at Lille. In 2020, Osimhen transfer to Seria A klob Napoli fo a klob rekod fee of £70 million. Na im win di Seria A Bes young playa awod in di 2021-22 season.

Na Osimhen win di Golden Boot awod at di 2015 FIFA U-17 Wod kop, wey Nigeria win. E first pley fo Naijà sinior teem in June 2017 an e pley fo di 2019 Afrika Kop of Nations.

Hau e tek stet lif
Na Lagos dem bon Osimhen, im mama an papa na fom Edo stet. Wen e dey gro, Na Didier Drogba e lik to dey luk as e dey pley.

How e tek play for difren difren klob
Osimhen stet im karier at di Ultimate Strikers Academy, wey dey Legos, Nigeria. In January 2016, Afta dey don ci sey e du Wel fo di 2015 FIFA U-17 Wod Kop, Osimhen kon du pre- kontrat wit VFL Wolfsburg, di kontrat na sey Osimhen go join di klob fo January 2017. 

VFL Wolfsburg

On 5 January 2017, Osimhen sign a three-an-half year kontrat wit di klob, wey go end fo June 2020. Wen e rich di klob e no first pley bikos of wound wey e get, on 13 May 2013, Osimhen pley im first game fo Bundesliga an fo im klob Wolfsburg, e enta fo 59th minutes in a 1-1 draw wit Borrusia Monchenglabach.Osimhen pley fo im klub against Hamburger SV, wey bi di final match game day fo 2016-2017 season. E enta fo Sebastian Jung wey bi defender,  di match end fo 1-1 draw, an Hamburg skore late wey mek dem Pas Wolfsburg fo di table, wey kon mek Wolfsburg go relegation pleyoff wit Eintracht Braunschweig. Osimhen dey fo di two matches. Wolfsburg win 2-0 fo di second leg, wey mek dem pley fo di next Bundesliga.

Osimhen nem dey fo 12 among 17 match dey playa wey fo di first half of 2017-18 season, E sho fo 5 games. E pley im first Bundesliga ful match on 28 January 2018 wit Hannover, wey dem win 1-0. Osimhen stet two more games, E pley ful match against Werder Bremen on 11 February an dey komot am fo first half fo Daniel Didavi against Hertha Berlin on 31 March. Wolfsburg kon dey fo pley off fo Religation. Osimhen no pley bikos of injury wey e get. Osimhen pley one game fo Wolfsburg's DFB Pokal campaign, E enta fo Josuha Guilavogui fo las ten minutes inside di match wey Schakle beat dem fo quarter-final. Osimhen du shoulder surgery on 2 May, wey mek am finish di season wit 12 match fo Bundesliga.

Charleroi

Osimhen du trial fo Belgian Klub Zulte Waregem an Club Brugge, wey bi di champions by dat time. E get malaria dat time wey affect dey way e luk, an di two club no gree sign am fo loan. On 22 August 2018, Osimhen join Belgian klub Charleroi fo loan, afta e no skore fo im klub Wolfsburg inside 16 match wey e pley fo dem. Dem yuz am reples Kaveh Rezaei, wey dem sel to Klub Brugge afta e skore 3 goals fo im first 3 games of di season. Osimhen first pley fo dem on September 1, wen im klub pley wit Excel Mouscron, e enta late fo Jèrèmy Perbet. Osimhen first pley im ful match on 22 September, E skore im first goal Wen dem pley wit Waasland-Beveren.

Osimhen stet match wit Adama Niane fo di nex four games, E skore di onli goal fo Napoli wen dey loose to Cercle Brugge an Gent. E skore two times fo di las five minutes in a 3-2 win ova Zulte Waregem on 21 October, afta Hamdi Harbaoui don giv Waregem 2-1 lead Wen e skore two times fo first half. Osimhen dey stet match fo im klub rich 25 November, wen e skore a goal wen dem kari am enta in di 4-2 win ova Lokeren. Afta di game, Osimhen tel BBC Sport sey e don ci happines again. Osimhen finish di first half wit 8 goals in 16 games, sekond onli to Cristian Benavente in di team.

Afta e don du wel wit di Belgian side, E pley 36 games an skore 20 goals, Charleroi anous sey dem wan buy Osimhen bikos e du wel fo dem Wen e dey fo loan.

Lille

In July 2019, Osimhen du kontrat wit Lille OSC. On 11 August 2019, e pley im first match fo dem, e skore two times fo inside 2-1 win against Nantes. 

Na im bi di Lique 1 Playa of di Month fo September 2019, e skore two goals an du two assists inside five leaque matches fo Lille. On 2 June 2020, na Osimhen win Playa of di Season awod, afta plenti fans vote fo Osimhen. 

Osimhen skore im first goal in UEFA Champions League on 2 October 2019, wen e enta inside di 1-2 match wey Chelsea beat dem fo home. E finish as top skorer fo Lille, wit 13 goals fo 25 Ligue1 matches, an 18 goals fom hol competition. Di way wey Osimhen dey pley an skore, mek meni pipul tok sey na im go bi di Afrika Playa of di Year fo future.

Napoli

On 31 July 2020, Seria A klob Napoli anous sey dey don sign Osimhen, fo klob rekod of £70 million wit add-on wey mek di moni dey lik £80 million, wey kon mek am dey insaid playa wey cos pas fo Afrika. 

On 17 October 2020, Osimhen skore im first goal fo Napoli insaid 4-1 win wit Atalanta. Afta wey Osimhen skore e komot im shirt wey dem writ sey mek polis stop di killin of im pipul fo Naijà. 

On 13 November 2020, fo Afrika kop of Nations qualifier game, dem kari Osimhen komot bikos e get injury. Dey go chek am an na shoder injury wey mek am no fit pley fo two months.

Wen e dey rekova fo di injury im klob giv am chans to dey fo im home contri Naija, wey mek am du im birthday fo Naijà. Na wen e dey Naijà dey du im birthday mek pipul bilif sey e tek gat COVID-19 virus, as e test positif wen e rich Naples. Di positif test an di shoder injury mek am no dey pley bol til 29 January 2021, wen dey kari am enta fo 20 minutes fo Napoli's Coppa Italia win wit Spezia.

International Karier
Osimhen na memba of di Nigeria under-17 team wey win di 2015 FIFA U-17 Wod Kop fo Chile. E skore ten goals fo insaid seven games fo di tournament an win di Golden Booth an Silver Bol awods. As e tek pley mek am win di CAF Youth Playa of di Year 2015.

Osimhen first pley fo Naijà on 10 June 2017, insaid di match wey Nigeria beat South Africa 2-0. E no pley fo Nigeria's 2018 FIFA Wod kop bikos e no du Wel fo im klob Wolfsburg. Osimhen du Wel fo di klob wey dey loan am Charleroi, wey mek Gernot Rohr kol am fo November 2018 international break, wey dem stet wit a friendly win wit Uganda.

In Match 2019, dey rilis Osimhen fom di Supa Eagles to join di Naijà U23 side as dey don dey beat dem 2-0 to Libyan. E skore 3 goals fo di ritorn match wit Libyan fo Asaba. 

Osimhen dey insaid Gernot Rohr's 28 man list fo 2019 Afrika kop of Nations in Egypt. Fo di third ples match, Osimhen enta fo Odion Ighalo wey get injury fo half time insaid di team 1-0 win wit Tunisia. E pley fo 45 minutes fo di tournament.

Di Supa Eagles end di 2021 AFCON qualifier Wel, dey beat Losotho 3-0. But, Osimhen miss di Afrika kop of Nations bikos im klob tok sey e get COVID-19.

text:
Yoruba langwej na langwej wey Pipul for West Afrika dey spik espeshial in South-West Naijá.Na Yoruba Pipul dey spik am. Na abaut 45 million of Yoruba pipul dey spik am an na abaut  2 million pipul wey dey no bi yoruba dey spik am.Yoruba langwej na langwej wey get diffren fashion, mentod an way of spikin.Na pipul wey dey Naijá an Benin dey spik am pass bot smol grup in Cöte d'Ivoire, Sierra

Leone an Gambia still dey spik am smol smol.

You go hear Yoruba Language for Afro- Brazilian side wit diffren nem kol Candomblé, for di Karibian side of Santeria  wit Lucumi Langwej.

Tori of di langwej
Yoruba dey amog di Edekiri langwej. Oda langwej qey dey di Edekiri langwej bi Itsekiri an Igala. Yoruba langwej dey amog di Afrika langwej wey Pipul wet no dey Afrika kontinent dey spik pass as ova 47 million of both  Yoruba pipul an meni million wey no bi Yoruba  dey spik am.

Langwej
title: Yoruba Langwej

text:
Igbo langwej na di langwej wey Igbo pipul dey spik.Igbo pipul na traib wey dey stey South-East of Naija.
E get di jeneral Igbo langwej wey dey Tek dey rait an rid wey dey fom in 1972 an na Owerri (Isuama), Anambra (Akwa), Umuahia (Ohuhu) mentod of spikin Igbo dey tek fom am.Ika, Ngwa Ukwuani an Ogba langwej na stil pat of Igbo langwej.

Tori abaut di langwej
Di fest buk wey Igbo word dey inside na "History of the Mission of the Evangelical Brothers in the Caribbean" wey dey poblish in 1777.Wen e rish 1789, Olaudah Equiano wey bi slave bifor rait one buk wey get 79 Igbo words.Na for London inside England dey tek poblish di buk wey get di nem "The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano."Di buk tok about how Igbo life bi as Equiano tek see am wen e dey e vilej Essaka.
Wen Oyinbo (White pipul) kom see how Naija Riva bi for 1854 go rish 1857, Dey kari one Yoruba pastor Ajayi Crowther kom an wit di hep of one young Igbo pesin Simon Jonas wey dey intaprit for dem, dey stat to fom how to rait Igbo langwej down in 1857.
Di langwej kom dey propa to rait wel wel wit di hep of di chorch "Union Ibo Bible (1913).
Di Sentral Igbo wey of spikin Igbo na di one wey kom fom memba of Ezinifite grup of Igbo in Sentral Owerri Aria bitwin di towns of Owerri an Umuahia in Easta Naijá.Wen Dr. Ida.C. Ward mek di sorgeshion in 1939, na di Sentral Igbo misionari, poblisha an raita dey yuz rait.
Anoda wet of spikin Igbo bi Standad Igbo wey bi Igbo wey kombine all di oda mentod of spikin Igbo langwej.
Chinua Achebe no even like as pipul dey du dia best to get just one Standad way of spikin or raitin Igbo for one leshua wey e gif for katolik chorch in Owerri.

Gramma wey dey inside Igbo langwej
Igbo langwej sef get Noun, Pronouns, Numerals, Verbs, Adjectives, conjunctions an  preposition. All dis gramma na pat of spicy as Inglish pipul dey kol am.
Di onli Preposition for Igbo langwej bi "na" an e min plenti an na for di wey dem yuz am go show wetin e min.
See dis ezampul wey Emenanjo (2015) yuz to sho am:"Adjectives" wey dey Igbo langwej no plenti.Infat, Emenanjo (1978, 2015) see onli 8 adjective:
 ukwu wey bi 'big',
 nta wey bi 'smol';
 oji wey bi 'dak',
 ọcha wey bi 'light';
 ọhụrụ wey bi 'niu', ochie wey bi 'old'; 
 ọma wey bi 'gud';
 ọjọọ wey bi 'bad' "Verb" plenti wel wen for Igbo langwej an na verb dey tek fom meni sentens for Igbo langwej.
If pesin dey spik Igbo, di sem word fit min Male, female or tins. For ezampul: '''"Ọ maka" fit bi man, wuman or tin is fine.

Di Vois wey dey tek dey spik Igbo langwej
Igbo langwej na langwej wey bi sey if you no yuz di koret way tok am, e go min diffren tin. For ezampul, 'ákwá "krai", àkwà "bed", àkwá "egg", an ákwà'' "klot".

Aria wey dey spik am pass
Pipul wey Hausa bi dia papa langwej dey Souta Niger an Norta Naija.
For pesin wey dey Norta Naija, Kameroon, Gana wey wan kommuniket or du bizness wit diffren langwej go beta yuz Hausa langwej.Infat to du bizness in West Afrika, ( Benin, Gana, Kameroon, Togo, Chad an pat of Sudan) Hausa bi like bizness langwej.

Difren wey of spikin di langwej
Hausa no too difren as pipul dey spike am, bot pipul wey dey stodi langwej don see sey di wey one aria dey spik am fit difren fom oda aria.

Tradishional way of spikin Hausa
 Pipul wey dey spik Dauranci in Daura, Kananci in Kano, Bausanci in Bauchi, Gudduranci in Katagum Misau, Hadejanci iin Hadejiya an oda pat of Borno dey spik "Easta Hausa".
 Pipul wey dey Spik Sakkwatanci in Sokoto, Kastinanci in Kastina, Arewanci in Gobir, Adar, Kebbi, Zanhwaranci in Zamfara an Kurhwayanci in Kurfey in Niger dey spik "Westa Hausa".
For Kastina, na bot di Westa an Easta Hausa dem dey spik for dia. Na Hausa wey dem dey spik for Sokoto na im dey tek rait Hausa langwej, dat is di risin dem dey kol am klasikal Hausa.
Di Hausa wey pipul dey spik for North na Arewaci (Arewa mins North).Di Hausa wey pipul dey spik for South na Zazzaganci in Zazzau.
Di Standad Hausa wey pipul dey spik  na e bi Daura (Duranchi) an Kano (Kananci) bikos na dis one BBC, Deutsche Welle,  Radio France Internationale an Voice of America dey yuz tok Niuz.
Now adaz, Zazzaganci fom of Hausa na im dey wan dey yuz rait an spik Hausa langwej.

Berom or Birom na one of di popula langwej among Plateau langwej wey pipul dey spik wel wel for Naija. Na dis langwej evri Berom dey spik for vilej aria.Now adaz, meni Berom don dey go stey in Hausa siti. Di smol Cen langwej an Nincut langwej fit bi sepiret an na abaut 1 million pipul dey spik am.
For meni aria in south of Jos Siti in Plateau Stet in Naijá.

Tori of di langwej
Di Berom get link wit di Nok Kolshor, a human sosieti wey don dey bitwin 200BC go rish 1000AD.Di true tori bi sey,di pipul wey dey spik Berom langwej dey Jos Plateau an Kaduna Stet.

Difren mentod of spikin di langwej
Di Berom langwej get difren fom of spikin am. Dey bi:
Gyel–Kuru–Vwang
Du–Foron
Fan–Ropp–Rim–Riyom–Heikpang
Bachit
Gashish
Rahoss-Tahoss

Di sound wey dey komot wen spikin am
Easta Berom langwej get Twenty-four konsonati sound an Berom langwej get Seven vowel sound.

How to rait di langwej
Dis na how to rain Berom langwej:
a, b, c, d, e, ɛ, f, g, gb, h, i, j, k, kp, l, m, n, ng, o, ɔ, p, r, s, sh, t, ts, u, v, w, y, z

Sankie Maimo (1930 – 4 September 2013) na pesin wey dey rait and e kom from British Southern Cameroons.
Maimo move kom Ibadan, for inside Naija, wie e wok as skul ticha.
Na for die e start di journal Cameroon Voice in 1955. Afta, e do one play wey di taitu na I Am Vindicated, e still rait one buk wey di taitu na Adventuring with Jaja.
Im woks dem show say di Africa pipul go need to folo di way wey di Europe pipul dey do tins bifo dia eye go fit open.

text:
Bola Ahmed Adekunle Tinubu na Naija politishan an di presido of Naija. Bola Tinubu na di nomba 16 pesin to bi Naija presido. Tinubu don bi govno of Legos Stet bifor bifor from 1999 go rish 2007. Tinubu don bi Senato for Lagos West for di Third Republic wey no last. Na Bola Tinubu dem chuz for All Progressive Congress as dia kandidet for di 2023 Naija Presido eleshon.
Na for Southwest Naija Tinubu gro bifor e kom go United State (USA) go rid Accounting for Chicago State University . Tinubu kom bak to Naijá araund 1980 an e get wok for Mobil Nigeria as akauntant, bifor e join politis as pesin wey Social Democratic Party pik as dia Lagos West senatorial kandidet.
Afta Sani Abacha tok sey e no wan see Senate again in 1993, Tinubu dey amog di pipul wey fight mek demokrazi kom bak as e join di"National Democracy Coalition movement.Di Tru mata bi sey, Tinubu nid run komot fom Naijá in 1994, e kom bak wen Abacha dai in 1998 an na dis one stat di bigini of Fourth poblik.
For di gofnor eleshion wey dey du for 1999, Tinubu wey bi memba of "Alliance for Democrazy" (AD) win ova di Peoples Democratic Party" (PDP) kandidet Dapo Sarumi an di kandidet of "All People's Party" (APP) Nosirudeen Kekere-Ekun.Afta Four years, Tinubu win di sekond eleshion for di sekond term ova di PDP kandidet Funsho Williams.Di main tori of Tinubu as govno of Legos Stet bi how e wan mek Legos Stet Mega siti an e fight wit Fedira Govament wey PDP kandidet dey kontrol.
Afta wen Tinubu liv ofis, e bi amog di ogas wey fom di politika parti "All Progressive Congress" in 2013.
Pipul dey always get kweshon on Tinubu karia if e get magomago an di tori abaut e life.

Tori abaut e life an skul wey e go
Akordin to di pepa wey dey kot, dey bon Tinubu for March 29, 1952.Tinubu mama na Abibatu Mogaji wet leta bikom di Iyaloja of Legos Stet.Tinubu go St.John's Primary School, Aroloya wey dey Legos an Children Home School in Ibadan. Tinubu travul go abrod wey e go Richard J.Daley College in Chicago den Chicago State University.E get di sartifiket Bachelor of Science (BSc.) in Akauntin.
Pipul no too suo about Tinubu wen dey bon Tinubu, di skul wey e go an e ril nem bikos meni dokument an wetin Tinubu sef dey tok about am no mek am klair at all.
Den sey na anoda famili wey dey Osun State bon Tinubu an sey e ril nem no bi Bola Ahmed Tinubu an sey na lai e dey tok abaut e histri, bot all dis one na dem sey dem sey.
Dis "Dem sey, Dem sey  stat wen Tinubu somit e pepa to INEC (Independent National Electoral Commission) wen e wan go for govno in 1999. Di pepa lai sey Tinubu go Government College Ibadan an di rekod wey dey Chicago State University  tok sey na 1954, no bi 1952 dey bon Tinubu.
Wen dey tell Tinubu mek e tok wetin happun, e sey Tokubo Afikuyomi mek mistek wen e somit e pepa giv pepa giv INEC an sey Chicago State University du mistek wen dem dey rait e age.
Di mata stil kom up wen Tinubu rilis e pepa to INEC in 2022 as e wan go for presidet bikos im no put di e pamari an sekondri skul wey e go dis time araund wen e dey put dem bifor.

How e tek wok an tori abaut e drug mata
Tinubu don wok for di folorin kompini:
 Arthur Andersen
 Deloitte, Haskins & Sells
 GTE Service Corporation
 Mobil Oil: Tinubu join Mobil oil wen e roton to Naijá an e leta bikom one of di ogas wey get mouth for di kompini.

Wen Tinubu dey USA for ovasee, di Govament for ovasee chek Tinubu bank akaunt an tok sey e hand no Klin bikos of di big moni wey dey inside am.Di Govament kom blok di akaunt wey di moni wet rish $460,000 in di year 1993.Di Govament blok di akaunt bikos Tinubu dey hep sel Hard drug for two Chicago dila in di eli 1990s.

How e tek stat politis
Tinubu stat to join politis in 1992 wen e join "Social Democratic party"(SDP). Tinubu na memba of di grup wey Shehu Musa Yar'adua dey kontrol inside SDP parti.Oda politishian wey dey di politika parti na Umaru Yar'adua, Atiku Abubakar, Baba Gana Kingibe, Rabiu Kwankwaso, Abdulahi Aliyu Sumaila, Magaji Abdulahi, Dapo Sarumi an Yomi Edu. Tinubu bikom Senate wey dey repiset Lagos West Constitution bifor di Naijá third ripoblik skata.
Wen dey skata di rosot of June 12, 1993 presidenta eleshion, Tinubu kom join oda politishian fom di parti National Democratic Coalition(NDC). Di grup na pipul wet dey fight mek demokrazi kom bak to Naijá an mek dey mek Moshood Abiola di presidor of Naijá as dey biliv sey na Abiola win di June 12 eleshion.
Abiola run komot fom Naijá wen jeneral Sani Abacha bi presidor in 1994 an kom bak in 1998 afta Abacha don dai.Na dat time di Fourth Nigeria Replubic stat.
Bifor di 1999 eleshion, Bola Tinubu na boi of Abraham Adesanya an Ayo Adebanjo an dey bi di lida of di parti "Alliance for Democrazy" (AD).Tinubu win di pamari eleshion wey di parti du to chuz bitwin Tinubu, Funsho Williams and Wahab Dosunmu wey bi forma minista of woks and hause. Tinubu bikom di Govno of Legos Stet in January 1999 onda di AD parti.

Govno of Lagos State
Tinubu bikom di govno of Legos on May 1999 an e promis sey e go mek 10,000 hause for poor pipul to stey.For di 8 years wey Tinubu yuz as govno, e put moni for edukeshion an giv bak som skul to dia forma owna.Tinubu stat niu road as e plan to mek Legos get propa road bikos of di nomba of pipul in Legos.
Tinubu with e sekond in komad, Femi Pedro win di sekond term eleshon as e enta ofis as govno in April 2003. Na onli Legos State PDP no win for all di State wey dey Saut-West.Wahala dey bitwin den presidor Olusegun Obasanjo of PDP an Tinubu of AD wey Legos Stet sopoz fom adishional lokal govament bikos of how pipul tek plenti inside di Stet.Bikos of di palava, forma presidor Obasanjo no gri giv Legos Stet dia moni wey fediral dey give Stet to giv dia lokal govament.As e time for govno dey kom to end, Tinubu enta meni kuore wit PDP politishian like Adeseye Ogunlewe wey bi forma Legos senator wey bi minista for wok an hause at dat time, an Bode George, hey bi head of PDP for Saut-West.
Di luv wey Tinubu an Femi Pedro get for one anoda stat to wik wen Femi Pedro tok sey e sef wan bikom govno of Legos.Dis one mek Femi Pedro go join anoda parti kol Labour Party (LP) wen e stil bi vais govno. 
Tinubu time as govno of Legos Stet finish on May 29, 2007 wen e liv di posishion for Babatunde Fashola of Action Congres (AC).

E bank akaunt for oyibo kontri palava
For April 2007, afta wey di jeneral eleshion don finish, di fediral govament kari Tinubu go Code of Conduct Bureau sey mek e tok how e tek get 16 difren difren bank akaunt for oyibo kontri.

Lagos moni an e share for Econet
For January 2009, EFCC (Economic and Financial Crimes Commission) tok chek Tinubu, govno of Delta James Ibori, govno of Akwa Ibom Obong Victor Attah weda dey yuz Stet moni, dia pawa as govno tek bai shiar for V-mobile kompini in 2004.
E get one ripot wey som pipul get sey dey wan kill Tinubu on March 2009. Di parti AD ( Alliance for Democrazy) ripot di mata to den inspeto of polis Mike Okiro mek e luk di mata wel wel.
For September 2009, British Polis tok sey dey wan chuk eyes inside how Legos Stet Govament tek bai shiar for Econet ( Airtel for now). Tinubu tok sey no magomago dey am an sey na all di pipul for Legos go gain inside wetin dey du.
Naijá Fediral govament no gri kopuret wit  British Polis to investiget di three forma govno in London kot.

Godfada an hooligan in Legos Stet
Pipul dey tink sey Tinubu na godfada of Lagos wen we tok abaut politis mata for Legos.E get one sho for AIT television wey kari di tori wey di taitu na "The Lion of Bourdilon".Di AIT sho na 2015 Dokumentri wey tok abaut how Tinubu dey kontrol politis an moni wey Legos Stet get.Tinubu kari di produsa of di sho go kot an e tok sey dey most giv am #150 billion for how dat sho tek lai an spoil e nem.Dey kansu di AIT sho on March 6, 2015.
Di kas of Fashola sekod term kwerel wahala wit Tinubu as Tinubu wan mek Muiz Bahire (wey bi forma envarometa komishona) to bi govno instead of Fashola in 2015 fit don mek pipul tink sey e na godfada of Legos Stet. Anoda kwerel bitwin Fashola an Tinubu happun as Tinubu dey kampain for Akinwunmi Ambode an Fashola dey kampain for anoda pesin.Anoda tins wey mek pipul tink sey Tinubu na godfada bi how Akinwunmi Ambode tek komot as govno an how e tek arrenj mek di niu govno Babatunde Sanwo-Olu enta ofis as govno.

Tori abaut Bullion van an eleshon for Lagos
Wen 2019 eleshion dey go on, meni pipul see Bullion van enta di ples wey Tinubu dey liv for Bourdilon road for Ikoyi. Wen dey tel Tinubu mek e tok abaut am e tok sey "I fit put my moni eniwie wey I like" .

Politis
For 2016, Tinubu tok to Atiku Abubakar wen e stil bi vais president sey mek e liv PDP an kom e politikal parti to kampain for presidor of Naijá.Atiku gri to join Tinubu for e parti bot e no chuz Tinubu as e sekond bot go for Ben Obi wet kom come Saut-East as e sekond.Atiku no win di eleshion as PDP win for di eleshion.
Wen Tinubu see sey e parti no win di 2007 presidetal eleshion, Tinubu stat to dey join oda parti togeda so dat all di smol parti gi fit fom one big parti to tek shalej PDP in 2019.
In February 2013, Tinubu don hep mek three smol smol parti join to fom one parti. Di parti bi: Action Congress of Nigeria (ACN), Congress for Progressive Change (CPC), All Nigeria Peoples Party (ANPP) an smol smol pat of All Progressive Grand Alliance (APGA) an niu PDP (nPDP)
Di nem of di niu parti wey dey fom na All Progressive Congress (APC).
In 2014, Tinubu join hand wit forma militri hed of state Jeneral Muhammadu Buhari wey bi lida of CPC parti wey join fom APC.Buhari don kampan to bi presidor for three times bifor in 2003, 2007, 2011.
Tinubu bifor wan bi Buhari vais bot leta chenj e mind an e pik Yemi Osibanjo to bi Buhari vais.Yemi Osibanjo na Tinubu frend an e na forma komishona of jostis.
In 2015, Buhari win di eleshion onda di APC parti an Buhari win end di sixteen years wey PDP din dey kontrol  Naijá.Buhari wey win mek am di fest time wey anoda pesin wey no bi president win presidor of Naijá for Naijá histri.
Tinubu plai meni pat in Buhari Govament, as e sopot meni idiya as pipul dey tok sey e bi like Tinubu sef wan go for presidet too.In 2019, Tinubu sopot Buhari to fit win PDP kandidet Atiku Abubakar.
Wen wahala happun for APC parti, dey remuv Tinubu frend wey also bi APC parti Chairman Adams Oshiomole as Chairman an meni pipul kom dey tok dey na plan mek Tinubu fit no fit kampain to bi Presidor for 2023.

Plan to bi 2023 Naijá Presidor
For January 10, 2022, Tinubu mek Presidet Buhari no sey e get plan to bi di Naijá Presidor for 2023. On June 8, 2022, APC parti tok sey na Tinubu win di pramari eleshion as e get 1,271 winni Vais Presidor Yemi Osibanjo ewu get 235 an Rotimi Amaechi wey get 316.

Pasonal life
Tinubu na muslim.Tinubu wife na Oluremi Tinubu wey bi di Lagos Sentral Senator district senator.Tinubu mama Abibatu Mogaji dai wen mama bi 96 years on June 15, 2013. Tinubu pikin Jide dai in London wen e get hart attak for dia.

Shif taitu
Tinubu na Asiwaju of Legos an di Jagaban of Borgu kingdom in Naija Stet in Naijá.

Abraham Babalola Borishade (7 March 1946 – 26 April 2017) na bifor bifor Naija politician. E bi Federal Minister for Naija for four times from 1999 go rish 2011. Pipul sabi am as Electrical engineer, ticha an political strategist.

How e tek stat life
Borishade attend St. Andrews Primari Skool, Usi Ekiti, and Doherty Memorial Grammar Skool, Ijero Ekiti. For 1971, im graduate from di University of Ife, with First Class Honors in electrical engineering. Afta graduation, Dem employ am as a graduate assistant there.For 1972, Dem giv am Commonwealth Scholarship for a doctorate degree in high-voltage engineering for Victoria University. Im kolet PhD for 1975, and im go bak Obafemi Awolowo University (OAU), where im launch di Electrical Power Systems degree program and di University of Ife Consultancy Unit, both in di Faculty of Technology.

How e tek wok
For 1975, Dem select Borishade to train for di Nuclear and Power Engineering Station for Texas A&M University. Im kolet certificate for Nuclear Power Development. Im still go du more training for di International Atomic Energy Agency, Vienna for 1982. Borishade na registered engineer and a memba of di Institute of Electrical Engineers, United Kingdom.Im bi bifor bifor memba of di Nigerian Society of Engineers, American Nuclear Society, and di Science Association of Nigeria. Im bikom Associate Professor of Electrical Engineering for OAU in 1985.Im serve as a memba of di Technical Advisory Committee of di Regional Centre for Training in Aerospace Survey. Im bi representative of di congregation for di University Senate, and also Chairman of Project Advisory Committee and University Works and Maintenance Service Monitoring Committee.

How e tek du govment wok
For 1988 dem elect Borishade as a Memba of di Constituent Assembly wey go review di 1979 Constitution of di Federal Republic of Nigeria. Im advocate for di creation of di Nigeria Energy Commission and di Environmental Protection Commission wey later create di Federal Environmental Protection Agency (FEPA), a precursor to di present Ministry of Environment.

Sound Sultan (dem bon am as Olarewaju Abdul-Ganiu Fasasi for November 27, 1976 an e kpai for July 11, 2021) na Naija singa, songraita, akto an recording artist. E dey among di pipul wey stat hip hop music for Naija. Pipul sabi am wel wel as e dey yuz im muzik tok abaut poor pipul, bad govment, an bad tins for Naija.

How e tek stat life
For 1991, e dey sing oda artist song for party wey dem dey do inside skul an e dey rait im own song. E dey luk im broda wey bi Baba Dee ezampul. Dis im broda stodi theatre art, an na im tich am hau e go dey du ontop stej. E stat to dey len hau to pley guitar afta e don finish sekondri skul an e dey inside one muzik band for 1999.

How e tek wok
Sound Sultan's wok fo sho biznes in di 1990's, wen e gada moni to tek enta studio.

By 1999, e don win plenti talent sho fo Naijà. E rilis im fest single - Mathematics "Jagbajantis" in 2000, wey pipul sabi wel wel fo Naijà. Sound Sultan stil rilis oda songs wit oda artist, Na Kennis Music sign am.

Onda Kennis Music e rilis four albums,for 2007, im kontrat wit Kennis Music finish e kon go join Baba Dee wey bi im broda stat Naija Ninjas, wey dey du rekod, produs an dem dey du clot sef. Im stat to dey sing as rapper leta e sing R&B, Afrobeat, an Naijà Fuji. E tok sey mek pipul no dey luk artist kain song but mek dem dey hear di messaj wey di artist dey send.

Wen e dey Naijà Ninja, e rilis Back from The future (2011) an sign artist lik Karma Da Rapper, Young GreyC, Shawn(Sean Tizzle) an Blacka.

Naijà Ninja rekod label fest rilis na The Rebirth for 2012 an songs lik Aropin wey pipul sabi wel wel dey insaid som artist like Sean Tizzle, Karma & Sound Sultan folo dey fo di EP.

Sound Sultan an Wyclef Jean fest wok togeda fo di song wey bi Proud to be an African wey Faze an 2 face folo dey fo di song. Wyclef stil folo Sound Sultan du som oda songs lik: King of my Country (2009) an People Bad(2012). 

Fo Insaid 2012 dem annous Sound Sultan nem as UN Ambassador for Peace bikos of im bi gud ezampul for Naijà youth. 

Insaid 2015, wen plenti pipul don dey tok sey where e dey Sound Sultan kon rilis song wey  bi Remember.

Sound Sultan dey Insaid pipul wey stat Continental Basketball Leaque an e get im own team wey bi: Lagos City Stars.

text:
Atiku Abubakar (dem bon am for November 25, 1946) na Naijá politishian an biznessman wey don bi  Vice presidor of Naijá fom 1999 go rish 2007 wen Olusegun Obasanjo bi presidor of Naijá. Atiku na bifor bifor govno of Adamawa Stet in 1990, 1997 an leta 1998 bifor e kom bi vais for Olusegun Obasanjo fom in 1999 an Obaasanjo sekod time in 2003.
Atiku Abubakar wan bi presidor of Naijá for five time sins bot e hand to rish am.Di five time bi: 1993, 2007, 2011, 2015, an 2009.
For 1993, na Atiku Abubakar bi di kandidet of SDP ( Social Democratic Party) wey kontest wit Moshood Abiola an Baba Gana Kingibe.For 2007, Atiku Abubakar bi di AC (Action Congres) wey kari nomba 3 posishion as Umaru Yar'adua for PDP ( People Democratic Party) kari fest an Muhammadu Buhari for ANPP (All Nigeria Peoples Party) wey kari sekod posishion.Atiku join APC in 2014 tinkin sey di parti go chuz am to bi dia presidenshial kandidet for di 2015 eleshion bot na Muhammadu Buhari di parti chuz for di pramari eleshion wet di parti du.In 2017, Atiku go bak to PDP an na im PDP chuz mek e bi dia presidenshial kandidet for di 2019 presidenshial eleshion bot na Presidet Muhammadu Buhari win di eleshion again. In May 2022, di PDP stil chuz Atiku Abubakar as dia pesin wey go bi dia man for di 2023 Naijá presidenshial eleshion.

Tori abaut e life
Na for November 25, 1946 dem bon Atiku Abubakar in Jada.Jada na one vilej wey dey Kamenroom bifor e kom dey onda Naijá teritiri todey.Atiku papa na Fulani trada an e mama nem na Aisha Kande. Dey nem am Atiku bikos dey like di nem as e grapapa nem sef na Atiku Abdulqadir wey kom fom Wurno, Sokoto Stet an muv to Kojoli vilej at Jada, in Adamawa Stet.Atiku grapapa fom e mama side na Inuwa Dutse muv kom Jada, Adamawa Stet fom Dutse in Jigawa Stet. Atiku papa dai inside wota as e wan kross a riva go one vilej wey nia Jada kol Toungo in 1957.

How e tek go skul
Atiku papa no like mek Atiku go skul bikos e no like westa edukeshion.Wen Govament pipul no sey Atiku no go skul wen e stil smol, dey kari e papa go jail an e yuz somtimes dia before Atiku mama pai di fine to rilis Atiku papa.At di age of eight years old, Atiku stat "Jada Primary School" in Adamawa.Wen e finish e pamari skul in 1960, e go "Adamawa Provincial Secondary School" wit oda 59 studet.Atiku finish sekondri skul in 1965 an e get gradi three for e WASSCE (West African Senior School Certificate Examination) wey e du.
Atiku go "Nigeria Police College" wey dey Kaduna bot bikos e no fit produs e ezam wey e tek pass matimatis giv di skul pipul-dem, Atiku komot don di skul.Atiku kom go wok for smol time inside "Tax Office" for Ministri of Finans wey dey dia aria.E kom enta "School of Hygiene" wey dey Kano in 1966.Atiku finish wit Diploma in 1967, na im bi di tempuari Student Union Presidor of di skul.Atiku kom get free edukeshion to rid Diploma in law for "Ahmadu Bello University" wey dia govament giv in 1967.Wen e finish di Diploma korse, in 1969 wey Naijá pipul dey fight diasef, e enta Naijá kostom David day year.
In 2021, Atiku pass an get Masta digri in intanashional rilashion in "Anglia Ruskin University" wet dey Cambridge in United Kingdom.

E pasonal life
Atiku mari four wife an get twenty eight pikin.E tok sey e get meni wife bikos e wan mek di Abubakar famili big as na onli im dey wen e smol an e no wan mek e pikin dem dey fil lonli.
 Wen e mari dem
 In 1971, Atiku sikrit mari one Titilayo Albert for Legos bikos Atiku famili no wan mek e mari Titilayo. Di pikin wey Titilayo bon for Atiku naa: Fatima, Adamu, Halima an Aminu.
 In 1979, Atiku mari Ladi Yakubu as e sekod wife.Di six pikin wey Ladi bon for Atiku na: Anna, Atiku, Zainab, Ummi-Hausa, Maryam an Rukaiyatu.
 In 1983, Atiku mari e nomba 3 wife wey bi Princess Rukaiyatu, di pikin of Lamidi of Adamawa, Aliyu Mustafa.Di pikin wey Rukaiyatu bon for am na: Aisha, Hadiza, Aliyu (nem of e papa), Asmau, Mustafa, Laila an Abdulsalam.
 In 1986, Atiku mari e nomba 4 wife, Fatima Shettima.Di pikin wey Fatima bon for Atiku na: Amina (Meena), Hasfat, Mohammed an di two twins Ahmed/Shehu an Zainab/Aisha.
Atiku no grie mari Ladi again so dat e go rimuv am kom mari Jennifer Iwenjiora Douglas so dat e wife no go pass 4 jos as islam tok am.
On February 1, 2022 wey bi Tuesday, Jennifer Douglas tok sey e no mari Atiku again bikos Jennifer like to stey in United Kingdom an Atiku wan mek e stey Naijá.

How e tek wok
 Kostom
Atiku wok for "Nigeria Custom Service" get promoshion rish di sekod posishion wey big pass for Kustom wey bi "Deputy Director".E ritaya in April 1989 kom enta bizness an politis.
 Bai an sel of land propati
Atiku get loan of 31,000 Naira to build e fest haus for Yola an den rent di haus.Di moni wey e get for di rent e yuz am build e sekod Haus.Na so Atiku dey du am smol smol onti e propati kom plenti for Yola.
 Farmin
In 1981, Atiku enta farmin bizness.E kolet 2,500 hekass  of land an stat to grow maize an kottin.Atiku tok sey di farmin bizness mek am loss moni dat time wey e stat am.
  Bai an sel of fud
Atiku also stat to dey Bai an sel rice, flawa an sugar bot wit big motor e dey yuz bai an sel dem.
 "Transpotashion"
Wen Atiku stil bi Kustom ofisa at Apapa Ports, one Italian pesin wey e nem na Gabrielle Volpi kol am mek e set up NICOTES (Nigeria Container Services). NICOTES kompini na abaut how goods for Apapa go dey move from Apapa port.NICOTES kom leta bi "Intel Nigeria Limited" an na dis one giv Atiku big moni. Atiku dey amog pipul wey fom Intel Nigeria Limited, one oil sarves kompini wey dey Naijá an Ovasee.Atiku stil get oda bizness in Yola, Adamawa wey inklud "Adams Beverages Limited", anoda anima fid kompini an "American University of Nigeria (AUN).Di univasiti na di fest Amerika univasiti to dey Sub-Sahara Afrika.

Wahala as e enta bizness
Kompain dey always folo Atiku as e dey wok for govament an stil get e pravat bizness. Atiku tok sey no bi im dey kontrol di kompini sey na Shares e Jos bai in di kompini.Atiku leta chenj di nem of di kompini NICOTES to INTEL an akusashion dey always folo am sey e dey yuz di kompini du deyti bizness fom U.S. govament wen e bi vais presidor.
How e tek stat politics
Atiku stat to du politis wen e sopot Bamanga Tukur to kampain as Tukur wan bi Govno in di eli 1980s.Tukur dat time na Manijin Dareto of NPA.(Nigeria Port Authority).Atiku hep kampain an giv moni so dat Tukur go fit enta as govno.
Wen e don dey rish di time for im to ritaya, Atiku mit Jeneral Shehu Musa Yar'adua wey bi Sekod-in-komad shif of staff, Suprim hedkuorta bitwin 1976 an 1979. Na Yar'adua mek am dey kom e haus to join politis mitin wey dey happun for Yar'adua haus wey dey Legos.Na di mitin mek dem fom "The People Front of Nigeria".Politishian wey dey dia na: Umaru Musa Yar'adua, Baba Gana Kingibe, Bola Tinubu, Sabo Bakin Zuwo, Rabiu Kwankwaso, Abdullahi Aliyu Sumaila an Abubakar Koko.
In 1989, dey vote Atiku as di Nashional Vais-Chairman of di "The People's Front of Nigeria"'' as di third Nigeria Reploblik wan dey stat.

text:
Timi Dakolo na Naijà singa, song raita an muzik Produsa. Na im win Idols West Afrika Insaid 2007. Som tins wey folo di win na rekod label wit Sony BMG.

Hau e tek stat life an im wok
Na fo Accra, Ghana dem bon Timi Dakolo to Naijà man, wey kom fom Bayelsa an im mama na fom Ghana. Timi Dakolo mama, Norah Kimmy Head, die Wen e dey smol. Na Ghana dem bon am but na im mama an aunti fo Portharcourt, e sta wel wel. Im tok say na im aunti Susan Larry, fest dey tich am hau to sing. 

Timi stat to dey sing wen e dey twelve years. Insaid 2013, e join Purple Love wey bi music grup. Plenti pipul sabi di grup fo Portharcourt, but di grup kon skata as all memba go University of Port Harcourt. Timi Dakolo win lokal competition wey bi G.E FACTO, wey dem du fo Port Harcourt.

Hau e tek win Idols West Afrika
Insaid 2006, Timi Dakolo go for Idols West Afrika in Calabar, Cross River Stat of Naijà. Timi sing Lemar's Time to grow song fo dia. Di pipul wey dey giv mark lik di way wey e sing Wel wel, wey mek dem tok say e fit win am.

Wen di Idols West Afrika dey go, Timi Dakolo no dey fo di las 3 wey fit komot. Insaid all di week wey dem tek du di sho na Timi vote dey plenti Pas. 

Na wen e dey di competition im mama die, but e stil kountiniu wit di sho.Bifor Timi go fo Idols West Afrika e don dey go Skol fo University of Port Harcourt.

Afta Idols
Afta Timi don win Idol West Afrika 2007, fo January 1, 2008, New year day, dem shot am fo Presidential Hotel wey dey Port Harcourt. E go do chorch tins fo di hotel wit im frends. No bi Dakolo dem won shot bullet jus touch am. One Gate man die fo di plez, Timi no die but e get wound for bodi, dem kari am go hospital an e kom bak dat day.

Timi rilis im fest three songs insaid 2009.

Fo 2011, Timi rilis anoda song wey bi There's a Cry. Na for Naijà dem du di musik video. Na Lone Rekord/Now Muzik im sign for.

Timi Dakolo dey Insaid dey pipul wey dey giv vote fo Di Voice Nigeria.

Timi Dakolo rilis Christmas album wey e kol "Merry Christmas, Darling" wit artist lik Emeli Sandé an Kenny G Insaid November 2019.

Im pasonal lif
Timi Dakolo mari Busola Dakolo (nèe Amupitan) fo 2012. Dey get three pikin.
