Yoruba pipul na one West Afrika grup of pipul dat stey in Naijá, Benin an Togo. Di nem of di aria wey Yoruba pipul dey stey na "Yorubaland".Di nomba of Yoruba pipul for Afrika pass 48 million. Outside Afrika, Yoruba pipul pass som hundred thousand.Na Naijá you fit see mejoriti of Yoruba pipul. In Naijá populashion, Yoruba pipul mek up to 21 paset akordin to CIA kalkulashion.Yoruba pipul dey amog one of di traib wey meni pass for Afrika.Na almost all yoruba pipul dey spik di Yoruba langwej.
For Afrika, Yoruba pipul get bandiri wit Itsekiri to di Saut-East in di North-West of Niger Delta.Yoruba pipul get bandiri with Bariba to di North-West in Benin an Naijá.Dey also get bandiri wit Nupe to di North an get bandiri wit di Ebira to di North-East in sentral Naijá.For di east, Yoruba pipul get bandiri wit Edo, Esan an di Afemai grup in mid-westa Naijá.To di Southwest, Yoruba pupil get bandiri wit "Gbe" spikin pupil , Mahi, Gun, Fon, an Ewe who dey Benin an Togo.

Orijin of di wod yoruba
Di fest time wey we wan see di wod yoruba for buk na one buk wey get di taitu  "Mi'raj al-Ṣu'ūd" wey Ahmed Baba rait in di year 1614.
As di wod yoruba dey di buk, e sho sey di wod dey popula sins 1500s.
E neva rili klair di pesin wey fom an di minin of di wod Yoruba as meni pipul wet dey stodi pipul giv diffren rison to am. For ezampul:
 Yarub (Son of Canaanite, Joktan) by Mohammed Bello

 Yolla Ba.
For one buk wey Richard F.Burton rait about Yoruba in 1861.E tok na fom di wod Ori Obba dey tek fom di wod Yoruba. Ori Obba minin for yoruba langwej na Head King.Di wod Ori Obba don dey wey pipul don dey tok an rait am sins 1500s.

text:
Quavious Keyate Marshall (bon April 2, 1991), wey pipul sabi wel wel as Quavo, na Amerika singa, song raita, an rekod Produsa. Im dey Insaid pipul wey stat di song grup Migos. Quavo na Takeoff an Offset famili, all of dem dey insaid di Migos grup. 

Quavo don folo artist wey dia song don dey top ten Billboard Hot 100 sing songs, wit artist lik DJ Khalid "I'm the one an "No Brainer", Post Malone Congratulations. Insaid 2018 e rilis album wey bi Quavo Huncho wey dey nomba 2 fo Billboard 200.

Hau e tek stat life
Dem bon Quavious Keyate Marshall on April 2, 1991, fo Atens, Georgia. Three memba for Migos grup gro up togeda wit am for Gwinnett County, wey dey Atlanta, Georgia. 

Na Berkmar High School e go and e pley for di football team. Quavo get gud rekod for di skol team, wen e pley di skol team dey 1-9 for 2009 season. Quavo no finish skol for Berker.

Im wok
Quavo, Takeoff an Offset stat Migos insaid year 2008. All di three pipul wey stat di grup bi famili an na Quavo mama ples dem live. Pipul fest sabi di grup nem as Polo club wey kom fom Lawrenceville, Georgia. On August 25 2011, di grup rilis dia fest wok wey dem kol am Juug Season. Dem du anoda wok wey dem kol am No Label, fo June 1, 2012. Plenti pipul kon sabi di group wok wel wel wen dey du "Versace" song insaid 2013. Quavo fest onli song bi "Champions" wey get difren oda artist insaid, di song rich 71 fo Billboard Hot 100.

Afta Migos sekond album wet bi "Culture" sel Wel wel, wey mek am dey nomba one for US Billboard 200, plenti artist kon dey kol am for dia songs, som of di songs na "Congratulations", "I'm the one", "Portland" an "No Brainer". 

Insaid April 2017, Quavo folo for The fate of di Furious: Di album wey dey di song "Go Off". Na December 14, 2017 e rilis "Ice Tray" wit Lil Yachty. Di song dey nomba 74 for Billboard Hot 100. 

Na December 21, 2017, Quavo anous say im go rilis Huncho Jack, Jack Huncho wit Travis Scott on December 22, 2017. Di album get 8 songs wey dey for Billboard Hot 100. 

On January 26, 2018, Migos rilis Culture II , Quavo rilis three songs insaid im album, "Working me", "Lamp talk" an "Bubble Gum", "Working Me" rich nomba 52 for Billboard Hot 100. 

For May 18, 2019, Quavo do sho wit Madonna for di final of di Eurovision Song Contest 2019.

Im pasonal life
On April 18, 2015, polis stop Migos sho bikos dem took say all three membas for di grup get gun an dem dey yuz wetin govment don band. Dem kari am go jail kon leta rilis am wen dey leta ci say e no du am. 

Quavo kolet MVP awod for di 2018 NBA All Stars game. 

Quavo an Sweetie dey togeda for 2018. Sweetie kon leta tok say dey don dey togeda na for March 19, 2021 Shi tok am. Sweetie tok say dem no dey togeda bikos Quavo dey folo anoda woman.

Quavo na one of di pipul wey get FCF Glacier Boyz, wet bi team fo Fan control futbol Leaque.

text:
Kevin Akpoguma(dem bon am fo 19 April 1995) na pesin wey dey pla ball fo bak fo 1899 Hoffenheim wey dey Bundesliga. Dem bon am fo Germany and im bin dey pla fo Germany wen im stil smal but e later kom dey pla fo Naija.

Im klob Caria
Fo 2016-2017 im bin pla fo Fortuna Düsseldorf wey dey 2 Bundesliga. Fo 21 April 2017, wen di sisin don dey end im and Bernd Nehrig wey dey pla fo FC St. Pauli jam as dem dey pla togeda and im kom brake im nek.

Im fest show fo di next sisin fo 22 Oktoba 2017 an im komot Stefan Poch fo haf taim. Dem lata draw di mach wit 1899 Hoffenheim 1 - 1 Vfl Wolfsburg. Afta 4 dais, im stat mach wey dem lose Werder Bremen 1 - 0 1899 Hoffenheim.

Im intanashonal Caria
Im mama na German wuman an im papa na Naija man. Bicus of dis wan im fit pla fo Germany or Naija. Im don pla fo Germany wen im neva old fo di U16, U17, U18, U19, U20 and U21 tim dem.

Na im bin captain fo di German U-20 tim an dem enta quatafinal fo di 2015 FIFA U-20 World cup wey dem do fo New Zealand.

Fo Oktoba 2018, im talk sa im fit pla fo Naija.

Fo 21 Septemba 2020, Naija coch Gernat Rohr tok sey Akpoguma don tok sey im go pla fo di Naija nashonal tim.

Fo 28 Septemba 2020, im tok am sey im go pla fo di Naija nashonal tim. Fo 9 Oktoba 2020 im pla fo Naija fo di fest taim fo wan frendli wey Algeria bit dem 1 - 0.

text:
Hausa pipul na di etnik grup wey plenti pass in West an Sentral Afrika. Hausa pipul dey spik di Hausa langwej an Hausa langwej na im bi di sekod langwej afta Arabic wey pipul dey spik pass for Westa Asia, North Afrika an pat of Sahara/Sahel. Hausa pipul difren bot dey get di sem Kolshor an you fit see dem for Niger an Norta Naijá. Hausa pipul go rish 54 million an you fit also find dem in Benin, Kameroon, Ivory Coast, Chad, Sudan, Central Africa Republic, Republic of Congo, Togo, Ghana, Eritrea, Equitorial Guinea, Gabon, Senegal an Gambia.
Hausa spikin komuniti skata for all di West Afrika an di Sahara an you go see plenti of dem in di town kol "Agadez".Som Hausa pipul don muv to Siti like Legos, Port Harcourt, Accra, Abidjan, Banjul an Kotonu an pat of North Afrika like Libya ova di last 500 years.Di Hausa pipul dey live for smol vilej as wel old town an siti wie dey plant krop an raise Animal.Som Hausa stil dey bai an sel in lokal an long distans akros Afrika.
Hausa pipul like to dey yuz horse to dey waka an pipul for Hausa wey get moni dey travul on horse.Wen Hausa pipul wan du selibeshion like Eid day or Ranar Sallah (Inglish Day of Parsya), Dem dey yuz horse sho dat day.
Dauda Siti na di korshoral sentar for all Hausa pipul bikos na di town old pass in tradishion an kursho amog all Hausa vilej or town.

Populashon
Ova di 500 years wen don pass, Hausa pipul don waka di hol Afrika for risin like Militri savis, to Bai an sel, to find fud to chop, to go Mecca, to run for proteshion or to tok abaut Islam.

Histri of Hausa pipul
Na Daura, wey dey Norta Naijá bi di oldest Siti for Hausaland.Di Hausa pipul wey dey Gobir for Norta Naijá dey spike di oldest Hausa.Na Kastina fest get nomba of Hausa wey go skul pass bifor Sokoto kom pass am bikos of wetin Usman Fodio du wen e dey arenj how Islam go bi like.
Di wey Hausa pupil dey du tins wan resembu oda etnik grup like di Fula, di Zarma an Songhai (in Tillabery, Tahoua an Dosso in Niger); di Kanuri an Shuwa Arabs (in Chad, Sudan an North-East Naijá); di Tuareg ( in Agadez, Maradi an Zinder); di Gur an Gonna (in North-Easta Ghana, Burkina Faso, Norta Togo an orpa Benin); di Gwari (in Sentral Naijá); an di Mandinka, Bambara, Dioula an Soninke (in Mali, Senegal, Gambia, Ivory Coast an Guinea)

Difren difren grup wey mek Hausa pipul
Hausa pipul bi di "Kasar Hausa" wey dey stey in West Africa. Hausa pipul dey klass demsef into three grup: Habe, Hausa-Fulani an Banza or Banza 7.
 Habe bi di pure Hausa pipul. Dey bi Gobirawa, Kabawa, Rumawa, Adarawa, Maouri an odas. Di Habe dey rul an kontrol di Hausa kingdom Buford Danfodio fight (Jihad) of 1804.
 Hausa-Fulani or Kado bi di Hausa an Fulani orijin. Dem dey spik one kind Hausa as dia papa langwej.Akordin to histri of Hausa orijin, na di Fulani wey kom liv for Hausa land in di 15th sentuari an leta in di biginin of 19th sentuari dorin Usman Danfodio kwerel against di Hausa kindom wey lid to Sokoto kalifat.( Sokoto kindom). Di grup wey mek up Hausa-Fulani bi Jobawa, Dambazawa, Mudubawa, Mallawa, an Sullubawa traib wey dey kom fom "Futa Toro".
 Banza or Banza 7 bi di Hausa grup wey old pass amog di Hausa grup bot di Hausa wey dey spik no dey again.Pipul no tu no tins about Banza pipul like dat.Di grup wey mek up Banza grup bi Ajawa, Gere, Bankal an odas.

Rilijion
Islam rilijion don dey Hausa land sins 11th sentuari an meni pipul wey sabi Islam don kom prish in Kastina like Wali Muhammad dan Masani (e dai 1667) an Wali Muhammad dan Marma (e dai 1655)
title: Hausa pipul

text:
Dr. Doyin Abiola, Doyinsola Hamidat Abiola (e papa nem na Aboaba) na e bi di forma manija for National Concord Newspaper.Dr Doyin Abiola bi di fest Naija wuman wey bi edito for Nigerian Daily Newspaper.

How e tek go skul an wok
Na Univasiti of Ibadan Dr. Doyin Abiola kolet ha digri for English and Drama for 1969.Afta wey e finish yunifasiti, e stat to dey rait for "Daily Sketch Newpaper" in 1969.Dorin dat time, Dr Doyin stat to rait inside one niuz pepa kol Tiro an di niuz pepa dey tok abaut ewspapa wey dey tok man an wuman mata. Fo 1970, shi komot Daily Sketch Newspaper an shi travul go United States to go do ha mastas fo Journalism. Wen shi kom bak shi si wok as Features Writer fo Daily Times smal taim dem giv ha Group Features Editor. Shi lata go New York Univasiti to go do ha PhD fo Communications and Political Science fo 1979. Afta dat wan she go bak Daily Times an dem cari am go Editorial Board, na fo dia shi wok wit oda beta edito wey sabi wok wel wel laik Stanley Macebuh, Dele Giwa an Amma Ogan.

text: Eastern Obolo (or Obolo agan̄ Mbum-ura for dem natif Obolo langwej) ma one Local Gorment Area (LGA) for southern Naija. En headquarters dey for Okoroete. The place dey for Akwa Ibom State, and na local gorment wey dey near oshen. Na on 4th December, 1996 wey Federal Gorment of Naija tok sai mek Eastern Obolo no dey share gorment with Ikot Abasi LGA again; mek en stand by en self. Na so dem take give am en own local gorment. People wey live there plenty pass 30,000, and de area big reach 17,000 km². En get 16 villages, wey dem divided into two clans, wey bi Okoroete and Iko. En get ten political wards. All di villages wey dey Eastern Obolo na of di Obolo ethnic group, and dem get common ancestral lineage wey dey make dem live together peacefully.
title: Eastern Obolo

text:
Obolo lanwej (wey some pipul stil de kol am Andoni lanwej ) na one of di Lower Cross lanwej. Dem dey spik am for Eastern Obolo LGA wey dey Akwa Ibom State an for Andoni LGA wey dey Rivers State for Naija. Some Obolo pipul wey don komot go Ibeno LGA dey spik am plenti for dat side also. For all di lanwej wey dey inside di group of Lower Cross langwej-dem, na Obolo langwej dey difren pas all di oda langwej.

Some tins wey dey abaut di langwej

 For all di 530 langwej wey dey Naija, na Obolo langwej bi nomba 23 lanwej wey get ful Bible. Dem fes poblish di niu testament for 1991, den kom poblish di ful one for 2012.

 Obolo Katolik Bible na im bi di fes for Naija wey dem arenj di way dem tek du Jerusalem Bible.

 Di langwej get novel, Mbuban Îchaka, wey bi di fes of e kind for Eastern Naija Delta. Dem poblish am for 2010.

text:
University of Ibadan (UI) na poblik yunivasiti wey dey Ibadan for Naija. Na for 1948 de fom am as University College Ibadan way bi one of di skul wey dey onda University of London. Di yunivasiti komot onda University of London  for 1962.University of Ibadan bi di yunivasiti wey old pas wey dey giv digri satifiket for Naija.Bikos of meni studet wey don pass out for di Univasiti, di Univasiti don hep for politis, indostrie, ekonomis an kulshora divelopment in Naija.Di histri an di wok wey di skul don du mek am get levul as one of di fine Univasiti in Afrika.
Di univasiti of Ibadan get 92 depatment inside 17 fakulti wey bi Arts, Science, Basic Medical Science, Clinical Science, Agriculture, Social Science, Education,  Veterinary Medicine, Pharmacy, Technology, Law, Public Health, Dentistry, Economic and Management Science, Renewable Natural Resources, Environmental Design and Management, and Multidisciplinary Studies.

text:
Lagos State University wey pipul stil sabi as LASU dey Ojo, one town for Legos Stet for Naija. Na for 1983 dey stat di yunivasiti. Di motto of di skul na: For Truth and Service. Di yunivasiti get ova 35,000 student. Na wen Lateef Jakande bi govno of Legos Stet dey fom di yunivasiti. Di yunivasiti dey giv Diploma, digri an post graduate satifiket inkludin MBA program. For di ranking wey Times Higher Education World Rankings du for 2020, LASU dey amog di best top 600 yunivasiti for di wold. For 23 June 2021, di yunivasiti kari fest for di best yunivasiti wey dia age neva rish 50 years for Naija. For 2 September 2020, Time Higher Education rank Lagos State University as di sekond best yunivasiti for Naija an na di onli Stet yunivasiti wey dey di rankin .Meni intanashonal bodi don giv LASU moni inkludin to fom a World Bank Group Africa Centre for Excellence on Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics

Histri
Di yunivasiti fest stat as plenti plenti kampos an  skul wey student go dey kom fom house. LASU get four kampos wey dey Ojo (wie di skul dey), Epe (wie di Fakulti of Enjiniarin an skul of Agrikolsho dey), Ikeja (wie di kolej of medisin for LASUTH dey).
Na 3 fakulti dey tek stat bdi skul: Commerce and Business Administration, Law an Medicine. Dey leta chenj Commerce and Business Administration to Faculty of Business and Social Studies.Na leta leta dey kom join Falkuti of Art, Education, Engineering an Science .

Epe Kampus
Di Epe kampus dey North side of Lekki Lagoon an na Epe kampus di Falkuti of Enjiniarin an skul of Agrikolshor dey.Studet dey stey di kampus an dey kret Epe kampus bikos Ojo kampus no fit kontain Falkuti of Enjiniarin.Na Armi barak dey wen Epe kampus dey now an dey chenj di barak to kampus dorin Olusegun Obasanjo rijin wen e bi presidor of Naija.Na Epe kampus studet wey dey du pre-digri an Diploma korse dey go.Na Epe kampus big pass for all di Kampus wey Lagos State University get.

Jeneral nolej of di kolej
Na for 1947 dey fom di kolej so dat e go riplas "Yaba Higher College".Di kolej stat to get pawa to kontrol wetin dey hapun inside di kolej in 1969 by one Decree 23 wey tok sey di kolej fit du full-time an part-time korse for trainin an instrushion in Tekinoloji, Sayensi, komas an manejiment, Agrikolshor an risach.
Na YABATECH bi di fest hiya institushion to get Centre of Entrepreneurship Development so day studet go get sense of how wok and indostrie de.YABATECT stil get Quality Assurance Unit to monitor di kind of akademi sarvis wey di skul dey diliva.Di skul stil get The Applied Research and Technology Unit (ARTI) to promot risach an hep pravate sektor organisashion so dat dey go fit gain fom risach wey pipul dey du.
Di skul get free Medical sarvis wey dey opun 24/7. Di skul get sport arena wet dey di Sentral of di skul Kampus an di kolej don win The Nigeria Polytechnic Game five inside di 16 times wey dey du di kompetishion.

Dey chenj di nem bikos of one forma Ogun Stet govno wey bi Olabisi Onabanjo for di tins wey e du to mek di skul dey Ogun Stet.

University of Abujana yunivasiti wey dey Abuja di kapita of Naija. Na for January 1988 dey form di skul (onda decree No 110 of 1992 amended). Di risin dey form di skul na to tich student wey kom di yunivasiti kampos or di student wey dey online di tins wey oda skul sef dey tich. Dem stat to tich for di yunivasiti for 1990 wit di fest grup of student wey stat di skul.

Tori abaut di skul
Di yunivasiti stat for one tempoari land wey dey fest wan yuz for pamari skul for Gwagwalada. Di nem wey dey giv dat tempoari land na 'mini- kampos'. Na for di mini kampos de fest stat to dey tich for 1990 afta wey di yunivasiti kom pak go di big land wey kova 11,800 acres wey dey di road wey go Abuja City Airport.
Di yunivasiti of Abuja main kampos get three wuman hostel an two bois hostel an na plenti student dey liv dia. Di ofis of distant learning dey for Abuja aria (Area 3 Garki).

Akademi
University of Abuja dey du Diploma, Under Graduate an Post Graduate course an Central for Distance Learning.

Akorede Babatunde Okunola (dem bon am for 7 August 1969) wey plenti pipul sabi for im wok as Saheed Osupa abi King Saheed Osupa (K.S.O), na Naija fuji singa, fim akto, an song raita.

How e tek stat life
Dem born Saheed Osupa for insaid Mafoluku fo Ajegunle, Lagos State an na Ibadan, Oyo Stet e tek gro. Saheed papa wey e nem na Moshood Ajiwere Layeye dey du muzik sef an na Ayinde Barrister famili e bi.

Skul wey e go
Amuwo Odofin High School wey dey Legos, na im e go. E kon go du im National Diploma for The Polytechnic,Ibadan. Saheed osupa kon stil go America International college.

Im wok
Fuji Music

Saheed Osupa stat to dey sing fuji insaid 1983. Im fest album na Fuji Fa Disco, e kon du Fuji Blues. E don du pas 40 albums. Insaid 2018, Ayinde Barrister give Saheed Osupa "King of Fuji".

Hip Hop Music

Saheed Osupa du difren Hip hop music lik Non stop wey e rilis on 12 June 2008. Na 20 December 2014, e rilis "Vanakula". On 13 April 2015, e rilis Africa Beauty wey K-Solo produs. For 8 August 2015, e rilis "Womi" wey Seriki dey insaid.

Na 7 November 2015, Saheed Osupa nem dey insaid The Net as artist wey don dey du Wel Wel fo music. 

Fims

Saheed Osupa don sho for yoruba pas 30 times insaid yoruba Fims.

Saheed Osupa an Alabi Pasuma quorell
Saheed osupa an Alabi Pasuma get plenti quorell. Di one wey pipul sabi pas na di 1998/1999 own, an di quorell of 2007.  One of di tins wey stat quorell na wen Saheed osupa an Kwam1 get quorell, Pasuma kon dey sopot Kwam1. Osupa rilis 10 rekods bikos of di quorell an all of dem sel Wel Wel, wey kon mek plenti pipul tok say na im win.

University of Ilorin wey pipul sabi as Unilorin na fediral govament yunifasiti wey dey Ilorin, Kwara Stet inside Naija.Na for August 1975 dey kret di skul wit a dikri of di fediral militri govament.Dey fom di skul so dat  meni Naija populashion wey get plan to go yunifasiti go fit go an sey di skul go train Naija studet so dat dey go fit hep wok for ekonomi of di kontri to beta.
Wit all di hiya institushion wey dey Naija, na Unilorin big pass bikos e land na 15,000 akas of land. For 2021, JAMB tok sey na Unilorin pipul like to go pass.

Tori abaut di skul
Di yunifasiti fest stat as smol pat as Yunifasiti kolej wey dey pat of University of Ibadan.Dr T.N Tamuno wey bi professor an hed of Histri Dipatment for University of Ibadan bi di fest prisipal of di kolej in September 1975. Wen December 1975 rush, Dr Tamuro don bi di Vais- Shansellor for di yunifasiti of Ibadan. Bikos of dis one, dey kom chenj di prisipal of di kolej to Professor O.O. Akinkugbe in 1975.Akinkugbe bi di hed of Falkoti of Medisin, yunifasiti of Ibadan bifor e go di kolej.Akinkugbe find hep go di sekond Militri govno of Kwara Stet, di late Korne Ibrahim Taiwo so day di govno go fit sopot di skul to stand wel wel.Akinkugbe stil find hep go di nomba 3 Miliri govno of di Stet, Brigediya George Agbazika Innih wey komot land fom di land of Kwara State College of Technology giv di Yunifasiti. For October 1977, di yunifasiti kom fit stand wel wel an Professor O.O.Akinkugbe kom bi dia fest Vais-Shansellor.
Na onli 200 studet stat di skul on 23 October 1976 as dey pass di entrans ezam an tishin stat on 25 October 1976. Na onli 3 falkoti di yunifasiti tek stat wok: Falkoti of Art, Falkoti of Sayens an Falkoti of Edukeshion.Wen dey stat na for tempoari Kwara State Polytechnic  kampos dey fest dey yuz an dey kol di kampos mini-kampos.Na di mini-kampos all di tishin Program of Falkoti of Art, Sayens, Edukeshwon, Enjiniarin an Tekinoloji, Biziness an Soshial Sayens an Bezik Klinika Sayens seshion of di Health Sayens Falkoti.
Na dis mini-kampos dem dey yuz ontil January 1982 wen dem kari ova 1000 Sayens studet go di pamanet site. In 1982, dem don finish di niu falkoti blok an ples for Nashoral Sayens an Enjiniarin site. In 1983, dey stat di law programs onda di falkoti of Bizness an Soshial Sayens. In 1993, di law Dipatment kom get e own ples too.

Micheal Collins Ajereh  (born 26 November 1982), wey meni pipul sabi am as Don Jazzy, na rekod Produsa. Na im get Mavin Records. E dey insaid pipul wey stat Mo' Hints rekods wit D'bang.

Hau e tek stat life an Skol
Na for Umuahia, Abia State dem born Don Jazzy, im papa na Collins Enebeli Ajereh an im mama na Mrs Ajereh. Don Jazzy papa na fom Isoko wey dey Delta State an im mama na fom king famili for Abia State. 

Na for Ajegunle, Legos e gro up. Don Jazzy go co- educational high school, Federal Government College Lagos. Don Jazzy don lik musik fom smol, wen e dey 12 years e don sabi pley piano an guitar. Don Jazzy kon stil go Ambrose Ali University, Ekpoma, Edo State  go stodi business management.

For year 2000, Don Jazzy uncle hep am go London to go pley guitar for one London chorch. Don Jazzy wok for MacDonald wey dey for London. Don Jazzy stil dey du musik for London wit Solek, JJC Skillz, Kas, Jesse Jagz, 419 Squad an D'Banj. For March 2012, Don Jazzy an D'banj tok sey dem no dey togeda again.

Hau e tek wok
Mo'Hits Rekods an GOOD music

Na year 2004 Don Jazzy an D'banj stat Mo'Hits Rekods. Afta 2 years dey kon stat di rekods, Don Jazzy produs No long thing an Rundown/Funk You up album. 

Insaid 2008, Don jazzy produs The Entertainer wey D' Banj sing. Na im hep Wande Coal produs hol di Mushin 2 Mo'Hits album.

Insaid 2011 Don Jazzy folo Kanye West wok fo Very Good Music. Don Jazzy an Kanye West wok togeda produs Lift Off, wey Beyonce sef dey insaid di song. 

Marvin Rekods

Na May 7 2012, Don Jazzy anous sey e don get new rekod label wey bi:Mavin Records.  For May 8, 2012 Don Jazzy rilis album wey hol artists wey dey for di niu Marvin Rekods dey insaid. Mavin rekods sign Tiwa Savage wey pipul sabi wel wel.

For 5 November 2013, Ajereh an Wande Coal no gree fo diaself, wey mek Wande Coal leta komot for Mavin Rekods.

Insaid September 2014, Ajereh produs for Reekado an D'ija, Di song nem na "Arise".

For Headies Award 2015, Don Jazzy an Olamide no gree on top who win di Headies Next Rated awod. Olamide tok say na Lil Kesh sopos win am but dem giv Rekaado. 

Insaid 2019, Don Jazzy sign Rema an for 2020 e kon sign Ayra Starr for Mavin Rekods. Insaid 2021 Don Jazzy anous niu artist wey bi Magixx.

Insaid 2011, Don Jazzy dey insaid Moses Inwang's Nollywood fim The 3 Digits.

Ekiti State University Ado Ekiti wey dey fom as Obafemi Awolowo University Ado-Ekiti in 1982 wen Shif Michael Adeknle Ajasin bi di fest sivilan govno of Ondo Stet.Di yunivasiti bi pat of Association of Commonwealth Universities.Pesin go si di skul afta pesin don drive 12 minit komot fom di sentra of Ado-Ekiti siti for Ekiti Stet in Naija.
Ekiti State University Ado-Ekiti bi di onli yunivasiti in Naija wey don chenj nem four times for witdin 25 years wen dey kret am. Dey chenj di nem to "Ondo State University" in 1985, "University of Ado Ekiti" in September 2011.In 2021, Ekiti State University bi nomba 3 best yunivasiti in Naija akordin to webometrics.

Tori abaut di skul
Kreashion
For 14 January 1981, Shif Adekunle Ajasin wit di hep of di sivilian govament of Ondo Stet tok sey dey go like get molti-kampos yunivasiti for di Stet an dey arenj 16- memba kommittee for di projet. Na dis one mek dey fom di skul in March 1982 wit di nem Obafemi Awolowo University, Ado Ekiti an pik Prof I.O. Oladapo as di fest Vais- Shansellor an di fomin of di fest kausul wey Shif B.A Ajayi bi di Chairman on 28 March 1982.
Na for one old fud rest house di skul tek stat in Akure an e kom move to tempoari site in Ado-Ekiti an na dia klass stat with 136 studet wey dey three falkoti wey bi Falkoti of Aarts, Science an Social Science. For di 1983/1984 kalenda, dey add som korse like Geology, Biology, Chemistry, French, Yoruba Studies, Philosophy, Religion Studies, Political Studies an Psychology. In 1983/84 kalenda, dey add di Falkoti of Education an dis inkris di studet nomba to 724.In 1985/86 kalenda, dey add falkoti of Engineering ( Civil, Mechanical an Electrical) an Dipatment of Banking and Finance. Di falkoti of law na im dey add for 1991/92 kalenda an in 2001 dey add falkoti of Agrikolshoral Science mekin all di studet nomba bi 10,000 in 8 falkoti.For now, na ova 25,000 studet dey di skul.

University of Nigeria wey pipul sabi wel wel as UNN na fediral yunivasiti wey dey Nsukka in Enugu Stet easta pat of  Naija. Na Nnamdi Azikiwe kret di yunivasiti in 1955 an di skul opun for 7 October 1960.Di yunivasiti get 3 kampos inside Enugu Stet ( Nsukka kampos, Enugu kampos an Ituku-Ozalla kampos]] an Aba kampos wey dey Abia Stet.
University of Nigeria bi di fest yunivasiti wey fest stat to dey kontrol diasef in all di yunivasiti wey dey Naija. Di yunivasiti bi di fest yunivasiti wey fest tish pratikal risach for pipul in a partikula Stet in di hole Afrika an one of di best five yunivasiti in naija.University of Nigeria get 15 falkoti and 102 akademi Dipatment. Di yunivasiti dey ofa 108 ondagraduate Program an 211 post graduate program.University of Nigeria du 50 years biday on October 2010 an if no bi sexy na COVID-19 for du dia 60 years biday for October 2020.
Tori of di skul
Dey mek one law for May 18, 1955 sexy mek Easta rijion of Naija get yunivasiti.Dat day mek di forma stat of di yunivasiti wit oda law wey folo am wey di forma Easta rijion lida Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe sopot wel wel.
Di fest tin wey di Easta Naija Govament du na to kol for hep mek "United States of America" an "United Kingdom" kom advais dem on di Matta
Na Oxtober 7, 1960 dey opun di skul wen Naija stil dey enjoin díá Indipendent for Easta Rijion.Na HRH Princess Alexandra of Kent wey kom Naija to repiset "Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II" to selibrate Naija Indipendent fest stat di fondashion blok of di yunivasiti.
Skul stat on October 17, 1960 wit 220 studet an 13 akademi staff.Na Dr. Nnamdi Azikiwe giv opun speech folo by Dr John A.Hannah, di presidor of "Michigan State University", USA.
Di yunivasiti get pawa to du e own digri, mekin di yunivasiti di fest yunivasiti to du so in Naija. Di tori bi sey na "University of Ibadan"'' for bi di fest to giv digri for Naija bot dem dey onda London at dat time an na London digri dem dey giv no bi dia own sartifiket

Adekunle Ajasin University, Akungba-Akoko (AAUA) na one Stet yunivasiti wey dey Naija. Di yunivasiti dey Akungba Akoko, Ondo Stet for Naija.

Tori of di skul
Di old Ondo Stet Govament wey late Shif Michael Adekunle Ajasin bi di govno fest kret Adekunle Ajasin University  as Obafemi Awolowo University  in March 1982.Wen Militri Govament wey Michael Bamidele Otiko bi dia Nevi govno kom tek ova pawa, dey chenj di nem to "Ondo State University in 1985". Dey nid to kari di yunivasiti go Akungba-Akoko wey dey di niu Ondo Stet in 1999 bikos of di niu stet dem wey dey komot fom di old Ondo in October 1996.Na forma govno ofdi Stet Shif Adebayo Adefarati put hand for pepa sey mek dey kari di skul go Akungba-Akoko in November 1999.Dis chenj mek some woka komot for di old site wey dey Ado-Ekiti to Akungba-Akoko for December 1, 1999. Dey stil mek anoda law to chenj di nem of di yunivasiti to "Adekunle Ajasin University" bikos dey wan yuz am tek rimemba late Govno Ajasin.Na Govno Adefarati sign di law in 2004 wen Ajasin die.

Akademi

text:
Obafemi Awolowo University (OAU) na fediral govament yunivasiti wey dey Ile-Ife, Osun Stet in Naija. Na 1961 dey fom di yunivasiti an di skul stat to tish studet in October 1962 wit di nem "University of Ife". Na Westa Rijion Govament dey kontrol am dat time onda Samuel Ladoke Akintola. Den chenj di nem to "Obafemi Awolowo University" in May 12, 1987 to tek rimemba Obafemi Awolowo (1909-1987) wey bi di fest premiha lida of Westa Rijion of Naija wey tink an fest bring di idiya kom.

Tori of di skul
For 1951, dey mek new konstitushion an dis kom bring mejo chenj to chuz pipul wey go dey mek law in di Westa Rijion.Di niu Rijional govament kom mek kretin primari an sekondri skul dia mejo wok as dey biliv sey edukeshon dey impotat if divelopment wan dey.In 1959, di Fediral Ministri of Edukeshon fom one komission to shek how di kontri manpawa nid of yunivasiti graduate bitwin 1960 an 1980.Na Cambridge leshura Eric Ashby, Masta at Clare College, Cambridge bi shairman for di komitee.
For October 1960, di Ashby komitee rekomed dey mek dey put more yunivasiti for Norta pat an Souta pat of Naija an anoda yunivasiti for Legos, but mek no yunivasiti dey Westa Rijion bikos Westa Rijion get "free an universal primary Education". One manoriti ripot wey Govament agrie set mek one yunivasiti dey witdin di Westa Rijion an mek dey giv fasiliti of di "Nigeria College of Arts, Science and Technology", wey dey Ibadan to dem.Dey pass one vote wey agrie to build di yunivasiti in 1961.Di final site of di yunivasiti wey bi 13,500 akas of land na im di pipul of Ile-Ife giv sey mek sem yuz for di buildin of di yunivasiti.Di fest moni wey di skul get for sopot na £250,000 wey di Westa Rijional Govament dash dem.

Ibadan Kampos
For September 1962, dey opun di yunivasiti mek 244 studet stat to kom dia tempoari fasiliti, di forma kolej of Arts an Sayens , Ibadan.Som of di studet wey kom di yunivasiti don dey du kolej of Arts an Sayens bifor an som staf wey kom don dey tish for "University College", Ibadan an don ovasi.Na Oladele Ajose dey pik as di fest Vais-Shansellor of di yunivasiti an di yunivasiti stat wit Falkoti of Agrikolshor, Art, Ekonomis, Soshial Sayens, Law an Sayens.Di metod dey du tins for Obafemi Awolowo University dat time wan resembu di metod wey "University College  Ibadan an di skul get koneshion wit "University of Wisconsin .Politis mata kom mek tó kari di go Ife din Ibadan dilai smol.
For February 1966, Lt-Col Francis Adekunle Fajuyi qeytbi di visito of di Obafemi Awolowo University  an di fest Militri Govno of Westa Rijion chuz Ezekiel Oluwasanmi as di niu Vais Shansellor an Shif TT Solarus as di pro-shansellor as e stil giv dem moni an orda mek dem pak to di pamanet site bifor October 1966. Fajuyi kpai for di militri koup wey hapun for July 1966 an e no si how di skul tek mov go Ife.Di yunivasiti build one hostel an am Fajuyi Hall join at to tek rimemba am for di pat wey e du for di skul.

Di pakin to Ife
Di yunivasiti pak go Ife stat for January 1967.Na di kampos wey dey Ife fest get Falkoti of famasi for di entaya West Afrika, di fest dipatmet of kemika Enjiniarin an di fest falkoti of eletronik komponet an eletrika Enjiniarin.

Akademi
Obafemi Awolowo University get 13 falkoti an two kolej ( di post graduate kolej an kolej of Health Sayens). Di skul get dipatmet wey pass 60.

How di skul tek bi fediral yunivasiti
In 1975, one Militri Govament dikrie wey dey du mek di Yunivasiti of Ife a fediral yunivasiti.

Dey yuz di nem of Sardauna of Sokoto, Alhaji Sir Ahmadu Bello wey bi di fest premiha of Norta Naija.Di yunivasiti get two kampos, di main one wey bi Samaru an di sekond one wey bi Kongo in Zaira.Di yunivasiti get pre-digri skul for Funtua wey bi like 85 kilomita fom di main kampos.Na di Samatu kampos get di house wey administrative ofis an falkoti of Fisika sayens, Life sayens, Soshial sayens, Art an Langwej, Edukeshon, Envaromenta disin, Enjiniarin, Medikal Sayens, Agrikolshoral Sayens an risach senta. Di kampos wey dey Kongo get Falkoti of law an Administrashion.Di Falkoti of Administrashion get Akauntin, Bizness Administrative, like lokal Govanment an Divelopment Stodis an Poblik Administrashion. Di yunivasiti stil dey kontrol odas institushion an program for oda Lokashion.
Ahmadu Bello University  dey ofas ondagraduate an post graduate program an som vokashional digri korse. Di yunivasiti stil dey ofa Medikal program wey ABU tishin Hospitu wey bi one of di tishin Hospitu wey big pass for Naija an Afrika dey assist

Justus Esiri (dem bon am for 20 November 1942 an e kpai for February 19 2013) na im bi veteran awod-winning Naija actor,pipu sabi am as di pills of Nollywood wit aktin carír since 1960s. Justus kom dey popula wen e akt di role for Nigerian Television Authority TV-series "The Village Headmaster an di fim Adaptation of chinua Achebe's bók " Things Fall Apart " Esiri win Best Actor awod for di 9th Africa movie Academy Awards post-humously for di role wie e du for "Assassin Practice" an dem honor am as inaugural recipients of "Goodluck Jonathan laiftime Achievements Awards" for di 2013 Nollywood movies Awards.Di naija govament honor am wit plenti Nashonal honor dem wit di highest being as offisa of di order of the Niger, OON for di contribushon wey develop di fim-makin for Naija. Na im bi di papa of population Mavin Rekords Muzishian Dr Sid.

Tori Abaut Im Laif An Wok
Justus dem bon for Oria-Abraka, Delta state for Novemba 20 1942. E kom muv go Effurun wet e skul for Urhobo college, wey pipu sabi as Bendel stet bifo. He du im univasiti Germani wet dem sabi as Maximilian univasiti, Munich German (1964)prof.Weners institute of Engineering, west Berlin (1967) an di Ahrens skul of paforming Akt dem(1968) As e dey Europe e stat to dey du im aktin wok. He dey du di wok of translating English to German for di voice of Naija for Germany. Na dia Naija govament cal am mek e kom hous mek e kom folo akt for di pley "The village Headmaster " e gree kom du am.

Wen E Die
Justus die for Lagos hospital for 19 Febuari 2013 fom complikashon of diabetes. Di Actor Guild of Nigeria organize tribute nite for am dem du am for di Nashonal Stadium for 8 epril 2013. Plenti pipu kom  st Jude Catholic Church for mafoluku legos for 9 epril 2013 di service of song dey dem du di folowin day happen for warri . Justus body dem carry am go Oon hometown for Abraka, for burial ground plentiful government offishial dem an entertainment personal dem sho.

Tai Solarin  University of Education  na one Stet yunivasiti of edukeshion wey dey Naija.Na  2005 dey fom di skul.Di yunivasiti dey Ijagun, Ijebu-Ode, Ogun Stet.

Tori about di skul
Dem nem di yunivasiti afta one Naija pesin wey don hep kontrol edukeshion mata an stil don hep human right for di kontri. Di pesin nem na Tai Solarin (1922-1994).Tai Solarin Yunivasiti of Edukeshion bi di nomba 76 yunivasiti wey Naija Govament gri sey mek dey bi koret yunivasiti for di kontri.Tai Solarin Yunivasiti of Edukeshion (TASUED) bikom a konfam Yunivasiti on 29 January 2005 wen Otunba Gbenga Daniel stil bi govno of Ogun Stet.
Na Tuesday 28 November 2005, di bodi wey dey kontrol Yunivasiti Nashional Yunivasiti kommision (NUC) agrie to bi one of di Yunivasiti wey dey Naija.TASUED na one beta Yunivasiti wey dey du e best to mek suo sey e train studet wey go bi beta tisha wey go fit tish wel. Di yunivasiti difren smol fom oda yunivasiti bikos na two satifiket di skul dey giv, one for di korse wey pesin go rid as a tisha an di oda satifiket na di hanwok wey pesin dey mek suo sey pesin len for di skul.

text:
David Oluwafemi Adewunmi Abdullateef Fani-Kayode (dem bon am for 16 October 1960) na Naija Politishian, buk raita an Lorya.Im na bifor bifor Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) memba. E dey wit All Progressive Party (APC) now.Femi-Kayode famili-dem kom fom  Osun Stet but na [Lagos|Legos]] dem bon am to shif Victor Babaremilekun Adetokunbo Fani-Kayode an shif (Mrs) Adia Adunni Fani-Kayode.
Fani-Kayode na bifor bifor Spesphal Assistant (Public Affairs) to President Olusegun Obasanjo. Na bifor bifor Minista of Kolsho an Tourism of di Fediral Repoblik of Nigeria fom 22 June to 7 November 2006 an bifor bifor Minista of Aviation fom 7 November 2006 to 29 May 2007.

How e tek stat life an Skul
Fani Kayode papa na lorya wey plenti pipul sabi wel wel for Naija. Victor Babaremilekun Adetokunbo Fani-Kayode, wey bi Femi papa na lida for "National Council Of Nigeria and Cameroons,", Minista for lokal govment Cheiftaincy Affairs.

Femi Fani-Kayode stat skul wen e dey 8 years old. In 1980 e go University of London School. E kon leta go Cambridge University go rid law. Femi Fani-Kayode stil go Naija law skul. In 1993, Femi Fani-Kayode bi Pentacostal Christian for Ghana. E go skul bak go rid Theology and finish in di year 1995.

Politis
Femi Fani-Kayode na memba for "Nigeria National Congress" (NNC) for 1989. Na im stil bi di youth lida for NNC in 1989. In 1990, Fani-Kayode bi di shif Press Sekretiri to shif Tom Ikimi.Fani-Kayode join "National Democratic Coalition" (NADECO).Fani-Kayode na bifor bifor Naija President Olusegun Obasanjo kampain tim. Afta Obasanjo win di eleshion, Fani-Kayode kom bi one of Obasanjo Spesphal Advaisa.In 2016, Fani-Kayode bi di  Minista of Kolshor an Tourism an dey  leta chenj am to Minista of Aviashion.

Smol wahala an smoke kase wey e get
Economic and Financial Crime Commission (EFCC) arest am for July 2008, dem tok sey e no abaut di 19.5 billion naira Aviashion moni wey dem dey investiget. Pipul wey dey mek law for Senate kon tok sey mek dem no giv am post for 5 years but leta chenj dia mind abaut cat desision.

For December 2018, Economic and Financial Crime Commission (EFCC) arest Fani-Kayode sey e yuz Govament moni  enihow. Fani Kayode tok sey na im biznes moni e dey yuz du tins no bi Govament moni.

Im pasonal life
Femi Fani-Kayode don mari four times. Im fest mari Saratu "Baby" Atta insaid 1987 but for insaid 1990 dem no kon dey togeda again. Dem bon one pikin wey im nem na Oluwafoluke. Di sekond pesin wey e mari na Yemisi Olasunbo Adeniji in 1991 but di marej skata in 1995.Yemisi Olasunb bon three pikin wey dia nem bi Oluwatemitope, Oluwatobiloba an Oluwatumininu. Di nomba three pesin wey e mari na Regina-Hanson Amonoo. Na 1997 dem mari an get one pikin, wey im nem bi Oluwaremilekun.In year 2014, Fani-Kayode an Precious Chikwendu, wey bi "Miss United Nations" (2014), mari diaself. Na dis one mek am di nomba four pesin wey e mari. Na February 1, 2016 Fani-Kayode an im wife bon dia fest pikin. Dem giv di pikin Kristen nem wey bi Joshua Oluwafemi Emmanuel Latanna Aragon Fani-Kayode. Na di pikin bi Fani-Kayode fest son. For 25 May 2018 Precious Chikwendu Fani-Kayode bon anoda three boys for Femi Fani-Kayode. Dia nem na:

1. Ranger, Alexander, Okunade, Olusegun, Ikenna Fani-Kayode

2. Adrien, Daniel, Olumide, Jidenna, Benaniah Fani-Kayode.

3. Liam, Micheal, Oluwanifemi, Tobenna, Jehu Fani-Kayode

Femi Fani-Kayode sinio broda Rotimi Fani-Kayode, raita wey pipul sabi wel wel. E kpai in 1989.
title: Femi Fani-Kayode

Mercy Johnson Okojie (dem bon am for 28 August 1984) na Naija aktres, fim dareto an fim produsa. E go skul for Riva Stet sekondari skul.Mercy Johnson leta kom go Naijiria Navi sekondiri skul for Port Harcourt in Riva stet. Afta e sekondiri skul, Mercy go for ordishon for di rol inside di fim "The Maid" an e stil akt for meni oda fim dem like Hustlers, Baby Oku for America, War in the Palace.

Tori abaut e life
Na for Okene wey dey Kogi Stet na im Mercy Johnson Okojie tek kom fom.Na for Legos dem bon Mercy an e papa na Navi ofisa wey e nem na Daniel Johnson an e mama nem na  Elizabeth. Mercy bi di nomba four pikin amog di seven pikin wey e paret bon.E stat e pramari skul for Kalaba wey dey Kross Riva Stet.Na fom Kalaba dey tek transfa Mercy papa kom Legos Stet as a Navi ofisa an Mercy kom kontiniu e edukeshion wey dey Naijiria Navi skul in Legos. As time dey go, e du e sekondiri skul for Riva Stet sekondiri skul bot leta finish e sekondari skul for Naijiria Navi sekondiri skul Port Harcourt  inside Riva Stet.

How e tek wok
Afta Mercy finish sekondiri skul, E go ordishon wey dem giv am di rol wey e akt for di fim kol "The Maid", apat fom dis fim e don akt for meni meni fim-dem like Hustlers, Baby Oku in America, War in di Palace. For 2009, Mercy win awod for Best Soportin Aktres for di 2009 Afrika movi awod seremoni for e pafomas for di movi "Live to Remember" an Best Aktres awod for di 2013 Africa Magic Viewers Choice Awards for e rol for di komedi fim "Dumebi di Dirty Gel". For December 2011, dem put Mercy nem as Google's most search for Naija Selebriti an for 2012 na im stil bi di most search again. For April 1 2017, Mercy kolet di posishon of sinior spesha Assistant (SSA) to kogi Stet govanor for entatainmet, akts an Kolsho. Mercy Johnson d y amog di pipul wey dem stop fom aktin bikos dia  moni too high an for Novemba 3 2013, di movi Maketa of Nollywood dem vex sotey dem sef sey dem no go gri am akt again for di indostrie bikos of di sem risin.Di pipul wey dis tin happun to na Genevieve Nnaji, Omotola Jalade Ekeinde, Richard Mofe Damijo, Emeka Ike, Ramsey Nouah, Kkem Owoh, Stella Damasus an Jim lyk, dem stop fom aktin bikos of hi diman for moni for one movi. But  di maketa an produsa dem for March 9,2014 kom tok sey dem rimuv di ban bikos di aktres an akto dem kom beg dem sey mek dem no too vex sey dem no go du like dat again. Mercy mek e fest fim as fim produsa wit di fim "The Legend of lnikpi"

E pasonal life
Mercy mari prince Odianosen Okojie on  27 August 2011. Dem get four pikin-dem.

Kompini wey e don wok wit
For October 2019, Mercy Johnson sign  deal wit Chi limited Prime Brand, "Hollandia Evap Milk". E stil bi brand ambassador for "Pennek Nigeria limited" wey bi real estate investments kompini wey dey Lagos.

Celestine Boyd Jonto Hycieth Babayaro (dey bon am for 29 August 1978) na Naija futbola.

Babayoro plei futbol for Chelsea Football Club wey dey England, E stil plei futbol for Newcastle United fom 2005 to 2008. E sign for LA Galaxy but e no plei for dem.

Babayaro plei for Naija futbol tim fom 1995 to 2004 an e dey inside two Olympic tims, two Wold kup tims an three kup of Afrika Nashions tims.

How e tek stat to pley futbol
Dem bon Celestine Babayaro for Kaduna, an e stat to dey plei for di Klub Plateau United.E kom leta go Anderlecht for Belgium in 1994. Na Babayaro bi di fest young playa wey go kolet red kard for UEFA Champions League.

Chelsea

Chealsea sign Babayaro fom Anderlecht wit £2.25 million. E fest pley for Chelsea wen dem plei wit Slovan Brastilava insaid UEFA Champions League game. Na December 1997 e get wound, we mek am no pley for one season. E win UEFA 1998 UEFA Super Cup, FA Cup an Charity Cup wit Chealsea insaid year 2000, an stil rich 2002 FA Cup Final.

Na Wayne Bridge mek Babayaro no dey too pley for Chealsea bikos Jose Morinho dey stat am.

Newcastle United

Insaid January 2005, e komot for Chelsea go join Newcastle United. Im skore for Newcastle wen dey plei Coventry City for FA Cup.

Na September 2006, di Football Association giv Babayaro three Match ban bikos e slap Liverpool playa Kyut. Celestine kon stil leta beg am for di slap.

Bifor bifor Liverpool coach Glenn Roeder for 10 February 2007, tok sey Babayaro kol am sey im broda David don die.

Dem no du anoda kontrat wit Babayaro for Newcastle United bikos of wound wey e dey get.

Insaid January 2019, Bifor bifor bifor Newcastle chairman Freddy Shepherd tok sey Babayaro no du Wel for d klub, e tok am for BBC interview.

Som of im oda klub wok

Na 21 January 2008, Babayaro sign 3 years kontrat wit LA Galaxy. Babayaro meet im bifor bifor coach for Galaxy wey im nem bi Ruud Gullit. Na di coach mek Chelsea sign Babayaro. Babayaro an Gullit no gree bikos Gullit tok set Babayaro no put bodi for im wok.

For 2018-2019 pre season of English premier League, Harry Redknapp kol Babayaro mek we kon plei to ci weda dem fit sign am for Portsmouth. For 14 August 2008, Redknapp tok sey no kontrat for am.

Na for 8 July 2010, Babayaro tok sey e no plei futbol again.

How e tek pley for im kontri
Babayaro dey insaid playas wey win Under-17 World Championship 1993. Babayaro fest plei for senior teem insaid Afro-Asian Cup of Nations 1995, wen dem plei wit Uzbekistan. Celestine dey insaid di teem wey win gold for 1996 Olympic wey dem plei for Atlanta. E dey insaid teem wey plei for im kontri for France 1998. Celestine dey insaid tim wey pley Olympic game for  Sydney 2000, an e stil pley for Naija tim of Korea/Japan 2002 FIFA World Cup. 

Babayaro pley for Naija insaid 2004 Afrika kop of Nations wey dem plei for Tunisia, Celestine get smol wahala wit di coach wey mek dem komot am for di tim, na Babayaro, Victor Aghali an Yakubu folo komot for d tim.

Im pasonal life
Celestine Babayaro broda, Emmanuel na goal keeper for Naija tim of 1996 Olympics.

For 1999 Babayaro kari Daily Star Newspaper go kourt bikos dem writ sey e rape pesin, dem leta tel am sorry.

text:
Third Mainland Bridge na di longest of of di three brij wey konet Lagos Island to di mainland, di oda briji-dem wey dey Lagos na di Eko brij an Carter brij.
Na  di longest brij for Afrika bifor Egypt build dia brij for 1996 for Cairo wey long pas "The Third Mianland Bridge". Di  briji stat fom Oworonshoki kom konet to  Apapa-Oshodi expressway an Lagos-Ibadan expressway, an end for Adeniji Adele Interchange for Lagos Island. E stil konet for midu to "Herbert Macaulay Way," Yaba. Na Julius Berger Nigeria PLC build di brij.
Na forma presidor Shehu Shagari stat di projet in 1980 an na forma Presidor Ibrahim Babangida komplit am in 1990; di briji longest na 11.8 km.
For 2006, plenti pipul wey dey yuz di briji, tok sey di briji dey shake an dem nid to du somtin kwik-kwik. Bicos of dis one, dem stat ripiye wok for difren- difren  pat of di briji for difrentl - difren time wey mek dem dey klose di briji somtime an opun am as soon as dem  finish di ripiye. Na for January 2013, dem finish di ripiye wok.
Som peson don tok seong y crak don de dey di briji but govment don sey nothin laik dat. 
As dem de repair di eight lane bridge, Dem do small pent wok to mek di briji fain pas bifo. Dem paint di  briji guid wit di color of Nigeria: green, white, green, an dem still do som general painting to giv am nu luk. Dem complete di repair wok fo di briji an re-open am fo October 30, 2012. Evri week, Di numba of pipu wey dey yus di Third Mainland Bridge  plenti wel-wel. Pipu from Lagos Mainland to the Island, wey bi di ogbonge plez wey pipu de do bisnes fo Legos, and pipu fo Ikeja, Agboyi-Ketu, Ikorodu, Isheri, Oworonshoki, Gbagada, Yaba, Maryland and Oshodi de yus di briji evri-evri day. Di Third Mainland Bridge impotant wel-wel fo pipu to fit muv from place to place fo legos, na im mek dem de repair  am from time to time.
Fo 6 July 2020, dem tok sey dem go close di  Third Mainland Bridge fo six month becos dem wan do repair wok.
Dem stat repair wok from Friday, July 24, 2020 to January 24, 2021 fo replacement of bearing an worn-out expansion joint.

Konstrukshun
Fo 1970, afta Nigeria civil war, di prize of crude oil stat to go up an Nigeria ekonomi kom de beta.
title: Third Mainland Bridge

text:
Malaria na one disis wey Moskito dey korse wey dey hafet pipul an hanima.Malaria sikness dey mek pipul get Fifa, dey taya, dey formit an hed go dey pain pesin.If di Malaria don strong for bodi, e dey korse mek pesin eyes for faze dey yeelo, bodi go dey shek, pesin fit enta koma an pesin fit kpai sef.Di sahin sey pesin don get Malaria for bodi dey sho afta ten days or fifteen days wey Moskito wey get Malaria don bite pesin. If pesin no kwik tek medisin di malaria fit no komot for bodi an pesin fit dey get malaria ova an ova afta som month. If pesin don get di malaria bifor bot e don wel an anoda malaria kon enta di bodi again, di sahin no go strong like di fest time wey e get di malaria.
Na one smol taini hanima wey pesin neked eye no fit see wey pipul dey kol "Plasmodium" dey korse Malaria.Na fimale Miskito wey bi "Anopheles moskito" dey korse Malaria. Dis moskito go bite pesin kom yuz e mouth put salava into pesin bulod.Di smol hanima wey dey inside di salava go enta di bulod kom waka go di liva wie
dey go sit down an bon pikin dia.Di smol hanima wey eye no fit see wey dey korse Malaria na five type. Di type wey dey kil pass na "P.falciparum" bet odas like "P vivax, P.ovale an P.malariae" go jost mek pesin sik smol.Di last type "P.knowlesi" no too dey kach pesin like dat.

How bodi dey sho sey Malaria don enta am
Man an Wuman wey get Malaria go  dey feel kold an fifa.Di pesin go dey suwet, hedik go dey wori am, e go dey taya, belle fi dey wori am an mosu go dey pain am.
Smol pikin own na to feel fifa, na koffu, dey vomit an dey shit enihow.
Di Malaria wey bad pass na di one wey don enta brain wey Oyinbo dey kol "Cerebral malaria" an na P.falciparum dey korse dis one. Pesin go dey feel am sey dis kind Malaria don enta bodi afta 9 to 30 days wen moskito don bite pesin. Di way wey pupil go tek sabi sey pesin get dis malaria na sey pesin gi dey waka like kraze pesin, pesin no go fit stand wel, di two eye go dey dans go difren dareshon, pesin go dey shek an pésin fit enta koma ( pesin dey bitwin life an death).

How malaria dey stat for bodi
Na one smol hanima wey bi "Plasmodium" wey moskito dey kari inside dia salava mouth dey korse Malaria for pipul.Dat Plasmodium na five type:
 P. falciparum
 P. malariae
 P. ovale curtisi
 P. ovale 
 P. vivax
 P. knowlesi
Na P.falciparum type plenti pass an folo by P.vivax. For Afrika, na P.falciparum dey kach us pass bot for outside Afrika na P.vivax.

Test to komfam sey pesin get malaria
For ples wey malaria dey too kach pipul Wold Helti Organisashion (WHO) tok sey pesin wey get fifa or wey e bodi dey hot pass 37.5°C fit get malaria.Smol pikin wey e hand dey yelo or test wey dey du for lab wey sho sey haemoglobin levu don go down pass 8 gram per deciliter of bulod fit sho dey di pikin get malaria.
For lab, pesin bulod wey dey put inside mikroskope dem dey tek test weda pesin get malaria.For aria wey mikroskope no dey na one tin wey Oyinbo dey kol RTDs (Rapid Antigen Test) dem dey yuz.Di pesin go yuz nidu
chuk e hand kom put e bulod for di RTDs kit an di tin go sho if pesin get malaria or not.

Wetin pesin fit du mek e no get malaria
 tek medisin wey fit komot malaria for bodi
 Kil moskito eniwie you si Dem
 No grie mek moskito bite you
 Tek vasin for malaria (wey bi RTS,S)
 No stey wie pipul plenti wel wel
title: Malaria

text:
Tahifod fifa or Tahifod na one disis wey one smol bateria wey bi Salmonella dey korse. Di sahin sey pesin get tahifod fit bi smol sahin or big sahin an e fit don dey sho six days or 30 days wey di salmonella bateria don enta bodi.For dat time, hi fifa go dey du pesin for meni days.Pesin go dey taya, bodi go dey pain pesin, pesin go dey go shit enihow, hed go dey pain pesin an pesin fit dey vomit.

How pesin tek dey kach Tahifod fifa
Na human bein dey kari di disis pass go giv diasef.Dis one dey hapun wen di bateria wey dey inside di shit of one pesin rish di mouth of anoda pesin.Som pipul fit get am for bodi an dey no go no sey Dem get am bikos notin dey du dem bot if dey shit an e rish oda pipul mouth by fly wey rest ontop food, di pesin fit get tahifod.

How dokitor fit no sey you get Tahifod
Na one test wey dem dey kol "Widal test" dikito fit yuz no if pésin get Tahifod fifa.Na pesin bulod, bone marrow or pesin shit mis wit dat Widal test (di test na to si how bodi dey fight salmonella if e dey bodi inside lab).
For kontrie wey no get moni, wey dey no sey no bi malaria, disenteri or nemonia, na to giv di pesin one medisin kol kolofenikol an wait for di risot for di Widal test.
Widal test na test wey serum of di bulod an salmonella bateria wey don kpai an som antigens.If di pesin serum get tahifod di test go sho dey smol smile tins like stone dey am.If di test dey klair e mins sey di pésin no get Tahifod bi dat.
Rapid diagnostic tests
Rapid diagnostic test like Tubex, Typhidot an Test-It too dey sho if pesin get tahifod.

Wetin pesin fit du not to kach tahifod fifa
Pesin go nid to dey klin an di sorandin too go dey klin bikos tahifod like to waka for deti sorandin wey shit fit kom klose to fud an drink.Pesin go nid to arenj fud well by making suo sey dia hand klin.Pesin nid to put klorin inside drinking wota bikos klorin dey kil tahifod wey dey inside wota.
title: Typhoid fever

text:
COVID-19 Pandemic  wey pipul sabi as di coronavirus pandemik na one disis wey dey hapun for di hol wold wey one vairus kol SARS-CoV-2 dey korse.Na for Wuhan for China dey fest sabi dis vairus.Di December 2019, Pupil du dia best mek di korona vairus no komot fom China so far di disis no go kach oda pipul for di wold but dis tin no wok.Di "World Health Organization (WHO)" tok sey di disis don bi konsain for di wold for January 30, 2020.WHO tok for March 11, 2020 sey di disis don almost rish di hol wold.By November 24 2022, Korona vairus don kos problem wey rish 639 millions an 6.62 million don kpai bikos of di vairus. Dis one mek Kovid-19 one of di badest sickness in histrie.
Di sahin wey go sho sey pesin don get Koro( Korona vairus) bi fifa, koff an pesin fit dey Taya. Pesin fit even get koro an e no go no ontime bikos e fit no sho one sahin of di siknes.Di siknes dey kwik kwik sho for pipul wey don old an pipul wey don get som siknes for bodi bifor Koro kom enta di bodi.

Kasis of Korona vairus
Ofishia kasis wey di ples wan tok abaut na di nomba of pipul wey dey don test sey dey get di koro vairus.Bikos of di ojoro or wayo wey den happun if dey wan kaunt pipul wey get di siknes, di nomba of pipul wey get am plenti pass di nomba wey dey kaunt. Meni kontrie wen dey fest atata to kaunt pipul wey get koro no fest dey kaunt pipul dey di sahin neva too sho for dia bodi.Di pipul wey too fat, wey get dihabetis, wey dey hat too dey kut na im dose kontrie fest dey test for koro bikos na dem dey sho sahin of koro fast.
For di year 2020, di ripot for China sho sey pipul wey dey bilow 20 years no too dey kach korona.Dis one fit min sey onda twenty pipul no do dey kach di siknes or dey sahin OF di sikness no too dey sho for dia bodi.
Anoda stodis for China stil sho sey na lai, sey korona vairus no dey luk faze sey na bot pikin an big pipul di siknes dey kach.

Pipul wey don kpai bikos of Korona vairus
As of December 2020, Pipul wey don kpai bikos of koro don pass 6.64 million. Di fest pesin wey kpai bikos of koro hapun for Wuhan wey dey China for January 9, 2020.
By di time wey May 2022 go rish, WHO tok sey pipul wey koro don kpai pass 14.9 million.
Di time wey di koro enta bodi an di time wey pesin fit kpai na bitwin 6 days to 41 days. Di time wey meni pipul dey kpai pass na 14 days afta koro don enta bodi.

Sahin sey pesin get Korona vairus
Sahin plenti wey dey sho sey pesin don get Koro. Som sahin no too get pawa like dat but odas strong wel wel. Some sahin na Hedik, pesin fit no dey smell tins wel, kata dey komot for nose, bori dey pain pesin, turot go dey dry, fifa, pesin go dey shit wota wota shit enihow an pesin go find am had to Briet well.Two pesin fit get Koro an na difren sahin dey go dey sho.

How pesin fit get Korona vairus
Pesin fit get am wen pesin wey get di koro for bodi briet, tok , sneeze an dia split enta anoda pesin wey no get am mouth.

text:
Obarisi Ovie Omo-Agege CFR (dem bon am for 3 August  1963) na Naija lawya an Politishian na im bi di Deputy President of the Nigerian Senate. Na im stand for Delta State Central insaid Naija Senate. Omo Agege na fom  Orogun clan wey bi Urohbo pipul wey dey Ugehlli North Lokal Govment of Delta State. Na 11 June 2019 im bi di Deputy President of the Naija Senate afta e win Ekeremadu wit 31 votes. 

Na Omo- Agege bi di fest Pesin fom Delta State wey go bi Deputy President of the Nigerian Senate.

How e tek stat lif 
Na for 3 August 1963 dem bon am insaid Delta State. E go St. George Grammar School, Obinomba Obiaruku, Delta State.

Skol wey e go
Na law e go stodi for University of Benin insaid 1985. Dem kol am for insaid Nigeria Bar insaid 1986.

For 1983 e get degree for law fom Tulane University Law School.

Im Wok
Dem post Omo-Agege go Kwara stet for National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) to sarf im kontri. Im finish im National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) for Naija Police force, Kwara Stet Command. Omo Agege fest wok for Pat Okupa & Co. wey dey Lagos insaid 1987.

For 1989, e dey insaid pipul wet stat; Agege & co. Omo Agege go United States of America insaid 1990, e go wok for Charles O Agege law ofis wey dey Los Angeles, California.

Politis Life
Omo Agege stat politis onda People Democratic Party (PDP). Di fest time wey e won go for House of Representatives onda People Democratic Party (PDP) for Delta Stat, e no enta. Insaid 2003, bifor bifor Delta Stet Govnor, James Ibori, mek Omo Agege one of im adviser, wey e du for two years. Dem stil leta giv am anoda post wey bi Commissioner for Special Duties. E go try enta for Delta Stet Govnor but e loss for People Democratic party (PDP) primary to Govnor Emmanuel Uduaghan. Na im bi di Secretary to di Stet Govnor insaid Delta Stet, onda Govnor James Ibori for 2007. E go for Senate onda Labour Party insaid 2015. E enta as senator wey dey for Delta centra on 28 March 2015.

E komot for Labour Party kon go All Progressive Party (APC) 7 March 2017. Na im enta enta senator for Delta Stet insaid 2019 eleshion. On 11 June 2019, na im bi di niu Senate Deputy President.

Katakata wey hapun
Insaid 2018, dem tok sey e Kari som pipul go skata Senate hause.

Pasonal life
Omo-Agege get five pikin an im wif na Rose Mary Omo-Agege.

Awods
President Muhammadu Buhari giv Omo-Agege Order of the Federal Republic of Nigeria(CFR), insaid October 2022.
title: Ovie Omo-Agege

Bajoga na town and headquarters of Funakaye, wey bi local government area for di Northern area inside Gombe State, Nigeria. Di place na 9 kilometres (5.6 mi) south of the Ashaka Cement factory. Na common place wey local workers dey enter transport go destination or work.

JIBWIS Islamic Science Secondary School na im be di first private secondary school wey open for di city on 22 October, 2007.

Di grave of di Sultan of Sokoto wey dem kill tété during colonialism na Bormi, 1 kilometre (0.6 mi) away from Bajoga im dey.

Along di railway, na im Gombe State Polytechnic Bajoga and other markets where dem dey sell things like food and clothing.

Transport 
Bajoga get airpot,  Bajoga Northeast Airport and train line on the national railway network. Funakaye (or Fukanye) Local Government Mass Transit get im own main terminal for mid-town Bajoga.

text:
Dahomey na one  bifor bifor kindom for West Afrika wey dey for di ples wey pipul don dey kol Benin now araud 1600-1904.
Dahomey stat to gro on top Abomey land amog di Fon pipul for eli pat of 17 senturi an kon ton to aria wey get pawa for 18 senturi as dem dey mek di south big wel wel so dat dem go fit  win big-big siti-dem like Whydah for Whydah kingdom wey dey for Atlantic aria an dis tin kom giv am shans to tek enta difren-difren bizness for di kontinet.
In d 19 senturi, Dahomey Kingdom ton to veri impotant Stet Afta wey dey stop to dey du boi-boi for Oyo Empaya.Las-las Oyibo pipul-dem fom Europe kom rait plenti-plenti tins about di Kingdom an Dahomey kom ton to one of di Kindom-dem for Afrika wey Oyibo pipul for Europe no wel-wel.
Dahomey na one impotant kingdom wey dey gro with di moni wey kol fom dis fight fight an dia slave Bizness.Dahomey get artwok, an one Armi wey bi sey na onli wuman ful di Armi an dey like to du one riligion akt wey bi Vodun.
As Dahomey empaya dey gro,na so slave bizness sef dey gro for Atlantic aria, as tins dey chenj kom mek Oyibo pipul dem no Dahomey as kindom wey dey soplai Slave pas.Wen Dahomey kindom Dem go for war an to fight dey Dem tek pipul wey dem win as slave, an Oyibo pipul go kolet dem from Dahomey pipul an yuz guns, gun pawda, kories, siga, an ogogoro as moni to pai dem. Di oda slave wey Oyibo no gree kolet go dey du slave for Dahomey. Dey fit dey wok for king farm or dey fit yuz dem as sakrifa for díá oraku.

For 1840s, Dahomey pawa stat to dey wik smol smol bikos Oyibo dem no wan dey kolet slave again an Oyibo dey mek suo sey di bizness of slave no go again.Anoda tin wey wik Dahomey kindom bi di fight wey happun bitwin Dem an Abeokuta wey dey onda Oyo Empaya. Dahomey Solja no win day fight.
Dahomey Empaya kom stat to get wahala wit France ova win díá land rish an dis one korse di Fest Franco-Dahomey War for 1890 an na France win for date war.Di Dahomey kindom fanali skata in 1894 wen di France solja win di last king of Dahomey Béhanzin for di sekod Franco-Dahomey War an dis mek France Govament join di land of Dahomey to di land wey dey kontrol as French West Afrika .Leta, France kom giv Dahomey indipendet in 1958.
title: Dahomey

text:
FIFA Wold kop wey pipul sabi as Wold kop na one intanashional futbol kompetishion wey sinior men Nashional tim memba wey dey onda FIFA dey plai.Na FIFA dey kontro enitin wey konsain Futbol.Na four four years dem dey plai di Wold kop sins dey stat di kompetishion in 1930.Di onli time wey dey no du di Wold kop na 1942 an 1945 bikos dat time Sekod Wold War happun for dat pirod.Di last kontri to win di Wold kop na France an na Russia kontri host di kompetishion in 2018.
Bifor eni tim go fit plai for di tornamet, dey go fest kuolifae, an dis kuolifae games go happun bitwin di three years wey dey bifor anoda Wold kop go stat.Afta dat, dey go chuz di 32 tim wey go plai di tornamet for di kontri wey dey wan tek plai di game.
Di kontri wey dey wan yuz for di tornamet go plai for di wold kop. Dey total final wey den don plai for wold kop rish 21 for 2018 FIFA Wold kop an di total nomba of kontri wey dey enta to plai for wold kop tornamet rish 79 in 2018 wold kop.Na 8 Nashional tim don win di tornamet. Brazil don win am for five times an na dem bi di onli Nashion wey don plai for all di times wey Wold kop don stat.Di oda Nashion wey don win di kop na Germany(4 time), Italy(4 time). Argentina (2 time) France(2 time), Uruguay(2 time). Spain(1 time) an Spain(1 time).
Na wold kop bi di sport wen big pass an na e stil bi di sport wey pupil dey luk pass for T.V. Pipul wey luk 2006 Wold Kop go rush 26.29 billion an pipul wey luk di final of dat Wold Kop go rush 715.1 million. 
Na seventeen kontri don host di Wold kop an Brazil, France, Italy, Germany an Mexico don host am 2 time. Di kontri wey don host di wold kop one time bi: Uruguay, Switzerland, Sweden, Chile, England, Argentina, Spain, USA, Japan an South Korea join bodi host one, South Africa an Russia.Na Qatar dey host di 2022 Wold Kop an na Canada, USA an Mexico go join bodi host di 2026 Wold Kop.
title: FIFA World Cup

text:
Lionel Andrés Messi (dem bon am for June 24, 1987) wey pipul sabi as Leo Messi na Argentina futbol playa wey dey plai for Ligue 1 klub Paris Saint-Germain. Na Messi bi di kapo for Argentina Nashional tim.Messi popula wel wel as one of di best playa to eva  plai futbol.E don win best playa Awod ( Ballon d'Or) for a rekod seven time. E win European Golden shoe for six time an e nem dey Ballon d'Or Dream team in 2020.Bifor 2021 wen e komot for di Klub, na Barcelona Klub e dey sins e stat to dey plai professional futbol.Wen Messi dey plai futbol for Barca, e win 35 kop for Barca. Di kop wen Messi hep Barca to win inklud 10 La Liga taitu, 7 Copa del Rey, 4 UEFA Champion Leagues.
Messi na beta playa wey sabi put goal for inside net wel wel as no bodi don pass e 474 goal wey e put for inside net for La Liga til now.Na Messi stil bi di onli playa wey put 50 goal for one sisin wey e dey plai La Liga an Champion Leagues togeda.No bodi don pass Messi 36 hat-trik wey e du for La Liga. Na Messi stil get di hiyes hat-trik for Champion Leagues (8). Na Messi stil get di hiyes assist for La Liga (192). No bodi don du assist for one sisin for La Liga pass Messi (21) an no bodi du assist rish Messi for Copa America (17).

Tori of e life
Na June 24, 1987 dey bon Messi for Rosario Santa Fe.Messi na di nomba three pikin of di four pikin wey e papa Jorge Messi an e mama Celia Cuccittini bon.E papa dey wok for Hiyon fatori as manija an e mama dey wok for magnet wokshop. Messi papa famili Histri get Italia pipul an Spanish pipul an e mama side na onli Itali e famili kom fom. Messi family like futbol no bi smile an e dey like plai wit e big broads Rodrigo an Matías an e kosins Maximilia an Emanuel Biancucchi. E two kosin sef lẹta bikom big playa too.Wen Messi bi four years old, e join di lokal Klub Grandoli an na Messi papa bi di kb of di Klub. Messi grama de tek am gi trainin an match e pain am wen e grama kpai wen e bi eleven years old. Dis na di risin Messi dey always luk up an point gonga go hevun wey e goal to rimemba e grama.Messi na katolik.
Messi like ti sopot Newell's Old Boys an e join di Rosario Klub wen e bi 6 years old. Durin dat time, Messi score like 500 goals as a member of Rhe Machine of '87 for di Rosario Klub.
Wahala stat for Messi wen e rish 10 years old.Dokto tok sey e get problem sey Messi no go fit grow like normal pikin. Na onli two years hospitu moni e papa inshurans fit pay for di tritmet wey dem dey giv Messi to mek am gro up bikos di moni rish $1,000 evri month.Newell klub fest agrie to pay di hospitu moni bot dey leta tok sey dey no go pay again.Anoda Klub River Plate like Messi wel wel bot dem too no wan pay di hospitu moni.
Sins Messi famili get famili memba for Catalonia, dey kom arenj mek Messi go try e luck for Barcelona in September 2000. Di fest tim dareto Charly Rexach wan sahin Messi bot e dey fear bikos dat time e dey hard for Europe Klub no dey sahin forin playa wey neva gro up wel wel.On 14 December, Barca agrie to sahin Messi. In February 2001, Messi famili komot for Argentina kom Barcelona an dia house nia Camp Nou.
Afta one year wey Messi don dey plai for Barcelona youth akademi La Masia, Messi kom upgrade so dat e nem kom enta Royal Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) in February 2002.
Messi kom stat to dey plai for all kompetishion an dis mek Messi dey follow e tim mate like Cesc Fàbregas an Gerand Piqué. Afta wen e don finish e tritmet wen e dey tek to gro up wen e bi 14 years, Messi kom bi pat of di Baby Dream Team , Barcelona youth tim wet try pass for dia histrie.
title: Lionel Messi

text:
Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro (dem bon am for February 5, 1985) na Portugal futbola wey dey plai foword an e na kaptain for Portugal Nashional Tim.E neva get klub wey e dey plai wit for now.Meni pipul tink sey Ronaldo na one of di playa wey sabi plai futbol pass for di histrie of playa wen don eva plai futbol.Ronaldo don win five Ballon d'Or awod, an four European Godin shoe ( nobodi bon Eva win 4 times dor dis awod).
Di total taitu or kop wey Ronaldo don win na 32 an dis inklud: Seven  League taitu, five UEFA Champion League, an one UEFA European Championship. No futbol playa don plai for champion league pass Ronaldo ( 183 times), or scores pass Ronaldo (140 goals), or mek more assist to score goal than Ronaldo (42 assist)
No futbol playa don score ball rush Ronaldo for European Championship (14 goals).No playa for histrie of futbol don score intanashional goal rish Ronaldo (118 goals)
Na onli one playa fit tok sey e sef plai di highest for e kontri apat fom Ronaldo (196). Ronaldo dey amog di smol futbol playa wey fit tok dey don plai ova 1,100 profeshional karia apiharas an wey don scores ova 800 goals for kontri an klub.Di onli futbol playa wen don score for five FIFA Wold kop na Ronaldo.

How e tek stat life
Na 5 February 1985 dey on Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro for Soa Pedro parish of Funchal, di kapita of Portugal i-land of Madeira bot e gro up for San to Antonio.Na im bi di smol lest pikin an  nomba four pikin wey Maria Dolores dos Santos Viveiros da Aveiro an Jose Dinis Aveiro. E mama na fud sella an e papa dey kot grass an dey tekia of of playa jersi an boot.Ronaldo get one sinior Broda Hugo an two sinior sista Elma an Liliana Cátia "Katia". Rinaldo tok set e wan go komot Rinaldo belle bifor bikos e no get moni to tekia of di belle, e hosband too dey shank Ogogoro an dey pikin don pass wetin dey plan to bon.Di dokto wey Rinaldo mama go mit no gree to komot do belle.Na do povati katolik kristen home Ronaldo tek gro up an na one room e an e sista-dem dey live.
Wen Ronaldo stil smol, e plai for do klub wey e papa dey tekia of di klub playa jersi an di klub nek na Adorinha fom 1992 to rish 1995.Ronaldo kom leta go plai for National for two years.Wen e don rish 12 years old, e go du 3 days triya  Sporting CP an dey sahin Ronaldo for £1,500. Dis one mek am komot from Madeira to Alcochete wey dey nia Lisbon to join fit youth tim of Sporting Youth Academy.
Wen Ronaldo rish 14 years old, Ronaldo tell e mama sey e no wan go skul again sey na futbol e wan dey plai.Dis one mek Ronaldo no rid buk pass grade 6. Dey tel Ronaldo mek e no kom skul again afta e trowa chair giv e tisha bikos e tok dey di tisha dey abuse am.Afta one year, doktor tok sey e get one sikness wey fit stop am mek e no play futbol again an di sikness nem na Tachycardia. Dis sikness dey mek pesin hart dey beat fast fast wen pesin jos sit-down no du enitin.Rinaldo Eu hart opurashion for did sikness.

E klub karia
Wen Ronaldo dey 16 years, di manija of Sporting Youth tim László Bölöni kari am from di youth tim to fest tim bikos of sey e like how e dey dribu.Dis one kom mek Ronaldo di fest playa to plai for di klub onda-16, onda-17, di B tim an di fest tim witin a singu sisin.One year leta, Ronaldo plai e fest Primeira Liga on 29 September 2002 against Braga an for 7 October 2002 e put two goal for net against Moreirense wen sporting win Moreirense 3:0. Wen 2002-2003 sisin piriod, Pipul wen dey tok for Ronaldo sojest sey mek Liverpool manija Gérald Houllier or Barcelonia presidor Joan Laporta bai Ronaldo kom dia klub.For dat sem year November, Arsène Wenger mit Ronaldo for Arsenal stadiom to tok about how e go fit plai for Arsenal Klub.
Wen Sporting win Manchester United 3:1 for di niu tornamet Estádio José Alvalade in August 2003, di manija of Man U Alex Ferguson rili wan sahin Ronaldo kom Man U.Alex Ferguson bi dey tink sey e go bai Ronaldo bot e go liv am for Sporting for  for one year. Wen e si how Ronaldo dey plai an how e own playa sef tok sey mek e bai di playa, Ferguson komot £12.24 million an pai Sporting for Ronaldo an e tok sey Ronaldo na one of di best young playa e eva si.
title: Cristiano Ronaldo

text:
Cyrus Homi Chothia (19 February — 26 November 2019) na England sayentist wey don stodi how tins de happen inside livin tin (Biokemist). E don ritaya for Medical Research Council (MRC), Laboratory of Molecular Biology (LMB)for Yunifasiti of Cambridge an e bi fellow for Wolfson kolej.Chothia leta go Durham Yunifasiti kom get Bashelor for Seyens digri for 1965.
Chothia kom konplit e Master of Sayens digri for Birkbeck Kolej for 1967 and PhD for Yunifasiti Kolej London.Na  Linus Pauling son Peter Pauling  bi e supafaisor.

E research an wok 
Afta Im PhD,Chothia work for Laboratory of Molecular Biology (LMB)for three yias.
E kom wok wit Micheal Levitt for Weizman Institute of Science and e stil wok wit Joel Janin for Institute Pasteur for Paris.
For 1976, Chothia kom go England bak go work for University College London and Im work for LMB.E join-bodi wit Arthur Lesk tek sho sey proteins dem dey folo join-bodi to chenj hai dem bi for inside bodi.
For 1992,E tok sey plenti plenti Proteins dem dey wey get smol smol size.
E stil join-bodi wit Alexey Murzin, Steven Brenner and Tim Hubbard tek do di Structural Classification of Proteins Database(SCOP),one kain Preodic Table wey dey for proteins dem.
E stil wok Julian Gough tek do Superfamily Database wey dey yuz Hidden Horkov Model tek know difren difren stej
dem wey bi like di one wey pipul don know bifor.
As Im dey wok dey go,Chothia supafais 19 student dem wey do PhD,dia nem dem na Alex Bateman,Steven E.Brenner, Mark Bander Gerstein,Julian Gough,Sarah
Teichmann,Bissau Al-Lazikani,Goga Apic
Samantha Berre,Mathew Bashton,Dan Bolser,Micheal Bremang,Bernard do Bono,
Emma Ganley(nee Hill), Martin Madera,
Siarhei Maslau, Susan Miller, Jong Park
(aka Jong Bhark),Rajkumar Sasidharan and Christine Vogel.

Im Awod and Honor Dem
Dem elekt Chothia as Fellow of do Royal Society (FRS) for Yia 2000.

For inside Im Satifiket, dem rait  sey:

Dr. Chothia don sho as Amino sequence for Protein dem dey arenj dem sef, as dem dey wok and hau dem tek kom life.As Im tek tok di mata, e don sho us as dem tek dey for difren difren klas wey meni pipul  don know.E don sho as Proteins dem dey chenj and as dem dey do oda tins dem.E don helep us know sey as Proteins dem  dey difren-difren  don mek dem fit alau Immunoglobin dem to fit know plenti-plenti difren Antigens.For 2015, dem elekt Chothia as Fellow of International Society for Computational Biology ((ISCB)and dem gif am di ISCB 
Accomplishment by a Senior Scientist Awod bikos of hau e tek yuz Computation tek know as Proteins dem tek dey.David Haussler and Micheal Waterman dem sef kolet Awod di sembtime wey Chothia kolet
Dan David Prize Awod for Yia 2015 bikos of efri tin dem wey e do do for Bioinformatics wok dem.￼

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Cyrus Chothia

text:
José Mário dos Santos Mourinho Félix GOIH (Dem bon am for January 26, 1963) na profeshional futbol manija an forma futbol playa wey kom fom Portugal.Na im bi di kosh of Seria A klub Roma. Di British midia giv am one nem wey bi di Speshal one an Mourinho na one of di futbol manija wey kolet kop an awod pass for di histri of futbol. Mourinho dey amog one of di futbol manija wey sabi pass in futbol histri.
Wen Mourinho sí sey e fit no mek am as futbol playa, e kuku ma plan to bi futbol kosh.Mourinho fest bi interpreta for Sir Bobby Robson for Sporting CP and for Porto. Afta dat time, e kom bi assitans for Robson an Louis Van Gaal in Barcelona. Mourinho kom stat to dey kosh for smol time for Benfica, den e du kosh smol for Uniäo de Leiria too.In 2002, Mourinho bikom di kosh of Porto an Porto kari dia ligi Primeira Liga two time, UEFA Cup an di Champion League.Di last time wey Porto win Champion League bifor Mourinho na 1987.Bikos e du wel for Porto, Chelsea Klub wey dey England kom Chus am as dia kosh in 2004. Mourinho dat time like to dey mek mouth wel wel wen e stat to dey kosh, e tok dey e na "Speshal one" an na day wod dey tek no am til todey.Wen Mourinho stat to dey kosh Chelsea, e hep di klub win 2 Premier League, 1 FA Cup an 2 League Cup for di three sisin wey e tek kosh di Klub Buford e komot for di klub bikos of sey e an di ona get gbenge smol.
For 2008, Mourinho go kosh Inter Milan wey dey Italy an e hep di klub win Seria A League two time an wetin dem dey kol Treble ( Champion League, Seria A an Copa Italia for one sisin). Di one an onli klub to du am for di histri of klub in Italy. Mourinho dey amog di five kosh in futbol histri wey don win Champion League wit two difren klub.In 2010, FIFA chuz am as di best kosh in di wold.
Mourinho kom go Real Madrid for Spain wey e win La Liga in 2011/2012 wit a rekod point an dis mek am di namor kiba five kosh to win ligi in four difren kontri.Wen Mourinho dey Real Madrid e stil win Copa del Rey an Supercopa de España.
Mourinho komot for Madrid in 2013 an join Chelsea again an for Chelsea e win anoda "Premier League" an "League Cup". Chelsea sack Mourinho in 2015 bikos of bad risot. Mourinho chuz to dey England an e stil kosh Manchester United an Tottenham Hotspur.Di time wey e yuz for di two klub no long bifor dey sack am.
Wen Mourinho kosh Manchester United, e hep di klub win Europa League, League Cup an FA Community Shield an e hep Tottenham to di final of di League.
Roma kom baya Mourinho as dia kosh an e hep Dem win di fest UEFA Europa Conference League.Na Mourinho bi di fest futbol Manija wey don win European Kompetishion wit four difren klub.E stil bi di nomba three manija to win all three major European Klub kompetishion an Mourinho bi di onli manija to win UEFA treble (Champion League, UEFA Cup/Europa League an Europa Conference League.
Na Mourinho dey nem di "Portuguese Coach of the Century" by di PFF ( Portuguese Football Federation) in 2015 an e na di fest kosh to spend ova 1 billion pound on transfa.
Bikos Mourinho sabi futbol mata wel wel, e sabi du shakara wel wel an bikos e like to win marsh even if e game no too swit, pipul dey kompiam wit Argentina kosh Helenio Herrera
title: José Mourinho

text:
Enoch Adejare Adeboye (dem bon am for March 2, 1942) na Naija pasto an Jeneral ovasiya of Redeemed Christian Church of God.

How e tek stat life
Dem bon Enoch Adejare Adeboye on March 2, 1942 in Ifewara wey dey nia Ife in Souta Rijion in Naija.Enoch Adeboye famili no too get moni

How e tek go skull
Adeboye in 1956 stat to go Ilesha Grama Skul wey dey Ilesha for Ogun Stet.Afta dat time, e fest go University of Nigeria, Nsukka (UNN) in Nsukka bot e no finish di skul bikos of di Naija sivu war.Adeboye kom go rid Matimatis an get e fest digri in 1967 for Univasiti of Ife. (di nem of di skul now na Obafemi Awolowo University).
In 1967, Adeboye kom mari e wife, Foluke Adenike an dey bon four pikin:
 Adeolu Adeboye
 Bolu Adubi ( née Adeboye)
 Dare Adeboye
 Leke Adeboye
In 1967, Adeboye get Masta digri in Hydrodynamics fom Univasiti of Legos.In 1975, e get e Ph.D in Applied Mathematics fom di Univasiti of Legos.

E wok as pasto
Adeboye join di Redemed Christian Church of God in 1973 an e du intapreta for di chorch bifor dey mek am pasto.Na pa Josiah Akindayomi in 1975.Adeboye kom bikom jeneral ovasiya of Redeem Chorch in 1981.For three years, Adeboye dey wok for University of Ilorin (Unilorin) an at di sem time, e dey du pasto.
Afta three years wey e dey du tishin an prishin togeda, Adeboye stop to dey tish an yuz all e time an pawa faze prishin.Bifor Adeboye bikom di Jeneral ovasiya of Redeem Chorch, di Chorch no too popula like dat. Adeboye hep di chorch to dey kontri wey go rish 198 kontri an pipul wey dey go di chorch in Naija pass 14 million.Adeboye tok sey e plan na to mek sure sey mek pipul dey si di Chorch evri 5 minit wey dem don waka.
Pipul tok sey Adeboye na pasto wey like to dey prish abaut moni an propati an e sef no folo dem chenj wod bikos of dat.
Bikos Govament tok sey mek enibodi no yuz more dan 20 years tek du oga for organazashon wey no bi biznes Organazashon an sey mek enibodi wey don pass 70 years no bi oga, Adeboye risain as Jeneral ovasiya in 2017.
Adeboye du e 80 years betday in 2022 an e giv hospitu plenti tins on dat day.

Buk wey e don rait
Adeboye don rait meni buk, some of Dem na:
 Open Heavens Daily Devotional
 Lessons from the Sower
 Christian Moderator
 Deadly Enemy of Man
 Divine Favour
 Kingdom Prosperity
 Fruits of the Spirit
 God of Wonders
 God’s Remembrance and Deliverance
 Prevailing Prayers
 The Wonder Working God
 Transitions
 Mathematics & Greatness

Yunivasiti wey e don dash moni
Adeboye don dash four Naija Yunivasiti tins.Di yunifasiti wey e don dash tins inklud: Obafemi Awolowo Yunivasiti an Yunifasiti of Nigeria

Awod wey e don risiv
Newsweek (2008) tok sey Adeboye bi one of di fifti pupil wey get pawa for di hol wold.
New Africa Magazine (2019) tok sey Adeboye dey among di 100 pipul wey get mouth pass for Afrika.

E pasonal life
On February 17, 1967, Adeboye mari Folu Adeboye. E don bon four pikin-dem (three boiz and one gel) and Adeboye get plenti gran-pikin.

On May 4, 2021, Adeboye pikin Dare Adeboye kpai at di age of 42 years.
