text:
Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) na Naija law enforsimet agent wey dey chuk eye for krime abaut moni Palava an 419 issue.
Na for 2003 dey fom EFCC bikos of di komplain wey di inta-govamet organizashion wey di nem bi FATF (Financial Action Task Force on Money Laundering) abaut Naija.FATF nem Naija as one of di twenty-three kontris wey dia hand de inside deyti moni bizness like teroris an drug bizness.
Na Abuja bi dia hed-ofis.

Di wok wey dey don du
EFCC onda dia forma lida, Nuru Ribadu dey dudia best to harest meni big pipul wey don put hand for kriminal mata.E don harest pipul like forma Naija shif law ofisa an meni bank shif esekutiv.In 2015, di EFCC harest govamet pesin wey bi Diepreye Alamieyeseigha.
For September 2006, di EFCC don get 31 of di 36 stet govanor wey EFCC dey luk into dia mata for koropshion.
For December 2007, di fediral govament Afta wey EFCC don chuk eye into dia mata tok sey dia hand klin an tok sey nek dey kom bak to di kontri.Meni Naija niuz pepa like "This Day" Kari di tori an di tok wey Fediral govamet abaut di mata.
For April 2008, di EFCC stat to dey chuk eye for forma Naija presidor gel pikin Iyabo Obasanjo-Bello bikos e kolet Ten million Naira ($100,000) wey dey thif for di dipatmet "Ministry of Health".
EFCC Kari di forma Health Minista (Professor Adenike Grange) an e sekod go kot bikos of di moni wey pass 30 million Naira ($300,000) wey lost from di ministri dipatmet wey sopoz dey for di dipatmet poket.
For June 6, 2008, Chif (Mrs) Farida Mzamber Waziri enta as di oga patapata for EFCC.For 6 August 2008, di komot di posishion of di forma oga patapata of EFCC from AIG (Assistant Inspector General) to DCP (Deputy Commissioner of Police)
Di pesin wey dey kontro di kriminal investigeshon of EFCC, Abdullahi Muazu, na e dey finish e life for Kaduna on September 14, 2010. E don dey chuk eye for meni bank ogas wey EFCC dey kweshon.
Forma presidor komot Farida Waziri as Oga patapata of EFCC on 23 September 2011 an e pik Ibrahim Lamorde as pesin wey go fest jost dey di posishon.In 15 February 2012, di Naija sineti konfam Ibrahim Lamorde as di oga patapata for EFCC.
Wen Muhammadu Bihari enta as Naija presidor, e komot Ibrahim Lamorde as oga for EFCC an pik Ibrahim Magu for November 9, 2015.Di sineti no gri konfam Ibrahim Magu as di Oga patapata of EFCC on two okeshion bikos of sekioriti ripot by pipul wey dey wok for law enforcement agency  giv.
Di Department of State Services join hand wit Nigeria Police Force harest Magu for July 6, 2020 an kari am go Naija presidor villa for som kweshon on korupshon wey pipul tok sey e du.On 7 July 2020, dey sospen Ibrahim Magu as di Oga patapata for EFCC onti investigashon finish on am.
For July 10, 2020, Naija presidor Muhammadu Buhari pik Mohammad Umar Abba as pesin wey go dey akt as oga patapata for EFCC onti di mata for kot finish.
For February 16, 2021, presidor Muhammadu Buhari nominee Abdulrasheed Bawa as pesin wey go bi di oga patapata for EFCC
title: Economic and Financial Crimes Commission

Chronicles from the Land of the Happiest People on Earth na one buk or novel wey Naija raita Wole Soyinka rait for 2021.Di novel na e nomba 3 novel.Di last time wey Wole Soyinka rait novel bifor dis one na in 1973 wen e rait Season of Anomy.

Wetin dey inside di buk
Di buk tok abaut Naija, bot Wole Soyinka rait am as if e jus tink am.For di buk, one sikret Sosaeti dey wey bi ogas for rilijion an politis dey yuz human pat as sakrifas.Di oga-dem dey get di human bodi from Dr.Menka hospitu an na tif dem dey tif di human bodi.Dr.Menka get one frend wey e nem Duyole an Duyole wan go stat niu job for United Nation an di wok dey New York City. E get som juju pawa wey no like mek Duyole go du di wok an dey kom dey distop am so dat e no go fit go du di wok.Dem yuz di tori tek tok abaut di bad-bins wey dey hapun inside gofment wok for Naija and som kontri-dem for Afrika in a metod wey no dey daret so dat meni pipul no go no sey na dem di buk dey tok abaut.

Wetin dey tok about di buk
Meni pipul wey tok abaut buk tok fine -fine tins abaut dis Wole Soyinka Novel.Ben Okri, wey bi Naija raita tok abaut di buk inside The Guardian.E tok dey di buk na " a vast dense Macabre" an e stil tok sey na dis buk gud pass for all di wok wey Wole Soyinka don rait.Ben Okri tok sey di buk na Wole Soyinka rivenji against di pipul wey dey rul in bad way in di kontri an for meni Afrika  kontris in di 21st Senturi.The New York Times to dey Wole Soyinka rait di buk bikos of e pain wey e dey feel for e kontri Naija.
NPR no too tok gud tins abaut di buk an sey di buk no dey among Wole Soyinka best buk. NPR tok sey di buk get som pat wey rili gud an dey di buk mek you no how life bi for Naija.

text:
AIDS wey di full nem na Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome na one disis wey di vairus HIV de korse.HIV full nem na Human immunodeficiency Virus.Wen HIV fest enta pesin bodi, di pesin fit no show eni sahin or e fit jos get smol fifa or kata.Wen di HIV don enta pesin bodi, e go dey inside bodi dey rest an dey gada pawa wey Oyinbo dey kol Inkubashon piriod.Wen di HIV vairus don gada pawa finish, e go stat to fight di pat of di bodi wey no dey gri mek disis enta di bodi.Afta som time, di HIV vairus go kom dey win an kil dose pat, yeye disis wen no sopoz enta bodi go stat to enta bodi an Tumor sef fit stat too.
Wen di HIV vairus don tey inside bodi an dose oda sikness don dey show, we fit tok sey di pesin don get AIDS.Wen di tin don lid to AIDS, di pesin go stat to dey loss bodi fat wey dey inside bodi an e go dey lin.
Tins wey fit mek pesin get HIV inklud Sex wey no get proteshon, to dey kolet an pass blood inside bodi, to dey share nidu an from mama to pikin wey stil dey belle.
Salava, Wota wey dey komot for bodi ( Sweat) an wota wey dey komot for eye (tears) no fit give pesin HIV.Mek pesin dey du oral sex no fit mek pesin get HIV.
If pesin dey du safe sex, no dey kolet an yuz nidu enihow, pesin fit no get HIV.If mama wey get HIV dey yuz di medisine wey dokto sey mek e dey yuz wel, e pikin wey dé belle or wey de giv breast fit no get HIV.
HIV dey korse meni wahala for sosieti bikos of di disis an bikos of how pipul no wan dey du tins wit pipul wey get di sikness.
Meni pipul biliv tins wey no koret abaut HIV. Som of di lie lie tins wey pipul buliv na sey if pesin jos near pesin wey get HIV e sef go get am.
HIV topik don bi big topik for rilijion mata, for ezampul, Katolik chorch tok sey dey no go sopot mek pesin dey yuz kondom bikos of sey e no wan kach HIV.
Meni medikal an politika organasashon don tok abaut dis disis meni time an dey don donate plenti moni bikos of di disis sins 1980s.
Na anima fest stat to get HIV bifor di disis kom stat to dey kach man an wuman too in West Afrika in di eli to di midu of di 20th senturi.Na for CDC (Centers for Disease Control and Prevention) in USA dey tek fest diskova AIDS in 1981. Dey diskova wetin dey korse AIDS in the eli pat of di dekede.
If we kaunt how meni pipul AIDS don kpai from di time wey don diskova di sikness onti 2021, di nomba go don rish 40 million wold wide.For 2021, na 650,000 kpai bikos of AIDS an na abaut 38 million pipul get di disis wold wide.
Di nomba of pipul wey get di disis for Easta an Souta Afrika go rish 20.6 million out of di 38 million wey get am wold wide.HIV dey among di disis wey dey di grup of pandemik disis ( disis wey dey evri wie an wey dey kash pipul fas fas)
Di United States' National Institutes of Health (NIH) join hand wit Gate Foundation tok sey dey go put 200 million dollars mek dey tek find solushion to AIDS.
For now, solutions or vassine neva dey, bot som drug fit hep slow down di disis an pesin wey dey yuz am fit liv norma life.If pesin no yuz di tritmet di pesin fit no liv pass 11 years from di time wey e kash di disis.
Two pipul wey don kash di disis bifor no get am again akordin to ripot as dia tori  nem na Berlin Patient an London patient.
title: HIV/AIDS

text:
Timipre Marlin Sylva CON (dem bon am for 7 July 1964) na Naija politishan an  bifor bifor Govnor of Bayelsa Stet weu de Naija. Timipre Marlin Slyva bi di Minista of State for Petroleum Resources for Naija.

How e tek stat life
Dem born Sylva for Brass wey de inside Bayelsa. (Na from Riva Stet dem komot Bayelsa Stet in 1996). E go skul for Bayelsa Stet an Legos Stet. Sylva don bi  memba for Rivers State House of Assembly in di 1990s.

How e tek go skul
Slyva pass out from Yunivasiti of Port Hakot wit distinshon in English (Linguistics) in 1986. Na Slyva no buk pass inside all di studet wey finish dat year for e dipatmet.For 2011, UBIS Yunivasiti give am Doktoret digri in "International Relations (Honoris causa)" Dey stil give Slyva e sekod Doktoret digri (Honoris causa) on di 2nd of December 2020 by AIPA (African Institute of Public Administration) an LBBS.

Politis
Slyva enta politis for 1992 wen e win House of Assembly eleshon for Brass wey dey inside old Riva Stet. Na Slyva yong pas for inside all di memba of house of Hasebili wey enta.Dey pik Slyva as Speshal Asistans to di Minista of Stet for "Petrolatum" wit di sopot of Dr Edmund Dakouru.E kontinu as Speshal Advaisa onti e komot go PDP go kolet pamari tiket for pipul wey wan bi Govno for Bayelsa Stet in 2006.For di pamari eleshon, na Dr. Goodluck Jonathan win an e kari sekod.Wen PDP kom du dia pamari eleshon for pipul-dem wey go like bi presidor of Naija, dey pik Umaru Musa Yar'adua wey don kpai now an Goodluck Jonathan as e vais.Sins Goodluck Jonathan no fit get two tiket for vais-presidor an Govno, e pik di vais-presidor an rilis di Govno tiket for Slyva.
Na PDP win as Govno for di 2007 Bayelsa Stet Govnoship eleshon. Slyva tek ova from di forma Govno wey bi Goodluck Jonathan.For di parti wey dey du so dat e go stat to dey du as Govnor, Slyva tok sey na Bayelsa bi di Stet wey no divelop  among di 36 Stet wey dey Naija.
Ebitimi Amgbare wey di oponet onda "Action Congress" for di 2007 Govnoship eleshon tok sey e no gri for di risot wey mek Slyva bi Govno.Ebitimi Amgbare kari di mata go kot an di kot kansu di eleshon risot. Di kot tok sey mek Slyva komot as Govno an mek dey mek di Spika of di House Werinipre Seibarugo as aktin govno onti dey du niu eleshon wey happun afta three month.
For May 24, 2008, dey du niu eleshon an Slyva wey bi PDP win 588,304 votes of di hol 598,000 wey de kaunt.Dey mek Slyva govno on May 27.
On January 27, 2012, Supreme kot rimuv Slyva as Govnor of Bayelsa Stet an dey pik Aktin Govno for di Stet onti February 2012 wey dey du anoda eleshon.
Presidor Buhari pik Slyva as Naija kabinet Minista of Stet for petirolium Risosis on August 21, 2019.

Korupshon mata
Afta wey dey pass "Petroleum Industry Bill" for August 2021, dey hakwues or blame Slyva sey e wan try bribe Fediral pipul wey dey mek Law even wen Naija pipul no wan somtin wey dey inside di Bill.
For one ripot wey dey People Gazette, e tok sey Slyva an Bassey Albert Akpan give moni wey go rish $10,million as bribe. From di $10 million dollar, Sinate Presidet Ahmad Lawal an House Spika Femi Gbajabiamila poket bitwin $1.5 million to $2 million.
Meni Fediral pipul wey dey mek law vex on di mata bikos wayo de how dey poker di moni bikos som of dem tok sey na onli $5,000 memba wey dey house of reprisetativ kolet an memba wey dey sinate tok sey dey kolet $20,000.
Gbajabiala, Lawal, Akpan an Slyva do BRI komet for di mata.

Awod
In October 2022, President Muhammadu Bihari give Slyva one Nashional honor awod wey di nem na Commander of the Order of the Niger CON.
title: Timipre Sylva

text:
Rabiu Kwankwaso FNSE, FNIQS (dem bon am for October 21, 1956) na Naija politishian an forma govno of Kano Stet from 1999 go rish 2003. E still bi govno of Kano Stet from 2011 go rish 2015.Afta wey Kwankwaso no win re-eleshon for 2003, forma presidor Olusegun Obasanjo pik am as di fest Minista of Defens of di Forth Riplobik even sef e no get eni esperiens abaut Miitri.Kwankwaso du Minista for Defens from 2003 go rish 2007.For 2015, e bi sinator wey dey ripreset Kano Sentra Sinatoriha District.Na one term e yuz an na onda APC (All progressives Congress) e tek enta as sinator.
For now, Kwankwaso bi di Nashiona lida for di "New Nigeria People Party".Pipul luv Kwankwaso for Kano an for North-Westa Naija.Meni pipul si am as politishian wey dey konsida di pipul onda am wen e dey rule dem.
For 2011, Kwankwaso win eleshion as di Govno for di sekod time onda di politika parti APC.
Kwankwaso enta as one of di pipul wey go like be Naija presidor for di pamari wey APC du bot na Muhammad Buhari dey fanali chuz.For 2018, e go PDP go du pamari for pipul wey go like bi presidor for PDP bot na Atiku Abubakar dey chuz.
NNPP (New Nigeria Peoples Party) don pik Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso as di pesin wey go repiset di parti fight for presidet for di 2023 jeneral eleshon.

How e tek stat life
Dem bom Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso for October 21, 1956 in Kano.Na Islam Fulani of Genawa Fulani traib.Kwankwaso papa bi di hed of Kwankwaso vilej an e taitu na "Sarkin Fulani Dagacin Kwankwaso".Afta somtime, dey mek Kwankwaso papa di Distrit Hed of Madoni an giv e papa di taitu "Majidadin Mano, Hakimin Madoni" by di Kano Emirate Council wen Alhaji Ado Bayero stil bi di 13th Fulani Emir of Kano.

How e tek go skul
Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso go Kwankwaso pamari skul, Gwarzo Bordin sinior pamari skul, Wudi kraft skul an Kano teknika kolej bifor e kom go Kaduna Politeknik. Na for di Politeknik e tek du e Nashional Diploma (ND) an Haya Nashional Diploma (HND).
Wen Kwankwaso still de skul, e na studet lida an e bi one of di ofishal Kano Stet Studet Hasosiashion.
From 1982 go rish 1983, Kwankwaso go Middlesex Politeknik wey de United Kindom go du e Post Graduate stodi.E still go Loughborough Yunifasiti of Teknologi go du e Masta digri in Wota Enginerin in 1985.Kwankwaso finish e Ph.D in Wota Enginerin for Sharda Yunifasiti

How e tek wok
Kwankwaso stat to wok for Kano Stet Wota Risosis an Enjinerin konstrushon Ajensi in 1975.Na Govamet of Kano Stet DW kontrol di Ajensi.E wok for dia for 17 years inside meni ples for di Ajensi onti dey mek am di presipal wota enjineha

How e tek wok in politis
Kwankwaso stat politis wen e join di politika parti SDP (Social Democratic Party).E dey for di grup wey jenera Shehu Yar'adua an oda popula politishian dey kontrol inside di SDP parti.Di oda politishian nem bi: Magaji Abdullahi, Babagana Kingibe, Atiku Abubakar, Bola Tinubu, Tony Anenih, Chuba Okadigbo, Abdullahi Aliyu Sumaila, Abubakar Koko an Lamidi Adedibu
For 1992, Kwankwaso bi di memba of House of Representativ wey dey represet Madobi Fediral Konstituensi.E stat to dey popula for Nashional politis afta dey chuz am as di Deputi Spika of di House.Durin di 1995 konstitushon konfirens, dey chuz Kwankwaso as di pesin wey go repriset Kano onda di memba of "People's Democratic Movement" .Na Yar'adua lid di grup.
Wen General [Sani Abacha]] tok sey e wan komot as militri ptesidor an hand-ova govamet for sivilian govamet, Kwankwaso go join DPN.(Democratic Party of Nigeria).
Na in 1998 Kwankwaso join PDP onda di platfom People's Democratic Movement in Kano.Pipul wey de lid di parti dat time na 
Mallam [Musa Gwadabe]], Senator Hamisu Musaan halaji Abdullahi Aliyu Sumaila.In 1999, Kwankwaso du pamari eleshon wit PDP an pipul wey folo-am du di pamari bi: Abdullahi Umar Ganduje, Mukthari Zimit, Ahlaji Kabiru Rabiu. Di Santsi/P.S.P. dey di bak of Abdullahi Umar Ganduje bot na Kwankwaso win di pamari eleshon.

Govno of Kano Stet
 Fest term
Kwankwaso bi di govno of Kano Stet from May 29, 1999 go rish May 29, 2003.Kwankwaso fest term as govno for Kano Stet no easi at all bikos of meni group dey against how e dey du e govno as e no dey Kari odas along.Anoda tin wey mek e fest term no easi na bikos e dey sopot Olusegun Obasanjo wey bi Yoruba presidet for eleshon.Kwankwaso no win di nes eleshon an na Malam Ibrahim Shekarau win an bikom di nes govno of Kano Stet.
 Sekod term
Kwankwaso kom bak as di govno of Kano Stet from May 29, 2011 go rish May 29, 2015.Dorin e sekod term, Kwankwaso du meni tins. E stat to dey du road, hispitu, skuls an kari meni Pipul go obodo oyibo go rid for dia.
In August 2013, Kwankwaso dey for di Seven govno wey join bodi Tek fom di G-7 govno wey dey PDP.
Wen November 2013 rish, E komot from PDP go join di niu oposishon parti APC.

2015 presidenta kampain
Kwankwaso bikos of di plenti pipul wey dey e bak kolet pamari tiket sey e wan bi APC presidenta kandidet in October 2014.Wen dey du di pamari eleshon for Legos finish, na Muhammadu Buhari win. Muhammadu Buhari get 3,430, Kwankwaso get 974, Atiku Abubakar get 954, Rochas Okorocha get 400 an Sam Nda-Isiah get 10 among all di vote wey dey kaunt day day.
How e tek wok afta e finish gorvonoship==
Olusegun Obasanjo chuz Kwankwaso as di Minista if Defens from 2003 go rish 2007.Na Kwankwaso kolet wok from Theophilus Danjuma as di Minista of Defens.

Sineto of Naija
Na Kwankwaso bi di Kano Sentral District sineto from May 2015 go rish May 2019.

2019 presidenta kampain
Kwankwaso an fourteen sineto wey still dey pawa dat time komot from APC go join PDP in July 2018.Wen October 2018 rish, Kwankwaso kolet pamari tiket of PDP sey e sef wan bi PDP presidenta kandidet.For di eleshon wey dey du for Riva Stet, na forth posishon Kwankwaso kari. Na Atiku Abubakar win di pamari wit 1532 vote, folo by Aminu Tambuwal wit 693 vote, folo by Bukola Saraki wit 317 vote. Kwankwaso wey kari four get 158 vote.

How e tek fom e politika parti
On February 2022, Kwankwaso set up di "National Movement" as a politika movement.E fom di politika parti bikos of di two politika parti wey dey Naija, di APC an PDP. Di nem of e parti na New Nigeria Peoples Party as di politika wing of di parti. For March 30, 2022, Kwankwaso bikom di parti Nashional lida.
title: Rabiu Kwankwaso

text:
Chinyere Ohiri-Aniche (e kpai in 2018) na Naija professo an pesin wey stodi human langwejis. From 2016 go rish wen e kpai, Chinyere Ohiri-Aniche bi di Oga patapata for di "National Institute for Nigerian Language (NINLAM)"

How e tek go skull
Ohiri-Aniche kolet B.Sc. in "French an "Linguistic" from Georgetown University for 1975.E kolet e M.Ed in "Language Teaching" from University of Montreal an na University of Port Harcourt in 1991 e tek kolet e Ph.D
Ohiri-Aniche bikom a sinior leshura wey dey tish Igbo edukeshon in University of Lagos
Two akademik buk tok an honor Ohiri-Aniche in 2015.
Wen e stil bi Oga patapata for LAN (Linguistic Association of Nigeria), Ohiri Aniche tok sey ova 400 Naija langwej de denja as in dey fit no de again.For August 2016, Naija presidor Muhammadu Buhari mek Ohiri-Aniche di CEO (Chief Executive Officer) of "National Institute of Nigerian Language" (NINLAN).
E kolet di posishon of oga patapata of NINLAN from Ben Elugbe an na Ohiri-Aniche bi di third esekutiv daretor of NINLAN.By di end of 2016, e tok sey fifti Naija langwej don dey di levu wey dey go kpai finali.
Chinyere Ohiri-Aniche kpai in September 2018.
Wok wey e du
 A comparative phonology of consonants in the Igboid, Edoid, and Yoruboid languages of Nigeria. PhD thesis, University of Port Harcourt, 1991.
 'Language diversification in the Akoko area of Western Nigeria', in R. M. Blench & M. Spriggs (eds.) Archaeology and Language IV. Language change and cultural transformation, 1999, pp. 79–94. 
 'Language pluralism and national development in Nigeria', in A. E. Eruvbetine (ed.) The humanistic management and pluralism: A formula for development in Nigeria, 2001, pp. 544–560.
 (ed. with Iwu Ikwubuzo and Chigozie Nnabuihe) Udezuluigbo: a festschrift in honour of Sam Uzochukwu. Itire, Lagos, Nigeria : Green Olive, 2008.
 (ed. with T. Uzodinma Nwala and Nath Aniekwu) Igbo nation: history & challenges of rebirth and development''. Ibadan, Nigeria : Kraft Books Limited, 2015.
title: Chinyere Ohiri-Aniche

text:
Omoleye "Yele" Sowore (dem bon am for February 16, 1971) na Naija pesin wey dey fight for human mata, an pesin wey dey kampain for Demokrasi govamet in Naija.Na Omoleye Sowore bi di founda of Sahara Reporters wey bi online Niuz Agensi.For August 2018, e fom di African Action Congress parti an e bi di kandidet of di parti for di parti chuz to go bi di presidor of Naija in di 2019 jeneral eleshon.
Di Nigerian State Security Service harest Sowore on August 3, 2019 bikos dey tok sey e dey fight govamet bifor of di ralli wey e du. Di nem of di ralli na "RevolutionNow".
Dey stil harest an flog Sowore dorin one protest in Abuja on January 1, 2021.
Sowore stil sofa injuri dorin a protest in Abuja on May 31, 2021.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na from Ese-Odo, Ondo Stet Yele Sowore.Na for Naijá Delta rijion dey tek bon Sowore ( Naijá Delta get six Stet an som of dem na Ondo Stet, Abia Stet an Imo Stet.Wen Sowore dey 12 years, e dey yuz okada evri morin go riva go dey kach fish so dat e famili go fit chop.Na bikos of how militari govamet dey tek yuz dia pawa mek Sowore tok sey e sef go dey wok for niuz if e gro.
Sowore go rid Jiografi an Planin for University of Lagos from 1989 go rish 1995. E no finish yunivasiti on time bikos dey tok sey mek e go stay for house for two years bikos of e politikal risin an student hativitis.Sowore bi di presidor of Yunivasiti of Lagos Studet Yunior bitwin 1992 go rish 1994.Wen e bi presidor of Studet Yunior, e tok against kortis an korupshion.Sowore get Masta digri for Poblik Hadministrashon from Kolombiha Yunivasiti.

How e tek wok
For 1989, Sowore tek pat in "we no go gree" wey studet du bikos of di kondishon wey IMF (International Monetary Fund) tok sey Naija go du bifor dey boro dem $120 million wey dey wan tek du orye pahip line.Di kondishon bi sey dey go ridus nomba of Naija yunivasiti from 28 to 5 yunivasiti.
Na Sowore bi di lida wey kari 5,100 studet du di "we no go gree" rahiot in 1992.Na Seven studet police kpai for di rahiot.Police harest Sowore an beat am.Sowore still dey among di pipul wey fight sey we no wan militiri govamet, sey mek Demokrasi govamet dey Naija on June 12, 1993.For harest Sowore meni times by govamet pipul.

E harest
Di DSS harest Sowore on August 3, 2019 bikos of sey e dey plan one "we no go gree" protest lol #RevolutionNow protest.Meni popula pipul kondem di harest. Pipul like Wole Soyinka, Oby Ezekwesili an odas.Dey hakuss Sowore sey e dey fight against Govamet an e dey yap or insolt Presidet Muhammadu Bihari.
Fediral Govamet give Sowore bail on September 24, 2019 on di kondishon sey e go rilis e intanashional passport witdin 48 hours.
Wen Sowore wan tok to Niuz pipul on September 29, 2019, e tok abaut di kind sofa sofa wey e si for prisin.E tok sey dey gree mek Boko Haram ogas dey yuz telifone an TV for prisin bot e no fit yuz did tins.Di kot kom tok sey mek Sowore dey go home on December 5, 2019 afta wey e don setu e bail.DSS stil kom harest am di sem day again. E finali mek am go home on December 24, 2019.
For December 2021, di Hi Kot for Abuja tok sey mek DSS (Department of State Service) to pay 2 million Naira give Sowore bikos of e fone wey dey kolet for e hand wen de harest am in 2019.

Sahara Riportas
Sowore stat Sahara Riportas in New York City in 2006.E tok sey e fom Sahara Riportas bikos e wan tek am fight korupshon an bad govamet pratis.
Sahara Riportas no dey kolet moni from Naija Govamet bot na Ford Foundashon an Omidyar Foundashon.

Presidenshal Kampain
For February 2018, Sowore mek pipul no sey e wan go for presidet of Naija in di 2019 Nigerian general election.Sowore fom a politikal parti kol African Action Congress, (AAC).Na dis AAC parti e wan tek kolet tiket as Naija Presidor in 2019.Wen di parti du dia pamari eleshon, na onli Sowore kom out as kandidet for presidet on October 6, 2018.
Afta wen Sowore don go mit meni big pipul for Naija like Emir of Kano an Wole Soyinka, E stat to dey waka all around di wold lukin for moni.Sowore go Australia, United State of America an UK.Sowore dey Luton, London on 10 November2018.

Eleshon risot
Na Sowore kari nomba 5 posishon wit 33,953 wen di risot of di eleshon kom out.Muhammadu Buhari of APC win di eleshon wit 15,191,847 votes an na Atiku Abubakar of PDP kari sekod wit 11,264,977 votes. Sowore pass Fela Durotoye of Alliance for New Nigeria wey get 16,779 votes an Kingsley Moghalu of di Young Democratic Party (YPP) wey get 21,886 votes

E pasonal life
Sowore an e famili dey live for Haworth, New Jersey.
For September 2021, dey tok sey Sowore junior broda kpai wen kidnapas shot am for Edo Stet.
title: Omoyele Sowore

Samuel Iorear Ortom (dem bon am for 23 April 1961), na Naija politishian, biznes pesin an e lik to dey hep pipul. Na e bi di bifor bifor Minister for State Trade and Investment onda Goodluck Jonathan govamet. Ortom enta as Govno for Benue Stet onda All Progressive Congress parti in 2015. E stil kon enta as Govno for sekod time on 29 May 2019.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Dem bon Samuel Ortom on 23 April 1961 in Guma lokal Govamet for Benue Stet, Naija. E go St John's Pamari Skul wey dey Gboko in 1970 but e kon leta go St Catherine's Pamari Skul wey dey Markurdi in 1974.Na for 1976 e finish pamari Skul. Ortom enta Idah Secondary Commercial College, wey dey Kogi Stet| Kogi State. E du two years for di skul bifor dem stop im papa for Govment wok, wey kon mek am no finish sekondri skul bikos of moni. E leta stat to dey du driva wok. 

E leta get General Certificate of Education an Diploma in Salesmanship E go Ahmadu Bello University,Zaria to get Interim Matriculation Board Certificate, in 1995, an Diploma in Journalism in 1998. E stil leta go Benue State University go get Advance Diploma in Personnel Management in 2001 an Member of Public Administration insaid 2004. Ortom get PHD fom di Commonwealth University, Belize.

Hau e tek wok for politis.
Ortom wok for difren parti for politis insaid Benue Stet some of dem na National Center Party of Nigeria as Stet Secretary, Stet Treasuerer for All Peoples Party (APP), second chairman for Peoples Democratic Party (PDP). Na Ortom bi di Director of Operation for PDP Campaign for Benue Stet in 2007 an Director of Administration for Goodluck/Sambo Campaign Organization for Benue insaid 2011, Na im bi di PDP National Auditor bifor im bi Minister for Naija.

text:
Jessie Laidlay Weston (wey dem bon for 28 December 1850 an e kpai for 29 November 1928) na pesin wey dey stodi on im own an wey sabi tins abaut kolsho.

Hau shi tek stat life
Weston na William Weston pikin, dem Sabi im papa for di tea biznes wey e dey du an na memba for Salters' company, e get two wife, di sekond wife nem na Sarah Buton,dem dey kol am first wife nem wey bi Laidlay Weston. Sarah die afta e bon two pikin, an na wen Jessica bi 7 years old. William kom mari anoda wife wey bi Clara King an shi Kon bon five pikin. Dem bon all di sinior pikin for Surrey, but di junior one, Clearance na Kent dem bon am. Jessie, im sista Frances an broda Clearance leta go dey live Bournemouth, na dat ples Jessica stat to dey rait buk, na Bournemouth shi dey til 1903. Di ples wey shi live for 65 Lansdowne Road stil dey dia rich 2010. Jessie skul for Hildesheim an stil go Paris, France onda Gaston Paris. Shi go Crystal Palace School of Art sef. 

One of di buk wey shi fest rait na The Rose-Tree of Hildesheim. Na tori wey shi get fom di Thousands year rose, wey gro for Hildesheim Cathedral wall.

Hau shi tek wok
Plenti pipul sabi im From Ritual to Romance (1920) wok. Insaid di buk shi tok abaut George Frazer on di Grail Legend, shi tok abaut di ples dem kom fom. T.S Elliot menshon Cassie wok insaid The Waste Land(1982), an stil tok say Cassie wok dey insaid wetin mek James Frazer's The Golden Bough poem. Dem tek insaid d buk tek du Apocalypse fim. 

Wen som pipul dey tok sey Weston wok for Grail Theme no bi gud wok, Plenti pipul lik di kain way e dey rait love stories.

text:
Martha Nelson Thomas(dem bon Martha Marie Nelson,for November 29,1950-May26,2013)na one Amerika folk  artist,wey plenti pipul know sey na Soft Skupsho wok shi dey do.
Na Thomas kriet "Doll Babies" wey dem yuz for Cabbage Patch Kids.

Im Baografi
Dem bon Martha Nelson for Princeton, Kentucky.Im papa an mama nem na Ralp an Ernestine Nelson.Wen shi stil smol, Im famili muv go Mayfield, Kentucky.
Na for Louisville School of Art shi graduet.Martha Nelson mari Tucker Thomas for October 10,1981.Dem kom bon three pikin dem ,Seth,Carl an Mara.Martha na sista to Albert Nelson wey dey stey for Louisville an dey kav ston for dia.
For 1971 wen shi stil bi student,Thomas stat to dey pratis to dey do smol-smol doll dem for Soft Skupsho.
Na wetin smol-smol pikin dem dey do shi dey tek do di Doll BabiesNa hand shi dey tek do di wok an dey sell am for Craft Fairs araund Louisville, Kentucky.
For 1976,Thomas mit Xavier Roberts for for one of di Cratf Fairs dem.Xavier tel Thomas sey mek shi soplai plenti doll dem wey dem go sel for Georgia,wie Im dey Liv an dey wok.Thomas alau am to dey sel di Doll Babies dem for some taim bot shi kom stop Roberts sef kom stat im own vashon for 1978, and for im kolet laisens for di dolls  and kom tel Coleco to do am pleti and Im kom kol am Cabbage Patch Kids
For 1979, Thomas Kari Roberts go court for di fest time.By 1983, shi stat to find hau Roberts go tek pey am $1 million for damej dem.For 1984, dem setul di mata bai dem sef and dem no go courtagen bot no bodi know hau mosh dem tek setul di mata.Araund dis time, Cabbage Patch Kids don popula so tey pipul dey buk and dey wait for di doll dem for like nine- month.Thomas sel meni of im wok tru Fibre-Craft wey bi like Im orijina Doll Babieswey alau kostoma to dey sow dia own doll.For dat time dem don dey sel Cabbage Patch Kids for $30- $150;di totaDoll Babieswey Thomas dey sel kost abuat $16.Afta di courtkes Martha kontiniu to dey kriat art truaut im life.
Some of im projet dem inklud toy wey shi do from di tins dem wey im pikin dem draw and som wey shi yuz socks tek do.
Martha and im famili sel al dis tins wey shi kriat dem for Loka kratf fairs.
Martha try wel wel tek sopot mek  smol pikin dem luv art.Shi bi artist wey dey stey for smol pikin elementri skul and shi do plenti workshop dem wit di loka girl skaut demand oda oganaizeshon dem.
Thomas dai for Louisville, Kentucky on May 26,2013 afta shi batul wit Ovarian  Kansa.
Dem ezibit im wok dem for High Museum of Art

text:
Dorothea Viehmann (Dem bon am for November 8, 1755 an e kpai November 17, 1816) na Jaman wuman wey sabi tok  tori wel wel.Na e tori bi di koko tori wey dey Brothers Grimms koleshon. Meni tori wey Dorothea Viehmann tok dey di sekod volum of "Grimm's Fairy Tales"

How e tek stat life
Di nem wey dey giv Dorothea Viehmann wen dey bom am na Katharina Dorothea Pierson.Na for Rengershausen wey near Kassel dey tek bon am.E papa an mama get ples wey pipul fit buy ogogoro.Viehmann gra gra papa-dem bi dose Huguenots wey run komot from Franss go Hasse-Kassel bikos dey kansu di Edit of Nantes wey favor di Huguenots wey dey Franss.As Viehmann dey gro up, e dey lisin to difren difren tori wey e papa frend-dem dey tok as dem dey kom tek ogogoro inside Viehmann papa shop.
Dorothea Pierson mari e hosband Nikolaus Viehmann wey bi telor in 1777.Na for Niederzwehren wey bi pat of di siti of Kassel dey live from 1787 go rish 1798.Na onli Viehmann tekia of e seven pikin wey dey bon wen e hosband kpai. E dey yuz wetin e sel from di farm gadin tek tekia of dem.
Viehmann stat to no di "Brother Grimm" in 1813 an e tel dem ova forti tori wit difren difren fashon.Bikos na Huguenot Viehmann gra papa-dem kom from, na french tori e dey tel dem.Wilhelm Grimm rait sey na shans e an e broad tek jam Viehmann.Wilhelm Grimm tok sey di wuman fit tok e tori ova an ova again an di wuman no go chenj one wod.Meni of Viehmann tori de wey no komplet.

Tori wey e tok 
Som tori wey de inside Grimm's Fairy Tales fit don bi wetin Dorothea Viehmann tok. Dem bi:
KHM 9: The Twelve Brothers (Die zwölf Brüder)
KHM 29: The Devil With the Three Golden Hairs (Der Teufel mit den drei goldenen Haaren)
KHM 34: Clever Elsie (Die kluge Else)
KHM 61: The Little Peasant (Das Bürle)
KHM 63: The Three Feathers (Die drei Federn)
KHM 71: How Six Men got on in the World (Sechse kommen durch die ganze Welt)
KHM 76: The Pink (Die Nelke)
KHM 89: The Goose Girl (Die Gänsemagd)
KHM 94: The Peasant's Wise Daughter (Die kluge Bauerntochter)
KHM 98: Doctor Know-all (Doktor Allwissend)
KHM 100: The Devil's Sooty Brother (Des Teufels rußiger Bruder)
KHM 102: The Willow-Wren and the Bear (Der Zaunkönig und der Bär)
KHM 106: The Poor Miller's Boy and the Cat (Der arme Müllersbursch und das Kätzchen)
KHM 108: Hans My Hedgehog (Hans mein Igel)
KHM 111: The Skillful Huntsman (Der gelernte Jäger)
KHM 115: The Bright Sun Brings it to Light (Die klare Sonne bringt's an den Tag)
KHM 118: The Three Army Surgeons (Die drei Feldscherer)
KHM 125: The Devil and His Grandmother (Der Teufel und seine Großmutter)
KHM 127: The Iron Stove (Der Eisenofen)
KHM 128: The Lazy Spinner (Die faule Spinnerin)

Lokashon an e berial
Di ples wey bi Niederzwehren bifor don bi "Märchenviertel,Fairy Tale Quarter".Dey yuz di niu nem tek honor Viehmann. Two timba house dey sho di ples wey Dorothea Viehmann don liv bifor bitwin 1787 to 1798 an from 1798 onti e kpai.
Dey nem "Quater's elementary school" an one moto pak mek e dey ansa di wuman nem.
Di ogogogo shop wey Viehmann papa get dat time don dey di lokal "Hütt Brewery" now.
In 2019, Berahna Massoum wey bi hatist mek one emage for Dorothea Viehmann.Di emage sey klose to "Fairy Tale Quarter".
title: Dorothea Viehmann

text:
Linda Dégh (dem bon am for 18 March 1918 an e kpai for 19 August 2014) na pesin wey dey stodi tradishional tori of pipul an e bi professo of Folklore an Ethnomusicology for Indiana Yunivasiti, USA.
Na for Budapest, wey de Hungary dey tek bon Linda Dégh.Deigh popula as pesin wey sabi tradishional tori as e sabi wok on tori wey consain Legend, orijin of tins an how vilej an siti tek stat in Yurope an Nort Amerika.
Dégh wey don bi professo Emerita for Indiana Yunivasiti kolet "AFS Lifetime Scholarly Achievement Award" in 2014. For 1982, na Dégh bi di presidor of di American Folklore Society.

How e tek stat life
Na for Budapest wey de Hungary dey tek bon Linda Dégh on March 18, 1920. Dégh kpai on August 19, 2014.Andrew Vázsonyi(1906-1986)  bi e hosband an di marej last for 28 years.

How e tek go skul an wok
Linda Dégh get e digree from Pèter Pázmány University wey de Hungary.Wen e finish for di yunivasiti, e stat to tish for folklore dipamet in Eötvös Loránd University. For 1965, Dégh stat to tish for Folklore institute wey de Indiana Yunivasiti, Bloomington.By di time wey 1982 go rish, e don bikom a distinguwish professo of Folklore and Ethnomusicology for Indiana Yunivasiti.
Wen Dégh stil dey tish for di Yunivasiti, e fom di jonal "Indiana Folklore " in 1968 an na Dégh bi di editor onti di jonal no kom de again.Na for 1980 di jonal stop to dey again an bifor den, di jonal bi di ofisha jonal of Hoosier Folklore Society. Dey stil mek Dégh di presidor of Hoosier Folklore Society in 1967 an 1968.Na for 1971 dey mek Dégh "Fellow of the American Folklore Society".For 1982, Dégh don bi di presidor of di Amerika Folklore Society an for 2004 dey giv Dégh "Lifetime Scholarly Achievement Award.
Dégh poblish 18 buks an rait ova 200 hatikul an essa.Pipul no wel wel for e wok wit legend an for di wey e dey yuz Ostention  du e wok.For 1983, Dégh an Andrew Vázsonyi rait "Does the Word 'Dog' Bite?" "Ostensive Action:A Means of Legend Telling" an e tok sey dey fit akt legend apart of mek dey Jos tok am.
Wen Dégh stat to wok on di wok of Ivo Osolsobê, Umberto Eco, Ludwig Wittgenstein an Bertrand Russell, dey tok sey na five ways dey fit divide folklore:
 Ostention
 Pseudo-ostention
 Quasi-Ostention
 False-Ostention 
 Proto-Ostention.

text:
Hester Jonas ( wey dey bon araud 1570 an e kpai December 24, 1635) na German norse an Wayo wuman.Dey Kil-am bikos e na witch.Pipul sabi am wel wel as "Witch of Neuss.
How e tek stat life
Na for Dormagen dey tek bon Hester Jonas.Wen e mari miller Peter Meurer, dey komot go live for Neuss.Afta e marej, Hester Jonas stat to get epiletik an shoki.E kom wok as norse wey dey tekia of mama an dia pikin an pipul biliv sey e get wayo wel wel.
Hester Jonas no how to yuz plant an tek trit pipul espeshali Mandrake.
Wen Hester Jonas bi 64 years, pipul hakuss am sey e bi witch, dey harest am, ask am kweshon, flog am an kari am kom di kot mek e faze Mayor or joj of Neuss.Di kot pass jojmet sey Hester Jonas don du padi padi wit Devil.Di kot fest lisin to e kase for November 15, 1635 an dey kom du e sekod yeerin for November 22, 1635. Hester Jonas tok sey e no bi witch an sey na lahi bi all di tins wey pipul dey tok abaut am. Afta wey Twenty-Eight days don pass for December 19 an 20, dey forse am to sit-down on top of chair wey pin or nail dey for almost three hours.Afta wey dey don beat Hester Jonas wel wel, e kom konfess sey e slip wit  one blak man wey e nem na "Hans Beelzebub" an sey e dey damej hanima an human bein wit blak majik. Hester Jonas eskape from wey dey lock am bot dey stil kach am bak.
Hester Jonas stil no gri sey na witch not wen beatin too plenti e gri sey e na witch di next day Afta dey kach am.Wen e don gri for all di tins wey pipul tok abaut am, di kot kom tok sey mek dey go kil-am by kotin e hed komot. 
For 24 December 1635, dey komot Hester Jonas hed. Dey put faya for e dead bodi an hashes wey rimen, dey skata am for all di Four aria of di ples.
Di rekod of how evritin tek happun dey di siti rekod  of Neuss.
Smol informashon abaut am
 "The ballad of Hester Jonas"'' by Peter Maiwald
 German folk rock band Cochise sing one song for Jonas.
title: Hester Jonas

text:
Mona Lisa Saloy na Amerika raita an pesin wey dey rait abaut tradishional tori. E bi "Poet Laureate of Louisiana sins 2021.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for New Orleans dey tek bon Mosa Lisa Sally an e go rid Inglish from Yunivasiti of Washington. Mona Lisa Saloy get e BA from di Yunivasiti in 1979. E go  San Francisco Stet Yunivasiti go get e MA in kreative raitin an Inglish in 1982.Na for  Louisiana Stet Yunivasiti e tek du e Ph.D in Inglish in 2005 an MFA in kreatin raitin in 1988.Saloy bi di "Conrad N. Hilton Endowed Professor of English at Dillard Yunivasiti.
Saloy raitin don sho inside meni poblishashon like Louisiana Folklore Miscellany, The Southern Poetry Anthology an The Children's Folklore Review. One of Saloy buk wey bi "Red Beans & Nicely Yours" win di 2005 T.S Eliot Prize an PEN/Oakland Josephine Miles Prize in 2006.Pipul sabi Saloy wel we'll bikos e like to dey rait abaut di pipul an kolshor esperiens of New Orleans.E don kolet meni awod an meni honor.One of dem na "di Mayor's Office Tricentennial Grant''" in 2018.

Buk wey e don rait

Groven Myhren don wok as aktor bifor for Det Noske Teatret, Riskteatret an Hordaland Theater.

Groven Myhren na di pikin wey Dagne Groven Myhren an Magne Myhren bon. Dagne Griven Mayhren na pesin wey dey du risach abaut buks an Magne Myhren sabi plenti Laguag.

Barbara Barnard Smith(June 8,1920-July 3,2021)na one Amerika enthnomusicologist wey stat and difelop di fild of enthnomusicology for Yunifasiti of Hawaii.
Shi bi Profeso Emeritus of music for  di Yunifasiti.Aldo dem emploi am to dey tich Piano and Western muzik;shi biliv sey dis kind tin go distroi indigenousHawai'ian and Pasifik Islandkulsho dem wey bi ancestral eritej of most of di student dem.Shi kom stat to dey len abaut hau stodi hau to tich an hau to rait abaut lokal indigenous Muzik and dans.
Barbara Barnard Smith kontiniu to advais PhD. student dem on top dia dissertafions on til di time wey shi dai for 101 yias of age.Na shi bi di gret grand girl pikin of William Dewey Hobson,wey bi pipul know as di fada of Ventura County,California.Smith stat im karia for di UH Manoa for 1949 to dey tich Piano and muzik tiori,afta shi don get Masta Digri for muzik litresho from di Eastman Skul of muzik.
For October 1972,shi edit one speshal edishon of di muzik Edukeshon Jonal to mek ethnomusicology go hai pas speshalis dem.
title: Barbara Barnard Smith

text:
Ethel Rudkin (Dem bon am in 1893 an e kpai on 21 September1985) na Inglish raita, histrie tela, tradishional tori tela an pesin wey dey stodi wey tin dey komot inside ground.Na from Lincolnshire dey tek bon am.Rudkin de among dos wey fest to dey kolet tradishional tori matiriha abaut Lincolnshire an som of wetin e kolet de Meni poblik institushon an North Lincolnshire Museum.

How e tek stat life
Na for 1893 dey bon Ethel Hutchinson in Willoughton, Lincolnshire.E papa an mama nem na Richard an Ethel Hutchinson.Rudkin mama famili kom from Suffolk.Wen Rudkin stil dey young, e dey tish an tekia of pikin wey one famili get.In 1917, Rudkin mari George Rudkin wey kom from Folkingham.Akordin to wetin dey rait for e obituari di marej swit bot e no last as e hosband kpai one year afta marej in 1918.George wey bi e hosband bi ofisa in di Machine Gun Corps dorin di Fest Wold War an e kpai bikos of di sikness way happun dat wen kash pipul for nose, throat.Dey giv e hosband one awod wey bi Militiri kross.Wen George kpai, Rudkin go bak to Willoughton to de wit e paret an tekia of dem.
Leta in Rudkin life, Lucy Arliss join am stey togeda an e hep am to dig ground to get matiriha for e wok.Lucy Arliss no leave Rudkin ontil e kpai.In 1972, Rudkin an Arliss go stey for one smol house in Toynton All Saints near Spilsby.Afta som years, Arliss kom kpai.Di nik nem wey Rudkin frend dey kol am na "Peter".

How e tek wok
Even sey Rudkin papa an mama no like am, Rudkin like to dey lisin an kolet matiriha wey tok abaut di tradishional tori of Lincolnshire.Meni of wetin e kolet stat in di year 1920s an 1930s.Na Rudkin hep C.W Phillip to chek di old buidin for war survey map.In 1931, e join di Di Folklore Sosaeti an Margaret Murray enkoraji am on e wok wey e dey du on Lincolnshire. Rudkin polish e buk Lincolnshire Folklore wit introdushon by Murray in 1936
title: Ethel Rudkin

text:
Katharine Mary Briggs (8 November 1889 - 15 October 1980)na one British Folklorist an raita,wey rait  The Anatomy of Puck, di four folum
Dikshonari of British Folk-Tales inside Inglish Langwej,an Meni oda buk dem on top Fairies an Folklore.
From 1969-1972, na shi bi di president of di Folklore Sosaiti, wey yuz im nem tek  establish one awod tek commemorate Im life an wok.

Baografi
Dem bon Katharine Briggs for Hampstead,London.Na shi old pas for di three girl pikin dem wey Ernest Edward Briggs bon an im kom from Yorkshire (Im famili do wel an get plenti moni for di mining wok wey dem do for Halifax an for Wakefield), an Marry Cooper.Im oda two sista dem nem bi Winifred an Elspeth Ernest biWater hiColor artist wey get speshal i upnt noerest for 'it'Scottish sceneryan Im dey  always tell Im pikin difren difren stori an e bi like sey na dis stori dem kom mek Katharine get lon time intres.Di famili kom muv go Perthshire for 1911,Wie Ernest biud one haus ,Dalbeathiehaus.
Ernest dai for die afta two yias for 1913.Katharine bigin to dry go Lady Margret Hall,Oxford for 1918, an shi kolet B.A for 1922 an stil kolet Im M.A for 1926.Katharine kom go back to dia ples (bikos of di famili coal legacy, an one Collieryfor Normantaun,shi no nid to dey find wok),shi jus bigin todey rait an dey do play dem- Al Im famili dey enjoi di tiata produshon dem, an na wetin Katharine want for im life bi dat- an shi stodi folklore an 17th- senturi Inglish Histri.
Shi gain im Ph.D wit one thesis on top folklore inside Seventeenth senturi litresho(Folklore in Jacobean litresho) afta di sekon wold war; during di war, shi don dey don tish for one Polish Skul an wen shi wok
for di medika bransh of di WAAF.
Briggs kom bikom pesin wey pipul know
Wel- wel as Folklorist.Afta Im first
buk on top Fairies,The Personnel of fairyland,shi kontiniu to rait Meni oda buk dem on top fairies an folklore inkludin The Anatomy of Puck an It's Sequel,Pale He ate's Team(1962).
An Encyclopedia of fairies(1976);an shi even rait Meni buk dem for smol- smol pikin dem like The Legend of Maiden-Hair(di first buk wey shi poblish)or Hobberding Dick, an Kate Crackernuts.
A Dictionary of British Folk-Tales for Inglish Langwej: Part A:Folk Narratives(1970) wey shi ripobish for three volume for 2011 as Folk Tales of Britain,an Phillip Pullman tok abaut am wen e dey do di introdoshon sey na di koleshon ful pas an naim get otoriti pas for British folktales''wey dem don do.
For 1969,dem giv am Doktorat awod for Litresho an kom mek pdi president of Folklore Sosaiti.Shi dey do post of president on til 1972, an dem tek Im nem tek dash one awod wey dem go dey giv pipul.
title: Katherine Mary Briggs

text:
Norma Christine Waterson MBE (dem bon am 15 August 1939 an shi kpai 30 January 2022) na Oyinbo musik shi dey sing an shi dey rait song sef. Plenti pipul sabi am as one of The Watersons memba, na grup wey dey uze music tok abaut dia Oyinbo kolsho. Oda memba for di grup na Mike Waterson an dia sista Lal Waterson, dia famili memba John Harrison, na leta wen di grup don dey big im hosband Martin Carthy join dem.

Hau shi tek stat life
Na Hull, East Lading of Yorkshire dem bon Waterson, bikos dem no get mama an papa wen dey smol na dia dey sta wit dia broda an sista Mike an Lal, na for di persin wey bi like dia mama, Elza Ward Dem sta, wey get shop for sekond Wod War time, shi kom fom Irish Gypsy famili. Shi tok sey im mama sabi sing wel wel an na fom am shi tek len hau to sing. Dey get one broda wey dey wit Pit Band, one of dia broda Sabi pley banjo an organ. Dia papa sabi pley guitar an banjo.

The Watersons
Na band wey stat for 1960s wit memba Norma, broda Mike, an sista Elaine wey dem sabi as Lal, dia famili John Harrison fom Kingston High School. Dem dey pley difren song bifor but na song abaut dia kolsho dem leta dey du. Dem Sabi Dem as  "the Folksons". Dia fest rekodin na for di Topic Records, dia fest album frost an fire Dem du di two for 1965, Frost an fire kolet awod of di Melody Maker Album of di year. Dey kon rilis The Watersons and Yorkshire Garland in 1966. Di Watersons grup skata in 1968, wen Norma go wok as Dj for radio station insaid Montserrat. Shi sta dia for four years an wok as DJ for radio Antilles.

Di grup kom togeda again in 1972, Bernie Vikers Kon dey du John Harrison role. Insaid dat sem year dem du music for Alan Plater TV play for today, "The Land of Green Ginger", wey dem film for Hull, an e dey stil film som insaid Bullbell Folk club. Dem cheng Vickers wit Waterson's hosband, Martin Carthy. Wit di cheng wey dem du, dey kon du Pence an Spice Ale (1975), Sound,Sound of Instrument of Joy (1977), an Green Fields (1981).

Mike Waterson's daugta Racheal Waterson, replas Lal wey komot bikos e no too well for insaid 1980's, but stil dey folo dem sing wit di grup wen Lal kom bak. Hol di five persin dey sing togeda for di late 1980s an rekod song for BBC Andy Kershaw show for August.1986. In 1987, di grup wok wit Swan Arcade to stat Blue Murder. The Watersons cheng, Kon get Waterson daugta Eliza Carthy, Anne Waterson, Jill Pidd an Maria Gillholey for difren times, but no bi hol di time dem du rekodin.

Lal Waterson kpai in 1998, by di stat of 1990s, Carthy, Waterson an dia daugta Eliza don fom Waterson: Carthy grup. Di Watersons no Kon dey pley live lik bifor again, but dey kom togeda for Festival an som speshial event, dem dey kol Dem di "The Waterson Family". Dem du "A Mighty River of Song" for Royal Albert hol on 12 May 2007, Di BBC Electric proms concert, Once in a "Blue Moon: wey dem sing for Lal Waterson", for di Cecil sharp hause wey dey London on 25 October 2007, an a Tribute to Bent, wok wey Dem uze sing abaut Albert Lancaster Lloyd, for Cecil sharp haus on November 15 2008, Di Watersons pafom for plenti festival an concert insaid England an Ireland.

Hau e tek wok
One of im wok Norma Watson, na John Cheley produs am an na Hannibal rekods rilis am in 1996, (dem menshion am for di Mercury Music Prize), shi du am wit im daugta Eliza, hosband Martin Carthy an oda memba wey dey "The Watersons", e stil get Danny Thompson (pentangle), Richard Thompson (Fairport Convention) an Roger Swallow (di Albion Band). In 1999 dem du folo-up for The Very Thought of You wey Hannibal rekods rilis an Richard Thompson, Danny Thompson, Eliza Carthy an hosband Eliza Carthy dey insaid.

In 2001, shi rilis fest album wey dey tok abaut kolsho,Bright Shiny Morning, on Topic Records. Shi dey insaid som oda pipul rekodins, one of dem wey pipul sabi wel na The Transport wit Peter Bellamy's. In 2018 Waterson sho as guest wit im broda Mike on Scottish singa James Yorkston's album When The Haar Rolls In, dem sing dia sista Lal's song, Midnight Feast.

In 2009 for one Topic Records 70-Anniversary Three Score and Ten dem nem three Watersons album and one Waterson: Carthy album as Classic albums. Dem bi Frost and Fire For Pence and Spicey Aly an Waterson:Carthy. Di track wey Norma parfom on na  ==Hal an Tow==( track 11 on di CD), Three Score and Ten (track 17), We Poor Labouring Man wit Waterson:Carthy (track 21 on di sixth CD), and Blue Murder, "No one stands Alone(track 22 of di seventh CD).

In 2010 Waterson du album wit im daugta Eliza wey dem kol Gift. Pesin wey dey wok for BBC Laura Barton rait sey hol di Waterson Famili na talent fom; Norma Waterson an Eliza Carthy, dia mama an pikin wey mek singin abaut kolsho popula for British, na wen e dey tok abaut di final song, "Shalow Brown", shi stil notis sey hol di famili memba sopot di song, Eliza papa Martin Carthy pley guitar an anoda famili memba Oliver Knight on electric guitar, vocals an cello.

In 2016 Waterson kolet Lifetime Achievement award fom BBC Radio2 folk Awards wit Joan Armatrading.

Dem sabi Waterson as head of di famili     shi kontinue to sing well wen shi dey 70s, Plenti pipul tok sey shi dey wok wel wel, sey na persin wey no gree stop to dey go sho an du rekods. Waterson final album, wey shi rilis in 2018, wey bi di sekond wit Eliza. Na Waterson sing lead on Toms Waits song "Strange Weather" an on version of Nick Lowe's The Beast in Me.

Parsonal life an hau shi tek kpai
Waterson mari Martin Carthy in 1972. Dem bon dia Pikin Eliza in 1975.

Shi kolet MBA(Member of the Order of British Empire) in di Queen's 2003 New Year's Honours, for hau shi tek wok insaid her music.

Waterson kpai on 30 January 2022, wen shi bi 82. Shi don dey suffer fom Pneumonia.

text:
Cornelia Sorabji (Dem bon am for November 15, 1866 an e kpai July 6, 1954) na Indian lorya, soshal riforma an raita. E bi di fest fimeli wey wan pass out from Bombay Yunivasiti an di fest wuman to rid law for Oxford Yunivasiti.Afta wey Sorabji finish Oxford Yunivasiti, e go bak to Indian an put bodi in soshal an advaisa wok to hep di Purdahnashins. Purdahnashins na wuman-dem wey dey no grie mek dem du enitin wit man wey no dey dia kontrie.Sorabji no fit go kot go fight for dose wuman bikos e Neva get di professional standin or satifiket to du am.Bikos of di one, Sorabji go du e LLB ezaminashon in Bombay Yunivasiti in 1987 an "Pleader ezaminashon of  Allahabad Hi Kot in 1899.Sorabji kom bikom di fest fimeli wey dey spik for kot.Na 1923 dey chenj di law for Indian so dat wuman sef go fit bi Barrista for Kot an na day year e kom bi Barrista.
Sorabji put bodi for meni soshal savis kampain grups. Som of di grup na Nashional Kaunsu for Wumen in Indian, di Fedirashon of Yunivasiti Wumen, an di Bengal Ligi of Soshal  Savis.Sorabji no sopot sey mek dey komposiri how Westa pipul dey si tins 
for di chenj abaut wuman-dem in India.E dey kiyefu as e dey du e best to chenj soshal mata an e no sopot fast fast chenj hadiya.
Sorabji biliv sey onti evri wuman no buk, all di politikal chenj wey dey wan du no go eva last. Sorabji sopot di British Raj, an Purdah for Hopa-Kast Hindu Wumen an e no sopot Indian Self-Rule
Bikos of wetin e biliv, e no get di sopot wey e nid to rili chenj som soshal mata.
Sorabji put mouth for meni poblikashon wey hep mata in di earli 20 senturi.

How e tek stat life an go skul
title: Cornelia Sorabji

text:
Ella Mary Leather (26 March 1874 – 7 June 1928) na one woman wey kom from Britain wey dey gada kolshor-dem and Herefordshire muzik-dem. Dem dey see her wok "Folklore of Herefordshire", wey she rait for 1912 as the "gud ezampu wey sayence go uze dey do gud gud tins for pipu for free". Som of di wok wey she do na Twelve Traditional Carols from Herefordshire,im rait am wit Ralph Vaughn and plenti small small buk for inside the kolsho-dem mata.

How im stat laif
Dem bon Ella Mary Smith for 26 March 1874 for one smoll place for Bidney for Dilwyn parish, wey dey for Herefordshire for England. Na Mary Ann (née Griffiths) and James Smith, wey be  farmer born am. Afta she finish Clyde Skool, she finish her school for Hereford High School for Girls. Im marry one man wey dey gada tins wey e name bi Francis Leather for 1893 and di two of dem move go one town wey be Woebley wia dey born dia three boy-pikin-dem wey bi John Francis, Geoffrey and Godfrey.

The kaind wok im do
Nobodi know wen Leather fess stat to dey gada kolshor-dem but for 1904 som of her smol-smol buk sho sey she bin don alredi gada plenti pipu wey dey follow am gada kolshor-dem wey she dey folo wok dat taime to tek gada kolshor-muzik for dat plec. One man wey dey rair buk-dem wey im name na 
Reverend Compton Reade ask Mar sey mek im sef folo raite one chapta wey bi "The Folk-Lore of the Shire" to di buk-dem wey dem tek dey rememba pipu wey don live for Old Herefordshire wey dem bring kom awtside dat year. For 1905, she put dem di buk-dem Folk-Lore and the Folk-Song Societies.
togeda. As e bi sey she no too sabi, muzik, e kom mek am hard for am to bring muzik raiting until 1906 wen dey put am to meet one man wey dey sing muzik wey dem dey kol Ralph Vaughan Williams. Williams hep am get one machine wey sabi do new muzik and stil do muzik wey dem don do befor. For 1907, her she kom get levul wel-wel for kolshor-dem kom strong wel-wel, wen im bring one buk about kolshor-dem wey be di fest Herefordshire buk.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Ella Mary Leather

How e tek stat life
Na for Kalifoniha wey de USA dey tek bon Christine Rimmer on January 28.Rimmer mama grapa dey dig ground for gold.E get tiata digri from Sacramento an kom stil go New York go rid aktin.

text:
Olive Walke MBE (dem bon am for 21 December 1911 an e kpai 10 September 1969) na Trinidadian muzishian an di fest pesin to gada "Caribbean tradishonal song togeda.Na e fom an daret di popula muzik grup "LA Petite Musicale".Walke daret di grup for meni years.Walke bi sinator in di fest Palimet of Trinidad an Tobago wen di kontri get e indipedet.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na on December 21, 1911 dey bon Beatrice Olive Walke in Belmont aria wey de Pot of Spain, Trinidad. E mama nem na Anella an e papa nem na Samuel Arthur Walke.Na Walke anti wey bi Edith an e onkul wey bi Simeon Hayes train am. Walke go "Tranquility Girls School" an di "Intermediate Government School" bifor e kom finish from Bishop Anstey High School.
Walke kom waka go London go kontiniu e muzik edukeshon as ego rid muzik in Triniti kolej of Muzik.
In 1936 wen  e stil de London, Walke mit e hosband Frank Hercules wey bi studet of "Trinidadian Student of Law". E hosband leta bikom pesin wey pipul sabi as raita.
Afta wey Walke finish wit ATCL digri, e leta forda e edukeshon for muzik at di Royal Akademi of Muzik.Walke bon one boi for Frank Hercules an dey nem am John.
Wen e don kolet e satifiket from di yunivasiti, e go bak to Trinidad.E hosband Frank sef komot from London go New York. Na dis tin mek di marej skata. Di pikin wey dey bon kom dey stey wit Walke anti Edit  an Walke onkul Simeon Hayes.John Simon Anthony Hayes kom leta bi fest kidni doktor to kom from Trinidad an Tobago an na Walke pikin form di "Trinidad and Tobago Kidney Foundation"

How e tek wok
Walke fest stat to dey giv muzik lesin an e dey tok for one redio show wey dem dey du evri wik kol "Musicians in the Making".Di show na to hep up komin muzishian to dey popula so dat pipul go no dem.
For December 1939, Walke fom one muzik grup wit di nem "La Petite Musicale". Di grup dey sing tradishonal Krismas song.Na for Walke house di grup dey pratis. Afta pratis, di grup go rent motor go pipul house dey sing in dia komuniti.
Afta di niu year, di grup stat to dey sing tradishonal muzik of Trinidad and Tobago.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Olive Walke

text:
Margaret Mattson na one of di two wuman wey dem kari go court but later free dem for Philadelphia in di province of Pennsylvania sylvania for witchcraft in 1693.

Tori abaut e life
Nils an Margaret rish colony of New Sweden for present-day southeastern Pennsylvania on May 22, 1654, on di ship Orn. Dey kon settle on land near Eddystone, Pennsylvania.

For Sweden-finish descent, na healer wey dem respect wey dey work for finnish tradition. For 1963 som of Margaret Neibor tok sey shi get cattle wey bi witch.

Dem kon karri am go cot of Pennsylvania Provincial Council for Febuary 7, 1683 (unda Julian kalenda). Dis one happun afta 19 years afta Swedish territory bikom a Swedish common law koloni an sobjet for English witchcraft art 1604.

Na meni neibor Kom out kom accuse am on top
Di Mata, ha own dota in-law, Mattson alleged crime sef dey insaid di mata wey dey mek di neibors dey fear wey Kom mek cows dey giv smol milk, bewitching an killing lifestock an shi dey show for witness for spectrum form. On Febuary 27, 1683, dem sharj Mattson and ha neibor Gertro (A.K.A Yeshro) Jacobson, waif of Hendricks Jacobson wey Anthoney General  bring bifor grand jury of 21 
men wey dem wan luk unsaid di mata by di colony proprietor William Penn. Di grand jury kom return true bill indictment
dat aftanoon di case kom leta show for trial. A Petit jury wey be 12 men wey Penn select an dem appoint an intaprita 
for di Finish Wumen, wey no sabi spik English. Penn barred di yuz of prosekushon an defens loyas handle di questioning himsef, an pamit introdoshon of 
unsubstantiated hearsay. Na Penn himsef giv di klosing sharj an dairekshon for di jury, but wetin e tel dem no dey transcribe. Akordin to di minutes of di provincial council on Febuary 26, 1683, di jury retorn wit guity sey "Guilty of having a comon fame of a witch but not guilty in manner and forme as shee stands Endicted"
But dem faind Mattson guity bikos pipul Sabi am as witch but shi no dey guilty sey e use am bewitch animals.
title: Margaret Mattson

text:
Lisbeth Nypan (1610-September 1670) na [Norwegian]] pesin wey pipul akus sey e na witch or dey yuz juju for pipul.Wen e kontri tok sey dey wan kil all di witch for dia, na e kilin de popula pass. Na Lisbet bi di sekod to di last pesin wey kot kil bikos of juju pratis in Norway.
Di onli witch kilin wey Rossell Hope Robbins tok abaut in e 1959 buk "Encyclopedia of Witchcraft and Demonology" na Lisbet an e hosband Ole Nypan.

text:
Shanno Khurana (dem bon am for 22 December 1927) na one klasika vocalist an komposa,India pesin wey pipul know wel-wel from Rampur-Sahaswan gharana of Hindustani klasika muzik. Shi disaipu of doyen of di gharana,Ustad Mushtag Hussain Khan"(d.1964),Meni pipul know sey shi sabi hau to pafom one kind bandish an ragg wey no komon,even as e bi sey di kind song wey shi dey sing na Khayal,tarana,thumri,dadra,tappa to 
chant an bhayan.Na Jodhpirnaim dem bon an na die shi gro,shi statto dey sing on top al India Radio for 1945 for Labore,an shi kom shift for sing for Delhi an shi kontiniu to dey on top al India Radio Delhi an for konsatbdem an for muzik festiva.Shi stat Muzik Edukeshon, an shi kom get M.Phil an PhD
for muzik fro di Kairragarh Yunifasiti an shi don do meni-meni risash dem for folkmuzik of Rajasthan.
Dem giv am Padma Shri awod fo kOkkr 1991,dem kom stil gov am di Padma Bhushan awod for 2006,wey bi di nomba three hayes honor wey India go ment for giv sivilian.For 2002,dem giv am Sangneet Natak Akademi fellowship hono wey bi di hayes hono for performing Arts an na India Nashona Akademi  for muzik,Dans an Drama dey gov di hon of Sangeet Natak Akademi hono.

Hau e tek stat life
Dem bon Khurana inside Punjabi famili for Jodhpur, Rajasthan.Meni pipul for im famili no bi muzishan,bot Meni of dem dokto dem,enginia dem,an pipulwey dey wok for foreignsavis dem bot shi stat to dey get intres for muzik wen shi stil bi smol pikin for di time wey shi see sey im broda as e dey len from musicologist an vocaliat Pandit Raghunath Rao Musalgaonkar,an disaipu an nephew of Raja Bhaiya Poonchwale of Gweiliar gharana.Im coservative famili no giv am shans to len muzik,wen Im fada kom see sey shi dey hie klasika muik wel-wel for radio, e mom alau am mek shi dey len muzik from Musalgaonkar wen shi stil bi 12 yias old.

Hau e tek wok
Khurana mari one dengist wey dey wok wit Indian Air Force wen shi bi 18 yias old an kom shift go Lahore, an for Al dis time shi stil dey sing for Al India Radio,(AIR),Lahore,sins 1945.Aftavdem poshon India,Im famili shift go Delhi,an im hosband kom liv Air Force wok kom stat to dey do im wok.Im hosband kom push so tey shi stat to dey do im riyaz again even as shi don get two smol-smol pikin an even di Moda-In-law dey sik dat time. Shi dey do pratis wit Maestro Pandit Chatur Lal,an dem gogeda for 17yiaa an shi stil dey sing on top Radio.Nirmala Jooshi,wey bi di Sekitri for Sangeet Natak Akademi kol sey mek shi kom dey Tish klasika Muzik for di muzik Skull wey dey for Sangeet Bharati for Mandi Haus for Delhi.
Afta som time, Im hosband introdus am to  one musicologist an shif produsa of AIR,Delhi; Thakur Jaidev Singh an dis pesin na Im hosband peshent.Singh kpm Hep am het konfidens wel-wel an shi kom stat to dey travu go Turkey,Iran, Greece, an oda aria dem as pat of kulsho deliget an na India govment dey sponso evri tin.an shi stil pafom for big-big muzik festival dem for India for 1960 an 70 dem like Tansen Summelan, Gwailor,Harvallabh Festival,Jalandhar,and Swami Haridad Sangeet, Sammelan, Mumbai.Di man even Tish am Putan-anh Thumr,an kom stil tell am sey mek shi join di India Kala Sangeet Yunifasiti of Khairagarh,Madhya Pradesh,Wie eminent musicologist an Tisha ,S.N Ratanjankar dey an don dia as Prinsipa of Bjatkhande muzik  Institut an im bi di Vais-Shanselo for dat time.
title: Shanno Khurana

text:
Vanetia Newall (dem bon am in 1935 an e kpai in 2017) na Inglish-Amerika tradishonal tori raita an e na bifor bifor presidor of di Folklore Sosaheti an fello of di America Folklore Sosaheti.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for London in 1935 dem bon Vanetia Newall. E papa na Amerika an e mama kom  from England.Dorin di Sekod Wold War, Newall stey wit e grapapa in United States.In 1953, e go rid Inglish Langwej an Litireshon for Yunivasiti of St Andrew.Newall leta get Ph.D from di yunivasiti for e wok on traditional tori.

How e tek wok
Newall luv for tradishonal tori kom from e travul wey e dey du as e dey waka abaut Sentra Europe wit e husband.In 1960, Newall dey luk araund as e dey si di way maket wuman dey dekoret egg for maket.Newall kom stat to dey kolet an stat to dey lisin to di kostom wey dey araund di egg koleshon. E buk wey e rait abaut di egg win Amerika Folklore sosaheti Chikago Folklore prize in 1971.Di nem of di buk na "An Egg at Easter".
Newall na member of British Folklore Sosaheti sins heli 1960s.E don bi dia Sekretiri from 1967 go rish 1980.Pipul no am we'll wel for di sosaheti bikos e sabi invite pipul kom di sosaheti an e no how to konvis pipul wey sabi tradishonal tori kom tok for di sosaheti.
Wen e na sekretiri for British Folklore Sasaheti, e hep hoganas two big hevet: "Di Anglo-America Folklore Conference" wey dey du for Ditchley Pak in 1969 an di sekod hevet "Di Folklore Society Centenary Conference" wey dey du for Royal Holloway Kolej in 1978.
Nawell bi di presidor of di Folklore Sosaheti from 1985 go rish 1987.
In di 1970s, Newall bikom a risasha felo at di School of Oriental and African Studies wey de London.E leta bikom visitin professor at  Yunivasiti of Kalifonia, Berkeley.
Newall dey put mouth for poblikeshon wey konsain tradishonal tori from 1973 go rish 1978.Na Newall bi di jeneral Editor of "The Folklore of the British Isles series" buk wey Batsford dey poblish.
For 1981, Newall form "The International Folklore Review", one jonal wey dey polish evri year for Eight years. Di jonal also hep for di divelopmet of younga tradishonal tori studet tu.

Buk wey e don du
title: Venetia Newall

text:
Sylvia Ann Grider ( Dem bon am in 1940) na Amerika tradishonal tori raita. Pipul no am wel wel for e stodi on spirit or gost, pikin-dem tradishonal tori an di wey e fit tok bad hevet wey don happun bifor bifor from e hed.
Grider bi di presidor of Amerika Folklore Sosaheti in 1993 to 1994.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Pampa, Texas dey bon Sylvia Grider in 1940.E go Pampa Hi Skul an e finish in 1959.
E yuz di free edukeshon program wey Cabot dey giv tek go rid fest Latin an leta Histrie for Yunivasiti of Texas for Austin.Grider get BA in Latin an MA in Histrie from di yunivasiti ( e tek som klass in Klassikal Sivilizashon korse tu).Wen e stil de yunivasiti, Grider stil dey tish for Caprock Hi Skul wey de Amarillo, Texas.
Wen Grider stil dey Yunivasiti, e folo join for di digin of ground to find old tins wey happun for Corinth in Greece.Grider tok sey na di time wey e stey for Greece mek am luv tradishonal tori. E tok sey di tori wey di pipul of Greece tel am swit am for belle pass di digin wey e join du.Grider Tish for N.R Crozier Teknikal Hi Skul wey dey Dallas bifor e go du e Ph.D in Folklore institute wey dey Indiana Yunivasiti.E finish di Ph.D in 1976.

How e tek wok
Grider tish tradishonal tori klass in di dipatmet of Inglish, Histrie, and Humaniti in Medisin for  Texas A&M Yunivasiti in 1976.E post for Graduate Kolej na Assistans Dean from 1981 to 1984. Leta, e kom get ofis in di dipatmet of "Anthropology" from 1988 to 2007.

Aggie Bonfire
Wen di buidin of Aggie Bonfire in 1999 kolapse, Grider daret sey mek dey kolet all di tins wey dey fit dey rimemba evritin wey happun dat day an e mek suo sey dokumet dey for di hevet for at di A&M kampos.

Posishon wey e don hold bifor
Grider don bi presidor of Texas Folklore Sosaheti bifor. E stil don bi presidor of di Amerika Folklore Sosaheti an dey don chuz am as one of di pesin wey go repriset dem for Amerika Kansu of Learn Stodies.

text:
Anna Hardwick Gayton ( Dem bon am in 1899 an e kpai in 1977) na Amerika pesin wey dey stodis kolshor, tradishional tori, an e dey kip meni old old tins wey e dey si for younga pipul.E dey popula bikos of how e yek gada informashon abaut tradishonal tori of Kaliforniha Indian pipul.Gayton don bi di presidor of di Amerika Folklore Sosaheti bifor in 1950.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Santa Cruz for Kaliforniha dey tek bon Anna Hardwick Gayton.Gayton go Yunivasiti of Kaliforniha, Berkeley to get e BA digri in 1923 e MA digri in 1924.
In 1928, e finish e Ph.D for ridin "Anthropology".Na Alfred L. Kroeber  an Robert H. Lowie. Gayon tek klass in "Psychology" an na Edward C.Tolman tish di klass.
Di fest wuman to kolet Ph.D in "Anthropology" from Berkeley. Di pepa wey e rait for Ph.D na "The Narcotic Plant Datura in Aboriginal American Culture"
Wen e dey du e Ph.D pepa, Gayton tok to meni Yokut an Western Mono pipul. Gayton rait nine pepa on Yokut an Western Mono tradishonal tori.
Wen e stil de Yunivasiti, Gayton bi di Assistans Editor to di jonal American Anthropologist.E stil bi Assistans Editor bitwin 1932 to 1934.Gayon stil bi di Assistans Editor for Yale University Publications in Anthropology.
Gayton mari Leslie Spier in 1931.Leslie Spier tu na pesin wey dey rait abaut tradishonal tori.

How e tek sopot Tradishonal tori
Durin 1930s, Gayton join Amerika Folklore Sosaheti (AFS) an e bi dia Riview Editor of di jonal  Journal of American Folklore  from 1935 go rish 1940. Gay on stil bi di Assosiate Editor of di jonal from 1940 go rish 1943.E stil bi di oga patapata for AFS's Komitee on Risach in Folklore from 1945 go rish 1948.E stil bi di Vais Presidor of di AFS in 1947.An in 1950, e bi di presidor of di sosaheti in 1950.

Akademik karia an koleshon of old old tins
For 1948, Gayton join di Staff of di dipatmet of Dekorativ Art wey dey Yunivasiti of Kalifoniha, Berkeley.E koko of e wok na to stodi di "Peruvian textile  wey dey di Yunivasiti koleshon.Na Lila M' O'Neale wey fest de di dipatmet bifor Gayton kom fest stat di wok.
title: Anna Hardwick Gayton

text:
Maria Leach (April 30,1892-May22,1977)na one raita an editor of buk dem on top folklore dem of di wold.
As shi bi skola, shi kompail an edit plenti folklore wok dem an shi author or editor of thirteen buk dem wey dey for adot, yong pipul,an smol-smol pikin dem.

Hau shi tek stat life, go skul an marej
Na for New York siti dem bon Maria Leach'. Bifor-bifor shi bi Alice-Mary Doane,shi bi girl-pikin of Benjamin H.Doane an Mary (Davis) Doane.
Im fada na one nativ of Nova Scotia,one of di three maritime provins dem for Canada.Na for Barrington,for Shelburne county naim dem bon di man, Im bi kom from one venerablefamili wey dem dey kol Doane(one Anglicizedfom of Gaclic nem wey komon for Southern Ireland sins 1500 yias dem)
For Nova Scotia e get koneshon to Seafaring usethru Im fada wey bi kapten for ship.For lait 1870 Dem or eli 1880 dem,
Benjamin Doane an im waif Mary, one nativ of South Carolina an an unreconstructed Rebelmuv go New York an establish one hom inside Manhattan for wie dem liv for som yia an bon dia pikin dem.
Alice-Mary Doane gro up an do Im Eli edukehon for New York siti.Wen shi graduet from high skul, shi go Earlham Kolej for Richmond,Indiana,wey di korikulom folo di tins wey dey for Rilijon Sosaiti of Frend dem (Quakers)Shi kom go stodi for im Masta digri for authtropology for di Yunifasiti of Illinois inside Urbana-Champaign.
Na for dia shi mit MacEdward Leach,wey bi student of medievallitresho an philologyan wey kom get intres for folklore.E like Oral tradition of medieval folklorejus like Mari ("Ma-RYE-uh" as dem dey kol am for British fashon),an shi tek as Im pen nem.Afta wen MacEdward Leach  don get a Bashelor digri for 1916 an wey don komplit Im militri Davis for Wold War1,Im an Maria kom Mari for 1917 an dem muv go Baltimore wia bot of dem kom stat graduet stodi for John Hopkins.
Maria kontiniu to dey stodi for doctorate for folklpre for 1918-19.For 1920 Im enta di Yunifasiti of Pennsylvania for Philadelphia an kom stat to dey tish as instrokto of Inglish.
Afta som time,for 1924,Leach dem kom bikom parent of one boy-pikin, Macdonald,dia onli pikin.
As e bi sey e jus bikom yong fada, MacEdward Leach kom get im doctorate for Inglish for 1930 an e kom join di fakoti of di Yunifasiti for 1931 as asistan Profeso of Inglish.
Leta Life an Profeshona karia
For 1936,Maria Leach get employment di Philadelphia Ofis dem of Funk an  Wagnalls, one firm wey dey poblish buk for skul.
As a parent wey dey wok,Leach dem kom get Haus for Bucks County Pennsylvania, an afta som yia,wen dia boy-pikin dey for boardingskul, dem kom stat to dey do dia indipendent wok dem.As Im stil dey for Pennsylvania, shi muv go back to New York,
title: Maria Leach

text:
Mariana Sadovska (dem bon am for 1972) na Ukraine aktres, singa, muzishan, an komposa. E de stey for Cologne.

How e tek wok
Sadovska stat dey wok for Les Kurbas tiata (Lviv, Ukraine]] wey dey Anatole Vasiliev's Festival in Saint Petersburg an Moscow.
Jerzy Grotowski wey dey Pontefera in Italy chuz am as one of membafor di "Slavic Pilgrim Project".Leta dat year, di pipul for Gardzienice tihata tok sey mek Sadovska dey wok for dem. E wok for di tihata as an aktor an muzik daretor for 10 years.
Wen e de Gardzienice tihata, e stodies how difren difren kolsho dey sing an how e tek dey mek pipul wey dey lisin dey feel abaut di muzik. Sadovska Waka araund go  stodi muzik wey kom from Ukraine, Ireland, Egypt, Cuba, an Brazil.E don organize how tradishonal singas of Ukraine go fit gain from muzishan wey kom Europe an United State.
Sadovska yuz di moni wey "Earth Foundation" dey dash pipul travul go New York in 2001.For New York, E wok as muzik daretor for La Mama, wit "E.T.C." tihata kompini, "Yara Arts  Group".
Wen e stil dey New York, Sadovska stat to wok on how e go tek bi beta singa.E wok wit som muzishan like:Julian Kytasty, [Michael Alpert]] (wey dey Brave old World, Anthony Coleman, Frank London, Victoria Hanna an Sanda.
In 2001, Global Village produs di fest Sadovska CD wey di tahitu bi:Song I learned in Ukraine 
In 2005, EVOE grup join Sadovska to produs e sekod CD "Borderland".
Sadovska don sing inside som hevet sentral like Knitting Factory, Joe's Pub, BAM, Macor, [Galapagos]], an Exit Art.
Sadovska bet studio wey e dey tek tish pipul abaut koret voice wey dey for yuz de sing.E sef len am for meni ples wey e don go like Grotowski Central for Poland, Intanashonal Workshop festival for Israel, Di Royal Shakespeare for London. Sadovska also len from meni akademik institushon like Harvard, Swarthmore, SUNY Buffalo, NYU, an UC Santa Barbara.

Famili
Sadovska papa na Ukraine singa, Song raita an translator Viktor Morozov. Sadovska mari di German perfomans aktist Andre Erlen.

text:
Verjine Svazlian (Dem bon am March 1, 1934) na Amerika wuman wey dey stodi kolshor, wey dey rait tradishonal tori an di lidin risasha at di "Institute of Archeology and Ethnography of NAS RA".Svazlian na Doktor of filosofi an professor. E na memba of "Honoured Scientists of the Armenia (2006)".
Svazlian hep to save meni tradishonal old tins wey difren langwej for Amenia dey yuz kominiket no lost wen dey sey, mek Armelia pipul komot by force from Westa Armenia, Cilicia an Anatolia go eniwie wey dey like stey.
Leta, Armenia pipul kom bak to dia land.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for 1934 dey bon Verjine Svazlian in Alexandria.Svazlian papa escape di killin wey happun wey dey wan kill all di Armenian pipul.E papa nem na Karnik Svazlian an e na raita an e hold poblik posishon.
Svazlian du e pamari edukeshon for "Poghossian Armenian National School" an e sekondri skul for 'Armenian Nun's Immaculate Conception School" even sey dey no like French langwej for sekondri skul.
In 1947, e folo e paret go bak to Soviet Armenia. Svazlian finish Yerevan Khachatour Abovian Armenian State Pedagogical University in 1956.Dipatment of Armenian Langwej an Litirashon e tek finish.

How e tek wok
In 1958, Svazlian stat to wok for Manouk Abeghian Institute of Literature of the Academy of Sciences of Armenia. Svazlian fest bi M.Abeghian grant-aided studet ( e wok onda sayentifik lidaship of di Akademishian Karapet Melik-Ohandjanian.
Svazlian don dey wok in Institute pf Archaeology and Ethnography of the National Academy of Sciences of Armenia sins 1961. 
E wok from 1996 to 2004 at The Armenian Genocide Museum-Institutr
Svazlian get e Masta digri in 1965 an e get e Ph.D digri in 1995.
Svazlian don rait ova 500 akademik an poblik Pepa wey dey poblish in Armenia, an ova sea.
