text:
Bold text'Carmen Roy''' na wuman wey dey stodi difren kolshor an rait abaut tradishonal tori.Na e du di vois stodi for di :'Gaspé Peninsula. Roy don hep kolet an kip meni old old tins an e don bi season daretor for Kanada Nashonal Muslim wey de Ottawa from 1940s go rish di 1980s.
Wen e wok wit Marius Barbeau an Luc Lacouciere, Roy join hans mek pipul like kolshor tins in Canada an e na one of di earli pipul wey stat tradishonal tori raita in Canada.
As an administrator for di Nashonal Musium, Roy hep organize di Scholarship of koleshon like Helen Creighton an Edith Fowke.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Cap-Chat wey dey Gaspé Peninsula e gro up.For dia, Roy yuz anaoda nem tek dey rait poem. Di nem wey Roy dey yuz na "Mouse Des Boos".Roy leta go "College Marguerite-Bourgeois" in Montreal wie e komplet e baccalauréat en Lettres in 1942.E den go rid French at di Université Laval.
Wen e stil dey Quebec siti, Roy stat to like tradishonal tori afta e mit Marius Barbeau in 1947.Wit Marius Barbeau hep, Roy get wok for Nashonal Musium of Kanada.Roy yuz free edukeshon du e Ph.D in "Ethnography" at di Sorbonne in 1953.For that e Ph.D, e wok onda Marcel Griaule an e pepa wey e tek get e Ph.D na "Literature orale en Gaspesis". Dos akademishan wey joj e pepa na Charles Bruneau an Henri-Irénée Marrou.Som pipul tok sey Carmen Roy de among di fest Wuman-dem wey wan kolet Ph.D sertifiket.

How e tek wok
Sins Roy na oga for French-Canadian an Acadian tradisonal tori, E wok in di koleshon of old old tins for "Canada's National Museum"wey dey Ottawa from 1948 go rish 1956.From 1948 go rish 1952, Roy hep organize vois rekod of Gaspe Peninsula pipul-dem. Di rekod kontain wetin pipul len or si long time ago wey kom hep to stat di foundashon of dia tradishonal tori wey pipul fit yuz for dia akademik wok.
title: Carmen Roy

text:
Elizabeth "Libba" Cotten (im papa name na Nevills; dem bon am January 5 1893 and shi kpai June 29 1987) na American blues an shi dey sing abaut kolsho. Shi Sabi pley guitar by hasef, shi dey uze left hand pley guitar an shi dey pley guitar for pipul wit rait hand. Shi dey pley bass line wit finga an Melody wit im thumb. Plenti pipul don no as shi dey pley an dey kol am "Cotten Picking". Shi dey insaid Rock and Roll  Hall of Fame class of 2002.

Hau e tek stat life
Dem bon Cotten for 1893 to famili wey like music wel wel for Chapel Hill, North Carolina, for one plez wey leta dey insaid Carrborro. Im papa an mama na George Neville(wey som dey spel as Nevills) an Louisa (or Louise) price Nevill. Na Elizabeth smol pas among di five pikin. Na shi giv imsef nem for fest day wey shi enta skul, wen e ticha ask am im nem, bikos for haus dem dey kol weam Li'l Sis.  Wen shi dey eight years shi don dey pley song, wen shi rich nine years dem fos am komot for skul an e Kon go du haus hep, wen e dey twelve years old, e don get wok for Chapel Hill. Dem dey giv am one dollar evri month, na insaid di moni im papa saf to buy am im fest guitar. Di guitar Sears and Roebuck brand,  wey di money rich $3.75. Na im tich imsef, but e Sabi pley di guiy wel wel, e dey use am dey pley difren songs.

E stil dey smol wen e don dey rait im own songs, one of dem na, "Freight Train" , wey kon bi song wey Plenti pipul sabi wel wel. E rait di song to uze  rimemba train wey e dey ear wen e dey smol. Di 1956 UK rekodin of songs wey Chas McDevitt an Nancy Whiskey du wey pipul lik wel wel na bikos of hau Elizabeth tek wok for Skiffle insaid UK.

Cotten stat to dey wok wit im mama as haus hep wen e dey 13 years old. On November 7, 1910, wen e dey 17, e mari Frank Cotten . Dia two bon one daughta, Lillie, afta smol time Elizabeth no pley guitar lik bifor bikos of im famili an chorch . Elizabet, Frank an dia Pikin Elizabeth Lillie muv around United States for some years, bifor dem kon sta for  D.C area. Wen Lillie mari, Elizabeth liv Frank, kon go dey sta wit im pikin famili.

Hau dem tek diskova am bak
Cotten no pley guitar for 25 years, na onli for chorch sho. E no dey du sho for poblic an du rekodin ontil shi rich im 60s. Na Seeger famili diskova am wen e dey du haus hep for dem.

Wen e dey wok for store, e hep one pikin find im mama. Di pikin na Peggy Seeger, an dia mama na pesin wey rait Ruth Crawford Seeger. Afta smol time. Cotten Stat to dey du haus hep, na for Ruth Crawford Seeger an Charles Seeger, na im dey hep dem luk afta dia pikin, Mike, Peggy, Barbara, an Penny. Di Segeer famili pikin wey no fit kol "Elizabeth" nem, Kon dey kol am "Libba". Wen e dey wok for di Seegers ( nh hol di famili sabi sing beta song wey Peter Seeger, pikin wey Charles bon for di pesin e mari bifor), e rimemba hau shi tek dey pley wit guitar 40 years ago kon Kari am an len am agiain, lik say na fom stat.

Hau e tek wok an rekodin
Insaid 1950s, Mike Seegers stat to dey du rekodin of Cotten song insaid Im haus. Na dis rekodin kon bi Folksong and Instrumental with Guitar album, na Folksway rekod rilis am. Sins e don rilis dat album, hol im songs, wit di one wey pipul tek no am "Frieght Train" - wey e rait wen e dey smol - singas lik Peter, Paul, an Mary, Jerry Garcia, Bob Dylan, Joe Dassin, Joan Baez, Davendra Banhart, Laura Gibson, Laura Veirs, His name is Alive, Doc Watson, Taj Mahal, Geoff Farina, an Country Teasers.

Peggy Seeger kari di song "Freight Train" go England,  plenti pipul wey lik kolsho song lik am for England.  Paul James an Fred Williams klaim sey na dem get di song.  Leta Cotten let dem no sey na I'm own.

Afta e du im fest album, e Kon stat to dey du concert wit Mike Seeger, di fest na insaid 1960 for Swartmore College.

For stat of 1960s, Cotten don dey pley wit popula pipul wey dey sing kolsho song. Som of dem na Mississppi John Hurt, John Lee Hooker, an Muddy Waters, for ples lik Newport folk Festival an di Smithsonian Festival Of America Folklife.

E kon lik to dey rait an sing pas bifor, wey mek mak am rilis rekod in 1967 wit im pikin, di nem na "Shake "Sugaree". Brenda Joyce Evans, an future Undisputed Truth singa.

Moni wey e get fom sho, awod an rekod wey e don du, e gada smol moni buy haus for Syracuse New York wit I'm pikin. E kontiniu to dey rilis rekod an du sho   sotey e rich im 80s. Insaid 1984 e win Grammy awod for Best Ethnic or Traditional Recording, for di album Elizabeth Cotten Live, rilis by Arhoolie rekods. Insaid 1989, Cotten dey insaid 75 influncial Africa- America Women wey dey insaid I Dream  A World foto.

Cotten kpai in June 1987, for Crouse-Irving Hospital in Syracuse, New York wen e dey 94 years old.Cotten stat to dey rait music wen e dey uze im broda banjo pley. Na left hand e dey use pley am wey dey difren fom hau im broda dey pley am.  Wen e kon uze guitar wit im song e kon dey niu to Plenti pipul. E go fest uze hol im finga down pley lik banjo. Im kain way wey e dey pley Kon bi wetin pipul dey kol "Cotten Picking" . Meni oda singa don kopi hau e tek dey uze guitar pley.

Awords and honors

In 1980, 1982, and 1987, Cotten was nominated for a Blues Music Awardin the Traditional Blues Female Artist category.[23]

Cotten was a recipient of a 1984 National Heritage Fellowshipawarded by the National Endowment for the Arts, which is the United States government's highest honor in the folk and traditional arts.[24]

In 1985, she won the Grammy Awardin the Best Ethnic or Traditional Folk Recording category for Elizabeth Cotten Live![25]

In 1986, she was nominated for a Grammy Award in the Best Traditional Folk Recording category for her 20th Anniversary Concertalbum.[25]

In 2022, Cotten was posthumously inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in the Early Influence category.[13][26]

Emerante Morse wey pipul sabi as Emerante de Pradines Morse (dem bon am for Emerante de Pradines; 24 September 1918 – 4 January 2018) na Haiti pesin sey dey sing, dans an du folklore. Shi bi di gel-pikin of Haiti songs  Auguste de Pradines (dem sabi am wel as Ti Candio or Kandjo).

Hau shi tek stat life
Amarante Jean Pierre wet bi Emerante mama pray mek Our Lady of Mount Carmel, patroness of the Carmelite order, give am gel-pikin. Di mama kom promis say shi go giv di pikin to di virgin saint mek shi de woship am. Dem bon Emerante wen di mama de for holide for Rivière Froid.
title: Emerante Morse

text:
Leyla Sarah McCalla (dem bon am October 3, 1985) na Amerika muzishan wey dey sing tradishonal old muzik. McCalla bifor dey play ginta for di "Grammy-winning" band Carolina Chocolate Drops but e komot go fom e own.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na from Queen, New York City dey bon Leyla McCallas but e gro up  in Maplewood, New Jersey. McCalla go Kolombia Hi Skul. E go liv for Accra, Ghana wen e bi tineja.Wen e don yuz one year for Smith Kolej, McCalla get transfa go New York Yunivasiti go rid abaut ginta paformans.In 2010, McCalla komot go liv for New Orleans an na for New Orleans e tek stat to dey yuz e skills by plarin of di strit of di French kwantas.
Na from Haiti McCalla papa an mama kom from.Jocelyn McCalla wey bi e papa bi Ezekutiv Daretor of di organisashon wey dey New York Nashonal Kolishon for Haitian Right from 1988 go rish 2006. Na McCalla intaprit di ri minin of di song "Vari-Colored Song" for e habom.McCalla mama na Régine Dupuy wey kom New York wen e stil bi 5 years.Régina Dupuy papa wey bi Ben Dupuy get one Niuz Pepa kol Haïti Progrès an na New York dey Niuz Pepa dey but e dey tok abaut tins wey pipul get an du.McCalla mama fom Dwa Fanm organisashon.Dwa Fanm na organisashon wey dey fight for wuman wey dia hosband dey bit.McCalla yonga sista na Muzishan wey dey stey New Orleans.

How e tek wok
McCalla na memba of di Carolina Chocolate Drops from 2011 go rish 2013.As of 2019, e don enta anoda grup wey di nem na Our Native Daughters
As of 2017, McCalla dey sing araund wit e New Orleans grup wey bi online three memba. One of di memba na e hosband Daniel Tremblay wey sabi ginta, banjo an Iron griangu an di oda pesin na Free Feral wey dey sing an sabi ginta.
For 2019-2020, McCalla sing for meni ples an di pipul wey e kari join bodi na Dave Hammer wey sabi Eletrik ginta, Shawn Myers wey sabi bit drum, an Peter Olynciw wey sabi Eletrik bass.

E fest habom
McCalla fest habom wey bi Vari-Colored Songs sel wel wel an pipul like di habom. Vari-Colored Songs habom wey McCalla du na to sho respet to Langston Hughes bikos meni of Langston Hughes puem , Langston Hughes tradishonal tori wey e sing wit Haitian Pidgin. McCalla tok sey e fest habom na Heart of Gold bikos di habom tok wetin de di mind of Hughes.
title: Leyla McCalla

text:
Genevieve Massignon (Paris, 27 April 1921-6 June 1966) na one Frensh linguist, ethnologist, musicologist an historian wey stodi Acadeian spish, an dialects an linguisticskomuniti dem for Brittany, for West of Frans an for Corsca.Shi poblish plenti impotant wok dem bez on dis risash.

Tori abaut E Life
Massignon kolet e License-es-lettres for 1941.For 1945( afta sekond Wold War),shi kontiniu Jaques Pignon(pesin wey die bifor time)wok,to dey pripe di CNRS for one  linguistic atlas'for di senta- West of France,an shi fokos on di dipatment of Vendee,Deux-Servres,Vienne,Charente,an Charete-Maritime:di Portevin-Saintongeais dialectarca.Bifor shi die shi don finish di  sovey wok wey Brigitte Horil go poblish an di nem go bi:Linguistic and Ethnographic AtlasPoitau,Aunis,Saintonge,Angoumois.Na dis atlas dem yuz tek do di dialectometric analysis of di dialect wey Liliane Jaqueneau do.
Bikos shi get intres for di wok wey e eda broda Yve-Massignon,wey bi human geographer an dey Liv for Madawska,Canada do, shi stat to dey do risash ontop di Acadain French komuniti
Yve-Massignon stodi loka French-Canada komuniti bifor e die for 20 yias old.
Dem poblish di risash wok wey e do an nem as,In Canada,the Upper Valley of Saint-Jean(Madawaska)and the future of Franco-AmericanFor 1946, Massignon get skolaship from French Ministri of Foreign Affairs'Cultural Relationsdipatment an dis kom mek fit travu go Canadian Maritime provincedem an di Mississippi Delta rijon go kolet traditional Acadian folklore an stori demand shi stil yuz dat time survey di loka dialect dem.Na dis investigeshon shi tek stat e PhD,Les parlers francais d'Acadie.
For 1966,shi sopos go di Franco -Acadian Festivities for Belle-Ile-en-Mer to mak di bicenennial of di Acadiansetument dem on top di Island.Na heartatak juz kill am as e remen smol mek dem stat di festival.
Apart from di linguistic wok dem wey shi do, Massignon kolet tradishonal stori  an muzik dem from komuniti dem wey dey for Acadia, Brittany, Corsica an di West of France.
BNF don poblish list an rekod of e buk dem.
FrenchIslamologist Louis Massignon, shi get two broda dem, Yves an Daniel Massignon.

Genevieve Massignon Wok Dem
Genevieve Massignon famili donet e wok dem giv BNF for 1985.

E Honor Dem
Medal of di Academy of Letters of Quebec(1963).Na shi bi di firstforeigner wey kolet di medal.

text:
Elene Virsaladze (dem bon am January 3, 1911 an e kpai for 1977) na Georgia wuman wey de rait tradishonal tori. Pipul sabi am wel wel for di plenti tins e don rait an how e dey tek ask pipul kweshon on wetin dey sabi abaut tradishonal tori. Meni of Virsaladze raitin don de plenti langwej like Russian, French, German, an English.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na on January 3, 1911 dey bon Elene Virsaladze. E papa na Ekonomist an e mama na Sayens pesin wey dey stodi plant.Na Virsaladze smol pass for di three pikin wey e papa an mama bon.
Wen Virsaladze bi 10 years, di Red soljas fight enta Georgia. Virsaladze papa wan komot from Georgia go Europe but e wife no gri .
Virsaladze finish e sekondri skul in Georgia. E leta go Tbilisi Stet Yunivasiti.For di Yunivasiti, na di tradishonal tori raita Vakhtang Kotetishvili de among pipul wey tish am.E finish ridin tradishonal tori an filosofi for yunivasiti in 1930.Virsaladge mari e hosband Shalva Khidasheli in 1931. E hosband leta bikom professor of Filosofi.
In 1935, Virsaladge finish from Litireshon, Langwej an Filosofi falkoti wey de Leningrad Stet Yunivasiti for Saint Petersburg, Russia.Di Pepa wey e yuz kolet e Ph.D na "The Genesis of Georgian Folktales" an na 1936 e finish am. For dat sem year, Virsaladze stat to tish woldli tradishonal tori for Tbilisi Stet Yunivasiti.Di pat of woldli tradishonal tori wey e dey tish pass for di Yunivasiti na Russian Tradishonal tori. Na onli one femali pikin Virsaladze get an e  nem na Manana.
Dey Kil Virsaladze papa an pesin wey e dey luk up to in 1937.Virsaladze nid to run komot to di Far East mek dey no Kil am too onti 1943. Afta 1943, dey kom tok sey e fit kom bak to Georgia. Wen Virsaladze kom bak, na Goti e stey onti 1948 bifor dey kom allow am to kom Tbilisi. E kom stat to wok for Shota Rustaveli Institute pf Georgian Litirashon an na dia Virsaladze tek du e Ph.D.
Na for TSU Virsaladze tek bikom professo wen e finish e Ph.D in 1974.E join International Narrative Folklore Society an join for Intanashonal mitins.For 1976, dey mek Virsaladze di hed of Folklore Dipatmet at TSU.
Virsaladze kpai in 1977.

E akademik wok
Wen e stil dey wok, Virsaladze poblish ova 100 wok. E waka wel wel for Georgia as e dey gada informashon an tins for e wok in 1950s, 60s an 70s.
Di Shota Rustaveli Institute stil get di vois rekod an raitin rekod of wetin e gada wen e dey travul abaut.

 "The Amirani saga and the Georgian hunting epos", in Acta Ethnographica Academiae Scientiarum Hungaricae, 1961

 Georgian hunting myths and poetry, 1976
title: Elene Virsaladze

text:
Elna Hansson (Dem bon am 1814 an e kpai in 1891) na Sweden wuman wey dey yuz tradishonal majik  an e dey asists pipul wey sik sef. Na Elna Hansson bi di fest wuman wey join doktor wey den assist sik pipul.

How e tek stat life
Elna Hansson na di pikin of tradishonal majik wuman Marna Nilsdotter wey de Lund. Marna Nilsdotter bi di fifth jenerashon of majik wuman-dem from di popular famili wey dey pratis tradishonal medisine. E papa an mama get one nem wey pipul dey kol dem an di nem na "Labored". Elna Hansson bikom di mama of di tradishonal wuman Johanna Maria Andersson, an di grama of Hedda Andersson. 
Elna Hands on live in Malmo afta e marej in 1833, an pipul sabi am wel wel as tradishonal medisine wuman. Jos like e mama, e wok na to trit wound an bone wey don break.Elna Hands on dey difren from oda tradishonal majik hela of dat time bikos e no dey yuz juju tek du e own tritmet. Did one mek pipul respet am an mek pipul as sayens doktor. Elna Hansson rili get beta nem as e du mek meni leg wey oda for don rimuv komot dey Ok. E mek meni pipul fit waka again afta wey dey get assidet.
Penti pipul dey kom mit am for evriwie like South Sweden, Norway an Denmark.Bikos of e wok an karatas, meni odas wey de du e wok kari sik pipul kom give am mek e trit dem.
Even sey e sabi wok wel wel, e stil neva get satifiket to du dat kind of wok. In 1855, one pesin wey bi August Falck go ripot am sey e na fake as Elna Hansson to get satifiket. Meni pipul rait leta to di king to tok beta beta tins abaut Elna Hansson.Di wahala wey de dat time bi sey, wuman to de go rid medsin for skul dat time. Di king kom rait in 1857 sey from now on mek wuman sey dey go skul go rid medsin bot na to dey sopot di man wey bi doktor.
Elna Hansson go di medsin skul an pass di exam.Na Elna Hansson fit bi di fest wuman to du dat for Sweden.
E satifiket mek am fit opun e ofisha klinik, an di klinik get room wey seven sik pesin fit stey.
Elna Hansson kontiniu to dey trit sik pipul onti e kpai. E pikin wey bi wuman join am in 1866 for di wok afta e sef don kolet satifiket to du di wok. Dat time, e pikin hosband don kpai.
Na for 1870 di Sweden Govamet kom grie sey all wuman wey like to rid medsin fit go rid am for skul.
Elna Hansson an e pikin kom grie sey mek Elna Hansson gran-pikin Hedda Andersson wey bi di 7-jenerashon of di famili go rid meds in for Yunivasiti. Dey tok dis one bikos dey no wan mek pipul dey tok sey dia famili de pratis fake doktor wey kom from dia jenerashon. Hedda Andersson kom bikom di sekod train wuman to bi doktor in Sweden.
title: Elna Hansson

text:
Adrienne Roy-Vilandré ( dem bon February 13, 1893 an e kpai October 23, 1978) na Quebec singa an wuman wey dey rait abaut tradishonal tori.

How e tek stat life
Na for February 13, 1893 dem bon Adrienne Roy-Vilandré for Levis, Quebec. E papa nem na A.R.Roy an e mama nem na Dubiana Deslauriers. Adrienne papa dem among bi pipul wey get one lokal Lévis Niuz-Pepa kol "Le Quotidien de Lévis". Wen Adrienne sef gro up e rait abaut e expirihens as e dey travul araund. Adrienne go skul wey Ursulines chorch sista dey kontro in Quebec Siti. Adrienne leta travul wit e peret go Europe. Na for Quebec e tek len how to sing wit Jeynevald-Mercier, e hosband François-Xavier Mercier, wit Victor Occellier an Berthe Roy. Afta dat, Adrienne Kon stat to dey sing on e own at di klub musikal de Quebec in 1913.
By 1922, Adrienne don get pat for André Messager singin an aktin play kol Véroniqu. In 1922, Adrienne travul go Paris an na dia e tek stodi wit Jane Berthori for two years.Wen e stil dey stodi, e go luk one song hevet wey Yvette Gilbert du an na from dat hevet e luv for tradishonal tori tek gro.
Wen e kom go bak to Quebec, Adrienne dey one of di fest wey sing di wok wey Honegger, Milhaud, an Poulenc in Quebec.
Adrienne give hundreds of paformans akross Canada as pat of di Alliance francaise, l'Association France-Canada, an di Canadian Institute of Muzik. Bikos of e wok, pipul stat to like e wok an in Expo 67 American Pavilion yuz some of e wok. Adrieene stil pafoms for redio stashon like CKAC (Montreal) an CBOFT (Ottawa) in Canada. E stil pafoms for New York for French-Canadian komuniti an di studio of di French komposa Charles Lagourgue.
Adrienne stil poblish an rait hatikul abaut muzik but e yuz difren nem wey no bi e ril nem tek rait am. Di nem wey e yuz na "Francine" . Adrienne yuz di nem tek rait for Quebec poblikashon like Le Mirror, L:Autorité an Le Jour
Adrienne dey mek suo sey e paformans  na two pat, one pat e go fest sing French Canadian tradishonal song an di sekod pat e go selet some Indian song wey Canada pipul wan lisin to.
title: Adrienne Roy-Vilandré

text:
Mite Kremnitz (dem bon am for January 4, 1852 for Grifward an e kpai for July 18,1916 for Berlin) wey dem de kol Bardeleben (im alias na George Allan, Ditto an Idem) na Germany pesin wey dey rait.

Tori abaut e life
Kremnitz na dota of one pesin wey dey popula wel wel, im wok na di pipu wey dey open pesin bodi wey dem dey kol dokto sef im nem na Heinrich Adolf Von Bardeleben. Na for Griefwalds, London shi tek gro an kon stat for 
1868 for Berlin. Shi kon leta marri one dokto wey im nem na Wilhiem Kremnitz an na dis kon Mek am folo am go dey ste for Bucharest for 1875. Di two of dem bon two pikin for dia sef.
For Romania, Marie na beta friend wit queen Elizabet, wey dey rait poem, buks an smol smol stori Unda nom de plume Carmen Sylva an for 1881 shi kon tek am as ha pesin wey dem go dey give respect wel wel. Dem kon bring out plenti buks an ple mek dem join togeda, Marie kon sign wit di pseudonym Ditto an Idem. For 1890 shi kon leta chenj am to Mite Kremnitz.
Afta wey ha hosband don kpai for 1897, Kremnitz kon go bak to Berlin. Shi too kpai for July 18, 1916 wey ha age bi 64.

text:
Irene Whitefield Holmes(nss Irene Therese Whitefield;26 October 1900-10 May 1993)na one Amerika pesin wey bi enthnomusicologist,educator an pesin wey pipul know wel-wel sey e dey kolet Cajun,Creolean an Louisiana frensh folk song dem.

Hau E Liv E Life
Dem bon Irene Therese Whitfield for Rayne, Louisiana.Na shi bi di sekond pikin inside ten pinkin dem,of seven girl three boy dem.Na for inside dia famili Rice farm  wey dey for La Belle Savanne,bitwin Doscon an Rayne wey bi two smol toaun for Acadia parish naim shi grow up.Im an Lauren Chester Post wey  dem bi relativ an wey bi Cultural geographer an educato dey Liv near dem sef on top dia fada farm dem
Whitefield go Southwest Louisiana Industrial Institute(dem don chenj di nem to University of Louisiana Lafayette),an shi graduat for 1919.
Shi kon get e masters digri from Louisiana Stet Yunifasiti,an PhD from di Yunifasiti of Chicago for 1924.
Whitefield kom stat to kolet an arenj Louisiana folklore song dem.
Wen Patricia Petnik dey rait ,shi diskraib Frensh langwej folk muzik,asgenre existed on the eye of the beholder.
For di bigin of 1939 Louisiana Frensh folklore song dem, Whitefield rait sey e dey veri difikot to sepret di song dem bot bikos dem need to grup di song dem, e stil arenj dem wit di Frensh wod wey dey inside di song dem.
Daniel Kingman sef tok abaut Whitefield
folk muzik for SouthernLouisiana,wey shi do on top difren Kolsho of komuniti dem wey dey for di rijon.E tok sey: Whitefield don show three difren set dem; Louisiana -Frensh, di pipul wey dey dia an wey dia
grait -grand pikin dem wey kom from Frans or from Carribeans;or from di Acadians or Cajuns,refuji dem from Acadia(wey bi Nova Scotianau)an wey dem welkom to Louisiana,an Spanishrula  dem dash free land afta dem poshu dem  komot for Canada for di midu of eightteenth senturi an som pipul wey kom from Afrika.
Wit dis difren set dem,e show sey Whitefield folo Profeso James Broussard of Louisiana Stet Yunifasiti.
Di Profeso tok sey  di three forms of Frensh na : Louisiana-Frensh,Acadian, an ' 'Negro- Frensh' or ''Creole
title: Irene Whitefield Holmes

text:
Margaret R. Yocom na folklorist an Poet. Shi bi profeso wey pipul respet wel wel and shi  tish for George Mason Yunifasiti from 1977 to 2014 an stat hau pipul go dey stodi Folklore as one Program for di skul. Shi wok for Maine.

Hau E liv life an go skul
Dem bon am for Pottstown, Pennsylvania,United States.
Na shi old pass among Betty Keek an Norman Davidheiser Yocom.Shi first difelop e intrest for folklore for Pennsylvania Stet Yunifasiti as shi dey stodi Inglish(BA,1970)
Shi kom go Yunifasiti of Massachusetts Amherst wia shi komplit di stodi an kom get M.A for Inglish an den e get PhD for Inglish (1980) an shi put all e mind for folklore.
As e dey for U Mass, shi rait abaut Im famili folklore.Shi wok wit som of dem from usePennsylvania, Germany, Swiss an Danish famili memba dem.Shi stil join-bodi wit oda folklore famili dem like Steve Zeitlon,Karen Baldwin,an Marilyn White.
Yocom wok wit pipul tek difelop di niu ethnographic  type of stodi.
As e rimen smol mek e finish wetin shi dey stodi for skul,shi stat to dey wok wit Smithsonian Institutions Festival of American Folklore,shi kom dey wok as field risash Kodineto for di 1976 ""Bicentennial FestivalNa shi bi prisenta for all di festival wey dem do until 1988,wen shi stat wok for summer for Maine.
Hau E tek do Akademik Wok
For 1977,dem giv am one wok for George Mason Yunifasiti for di kampos wey dey for Virginia.
Shi difelop one folklore stodi for student wey dey for Inglish dipatment,an di stodi get Folklore, Mythology an plenti Litresho inside for student wey dey for Inglish dipatment,kom stil difelop Folklore an Mythology Minor as Graduate Satifiket for  student wey dey Kolej of Humanities an  Soshal Sayens dem,kon stil difelop folklore stodi wey get plenti Folklore for  student wey dey stodi for Masters of Arts for Dipatment of Inglish.
For 1975 as e dey wok for di folklore Festival,Yocom jus see one FOTO inside some of di wok wey dem no wan yuz again.Dis FOTO wey shi see kom mek e enta anoda big risash wok.
Na one Wood carver an komuniti Scholar wey kom from Maine dey inside di FOTO.
Yocom don rait plenti buk dem an stil dey rait abaut Richard famili wey dey do wok,home making an  Knitting wok
for Western mountain of Maine.
Shi put e mind for Meni tins abaut Maine Kolsho espeshali wood carving, textiles arts,an  tradishona stori dem.
Shi tok wetin shi Len abaut Maine,shi tok sey "I like to dey folo pipul,wok for longtime one Tim an to know di ton wel-wel,di mata wide an e dip wel-wel but I too like Rangeley"
Hau E do FOLKLORE Wok
Shi don bi di folklorist an Kureto for Raneley Lakes Region Logging Museum.
wey Rodney Richard stat sins 1986.
Shi even volontia yo wok for Rangeley Lakes Region Historical Sosaiti an stil bi di prisenta for Meni of di New England Folk'' Festiva dem.
title: Margaret R. Yocom

text:
Kirin Narayan (dem bon am for November 1959) na Amerika pesin but wey e granpapa-dem kom from Indian. E na pesin wey dey stodi human koshor an e dey rait abaut tradishonal tori.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Kirin Narayan na di pikin of Ramji Contractor wey kom from Nashik an e mama na Didi Kinzinger wey bi Amerika but Did Kinzinger grapapa-dem kom from German. Narayan papa na Enjiniha an e mama na pesin wey dey draw house buildin for pipul. Dey bon Narayan for Bombay an e go skul for Indian bifor e famili kom United States in 1976.
Narayan go [[Sarah Lawrence College] ]wie e tek get BA satifiket in raitin. Narayan kom go Yunivasiti of Kalifoniha, Berkeley go du e Ph.D in 1987. E na leshura wey dey tish "Anthropology" an "South Asian Studies" at di Yunivasiti of Wisconsin-Madison.
In 1993, Narayan kolet one awod wey di nem na Guggenheim Fellow for di aria of anthropology an kolshura stodies. E na professor in di Kolej of Asia an di Pacific at di Australian Nashonal Yunivasiti

Buk wey e rait
Na for Narayan rait di buk "Storytellers, Saints, and Scoundrels: Folk Narrative in Hindu Religious Teaching". Di buk kolet di Victor Turner Prize from di "Society for Humanistic Anthropology" an di buk an anoda buk wey anoda pesin rait kolet di "Elsie Clews Prize" for Folklore from di Amerika Folklore Sosaheti.
In 1994, Narayan poblish e novel Love, Stars and All That". One raita wey bi Indian raita an editor Dom Moraes praise di wok an e tok sey:"Dis novel na koret an fine buk. Narayan yuz sens rait di buk, an e tok for di buk wetin e bi like to bi Indian pesin wey dey bon for Amerika. Pesin wey rid di buk go si sey Narayan na speshal raita, an sey e bi like sey na from hevun Narayan tek kari di gift of rai tin kom. E stil tok sey Narayan get beta future for raitin buk."

Narayan poblish anoda buk Mondays on the Dark Night of the Moon: Himalayan Foothill Folktales in 1997. 
For 2002, na Narayan rait di introdoshon pat of di niu edishon of di fest koleshon of Indian tori in Inglish, Mary Frere's old Deccan Days. In 2007, Narayan rait
title: Kirin Narayan

text:
Laura Boulton (dem bon am January 4, 1899 an e kpai October 16, 1980) na Amerika pesin wey dey stodi how difren kolsho dey sing. Pipul sabi am wel wel bikos of e rekodin, fims, fotografi of tradishonal muzik an e paformans in Egypt, Sudan, Uganda, Kenya an Tanganyika. Boulton dey kolet eni tradishonal instrumet wey e si araund di wold an dey kip am.Bikos of di work wey e du wit Nashonal Fim Board of Kanada, Pipul biliv sey Boulton dey among di fest wuman-dem wey wok for fim indostrie.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Konneaut, Ohio dey bon Laura Theresa Crayton on January 4, 1899.
Boulton go rid  how pesin dey tok an kolet e BA satifiket in Denison Yunivasiti. Boulton mari Rudyerd Boulton in 1925. Rudyerd Boulton na pesin wey dey stodi bird an leshura for Carnegie Museums of Pittsburgh wey de Pittsburgh. E bi one of di staff in di eli 1920s.

How e tek wok
Boulton stat e Masta an Ph.D digri at di Yunivasiti of Shikago in 1929. E de di dipatmet of "anthropology". For January 1929, Boulton stat e fest risach  travul.
Boulton join or lid risach travul group for ova 50 years of e life aa e dey yuz e rekod tape to rekod tradishonal song an bird song.
Di travul wey Boulton an e group du wit di hep of Amerika Musium of Nashoral Histri wey last for three months mek Boulton fit kolet an kip muzikal instrumet an rekod vois from Egypt, Sudan, Uganda, Kenya an Tanganyika
Ova di nes 50 years, Boulton join in meni intanashonal travul, koletin rekod, fims an muzikal instrumet.
Di buk wey Boulton rait wey tok abaut e life "The Music Hunter" tok abaut e travul an oda informashon. From di buk, Boulton tok sey wetin e want from e wok na to bring bak di wold muzik, no bi di one wey we de lisin to for studio or muzik house but di muzik of di pipul.
Di kontrie wey Boulton stil go an kolet muzikal informashon an instrumet bi:
Mozambique, Nyasaland, Rhodesia, Transvaal, Cape Province, Sierra Leone, Liberia, Angola, Naija, Senegal, di Koloni of Niger, Dahomey an odas oda pat of French Equatorial Afrika, di Kameroon, di Belgian Congo, Ethiopia di Ghana.
title: Laura Boulton

text:
Barbara Benary (dem bon am for April 7, 1946 an e kpai for March 17, 2019) na Amerika komposa an pesin wey dey stodi hiw difren difren kolshor dey mek muzik. Na muzik wey kom Indonesian an Indian e dey chuk eyes pass.
Benary don mek muzik for meni kompani wwy du mek fim for stage like  La Mama Esperimental Tihata Klub in di 1970s. Benary stil mek song for ETC Kompani of La Mama's sisin prodorshon  Di onli jelosi of Emer wey dey du in di 1970s an La Mama's  East Vilej tihata as dey dey sho am evri wie dey go. Benary mek muzik for Gauntlet or the moon on fire wey John Braswell rait an daret in 1976.
Na for 1976, Benary wit Phillip Corner an Daniel Goode fom Gamelan Son of Lion. Na Benary mek most of di band instrumental. Benary pafom wit Gamelan Son of Lion for di prodorshon wey di nem na "1001 instruments You've Never Seen or Heard" for La Mama in 1979. Benary mejo wok inklud Shadow puppet Operas wey get di nem Karna an "The Story Esther"
title: Barbara Benary

text:
Gayle Wald na professo of Inglish an Amerika stodis at di  George Washington Yunivasiti an e stil bi Guggenheim Fellow. Wald na di visitin Assistant Professo of Inglish an Amerika stodis at  Triniti Kolej in Hartford Connecticut from 1994 go rish 1995.

How e tek go skul
Wald finish wit BA satifiket in Inglish an French from di  Yunivasiti of Virginia in 1987. Wald kom du Ph.D in Inglish from  Princeton Yunivasiti in 1995

How e tek wok
Wald dey wok as Professo of Amerika Stodis for  George Washinghton Yunivasiti. Bifor, e na oga  wey dey kontro Inglish dipatmet bot na Wald dey kontro Amerika stodies for di Yunivasiti
Wald dey among di editor of di poblikeshon "Journal of Popular music Studies".E stil dey rait for Niuz Pepa an blogs 
Wald stil dey among di editor of "Bloomsbury':"
Buk wey e don rait
 Crossing the Line: Racial Passing in U.S. Literature and Culture (Duke University Press, 2000)
 Shout, Sister, Shout!: The Untold Story of Rock-and-Roll Trailblazer Sister Rosetta Tharpe (Beacon Press, 2007)
 It's Been Beautiful: Soul! and Black Power Television (Duke University Press, 2015)
Di buk "Shout, Sister, Shout! na e dey tek mek di dokumentari fim "Sister Rosetta Tharpe: The Godmother of Rock & Roll," wey Mick Csaky daret. Na stil "Shout, Sister, Shout! na e dey stil yuz tek mek di muzikal fim wey Randy Johnson daret; buk by Cheryl L. West. Na di muzikal fim deys tek opun di Pasadena Playhouse in July 2017 an di  Seattle Repertory Tihata in November 2019. Anoda muzikal wey George Brant du Marie and Rosetta'' stil yuz di tori wey dey Shout, Sister, Shout!.
For September 2019, Beacon rilis di ordiho buk of Shout, Sister, Shout! an Leslie Uggams tok inside an na Elizabeth Healy produs am.
Wald dey rait a buk wey konsain Ela Jenkins. Ela Jenkins na Muzishan wey dey sing for smol pikin-dem.

Awod wey e don kolet

 John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation Fellowship, 2012–13
 National Endowment for the Humanities Fellowship, 2012–13  
 National Endowment for the Humanities Fellowship, 2005-6
Wald don kolet two Nashonal awod. Di nem of di awod na Nashonal Endowment for di Humanities Falkoti Feloship: e kolet one in 2005-2006 an di sekod one e kolet in 2012-2013.
Gayle Wald stil don kolet John Simon Guggerheim Memorial Foundation Fellowship. E kolet dis one in 2012-2013.
title: Gayle Wald

text:
Vida Chenoweth (Dem bon am October 18, 1928 an e kpai in December 14, 2018) na pesin wey dey stodi how difren difren kolshor dey mek muzik, wey dey stodi langwej an wey sabi bit drum wey dey yuz stik du. Pipul give am praise sey na e bi di fest pesin wey wan mek drum wey dey yuz stik du  bring meni sound. Pipul tok sey na di wey Pablo Casals sabi mek one instrumet wey di nem bi Cello an di wey Andrés Segovia sabi ginta na so Chenoweth  sabi [Marimba| Drum wey dey yuz stik du]].
Chenoweth stat to sing in Chicago in 1956. E join anoda pesin wey sabi bit drum Ruth Stuber pafom in di Carneigie Hall. 
Wen Chenoweth stil dey araund 30 year, e du one gud bye show in Oklahoma in 1962 an ritaya from bitin drum in orda to faze prishin word of God. E rid muzik an hiw to translet bible. E leta bikom mishonari in New Guinea. Na for New Guinea e stat to dey yuz e muzik nolej divelop kristan mesej wit lokal muzik.
In 1985, e nem enta Oklahoma Hall of Fame an in 1994, dey put e nem for "The Percussive Arts Society Hall of Fame".

How e tek stat life
Chenoweth famili get one muzik store in Enid, Oklahoma. Na Chenoweth sinior broda advais am mek e len di old stik drum.Na piano Chenoweth fest len to dey plai but wen e injor for hand e kom stop to len am.
In 1941, one lokal tisha Sydney David tish am sime tins on now to sabi bit di stik drum. Wen Chenowwth stil dey skul, e len onda Clair Omar Musser for "Northwestern" Yunivasiti an e join for di stik drum group wwy day pafom for  Shikago in 1948. Chenoweth stil len how to kompos song an rait for stik drum. Bifor Chenoweth go "Northwestern" Yunivasiti wey e kom finish e final two years of stodi na  William Wood kolej e fest go.
title: Vida Chenoweth

text:
Jacqueline Simpson (dem bon am for 1930) wok na to dey stodi an rait buk abaut hau dem dey du tins lokal way. E don kolet plenti awod for im wok.

Hau e tek wok
Simpson stodi English Literature and Medieval Icelandic for Brenford College, University of London. E don du raita wok,na im don wok  as pesin wey dey check hol wetin dem rait for paper bifor evri bodi go ci am, e don bi president for Folklore Society bifor. Dem giv am Society Coote Lake reasearch Medal in 2008.  Na im bi di bifor bifor profesor for Sussex Centre of Folklore, na im bi di persin wey dey tok stori  for smol smol pikin for University of Chichester, West Sussex. E lik to dey to dey len abaut lokal popula pipul( pas mek shi dey tok abaut oda popula pipul wey no bi lokal), an e don du Plenti buk for dis kain pipul fom Iceland, Scandinavian, an England (E du one wit Jennifer Westwood wey don kpai). E don rait difren  buk an stodi on lokal tins for  difren English ples, an shi don du wok wit Steve Roud of di Penguin dictionary of English Folklore.

Terry Pratchett dey lik tok abaut am afta dem ci diasef for 1997, dat time Pratchett dey du risach on im buk, Carpe Jugulum, e dey ask pipul hau meni "magpie" rhymes wey dem sabi, hol of dem sabi onli one - wey dem uze for TV fim Magpie - Simpson sabi plenti, wen pratchett's dey tok, e tok sey e rich nineteen, wey mek am du wok wit am.

Im pasonal life
Na West Sussex , England Simpson live.

text:
Terri Quaye wey pipul sabi as Theresa (dem bon am for 8 November 1940, for Bodmin, wey de for England), na oyinbo singa, pesin wey dey pley piano, pesin wey dey rait song, an Percusionist. Shi bi gel-pikin of Cab Kaye wey sinio im sista wey im nem na Caleb Quaye an shi bi haf sista of Finley Quaye.

Shi du ha fest profeshona wok for 1958, wen shi sing wit Latin jazz band wey dia oga na Ido Martin. Na Colin Purbrook, Leon Cohen, an Brian Lemon dey folo am sing for stej, shi kon leta du residency wit Frank Holder. Shi wok wit for di group wey dem dey kol The merrymakers wen shi dey for Germany as a conga pleya an singa an kon stil folo Carmel Jones, Dave Pike, an Leo Wright ple song. Wen shi go Ghana wey bi di ples wey dem bon im grand papa put wey bi singa too Caleb Quaye (1895-1922), shi get ha Ga nem:Naa-Koshie.

For 1970 shi folo  Manu Dibango, Syvilla Fort, Harold Mabern, Junie Booth, Richard Davis, Billy Higgins, Archie Shepp, Dudu Pukwana, John Stevens, Trevor Watts, Dr. John, an Art "Shaki" Lewis wok.

For 1980, shi kon put oll ha bodi as edukato an ethnomusicologist for Musium of African Art, Smithsonian institution, Washington, Dc United Stet, an 1990.shi kolet masta digri for ethumusicology for 1988 fom yunivasiti of London. Shi don olso sho ha sef as pipu wey sabi tek foto of oda pipu. Maplin Art Gallery get ha wok insaid dia pamanent koleshon. Most of fi song wey Shi du for 1990s na solo/piano Vokal, an shi kon open ha own bar for London, Jazzers 1996-99. Shi don bikom pesin wey dey wok wel wel as a lay preacher insaid Unitarian church. For 1970s an 80s dem no am as pesin wey bi percussionist. Shi dey liv for South Coast of England an one of  di pafomance wey shi jost wan du na 2022 Swanage Jazz festiva.

Wie dem gada di tori
title: Terri Quaye

text:
Susana Esther Baca de la Colina (dem bon am for May 24, 1940) na pesin wey kom from Peru wey dey sing, rait song, skul tisha, raita of tradishonal tori an e dey stodi how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik. Baca don kolet three  Latin Grami Awod. E dey among di pipul wey wok wel wel so dat Afro muzik wey kom from Peru no go kpai.
For July 2011, dem mek Baca di  Minista of Kolsho for Peru wen Ollanta Humala bi presido for Peru.
Na for November 2011 dey yuz Baca as memba of  Organaizeshon of Amerika Stet an mek am di Presido of di komiti wey de luk into kolsho mata for 2011-2013.

Now e tek stat life
Dem bon Susana Baca for Chorrillos wey dey  Lima teritri for Peru for May 24, 1944.

How e tek wok
Baca mentod of singin na to yuz di old tradishonal mentod of singin wit di now adaz mentod of singin. Wen Baca dey sing, e dey yuz peru instrumet like box wey dey yuz bambu du, clay pot an ginta. Meni of Baca song na tradishonal song, e stil dey yuz some mentod wey Cuban an Brazil dey yuz sing somtimes. Di fest albom wey e du, Luaka Bop mek pipul no Baca wel wel. Na Greg Landau produs di albom.
Pipul wey dey lisin to Afro-Peru muzik no fit forget Baca bikos e dey among dos wey no allow mek do muzik kpai ( for ezampul, so Dana from di Perú Negro group, as wel as Festejo muzik.)
Baca don mek Peru muzik dey veri popular as e rilis di CD Afro-Peruvian Classics: The Soul of Black Peru. Di albom wey Luaka Bop get Baca song Maria Lando.Na David Byrne wey dey in Talking head bifor get di song.

Wetin pipul tok abaut e wok
Meni pipul wey sabi muzik tok sey Baca na pesin wey e impotats pass onli to sing Afro-Peruvian singa.
One pesin wey sabi muzik Michael Heumamn wey dey wok for  Stylus Magasin sey: Maria Lando put susana

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Susana Baca

text:
Linda Williamson (e papa nem bifo shi mari na Rast, dem bon am for January 2, 1949) na one America pesin wey sabi buk wel wel abaut di tori of pipul wey dey travu for Scotland. Na shi mek plenti pipul sabi Duncan Williamson tori wel wel.

Tori abaut E Life
Na Thomas Robinson Rast an Thelma Jane Cass bon Williamson for Madison-Wiscomson for USA.
Wen shi bi six yia old,shi stodi old oyinbo tradishonal muzik dem, dey song for Kuaya dem, dey play piano stil dey play muzik wey smol grip dey play togeda.
Afta shi finish skul for Yunifasiti of Wisconsin-Madison skul of muzik,shi mari one Amerika man wey e nem na Mark Headlee.Di two of dem kom dey stay for Edinburgh,Scotland so dat e hosband go stat to stodi for PhD ontop Philosophy, an shi sef kom enta to stodi one program wey konsan difren-difren tin dem(Interdisciplinary) for di Yunifasiti of Edinburgh skul of Scottish stodi dem an shi wok wit meni pipul wey Sabi buk wel-wel plus Hamish Henderson.As shi dey do di program, Williamson kpm stat to dey kolet tradishonal muzik dem, Song dem,Stori dem an (lore) som pipul molej an tradishona dem of pipul wey dey travul wel-wel for Scotland.Shi even travul wit Peter Cooke wey bi ethnomusicologist an Alan Brugord wey bi florist an shi kom intaviu an rekod Betsy Whyte of Montrose an Jare Turriff of Mintlaw, two of dem dey wok for Blair Haus.(Even sef whyte put Linda nem inside e buk wey e kol "Yellow on the Broom"). Bikos of dis pipul wey shi mit,shi kom stat to dey len abaut one man wey get seven pikin bot wey mo get waif wey e nem na Duncan Williamson an na Argyllshire pesin wey dey travul wel-wel.Afta som time shi kom mit di man for 1975.
As di two of dem dey wok togeda,dem kom stat to dey love dem sef.
Shi tel e hosband sey shi no wan Mari am again di man gree.Afta shi Liv E hosband, shi kom Mari Duncan on February 22,1977.
Williamson stey wit Duncan for one tradishonal Scottish tent wey pipul wey dey travul dey yuz.As e dey Liv E laif,na so e put mind for wetin shi dey do.Shi rait di tins dem wey Duncan don rait e Tori buk dem wey e poblish for Edinburgh, New York, Cambridge, Oxford London an Milan.
Dem two kontiniu to dey togeda on til 1993,wen dem kom sepret but Williamson kontiniu to wok wit Duncan ontop niu-niu buk dem an dem join-bodi do som Tori dem.Shi kom bak kom stey wit am for some mont dem bifor Stroke siknes kill am for November 8,2007.
title: Linda Williamson

text:
Marie Magdalene Elizabeth Hassenpflug (dem bon 27 December 1788 an e kpai on 21 November 1856) na German raita wey plenti of e tradishonal tori dey inside di koleshon of tori wey [[Brothers Grimm| Brodas Grimm] poblish. Pipul sabi am for e tori like "Little Red Riding hood", "Sleeping Beauty" an Snow White

How e tek stat life
Na for Ortsteil AltenjaBlau of Linsengericht aria in Landgrafschaft Hessen-Darmstadt of  Holi Roman Empaya dey bon Marie Magdalene Elizabeth Hassenpflug on December 27, 1788. Hassenpflug papa Johannes Hassenpflug (1755-1834) mari Hassenpflug mama Marie Magdalena Dresen (1767-1840). E mama kom from di Huguenot famili wey dey stey in Hanau.
For October 14, 1789, e famili pak go a house wey pipul dey kol "Haus Lossow" wey near maket korna of LindenstraBe in Neustadt. Hassenpflug famili pak go dia bikos dey mek e papa di hed of a di town Neustadt-Hanau. Hassenpflug gro up in dat house an na dat di famili stey onti 1799.
Hassenpflug get two sista an one broda. Di nem of di two sista na Jeanette an Amalie. Di nem of e onli broda na Hans Ludwig Alexander.
Hassenpflug na sikla wen e dey skol an one pesin wey no buk wel wel Heinz Rölleke tok sey dis one fit don mek am luv tradishonal tori bikos na bed e dey always stey. Na bikos e bi padi or frend wit Engelhards famili na e mek am get link to bi frend wit di Grimm famili. Hassenpflug onli broda Ludwig mari Charlotte Grimm. Charlotte Grimm bi di yonga sista of di  Brodas Grimm.

On 15 April 1799, Hassenpflug famili pak go Kassel bikos dey transfa e papa an give am posishon of finashal Supavasor of di Landgrafschaft Hassen-Kassel.
Marie Hassenpflug mari Friedrich von Dalwigk zu Schauenburg. E hosband stey for "Hanau" as di kaptain of di Kurprinz rigimet. Hassenpflug live for e hosband estate in "Hoof''" ( di niu nem for Hoof now na Schauenburg) an in Hanau. Na for Hanau dey bon dia boi Ludwig Alexander. Hassenpflug bon Ludwig Alexander on 24 January 1817.

From 1819 go rish 1824, Hassenpflug serve as pesin wet dey hep Herzogin Marie Friederike von Anhalt Bernburg wey Hi di gel-pikin of Langraf an leta Kurfürst Wilhelm IX/I of Hesse-Kassel.

text:
Lucy Duran na British wuman wey dey stodi how difren difren kolshor dey men muzik, e dey produs song an e dey tok for redio.Durán don wok as pesin wey dey kip old old tins at di  Nashonal Labrari Sound Arkeve. Durán join SOAS  Yunivasiti of London in 1993 an e na professor of Muzik espeshali di one from Afrika an Cuba in di Skull of Arts. Na Gustavo Durán wey bi Spanish komposa an sivil war soja  bon am. Jane Durán wey dey rait song an Cheli Durán wey dey rait buk bi e sista-dem.
Durán dey always tom to [[[BBC Radio 3| BBC Redio 3]]  Wold Muzik program wey di nem na "World Routes". Di Redio program stat in 2000 go rish 2013 an tok about difren difren tradishonal muzik wey kom from difren kontrie like Madagascar, Equatorial Guinea, Paraguay an Albania.

Duran don produs muzik rekod wey pass twenty albom an meni lidin Afrika muzishan don folk am wok.Meni Afrika muzishan wey folo am wok bi Mali Kora Playa Toumani Diabaté for di rekod "Kaira, Djelika, Songhai 2," New Ancient String ( Toumani Diabaté wit Ballaké Sissoko), and Toumani & Sidiki; Kulanjan (wit Taj Mahal an Toumani Diabaté). di rekod "Kulanja bi di muzik wey Barack Obama like pass wen e dey kampain to bi USA presidor in 2008.

Durán stil wok wit Mali singa Masse May Diabaté Kasai Kasse an Ngoni playa Bassekou Kouyaté Segu Blue, and I Speak Fula. Oda muzishan wey e don wok wit bi song raita Manecas Costa wey kom from Guinea Bissau: "Paraiso di Gum be", an di 2017 kolabo wit di grup wey kom from Mali, "Trio Da Kali" wit di "Kronos Quartet". Duran join hand wit Nick Gold an David Harrington to produs di albom "Ladilikan". Na "World Circuit Record''" rilis di albom an pipul like di albom wel wel an di albom kolet meni awod.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Lucy Durán

text:
Ruth Lyndall Tongue (dem bon for February 1898 an shi kpai for September 1981) na oyinbo pesin wey dey rait an tok tori wel wel an shi don du plenti lokal an som oda buks.

Tori abaut im life
Dem bon Ruth Tongue for Handsworth, Shi bi di third pikin an na shi smol Pas insaid Edwin Tongue wey bi im papa, wey bi kongrigashon minista an im waif Mabel Jones. Di famili pak go Tauton wen Ruth's stil dey smol, an dem kon stil pak komot for dia go Middle sex for 1908. Bikos sey Ruth don gro, shi stat to dey go klas for London kolej of muzik an leta go stodi for London Siti Literal Institute. Shi kon wok as a tisha an shi stil laik muzik an drama. For 1950 shi pak go Crowcombe, Somerset  na for die Shi stat to dey paform to dey tok tori an tok on tradishonal Mata bot di two na for lokal pipu an for insaid redio shi for dey du am. Shi add tori to di koleshon of tradishonal mata Katherine Briggs, na shi hep ha du ha own manuscripts for poblikashon, an shi kon leta join bodi wit am mek dem du one buk wey im nem na Folktales of England.

Tongue kom gom pipu wey go skul wel wel, shi feel about di repot wit di kontri folk of Somerset. Shi tok sey im mama bon am durin chime hour on Friday night, na dis one kom mek am get diffren koneshon wit di pipu of kontri-side; rekod tok sey na Monday dem bon am. Shi don tok tori of di Asra, sea morgan, lazy Lawrence, hyter sprites, oekmen, an plenti plenti oda kreshors, wey don appear for  Briggs encyclopaedia of fairies an in leta koleshon of folklore or fantasi.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Ruth Tongue

text:
Stella Brewer Brookes (dem bon am for January 22, 1903 an e kpai in November 1993) na profeso of Inglish for  Clark Kolej (di nem leta chenj to Clark Atlanta Yunivasiti) from 1924 to 1969. Brewer na pesin wey de stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way an na raita.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Fannin, Texas dem bon Brewer on January 22, 1903. Brewer  a one of di six pikin-dem wey J.H Brewer an Minnie Brewer bon. E papa de sel fud stuff an e mama na skul tisha.
Brewer broda J.Mason Brewer too na tradishonal tori raita. Brewer get e Yunivasiti digri in  Wiley Kolej wey dey Marshall, Texas. E get e Masta of Arts in Inglish from di  Yunivasiti of Michigan an kolet e Ph.D from  Cornell Yunivasiti in 1946 afta  e hosband kpai. Di Pepa wey e tek kolet e Ph.D na "Folklore in the Writings of Joel Chandler Haris".

How e tek wok
Brewer bikom professor at Clark Kolej in Atlanta. For Clark Kolej, e bi hed of Inglish Dipatmet, advaisa to studet poblikashon "The Mentor" an e fom di |Atlanta Yunivasiti Sentra Literary Symposium.Brewer stil tish durin holiday piriod at di  Alabama Stet Tisha Kolej.
Na Brewer rait di buk "Joel Chandler Harris, Folklore" (1950), an oda wok wey Haris du. Brewer ritaya for Clark Kolej afta e don wok for 45 years. Dey give am Honorari  Doktor of Leta digri from di Kolej.
Brookes an e hosband dey aktive in di NAACP in Atlanta. Na Brewer give NAACP tok in Emancipation Day adress in 1939. Brewer put bodi for di George Federation of Colored Women's Club. In 1948, dey pik am to bi di "Bronze Woman of the Year in Education in Atlanta by lota Phi Lambda sorority. Brewer stil kolet odas honors from di International Mark Twain Society'' an lokal television stashon WSB

E pasonal life
Stella Brewer mari Enos Luther Brookes in 1928. Enos Luther Brookes na professor of Kemistri an fisis wey kom from Jamaica.
title: Stella Brewer Brookes

text:
Luvsannorov Erdenechimeg (dem bon am for 1957) na pesin wey dey stodi how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik an how di muzik dey du pipul wey lisin to am. E na risasha.

How e tek stat life
Na for Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia 
dey bon Erdenechimeg in 1957.Erdenechimeg kom from di famili wey like to stodi langwej an rekod how pipul dey du tins for lokal way. Erdenechimeg risach wok na stodi on old  Asian muzik histri. Erdenechimeg bi  visiti professor at di  Indiana Yunivasiti, Dipatmet of Sentral Eurasian Stodies from 2005 go rish 2008.

How e tek go skul
Erdenechimeg get e bashelor digri in Muzik from di Muzikal Kolej in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia in 1978. E kolet e Bashelor an Masta digri at di  Tchaikovsky Konsavatori (wit Dr.Pr. Yuri Nikolaevich Kholopov) in [[Moscow, Russia from 1980 go rish 1986. Erdenechimeg rid Muzik at di  Shanghai Konsavatori (wit Pr. Chen Ying Shi) from 1997 go rish 1999. Na two Ph.D Erdenechimeg get.Di Pepa wey e rait tek kolet di fest Ph.D na "The Consonant and Dissonant Sounds of the Harmony of the Horse-headed Fiddle" for di  Mongolian Nashonal Yunivasiti of Art in 1993. Di sekod Ph.D pepa wey e rait na "The Harmony of the Mongolian Meditation Guru Song " for di  Mongolian Akademi of Sayens in 2000. Sins 2000, Erdenechimeg don bi Assosiate Professo in di Dipatmet of Muzik Tihori of di Mongolian Nashonal Yunivasiti of Art.

Buk wey e don rait
Erdenechimeg don rait ova 15 buks on muzik an muzik wey kom from Mongolian. Meni of e buk dey intaprit to Chinese, Russian, an  Inglish. One of e buk "Eighteen songs of a Nomad Flite" bi di fest old Chinese buk wey dey intaprit to Mongolian. Di buk kom out in 2002 an bikos of how pipul like di buk, dey print di buk again in 2003. Dey mek di buk into three langwej, Chinese, Mongolian an Inglish an Erdenechimeg stil add some niu tins like how di poem tek konet wit di instrumental Muzik, song, art, an drama. Di Mongolian komposa Tsogzolyn Natsagdorj yuz di buk du e stage Muzik show.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Luvsannorovyn Erdenechimeg

text:
Mary Elizabeth Jones (dem bon am February 8, 1902 an e kpai in July 17, 1984) na America gospel an tradishonal singa wey pipul sabi as singa wey hep men pipul like tradishonal song, games an tori in di 20 senturi.Wen Alan Lomax fest mit am, e tok sey "Jones rili wan tish America pipul from e heart. Alan Lomax too sey e kol Jones di mama konrej of Amerika Blak tradishon.

How e tek stat life
Jones gro up in a smol blak famin komuniti in Dawson, Georgia. Jones famili poor but dey like muzik wel wel. E grapapa wey bi slave wey dey bon in Afrika dey always dey tish Jones di kind song wey e dey sing wen e dey wok inside farm. Jones no go skul again wen e rish ten years old an by di time wey Jones go rish 12 years, e don mari an bon pikin. Jones hosband Cassius kpai afta some years wey dey don mari.
In 1924, Jones leave e 10 years old pikin wit e famili memba-dem an waka go Florida. For Florida, e stat to dey du all dose smol skol wok, dey play kard an sel ogogoro. Jones leta get e sekod hosband an stey wit am for St. Simon Island an kom join di  Georgia Sea Hiland Singa
E dey hungri Jones mek  Afrika-Amerika histri no jos kpai like dat. E wan yuz song an dans tek save di Afrika-Amerika histri. Dis one mek am travul go  New York Siti in 1961. For New York e jam Lomax so dat Lomax fit rekod e life tori an di bodi of muzik wey e get. Jones an di grup "Georgia Sea Hiland Singa" travul an dey sing in di 1960s. Dey sing for Carnegie Hall, [[Central Park| Sentral Pak, di Smithsonian Institution folklore festivals, di Newport Folk Festival an di Monterey Folk Festival on May 18 to 19, 1963. Jones kolet meni awod for tradishonal muzik an e inklud National Endowment for the Arts National Heritage Fellowship in 1982 an di Duke Ellington Fellowship at  Yale Yunivasiti.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Bessie Jones

text:
Elizabeth Marcelle Lively Hamer (dem bon am for July 14, 1900 an e kpai March 4, 1974) na Amerika Labrarian an e dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. E wok for ova 30 years at di  Yunivasiti of Texas an di  El Paso Poblik Labrari. E dey wok as espat in Texas tradishonal tori an histri. Hamer wok for 17 years as person wey dey kip dia moni for  Texas Folklore Sosaheti.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Whitewright, Texas dey bon Elizabeth Marcelle Libely on July 14, 1900. E papa nem na Robert Morris an e mama nem na Clara Susan (Lemon) Lively. Hamer papa  a pesin wey dey sel big goods an banka. E mama na Inglish tisha for  Grayton Kolej. Hamer yuz one year at di skul wey rilijon sista dey kontro  Kidd-Key Kolej bifor e kom go finish e sekondri skul for  Southeastern Stet Normal.
In 1919, Hamer get a two-year digri from  Kristen Kolej. For di Kolej, e bi dia studet union presidor. Hamer kolet e Bashelor digri in Inglish from di  Yunivasiti of Oklahoma in 1921. E leta get e Masta digri from di Yunivasiti of Texas in 1939. Di Pepa  wey Hamer wok wit na "Anecdotal Elements in Southwestern Literature".
In a 1943 Life Magazine wey tok abaut Texas tori, na Hamer Pepa dey tok sey pipul rid pass in di hol of Yunivasiti of Texas koleshon.

Hamer mari e hosband Robert Colt Hamer in 1922. Di marej produs one gel-pikin, Mary Marcelle Hamer Hull. Hamer marej skata in 1930.

How e tek wok
Hamer wok as di daretor of di Texas koleshon at di Yunivasiti of Texas from 1935 go rish 1955. Hamer dey yuz di big "Battle Hall reading room" as e ofis.
El Paso Poblik Labrari give am wok sey mek e bi di Refirens assistant in 1955.
title: Marcelle Lively Hamer

text:
Jane Hicks Gentry (dem bon am for December 18, 1863 - e kpai May 25, 1925) na Appalachian pesin wey dey stodi an sing abaut lokal tins, dem bon am for Watauga  County, North Carolina. Plenti pipul sabi am bikos of di way wey e dey ask question an "Jack Will, and Toms Tales",  wit di song e rekod Cecil Shap, plenti pipul sabi sey dem stat for England, Scotland or Germany, an kon pas to Jane's famili bifor e kon rich am.

Hau e tek stat life 
Na im bi di sinior for hol di five pikin wey Emiley Harmon an Ransom Hicks bon. Im broda an sista na John Riley, Mary, Magaret Elizabeth an William. Dia famili kom fom England, dem dey insaid famili wey American Revolutionary War mek dem kom America. Na fom Wurttemburg, Germany im fore fadas kom bifor dem kin dey stay for Amerika, bifor di America Revolutionary war, wen Emily dey 12 or 13 years old, dem folo oda famili muv go Maddison County, on di Meadow Fork of Spring Creek, na farm wok e dey du for dia. Meni times wen Emily dey wok insaid im haus, wen smol pikin gada am, e go dey sing for dem an dey ask dem  question wey go mek dem think an tel dem stori wey don dey for long insaid  Harmon famili. Jane no too go skul, but e len hau to read wey mek am fit read di Bible. 

E mari Gasper Newton "Newt" Gentry in 1879, an dia two get nine pikin. (Lydia Nora, Martha Emily, Mary Magdalene, Alfred Chanay, Allie Mae, Lillie Bertha Maud, Roy Stevens, Lalla Marvin, Nola Jane). Na for Hot Springs dem bon dia las bon. Wia dem buy land to dey uze for famin an dey train anima. Gentry pikin go Presbyterian-run Dorland Institute, na fom wetin dem get fom di fam wey Newt dey, dem uze dey pay skul moni. Jane wok insaid di skul. Afta som time, na im kon dey chek pikin wey dey wok for di skul, meni pipul sabi Jane for di skul bikos of hau e dey tel dem stori, sing  an danc for dem. 

Afta som time, e stat to dey wok for wia skul pikin dey liv. One of di famili frend tok sey e sabi wok an mek odas wok sef. Sey e lik to tel storis an sing. Di United States Govment later chenj Montain Park Hotel wey dey Hot Spring to wia Wold War 1 German sailor wey dem kash kamp.  Som  of dia famili liv for town, an som na for wia skul pikin dey stay for Jane House.

Songs an Storis
Pesin wey dey gada lokal song Cecil Sharp an im frend Maud Karpeles kom Appalachia bikos one America pesin wey dey rait an sing lokal song Oliver Dame Campbell ask dem to kom mek dem gada old lokal song an short song stori insaid 1916. Pesin wey dey kontrol Dorland dat time, Lucy Shafer advis dem mek dem kol Jane Gentry. Fom August 24, 1916 rich July 27, 1917, Sharp an Karpeles chek Jane's songs, dem kolet 70 of im wok. Sharp no tok wia di song kom fom, but tok sey most Appalachia short stori lokal songs kom fom England or Lowland Scotland. Holgar Nygard, wey bi profesor for English for Duke University, tok sey na fom Scotland na wia planti of Jane's wok, anoda pesin Brain Peters, wen e stodi Sharp's Appalachian wok, sho sey smol song stori lik "Barbara Allien", "Little Musgrave"  an "Lord Thomas and Fair Ellender" kom fom England.

Jane dey kol im stori "Jack, Will and Toms Tales". Betty N. Smith wey bi singa an dey du wey sabi histri mach di song to German Märchen pipul wey don live an du gret tins, but stil tok sey dem fit bi Hick's English fore fadas. Irving Bacheller wey dey rait buks an im wife Anna fest ci Jane insaid wia school pikin dey stay in 1914, wia e dey tel smol smol pikin storis an ask dem question wey go mek dem hapi. Di Bachellers hapi sotey dem tel am mek e Kon ci dem for Greenwich, Connecticut.

Wen Betty N. du im findings, di visit dey insaid Bacheller's buk Tower of hundred Bells, wey spoil wen fire bon in 1917, wen Jane kpai pipul stil kon no sey no bi lie, insaid one letter wey Bacheller rait to im pikin Maud Long, e rait for di letter say, e rait abaut im mama an hau e tek liv life, but fire don bon di buk insaid im house in 1917.

Dem gada fifteen storis wey Jane du insaid twenty-three buk wey Isabel Gordon Parker  du in The Journal of America Folklore 1925. Di oda stori buk wey dem du for pipul to read na six by Sevier County, Tennessee, an two storis by John Campbell of Townsend, Tennessee. Carter, wey bi pesin wey dey stodi lokal tins tok sey dem kollet Jane song  an no too luk di storis. Wen dem ask Jane mek e tok abaut im wok, e tok tru sey storis don dey down sins im great grandmoda to im great grandfada Council Harmon.

Jane pikin wey bi girl Maud Long leta rekod som of im mama stori for di Archive of America Folk Song at di Library of Congress.

Hau e tek kpai
Newt Gentry kpai March 24, 1992.

Jane kpai in May 1925. Insaid di paper wey dem tek tel pipul sey e don kpai, dem rait insaid sey e sabi Engish old songs an shi sabi Scottish lokal songs.

Som of im wok 
. Smith, Betty N. (2015). Jane Hicks Gentry: A Singer Among Singers. The University Press of Kentucky. ISBN 978-0-8131-4835-9 – via Project MUSE.
title: Jane Hicks Gentry

text:
Enid Porter (dem bon am for October 8, 1908 an e kpai for January 16, 1984) na pesin wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way in Cambridgeshire. Enid Mary Porter na pesin wey don wok for long time as e dey kolet an kip old old tins for Museum of Cambridge as e wok from 1947 go rish 1976. E wok rili helep to rekod di kolsho an sosha life of Cambridgeshire pipul. Enid tink an yuz sens as e dey hep kolet soshal histri of pipul. E dey allow pipul to tok dia histri an mek suo pipul tok abaut aria wey oda pipul wey dey stodi an rekod how pipul dey du tins for old way no like to du.
Enid buks wey dey Museum of Cambridge get beta beta informashon about kostom, tori an song of Cambridgeshire pipul.

How e ten stat life
Na for Westcliff-on-Sea, Essex, dey bon Enid Mary Porter on October 8, 1908. E papa nem na Hugh Porter an e mama nem na Ethel Mary Porter. Enid papa Hugh, kom from Bedford an e du e tisha tranin at a hiya-grade skul for Cambridge. E papa dey tish bifor for "Southend High School". Enid mama Ether Mary ( bifor e mari e papa nem na Scott) kom from di famili wey don tey for Cambridge sins Seventeen senturi. Bikos of e mama famili histri, Enid dey go visit e mama famili memba for Cambridge an e sabi di aria wel wel. Enid dey always dey rekod tradishonal tori wey e mama famili memba dey tel am.
Di Portel famili-dem rili go skul wel wel an get pipul wey dey wok for dem onti di fest wold war stat.
Afta wey Enid go rid modern langwej at  Yunivasiti Kolej London ( na inside di yunivasiti di Folklore Sosaheti Librari dey sins 1911). Enid folo e papa an kolet tranin at di Katolik Tranin Kolej, London an den stat to dey tish for difren difren skul onti di sekod wold war stat.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Enid Porter

text:
Rulan Chao Pian (dem bon am for April 20, 1922 an e kpai for November 30, 2013) na wuman wey dey stodi how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik an professor of  Chinese langwej an [Literature| Litireshon]]. Rulan Chao Pian bi one of di fest ten wuman to Hi full professor in di Falkoti of Arts an Sayens at  Harvard Yunivasiti.

How e tet stat life
Na for April 20, 1922 dey bon Rulan Chao Pian inside a big Chinese famili. Pian Papa Yuen Ren Chao stodi langwej.Pian mama Buwei Yang Chao na doktor an e also dey rait buk.Pian perent don dey stey for Cambridge sins 1920 bikos e papa get wok at Falkoti at Harvard Yunivasiti. Pian famili leta travul go China an France, but kom bak to "United State" .Di famili stil go Hawaii, New Haven, an Washington D.C. Wen Pian still dey yong, e lens to play piano skol but bikos of e famili travul travul, e no easi for Pain to fit len am wel.
Pian enta  Radcliffe Kolej wia e tek kolet e  Bashelo of Art an e  Masta of Art in muzik histri (Westa muzik) in 1943 ( na 1944 de e satifiket) an 1946 for e Masta. E kolet e Ph.D in East Asia Langwej and in Muzik in 1960. Some of di pipul wey tish am abaut muzik na "Doc" Archibald T. Davison, Edward Ballantine, A.Tillman Merritt, John Ward, an Walter Piston. Pian fest tish at Harvard Yunivasiti as tishin assistant from 1947 onti e kom get promoshon as instructor an leshura. In 1947, Pian bikom professor in di Dipatmet of Muzik an di Dipatmet of East Asian Langwej an Sivilisashon. Pian bi one of di three fimeli professor in di Harvard Muzik Dipatmet an one of di thirteen in di hol Falkoti of Arts an Sayens wey dey no fit komot onti e ritaya.
title: Rulan Chao Pian

text:
Carrie Blanche Grover (dem bon am for 1879 an e kpai for 1959) na Kanada tradishonal singa, an pesin wey dey kip tradishonal song an e sabi play Violin. Pipul respet am on tradishonal song an som of e song dey rekod of di  Librari of Kongress wey Alan Loma an Sidney Robertson Cowell put dia.

How e tek stat life
Na for Nova Scotia dey bon Carrie Spinney in 1879. Grover stey for Nova Scotia onti e rish 12 year old. Grover papa nem na George Craft an e mama nem na Eliza Long. Di famili kom pak go Maine an e kom go  Gould Akademi 
Wen one raita wey e nem na Fred Lincoln Hill wan tok abaut Grover e tok sey:
" Na from famili wey dey du farma, dey grind korn an dey kut faya wood e tek kom from. E don tey wey e gra gra papa dem kom Amerika.In fact, e famili don kom Amerika bifor di time wey Amerika stat to fight for Indipedet wit Inglish, Scotch, Welsh an Irish pipul. Grover mama famili-dem an papa famili-dem sabi sing wel wel.
In 1896, Carrie mari Almon Roy Grover in 1896 an na Gorham town dey both live. Di marej produs three pikin: Gertrude, Ethel an Roy.

E tradishonal muzik
Afta wey pipul don no am wel wel as tradishonal muzik singa, Grover in 1941 rekod 87 songs an Violin sound for di Librari of Congress. Di Librari of Congress tok sey: "Mrs. Grover sit-down in front of mikrofone an rekod twenty-skx disc. Di song wey e rekod som of dem don pass ova 100 years"
Rekod wey Grover du also dey pat of Eloise Hubbard Linscott koleshon. Na Grover bi di onli Niu England Wuman wey dey play Violin wey de inside di koleshon. Linscott tok sey e rili hapi sey Grover rekod de e koleshon. Linscott tok sey wetin Grover no sing e yuz violin tok am from e ova 400 song wey Grover get.
title: Carrie B. Grover

text:
Estella Louisa Michaela Canziani (dem bon am for January 12, 1887 an e kpai for August 23, 1964) na British wuman wey dey draw, dey paint, dey rait an e dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal ways.

How e tek stat life
Na for London dey bon Estella Canziani on January 12, 1887. Canziani bi di gel-pikin of Louisa Starr an Enrico Canziani (1848-1931). Canziani papa Enrico Canziani na painta an e mama Louisa Starr na Italian sivil enjiniha.  A for di famili house wey dey 3, Palace Green inside Kensington Palace e tek spent all e life.
Na aktist Canziani bi an e fest stodi for "Copernicus". Copernicus na one Kensington skul wey Sir Arthur Cope an Erskine Nicol dey kontro. Canziani stil go  Royal Akademi skul. Canziani show some of e paintin wok for RA London, Liverpool, Milan, Venice an France. Di paintin wey dey tek no Canziani na "The Piper of Dreams" wey e yuz wota kolor paint. E  show di paintin for pipul to si at di Royal Akademi in 1915. Meni pipul don copi an du paintin wey resembu Canziana paintin an e almoat wan bi di same of nomba of pipul wey ri du  Holman Hunt paintin The Light of the World.
Canziani travul wel wel araund Europe, espeshiali Italy.Di paintin wey e dey du dey show how lokal pipul dey diress an dey du tins in di vilej wey de I side inside Norta Italy. Canziani stil dey draw for buk.
Canziani stil dey rait buks. E don rait three buks: Costumes, Tradition and Songs of Savoy (1911), Piedmont (1913) an  Through the Appennines and the Land of the Abruzzi. Bikos of di buks wey e rait, Canziani nem de memba of di  Royal Jihogtafikal Sosaheti. Canziani rait meni hatikul in di jonal of di  Folklore Sosaheti. Canziani rait e own life tori inside di buk: ''Round About three Green (1939)
Dey kip meni of Canziani wok for Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery
title: Estella Canziani

text:
Anne Rasmussen (dem bon am for 1959) na Amerika tisha an pesin wey dey stodi how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik an how di muzik dey du pipul wey de lisin to am.
Plenti of di wok wey Rasmussen du na abaut  Arab Muzik for US an how dem tek de woship for Islam rilijon. Na Rasmussen bi di oga kpatakpata for di "William and Mary Middle Eastern Music Ensemble" sins 1994. Dey pik Rasmussen nem as di William M. an Anne B. Bickers professor of  Midi Easta Stodis in 2014.

How e tek go skul
Na for  Northwestern Yunivasiti Rasmussen dey kolet e B.A satifiket. E du e Masta program for  Yunivasiti of Denver. Wen Rasmussen wan du e Ph.D e go rid how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik an how di muzik dey du pipul wey dey lisin to am (Ethomusicology) from  Yunivasiti of Kalifoniha, Los Angeles. E klass mate dat time bi: A.J Racy, Timothy Rice, Nazir Jairazbhoy, Gerald Behague, an Scot Marcus.

How e tek wok
Rasmussen don rait meni pepa in meni Niuz pepa or magazine.E don rait abaut meni tins like: Ethnomusicology,  Asian Muzik, The World of Muzik,  Di Garland ensakopediha of Wold Muzik, an di  Harvard Dishonari of Muzik. Rasmussen produs four CD wey e tek rekod how pipul dey enta US an di komuniti muzik wey pipul dey sing for US. E bi forma Fulbright Sinior Skola an e dey wok as di Fest Vais Presidor of di  Sosaheti for Ethnomusicology.
Rasmussen dey tish "ethnomusicology" for  Di Kolej of William & Mary sins 1993. For di Kolej, e stil dey kontro how Midu East Muzik group dey du tins.
Rasmussen folo di Indonesian  Ku'ran spika Maria Ulfah waka araund United States  for di 1999 pafomas wey dey du wit di sopot of  Midu East Stodis Hasosiashon of North Amerika. Wen e go risach abaut muzik for Oman kontri, Di govamet of Oman an di  Sultan Qaboos Kolshoral Senta du parti for Rasmussen bikos of e wok for dia.
title: Anne Rasmussen

text:
Mary Hayes Davis (dey bon am araund 1884 an e kpai May 18, 1948) na Amerika raita, Niuz-pepa editor, an a poblisha. Davis get meni fims tihata. Meni pipul sabi Davis bikos e join bodi wit Chow Leung to rait di buk Chinese Fables and Folk Stories. Na wen Chow Leung de Chicago dey stat to rait di buk. Na for 1908 dey poblish di buk an pipul wey mek di buk tok sey di buk na di fest buk wey get Chinese tori wey dey yuz Inglish print. Meni pipul don ri-print di buk.
From 1908 go rish 1912, Davis kolet Native Amerika tradishonal tori wey Pima pipul an Apache pipul tok to rait di buk wey e stil dey wok on. Pima an Apache pipul dey stey Oklahoma an Arizona side of Amerika.
Davis pak to live for Southwest Florida an na for dia e tek poblish "The Hendry County News" an e stil get an kontro Seven fim tihata. In 1926, "The Tampa Tribune" kol Davis strong wuman of LaBelle as e no fear to ripot di killin of Henry Patterson even as bad pipul tok sey dey go sho am shege if e tok am. Dey give e Niuz-pepa, The Henry County News di Florida Niuz-pepa Assosiashon awod for Best Komuniti Niuz Davis in 1928. Di fim Tihata  Dixie Kirsta Tihata wey Davis Opun in 1941 de di list of  Nashonal Rejista of Historik Ples

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na araund 1884 dey bon Mary Hayes Davis in West Virginia. E dey stey for farm. Davis also live in Kansas. Davis onli yuz one year for kolej. Na e hosband fest kpai bifor e sef kpai.

Chinese tori an tradishonal tori
In 1900, wen e stil dey len in Chicago, Davis get one job to bi riporta an to dey rait for one popular niuz-pepa wey dey kom out evri day. Bikos of di riportin wok, e get to no pipul from  Chinatown, Shikago. Pipul wey e mit inklud Pastor Chow Leung. Chow Leung bi di pastor of di Senta Baptist Chinese Mission.
title: Mary Hayes Davis

text:
Allison Balfour or Margret Balfour na one of di wuman wey dey joj e kase sey e na witch in 1594 for Scotland. Na for  Orkney Hiland of Scotland wey dey aria of Stenness Balfour dey stey. For dat time for Scotland, di Scottish Witchcraft Art 1563 tok sey eni bodi wey dey katch as Witch  go kpai.
Na Patrick Stewart, 2nd Earl of Orkney wey pipul sabi as Black Patie dey kontro Orkney wen dey joj Balfour in 1594. Patie biliv sey e yonga broda espeshial John Stewart, Earl of Carrick, dey plan to kil am. Patie kom diskova Poisin medisine in one of di savant wey dey wok for John. Di savant nem na Thomas Paplay. Afta wey dey don bit di savant for eleven days, e tok sey Balfour de among di pipul wey wan kil Patrick Steward, 2nd Earl of Orkney.
Bifor dey finali kil di savant, e tok sey Balfour no dey among dose wey wan kil Patrick Steward. Even sey di savant tok sey Balfour hand no dey for di plan, dey stil kari Balfour familia go Kirkwall. For dia, dey flog am onti e gri sey e hand de dia. Di kot tok sey Balfour na no somtin abaut di posin medisine, sey e na Witch an sey mek dey go kil am. Just like di savant Paplay, Balfour tok sey e no no enitin abaut all di tin wey dey tek hakuss am but dey stil kil am on December 16, 1594. Bifor e kpai e tok of all di sofa sofa wey den du e famili an sey e hand klin for di mata. Na for Gallow Ha' Kirkwall dey tek kil am.

Tori of Witch for Orkney
Di Hiland of Orkney get dis old biliv sey Witch, juju an sey odas extra ordinari living tins de. Meni pipul for dia biliv sey majik pawa na norma pat of life an sey notin bad abaut am. By 1550, di pipul of Scotland stat to katch Witch. Di pipul wey dey mek law onda  Mary Kween Of Scot pass di Scottish Witchcraft Act in 1563. Di law tok sey eni Witch wey dey katch na kil dey go kil am.
Even sey di Orkney Hiland dey Honda Norway law onto 1611, na Scotland dey kontro di Hiland from 1468 onda di rule of Scottish lord. Na Patrick Stewart, 2nd Earl of Orkney day kontro di Hiland in 1594 wen dey fest stat di findin of Witch in Orkney.
title: Allison Balfour

text:
Emily Lyle (dem bon am for 19 December 1932 for Glasgow) na one Scottishballad student an sinior risash pesin for di skul of Celtic an Scottish stodi dem for di Yunifasiti of Edinburgh.

Hau E Liv E Laif
Emaily Lyle grow up for Kilbarchan,Kenfrewshire,Scotland.Shi stodi Inglish langwej an litresho for di Yunifasiti of St.Andrew(MA 1954),an shi kom stil stodi Edukeshon for Yunifasiti of Glasgow(Diploma in Edekeshon,1955).
Shi tish Inglish for six yias for Sekondri skul dem for Britain an New Zealand bifor dem kom apoont am as leshora of Inglish for Ripon Kolej of Edukeshon for Yarkshire(1961-65) an shi stil bi Sinior leshora for Inglish for Neville's Cross Kolej for Durham (1965-68).
Shi rait abaut Thomas di Rhymer an Tam Lin for Litresho an tradishona.Shi tek am stodi as dokto for itskul of folk-Lifestodi for di Yunifasiti of Leeds.
Afta som time shi stop to dey tish Inglish-litresho an kom stat im own wok ontop Sottish stodi.

Hau E do Skul Wok
For 1976-77,shi go Australia Nashona Yunifasiti for Australia go wok as fellow.As shi dey for Australia, shi stat to dey kolet tins wey konsan Scottish pipul,plus CD "Cho kit on a Tattie" (di spesha tins wey konsan smol-smol pikin song dem an wod dem wey end wit disem saund),an wok ontopbTochter.
For 1977,Lyle dash  Nashona Laibri of Australia plenti tins wey shi don rekod.
Di wok wey shi do for Radcliffe Institute of Harvard Yunifasiti for 1974-75 giv am chans to tek travulbgo Harvard Meni time an mek plenti pipul know am wel-wel.
Dem even giv am wok for di senta for di stodi of Wold Rilijon for 1995.
Dem apoint am as risash fellow for so skul of Scottish stodi  for di Yunifasiti of Edinburgh for 1970 to 1995 an kom stil mek am leshora from 1995 to 1998.As Profeso for folklore shi do som wok for Yunifasiti of California for Los Angeles for 1978.From 1979-1982 shi stil do som wok for folklore stodi for Yunifasiti of Stirling from 1979 to 1982.
Na sins 1998 dem don giv am honor as fellow for di skul of Celtic an 
Scottish  for Edinburgh.
