text:
Bold text'Brita Börn''', or Brita Biòrns (dem bon am 1967-fl. an e kpai 1745), na swedish wuman, wey dem Sabi for Gotland as wuman wey im way no dey pure, an shi dey insaid Swedish wuman wey dia way no pure wey live dat time. Dem Kari am go two court an court tok sey im way no pure. 

Hau e tek live life
Brita Biörn mari boatswain Jons Biörn in 1960 an Pehr Biörn in 1704, but e no kon get hosband in 1718. Shi bon one pikin wey bi boy for im fest marriage. E dey posibu but dem no komfam am sey im sekond hosband na im first hosband broda. Na for Gammelgarn Dem bon am, but na Gothem shi live for 1685. 

Plenti Pipul Sabi am wel as wuman wey im way no dey pure, Bikos of her way we no dey pure, Parish Vicar of Gothem, Nicias Lutteman, tok sey na shi bi Ashawo in 1722.  For kourt shi tok sey na one man wey bi Jacob i Halla, wey Kari am go meet Di sma undar Jordi , wey dey stay insaid water tich am hau persin wey no go dey pure. Shi tok sey hol im bodi dey for bed but na im spirt go di plez. Kourt kon tok sey im mata na Satan dey disturb am or mek e bi sey shi don mad, dem kon tok sey shi go dey eat bread an water for eight days an uppenbar kykoplikt bikos shi dey wok on Sundays an shi dey uze Jesus, Holy Spirit an God nem wen shi dey du di tins. Dem Kon still kolet hol di wok wey hi dey du for im hand.

Wen dem judge di kase, plenti pipul kon sabi am wel wel as wuman wey im way no dey pure, Head of di chorch kon dey komplain sey plenti pipu dey go ci am for hep an dey du am lik sey shi bi god. In 1737, pesin wey dey as di chorch head kach am wit one pesin wey dey kom ci am, Beata Grupe, dem arest dia two, kon kari dem go wia pasto wey sta. Dem ask am question abaut kase wey shi get for di sekond time in 1738. Shi tok sey na im papa broda Gertrud Zakrisdotter (1647-1718 ) tich am, an shi read hau shi tek tok wen shi dey du di juju for kourt. Di kourt tok sey shi no dey du witch, but tel am wetin dem tok wen dem ask question for dat fest time. On 21 October 1738,  dem purnish am wen dem tok set me shi dey eat onli bread an water for 12 days. Na  Kajsatornet(Kajsa Tower) for Visby city wall. Dem tok sey Brita Biörn no kpai for late 1745, but nobodi no di year wey shi kpai. In 1760, for insaid parish register dem ci one old wuman nem wey don kpai, di pesin nem na Old Brita'', an in 1765, pesin wey no get hosband nem wey bi Biörn nem dey insaid pipul wey don die, but nobodi no if Brita Biörn na one of dia two.

Som oda pipul wey live afta am
Shi get bon pikin wey bi boatswain Olaf Jönsson Lunda (1692-1773), wey mari Pernilla Larsesdotter (1715-1779). Im son pikin wey bi girl Greta Enderberg (1746-1831) an im great granpikin wey bi girl Gertrud Ahlgren(1782-1874), wey folo im mama way wey no pure for Gotland: dem sabi dia two as Hejnumskäringen for dia time as wuman wey dia way no dey pure.
title: Brita Biörn

text:
Mona DouglasMBE,RBV( 18 September 1898-8 October 1987)na one Manx pesin wey dey fight for Kolsho right, folklorist, pesin wey dey rait poem,wey dey rait stori,an wey dey rait Nius.
Shi wok wel-wel tek Manx Kolsho get levul an stand gidigba.
Na shi get maut pass among di pipul wey rait wok on top Manx for 20th Senturi an na shi strong pass for all fine-fine wok dem for tradishonal Manx folk, muzik an dans.
Shi join-bodi tek do plenti big wok dem to tek helep mek Manx Kolsho get levul an stand wel-wel an e still join difren-difren Sosaiti, buk wok dem an yong pipul grup dem.
Di one wey get levul pas among di wok wey e don do na Yn Chruinnaght.

Wen E stil bi Smol Pikin
Dem bon Constance Mona Douglas(Connie) for 18 September 1898 for 49 Allerton Road, Much Woolton, Lancashire(di niu nem nau na Merseyside)
Na Frank Beardman Douglas(1863-1943) an Frances Mona(e papa nem bi Holmes- dem bon am for London, Ontario,Canada)bi e papa an Mama an di two of dem kom from Manx.E papa an Mama komot for Isle of Man go Ingland go find wok bot na bekri wok dem kom dey do for Birkenhead.
Bikos shi dey sik, dem Kari am go e mama -papa Haus Ellien"Nell" Quayle an Patrick" Pat" Holmes(dia nem na Thomas for do time wen dem kaunt pipul for 1901)wen  shi still bi one mont old pikin.
E grandma kom dey tish am meni-meni tins abaut Manx,dis kom mek e know plenti-plenti tins abaut di Manx folklore, di song an dans.Shi stay for Lezayre eria,afta kom stay for Ballaragh nia Lacey wen shi stil bi smol -pikin.Na for dis ples dem train am as shi dey grow.
Shi even tok say" I no dey go skul dat time bot I jus dey go Ballaragh eria wit som fama dem an I dey go Lacey inside boat wit fishaman dem an I dey play Eni hau as I like".
Muzik plenti for Meni of di tins wey dem tek train am wen shi dey smol.
Shi even dey enjoi mizik for Meni evnin  inside dia Haus.E papa an Mama dem Sabi to play Muzik; e papa play Volin an flute, an e mama Sabi play Piano an Sabi sing.Even di two of dem bi part of one  Choral'' Sosaiti.Wen shi still bi six yias old, Meni pipul for dia komuniti dey gada evri evnin an dem dey read an tok abaut dia Kolsho an muzik.
As shi dey see dis tins, shi dey get nolej abaut Inglish an Amerika.
title: Mona Douglas

text:
Janet Douglas, Ledi Glamis (Dey bon am araund 1498 an e kpai in July 17, 1537) na one big wuman for Scotland wey dey tok sey e get Witch. Dem yuz faya tek Kil Douglas dorin di time wen James V of Scotland de pawa bikos sey dey hakuss Douglas sey e na Witch

E kase as Pesin wey get Witch
James V of Scotland no like di Douglas famili at all. Janet broda, Archibaid Douglas, 6th Earl of Angus mari di king mama. An Angus put di young James from prisin. Wen James free from Douglas famili hand for December 1528, e fest kol Janet an hakuss am sey e wan no dey obey am as king. Dey sey na Janet an odas sopot mek Earl of Augus kom to Edinburgh in June. Bikos James like Janet smol an e get one nik nem wey e dey kol Janet "our lovittis Dame Jonat Douglas" for one orda in 1529, e gri mek Janet an Patrick Charteris of Cuthilgurdy waka komot from Scotland an mek e no kom kot for  jojmet.
Jamie Cameron wey dey tok Histrie tok sey e bi like sey Janet no komot from Scotland bikos rekod sho sey e nem dey always enta kot kase for dat time. One of di kase tok sey na Janet kil e hosband by poisin wen e hosband kpai on September 17, 1528. Dey leta no du du di kase again an dis one allow Janet to mari e sekod hosband Archibald Campbell of Skipness dorin di dry sisin in 1537. By July 17, 1537, Dey hakuss Janet sey e an e broda , di ''Earl of Angus an George Douglas de plan to poisin di King.

James hakuss Janet sey e dey yuz juju or Witch am even as e bi sey James to fit prove am.Dey put Janet an e hosband for one onda ground prisin ( e hosband eskape but dey leta kil am) for one big house in Edinburgh. E no hard for James to put Janet for prisin but e hard am to get prove sey e dey witch am bad. Wetin James du bi sey, e allow mek dey flog Janet famili memba an savant. Dey tok sey Janet na witch an dey bon am wit gaya on July 17, 1537 for di big house wey de Edinburgh. Dey mek suo sey Janet smol boi dey luk as faya de bon e mama.
title: Janet Douglas

text:
Jean Jenkins(17 March 1922-12 September 1990)na one Amerika pesin wey bi ethnomusicologist wey stey for UK an shi travul go Meni kontri dem go kolet sound wey dem rekod dem, pisho dem an instrument wey dem dey yuz tek play muzik dem.

Hau Shi Liv E Laif
Dem bon Jean Jenkins for Arkansas an shi  stodi abaut orijin of human, Sosaiti ,Kolsho an Musicology for Missouri araund 1940 dem.For 1949, shi go Britain wit e hosband,an kontiniu to dey stodi for Yunifasiti of London for di skul wey dem dey stodi abaut pipul wey kom from East an Pipul from Afrika.Jekons travul go Meni kontri dem for Afrika an Central
Asia bitwin 1950 an 1980 dem go kolet speshal tins wey dem rekod,an speshal infomshon dem.Shi get levul wel-wel among di pipul wey do speshal-speshal tin for muzik an for tradishonal muzik from difren-difren part of di wold.
Shi get p itlenti tins dem wey shi kip for inside e stor.Pesin wey see or rid di wok wey Jenkins DU go see sey no bi hodinari wiman.Jenkins run komot from McCarthy,bi frend wot Haile Selassie.
Jenkins na pesin wey dey wok hard an as e dey travul abaut, e dey pak e hankie an ondawear go Eni wia e wan go.
For 1954, Jenkins stat to wok for Horniman Museum.
Wen shi dey for di Museum, shi stat to dey kolet difren-difren instrument wey dem dey yuz for muzik from kontri wey stil dey divelop dem, an do impotant wok for Ethopia(for di whole of 1960) an shi even kriet one ples wey dem go dey stodi
abautb difren-difren pipul Muzik(ethnomusicology).
Araund dat time,shi Mari e sekond hosband an shi kolet  British Paspot so dat dem no go posh am komot from US bikos of di Trade Unino wok wey shi dey do.Dem kom skata do marej for 1961.
Jean Jenkins na wuman wey strong wel-wel
an shi put mind ontop wetin shi get to do for mind araund 1960 an 1980 dem.
Jean Jenkins travul wel-wel for Southern Europe, Asia an Afrika.
Apart from oda ples wey shi travul go,shi go Uganda(1966-1968), Malaysia(1972), Indonesia (1973), Afghanistan(1974),Algeria an Moroko an Turkey an Syria(1975).
As shi dey travul go difren ples dem, shi kolet plenti infomeshon dem for saund wey dem don rekod;Pisho an shi even dey rait som tins inside smol buk so dat shi know go foget.
Shi stil kolet plenti instrument dem wey dem dey yuz for muzik.
Afta shi oganaiz one program  tek show (exhibition) Muzik an di instrument wey dem dey yuz for muzik for "Wold of Islam" for Horniman Museum for 1976; dis show (exhibition) mek plenti pipul kom know abaut di tins dem.For 1978, shi kompt for di Museum kom kontiniu to dey do e wok by e sef for Edinburgh, France an Gamni.For di Royal Scottish Museum in Edinburgh.
Shi kpai for Lodon September 12,1990.
title: Jean Jenkins

text:
Patricia Shehan Campbell na Amerika pesin wey dey stodi how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik an how di muzik dey du pipul way dey lisin to am.

How e tek wok
Campbell bi di Donald. E Peterson Professor at di Yunivasiti of Washington. For di Yunivasiti, e dey tish muzik edukeshon an Ethnomusicology. Bogor Campbell bi professor, e na memba of di falkoti of Washington Yunivasiti in St. Louis an Butler Yunivasiti.
Part of Campbell trainin bi playful dans muzik, piano an vois paformans, Campbell trainin stil bi stodi of Bulgarian group song, Indian (Karnatic) vokal koleshon an di Thai mahori. Dey add Indian vokal koleshon an di Thai mohori wen e stil de du e Ph.D  stodis in Muzik Edukeshon ( Di stodis konet wit ethnomisicolohy) for Kent State Yunivasiti. Di fest ples wey e fest stodis na Cleveland Muzik Skul Setumet an na dia e Len how to play Piano. Na Jonas Svedas an di pesin wey dey kompose am Bain Murray dey tish am den.
Campbell don fest tish group vois muzik in Cleveland aria skul bifor e kom chuz to bi a muzil tisha.
Campbell don hep arenj wetin pipul wey dey go skul go dey du in St. Loius, Indianapolis, an Settle aria. E don yuz di free edukeshon wey ''"National Endowment for the Humanities, the National Endowment for the Arts, the International Research Exchange (IREX), Fulbright-Hays, the Lily Endowment, and the International Foundation for Music Research tek get beta trainin an no more tins abaut Muzik Edukeshon.
Campbell hasist meni profeshonal hoganiaashon ( for ezampul, di Sosaheti for Ethnomusicology, di Intanashonal Sosaheti for Muzik, an di Kolej Muzik Sosaheti). Campbell don bi presidor of the  Kolej Muzik Sosaheti, e don wok as Vais Presidor of di  Sosaheti for Ethnomusicology, an di Oga patapata for di Board of Smithsonian Folkways. E don wok as editorial boards of di Sakoloji of Muzik, British Jonal of Muzik Edukeshon, Risach Stodies in Muzik Edukeshon, Jonal of Risach in Muzik Edukeshon, Kolej Muzik siposiom, an odas jonal. Campbell stil join hand as editor of di Global Muzik Series of  Oxford Yunivasiti Press
title: Patricia Shehan Campbell

text:
Moll Anthony wey pipul sabi wel wel as Mary Lesson ( dey bon am araund 1807 an e kpai in 1878)  na Irish gud wuman wey live at Hill of di Grande, but e bi like sey na Red Hill, County Kildare e kom from. Dey nem Moll afta e papa Anthony Dunne. Dey  beri Moll in Milltown, County Kildare in 1878.
Moll fit yuz leaf or plant tek kia of pipul an hanima wey dey sik. Na three pat Moll dey divadi di medisin wwy e dwy yuz tek kia of  pipul. Wen di sik pesin fest kom, e go fest give am two poshon of di medisine bottu an di rimeni medisine e go give di sik pesin wey e kom bak. Di moni wey di pesin go pay na 60 cent. Hakordin to one websait:
" Law de how pesin go tek yuz, tek, kari di medisine. If pesin no folo di law, di medisine no go wok. Pesin no go try yuz di medisine again if e no wok di fest time wey di pesin yuz am. Di medisine get pawa so tey evil spirit no go wan mek pesin Kari di medisine go house an di evil spirit go dey distop di pesin mek e no yuz am. Even wen di pesin don yuz di third an final medisine wey dey di bottu, some pawaful pawa go wan du mek e no wok. If di pesin yuz di medisine di way dey sey mek e yuz am, di medisine dey wok wel.

E tori
Moll Anthony get supanashoral pawa to trit sikness both for hanima an pipul. Some pipul tok sey e get di pawa from spirit. E fit no gri to hep a pesin wey sik sometimes, if Moll tink sey e go beta mek di pesin just kpai or if na di pesin sekod time to kom mit am for di sem risin. Bifor pesin go tell Moll wetin dey du am, Moll go don too di pesin nem an wetin bring am kom .
title: Moll Anthony

text:
Ursula Kemp or Ursley Kempe wey pipul sabi as Greg (dey bon araund 1525 an e kpai in 1582) na  Inglish wey dey yuz tradishonal plant an leave tekia of pipul an wuman wey wan bon. Pipul hakuss am sey na  Witch an dey yuz hang am wit rope onti e kpai in 1582. Pipul tok sey Kemp dey yuz juju bring sikness an e dey yuz juju kill e neibor.

How e tek stat life
Na for St. Osyth in Essex dey bon Kemp. E na native doktor wey pipul dey kol mek e kom trit pipul way sik. Pipul leta hakuss am sey na e dey mek pipul sik an sey eddy yuz juju kil pipul. Dey hakuss am of witch an dey joj e kase in Chelmsford for February 1582. For e kase, meni of Kemp neibor tok sey Kemp an witch an dey sopot wetin Justice Brian Darcy too tok.

Wetin happun for e kase
Kemp neibor an forma frend Grace Thurlow tok for kot sey wen e pikin Davy sik, e kari go mit Kemp mek e hep am. E pikin wel afta Kemp hep am. Sometimes leta, Grace tok sey e kom get smol kanta wit Kemp ova di tritmet of e gel pikin Joan. Afta some month, Grace tok sey Joan fall from bed an yuz neck break an kpai. Grace stil tok sey wen e no fit waka wel wel, e go mit Kemp to trit am an Kemp hagri to trit am if e bring 12 pence. Wen Kemp stat to trit Grace, Grace get beta but Grace no gri to pay Kemp di 12 pence again. Grace tok sey e no get 12 pence to pay. Kemp vex an tok sey e go ponish Grace for wetin Grace du am. Grace tok sey Afta dat fight wit Kemp, Grace tok sey e no fit waka again. Grace stil tok sey sins den, e or e gel pikin dey always sik. Grace tok sey na Kemp dey witch am dat is di risin for e sikness, e pikin sikness an di kpai wey e pikin kpai.
title: Ursula Kemp

text:
Anna Johansdotter or Anna Jonsdotter (dey bon am July 15, 1797 an e kpai in 1860) na Sweden tradishonal nativ doktor an wuman wey get pawa to tok wit spirit. Meni old old tori tok abaut Dis wuman. E dey popular wit e nik-nem Kloka Anna ("Wise Anna").

How e tek stat life
Na for Liatorp wey dey Småland dey bon Anna on July 15, 1822. Anna dey wok for farm onti 1822 wen e kom stat to dey tekia of e sef as Native tradishonal doktor. Anna fest stey in Göteryd from 1822 go rish 1840s an afta dat e pak go Pjätteryd. Na for Pjätteryd e tek de popular wel wel. Akordin to old tori, Anna stat to get sens to du native doktor afta e don chop some  cowberry wen white snake don torch wen Anna dey bush wen e stil bi smol pikin. Pipul sabi Anna as pesin wey fit yuz e mind to no wetin dey di sik pesin an e fit mek dem wel. Dis e habiliti mek pipul for di kontri to kom mit am wit dia sik pipul. Anna no get fix prize for di moni e dey kolet for tritmet but e go luk how di poket of di pesin bi bifor e go tok how much moni e wan kolet. Dis one mek am dey du free free tritmet meni times bikos some pipul no get moni at all. Pipul tok sey Anna na native doktor wey get blak eyes an wey get vois wey deep an sey e get meni blak cat. Anna dey yuz meni plant root to tekia of sik pipul. Anna pikin Kristina wey bi gel dey join hand wen Anna wan go find medisine an wen e dey trit sik pipul.
As e sabi rid pesin mind, pipul dey kom mit Anna wen somtin lost so dat e go fit tel dem how to no how di tin tek waka.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Kloka Anna

text:
Leda Valladares ( dey bon am on December 21, 1919 an e kpai July 13, 2012) na Argentina singa, song-raita, pesin wey rid muzik an pesin way dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Dey bon Leda Valladares in San Miguel de Tucumán in Norta Argentina. Valladares gro up lisinin to old European muzik an tradishonal song of  Amerindian pipul wey dey live for di aria. Wen Valladares dey smol, e len how to play Piano. Valladares wit e broda form one muzikal grup wey dey pratis tradishonal song, jazz an kul muzik or blues. Valladares dey poblish puem til e kpai. E fest stat e yunivasiti stodis in  Nashonal Yunivasiti of Tucumán wen e rid Inglish, Valladares Afta one year chenj klass to filosofi an edukeshon. In 1948, e finish yunivasiti.
As Valladares dey rid filosofi an edukeshon for skul, e stil chuk eye for muzik stodis in Akedemi of Fine Art an in Indipendet risach among pipul wey dey sing tradishonal muzik.
Afta wey Valladares finish skul, e fest tish for somtime bifor e pak go Paris in di heli 1950s. For Paris, e form one muzik grup wit Maria Elena Walsh. Both of dem dey sing tradishonal Argentina song for wey pipul dey drink an for tihata. Di grup go bak to Argentina Afta Juan Peron komot as presidor bikos of  Libiretin Revolushon wey happun in 1956. For dat time, pipul kom like Argentina tradishonal muzik smol an Valladares grup dwy mek albom an sing dat time. Pipul wey kom dey lisin an enjoi dia muzik no plenty like dat. Valladares an e sekod wey form di grup Maria Elena Walsh kom skata an go dia way in 1962. Valladares kom stat to dey kolet an rekod di tradishonal old song of Argentina. E mek some albom from di koleshon an rikodin wey e du from 1960 go rish 1974. Di nem of di albom na: ''Mapa musical de la Argentina (Musical Map of Argentina). Di albom rikod an kip meni old tradishonal song wey dey di kontri from Doreen difren lokeshon.
title: Leda Valladares

text:
Kati Zsigóné (Józsefné Zsigó, bon Julianna) ( dey bon am June 16, 1953 in Kecskemét) na Hungarian wuman wey bi aktist, an painta. In 2009, e nem de among di five best painta in di wold an di nomba one for Europe kontinet.

How e tek stat life
Juliana papa na farma an e dey yuz hand mek basket. E papa give an one nik-nem  "Kati". Wen Kati bi three years old, e peret marej skata bikos e papa dey bit e mama an sey e papa too dey shank ogogoro. Kati kom stey wit e mama even sey e mama na poor wuman. Na onli Kati e mama bon. Bikos di smol moni wey Kati mama dey kolet as klina as e dey klin for di lokal katolik skul no go rish dem, Kati stat to dey wok wen erish 14 years.
Kati mari József Zsigó on May 7, 1977. Di marej produs one gel pikin Katalin wey dey bon on July 9, 1978. Kati see e grapikin Panna wey bi gel on January 3, 2013.

How e tek wok
Pipul sabi Kati sey e no how to paint bikos of di sopot wey e hosband give am. Kati tok sey e hosband na e nomba one soporta an fans. Na wen Kati bon e gel pikin an bikos e wan mek paint di room wey e pikin wan dey, dis one mek am stat to paint. For dat time, e hosband advais am sey mek e no go hiya eni painta but mek e paint di room by e sef. Kati kom stat to dey len how to draw an kolor wel wel. Kati pratis eight difren mentod of paintin an kolorin but na wall paintin e sabi pass. Afta Kati don len wall paintin, e stat to du tile paintin, orye paintin paintin ( di one na to draw horse or Hungarian lokal hanimal, how some aria bi an emeji), seiling. E stil len how to put disain for kup an plate, tebu klot an best. Kati stil len anoda paintin mentod wey di nem na "riseliözés".
title: Kati Zsigóné

text:
Wuzzie George (1888-Decembee20,1984)na one Paiute wuman wey dey do Kraft  wok from North,an shi wok wel-wel to mek dia tradishonal laif an netiv kostom dem get levul wel-wel.
Shi stil join-bodi tek wok wit Margaret Wheat wok ontop di wok wey shi rekod for Northern Paiute Lifeways

Wen E Dey for Smol Pikin
Wuzzie Dick George for circa 1880-1883 an dem dey kol am Wizi,"Smol Anima"
an di nem kom ton to Wuzzie for Inglish.
Shi bi di girl-pikin of Sam an Suzie Dick, of di "Cattail-Eater" wey bi old netiv grup, shi bi memba of di Northern Paiute train for West of Nevada.Bifor-Bifor,Paiute pipul dey do Waka abaut an dem no dey stay for one ples for long time, an dem bon for dem bon am for di time wey pipul juz dey gada smol-smol tins for Stillwater Mountain Range, bot shi spend Meni of e Laif hifor wia dem dey lol Fallon an Stillwater, Nevada.
Wen shi stil bi smol girl,e grand papa an mama,Stovepipe an Mattie tish am Meni of di netiv kostom an tradishonal stori dem wey shi kom wok wel-wel to mek am get beta levul.
Afta e papa an mama sepret wen shi stil bi 10 yia old pikin,wuzzie stat to dey wok wit di White  Ernst famili an kom stat to dey learn Inglish.
Shi even go di Indian Skul Nia Carson Siti  bot wen Measles diziz kom stat to Kash pipul,e papa kom komot am from skul.
Wen shi stil dey young,shi Mari Jimmy George,dem bon Eight(8) pikin bot na onli five(5) of dem grow.
Di two of dem dey togeda ontil di hosband kpai for 1969.

Hau Dem Keep Lifeways
George stat to dey tish di tradishonal Lifeways an e yuz an to dey mek di Kolsho get levul.
Shi even dey yuz smol-smol drama to tek tish e pipul dem abaut dia tradishon for difren-difren Skul dem.
Na shi dey intaprit for for for e hosband wen e dey do tradishonal Shamanic  medisin for a for abaut 40 yias ontil midul of 1950 dem.
For ova 30 yias, sho dey dey wok to rekod netiv tins wey dem dey do, so dat di tins dem go kontiniu to dey dey.
Shi join-bodi wok wit Margaret Wheat,wey dey stodi di orijin of human Sosaiti an Kolsho.Di wey shi do show wel-wel for one buk wey dem kol "Survival Arts of the Primitive Paiutes" an wit Catherine S.Fowleran Sven Liljblad'' an di two of dem bi pipulwey dey stodi human orijin, Sosaiti an Kolsho.
George travul wit Wheat go do one prisenteshon an smol drama(demonstration)
title: Wuzzie George

text:
Edna Garrido Ramírez (dey bon am June 19, 1913 an e kpai April 11, 2010) na Dominican wuman wey bi tisha, risasha an pesin wey dey stock an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Pipul sabi am as one of di pipul wey stat to dey rekod Dominican lokal dans, tok, song, pikin games an odas lokal tins an how difren siren kolsho dey mek muzik an how e dey du pipul wey dey lisin to am.

How e tek stat life
Na for  Azua, Dominika Ripoblik dey bon Edna Garrido Ramirez in 1913. Garrido famili-dem na raita. E gro up in San Juan de la Maguana. Garrido papa nem na Victor Garrido Puello an e mama nem na Tijides Ramírez Lasala. Garrido papa na raita, jornalist, an pesin wey dey rait histri an e mama na di pikin of jeneral Wenceslao Ramirez.
Garrido du e pamari skul in San Juan de la Maguana. Afta wen e don rish ten year old, e join e famili as dey pak go di kapita of Dominika Riploblik Santo Domingo. E go Institute de Señoritas Salomé Ureña go rid edukeshon an e finish di skul in 1934. Garrido wok as Trisha from 1934 go rish 1946.
Garrido bi klose padi of Hilma Contreras. Na Hilma Contreras win di 2002 Nashonal Litirasho Prize awod. Bikos of di advais wey e frend tel am, e join di klass wey  Amerika professor Ralph Boggs dey tek in  Autonomous Yunivasiti of Santo Domingo in 1944.
Dat klass wey e join mek e luv for how to dey rekod how pipul dey du tins for lokal way gro. E waka all di kontri as e dey du risach. Garrido du risach on South nails de Palo an La Cofradia del Espiritu Santo. E travul go Cibao rijion wia e kolet di rekod of popular lokal singa Ñico Lora.
title: Edna Garrido Ramírez

text:
Sidney Robertson Cowell ( e nem wen dey bon na Sidney William Hawkins. Dey bon am June 2, 1903 an e kpai February 23, 1995) na Amerika wuman wey dey stodi how difren difren kolsho dey mek dia muzik an e dey kolet an kip tradishonal song. Sidney bi di wife of di muzik komposa Henry Cowell.

How e tek stat life an wok
Dey bon Sidney Robertson Cowell in San Francisco in  California on June 2, 1903. Sidney papa na Charles Albert Hawkins an e mama na Mabel Hawkins ( e nem bifor e mari na Morrison). Sidney go rid Romans Langwej an Filosofi in Stanford Yunivasiti. E kolet e B.A satifiket in 1924.
Na in 1924 Sidney mari Kenneth Robertson, way bi a medikal studet. Afta di marej, dey go Europe.
In 1925, Sidney enta "École Normale de Musique" wey dey Paris to rid piano wit Alfred Cortot.
Wen e kom bak to California, Sidney tish for di "Peninsula School for Creative Education" in  Menlo Pak, Kalifornia from 1926 go rish 1932.
Dorin dat time wey e dey tish, Sidney stodi how to sabi muzik tins wit Ernest Bloch an e an e hosband still go len how oda kolsho wey no bi Europe dey mek dia muzik at di San Francisco Conservatory Music.
Afta wey e marej wit Kenneth Robertson skata in 1934, Sidney pak go New York City an e hep daret di Sosha Muzik Program at di 'Henry Street Settlement" on di lowa East side. E wok wit one eldali Jewish wuman. Sidney wok as Assistant for Charles Seeger in 1936. Charles Seeger na di teknikal advaisa of di yunit of di Spesha Skills Divishon of di Risetumet Administrashon in Washington ( dey leta chenj di nem to Farm Sekihoriti Administrashon). Na wen e stat to wok as assistant e dey kolet an rekod tradishonal muzik in Appalachia, di Ozarks an di hopa Midwest.
Sidney leta go bak to Kalifornia wey e stat an arenj mek di  Librari of Kongress, di  Yunivasiti of Kalifornia, Berkeley an di  Wok Progress Administrashon of di Norta Kalifornia Folk Muzik  Projet sponsor e projet wey wan du. Sidney kom bi di daretor of di projet from 1938 go rish 1940. Na 20 wokas dey wok onda am dat time.
title: Sidney Robertson Cowell

text:
Brigitta Lars Anderson's ( e kpai Afta 1551) or Birgitta Lass Anderson ("Brigitta, Wife of Lars Anderson") also kol Brigitta Andersdotter ("Brigitta gel-pikom of Anders) na Sweden wuman wey bi tradishonal native doktor an pesin way dey hep for palas.
Na Brigitta bi di wuman doktor wey tekia of di pikin of King Gustav I of Sweden an e stil dey tekia of di Kween Margaret Leijonhufvud. Di Kween like Brigitta as e doktor na e bi nomba one doktor wey dey trit am.

How e tek stat life
Di wok of Brigitta na to tekia of di king pikin-dem. Di pikin get dia own place wey dem dey stey an di place long rish atlit 1540. Di nem of di aria wey pikin-dem dey stey na Barnastugan (Pikin house). We no too no meni tins abaut di pipul wey wok at di palas dorin dat period wey Brigitta wok dia. Di onli tin wey we no bi sey Dis four wuman chuk eye for di king pikin-dem: Margareta, wey bi di kween korsin an nemsek. Di sekod wuman na Ingrid Amundsdotter wey bi widow an get mouth for di Palas. Di nomba three pesin na Ebba Eriksdotter Vasa an di last pesin bi Christina Gyllenstierna. Ebba Eriksdotter Vasa an Christiana Gyllenstierna dey luk afta di pikin-dem jost for smol time. Di Kween biliv in Brigitta wel wel dat e dey halao mek Brigitta tekia of e pikin wen e wan travu.
Brigitta na jost hodinari pesin. Kween Margaret jost like am an e na pesin wey di kween mek as e pasonal pesin wey di kween dey diskuss tins wit. No bi onli sey di kween halao mek Brigitta dey tekia of e pikin-dem, e stil mek Brigitta dey kontro e biziness. For ezampul, wen di kween borow one pesin kol Anders Persson moni in 1545, na Brigitta e yuz as e finansha agent to kolet di moni bak.
title: Brigitta Lars Anderssons

text:
Alice M.MoyleAM FAHA(25 December  1908-9April 2005)na one Osrelia pesin wey stodi abaut difren-difren pipul muzik(ethnomusicologist).

Hau Shi Liv E Laif an go Skul wen Shi dey Smol-pikin
Dem bon Alice Marshall Brown for Bloemfontein,for South Afrika on 24 December 1908.Wen shi stil bi four(4) yias old shi follow e papa an mama kom wey bi Margaretta an Ellison Brown dem kom Ostrelia.
Shi go Fintona Girl's Grammar Skul.
Eni time wey Moyle dey wok shi go dey listing to song wey Afrika wuman dem dey sing.As shi dey listin to dis song dem,shi stat to dey get intrest for Muzik.
Shi graduat from Yunifasiti of Melbourne as Bashelor of muzik  for 1954 an shi kom stil get Masta of Arts  for di Yunifasiti of Sydney.Wen shi kom bak to Melbourne,shi kom komplit PhD for 1975 for Monash Yunifasit, an na dis one bi di first PhD wey dem let am do for di Yunifasiti.

Hau Shi do E Wok
Wen Moyle stat wok,shi dey do Tisha wok an e dey gada tori dem for nius.
Shi kom Mari Murray Moyle wey bi enginia for eletronik an saund for 1933.
As shi dey stodi for e B.A.,shi go one program wey A.P.Elkin wey stodi orijin,Sosaiti dem an Kolsho(anthropology), do an dis program
 kom mek am stat to dey get intrest for
di eshient pipul Muzik an shi stodi di wok e don rekod wen shi dey do e M.A.
Afta som time E hosband enkorej am an shi kom travul meni time go rekod eshient pipul Muzik dem an song dem.
Shi bi part of di first pipul dem wey stat Ausralian Institute of Aboriginal Studies (wey dem don chenj to Australian Institute of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Studies or AIATSIS) an shi kom wok for dia ontil shi ritaya wen shi bi 70 yias old.Dem honor am wit fellow an shi kontiniu to dey do e risash wok and travul sotey shi tish 88 yias old.
Moyle bi one of di pipul wey first stat Musicology Society of Australia an na shi bi di Nashonal President for 1982-88.Shi even dey among di International Council for Traditional Music for Australia.
Bikos e know sey di matiria dem wey dem dey tek tish for di skul dem no plenti,Moyle wok wel-wel tek mek muzik an Dans Tradishonal an eshient pipul Muzik dem Kolsho,for 1992,an dis tin wey shi do get one video,two Vois for keset,one buk for student dem an som ton wey go helep Tisha hondasand  hai to yuz di tin.
title: Alice M.Moyle

text:
Maud Cuney(e papa nem na Cuney, February 16,1874-February 13 or 14 1936)
na one Amerika pesin wey dey play Piano an wey stodi Muzik,raita an shi dey fait for di right of Afrika-Amerika pipul wey dey for Boston, Massachusetts for United States.Sem bon am for Galveston.Shi bi di girl-pikin of Norris Wright Cuney wey bi Lida of pipul wey dey fait for pipul right an na e bi Oga of Texas Republican Party for di Reconstruction Era.Na Adelina(e papa nem bi Dowdie) wey bi skul Tisha bi e waif.
For 1913,Cuney -Hare poblish di Tori of hau E papa Liv E Laif.
Afta dem get freedom,Cuney Hare stodi for di niu Ingland Conservatory mizik for Boston an kom ton to pesin wey dey play Piano wey hey levul wel-wel.
Na for Jamaika Plain wey dey Nia Boston.Shi Liv most of e Laif.
Bikos sey shi stodi Muzik ,shi kolet plenti Muzik of South an Carribean as shi dey stodi folklore,an na shi bi di first pesin to stodi Creolemuzik.
Meni  pipul dey remeba e last weekend wey shi kol Negro Muzishan dem an Dia Muzik(Negro Musicians and Their Music)(1936)wey shi yuz tek rait abaut Afrika an Amerika pipul muzik dem.

Hau Shi Liv E Laif an go Skul wen shi dey Smol-pikin
Dem bon Maud for Galveston,Texas for February 16,1874, to Adelina(Dowdy,or Dowdie if we spel am for anoda way)
an Norris Wright Cuney e hosband.
E papa an Mama dem kom from white pipul an black pipul famili dem-E papa na one white pesin wey get levul wel-wel for famili an e mama na wuman wey fine like man from Woodville,Mississippi.
Dia orijin na from Afrika,India,Europe an Swiss-Amerika pipul dem.
Dia famili wey get moni  wel-wel an get levul for politik wey Gen.Phillip Minor Cuney of Austin County,Texas wey send bon from e Louisiana.
Norris Cuney na one of di eight(8)pikin wey Cuney an Adelina Staut e Hauskipa bon.
Phillip Cuney mek e pikin dem on Staut free  bifor di Civil war.
Araund 1850,Cuney bi one of di pipul wey get big farm dem an pesin wey get slave for Texas.E farm na 2000 acred an e get pas 100 slave dem.
E waif dem wey bi Oyinbo bon Eight(8) pikin,Eliza(Ware) Cuney wey bi e sekond waif bon tree(3) pikin bot shi quik Kpai, e third(3) wife Adeline(Spurlock) Cuney bon five(5) pikin dem.
Phillip Cuney Kari e boy-pikin,Joseph an Norris dem go Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, mek dem dey dia dey go skul bifor dem stat di war.
Afta som time Norris go wok inside difren-difren boat dem for Mississippi River bot afta dem end di war,e kom ton Lida for Texas Republican Party.
title: Maud Cuney

text:
Amanda Villepastour (dem bon am for 20January 1958) na one Ostrelia pesin wey stodi difren-difren Kolsho muzik an shi bi bifor-bifor Profeshona muzishan.
Pipul know am wel-wel say na shi dey play keyboard for one grup of muzishan for Ostrelia wey dem dey kolEurogliders araund 1980-1987 Meni pipul sef know am bikos shi try wel-wel for di risash wok wey shi do an di buk wey shi poblish ontop Yoruba Muzik for Naija an Afro-Cuban rilijon Muzik dem for Kuba(Cuba)

Hau Shi Liv E Laif an go Skul wen Shi stil bi Smol-pikin
Dem bon for Perth for western side of Ostrelia.Shi go Methodist Ladies Kolej wey dey Nia di siti of Claremont.
For di bigin of 1970 dem, wen shi stil bi 14 yia old,Shi stat to dey play muzik
wel-wel as a Profeshona.
Bitwin 1974 am 1976, na shi dey play  piano,accorfion,an stil dey sopot di pesin wey dey sing for one grup wey dey sing wey dem kol Duck Soup.
For one intaviu wey Afropop Worlwide Tori pesin do wit an wey dem poblish for 2016,shi tok say Duck Soup bi like Chicago Blues  Muzik grup for Perth.
Villepastour bi student wey stil dey for skul from 1977-1980 for di Dipatment of Muzik for Yunifasiti of Western Ostrelia.
Shi join-bodi wok wit Roger Smalley wey bi Anhlo-Australian pesin wey dey rait song ,dey play piano an wey dey kondort Muzik wen pipul dey sing.Shi even stil play Javanese Gamelanmuzik wit Bernard Ijzeediaat(Suryabrata),wey Jaap Kunst train an e sef kom train one Amerika pesin wey dem kol Mantle Hood wey stodi difren-difren pipul muzik
(ethnomusicologist) an Pipul bilif sey na e bi pesin wey stat gamelanfor United States.
Villepastour graduet as pesin wey dey konpos song wit Bashelor of Muzik.

Hau Shi go Skul
Eurogliders
For 1980 Villepastour an one muzishan from Perth wey e nem bi Bernie Lynch kom join-hand tek form one Muzik grup, an dem kol am Livong Single
Dem agri sey na Villepastour go dey play keyboard an Lynch go dey rait song an dey play giita an ho stil dey song.
Di two of dem kom find oda pipul wey go join dia grup.Dem yuz Crispin Akerman as anoda pesin wey go dey play giita,Don Meharry go dey play Bass an Guy Slingerland to dey play drum dem.

Tori abaut pipul life
title: Amanda Villepastour

text:
Margaret Bane ( wey dey bon 1542 an e kpai March 25, 1597) na Scotland wuman wey dey tekia of wuman wey get belle an wan bon. E dey pat of di pipul wey dey kill for di  Great Scottish Witch Hunt of 1597.
Na for Kincardine O' Neil, Aberdeen, Scotland Margaret Bane dey stey wit e hosband. Bane an e hosband bon two pikin, Duncan Gardyn an a gel kol Helen Rogie. Dia two pikin dey stey with dem. Na to dey tekia of wuman wey get belle bi Bane wok an pipul respet am wel wel. Meni pipul dey kom mit am for tritmet from pipul wel no too get moni to big wuman dem. Pipul hakuss am sey na juju wuman or witch for in 1567 but na 1597 dem kom joj am for Kot. Dey Kil Bane for di sem year.

Wetin hapun for e kot kess
Na for 1567 dey fest hakuss Bane of witch bikos e dey du tins wit e frend Jonet Spaldarge wey bi e sista. Notin du am onti di "Great Scottish Witch Hunt of 1597". Na hakuss am sey e na witch in 1596 but dey leave am. Eight wuman tok sey e dey among dem as dem dey yuz juju on odas. Bikos di wuman-dem dey live an wok togeda, so e dey hisi for dem to no one anoda inside kot. Dey hakuss Bane of meni tins. One of di tins bi sey e dey du tins wit a witch wey bi e sista Jonet Spaldarge an how kom e too sabi tins abaut wuman belle.
Pipul stil hakuss am sey na e kill e forma hosband. Dey tok sey e du am by di transfa of di labor pain wey one wuman give am.Anoda tin wey dey tek hakuss am bi sey e no grit one man way grit am bak one day an di man kpai dat sem day. Dey sey Bane na witch bikos e go luk go majik way happun for sea side an sey how e tek no sey one pikin go bi boy or gel.

Bifor Bane kpai, e tok meni wuman sey dem sef na witch an some of dem na: Christiana Arcly, Jonat Davidsone, Jonat Lucas, Margrat Og, Issobell Oige, Isobelle Richie, Beatrix Robbie an Bane own pikin sef Helene Rogie.
title: Margaret Bane

text:
Temitope Balogun Joshua (dem bon am for June 12, 1963 and im die for June 5, 2021), wey pipo sabi as Prophet T. B. Joshua, na Naija ogbonge pastor, tok tok persin for televishon, prophet and moni dasher. Bifor im death, na im bi di oga kpatakpata of di Synagogue, Church of All Nations, (SCOAN). Na im stat di Emmanuel TV televishon steshon fom Lagos Stet. Dem bon am for Arigidi Akoko wey dey for Naija.

Prophet T. B. Joshua die for June 5, 2021 afta e hold service for him church dat day, tori bi say he die jejeli for praying posishon wit no sign of sickness or health poblem, Christian pipo si am as a call to etana glori, e die a week bifor im 58th birthday.

Acodin to Isaiah Ogedegbe, Prophet TB Joshua death na "big blow to Christianity". Or im passing na "major blow to Christianity".

On 27 August 2022, Isaiah Ogedegbe for im tribute to Prophet TB Joshua rait: "Clearli, T. B. Joshua na di man wey God don show im hand. Joshua hand don become God hand wey don bring divine healing to di sick. Na im be 'di man wey si tomoro' becos e don truli hear fom God and si wetin di future hold, and e mek us know di mind of God".

Isaiah Ogedegbe also queshon pipo for im tok: "Na true say T. B. Joshua na prophet? Yes, and e even high pass prophet. Im predishons nor dey jos carri hapun becos God dey yuz am wen e come to mata of profesi as evritin wey e tok don hapen exactli wen, wie and how e say e go hapun".

Predishons
Di oga kpatakpata of di church, T. B. Joshua tok say e give profesi abaut di Synagogue Church building collapse "three weeks bifor e hapun".

While anoda Naija relijos figor, Isaiah Ogedegbe also tok say e si di tin eight months bifor e hapun.

Socessor
Afta im kpai for June 2021, im wife Evelyn Joshua kom take ova as di niu lida of di SCOAN.

text:
Ruth Rubin ( dey bon am September 1, 1906 an e kpai on June 11, 2000) na Canadian-Amerika wuman wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. E stil bi singa, poet, an pesin wey sabi Yiddish kolsho an muzik.

How e tek stat life
Ruth Rubin ril nem wen dey bon am na Rivke Rosenblatt. Na for Montreal dey bon am in 1906. Rubin sabi spik three langwej: Yiddish, Inglish an French. Rubin papa an mama komot from Bessarabia in Canada. Dat ples bifor na pat of ples wey Russian govamet dey kontro. Rubin at list get one junior sista lol Esther. E go di poblik skul wey dedi siti an also di Peretz Shule. Peretz Shule na skull wey Yiddish pipul dey go an na for dia Rubin fest tek lisin to Sholom Aleichem spikin in 1915. E luv wetin Sholom Aleichem too wel wel at dat time. Wen e go New York in 1924, e stodi muzik an stil go evenin klass at Hunter College bikos e dey wok as Seketri an short-hand tisha.

How e tek wok
Araund 1935, Rubin like to stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for loyal way in Yiddish an dis one mek go find Chaim Zhitlowsky. Chaim Zhitlowsky na sabi Yiddish wel wel as na raita for "Guidance". Rubin stat to dey du e risach for  YIVO Institute for Jewish Risach, di  New York Poblik Librari, an di ples wey Jewish Theological Seminary dey kip old buks. Apart sey e dey tish muzik an poem for Yiddish skul, Rubin still dey poblish buks. Wen Wold war II stat, Na Rubin dey intaprit leta an tori wey dey kom from ghetto an prisin kamp from Yiddish langwej to Inglish langwej.

Araund 1947, Rubin stat to dey go mit pipul wey de Jewish komuniti wey kom to New York siti, Montreal, an Toronto wey run komot from dia ples bikos dey no wan kpai bikos of di kili-kili of Jew pipul.
Rubin wok rili dey impotat bikos e stat to dey rekod an kip Yiddish song an Yiddish tori wen pipul no dey too notis am dat time.
title: Ruth Rubin

title: Synagogue, Church of All Nations

text:
On 12 September 2014, one ogbonge building wey dey for Synagogue, Church of All Nations area fall rish ground. Som pipo ves wit di National Emergency Management Agency (NEMA) and odas becos dem tink say dos emagesi agensi nor give enof infomeshon abaut di tragedi.

Sad tori
On 12 September 2014, one ogbonge building fall for di SCOAN's area wey dey for Lagos, killing if e small well-well 115 pipo, 84 of dem na South Africans.

Predishons
Di oga kpatakpata of di church, T. B. Joshua tok say e give profesi abaut di Synagogue Church building collapse "three weeks bifor e hapun".

While anoda Naija relijos figor, Isaiah Ogedegbe also tok say e si di tin eight months bifor e hapun.

Isaiah Ogedegbe na also Naija blogga.

Pipo wey kpai
Naija emagesi agensi nor gre reliz di kontris of pipo wey kpai. But oda kontris don give som infomeshon about dos wey kpai. Plenti of di pipo wey kpai na fom Saut Afrika.

Reashons
Di gofnor of Lagos State for dat time; Babatunde Fashola, orda all church wokas comot fom di sait becos dem gatz to propali rescue di bodis wey di building fall pres. Di gofmet also tok say di church nor get gofmet aprova bifor konstrushon.

Jonalis Nicholas Ibekwe reliz one audio recodin wey capshor momet wen T. B. Joshua give bribes to som jonalis mek dem for ripot di tragedi wit style so dat im church nem nor go spoil.

Cause
Di oga kpatakpata of di church, T. B. Joshua don tok wetin cause di tragedi. Acordin to im, na one strange aircraft wey fly ova di building for small time bifor e fall. Dem reliz vidoh for YouTube wey capshor momet wen di plane fly ova di building bifor e fall.

But di korona ripot tok say di tragedi hapun becos dem nor konstrut di building well.
Three gofmet agensi - di Nigeria Building And Road Research Institute (NBRRI), di Council for di Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) and di Building Collapse Prevention Guild (BCPG) lok at di sait and si som eros.

Trial
Joshua nor gre show im face for one November 2015 hearing and SCOAN's lawyas rait meni aplikashons to stop di trial.

Di Lagos State gofmet
don tok say di case must get trial.

Loka tok tok persin for redio, Daddy Freeze kompe di tragedi to anoda one wey hapun for Lekki, wen sekuriti agensi ares and jay di oga of Lekki Gardens, Richard Nyong becos e ilegali opun im building onda konstrushon and wey leta fall rish ground.
Freeze ves wit di sekuriti agensi becos dem ares Nyong sharpali, but dem nor ares Joshua.

text:
Kate Anne Rusby (dem bon am 4 December 1973) shi dey sing lokal song an dey rait song fom Penistone, West Riding of Yorkshire, England. Dem dey kol am "Barnsley Nightingale", shi don dey difren British lokal festival, an dem sabi am as one of di singa wey dem sabi pas for English lokal singas. In 2001 The Guardian tok abaut am sey na shi bi di British star wey pipul go ear im sweet voice. In 2007 for BBC website  dem kol am first niu lady for lokal music. Shi dey insaid di singa wey dia nem dey insaid pipul wey fit win Mercury Prize.

Hau e tek wok
Dem bon Rusby insaid famili wey hol of dem sabi sing, in 1973 for Penistone, West Riding Yorkshire, England. Afta shi don len hau to sabi pley guitar, fiddle an piano, an stil sabi to dey sing, shi don pley for meni festival wen shi dey smol an wen shi dey gro, bifor shi Kon go join ( an na shi Kon leta bi di lead Vocalist of) di Female Celtic folk band the poozies. Na for 1995 shi rilis album wey mek plenti pipul sabi am, Kate Rusby & Kathryn Roberts album wey shi du wit im frend wey dey sing abaut lokal tins song Kathryn Roberts . In 1997 Roberts rekod im fest solo album, Hourglass. Na im famili hep am wit di fest solo rekod. Afta wey plenti pipul don sabi  am for d wod im famili no stop to dey hep am insaid all im wok. 

Rusby dey insaid one grup , Equation,  wey leta chenj to Cara Dillion wey dia wok na to sing abaut lokal tins. Wen di grup stat dem get difren singa insaid lik Kathryn Roberts an pesin wey im nem dey for insaid singa wey fit win Mercury Awod Seth Lakeman, an im broda, Sean Lakeman. Im fest EP, wey dem du mek dem get kontrat wit WEA.

Song wey Rubsy no rilis "Wandering Soul" na song wey shi du for [[Billy Connolly's World Tour of New Zealand"]], wey bi pat of BBC television sho in November 2014. 

E du song wit Roman Keating wey mek am go up for UK Singles Chart, dia song "All Over Again" rich nomba 6 in June 2006. Shi stil du song solo album of  Roody Woomble , wey dey insaid pipul wey sing Idlewind. Dat same year im Cover of The Kniks' "The Village Green Preservation Society" dem uze for BBC one television komedy Jam and Jerusalem. Rusby rait difren new songs for di komedy fim, an na shi pipul tok sey sing for di sho music.

Na for 2007 Cambridge Folk Festival dem let pipul no sey di album Akward Annie dey kom out, dem Kon rilis am on 3 September 2007. 'The Village Green Preservation Society dey insaid di album as jara trak. For 2018 shi rilis Sweet Bells, na album wey plenti lokal krismas songs wey Rubsy du. Shi kon du anoda 3 krismas  albums: While Mortals Sleep (2011), The Frost is All Over (2015), Angels and Men (2017), and Holly Head (2019). Na evri December, Rubsy dey travu go du December sho for  United Kingdom in 2010, Rubsy rilis anoda song Make the light, na song wey shi don rait down tay tay. Insaid 2014 shi rilis album wey bi Ghost, lokal song dey insaid an three oda Rubsy songs. Rubsy fourteen solo album na Life in a paper boat wey shi rilis in 2016, year wey folo shi rilis fourth krismas album "Angels and Men". In May 2019, Rubsy rilis anoda album wey bi "philosophers, poets & Kings", im 5th krismas album folo dat one afta 6 months. 

Wen e don dey enta 10 years, Rubsy rilis kova album of popula songs lik Shake it off (Taylor Swift), Everglow (Coldplay) an Friday im in Love (The cure) an som plenti oda songs. Na wen Covid- 19 pandemic dey shi produs di album, Kate tok sey e dey im plan to rilis di album dis year, an sey Lockdown kon mek am pasonal. Wok wey shi jos du niu na '30: Happy Returns' an shi du parti bikos shi don rich 30 years wey e don dey sing. Di Songs na di niu ones wey Kate like for im wok. Dem rilis am May 2022.

Im pasonal life
In August 2001, Rubsy mari Scottish man wey dey sing  lokal song an e dey insaid im band memba, John MacCusker ( e dey insaid Battlefield band]] , na im produs meni of Rubsy rekodin rich The girl who couldn't fly, but dem no dey togeda again in 2006. In June 2010, shi mari Irish singa Damien O'kane, shi bon two pikin for am.

text:
Galit Hasan-Rokem (dem bon for 29 August 1945) na di Max and Margarethe Grunwald Profeso for di Mandil Institute of Jewish Studies for di Hebrew Yunifasi of Jerusalem.

Hasan-Rokem don rait meni buk-dem an e even join-bodi wit Wiley-Blackwell tek rait one buk wey dem kol Companion to folklore(2012).
Hasan-Rokem put mind wel-wel risash ontop provab dem,folklore an Midul East pipul Kolsho an difren-difren kind of folklore an tok dem.E even dey poblish poem an e sabi translet poem dem , an Hasan-Rokem even dey sopot pipul wey dey fight for Palestine pipul right dem.
One Nius-Pepa wey dem kol The Jerusalem Post tok say Hasan-Rokem sabi big big  pesin among di pipul wey dey rait folklore.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Dem bon Galit Hasan-Rokem for 1945 for
Helsinki.E papa an mama dem kom from Finland.
Hasan-Rokem go Helsink Jewish day skul from 1952 go rish 1957. For 1957, wen e stil bi 12 year old, Hasan-Rokem folo e papa an mama travul go Isreal. Afta eb graduat komot for high Skul, Hasan-Rokem go du e komposri militri savis an stat skul for diHebrew Yunifasiti of Jerusalem an as e stil dey dia dey stodi for e digri, e join-bodi du one program of di Dipatment of Finnishan Comparative folklore for Yunifasiti of Finland.
Wen Hasan-Rokem dey dia,Profeso MattiKuusi an Lauri Honko dem tish an dis kom mek an get plenti intre to tek stodi as folklorist.
Shi kolet e doctorate for di Hebrew Yunifasiti of Jerusalem for 1978, an na Profeso Dov Noy dey tish am.
Na 1984 shi ton to Profeso of folklore for di Hebrew Yunifasiti of Jerusalem.
Hau Shi Wok
Shi do risash ontop provab dem,folklore an Kolsho of pipul of di Midul East plus difren-difren folklore dem an esplaneshon dem an one folklore wey dem kol rabbiniclitresho.
Shi don do plenti wok dem ontop Is real pipul provab dem an Georgian Jew for Isreal.
Hasan-Rokem sho wel-wel for e wok say shi sopot wuman dem.
Meni pipul sef tok abaut hau Shi dey sopot wuman for inside all e wok espeshali pipul wey dey rait buk dem.
Shi even don poblish Meni of e buk an wok dem for eight difren-difren langwej dem.

Oda tins wey Shi do
Na Hasan-Rokem stat one projet wey dem dey yuz tek arenj difren-difren provab dem for Hebrew Yunifasiti of Jerusalem.
title: Galit Hasan-Rokem

text:
English na langwej wey start for Anglo-Saxon England. E bin get origin from Anglo-Frisian an Old Saxon dialects. Now, English don dey use as global langwej. Dem get about 375 million people wey dey speak am as dia first langwej for the world.

English na di onli offishul langwej or one of di offishul langwejes of nearly 60 kontris. E dey also be di main langwej of pass more kontris for di worl dan any oda langwej. E be di main langwej for United Kingdom, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. E be one of di offishul langwejes for Singapore, India, Hong Kong, and South Africa. People wey sabi English full ground for some part of Caribbean, Africa and South Asia.

For 2005, dem estimate say over 2 billion pipul dey wey sabi speak English.[4] English na di first foreign langwej wey most learners wey get anoda main langwej dey learn. E be official langwej for United Nations, European Union, and plenti oda international oganizations. English na di most widely-spoken Germanic langwej, with at least 70% of Germanic speakers dey sabi English. About 220 million oda pipul dey use am as their second langwej. E dey important well well for science, technology, work, travel, and trade, and at least one billion pipul dey learn am. All dese things combine make English the largest langwej by number of speakers.
title: English langwej

text:
Theo Brown ( Dem bon am 16 December 1914 an e kpai 3 February 1993). Na British pesin wey dey stodi Devon lokal tins. Na Lecturer for Exeter University, e dey tich Comparative Religion.

Hau e tek wok
Na Jean Marion Pryce bi di nem wey im papa an mama giv am wen dem bon am in London.im mama kpai wen shi dey bon am. Im papa wey lik tuo dey stodi, wey kon leta dey wok for British Museum - no fit dey monitor am, go out am for wia pikin wey no get mama an papa dey sta. Na Dorothy Langford Brown, of Braton Hall, Kingskerswell, Devon Kari am komot for dia to dey train am an stil Kon chenjim nem to  Theodora Brown.

Brown go stodi for Westminster School of Art, na for dia Mervyn Peake an som oda pipul tich am, an na for dia shi tek ci im bes frend, Magret Matcham. Shi folo for Kenn grup of artist.

For sekond WOD war shi join Women's Royal Service but im mama tel am sey mek shi no go far fom hause, hol di time shi uze na for home defens wok. Na wen shi wan join Werns Dem tel am for birth certificate, na dat time shi tek no sey no bi im mama an papa dey tek kare - sumtin wey mek am no hapi.

Afta di war, e no hapi an onli am dey tink, shi ci W.F Jackson Knight for station café of Exeter Central Railway Station. (Hau dem tek meet dey insaid Jackson Knights life tori). E afect im life afta dem meet, na im mek am stodi lokal tins an Comparative Religion, e leta bi ticha wey dey tich di wok at Exeter University. Dem Sabi am wel as memba for skul of pipul wey dey stodi lokal tins, an e get di mind sey e go sabi di way wey lokal tins dey tek hapun wey plenti pipul neva sabi. Shi gada plenti lokal storis an wey pipul dey du tins, wey dem put for Devon an Exeter Institution, di smol buk wey shi rait an im wok wey plenti pipul no ci dey Exeter University Library. Brown kpai for Exeter City on 3 February 1993.

Kemi Omololu-Olunloyo (dem bon am for August 6, 1964) na Naija jonalis, bloga and aktivis. Shi bi di gel pikin of Victor Omololu-Olunloyo wey bi di bifor gofnor of Oyo Stet. Dem sabi am well-well for Naija online komuniti as persin wey dey mek kontrovasa komets abaut pipo. One raita ves wit ha bicos plenti tins wey shi tok abaut ha laif and kariha na wayo.

How shi tek stat laif
Omololu-Olunloyo na di gel pikin of Oyo Stet bifor gofnor Victor Omololu-Olunloyo and di sekon pikin out of 10 pikins wey dem bon. Shi live for 14 years for Naija, 20 years for Amerika and 5 years for Kanada bifor shi kom bak to Naija.

Kariha
Omololu-Olunloyo don bi tok tok persin wey diskos abaut terorisim and bodi matas for CBC Nius, Ruptly, CTV Nius, BBC and Naija Televishon Ortoriti. Shi also wok as muzik jonalis for Naija Trybon.

For 3 Septemba 2022, Isaiah Ogedegbe repit im advice to Kemi Omololu-Olunloyo wie e tok say mek Kemi bi kiafu wen raiting abaut pipo. Dis na di sekon time wey e dey tok am becos e don give Kemi dat advice bifor.

Howeva, for April 18, 2023, Isaiah Ogedegbe bin digres fom advising to kritisizing Kemi Omololu-Olunloyo becos shi dey yuz di dai of som ogbonge pipo pikin-dem tek gada yeye populariti and e kol ha "kontroversa" and irashona".

text:
Norah Montgomerie or Norah Mary Shargool (dem bon April 6, 1909 an e kpai on February 19, 1998) na Bristish pesin wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. E na raita an e sabi put piksho for buk so dat pipul go ondastand di ridin.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for West Dulwich, London dey bon Norah Shargool. Norah papa nem na John Shargool an e mama nem na Letitia Alexander Shirley Shargool ( Norah mama nem na Sawyer bifor e mari). E papa na hakantant an e mama bi telor wey dey mek klot.
Norah go bordin skul wey de Folkestone an e still gi akt skul wey de London.

Norah tok inside Niuz-pepa sey e sabi sing, tok tori bikos e len dem from e gra-mama an sey e no fit foget e gra-mama advais wey bi: "No give smol pikin pap, give dem somtin wey dey fit chop for mouth". Norah dey mek suo sey e dey yuz dis advais for all e wok.

How e tek wok
Norah Montgomerie stey forDundee wia e wok for Skotish poblishin kompini DC Thomson. E still wok in London as pesin wey dey draw pikshor for magasin for pipul to ondastand di magasin as dem dey rid am.
For Norah wok, e dey sopot Scot langwej, dia tradishonal tori an dia muzik. Norah join bodi wit e hosband to rekod an kip Skotish tradishonal muzik, dia smol smol pikin song-dem. E still hep rait an draw for meni tradishonal song  an for smol pikin-dem song.
Some of di song wey e hep rait or draw inside na:
 Sandy Candy and other Scottish Nursery Rhymes (1948)
 The Well at the World's End (1956)
 The Hogarth book of Scottish nursery rhymes (1964)
 From Time to Time: Selected Poems (1985)

Norah stil rait an draw pikshor for e own buk like:
 Merry Little Fox and Other Animal Tales (1959)
 Twenty-five Fables (1962)
" To Read and to Tell (1964)
 This Little Pig Went to Market: Play rhymes for infants and young children (1966, with illustrator Margery Gill)
 One, Two, Three: A Little Book of Counting Rhymes (1967).
In 2009, Norah gra-son, Julian Brooks gada all di wok wey Norah don yuz e hand rait an e mek one buk from am. Di nem of di buk na: The Fantastical Feats of Finn MacCoul''.

E pasonal life
Norah Shargool mari William Montgomerie in 1934. William Montgomerie na Skotish raita an pesin wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Di marej produs two pikin, Dian an Ian. Norah hosband kpai in 1994. Norah sef kpai in 1998. E kpai in Edinburgh wen e bi 78 years old.
title: Norah Montgomerie

text:
Zola Neale Hurston ( dey bon am January 7, 1891 an e kpai on January 28, 1960) na Amerika raita, pesin wey dey stodi how pipul dey live in di past an e na fim-meka. Hurston rait an tok abaut how oyinbo pipul an blak pipul dey trit demsef for American South in eli 1900s. E stil rait abaut di spirit pratis-dem wey blak pipul dey paform in di past wey bi Hoodoo. Inside di four buks wey Hurston rait, na Their Eyes were Watching God pipul no pass. Dey poblish dat buk in 1937. Hurston don rait ova 50 smol smol tori an play.

How e tek stat life an go soul
Na for Notasulga, Alabama dey bon Hurston on January 7, 1891.Wen Hurston bi three year old, e move wit e famili go Eatonville, Florida in 1894. Eatonville bi di onli town wey bi sey na blak pipul full am an wey United State biliv sey di town na among United State town.Hurston bi di nomba five out of di Eight pikin wey John Hurston an Lucy Ann Hurston bon ( e mama nem na Potts bifor e mari). Na for inside slave dey bon all di four grandperet wey Hurston get. John Hurston wey bi Hurston papa Baptist prisha an pesin wey dey boro land to farm. Hurston papa leta bikom kapitaa. Lucy Ann Hurston wey bi Hurston mama na skul tisha.
In 1897, Hurston papa bikom chairman for di town. In 1902, Hurston papa bikom pastor in Macedonia Missionary Baptist. Na dat church big pass for all di chorch wey Baptish get dat time.
Wen Hurston gro up, e dey always yuz Eatonville wen e wan rait e tori. Na onli Eatonvile town Hi di onli ples wey blak pipul fit live an du enitin wey dey like Oyinbo pipul no go tok or du dem enitin.
Wen some Norta tisha kom Eatonville in 1901, dey pak some buk give Hurston an dis one opun e eyes to ridin buks. Na for Eatonville Hurston du e smol an e too abaut life for di town in di buk "How it feels to be Colored Me".
Evri year, di Eatonville town dey du one big parti to rimemba Hurston. Di nem of di parti na "Zora! Festival".
title: Zora Neale Hurston

text:
Helen Heffron Roberts ( dey bon am in 1888 an e kpai in 1985) na Amerika wuman wey dey stodi kolsho an e dey also stodi how difren kolsho dey mek muzik. Roberts wok na to luk into di horijin an how muzik tek divelop among di  Jamaika pipul an di  Pueblo pipul wey dey stey d Southwest of Amerika. Roberts rekodin of old Hawaii song dey  Bernice P. Bishop Musium in Hololulu wey dey kip am. Na Alfred V. Kidder an Franz Boas train Robert

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Chikago dey bon Roberts on June 12, 1888. Na Roberts bi di sinior pikin among di three pikin-dem wey e peret bon. Roberts papa nem na William Hinman Roberts an e mama nem na Dana Alma McDonald Roberts. Robert papa wok na hakantant an e mama na aktist.
Wen Roberts dey smol, e peter buy piano for am an dey hep am so dat e go sabi play di piano wel wel. Wen e finish e pamari an sekondri edukeshon in  Monticello Seminari, Roberts go kontiniu e edukeshon from Chikago Musikal Kolej an e finish in 1909 an e stil finish  Amerika konsavetori of Muzik in 1911.

How e tek wok
Wen Roberts dey muzik skul, e kom see sey e no fit bi wetin e papa an mama wan mek e bi: pesin wey go Dani play piano wel wel. Na bikos of di sikness wey e get an e hand wey no fit play di piano wel mek am no dis fact.

Wen Robert wan too for one tok wey e du, e tok sey e no bi popular pesin wey sabi play piano bikos of e sikness an sey e like  Nativ Amerika kolsho pass di piano lessin. Dis two tins mek am travul go Southwesta United States. Ova di years, e kontiniu to join muzik klass wit tishin muzik inside klass in Kansas, Texas.

title: Helen Heffron Roberts

text:
George Perry Floyd Jr. (dem bon am for Oktoba 14, 1973 and e kpai for May 25, 2020), wey pipo sabi as George Floyd, na Afrikan-Amerikan man wey one oyibo polis ofisa, Derek Chauvin kpai wen e tanda for Floyd nek for som minis. Plenti pipo no hapi wen e kpai an dis one mek dem ves an wit protes bikos dem wan yuz wetin hapun to George Floyd stop di bad bad tins wey pipo wey black pipo dey faze for Amerika.

Plenti Amerikan pipo, inkludin one Naija relijos figor and bloga Isaiah Ogedegbe, nor hapi wit di way Floyd tek kpai. Dem tink say dis na sahin wey show sey to dey fight black pipo for America neva finish for di kontri. Som pipo kari protes go strits. Meni protes go jejeli. Odas turn to gbege.

For 9 June 2020, Isaiah Ogedegbe show konsan for di kpai of George Floyd and as e dey ves, e kom tok say e si am "as a risent manifestashon of weked racism".

text:
Alsarah ( dey bon am in 1982) na Amerika wuman wey e gra-peret kom from Sudan. Alsarah na singa, song-raita, an pesin wey dey stodi how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik. E bi di lida of di grup Alsarah & the Nubatones. Alsarah grup don pafom wit meni oda grup like The Nile Project. Di nik-nem wey e dey ansa bi wen dey join "al" wit e ril nem "Sarah" to give "Alsarah".

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Khartoum in Sudan dey bon Alsarah. Alsarah peret na pat of di  pipul wey dey fight mek govamet no trit pipul enihow. Wen Alsarah dey eight year, e peret komot from Sudan bikos of di way Omar al-Bashir tek yuz by force kolet pawa to bi presidor of Sudan in 1989. If Alsarah peret no komot for Sudan, dey fit kil dem bikos di niu presidor fit tink sey dey bi pipul wey no go wan lisin to e kontro. Alsarah famili komot from Sudan go dey stey in Taez in Yemen. Wen fight an war stat for Yemen in 1994, Alsarah famili pak komot United States an dey live for Boston as pipul wey komot from dia kontri bikos of  fight fight.
Wen all dis tins dey hapun in Alsarah life, e dey find hapiness in lisin to redio, lisin to muzik wey kom from Yemen an tekin piano lesin from famili frend. 
Wen e dey United State, Alsarah sing for meni Wold muzik hevet an e go stodi for Pioneer Valley Pafomin Akts Charter Poblik Skul. Alsarah rid Ethnomusicology at  Wesleyan Yunivasiti. Na for di Yunivasiti e tek rait sinior Pepa on Sudan [Zār]] muzik.

How e tek wok
Wen Alsarah finish Yunivasiti in 2004, e go New York Siti an stat to sing as profeshonal singa in Arabik langwej an e dey du difren job join di singin to fit chop. Alsarah bi di singa for di Zanzibari band Sound of Tarab.

Alsarah & the Nubatones
Na in 2010 Alsarah fom Alsarah and the Nubatones. Pipul wey de inside di band na: e sista Nahid, bak-up singa Mawuena Kodjovi, ginta playa Luthier Haig Manoukian ( wen e kpai, Brandon Terzic kom join dem dey du Luthier Haig Manoukian wok), drum bita Rami El-Aasser of di Cafe Antarsia Ensemble
title: Alsarah

text:
{Short description|Czech singer (1964–2022)}}

Hana Work (dem bon am 15 February 1964 an e kpai 16 January 2022) na pesin wey dey sing abaut lokal tins an na fom Czech. Shi bi memba of Asonance band.

Life
Dem bon Hana Horká for Prïbram. Shi stodi at Brno Conservatory Kon join di Janácek Academy of Music and Performing Art. Shi wok for National Theatre Brno. In 1985, shi join grup wey Sabi lokal tins Asonance Shi bi one of di key pesin for di grup. Shi du im las album wit album wit Asonance in year 2019, "Návart Krále" (The return of the King). Di singa no gree kolet COViD- 19 injecshion bikos shi want mek dem no disturb am an alow am pas shi bilif sey wetin dey  pesin body fit hep pesin fight COVID- 19.

Im pikin Rek tel Czech Radio sey im wit im papa don get COVID- 19 bifor krismas, but go kolet di injecshion an no wel for three days, Hana Horká, wey get COVID- 19, no wel for five days, til shi kpai on 16 January 2022. Im pikin wey bi boy tok afta one day wey shi kpai, sey na bikos im mama no kolet di COVID- 19 injecshion mek am kpai.

Wia dem gada di tori

text:
Nelson Rolihlahla Mandela (dem bon am for July 18, 1918 and e kpai for Disemba 5, 2013), wey pipo sabi as Nelson Mandela, na di lait Saut Afrika politishian and aktivis. For April 27, 1994, dem mek am di fes Presido of Saut Afrika wey bot blak and oyibo pipo vote for. E na also one taim fes blak Presido of im kontri, Saut Afrika.

Dem bon Mandela for Mvezo, Saut Afrika and im bi memba of di Thembu roya famili.

Im gofment show konsan abaut endin apatide, kolor bad belle and povati for im kontri. As a biliva of soshalisim, e wok as di Presido of di Afrikan Nashonal Kongres fom 1991 rish 1997. Na im mek niu Konstitushon of Saut Afrika for 1996 wey forbid eni diskriminashon wey konsan langwej, relijon, hadicap and setua orihentashon, not jos kolor bad belle. Mandela na di bifor Seketari Jenera of di Non-Aligned Mofment fom 1998 rish 1999.

Mandela don kolet mor dan 250 awods, inkludin di 1993 Nobel Pis Priz, di Amerika Presido Meda of Fridum and di Soviet Orda of Lenin. Pipo dey kol am wit im Xhosa klan nem, Madiba, or Tata ("Papa"). Dem dey si am as a hiro and im akshons don give plenti pipo hope.

Mandela bi dey sik for som years afta e don retaya. Dem put am for huspito for 2013 becos of im lung infeshon. Mandela kpai fom di siknes for Disemba 5, 2013 for Houghton Estate wey dey for Johanisbog. E bi 95 years old.

For 29 Septemba 2022, Isaiah Ogedegbe rait one poem abaut Nelson Mandela to prez im laif.

text:
Kefee Obareki Don Momoh (dem bon am for Febuari 5, 1980 and shi kpai for June 12, 2014), wey pipo sabi as Kefee, na di lait wuman gospo musikshian for Naija.

How shi tek stat laif
Dem bon Kefee for Sapele wey dey for Delta Stet for Febuari 5, 1980.

Shi bi memba of Andrew Obareki famili, and ha papa and mama bi one taim dikens for one church wey di papa and mama of ha bifor husband Alec Godwin stat.

Kefee finish fom di Univasiti of Bini wit a digre for Biznes Administrashon. As a tineja, shi show konsan abaut church matas espeshali to sing for di kwaya.

Kariha
As Kefee zil for muzik get biga, shi stat to rait and kompose songs. For 2000, shi reliz one abom wit di nem "Trip" and dat mek ha popula as a gospo singa for di Naija muzik indostri.

For 2003, dem sign Kefee to Alec's Etatainment, a rekod lebel wey ha bifor kwaya direktor stat. E neva tey bifor shi reliz anoda abom wit di nem "Branama".

Di Branama abom also mek plenti pipo sabi Kefee as ogbonge gospel singa and dem buy di abom bot nashonali and intanashonali. Branama sel nine tausund kasets for three wiks and ova two milion CD/VCDs for one mont. Na so ha ogbonge kariha as Naija gospo singa tek stat. Di lait singa songs wey pipo sabi evriwie na "Branama" and "Kokoroko".

Awods
Dem don honor Kefee wit di Intanashonal Young Ambasador for Pis Awod for 2009. Shi win di 2010 Hedis Awods for Bes Kolaborashon wit Timaya for "Kokoroko".

Pasona laif
Kefee mari two taims. Shi fes mari Alec Godwin for three years rish 2008.

Shi leta mari redio tok tok persin Teddy Esosa Don-Momoh for March 3, 2012 for Sapele, Delta Stet.

Dai and beriha
Doh rumor kari am say di cos of ha dai na pregnasi komplikashons, Kefee Obareki Don Momoh kpai fom lung felior for one huspito for Los Angeles, California for June 12, 2014.

Shi bi don dey koma for fifteen days.

Dem beri ha for Friday July 11, 2014 for di ples wie shi kom fom, Okpara Inland wey dey for di Ethiope East Loka Gofment Area of Delta Stet, Naija.

Also for July 11, 2014, Naija relijos figor Isaiah Ogedegbe rait one poem abaut Kefee to prez ha laif.

For Septemba 29, 2022, Isaiah Ogedegbe bin rait anoda poem abaut Kefee.

text:
Brita Egardt (e papa nem na Mellendar; 1916-1990) na one pesin from Sweden wey dey stodi difren-difren pipul karata an hau dem rezembul an difren from each oda(ethnologist) an stodi of tradishonal biliv dem,stori an kostom dem(folklorist).Shi even do risash ontop pipul biliv an kostom dem.Shi wok wit Folklife Archive (Folklivsarkivet) for Lund Yunifasiti.From 1967 to 1973 shi wok as docent of Nordic an shi do risash tek help an balans difren-difren tradishonal biliv,stori an kostom dem(Nordisk och jamforande 
folklivsknig).Shi get maut wel-wel for mata wey konsan difren-difren pipul karata an kostom dem.
Di Hastislakt och rackarskamwok wey shi kol(The Slaughter of horses and the shame of the Slaughterers), mek e get levul wel-wel for 1962 an shi folo join-bodi tek rait Schwediache Volkskunde.Quellen, Forschung.Ergebnisse(1961).Shi even kontrbut meni-meni hatikul dem ontop Tradishonal biliv,stori an kostom dem.

Hau Shi Liv E wen shi bi Smol-pikin,Hau shi go Skul an E famili dem
Dem bon am for Trelleborg for August 7, 1916.Brita Sigrid Anna Lvisa Mellander na di girl-pikin of Arvid Gohfrid Mellander wey bi Postmaster
an e waif , Augusta Matilda(Mattis).
E papa nem na Johnsson.Na shi bi di sekond pikin.Wen shi finish skul for Malmos high Skul for girls for 1936, shi kom stodi Nordic stodi, histri of rilijon an Tradishonal biliv, stori an kostom (Folklore), an shi kom graduet for 1941.For dat sem 1941, shi Mari Otto Egardt wey dey wok for Bank an dem bon two pikin,Eva-Mia an Peter.Dem giv am doktoret Awod for thesis wey shi do ontop Slaughter of horses

Hau Shi Wok
Afta shi wok as pesin wey dey helep(amanuens) for muziom wey dem yuz tek tok abaut histri(Historical Museum)
wey Lund Yunifasiti for 1952,dem kom promot am to Prinsipa Asistant  an dem stil gov am post as pesin wey dey kontro di ples wey dem dey keep histri infomeshon(archivist).
From 1967 to 1973, shi wok as docent for Nordic  an Tradishonal biliv, stori an kostom stodi dem an shi kom stil wok for stodi of difren-difren pipul karata an hau Dem difren an rezembul demsef.(ethnology)
title: Brita Egardt

text:
Edit Hodgetts(shi kpai for 1902)na one pesin from Britain wey dem bon for Russia wey dey rait Smol-pikin stori dem,folk tale,an fairy tales.

Tori abaut E Laif
Dem bon am for Russia an na dia shi Liv wen shi stil bi Smol-pikin.
Micheal Nicolaevitch an Sophie Nicolaevna dem tek as dia girl-pikin.
Afta som time, shi kom muv go England go stay dia.Meni pipul know am bikos  of e buk dem wey shi gada-togeda tek mek Koleshon ontop Russia fair tales wey shi poblish for 1890 for London. Dem stil print dis Koleshon buk Meni times
for 1891,1892,1972,1974,1983,2013, 2015 an 2017.
Wen shi dey tok abaut di buk, Hodgetts tok sey di stori dem na wetin shi don dey gada-togeda sins di time wen shi bi Smol-pikin an shi gada dem from skul an from di pipul wey tek kai of an wen shi dey smol.Shi even tok sey dem tranlet som from Russia langwej.
Shi dediket di buk giv eselensi Micheal Nicolaevitch an eselensi Sophie Nicolaevna de Kapouatine.
For 2017,dem poblish two of dis Russia stori dem,The Blacksmith and the Devil an The Wonderful Trade for inside one buk wey dem kol Sorcerer's Apprentice:An Anthology of Magical TalesNa Jack Zipes yuz Princeton University Press kom poblish am.
Som of E oda stori dem na Vaselesa the Beautiful ''''The Silver Platean Transparent Apple,  The Soldier and the Demons,The Snow-Maiden, Jack Frost, Ivan an the Chestnut Horse,Horse Three Kopeks,The Red Flamingoes, The Witch and the Sister of the Sun, Princess Vera the Wise, Count Daniel Nathaniel,The Witch, Mary & Natty,The Robbers, Ivashko and the Witch,Prince Kid-Skin, Want,An Angry Wife, The Lucky Child, The Potter and the Evil Spirit,Princess Grey-Goose, Grey Wolf and the Golden Cassowary,Starvelling King Vladimir and the Skeleton, The Quick Runner, Honesty and Dishonesty, Fona Berennekoff,The Roguish Peasant,A Hoax,The Wonderful Sailor, Senka the Little,Elie Muromittch, The King of the Sea and Melania the Clever,The Last of the Russian Warriors, "If you don't like it, don't listen, but don't Spoil my lies" The Little Brown Cow''
38 inside dis Russia stori buk dem wey shi gada-togeda tek do Koleshon na stori wey Inglish pipul dem no know bifor dem kom polish am.
title: Edit Hodgetts

text:
Ellen Stekert ( dey bon am in 1935) na Amerika leshoral, pesin wey de stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way an muzishan. Stekert na Professo Emerita of Inglish at di  Yunivasiti of Minnesota.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for New York Siti dey bon Ellen Stekert in 1935. E gro up in Great Neck for [[Long Island| Long Hiland]. Na smol rimen e for kpai bikos of polio wen e dey smol. Sketert stat to dey sing traditional old muzik wen e dey sekondri skul an now e don rilis meni rekordin albom.

Sketert go Cornell Yunivasiti an e len for di klass wey Harold Thompson. Harold Thompson na pesin wey de stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Sketert even hep Harold Thompson tish studet somtimes. Wen di luv wey Stekert get for tradishonal muzik stat to gro, e stat to Waka abaut araund dey rekod an kolet tradishonal song-dem wey singa dey sing for Norta pat of New York. Stekert kolet some muzik from Ezra "Fuzzy" Barhight. Ezra Barhight na pesin wey dey kot tree down for bush an na Cohocton, New York e dey stay. Stekert rekod an rili dos song in 1958 wit di tahitu Songs of a New York Lumberjack
Afta wey Stekert rid filosofi in Cornell Yunivasiti, e go du e Masta digri in folklore for  Indiana Yunivasiti. For Indiana Yunivasiti, e kontiniu to dey waka abaut koletin tradishonal song in Kentucky an Souta Indiana. Wen Stekert finish e Masta digri finish, e stat e Ph.D in folklore for Indiana Yunivasiti but na Yunivasiti of Pennsylvania e tek finish e Ph.D an kolet e satifiket. Bikos of di way e dey du e supavisor wok, Stekert finish e Ph.D in 1965. Di nem of e supavisor na Richard Dorson.

How e tek wok
Di fest tishin wok wey Stekert du na for Wayne State Yunivasiti wey de Detroit. For di yunivasiti, Stekert kontiniu di wok wey Thelma G. James fest stat. Di wok bi see e kontiniu to dey kolet an kip di tradishonal ways pipul dey du tins for siti.
title: Ellen Stekert

text:
Olga Erastovna Ozarovskaya (dey bon am in 1874 an e kpai in 1933) na Russian pesin wey de stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way, e na tori-tella, raita an pesin wey dey kip tradishonal tori wey pipul dey tok.
Ozarovskaya don poblish some  Norta Russian tradishonal tori buks. Na Ozarovskaya bi di fest wuman wey wan wok for govamet in Russia an di fest wuman wey du wok for sayens akedemik in  Russian Empaya. Ozarovskaya don wok wit Russian tradishonal tori-tella Mariya Krivopolenova

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for St. Petersburg wey de Russia Empaya dey tek bon Olga Erastovna Von Ozarovskaya. E papa nem na Erast Ozarovsky an e mama nem na Varvara Petrovna Von Ozarovsky. Ozarovskaya papa na Russia Souja bifor. Ozarovskaya get two brodas Alexander Erastovich Ozarovskaya an Yuri Erastovich Ozarovsky. Alexander na souja an Yuri bikom aktor an e leta bi di daretor of di  Alexandrinsky Tihata.
Ozarovskaya rid Kemistri an get e digri in  St. Petersburg Yunivasiti ( dey chenj di nem to Saint Petersburg State University). In 1897, Ozarovskaya finish from "Higher Women's Courses" in Petersburg wey e kolet digri satifiket in Matimatis.
In di 90s, araund 1907, Ozarovskaya stat to pafom for smol smol an lokal ples. E pak go Moscow an fom di "Living Word  Studio" in 1911. Bitwin 1915 go rish 1925, Ozarovskaya travu to Norta Russia four time bikos e wan kolet an kip Norta tradishonal tori an song. Wen Ozarovskaya travu gi Arkhangelsk Governorate in 1915, e met Mariya Krivopolenova an e gri mek Mariya folo am go Moscow so dat Mariya go fit pafom in Moscow. Ozarovskaya stil rait an intaprit di wok of Krivopolenova's an Dis tin wey e du mek am de popular wel wel.

Ozarovskaya kpai on June 12, 1933 in Frunze (di niu nem na Bishkek), Kirghiz ASSR, Soviet Union. Meni of di tin wey e kip dey St. Petersburg inside di Pushkin State Museum of Fine Arts.
title: Olga Ozarovskaya
