text:
Louise Elizabeth Manny (dey bon am 1890 an e Kpai 17 August 1970) na New Brunswick wuman wey dey stock an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way an e stil bi pesin we dey stodi histri. Na for Gilead, Maine dey bon am but e famili go stey for New Brunswick wen e bi three years old. Na for  Miramichi Riva side e tek gro up an from dat side e stat to like lokal tori. Manny rait an tok abaut DOS tori wey e lisin to for Miramichi Riva side wel wel. 
Wit di hep of Lord Beaverbrook in 1947, Manny stat to dey kolet an rekod di song wey pipul wey fall big wood an pipul wey dey katch fish dey sing in Miramichi aria. Beaverbrook still hep Manny wit moni so dat e go fit arenj an du di house wey de Newcastle, New Brunswick wel. Na di house kom leta bikom di lokal librari.
Beaverbrook dey mek suo sey Manny folo di kommand wey e dey give as Manny dey kolet an rekod songs an tori-dem for Miramichi aria. Beaverbrook tok sey na onli horijina song mek Manny dey kolet an rekod no bi di one wey dey no sabi how e tek kom. Wen Manny don finish di wok wey Beaverbrook give am ( Manny poblish di wok as Songs of Miramichi), E kontiniu e risach wit more freedom. Manny kom dey rekod an kolet both old an niu tradishonal song. E tok sey tradishonal song na song wey pipul dey sing from dia mind an he'd an na for dia frend to enjoi am. E stil tok sey na di pipul demsef dey form am an di muzik dey waka from one pesin wey hear am to anoda pesin. Manny no wan no weyda di muzik na old or niu tradishonal song as far as sey e song tok abaut dia kolshora bakgraund e go rekod am. E tok sey as dem dey rekod am like dat, dey don hep save di kolsho an histri of New Brunswick.
E rish like twenty years (1947 to 1965) wey Manny dey play di rekod-dem for di weekli brokast on CKMR redio in Newcastle.

Manny also dey tok an rait abaut histri tins for one niuz-pepa wey dey kom out evri week. Di pat wey e dey rait e own for di niuz-pepa na "Scene from an Earlier Day". Na Manny form di Miramichi Folksong Festival in 1957.
title: Louise Manny

text:
Maria Ester Grebe Vicuña (dey bon am July 11, 1928 an e kpai November 1, 2012) na Chile wuman wey dey stodi pipul kolsho an e stil dey stodi an rekod how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik. Grebe major wok na to rekod an gada muzik wey pipul wey kom from Chile kontri dey du.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Arica wey de Chile dey bon María Ester Grebe in July 11, 1928. E rid how to mek muzik from  Yunivasiti of Chile. Grebe kolet e B.A sartifiket from di yunivasiti in 1965.Grebe stil kontiniu e stodi as e go  Yunivasiti of Kalifornia an  Indiana Yunivasiti in di late 1960s. Grebe stodi in Yunivasiti of Chile in di 1970s.  Karen Yunivasiti Belfast give am Ph.D sartifiket in 1980.

Grebe rili wok for a long time as pesin wey dey stodis pipul kolsho an how dem dey like as sosaheti. Na how Chile kolsho an how di pipul dey du e fokus e wok pass. Grebe as eddy du e risach, go waka abaut di kontri as e dey go one festival or serimoni to anoda one. E go stil dey ask pipul kweshon from one topik to anoda. Grebe na professor wey don hey in di Dipatmet of Anthropology wey de Yunivasiti of Chile. Na di Yunivasiti e tek tish onti e ritaya in 2008. Grebe stil wok in di Dipatmet of Medisine as e stodi Mapuche tradishonal medisine. Pipul sabi Grebe wel wel for di wok wey e du as etek stodis how difren difren kolshor dey mek muzik an how di muzik dey du pipul wey dey lisin to dem. Grebe stodi muzikal tradishon of Mapuche an pipul wey dey stey in Chile. In 1964 an in 1977, dey give Grebe Guggenheim Fellowship awod mek e yuz am tek forda e muzikal risach.
title: María Ester Grebe

text:
Raquel Barros Aldunate (dey bon am December 2, 1919 an e kpai in August 11, 2014) na Chile wuman wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Pipul sabi Barros wel wel bikos of e risach wey e du on Chile tradishonal song an dans.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na 1952 Raquel Barros form di Folklore Association of Chile. E bi di daretor of dat grup for meni years. Di nem to di grup don chenj to "Raquel Barros Folklore Group of Chile" an na di grup old pass for Chile kontri as far as tins abaut kolsho is konsain. Barros na risasha at di  Yunivasiti of Chile at di Institute of Muzikal Risach an for dia Muzikal Dipatmet bitwin 1958 go rish 1980. Barros don wok as Vais-dean an hasitat dean for di Falkoti of Muzikal Sayens an Akts an Paformans  from 1974 go rish 1975. In 1973, dey mek Barros di daretor of di  Nashonal Folkloric Ballet.
As Barros dey du e risach, e dey always join an rekod how pipul dey du tins for old way.
Even wen Barros don old, e stil dey rait an tok abaut Chile kolsho. Wen e na 82 years, dey mek Barros di presidor of di kolshora senta of di Municipality of Recoleta.

In 1996, dey mek Barros one of di honorabu memba of di pamanet Intanashonal Folklore Kommishon wey dia hed-ofis dey Beunos Aires in Argentina. In 2004, Barros join as memba of di "FONDART" projet kwulifikashon Kommishon of di  Nashonal Kansu of Kolsho an di Akts. 

Raquel Barros fall wen e dey house an tek Kari go hispitu. Barros kpai at di Hospital del Salvador in Santiago on August 11, 2014.

Buks wey e don rait
Some of Barros buks wey e don poblish bi:
 "El folklore de Chiloé", wey Nashonal Seketri of Wumen for  di OAS mitin, Santiago poblish in 1979. ( Manuel Dannemann join hand du di buk)
 "La poesía folklórica de Melipilla", Revista Musical Chilena, No. 60, Santiago, 1958
 "La danza folklórica chilena – Investigación y enseñanza", Revista Musical Chilena, No. 71, Santiago, 1960
 "El guitarrón en el Depto. de Puente Alto", Revista Musical Chilena, No. 74, Santiago, 1960
 "Introducción al estudio de la tonada", Revista Musical Chilena, No. 109, Santiago, 1964
 Guía metodológica para el estudio del folklore chileno, Editorial Universitaria, Santiago, 1964
 La ruta de la Virgen de Palo Colorado, Santiago, 1966
 El romancero chileno, Santiago, 1970
Apart from di buks-dem wey Barros rait an poblish, e stil arenj list of tradishonal muzik wey de rekod in di Tradishonal Muzik Rekod of di  Falkoti of Akts of di Yunivasiti of Chile.
title: Raquel Barros

text:
Ruby Terrill Lomax ( dey bon am in 1886 an e kpai in December 28, 1961) na Amerika wuman wey bi tisha an e na pesin wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Terrill join hand wit e hosband John A. Lomax to rekod an kip Amerika tradishonal songs. E stil hep to mek pipul no di impotant of mek Wumen go skul an e na "Dean " for wumen edukeshon at  Yunivasiti of Texas in Austin

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Denton, Texas wey de United State just outside Dallas dey bon Ruby Terrill. E get digri for Stet Kolej. Ruby Terrill mek rekod as di fest wuman wey get hi-yest 1  at di Yunivasiti of Texas. Wen Terrill see sey na tisha e go like to bi in life, e tish for sekondri skul wey de vilej side an di sekondri skul wey de siti for di Stet wey e de. E still tish for kolej wey de e Stet. E yuz di moni wey e get from dis tishin job tek sopot e sef as e kontinu to rid for yunivasiti. Di sponsor moni wey e get as e wan len Latin from 1914 to 195 hep  Terrill to fit get Ph.D in Klassikal Langwej. Di moni wey e get as e dey du holiday lesin for four years at di  Yunivasiti of Chikago an two years at  Kolombia  Yunivasiti hep sopot too so dat e go get e Ph.D.

How e tek wok
Terrill Kolet e M.A sartifiket in klassikal langwej from Kolombia Yunivasiti. Wetin Terrill go rid na Latin but e stil get smol nolej in Greek afta wey dey mek am di "Dean" of women hasosiate professor of klassikal langwej at di Yunivasiti of Texas in Austin. Wen e still dey wok for di yunivasiti, Terrill join as memba to lokal, nashonal an intanashonal sosaheti. Di student wey de Yunivaasiti of Texas no am we'll we'll bikos of sey de jentu, nice an e dey always laff wit dem.

text:
Maria Paula Survilla(February 1, 1964-April 25, 2020)pipul even dey kol am Paulina Survilla,na one Amerika pesin  bi Profeso for di stodi of difren-difren kolsho Muzik an hau Dem rezembul dem sef(ethnomusicoloy)an stil bi pesin wey dey fight for di rait of Belarusia pipul dem.

Tori abaut E Laif
Na Janka an Ivonka Survilla dem bon am for Madrid,Spain.Di two of dem dey tok again pipul wey dey fait for Komunis dem
an dem komot for Belarus bikos of di wahala wey sekond Wold War kos.
Dem muv go France, stay dia for some time ,kom stil muv go Spain.Bikos Paula mama like to dey learn niu-niu langwej dem,shi sef kom stat to dey learn difren-difren langwej dem sotey e kom Sabi spik French, Spanish an Belarusian langwej wel-wel wen shi stil bi smol-pikin.

Wen Shi stil bi Smol-pikin
Wen shi bi five yias old,e famili muv go Canada an shi kom stil learn Inglish as e nomba four langwej wen shi dey for skul.Joz as e mama dey difend Belarus Kolsho, Survilla sef kom ton to pesin wey dey fait for pipul right wen shi bi smol-pikin.Shi even stat one grup wey shi kol Youth Canadian Ethnocultural Council an shi bi di shia-pesin.
Wen shi dey for Yunifasiti of Ottawa,shi stodi difren-difren pipul Kolsho Muzik an hau dem rezembul demsef(ethnomusicology), an kom graduet wit B.A ontop Muzik(Clarinet1987) an shi kom bikom memba of di Governor General Foot Guards Band.Shi even do di wok of pesin wey dey gaid pipul dey tour an dey
show visitos dem difren-difren tins wey dey for di Parliamentan inside Govno Genera kompand.

Pipul Wey Sabi Buk Dem
For 1987 Survilla Mari Eric Wachmann an dem muv go Ann Arbor Michigan, so shi kom stat wok ontop e M.A digri for di Yunifasiti of Michigan.
Wen shi dey do e Masters, di tins wey shi rait tek difend e wok (thesis) naim shi kol Music and Identity: Byelorussian making music in North America.
For 1991,dem giv Survilla shans to dey go skul for free(Scholarship) an dis gift kom mek am for do orijina risash ontop Bialystok, Poland an Belarus.
At las di wok kom stil gov am anoda shans to tek rait plenti-tins(dissertation) ontop Mermaids an Rock Singers an dis wok wey shi rait mek dem giv am e PhD for pesin wey stodi difren-difren Kolsho Muzik an hau Dem rezembul demsef (Ethnomusicology) for di Yunifasiti of Michigan.
title: Maria Paula Survilla

text:
Zofia Kowalewska ( dey bon am in 1853 for Bakszty Male an e kpai in 1918 for Minsk) na wuman wey kom from Poland wey dey rait histri, e dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Zofia na wuman wey stil dey fight for pipul so dat dia life go beta.

How e tek stat life an wok
Na for 1853 dey bon Zofia Kowalewska in "Bakszty Male". Bakszty Male dey pat of di aria wey Russia empaya dey kontro bifor bifor. Zofia famili get plenti land wey dem de kontro for Poland. Zofia nem bifor e mari na Zofia Lẹtowski. Na Eugeniusz Zawadzki wey kom from Vilnius County Zofia mari. Wen e dey e house, e dey tish edukeshon tins an also dey sikrit tish  Poland langwej an histri of Poland. E rili wok wel wel mek  Poland kolsho no kpai among di lokal pipul of Poland.
For di buk-dem wey Zofia Kowalewska dey rait, e dey tok abaut di plan an hope wey all Poland pipul get dorin di  January riot in Poland an how Poland pipul dey live an du tins in Minsk. Zofia Kowalewska rait tori abaut tins wey hoganazashon wey dey fight govamet dey du in Poland. E stil rait abaut how dos hoganazashon tek stat in 1863. Na Józef Zawadzki buk-shop wey de Vilnius poblish meni of di buks-dem wey Zofia Kowalewska rait. Zofia like to dey rait abaut di lokal tradishonal tori an e stil like to dey rait abaut pipul kolsho, how pipul dey du tins in dia lokal ways. Zofia sopot di "Polish Sosaheti for Edukeshon an Shariti" wey de Minsk. Zofia stil rait hatiku an smol smol tori in "Kurier Litewski" an "Eisla"
Na February 22, 1918 Zofia kpai in Minsk di kapital of Belarus.
Na February 22, 1918 Sofia kpai in Minsk. Minsk na di kapital of Belarus.

Buk-dem wey e don rait
 Obrazki Mińskie 1850-1863, nakładem księgarnia Józefa Zawadzkiego w Wilnie, 1912
 Ze wspomnień wygnańca z roku 1863, nakładem księgarnia Józefa Zawadzkiego w Wilnie, 1912
 Z pamiętników doktora:powieść współczesna, nakładem księgarnia Józefa Zawadzkiego w Wilnie 1913
 Dzieje powstania lidzkiego: wspomnienie o Ludwiku Narbucie, nakładem Wyd. "Dziennika Wileńskiego" w Wilnie, 1934
title: Zofia Kowalewska

text:
Kateryna Anatoliivna Pavlenko (dey bon am August 10, 1988) na Ukraine singa, komposa an na pesin wey de stodis an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Pipul sabi am wel wel as Monokate. Na Pavlenko bi di lid singa of di Ukraine folk band Go_A. Na Go_A band repriset Ukraine at di Eurovision Song Contest 2020 wit di song "Solovey". Wen dey kansu di program bikos of COVID-19 Pandemic, di band repriset Ukraine again in 2021 wit di song Shum.

How e tek stat life
Na August 10, 1988 dey bon Pavlenko Nizhyn, Chernihiv Oblast, in Ukraine. ( at dat time di nem of Ukraine na Ukraine SSR). Chernihiv Oblast na one siti wey de North-East side of Kyiv, di kapital of Ukraine. Pavlenko mama dey wok for di militri an dey no de give am eni mini for di wok dia. Dis one mins sey Pavlenko famili poor no bi smol an for sometime dey no even get ples to stey. Pavlenko gro up lisinin to  tradishonal muzik. E gra-ma na singa an e tish Pavlenko how to sing tradishonal mizik. Di metod wey e gra-ma tish am na  White Vois.
Pavlenko gra-pa sabi play one muzikal instrumet kol Accordion. Pavlenko mama sef dey sing inside one tradishonal song muzikal band.

Wen Pavlenko still dey skul, e go rid muzik an e tisha-dem wan mek e bi singa wey go dey sing for stage lol "opera" singa. In Pavlenko mind, na singa wey de sing muzik wey di muzik dey loud e wan dey sing. Bikos of dis one, Pavlenko join one lokal rock band an wen e gro up smol an e pafom for meni show.

How e tek go skul
Pavlenko go Nizhyn Skul of Kolsho an Ant an e finish di soul in 2009. E kom enta  Kyiv Nashonal Yunivasiti of Kolsho an Akts go rid Folklore an e finish in 2013.

How e tek wok
Pavlenko don hep daret meni group wey dey pafom. E don hep daret di popular band  wey de araund Berezan, Kyiv Oblast. Pavlenko is di lid singa of di band Go_A an e don rait an poblish e own muzik onda one fake nem wey Hi Monokate.
title: Kateryna Pavlenko

text:
Yei Evelyn Theodara Kate Ozaki (dey bon am December 1870 an e kpai on December 28, 1932) na Japan wuman wey dey chenj Japan smol smol tori to anoda langwej for pipul to ondastand. Some pipul komplain abaut e wok but afta e kpai dey kom riprint e wok meni times.

How e tek stat life
Na for London dey bon Yei Theodara Ozaki in 1871. Ozaki papa nem na Baron Saburō Ozaki an e mama nem na  Bathia Catherine Morrison wey kom from England ( dey bon am 1843 an e kpai 1936). E papa Baron Saburô Ozaki bi one of di fest Japan men to go rid in Europe or Amerika. Ozaki mama bi di gel-pikin of William Mason Morrison ( dey bon am in 1819 an e kpai in 1885) wey e bon wit Mary Anne Morrison. Ozaki mama wey dey tish in England mit Ozaki papa wen e kom len for e klass an both of dem mari in 1869.

For one buk wey Mary Fraser rait wit di tahitu "A Biological Sketch; from Warrior of old Japan and others stories" e tok sey Ozaki mama wey bi Bathia to live togeda with Ozaki papa. E stil tok sey Ozaki mama  stil bon anoda two gel-pikin: Masako Maude Mary Harriett Ozaki (dey bon am in January 1872) an Kimie Bathia Alexandra Ozaki ( dey bon am in 1873 an e kpai 1964).
Ozaki papa kom bak to Japan in 1873 bikos e wan mari one wuman wey e famili get mouth as dey don plan di marej sins. Di nem of dat wuman na Toda Yae. Dis one hapun bikos dey wan mek di famili nem Toda no kpai.
Leta, Ozaki papa komot from Japan an get a job for St. Petersburg wey dey Russia so dat e go fit dey klose to Ozaki mama. Na in 1880 di famili of Baron Ozaki kom gri sey dia pikin rili don mari Ozaki mama an dey put e nem in di list of wife wey dey dia famili histri.
title: Yei Theodara Ozaki

text:
Berit Tørrisdatter Skjefte Pynten (dey bon am araund 1809 an e kpai in 1899) na one wuman wey kom from Norway wey sabi play one tradishonal Norway muzik instrumet wey bi like ginta kol langeleik.Pipul stil no Berit Skjefte as Berit på Pynte or Berit Pynte. Skjefte kom from Vestre Slidre wey de Valdres aria. E bikom popular wel wel for Norway bikos of how e tek sabi pafom in front of pipul an how e dey yuz babi wey dey dans pafom.
infat, Na from Skjefte paformas di two muzik komposa Edvard Grieg an Ludvig Mathias Lindeman dey get hidiya or inspireshon to du dia wok. Dey kip three instrumet-dem wey Skjefte dey yuz pafom  inside  Ringve Museum wey de Trondheim.

How e tek stat life
Na for Vestre Slidres dey bon Berit Tørrisdatter araund 1809. Skjefte papa nem na Tørris Toresen ( dey bon am in 1772) an e mama nem na Marit Tørris (dey bon am in 1778 an e nem bifor e mari na Gjermundsdatter). Skjefte papa na souja an farma. Na inside Gryte farm e tek gro up. Skjefte mari Andris Andrissen Skjefte ( dey bon am in 1804). E hosband wok na farma an pesin wey dey menshon land. One gossip wey dey go raund dat time bi sey, Skjefte an e hosband yuz just five pot of ogogoro tek kolet di house wey de klose to main road to Vestlandet. Di nem of di house na Pynten.

How e tek wok
Wen Skjefte go find hanima for bush wey dey go chop, Skjefte go dey house dey kolet mini from pipul wey wan am to play di langeleik instrumet for dem. Di house Pynten na beta restin ples for meni Norway pipul an pipul wey fourin pipul wey dey travul on di main road to Bergen.
Skjefte get bizness sense bikos e sabi to mek motor driva to stop an allow di pasenja to kom an enjoi di muzik "Berit på Pynte".
title: Berit Skjefte

text:
Heidi Aklaseaq Senungetuk na Alaska wuman wey bi professor wey dey stodi how difren difren kolsho dey mek muzik an e stil bi muzishan. E na pikin of Ronald Senungetuk an Turid Senungetuk. Senungetuk stil bi gran-pikin of Helen and Willie Senungetuk. Na from [Wales, Alaska]] bi di orijin of e famili histri.
Senungetuk gro up in Fairbanks. E papa fom di Native Art Center an e stil bi di head of dipatmet of Akt at di  Yunivasiti of Alaska.

Na from  Wesleyan Yunivasiti Senungetuk tek du e Ph.D in "Ethnomusicology". Wetin e wok on for e Ph.D na how native pipul dey du muzik an dans in di siti aria wey de araund di Arctic

How e tek wok
Heidi Aklaseaq Senungetuk get e Bashelor an Masta digri from  Oberlin Kolej Konservetori of Muzik an di  Yunivasiti of Michigan Skul of Muzik. Na how to play an paform Violin e go rid.
Wen e din kolet e Ph.D satifiket in "Ethnomusicology" from Wesleyan Yunivasiti, e wok for  McGill Yunivasiti as di fest post-graduate risasha in lokal langwej. Na Senungetuk bi di fest skolar in  Yunivasiti of Alaska Archorage wey dey tish Alaska Native Stodis. Senungetuk dey tish "ethnomusicology" as assistat professor at di Yunivasiti of Alaska Anchorage.
Senungetuk get posishon at di Louisiana Philharmonic wey de New Orleans as pesin wey sabi play Violin. E stil get posishon in di Tulsa Philharmonic, in di Breckenridge Muzik Festiva in Colorado, in di Anchorage Symphony Orchestra.

Senungetuk don pafom yuzin di Violin in front of pipul at di "Inuit Artist's World Showcase" wey happun for Inukjuak in  Kanada. E stil don pafom at di  Nashonal Musium of di Amerika Indian wey de Washington, D.C in dia klasika siris. Senungetuk don pafom at di  Nashonal Gallery of Arts an for di  Amerika Musium of Nashoral Histri
title: Heidi Aklaseaq Senungetuk

text:
Peter Palmer Ekeh (dem bon am for August 8, 1937 and e kpai for November 17, 2020), wey pipo sabi as Peter Ekeh, na di lait Naija soshologist and univasiti tisha.

E bi profesor, di chairmo of di Dipatment of Politiko Sayens for di Univasiti of Ibadon (1978-1983) and di chairmo of di Ibadon Univasiti Pres (1983-1988). E bi di Presido and chairmo of di Urhobo Historiko Sosaiti, wey e stat for 1999 and becos of am "pipo go sabi Urhobo kolsho and histri mek e for nor los". Na im stat di Naija Skolas for Dailog. For 14 March 2023, Isaiah Ogedegbe tok say e si am as "one of Urhobo ogbonge skolas wey don show konsan about building im students and giving dem koret norlej of politiko sayens". Bifor nau, dem don konsida am as "iroko tree for di fid of politiko sayens and soshologi".
Dem sabi am evriwie as beta raita, wit meni koret buks and atikuls wey e rait. Him 1975 atikul: "Kolonialisim and di Two Pobliks for Afrika: A Theoretiko Stetment" na one of di most cited works for di fid of Afrikan, politiko and soshologiko studis for som univasitis all ova di world.
Dem rimemba am as a husband, papa, grandpapa, and skola.

text:
Françoise Robin ( dey bon am in 1968) na Tibet professor wey dey stodi Tibetan at Paris'  Nashonal Institute of Oriental Langwej (NALCO). For NALCO, e na espat in di langwej, sinima, an litireshon of Tibet. Na Robin stil bi di general seketri of di intanashonal Hasosiashon for Tibetan Stodis.

How e tek wok
E go don pass ova twenty times wey Robin don travul go di Himalayan rijion an Tibet. E yuz three month in Nepal in 1993.
Bikos of e risach, Robin stey for ten-month in Tibet in the year 1994. In 1999, Robin get e DEA from INALCO. Na Heather Stoddard supavise di Ph.D pepa wey Robin du in 2003. Di nem of Robin pepa wey e rait for e Ph.D na:"La littérature de fiction d’expression tibétaine au Tibet depuis 1950 : enjeux identitaires" ( "Fiction Literature of Tibetan Expression in Tibet after 1950: Identity Issues").

Leta, Robin bikom a professor at INALCO. Na Robin bi di daretor of di Institute of Tibetan Stodis at the College de France from 2009 to 2015). Na e dey kontro di Tibetan divishon of INALCO sins 2011. Robin stil bi di daretor of INALCO Dipatmet of Southeast Asia, Upper Asia an di Pasific from 2013 to 2014.

Na in 2002 Robin bi a memba of di Société  Asiatique an in 2007 till 2010, e bikom a memba of di  Hassosiashon for Asia Stodis. E stil enta as memba of di grup from 2017. Robin de among di pipul wey form SFEMT ( The French Society for Study of the Tibetan World) in 2012 an e wok as dia presidor onti 2016. Afta 2016, Robin wok as di grup vais-presidor. Robin still bikom pat of administrashon kansu of di  Intanashonal Hassosiashon for Tibetan Stodis in 2016. Na e bi di general seketri sins 2019.
Robin na hassosiate memba of di ''"Research Centre for East Asian Civilizations (CRCAO) at di  French Nashonal Senta for Sayentifik Risach
title: Françoise Robin

text:
Sophia Morrison (24 May 1859-14January 1917)na pesin wey dey fait for Manx Kolsho, dey rait an dey kolet Tradishonal biliv Stori an Kostom dem.
Bikos of hau do tins dem wey shi don do tek mek pipul laik Kolsho, me I pipul dey see am as pesin wey get maut wel-wel
among pipul wey mek Manx Kolsho get levul.
Pipul dey rimenba am bikos of di majik stori dem wey shi don rait for Manx, an wey shi poblish for 1911.Wwtin mek pipul know am wel-wel pas na bikos shi dey fait for Manx Kolsho an wit di wok dem wey shi do wit di Manx Langwej Sosaiti an di Journal wey shi kol Mannin, wey shi stat to dey koret from 1913 tili wen shi kpai.

Hau Shi Liv E Laif wen shi stil bi Smol-pikin
Dem bon Sophia Morrison for Reel Isle of Mau,as di nomba three pikin among di 9 pikin wey Charles Morrison(1824-80) an e wife Louisa(e papa nem na Crelin)(1830-1901) bon.
E papa na biznezman wey pipul respet wel-wel.E papa get plenti boat wey dem tek dey kol fish an na e  biud AtholStreet for Peel.
Wen dem kaunt pipul for 1881,dem tok sey na Sophia Morrison dey stay for nomba 7 Athol street,bot e bi like stay shi even dey stay wit anoda famili for nomba 15 for dat Athol street.
Na Clothworker skul for Peel naim Marrison go an shi stodi Muzik wit som of E famili dem frend  Edmund Goodwin.
Na Morrison bidi first pesin wey pas exam for Muzik for di Kolej for Trinity Kolej of Muzik an bikos of dis,dem giv am Awod.
Apat of wetin pipul know abaut am wen shi dey for Kolej araund 11 yia old ,
most of e Laif naim dem no know abaut.
Morrison stay for Ballig,nia On han so dat shi go dey fro dia go skul.
Shi stat to dey put mind for langwej na so shi dey Sabi Manx an French,Irish,Scottish, Gaelic, Italian an Spanish.
Sophia travul go Meni-meni ples like France, Brittany,Italian and Spanish.

Hau Shi do E Wok
Sophia Morrison put di whole of e Laif to dey keep Manx Kolsho for evei wia.
Wetin mek am put mind wel-wel for Manx Kolsho na bikos sey shi biliv say smol-smol pipul fit foget abaut Manx Kolsho.
Shi rekod plenti tins abaut Manx Olsho an shi dey ekorej Meni pipul to dey sopot Manx Kolsho, to dey rait abaut di Kolsho.
Shi try wel-wel ontop Tradishonal biliv,stori an Kostom dem plus Muzik, shi even mek pipul bogin to dey like enitin abaut Manx.
title: Sophia Morrison

text:
Yuki Kajiura ( dey bon am August 6, 1965) na Japan wuman wey bi muzik komposa an muzik produsa. Kajiura don mek meni muzik for meni babi film-dem an some of dem bi: Sword Art online, Puella Magi Madoka Magica, Fate/Zero, The Garden of Sinners, an Pandora Hearts.
As pesin wey sabi mek muzik, Kajiura way of mekin muzik dey difren to oda pipul bikos e sabi join nowadaz muzik wit eletronik muzik.

How e tek stat life
Na for Tokyo Japan dey bon Yuri Kajiura on August 6, 1965. Muzik don bi pat of Kajiura life sins 1972 as e dey folo go dey play di piano. Di wok wey Kajiura papa dey du mek dia famili pak go West Germany. Wen Kajiura bi seven years old, e rait e fest song wey di tahitu bi:"Thank you, Good-bye". Kajiura rait di song for e gra-mama to tel am gud-bye as Kajiura dey folo e famili komot for Japan.

Kajiura kom bak to Japan wen e de araund 12 to 13 years an dat time e de junior sekondri skul. Kajiura leta finish kolej in Japan. E wok as komputa Disahina onti 1992 bifor e stop di wok to faze mekin of muzik.
In 2002, one Japan muzik band kol See-Saw wok wit anoda Mashimo projet kol hack//Sign. Dorin di prodoshon of di projet, Kajiura mit Emily Bindiger. Emily Bandiger luv Kajiura voice wen e sing sotey e tok sey na Kajiura go pafom ova 10 of di song wey de projet.
Kajiura even tok wit play play sey na Emily Bindiger bi e Inglish tisha for one show wey bi Anime Expo in 2003.

One of di muzik projet wey Kajiura mek na FictionJunction. For "FictionJunction", e wok wit oda aktist like Yuuka Nanri, Asuka Kato, an Maori Oda. Di one wey Kajiura du wit Yuuka wey e kol FictionJunction Yuuka popular past.
In 2004, di two of dem, produs an arenj song for Kōichi Mashimo's Madlax. In 2005, dey du dia fest albom togeda wey dey give di nem: "Destination". 
Dey tok sey Yuri Kajiura go bi spesha guest for di pafomans of di Eminence Orchestra show in October 2007. Di nem of dat show na: "A Night in Fantasia 2007- Symphonic Anime Edition"
title: Yuki kajiura

text:
Kaia Gjendine Slålien ( dey bon am 1871 an e kpai 1972) na Norway wuman wey dey hep komot milk from cow an e sabi sing tradishonal muzik. Gjendine muzik dey swit Edvard Greig an e frend-dem we dey lisin to di song. Na in 1891 Edvard Greig an e frend fest go mit Gjendine at Skogadalsbøen wey e dey stey in Vestland. Greig an e frend go pass di road wey mountain full as dem dey go an kom to lisin to e song.
Grieg song "Gjendines bådnlåt" de pat of "Opus 66"19 Norwegian Folk Songs". As Gjendine dey grow old, na so pipul dey no am more more. Infat,  Kween Wilhelmina of di Netherland sef visit am. Wen Gjendine rish 90 years, dey kol am to kom Bergen Festival an for di festival e mit King Olav.

How e tek stat life
Na for Gjendebu wey de Bøverdai, Lom Municipality dey bon Kaia Gjendine Slålien. E na gel-pikin of Eirik A. Slålien (bon in 1829 an kpai in 1915) an e wife Anne Slålien ( e wife nem bifor marej na Syversdatter.Dey bon e wife 1837 an e kpai 1924). Gjendine papa na farma. Dey give am Gjendine bikos of dat is di nem of e famili land wey dey tek dey du agri-kolsho. Wen Gjendine dey 10 days old, Priest Honoratus Balling baptase am. Na Halvor Olsen Slålien e mari.Halvor Olsen Slålien na farma an pesin wey dey show pipul road as dem dey waka araund for di plaze. E hosband sabi play di violin veri wel wel.
Na Gjendine mama an e gra-pa tish am meni of di song wey e sabi sing.

How e tek wok as singa
As a young gel, Gjendine dey stet wit e papa for Gjendebu dorin di dry sisin an leta e go go di mountain side by e sef or folo pipul wey get farms for Skogadalsbøen. Na wen e bi 20 years old in 1891 e mit Edvard Grieg an e frend wey dey jos de waka abaut for di mountain side. Grieg frend-dem na Frants Beyer an di Holland komposa Julius Röntgen.
title: Gjendine Slålien

text:
Mary Winslow Smyth ( dey bon am March 26, 1873 an e kpai in 1937) na Amerika wuman wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way an e stil dey kolet tradishonal song-dem in di heli 20 senturi.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Bangor, Maine dey bon Mary Winslow Smyth on March 26, 1873. Smyth gra-pa na professor for  Bowdoin Kolej.Smyth mama kom from old-line  Bangor  an dorin dry sisin r sry stry Islesford, Maine. Smyth finish from  Smith Kolej in 1895. Na for 1897, Smyth kolet e Masta satifiket. Smyth get e Ph.D satifiket in Inglish from  Yale Yunivasiti in 1905. E stil wok as Hassosiate professor at  Elmira Kolej from 1922 to 1924.
E fest dey kolet an kip tradishonal song on e own bifor e kom join bodi wit Fannie Hardy Eckstorm. Fannie Hardy Eckstorm na pesin wey de stock an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way too.
Smyth join bodi wit Fannie Eckstorm to rait an rilis di 1927 buk " Minstrelsy of Maine: Folk-Songs and Ballads of the woods and the Coast". Smyth dey gada tradishonal song from pipul wey dey stey for wata-side. Half of di tins dem wey de inside di buk kom from di wata-side pipul-dem (E patna faze pipul wey dey cut wood an pipul wey no de wata-side)

Phillips Barry rili like di wok wey Smyth an Eckstorm dey du, an e wok wit dem. Dia sekod buk, "British Ballads from Maine: The  Development of Popular songs with Texts and Airs" (1929) add Barry as one of di editor. If sey di way all of dem tek wok bring beta risot, Smyth no too hapi sey dey add Barry as editor for di buk. E tok sey even if Barry wok for di buk, e wok for di buk no rish for dem to add am as editor, an sey na bikos of di big skul wey e go an bikos of e na man na e mek di poblisha of di buk add e nem.

Smyth sabi rekod an kip song an e na beta risasha. Wen e tok abaut e wok for one niuz-pepa kol Bangor Daily News, e tok abaut di hard wok, pasiens, an luck wey all of dem ( Smyth, Eckstorm)  put for dia wok to get beta risot. Akordin to Symth, e tok sey Meni pipul dey wonda if dey tok sey dey wan lisin an rekod dia old song. So Smyth an di odas nid to play wit dem fest, win dia trust bifor pipul go gri give or sing to dem.
title: Mary Winslow Smyth

text:
Ola Belle Reed (dey bon am August 18, 1916 an e kpai on August 16, 2002) na Amerika wuman wey dey sing Appalachian tradishonal muzik. E na song-raita an e sabi play di muzik instrumet wey bi like ginta kol banjo.

How e tek stat life
Na for Grassy Creek, Ashe County, North Carolina dey bon Reed on August 18, 1916. Di nem wey de e birth satifiket na Ola Wave Campbell. Reed papa nem na Arthur Campbell an e mama nem na Ellen Campbell (e mama nem bifor marej na Osborne). Reed na nomba four pikin out of di thirteen pikin-dem wey e peret bon.
Reed from smol sabi di clawhammer-style banjo as e dey play am wen e famili dey sing di old song wey pipul araund di montain aria dey sing. Reed mama famili-dem an Reed mama famili-dem too sabi di banjo instrumet wel wel. Reed gra-pa wey bon e mama wey e nem na Alexander Campbell sabi di violin wel. Reed papa sef sabi play violin, banjo, ginta, an organ wel too. Na Reed onku Dockery Campbell pipul biliv sey na e tish Reed how to play di "clawhammer-style banjo". From Reed mama side, Bob Ingraham dey tish for singin skul an e onku Herb Osborne sabi sing oda pipul song wel. Na Reed mama an gra-ma tish Reed how to sing song.

How e tek wok
Wen Reed don bi tineja, e famili pak go Souta Pennsylvania. In di mid-1930s, Reed join di "The North Carolina Ridge Runners". Leta, e fom a band kol "The New River Boys and Girls" wit e broda Alex Campbell. Alex Campbell leta go opun di "New River Ranch in Rising Sun in Maryland. Meni muzishan kom di ples kom pafom onto 1958 wen dey skata di ples. Dey leta bi di "House band" an dey kom dey oafom live sho at anoda muzik park  kol "Sunset Park" in West Grove, Pennsylvania.

Reed song dey always tok abaut life an tradishon of Appalachian pipul.Odas muzishan don ripit e song wey de popular. Del McCoury, Tim O'Brien, an Marty Stuart don sing one of e song wey de popular "High on the mountain". Del McCoury as wel as Tim O'Brien don sing anoda of e song "I've Endured". Dey nem one muzik grup wey de New York Ollabelle bikos of Reed.

Dem dey du one festival evri year Di "annual Ola Belle Reed Muzik Festival in [Lansing, North Carolina]] to honor Reed Reed life an muzik.
title: Ola Belle Reed

text:
Olajide Fashikun (dem bon am September 14, 1965 an e kpai January 27, 2019) wey pipul no wel wel as Olajide Ayodeji Fashikun, na di late Naija jonalis wey dem harest for November 2011 ova di tori wey e rait wey tok of koropshon wey dey hapun for the Naija Futbol Federashon.
Fashikun bi di bifor editor of di Nashona Akord Niuspepa and di poblisha of Gong News onti e kpai for January 2019. For 15 October 2019, Isaiah Ogedegbe tok beta tins abaut  Fashikun afta e kpai  and e kol Fashikun "a no-nonsense jonalis, a sports ripota wey nobody fit bribe".
Dem sabi Fashikun wel wel for di way e dey tok an fight mek magomago no dey Naija sports. Dem also sabi am as di persin wey stat di "Adopt an athlete" hidiya to helep upkoming athletes wit moni to go ogbonge kompitishons.

How e tek stat life
Na for Kaduna wey de Naija dem bon Olajide Fashikun on di 14 September, 1965.

E stat as all round sportsman wey pley futbol, handbol, volibol, basketbol and e win vitori for im kontri.

Fashikun pley handbol for Naija (1979-1999) wen e ritaya from intanashona dutis. E pley futbol for Zabgai of Bauchi (1984); El-Kanemi Wariors of Maiduguri (1985); Zamelek of Egypt (1986-1988) wen injuri mek am comot.

E bi Naija junior 200m wina and rekod hoda for 1979. E bi di yongest pleya for Naija handbol men nashona tim wey win di Afrikan Nashons Kup for 1979.

Medas
Fashikun don win gold meda at Afrikan Nashons Kup for Legos, Naija for 1980; gold meda at Afrikan Nashons Kup for Baushi, Naija for 1984; gold meda at NIPOGA for 1985 for Kaduna, Naija; bronze meda at Naija Univasitis Games Asosiashon (NUGA) for 1988 for Kalaba, Naija; gold meda at NUGA for 1998 for Kano, Naija.

Buk
Issues in Nigerian Social Work Administration

Posishons
E bi di bifor editor of di Nashona Akord Niuspepa, di sports editor of di Herald Niuspepa and di senior sports ripota of ThisDay Niuspepa. E bi also di managing editor of Gong News and pipo sabi am for im koret ripots. E don bi leshora bifor for di Kwara State Polytechnic and e na di bifor chairmo of di Sports Raitas Asosiashon of Naija, Kwara State rejon.

Fashikun bi di bifor daretor, Sports Development and Marketing wit di Naija Sports Development Fund Incorporated.

How e tek kpai an e beriha
Fashikun kpai one Sunday morning for 27 January 2019 for di Fedra Medkol Senta, Jabi for Abuja, Naija afta a brief siknes. E bi 54 years old.

Dem beri am for Wednesday, 30 January 2019 for di ples wie e kom fom, Obbo-Aiyegunle wey dey for Ekiti Loka Gofment Area of Kwara Stet, Naija. E dai leave im old mama, wife and four pikins.

For 25 March 2023, Isaiah Ogedegbe once again prez Fashikun for im atikul and e tok say, "E bi sports jonalis bifor wey bin give sports jonalisim a niu definishon, di man wit di acidik biro wey bin rait truth to pawa. E bin dey tok im mind evri taim, yuzing im ogbonge websait Gong Nius to expose wayo and koropshon".

text:
Sussane Rosenberg (dey bon am August 29, 1957) na Sweden wuman wey sabi sing tradishonal song. E na professor an risasha.
Sussane Rosenberg gro up outside Stockholm an e dey sing eni wia wey e see chans to sing sins heli 1980s. Na for  Royal Kolej of Muzik, Stockholm e to stodi for one paformas program in 1984 go rish 1988. For di skul, Rosenberg  don dey tish tradishonal muzik an e na professor sins 2006.
Bitwin 2004 go rish 2008, Na Rosenberg bi di head of Dipatmet of Folk Muzik.

How e tek wok
Rosenberg rid Musicology  in  Stockholm Yunivasiti from 1982 to 1984. E stodis na abaut how one patikula tradishonal singa dey yuz sing. E wok as tisha for  Sibelius Akademi in Helsinki from 1987 to 1991. Rosenberg tok abaut e risach wey e wan tek kolet e Ph.D satifiket wit di komitee wey dey give satifiket in  Royal Kolej of Muzik in Stockholm an di Sibelius Akademi wit e pepa: "Kurbits-ReBoot: Swedish Folk singing in a new artistic context".

Muzik karia
Rosenberg na one of di popular tradishonal muzishan wey kom from Sweden . E sabi yuz gud vois teknik dey sing baroque, jazz an nowadaz muzik. E stil dey wok as risasha, tisha, komposa, an raita.

Rosenberg de among di pipul wey no let tradishonal muzik song-dem no kpai as e dey risach dem an dey yuz am sing for e song. For 1990s, Rosenberg divelop meni sound in tradishonal singin in di group wey e fom "Folk Women's Choir" (1993-1996). E don rait song for some muzik group like "Pust'" (2000), "Stjärnan" (2013), "Miss a Vox Mundi" (2021)
In Sweden, Rosenberg don join bodi wit di komposa Karin Rehnqvist an du meni wey Rosenberg do like: "Puksänger-Lockrop" (1989), "Hrtluft" (1993), "Rädda mig ur dyn" (1997), "Sä gär en dag''" (2000). Rosenberg don also join bodi wit some daretor like Peter Oskarsson ( Den Agora Vreden, 1988-1990) an Leif Stinnerborn ("Ljuset" 1996).
title: Susanne Rosenberg

text:
Patricia Lysaght ( dey bon am in 1948]] na Ireland wuman wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Lysaght na Professor Emerita of European Ethnology,  Yunivasiti Kolej, Dublin in Ireland.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for County Flare dey bon Patricia Lysaght. Lysaght fest dey rid law bifor e kom chenj to ridin Ireland Langwej an Litirashun, an European Folklore an Ethnology. Lysaght finish e Ph.D at di Nashonal Yunivasiti of Ireland in 1982.

How e tek wok
Lysaght poblish one buk in 1985 wit di nem The banshee: a study in belief and legends about the Irish supernatural death-messenger. E poblish di buk base on e Ph.D Pepa wey e rait. One pesin wey check di buk tok sey na beta buk for Ireland tradishonal tori an intanashonal tradishonal tori stodis.
For di time wey Lysaght don wok, e don rait ten buks an rait ova one hundered hatikuls.
Di risach wok wey Lysaght dey rait na abaut tradishonal majik tori of Ireland an on Ireland food an how Ireland pipuk dey produs dem.
Na Lysaght bi di presidor of di International for Ethnology Folklore's Working Group on Food Research. Lysaght don wok as Editor of both Folklore ( Jonal of di Folklores Sosaheti, London) an Béaloideas (Jonal of di Folklore of Ireland Sosaheti, Dublin).

Awod-dem
Lysaght don get meni skolaship an visitin professor at a nomba of intanashonal Yunivasiti an Institute like Westfälishe Wilhelms-Universität, Münster, an di Russian Akademi of Sayens, wey de Moscow.

Dey chuz Lysaght as memba of di  Royal Irish Akademi in 2006. E stil bi memba of di Royal Gustavus Adolphus Aka demi for Swedish Folk Kolsho. Di Akademi give am di Torsten Janckes minnesfond prize awod for di way e tek wok in Folkloristic an Ethnological Scholarship in to 2013. Lysaght stil kolet di Coote Lake Medal of the Folklore Society for di beta wok wey e du in risach an skolaship.

Frances Densmore (May 21,1867-June5,1957)na one Amerika pesin wey stodi wia  pipul kom from an Dia orijin, an shi stodi hau to tok abaut pipul an Dia Kolsho.Dem bon am for Red Wing, Minnesota.
Pipul know say Densmore stodi Amerika Native Muzik an Kolsho an we fit kol am pesin wey stodi difren-difren pipul Muzik an hau Dem rezembul demsef

Tori abaut E Laif
Wen shi stil bi smol-pikin, shi stat to dey laik Dakota pipul Muzik dem.
Shi yuz 3yias to stodi Muzik for Oberlin Kolej.Wen shi stil dey skul wen twenty senturi jus stat, shi wok as Muzik Tisha wit Native Americans Nationwide, an as shi dey learn , shi dey rekod, an dey dey rait dia Muzik an even dey rait abaut hau Dem fit yuz am inside dia Kolsho to mek American Native dem stat WesternKostom dem.
title: Frances Densmore

text:
Tejaswini Niranjana (dey bon am July 26, 1958) na Indian professor. E dey stock difren kolsho, dey translet an e dey rait buk. Pioul sabi Niranjana wel wel bikos e don add nolej to  kolsho stodis,  gender stodis,  translashon, an ethnomusicology ( na di one of Indian muzik e rait pass). E papa nem na Kulakunda Shiva Rao but pipul sabi am as Niranjana an e mama nem na Anupama Niranjana. Niranjana papa na dey rait film an also buks an e mama sef dey rait buk. Niranjana hosband na Ashish Rajadhyaksha wey bi raita an pesin wey dey stodi kolsho of pipul.

In 2021, dey give Tejaswini Niranjana one awod wey bi American Literacy Translators Association Prize for prose fiction Translashon. Na one buk kol No Presents Please a Jayant Kaikini rait. Di buk na smol smol tori wey tok abaut abaut Mumbai siti. Di buk No Present Please till kolet di DSC Prize for South Asian Literature 2018 in 2019. Dey tok sey na Niranjana an Jayant Kaikini get di awod togeda.

Na Niranjana stil get di 2018 Humanities and Social Sciences Prestigious Fellowship, Research Grants Council, Hong Kong. Na e stil kolet di Karnataka Sahitya Aka demi Award for Best Translashon of 1994.
Wetin dey tek no Niranjana pass na wetin e rait abaut how govamet of oda kontri go wan dey kontro anoda kontri an translashon, e raitin abaut wetin wuman dey sofa an di "kweshon kolsho" in India. Pipul stil no am for e risach on muzik ( patikula muzik wey kom from Karibian, Hindustani klasika muzik, an Indian-China kolabo).

Niranjana get Masta digre in Inglish an "Aesthetics" from di  Yunivasiti of Bombay. E get a MPhil in Linguistics'' from di  Yunivasiti of Pune, an a Ph.D from di  Yunivasiti of Kalifornia, Los Angeles.

Niranjana dey among di pipul wey fom an e stil bi sinior fello at di Center for Study of Culture and Society, Bangalore.
title: Tejaswini Niranjana

text:
Tolulope Arotile, (dem bon am for Disemba 13, 1995 and shi kpai for July 14, 2020), wey pipo sabi as Tolulope Oluwatoyin Sarah Arotile, na di lait Naija fest wuman faita helikopta pilot for di Naija Air Force.
Dem sabi am as persin wey fait against insekuriti for di northern stets of Naija.
For 29 July 2020, Isaiah Ogedegbe prez Arotile for im tribot and e kol am "a young, brilliant, and brave lady wit a promising future".

Birth, edukeshon and kariha
Na Mr and Mrs Akintunde Arotile bin bon Tolulope Arotile for Kaduna, Naija for 13 Disemba 1995, but shi kom fom di Iffe area for Ijumu Lokal Gofment Area of Kogi Stet, Naija.

Shi bin atend Air Force Primari Skul, Kaduna fom 2000 rish 2005 and Air Force Sekondari Skul, Kaduna fom 2006 rish 2011 bifor shi leta gain admishon into di Naija Difens Akademi, Kaduna as a memba of 64 Regula Kos for 22 Septemba 2012, wie shi get Bashilor digre for Matimatis.

Arotile bin tok say shi join di militari bicos of ha luv for di militari. Shi also bin tok say to bi a militari ofisa na ha long taim drim.

Dem komishon am into di Naija Airforce for 16 Septemba 2017 as a memba of di Naija Difens Akademi Regula Kos 64.

Shi bin hold a komesha pilot license and also patek for tactika flying training for di Agusta 109 Pawa Atak Helikopta for Itali.

For Oktoba 2019, di Naija Air Force bin dekoret am as di fest wuman pilot wey di service go get in 55 years.

Dai and beriha
For 14 July 2020, les dan eight months since ha dekoreshon, Tolulope Arotile kpai at di age of 24 for Kaduna, Naija. Di Naija Presido, di NAF, and di Naija pipo bin show konsan abaut ha dai and di cos of ha dai na bicos shi injor for ha head wen one moto jam ha.

Dem beri ha for 23 July 2020. Dem rimemba am as a gud wuman wey for impact di laif of meni young Naija gels and wumen for di future.

text:
Francisca Oboh Ikuenobi e dey stodi hau to kontrol water an hau di earth go beta, na fom Ubiaja in Esan South East lokal govmet of Edo noStet|State Shi sabi hau plant dey gro an wetin dey mek am no gro, an na professor of Geology in Department of Geosciences an Geological an petroleum Engineering, shi bi Associate Dean of Academic Affairs in College of Engineering and Computing, Missouri University of Science and Technology.

Hau e tek stat wok an skol
Oboh-Ikuenobi go Gorretti Girls Grammar School Benin City, Nigeria. Shi get fest klas BSc in geology in 1983. Afta dat one shi wok as production geologist for Shell Production Development Company of Nigeria in Lagos, an pesin wey dey stodi wota an dust wit Shell for dia Laboratory in Warri Delta State, bifor e go bak to skul for im MSc in applied geology in 1987, fom Univasiti of Ife Nigeria (wey Kon bi Obafemi Awolowo Univasiti now).  Afta shi kolet MSc shi dey hep lecturer for Ife Univasiti. Dem giv am  Commonwealth Scholarship Commission awod bikos of hau shi tek wok for Department of Health Sciences, Univasiti of Cambridge ( New Hall, nau Murray Edwards College), wey dem giv am di awod for 1991 wit im thesis 'Palaeoenvironmental Reconstruction of di E2.0 Reservior in di Kolo Creed field, Niger Delta (Nigeria)', shi join Missouri S&T, afta dat one Department of Geology an Geoohysics in 1991 as person wey dey hep profesor in geology.

Hau e tek du ofis wok
In 1997 Oboh- Ikuenobe bi di associate profesor of geology, in 2005 full Professor an oga for program in geology an geophysics fom 2006 to 2014. Na shi bi dey as chair persin for smol tim for department fom January 2015 to July 2017, na shi bi associate dean for academic wok in di college of Engineering an Computing an na shi don wok for Shipboard Sedimenlogist on di Ocean Drilling program (Leg 159 Eastern Equitorial Atlantic Transform Margin) January to February 1995. Insaid som ofis shi bi president, president an foma president of di AASP (Di Palynological Society), fom 2010 to 2013, memba for Geological Society of America.Shi dey for insaid som pipu wey gada dey stodi hau dey earth dey chenj fom 2012 to 2015, na director for Association for women wey dey  stodi hau earth dey chenj, shi e dey insaid pipu wey dey chek wetin oda pipul rait for di Journal of Africa Earth Science sins 2019.  In 2010 an 2011 shi bi wok shop oga for 'On Cutting Edge',  na wetin dem plan to dey uze gada an tok abaut earth mata wit memba wey  dey stodi hau d earth dey chenj, wey National Association of Geoscience Teachers sopot an National Science Foundation sef uze moni sopot dem, sins 2013 shi bi memba of International Geoscience programme (IGCP).
title: Francisca Oboh-Ikuenobe

text:
Di way  Weyda dey chenj dey hafet hanima wey de waka for graund an di one wey de inside wota, Oda tins wey di weyda wey de chenj evritime dey hafet na tundra, Mangroves,  Koral reef an Caves. As evriwie just de hot, as sea level jost dey rise show sey we don dey see di efet of weyda wey just de chenj enihow. Bikos of weyda wey de chenj enihow, di one fit mek some plant or hanimal no dey again, mek di way hanima an plant dey tek kopurate no de again, mek we dey see some hanimal or plant for aria wey de no sopos de, mek forest no dey again, mek levu of hasid wey de sea an ocean go up, mek rain dey fall enihow an mek nashora katakata jost dey hapun.

Di full Tori
Di way weyda de chenj dey hafet evriwie wey we fit find livin tins. Di hol wold don dey hot pass bifor an dis one dey mek some hanima to komot from wey dem dey stey go oda
Ples (some wey no fit go oda ples don kpai).
One ezampul na how bird dey move abaut. Bikos di weyda dey hot more more, bird nid to go oda ples wey fit di kondishon wey de fit live. Bikos di weyda dey hot more more, snow no too dey fall like bifor again, di levul wey sea di rish don go up wel wel. Di tin wey dey kova di earth mek sunshine to too much wey Oyinbo dey kol "ozone" no too strong as bifor an weyda sef no bi like bifor. All dis tins fit hafet how man set dey du tins for the earth an how plant an hanima dey du tins togeda.
From di IPCC Fourth Assessment Report, Pipul wey sabi weyda tins chenj litireshon buk on how weyda wey dey chenj dey hafet plant an hanima, tok sey inside di 30 years wey jos pass, wetin human bein dey du don dey hafet di earth an life wey de inside am. (Rosenzweig et al (2007) )
Schneider as oda pipul wey hep as tok sey di way evriwie dey hot more more don hafet some hanima an di relashoship bitwin plant an hanima. Dey even tok sey di wey weyda dey chenj more more go mek some hanima to kpai patapata an di nomba of difren difren hanima an plant go ridus wel wel for di wold.
title: Effect of Climate Change on Ecosystem

text:
Di way klimet or weyda dey chenj enihow dey hafet fish in meni aria: If Ocean wota hot smol pass as e sopos bi, e go hafet all di fish-dem wey de inside di wota an di plant inside am. If di acid levu wey wota sopos get chenj, e go hafet livin tins inside di wota. Klimet chenj dey hafet di way wota dey flow an e dey mek wie pipul fit find fish we  hard. Klimet chenj dey hafet difren fish in difren way. Klimet chenj dey mek wey we fit find fish inside wota dey chenj an how fish dey produs pikin inside wota. In fact, di way klimet dey chenj  go soon hafet how meni fish de inside wota an how fish bizness go bi. Kontri wey bi sey na onli fish bizness dey tek dey chop go find am veri hard to live. Di nomba of fish wey kontri wey dia weyda dey hot like South Pacific rijion go fit katch go dey low bikos of klimet chenj.

Klimet chenj go hafet fish bizness an eni bizness wey na wota hanima bi di tin wey dem dey sell. Dis one go hard komuniti wey put hope on dis bizness to live. Big wota like sea or Ocean dey hep mek carbon (smoke wey dey kom from fiya) no too plenti as dem dey hol-am mek e no too plenti for di wold, but klimet chenj dey mek am hard for di sea to du am nowadaz.
Klimet chenj don mek di way rain dey fall dey chenj an dis one dey hafet wota wey de side riva an inside fish pond-dem.
Di wey evriwie de ova hot don mek di wota levu ova go up an dis one don mek flood de hapun, disis don plenti an weed full evriwie. Dis one fit korse mek buildin skata an mek prodoshon ridus wel wel.
title: Climate Change and fisheries

text:
Di way human bein dey du tins dey mek di Wold or Earth dey hot more more an oyinbo pipul dey kol dis tin Greenhouse gas emmision. Dis hativitis dey korse klimet chenj. Di mejo tin wey dey korse mek di wold dey hot more more na as one gas wey bi Carbon dioxide wey dey komot wen dey put faya on somtin. Wen pesin yuz Coal, petirol an gas to put faya to somtin, dis Carbon dioxide gas dey always komot enta breeze. Di kontri wey dey burn or rilis dis gas pass na China bikos dey too dey yuz Coal. Odas tins wey dey mek Carbon dioxide plenti na pipul wey dey yuz plenti oil an gas du tins.
Anoda tins wey dey mek Carbon dioxide gas plenti na how pipul dey get  heletrisiti or light. One hoganizashon wey dey tok abaut am  di United States Environmental Protection Agency tok sey to dey transpot light from one ples to anoda mek up of 27 pacent of greenhouse gas emmison in USA. As pipul dey not down tress an dey levul forest an bush dey mek di hafet of greenhouse effect plenti more an more bikos anoda gas kol methane dey folo enta breeze too. 
Some kontena wey get all dis gas fit dey lik an Dis one sef dey hafet di klimet chenj. Somtim, Agrikolshoral pratis like to dey dig graund an di kind fataliza wey pipul dey yuz fit rilis gas like methane or nitrous oxide to di air. Air kondishon an fridge sef fit inkreas di Kliment chenj bikos som gas like fluorine fit get dia way enta air.
title: Greenhouse gas emission

text:
Na three levul of govamet dey kontro how pipul dey get wota for Naija. Dem bi:
  Fediral govamet of Naija
  Stet govamet
  lokal govamet
Fediral govamet dey kontro all di ples wey wota fit kom out. Stet govamet dey kontro how pipul wey dey stay siti for fit get wota wey dey nid. Lokal govamet dey kontro how pipul for vilej go tek get wota. For Naija, pipul no sabi di one of di three govamet wey dey in kontro sey mek di wota de klin.
In Naija, di kwuliti of wota wey wota korporashon dey give pipul o too gud an di moni wey di korporashon dey risiv bak from it de smol. Even sef di moni wey pipul sopos to pay for getin wota smol, pipul stil no dey pay di moni. Na onli wey assistans wey di korporashon dey get dey mek dem kontiniu bizness.

Nashonal polisi in Naija gri mek kompini an enibodi fit join for bi bizness of wota biziness in Naija.

How Naija pipul fit get wota
For araund 2015 in Naija, 67 pacent of pipul wey de di kontro fit get di wota wey dey nid. For siti, na 82 pacent of pipul fit get wota wey dey nid an for vilej di nomba na 54 pacent.
Meni pipul in Naija no get klin wota espesiali di pipul wey dey stay for vilej. For wetin di global wota saniteshon an hijenik statistics show, 79 pacent of Naija pipul dey find am hard to get wota. In 2015, na abaut 60 million Naija pipul no fit wota to yuz. For wota wey klin, na onli 33 pacent of Naija pipul get wota wey klin. For Siti-dem na abaut 39 pacent an for vilej-dem na abaut 27 pacent. In Naija as hol, e go rish 122 million pipul wey no get wota wey klin.
title: Water Supply and sanitation in Nigeria

text:
Di Urhobo pipul na one etnik grup for Saut area of Naija for Delta Stet. Dem bi one of di etnik grup wey plenti pas for Delta Stet. Dem dey spik di Urhobo langwej.

Ogbonge pipul
Justus Esiri, aktor
Kefee, gospo singa and komposa
Peter Palmer Ekeh, soshologist and univasiti tisha
Real Warri Pikin, komendia

Lokeshon
Profesor Peter Palmer Ekeh, Fanda of Urhobo Historiko Sosaiti, leta rait for im buk: Studis for Urhobo Kolsho, say "Urhobo fisikali tanda for di Atlantik forest belt wey stretch fom Senegal for West Afrika rish Angola for sentra Afrika. Historikali, dis rijon na di most orijina for all of Afrika. Until di Portuguese waka enta im teritris for di late fiftinth senturi, im forest pipos bin grow dia own foms of civilizeshon, outside influences nor touch am. Dis forest belt of western Afrika, old Christian influences wey spread for North Afrika nor touch am, not even Islamic forces wey kom as far saut as Hausaland for di eleventh senturi. Doh Asian and Arab influences wey kom fom akros di Indian Ocean bin touch East Afrika and even Sentra Afrika, as di mixture of Swahili langwej prove, yet no simila trans-Atlantik influences rish di forest belt until di Portuguese waka kom for di late fiftinth senturi".

Marenj
Bifor pipo tok say dem do marenj propali for Urhobo kolsho, dem must don pray to di ancestors (Erivwin) and God (Oghene). Di bride papa go say a praya and blesin wit di netif langwej for di kopo.

At dis point, di bride go sidon for di husband lap. Dem go give di blessed drink to di husband who go drink fest; den he go give am to im wife to drink. Di wife go drink and pass am back to ha husband to finish, as a sign of respect. Na dat taim pipo fit kol dem husband and wife.

Eucharia Oluchi Nwaichi na Naija sayentis wey dey yuz di nolej of biology to protet an save di henvaromet. (Environmental Biochemist). E stil bi sayentis wey dey stodi graund or soil. (Soil Scientist) an a sayentis wey dey stodi di way kemikas dey hafet livin tins (Toxicologist). 

Nwaichi risach aria na how to manej tins wey don waste, how to mek suo sey polushon no de an how to yuz plant or livin tins tek klin up di henvaromet mekin suo sey kontamineted matiriha no dey di soil again.

How e tek go skul an wok
Nwaichi get B.Sc., M.Sc an Ph.D satifiket in Biochemistry from  Yunivasiti of Port Harcourt. E leta bikom a sinior leshura in dat yunivasiti. Bifor e stat to dey tish for Yunivasiti of Port Harcourt, Nwaichi don wok for Shell Oil Kompini for one year (2009-2010).
Dey mek Nwaichi intanashonal felo at di 2013 L'Oréal-UNESCO Awod in Sayens. E bi memba of meni akademik hoganasashon  Hoganasashon for di Women in Sayens for di Divelopin Wold,  Amerika Kemikal Sosaheti,  Intanashonal Phytotechnology Sosaheti, Intanashonal Sosaheti For Henvaromenta Teknoloji,  Sosaheti for Functional Fud an Biohative Kompaund an di Nigerian Institute of Management.

In 2022, Nwaichi kolet di John Maddox Prize awod.
title: Eucharia Oluchi Nwaichi

text:
'Nana Ama Browne Klutse (dey bon am for 23, May 1981) na Ghana leshura an Sayentis wey dey stodi klimet or how weyda kondishon de chenj ova a long piriod of time.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na Nyanfeku Ekroful dey tek bon Nana Ana Browne Klutse on 23 May 1981. Klutse go Anomabo Methodish pamari and JHS for e pamari skul. E go Mfantsiman Girl Secondary Skul an leta  Yunivasiti of Cape Coast in Ghana. For yunivasiti, Klutse get B.Sc Physics.
Dr Klutse du e Ph.D in Climatology for  Yunivasiti of Cape Town wey de South Afrika.
How e tek wok
Dr Klutse stodi how klimet or weyda kondishon dey chenj in West Afrika. E stodi na abaut how di dareshon of breeze dey hafet renin sisin an dry sisin. Dr Klutse bi di sinior leshura at di Dipatmet of Physics in  Yunivasiti of Ghana. Bifor bifor, na Dr Klutse bi di oga for one senta kol "Remote Sensing and Climate Center". Kluse bi memba of Klimet Sayens Felo of di African Institute for Mathematical Sciences an e na lid raita wey dey rait inside IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6). Klutse stil dey hep mek meni gel-pikin join bi sayentis in Ghana as e dey sopot sayens edukeshon in di kontri.
From 2016 go rish 2018, Klutse wok for "Ghana Space Science and Technology Institute" of di  Ghana Hatomik Henagi Kommishon as dia sinior risasha . Bifor dis wok, e don bi visitin leshura at di "West African Science Service Centre on Climate and Adapted Land Use''" (WASCAL) in Akure inside Naija.

How e tek put hand inside politis
Klutse na memba of di  Nashonal Demokratik Congress.

text:
Margaret Adebisi Sowunmi (dey bon am September 24, 1939) na Naija wuman wey dey stodi plant (botanist) an e stil dey stodi how wetin human bein dey du don hafet di envaromet (environmental archaeologist). Sowunmi nem bifor e mari na Jadesimi.
Sowunmi bi professor of Palynology an Environmental Archaeology at di  Yunivasiti of Ibadan.
Na Sowunmi stat di mek pipul dey stodi how human hativiti don hafet di envaromet an di stodi of how old old plant wey don kpai don hafet man from wetin rimain of di plant (Paleoethnobotany) in Naija. Di pesin wey fom an stil bi presidor of Palynological  Association of Nigeria bi Sowunmi.

How e tek stat life
Na for Kano wey de Norta Naija dey tek bon Margaret Adebisi Sowunmi on September 24, 1939. Sowunmi papa na pasto of Church of Nigeria. E du e sekondri skul for  St Anne Skul, Ibadan an leta kolet e B.Sc satifiket in spesha Botany for di Dipatmet of Botany at Yunivasiti of Ibadan. Na 1962 e kolet e B.Sc  satifiket in Botany.
In 1963, Sowunmi get chans to go du e Ph.D in Palynology wen e risiv skolaship.
Bikos of dis one, E go Sweden to stodis with Gunnar Erdtman wey bi e supavaso. Na for 1967 e get e Ph.D satifiket in Botany at Yunivasiti of Ibadan.

How e tek wok
Sowunmi wok as a leshura wey don get Ph.D to risach at di "Archaeology Unit" for Institute of Afrika Stodis wey de Yunivasiti of Ibadan in 1967. Na Sowunmi di Naijiria Yunivasiti "Palynology" Laboratori in 1971. E bikom professo of "Palynology an "Environmental Archaeology" in 1982.
Dorin Sowunmi wok as leshura, e don go meni hiya skul as visitin leshura. Some of di skul wey e don go as visitin leshura na: di Dipatmet of "African Archaeology",  Uppasala Yunivasiti in 1997, di Institute of Archaeology, Yunivasiti Kolej London, an di Dipatmet of " African Archaeology and African Archaeobotany", Johann Wolfgang Goethe-Universität.
Wen e dey wok, e supavase seven studet for dia Ph.D satifiket an pipul sabi am as beta tisha wey sabi enkoraj e studet.
Sowunmi don wok on mata wey konsain wuman in "Archaeology" in Naija an infat, e don hep chenj somtins for some yunivasiti korse taitu wey tok abaut men for skuls.

Na Sowunmi bi di fonda an presidor of Palynological Association of Nigeria an e stil bi presidor of West African Archaeological Association.

Na in 2004 Sowunmi ritaya.

E risach wok
Sowunmi don du big tins dorin e risach wey oda pipul neva du bifor an dey bi:
 Na Sowunmi bi di fest pesin to risach "Identifications of Age and Paleoenvironment of the Gwandu Formation".
 Na Sowunmi bi di fest pesin to risach " the first descriptions of Eocene pollen of the Ogwashi-Asaba Formation."
 Na Sowunmi bi di fest pesin to du "stodi of Late Quaternary vegetatation and environmental history of Nigeria"
 Na Sowunmi bi di fest pesin to stodi "pollen from an archaeological site in Nigeria.
 Some of e wok wey e don poblish

text:
Di way klimet or weyda dey chenj dey hafet di way fish an oda wota hanima-dem dey produs for wota: Bikos weyda jos dey chenj enihow, e dey hafet di hasosiashon wey wota hanima get wit plant wey de inside big  wota wey dem dey chop. Wetin dey korse dis one bi sey klimet chenj dey mek big big wota-dem dey hot pass norma, dey mek wota dey taste as if e sawa, an e dey ridus di "air" or hosijin wey de inside wota wey fish an oda  wota hanima dey yuz.
Klimet chenj stil dey hafet smol smol wota-dem like riva, pond, lakes, an wota wey de inside graund too.
title: Fisheris and Climate Change

text:
Wetin Klimet (or weyda) wey dey chenj dey korse for big big wota-dem like Ocean or sea plenti wel wel. Dem bi:
 Ocean dey hot pass bifor
 Ocen hacid levu don go up.
 di levu of wota wey de ocean don go up
 Ice-blok wey de inside ocean wota dey melt kwik-kwik
 Chenj in how dip ocean dip rish.
 ridus di levu of Oxygen gas inside ocean.
 chenj di way wota dey flow for ocean.
All dis chenj dey hafet livin tins wey de inside dos big wota-dem. Di tins wey dey korse dis tin na bikos di earth don dey hot pass as e bi bifor bikos of all di tins wey human-bi dey du. Ezampul of wetin human-bi dey du na to dey rilis one air wey oyinbo dey kol "Carbon dioxide" an anoda gas na " Methane". Bikos na di ocean dey kolet all dis gas wey man dey rilis inside di earth, dis one mek ocean wota dey hot pass bifor. Carbon dioxide gas fit bi hacid if e enta wota, dis one dey mek ocean wota hacid levu for ocean wota dey hi.
Pipul tok sey ocean dey kolet 25% of carbon dioxide wey human-bi dey rilis to di sorandin.
Evribodi no sey ocean get difren difren leya as di way one ples inside ocean dip pass anoda ples. As ocean tempurashon dey hi more more, dis one dey mek di pat of ocean wey near outside dey hot. Dis na bikos di breeze wey dey kom ocean dey hot more more.If ocean kolet di hot breeze wey dey kom from land, e go give land e own kul breeze Dis one wey difren leya of di ocean dey hot more more, e dey ridus how di ocean sopos kolet hot breeze wey dey kom from land an dis one dey mek land breeze sef dey hot more more sins ocean no gri kolet di breeze. 
If hot breeze dey enta ocean more more, e dey give heavi breeze wey dem dey kol "cyclones" more pawa. Dis heavi breeze an di oda ones wey dey skata tins go dey plenti more more bikos of klimet chenj. Di fud wey fish wey de nia on top ocean no go si fud chop again bikos na di more ocean kolet "carbon" for bodi, na di more fish go get fud to chop. As ocean tempurashon dey hot more more na so di levu of salt inside wota go inkres an na so smol wota like riva go dey get smol smol salt.

Wota wey don hot no fit get di sem levu of hosijin gas wey wota wey kulee or cold go get. Dis kulee wota dey get more hosijin pass hot wota.
Sins klimet chenj dey mek ocean hot more more, hosinji wey fish wota nid to fit dey alive dey ridus an dis one dey mek some fish kpai an some fish fit go just waka go aria wey dem no sopos de if not bikos of klimet chenj.
title: Effect of climate change on oceans

Dore Numa College na sekondri skul wey gofment get for Warri, Delta Stet,  Naija.

Di skul na day skul wey dem nem afta Chief Dore Numa.
Di skul stat for October 1980 to give sekondri skul edukeshon for pikin-dem for di aria. Di skul motto na "Hardwork Is Success".

For June 2013, during di administreshon of Gofnor Emmanuel Uduaghan, Dore Numa College na one of di skuls wey di Delta Stet Gofnor bin inspect, who bin kondem distroshon of gofment propatis for di niuli konstructed skuls.

For December 2021, one  tori tok sey one sekrit cult gbege hapun bitwin som Dore Numa College studet and oda studet wey kom from difren skuls for di aria.
A gel-studet wey dey go Dore Numa College wey e nem bi Sharon Taiwo don bikom a victim of human trafficking and di wife of di Delta Stet Gofnor, Mrs. Dame Edith Okowa bin hep am wit som moni.

Dore Numa College na also one of di skuls wey bin benefit fom Gofnor Ifeanyi Okowa's school fonishor "in prepareshon for di reopuning of skuls closed due to di COVID-19 pandemic".

Klimet chenj hajosmet na di way to hajos to wetin dey or wetin fit hapun bikos of klimet chenj. For human-bi, hajosmet to klimet chenj mins to lowa or kip away from wetin klimet chenj fit korse. Di tin stil inklud how human-bi fit find oda hopotuniti to hep nashora sistem. 
Wetin human-bi dey du for klimet chenj fit bi wetin dem dey du to mainten di nashora sistem or wetin dem du to hep nashora sistem bikos of klimet chenj.

Wetin human-bi nid to du bikos of klimet chenj difren from one aria to anoda. Dis tin dipen on how wetin dey wan du fit hafet odas human-bi wey dey di aria an how wetin dey wan du fit hafet plant an hanima wey dey di ples.
Na four katigori we fit put all di wok wey we dey du to hajos to klimet chenj. Dem bi:
 to dey yuz instrumet an teknoloji fight klimet chenj
 to dey yuz hoganazeshon fight klimet chenj
 to dey yuz how human-bi dey du tins an di kolsho of human-bi fight klimet chenj
  to dey yuz nashoral tins araund us fight klimet chenj.
Na Divelopin kontris like Naijiria dey always sofa di hafet of klimet chenj. Di way human-bi fit hajos to klimet chenj no bi di sem mentod among difren aria an difren populeshon an pipul wey dey stey for divelopin kontris no too get di pawa to hajos to am. To hajos to klimet chenj beta, pesin nid mek di kommuniti wey e de gud an ondastand wetin dey go on an mek ekonomik of di aria beta wel wel to fit sopot how e wan tek hajos to klimet chenj.

Di tin bi sey, di more divelop a kontri bi, di more e go fit hajos to klimet chenj wey dey hapun. Somtimes, som pipul wey de som divelop kontri sef fit get som kind karatas wey fit mek am difikut for dem to fit hajos to klimet chenj. Even som divelop kontri stil fit find am difikut to hajos to niu tins wey klimet chenj dey korse wey dey neva si bifor in dia kontri.

Di moni wey dey go for hajosmet to klimet chenj no bi smol. E dey rish billion of dolla evri year for di nes years to kom.
title: Climate change adaptation

Prime 9ja Online na Naija niuz-pepa wey you fit si onli for intanet. Na Edo Stet inside Naija dia ofis de. Prime 9ja online dey tok tori abaut politis, bizness, entatemet, sport, an meni oda tins provide tori and analysis on top politics, business, entertainment, sport an meni oda tins. Na Chima Joseph Ugo stat di niuz-pepa for intanet in 2016. Chima Joseph Ugo stat di niuz-pepa bikos e tok sey e wan dey give Afrika an Naija pipul koret niuz wey no get magomago.

History 
Prime 9ja Online na one online niuz an midiha websait wey Chima Joseph Ugo fom for 2016 wey get dia ofis for Okada, Edo, Naija. 

For June 2022, Stamp Nigeria nem Prime 9ja Online amongst di 19 niuz-pepa wey pipul don dey sabi wel wel for Naija. 

Na for March 2023 dey stat di niuz wey dey yuz pijin langwej du for di niuz-pepa.

For December 2022, Media Bias/Fact Check nem Prime 9ja Online as di niuz-pepa wey tek tok as mata bi an sey di pepa no dey tok magomago for all di pepa wey dey chuk eye into. Na onli Prime 9ja Online bi di niuz-pepa wey Media Bias/Fact Check don rate like dat so far for Naija.

Pidgin Version 
Afta wey Prime 9ja online don get dia niuz wey dem dey rait for koret English langwej, dey stat di niuz wey na pijin langwej dey wan dey yuz rait. Prime 9ja Online Pidgin. The aim na to reach out to more Nigerians wey fit understand Pidgin English better than Standard English. Dey stat di pijin vashon bikos dey wan mek meni pipul wey fit no ondastand koret english fit dey get niuz for di langwej wey dem ondastand.

Wetin klimet chenj or weyda wey dey chenj for di wold dey korse plenti wel wel. Weyda wey dey chenj dey hafet envaromet, dey hafet how plant an hanimal dey sopot one anoda to fit live, an dey hafet human-bi sosaheti too. Di hafet of weyda wey jos dey chenj dey hafet diften aria pass oda aria in difren ways. 
For som aria, klimet chenj fit mek di aria hot pass nomal, an for oda aria e fit mek di aria kul pass nomal.
We fit ridus di hafet of klimet chenj if we do tins wey fit stop di klimet chenj or we do tins to hajos wit di chenj.

Klimet chenj don damej meni land as e don mek di land hot pass nomal bikos of tempurashon wey jos dey high more more. Dis tempurashon wey dey go up don mek land no too get wota for graund ( too dry) an klimet chenj don also mek di way bush an forest dey kach faya plenti more more. Di way evriwie dey hot nowadaz don hafet how di nashora envaromet dey sopot livin tins wey de inside.

Bikos of klimet chenj, som kind of hanima wey dey inside wota dey komot from di aria of wota wey don ova hot for dem go aria wey stil dey kul for now. Hanima wey dey waka for land sef don dey komot go aria wey de up up bikos of klimet chenj. Di mata now bi sey, fish-dem wey de inside wota don dey enta inside wota wel wel dan bifor bikos di top of di wota don dey hot for dem to fit live nowadaz.
Na bitwin 1% (pacent) an 50% (pacent) of hanima wey dey waka for land fit no dey again in fushor bikos of di hafet of klimet chenj.

Di hafet of dis klimet chenj on big wota like ocean bi sey: e dey mek ocean hot pass nomal, e dey mek ocean wota get hacid too much, e dey mek ocean wota ovaful, e dey mek ice block inside ocean dey mek kwik kwik, e dey chenj how dip ocean dip rish, e dey ridus di levu of osijin (oxygen) gas wey de inside ocean wota an e dey chenj di way wota sopos flo inside ocean.

Klimet chenj dey hafet fud prodoshon an dis one dey mek fud no too de like bifor. Wota wey klin wel wel sef no de like bifor bikos of klimet chenj. Klimet chenj don even hafet human-bi bodi bikos of di heat wey jos dey. Sins klimet chenj dey mek evriwie ova hot, dis one don mek sikness an disis plenti more more.

Di hafet of weyda wey jos dey chenj dey hafet difren kontri for difren ways. Kontri wey bi sey na dem dey rilis one gas kol carbon dioxide (C02) no too dey feel di hafet bikos dey get moni an tin-dem to fit hajos dan oda kontri wey no get dos tins.

Di bizness wey go sofa bikos of klimet chenj na: agrikolshor, fish bizness, fayawood bizness, bizness wey bi to give light or pawa, bizness wey bi sey na to mek pipul travu go enjoi demsef, bizness wey bi moni bizness. Som group like pipul wey no get moni, wuman-dem, smol pikin-dem an pipul wey dey stey for one patikula aria fit sofa di hafet of klimet chenj dan odas.
Klimet chenj fit mek pipul komot for dia aria go oda aria bikos dey wan go fit fud as klimet chenj don hafet dia land wey dem dey yuz farm.
title: Effect of climate change

Good Friday na di rilijos holide wey kristen evriwie dey do to fit rimemba di sofa an di way Jesus tek kpai. Na dorin di holi week dem dey do am as pat of Paschal Triduum, ( three day pratis dat stat on Thursday an finish on night bifor Easta). Plenti pipul sabi Good Friday as Holy Friday, Black Friday, or Great an Holy Friday.
Dem dey yuz di Friday to rimemba di krusifishon of Jesus Christ, how e tek kpai and how e tek rise fom di dead. Di holiday dey always hapun for di same time as di Jewish holide of Passova.

Memba of meni kristen chorch like Katolik, Methodist, Anglican, Oriental Orthodox, United Protesant, Easta Orthodox, Lutheran, an Presbyterian dey do Good Friday wit fastin an chorch program join.
For katolik, Anglican, Methodist, an Lutheran chorch, dem dey stat Good Friday 12PM onti 3PM bikos na dat time Bible tok sey dakness kova di land wen Jesus give e life an kpai on di kross.
Pipul wey dey chop Holi kommunion wey dey  Moravian Chorch dey go klin wey dey beri dead bodi in Moravian semetri.

Di ril date for Good Friday dey chenj from one year to anoda in Gregorian an Julian kalenda. Kristen wey de Easta an kristen wey de Westa too no agri ova di date wey Easta an Good Friday go bi. 
Good Friday na holide wey govamet put hand mek pipul dey do in meni kontri of di wold an 12 U.S. stet too.

Some kontri like Germany wey kristen plenti no dey gri mek pipul dey sing or dans dorin Good Friday bikos dem tink sey Good Friday na for pipul to tink of dia life .

Di estimated year of Good Friday na AD 33, by two difren groups, and at fest as AD 34 by Isaac Newton bikos of di difrens bitwin di Biblikal and Julian kalendars.

For Good Friday, 7 April 2023, a Naija relijos figor Isaiah Ogedegbe bin kol on Christians all ova di world to imitate Christ "by loving demselves genuineli".

Wie dem gada di tori
title: Good Friday

Mariama Mamane na Niger wuman wey dey wok to protet di envaromet an e stil bi enjinia. Na Maname fom di Jacigreen kompini an di kompini don kolet meni awod for di wey e dey do to klin riva an wota-side.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for near Niger Riva wey de Niamey Mamane tek gro up. E mama na pesin wey get Masta digri in life and earth science.
As at 2020, Mamane dey stey in Burkina Faso. Mamane get digri in biodiversity an envaromet manejimet from  Yunivasiti of Niamey.

How e tek wok
For 2016, Mamane win di Entrepreneurial Journey prize from di International Institute for Water and Environmental Engineering ( dey no di organesahon as 2iE).
Na Mamane fom di kompini Jacigreen an e rejista di kompini in Ouagadougou.
Jacigreen dey wok on one plant wey dey plenti for riva side wey bi hyacinth to fertalaza, manior, an bio-gas. Dem dey yuz dis bio-gas as petirol inside jenerator to get light or eletrisiti.
Mamane win di United Nations Environment Programme Young Champions of the Earth Prize in 2007. Di prize rish 15,000 dollas.
title: Mariama Mamane

text:
Klimet chenj in Afrika na big wahala for Afrika bikos Afrika kontinet dey among di kontinet wey dey sofa di hafet of klimet chenj wel wel. Infat, some risach buk tok sey na Afrika kontinet go sofa di hafet of klimet chenj pass oda kontinet for di wold.
Dis sofa go hapun bikos Afrika no get mentod to kope with klimet chenj, dey dipen on dia nashora envaromet to fit live, an dia way of dorin agrikolsho na old mentod. Di wahala wey klimet chenj go korse to agrikolsho, to fud, to wota, an to di way hanima an plant dey tek dey helep diasef go plenti no bi smol. Dis one fit mek am veri difikot for Afrika to divelop kwik-kwik.

For 2007, IPCC tok with ful konfidens sey klimet chenj go hafet agrikolsho prodoshon an how fud go plenti rish in Afrika kontri. To manej dis klimet chenj, Afrika kontris go nid to ridus klimet chenj or find way to hajos to klimet chenj.
Ova di komin years, klimet chenj go mek di wold hot pass bifor an dis one go mek plenti rain to fall. As tins dey now, Afrika don dey hot pass oda kontinet of di wold. Meni pat of Afrika fit no dey Ok for pipul to live inside bikos of dis klimet chenj, an dis go hafet human health, fud an povati.
Di way rain go dey fall from one ples to anoda go dey difren but wetin dey suo bi sey rain no go bi like bifor again bikos of klimet chenj.

Afrika tempurashon don go up by 1% (pacent) sins di late 19th sentuari to di heli 21st sentuari an for sahel rijion, di tempurashon don go 3% (pacent) dorin di dry sisin. For ezampul, Kenya dey sofa for wetin klimet chenj dey do. Klimet chenj dey mek wota ful evriwie an som ples mek wota no de at all. Pipul wey dey tok wetin fit hapun for fushor tok sey dis two tins go dey bad more in di fushor. Oda pipul tok sey tok sey di tempurashon go go up bitwin 0.5% to 2%. For Nairobi wey bi big siti for Kenya, klimate chenj go mek Ghetto aria plenti. Livin in Ghetto aria dey korse dey kreate e own smol klimet bikos of di tins wey pipul dey yuz do house, di wey di house tek klose so tey breeze no dey flo norma, an di way eletrisiti an oda tins no dey di aria.

If we wan helep mek dis aria fit kope with Klimet chenj, dos house sopos to dey ok, an di aria sopos to fit kope with klimate chenj.
Bikos pipul wan kope with dis klimate chenj, meni tins don dey go on. Some of di tins bi:
SADC "Policy Paper Climate Change", an "adaptation strategy for the water cycle". Odas tins bi sey, pipul don join bodi to fit see mentod to kope with klimet chenj. Some of di progam wey pipul dey join hand for na
 Programme on Climate Change Adaptation
 Mitigation in Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA-SADC).

 Afrika Union wey bi intanashonal hoganazashon an wey get 55 kontri inside dem put down dia 47 plan in di year 2014 ripot on how to fight an hajos to klimet chenj. Di  Sekretiri Jeneral of di United Nashon tok sey dey nid to join bodi with Afrika Union to fight klimet chenj in orda to mit dia UN  Sustainable development goals. Di  United Nashon guess sey with di way Afrika populashon dey gro, di kontinet nid $1.3 trillion dolla to fit kari out di Sustainable development goals'' evri year. Anoda hoganazashon Di  Intanashonal Monitiri Fund guess sey Afrika nid $50 billion to fit kope with klimet chenj.
title: Climate change in Africa

Easter, wey dem dey also kol Resureshon Day and Pascha, na di kristen holide wey plenti pipul dey yuz tek selibrate Jesus Kraist returning fom di dead. Kristens bilive say dat na di day wey holi pass for di year. Som pipul wey nor bi kristens stil dey selibrate am as a kolshoral holide.

Easter nor dey hapun for di same date evri year. Som pipul don kol am moveable feast bikos di date dey chenj. Nau nau meni kristen chorches don gri on how dem tek dey kakulate di date. Dem dey selibrate Easter for di fest Sunday folowing di fest ful moon wen bi on or afta March 21st. Dis min say dem dey selibrate Easter for March or April. E fit hapun as earli as March 22 and as lait as April 25.
Western chorches, like di Roman Katholik Chorch, dey yuz di Gregorian kalendar, while Eastern chorches, like di Eastern Orthodox Chorch, dey yuz di Julian kalendar. Bikos of dis, di date for Easter selibreshons dey difren for di two types of chorches, even doh di way dem tek dey kakulate Easter dey similar. For 2015, pipul evriwie bin selibrate Easter for April 5 for bot di Gregorian kalendar and Julian kalendar. For 2019, dem selibrate Easter for April 21.

For Easter Sunday, 9 April 2023, a Naija relijos figor Isaiah Ogedegbe bin kol on kristens all ova di world to imitate Kraist "by loving demselves genuineli".

Wie dem gada di tori
title: Easter
