The Nigerian Observer na evri day niuz-pepa wey dem dey poblish for Benin City, Edo Stet, Naija. Dem don dey poblish di niuz-pepa sins 29 May 1968. Di pipul wey dey run am, Bendel Newspapers Company Limited, na di Edo Stet Govamet get am.

For 1973, one ripota for The Nigerian Observer kom rait one tori abaut tisha  wey wan strike for Rivers Stet. E hapun sey na di day Governor Alfred Diete-Spiff wan do e biday di tori kom out. Di govno si di tin as insot, di govno hasitans Ralph Iwowari kon shave di ripota  head for poblik an flog am with cane 24 times. Na di forma Bendel Stet wey dey leta komot Efo Stet from dey kontro The Nigerian Observer dat time. Anoda  niuz-pepa  wey dey Rivers Stet wey bi The Tide no gri tok  abaut di fight with di tisha.

Wen Shehu Shagari bin dey rule (1979-83), police bin dey harass pipo-dem wey dey work for di niuz-pepa. Dem go dey arrest dem an lock up dia office. Even some oda papers wen opposition party dey control, dem go harass dem too. For 1989, becos of wahala with moni, di niuz-pepa con close for some time. For 22 July 1993, General Ibrahim Babangida con ban The Nigerian Observer plus some oda pepas like National Concord, The Punch an The Daily Sketch.

Wen dem analyse The Nigerian Observer and oda Naija papers wey dem publish for 1999, dem talk say e no too dey sell, and e get small adverts wen just dey take 15% of space wey e get, compared to 50% wey typical North American paper go get. Most of di adverts na government notice; di paper no dey make enough money coupled with di scarcity of newsprint and dis no allow dem to cover many things or do investigative journalism.

Wia dem gada d tori
title: The Nigerian Observer

For soshal sayens, social relation or social interaction na eni rileshonship bitwin two or more pipul. E fit bi bot positiv (afiletiv) and negetiv (agonistik).

Soshal rileshonships na speshal kes of soshal rileshons and e fit hapun witout eni komunikeshon wey tek ples bitwin di pipul wey e konsan.

Soshal rileshonships bitwin rish and por pipul

For 26 March 2023, Isaiah Ogedegbe bin rait say akodin to "both Akbishop Arikoro and Nkem Owoh tok", gud soshal rileshonship bitwin rish and por pipul bifor di taim of nid na key to beta di human-bi kondishon".

Di hafet of klimet chrnj on human-bi health dey hapun in two ways. Di fest one bi di daret one an di sekond way bi di indaret. For di daret hafet of klimet chenj, weyda no gi dey norma an dis one dey korse injuri an mek pesin kpai. Di indaret one bi sey klimet chenj go mek onga plenti bikos fud for farm no go gro wel wel an wota wey gud for drinkin for hard to get.

Di kind wahala wey klimet chenj dey korse for human-bi no bi smol tin. We fit puy di wahala into three katigori:
 daret hafet ( ezampul, hot weyda, bad weyda)
 di klimet chenj wey dey jafey oda tins wey dey helep man fit live ( fud prodorshon, moskito an fish for wota)
 di indiret hafet wey dey lid to povati, mek pipul no get ples to stey again, an menta health wahala.
Di fat bi sey, weyda wey too hot fit hafet pesin health in di folorin ways: e fit mek pipul wey no like hot aria stat to sik, mose fit mek di nomba of pipul wey dey kpai go up, e fit hafet fisika wok wey pipul dey do, an e fit korse menta probem for some pipul. 

Klimet chenj fit korse mek some disis plenti pass norma. For ezampul, in some aria , disis wey moskito dey korse fit plenti, disis like kolera, an some disis wey dey hapun bikos pesin drink wota fit plenti. Klimet chenj fit

text:
Okada (or Achaba, Going, Inaga) na motorcycle wey dey carry passenger, e dey common for Naija and other African kontris-dem.

Okada or motorcycle taxi dey popular for some oda West African kontris like Togo (dem call am oléyia), Benin (dem call am zémidjans), Burkina Faso, Liberia (dem call am phen-phen), Ghana and Sierra Leone.

Etymolọgi 
Commercial motorcycles for Nigeria wey dem dey use carry passenger wey dem nickname "okada" get origin from Okada Air (wey don close) wey be airline wey get the same name as the owner, Chief Gabriel Igbinedion hometown. Dem call am okada because e fit waka well well pass for Lagos heavy traffic and dem fit carry passenger go their destination quick quick like how the airline dey take fly people. The irony of using airline name as nickname for commercial motorcyclists and because everybody sabi Okada Air, na him make the name okada still dey use even after the airline wey dem take the name from don close, wey many Nigerians no longer remember. For January 2020, "okada" word join the 28 other widely used Nigerian words wey dem add to Oxford English Dictionary for the January updates.

Naija society 

Taxi and bus wey dey Nigeria no dey ehn, and traffic and bad roads na everywhere. Okada na im people dey use for cities like Lagos, whether na businessmen, government workers or students, so dat dem go fit pass go their destinations even for traffic. Okada dey fit pass roads wey cars and buses no fit pass, especially for villages and areas wey no get access. The main reason why okada dey so popular na because of their low cost for operators, and the fact say dem dey use fuel small, wey e dey important well well for Nigeria wen fuel no dey plenty.

Riding for okada dey cost pass public transport. Tourists and people wey dey live for the place don talk say the experience wey dey come with okada na different level.

Wia dem gada di tori
title: Okada (motorcycle taxi)

Marie Clothilde Balfour ( dem bon am October 20, 1862 an e kpai on September 1931) na Bristish wuman wey bi raita, transletor, an pesin wey dey stodi an rekod how dem dey du tins for lokal way. Balfour rait three novel, rait some tori, an play-dem, e yuz song tek translet how pesin dey feel ( poetry) an French Revolution-era memoir ; e kolet an rekof tradishonal tori an muzik, e stil translet two big leta-dem wey kom from e anti.

How e tek stat life an go skul=
Na for Edinburgh dey bon Balfour. E na di gel-pikin of James Balfour an Christina Simson Balfour ( e leta chenj nem to Nicholson). James Balfour wey bi e papa na enjinia. Di raita Robert Loius Stevenson bi Balfour fest kosin. Balfour stat e life for New Zealand as e papa dey wok for dia dat time.Wen Balfour papa kpai for 1869, e go bak to Scotland wit e mama. Balfour rait three novel, e translet one French Revolution wey bi era memoir, an e edit two volume of leta wey e anti Margaret Isabella Balfour Stevenson  rait, wey e send wen e travul wit ha son go Polynesia. Balfour rait play dem, an tori dem an rait som buk abaut tradishon.
Na from time to time won pisin wey bi buk espat no dey shuor abaut di orijinaliti of di stori wey Marie Clothilde Balfour tok sey shi rait, bikos di stori dem wey shi rait dey strenj an shi add ha own simpu an eezi way tu ondastand.

Buk Dem wey shi don Rait
1.Legends of the Cars (1891, a series of articles)

2.White Sand (1896, novel)

3.Maris Stella (1896, novel)

4.Sub Tegmine Fagi (1897, short story)

5.The Fall of the Sparrow (1897, novel)

6. Saint Joseph and Mary, from a French folk song" (1897, poem translated by Balfour)

7.From Saranac to the Marquesas and beyond; being letters written by Mrs. M. I. Stevenson during 1887–88, to her sister, Jane Whyte Balfour (1903, edited by Balfour)

8.Examples of printed folk-lore concerning Northumberland (1904, collected folksongs)
Memoirs of Mlle des Écherolles, being sidelights on the Reign of Terror (1904, translated by Balfour)

Im Pasona Laif
Balfour mari ha fest kohsin,  wey bi fisishian James Craig Balfour dey kom get won dohta, wey e nem na Marie Margaret Melville Balfour, shi tu leta bekom pesin wey dey de rait. Balfour hosband kom dai for 1907, an shi dai for 1931 for London.

Wie Dem Gada di Tori
title: Marie Clothilde Balfour

text:
Dem bon Jeanne Scelles-Millie for 12, September 1900 reesh 22, March 1993 an na French akitekshor enjinia e bi an na raita wey dem bon for Algeria, e stey for die till e get fridom from France. Shi get intrest for difrent pipu wey bi Kristen, Jew pipu an Muslim mata. Shi rait an gada difrent North America tradishon stori dem an oda tradishon stori dem. Shi an ha hosband wey bi Jean Scelles dey aktiv tu fait prostitute mata.

Ha Life
Na September 12, 1900 na im dem bon Jeanne Millie for Algiers an na for french family dem bon am. Shi see ha sef sey shi bi wuman wey kom from di two water side. For 1924, na shi bi di fest wuman tu kolet diploma  for École Spéciale des Travaux Publics (ESTP) for Paris,
an di fest wuman wey bi enjinia for akitek wok for France. Na shi bi di fest wuman wey dairekt konstrokshon wok for Algeria. Shi Mari tu Jean Baptiste wey dem bon for 1904.

Jean an Jeanne Scelles-Millies dem bi pesin wey pipu sabi well for sillonniste circles. Dis katoleek hosband an waif wey dey do well na dem fom di grup wey biliv sey na won God dey (Monotheistic) for 1934 tu bring Muslim dem, Kristen dem an Jiu pipu tugeda wit sheikh Tayeb el Ogbi wey bi won sabi pesin for islamik mata, wey start di AUMA wit Ibn Badis an di Jewish aktivist wey bi Elie Gozlan. Dis grup kom hav wikli diskoshon for rilijion mata bitwin Muslim dem, Jiu pipu an Kristen dem. For di sohma of 1935, Jeanne an Jean hep arenj for di Abbé Jules Monchanin wey bi memba of di Société lyonnaise de philosophie, tu fit mit wit di el Ogbi wey get biliv for e drim.
Afta two yes di Scelles-Millies wey bi hosband an waif kom introdius Monchanin to profesoh Louis Massignon.

Jeanne Scelles-Millie hep fait for di soshia, kohshora an di politika fridom for di Algieria pipu. Na shi stat di Franco- Muslim skull dem. For di sekond Wold War (1939 go Rees 1945) shi join bodi for di French resistance an metropolitan France for Algeria.   Dem put Jean Scelles for prisin sey e bi memba for di resistance wey hapun for 1941 for Algiers.  E len abaut prostitushon from e mate wey dey for cell wit am, an na pesin wey dey arenj prostitut for men dem, him an e waif desaid to giv dia taim to defend human speshia value for di awieness kampen an put preshor for pipu wey dey for politiks to privent how dem dey kari pipu from won ples to anoda an yus dem for bisness mata wey no raim, na dat taim dey kom no sey na di kostoma bi di tru kos for prostitushon. Jeanne Scelles-Millie kom fainali moov tu France for 1957.  Shi rait an poblish som lokal tradishon buk dem. Shi kom dai for Saint-Maurice, Val-de-Marne, for 22, March 1993.  Jean and Jeanne Scelles kriet di Scelles Foundation (https://www.fondationscelles.org/en/) for 1993, an liv all dia propatee. For 1994, dem kom sabi di foundashon sey e dey yusfu for di poblik as  dem dey fait agenst the yus of pipu for sex bisnes.

Som Of Wetin E Rait Dem
Scelles-Millie's Contes sahariens du Souf, (1964) e rait dis lokal buk bai won Arab pesin wey dey tell stori from di Kabylie for di Sahara bohda. Som of di stori na for small pikin dem an e reelet am to di yut wey dey di aj of 15 an 16. Note dem, koment dem wit som wohd dem wey get esplaneshon dey insaid di stori.

Les Quatrains de Medjdoub le Sarcastique (1966) na wetin e gada rait wey reesh 340, som kom from di wons wey e fest rait dem. E konten wetin pass 100 (quatrains) wey bi four lines of raitin dem wey e provaid wit maut bai di Khalifa familee for Algiers wey dey neva poblish. Di wok konten di sens of di kaind laif wey di raita liv, di taim wen e rait an e viu pipu bihevioh, rilijion, an wuman. Dem prisent di quatrains for di orijina an translet am wit note dem an koment dem. John Wansbrough kritisais riviu kom stat for di raitin dem dat di buk dem tu bi siriosli stodi bai di pesin wey gada difrent infomeshon bai di genre of North African colloquial literature don fail. Dem riprodius di infomeshon for a konfiusin mana.
Di copi dem dey skata wit som mistek insaid di wey dem intaprit am.

Contes arabes du Maghreb wey shi rait for 1970 na wetin konten 45 stori dem wey bi sey na for Arabik or for French languej shi hie di stori dem, an faif pipu wey dey tell stori wey kom from Moroko, Algeria an Tunisia fit don tell ha di stori dem wey eesh of di stori get beta koment from pipu wey get nolej dem. Di stori dem kom from Arab tradishon insted mek e kom fro from di Berber tradishon. Sins all di pipu wey tell ha di stori dem na pipu wey sabi buk well, di stori dem sho how Arabik tradishon tek afekt di raitin. Dem kritisais di stori bikos pipu wey do di wok dem no kom out sey na dem do di wok an dem no bring out di orijina raitin for di stori raitin dem, but di stori dem get valu bikos na stori wey konten pipu bihevioh an pipu rileshonship dem.

Di Contes mystérieux d'Afrique du Nord, wey shi gada rait for 1972 wey shi kom ripoblish am for 2002, na wetin shi fit don imajin an gada from di famili of pipu wey dey rilijios dem,  (pious), holy Muslim dem (meraboutic), or di pipu wey sabi law mata dem (magistrates) or from di famili of di pipu wey de du fam wok (farmer) wey de onda di simbol of di North African. Note dem wey shi diskus afta eesh of ha imajinashon stori dem tok abaot oda stori dem wit simila aidia dem. For 2003, after di deht of Algeria poblish pesin wey tok about di entre christianisme et islam tok abaot di risin an di ashuorans wey mek am soport di strogu abaot fridom for soshia, kolshora an politika mata.

The Nation na Naija niuz-pepa wey dem dey poblish evri day for Legos Stet, in Naija. Akordin to di tori wey The Advertisers' Association of Nigeria (ADVANS) Kari kom for 2011, dem sey na di sekod most popular pepa wey pipul dey rid pass for Naija, an di tori wey dem tok for 2009 folo tok di sem tin.

Di websait of di pepa tok sey dem stand for freedom, justice and maket ekonomik. Dem dey target di pipul wey get moni, wey sabi buk an wey wan go up for life, as dia rida.

The Nation get printi plant for Legos, Abuja and Port Harcourt.

Di niuz-pepa dey rait tori abaut bizness an ekonomik, poblik polisi demokratic process and institutions of demokrasi, sports, arts an kolsho 

Di niuz-pepa na di fest of e kind wey wan dey all di 36 Stet of Naija witdin two years wey dey stat to wok. Dis one hapun as risot of di Campuslife poblikeshon wey dem dey distribute on Thursdays with eight pages, wey dey specially dedicate to student journalists and writers wey dey for tertiary institutions for Naija. Di Campuslife pull-out, with di late Ngozi Nwozor-Agbo as pioneer editor, bin help di newspaper bikom popular for evri house for Naija. Plenti studet jonalis an ripotas wey rait inside di niuz-pepa wen dey still de skul don  dey popular for dia various professions.

For April 2010, gunmen kill Edo Ugbagwu, one of the ripotas wey dey kova court tori-dem for The Nation. We no sabi wetin korse am.

text:
Poverty min wen pesin nor get enof moni for bezik nids such as fud, drinking wota, shelta, or toletris. Meni pipul for difren kontris dey live in povati, espeshali for developing arias of West and Sub-Saharan Afrika, Latin Amerika, Karibian and som parts of Asia.

E get difren ways to measure povati. Di World Bank tok say povati na wen pesin get les dan US$1 a day to live on. Moderate povati na wen pipul live on les dan $2 a day. For di year 2001, 1.1 bilion pipul dey extrimli poor, and 2.7 bilion dey moderateli poor.

For di developed world, dis nor dey hapun. For dia, dem dey si meni pipul as di woking poor. Dem get wok, but di moni dem dey kolet nor dey enof for bezik tins such as fud and a hom. For most developed kontris, pipul wey nor get wok dey kolet moni fom di Govament, but di moni smol wel-wel and e nor rish to buy beta tins wey fit mek laif komfortebol.

For di developing kontris of di world, ogbonge povati don mek meni young pipul to dey do bad-bad tins. Akording to Isaiah Ogedegbe for April 19, 2023, povati nor bi excuse for young pipul to dey live a laif of krime.

Wie dem gada di tori

text:
Esan pipul na one big grup of pipul wey dey for di southern pat of Naija, wey get di sem orijin, an dem biliv in di sem kolshor, rilijion, languej an meni meni oda tins dem. An na Esan languej dem dey spik. Pipul sabi Esan pipul sey dem bi farm woka, herb doktohs, big worrior dem wey dem dey hire wit money, an dem bi hontas. Dem dey fam pam tree dem, bush mango dem, cherry (Agbalumo), Pepper, kokonut, betel nut wey ibo pipul dey kol (Utazi), blak pear, kokoyam, avokado pear, yam, kassava, maize, rice, kola, beans, groundnut, banana, orange, plantain, sugar cane, tomato, potato, okra, pineapple, pawpaw, an difrent difrent type of vegetable dem. Pipul biliv sey di present Esan pipul don dey togeda from di 15 senturi wen di sitizin an most of di prince dem wey pipul sabi well well komot from dia neboh dem wey bi di Benin empaya wey dey for di northeast, Dey fom komuniti dem, an kingdom dem wey dey call eguare among di indijin dem wey dey mit for die. Dem dey for all di 35 kingdom wey dey establish for di land of Esan, wey inklud; Amahor, Ewohimi, Ekekhenlen, Ekpoma, Emu, Ekpon, Ewu, Ewato, Ewosa, Idoa, Ifeku, Igueben, Ilushi, Inyelen, Irrua, Ogwa, Ohordua, Okalo, Okhuesan, Onogholo, Opoji, Oria, Orowa, Uromi, Udo, Ugbegun, Ugboha, Ukhun, an Uzea, Ubiaja, Urhohi, Ugun, Ujiogba. 

Di Esan kingdom dem fait war agenst diasef, wit di war, di Esan pipul still dey keep di sem kolshor wey di Benin empaya chief dem don influens dem wit. For September 1897, di oyibo pipul (British Empire) kom tek kontro an tek ova dis kingdom dem, wit di Benin empaya, dey kom get fridom afta 63 years for 1960 wey Naija get fridom from di oyibo pipul (British colonial rule). Diwar wey Esan pipul fait bitwin diasef mek dem sorfa som fisika problem for dia laif laik pohvati an lak of infrastrokshor. Di main languej of di Esan pipul na Esan languej wey dey rileted tu Edo languej, Anioma an Urhobo languej, Owan languej, Etsako an Isoko languej. Dem 
konsida di languej sey e dey important for one rijion for Naija, an dem dey teach di languej for dia pramary skull dem, dem still dey yus di languej tu pass infomeshon for redio an televishon. Dem even rekognaiz an dey kaunt pipul wey dey spik di Esan languej for dia kingdom. Dem kom fit kaunt laik 1 million tu 1.5 million pipul wey bi sitizin dem wey dey difrent difrent ples for di land wey dey spik Esan languej for Naija.

Wetin History tok about dia Orijin
Di wod wey bi Esan don dey wit di Esan pipul for meni hundred yehs an dey don dey yus am befoh dey mit wit di Europe pipul. Meni pipul wey sabi history biliv sey di nem Esan kom from di wod wey bi (E san fia) wey get orijin from Benin wey di meenin na (they have fled or they jumped away).

Ishan na how english pipul kom rait dia Esan, an na bikos dem no fit pronauns di nem of dis pipul well. Biliv still dey wey show sey di kaind koropshon don afekt som nem dem for Esan laik Ubhẹkhẹ naw dem kom call am (Obeche tree), Uloko naw dem call am (Iroko tree), Abhulimẹn naw dem dey call am (Aburime), an meni nem dem laik dat. Dem don try mek dem shenj an reton tu haw e bi from di stat for di tins dem wey konsan buk mata.

Time wey pipul don dey Exist before Dem start to Rait History
Akordin to pipul wey stodi materia tins dem laik tuls, pot, stone, wall an oda tins wey pipul dey yus, abaot pipul wey don leev for di taim wey pass (archaeologist) an evidens from languej, pipul don fest stey for di savannah-forest an area dem wey dey bitwin som place dem for di land wey dey Esan for laik 3000 yehs before. From 500 AD to 750 AD, som hunta wey bi dia laif stail na only to dey hunt, dey kill fish an dey do oda tins laik to dey gada honey for living na im dey rely on to dey sorvaiv, dis pipul start tu stey for di savannah-forest wey bi place wey dey warm an som taim ren dey fall for dis plasis dem for di land of Esan an dem stey for wie forest dey for di Benin empaya. Dem don dey before  di Esan  an di Edo sosaeti wey kom build tins dem wey advans laik place dem wey get difens dem an wall dem around di family propati dem. Dis plasis wey dey build tins round dem na plasis wey tins wey dem build tu demaket wie pipul dey stey an farm propati rish 3 to 5 kilometers. Dis propati dem kom big an bikom vilej demand for 800 AD, dis vilej dem kom gada tu fom kingdom wit important pawa. Di finding wey dem do for dis awa taim kom show sey Wie Dem buid di wall sem dat taim na eastern part  for Benin empaya an na for di northern part for Esan land. Pipul kom stat tu stey for pamanent plesis wey dey near wie  water dey flow for di high land dem wey dey for di northern part. 

Na how plenti pipul tek dey moov from plesis tu Esan teritry for di sem taim na e influence di kolshor, languej an growth wey dey for di land of Esan well well. Komuniti dem for Esan land wey dey di south an east part wey bi sey dem bi 
(Ewohimi, Ewatto, Ekpon, Amahor) na Igbo an Igala pipul plenti for die na dem bi di (Uroh); Emai pipul kom from di north kom enta  (Ukhun, Idoa) an di Amahor an Etsako kom enta (Irrua), from di south, di Itsekiri enta (Ekpon) an Urhobo enta (Ujiogba).

Na Edo pipul influens Esan land well well wey bi di founda of Benin empaya. For 1460, Oba Ewuare kom pass one law wey hard for pipul tu folo wey dey don stop laik (sexual intercourse, bathing, drumming, dancing, and cooking). Dis law Dem dey hard an e no dey eezi for di sitizin tu follow, na e mek di pipul run go di kingdom of Esanland. Na dis movment kom shape di Esanland modern kolshoral identity wey mek bring di wod Esan, or refugee. Di nolej wey pipul don share about art an kolshor don sopot dis obsavashon for di tins dem. Pipul wey sabi history mata for Esan an Edo don gada plenti stori about dis movment.

Before Dey kolonaiz Dem
Esan kingdom get difrent digri for di wey dem tek gorven diaself, but na Benin empaya get di high pawa wey high wey  di Esan pawa dey onda am. Na di Oba of Benin apruv di enijie of Esanland an Esan kingdom dem dey giv honor to di Oba of Benin. Dem still get meni rekod for fight bitwin di Esan kingdom an di Benin kingdom. Dis one na bikos of Oba, wey dey for di throne wey send white chalk to di Esan pipul wey e mean di sign of friendship bitwin di two kingdom dem. An if Esan pipul reject di chalk, den di Oba go won try enta di Esanland an fight dem. Di difrent wey dey for dia politika stability wey dey bitwin di Benin kingdom an di Esan kingdom still dey cos fight fight bitwin dem. Dat kain fight fight dey komon bitwin dem sotey no rekod for eni history dem wey show sey peace dey bitwin di Esan kingdom an di Benin pipul.

Esanland dey do wold tred well well dat time. Benin wey high ova di Esanland for Position mata na e mek dem to dey send for treda wey kom from far place dem, or ekhen.  Ekhen dey sorply cloth, ivory, peppers, an slave dem for di Europe pipul wey dey do buy and sell wey dey for Yorubaland, Esanland, an Afenmai.
Di Uzea war hapun for 16th senturi, dis na di fight fight wey hapun bitwin di Uromi kingdom an di Benin kingdom. Di last from 1502 go rish 1503, an na e leed to di rizin why di Oba Ozolua  for Benin refius to bikom friend wit Onojie Agba for Uromi. 

Di war kom end for di wey dem dey call Uzea, na dat time dem kill di two leader dem. So, for di time wey peace kom dey, di Esan kingdom kom dey send soja dem to Benin kingdom wey dem go leta pay for dem. Like for di war wey hapun bitwin 1515 to 1516 for di time of Idah, an di sacking of Akure for 1823.

For 19th senturi, dem kontinu tu dey atak di north part of di Esanland wen di Nupe Muslim dem dey luk pipul wey dey go dey yus for slave, sotey di Nupe Muslim pipul tek ova an turn dem to Muslim, afta dey don tek ova di Kukuruku pipul land. Meni Esan kingdom dem wey kom from di south kom help for di fight for dem tu atak di Nupe pipul wey dey atak dem. Esan pipul kom get favoh for di atak wey dey atak dia pipul dem, dey kom kari plenti Nupe an Etsako worior tu Esan siti wey bi sey na die dem dey dey prospa till dis awa taim. For dat 19th senturi, di Oyibo pipul dey demand for palm drodukt from di land, na dat taim Europe pipul kom influens Esanland well well.
War For Esan an Kolonaizashon
For 1897, di British pipul kom find out about Benin for 1897, wey mek di Esan get fridom from di Benin kingdom. For 1899, British pipul kom enta an distob di Esan kingdom for seven yehs. Pipul for Esan kom show sey dem strong tu konka pass di Benin pipul bikos dia govment strong an get pawa. Di kingdom dem kontiniu tu fight di British even wen dia neboh dem don sorenda for fight. Som chief dem wey dey don win for war like Ologbosere an Ebohon still dey stand agenst di rule dem wey di British pipul don yus style style put for di Esan pipul land wey dey guide dem for di west part wey dem put militry post an dey block raod dem. E last from 1897 go rish 1899, na die Ologbosere kom sorenda for bohda wey dey for Okemue vilej.

Di kingdom wey di British pipul fest atak na Ekpon kingdom. Ekpon kom kari fear put for di British pipul mind an kom dey agenst di wey di British pipul enta dia land tu fight dem for April 22, wey lead tu di mont wey dem get katakata. Afta di British pipul fest enta tu fight di kingdom, Ekpon kom dey for one place an kom dey konfius, an letah for April 29, di Ekpon kingdom kom go mit di British pipul wit soprais atak for Okemue wie dem gada put dia kamp. Na dis one mek di British soja dem kom go bak tu go gada pawa for dem tu dey strong dey kom bak to fight an win an dey kill Ologbosere for May. Di British pipul kom fail as dem dey try tu kom an fight dem more more, as dem tek kontro for Irrua na e mek dem bring di imajensi katakata plan wey mek di British dem kom sorenda. Oda Esan Kingdom dem kom dey yus dis imajensi plan wey kom help dem wey mek di British no go fit enta Esanland tu fight dem till 1901.

For 16 March 1901, Di British pipul atak di Uromi kingdom wey dia head for die na wise man Onojie Okolo. Prince Okojie Uromi kom respond dem wit veri fast imajensi war plan. Afta small taim, di British sojas kom kill Okolo for wie e dey for di Amedokhian vilej afta dey don tek ova di vilej. Na dis one kom vex Prince Okojie sotey e kill di British sojas dem kapten before dey kom go gada more tins tu fight. Di British kom notis sey Uromi pipul no eezi tu fight wit If dem no get netiv help, na die dey go mit lokal soportah dem laik Onokpogua wey bi di Ezomo for Uromi. Na dis one kom mek dem kidnap Prince Okojie from di forest an send am go mit di British for dia offis for Calabar. So na dis style meni kingdom dem wey fight wit di British dem kom kohpi, di Esan pipul kom laik to dey yus di imajensi plan well well wey letah bring long taim katakata as dem no even get beta weapon dem go bak go gada pawa for diasef well from Benin City to fit fight di British dem. Di taim wey dem kapshor di vilej den di intana resistans na vaolent,di imajensi war plan wey kontiniu for Uromi soja dem na e mek di British dem tu fit rilis Prince Okojie. Di British dem kom vex an stat to distroi meni vilej wey dey don kapshor dem. But, for 1906, Esanland kom asept di British rule dem, an di 34 kingdom dem wey bi Esan pipul own kom dey onda di British pipul for Naija

Esan Pipul Musik an Dans
Esan pipul dans na one kaind dans wey bi sey e no dey eezi tu dans an e dey very interested tu watch, na di kaind dans wey involv tu dey muv bodi for di wey enihaw pesin no fit trai am (acrobatic dance) an na yung men dem dey parfom for di dans, meni of  Igbabonelimhin na e dey for di dans, 
Igbabonelimhin na tu dey twist yoh bodi an dey do somasolt as di beat dey kom out from di drum. How di vilej dem for Esan dey operate dey difrent for eesh oda. Dem dey fix did small fight for days dem wey dem fix for di pafomans. Onda nomah tin, na evri two week dem akodin tu Esan kalenda or for market day for di difrent vilej an town dem wey gada tu bikom Esan na e dem dey do di Igbabonelimhin pafomans. Igbabonelimhinsopos bi dans wey dey sopos dey dans to mark selibreshon dem laik end of year, niu yam festiva dem, an soshia funkshon dem, laik berial serimoni. For Esan, di dans na one dans wey dey show speshia simbol for Esan pipul of awa taim wey dey evriwie.

Esan Pipul Tradishon And Dia Rilijion
Esan Pipul tradishon an lokal stori dem laik igbabonẹlimhin and akhuẹ, na one wey of lernin an na entatenment e still bi. Di Esan Pipul get important tradishonal ruler for dia sosieti wey dey mek tins tu dey orda for dia sosieti wie biuti an beta bihavior dey dey togeda. As e bi sey Kristen don dey for die for veri long taim, plenti Esan Pipul still biliv in tradishon an dem dey wohship dia papa dem spirit an oda small small god dem. Plenti pipul for Esan still bi Kristen dem, meni of dem na Catholic an e neva teh wey som of dem stat tu go oda shorsh dem. Na difrent difrent lokal languej dem dey for Esan vilej wey bi sey na from Bini languej, di Esan an Bini pipul still get somtins dem bitwin dem wey mek dem dey somhaw close, na e mek dat seyin wey tok sey Esan ii gbi Ẹdo wey di meenin na Esan no dey do bad tin for Ẹdo wey e still meen Bini. E get oda transleshon dem wey tok sey Esan gbe Edo wey e meenin na Esan don win Bini. Di Esan pipul dem tradishon for rilijion mata resembu Edo pipul tradishon for rilijion mata well well, bikos of sey di Esan pipul komot from Bini empaya tu di southeast for di 15th senturi, E get meni small small god dem wey bi di Esan rilijion wey Bini pipul sef dey serv. 

Osabobua, na di main Edo an Esan pipul god. Kristen dem an di  pipul wey dey travul tu prish dem kom kari di nem sey di nem na for God. For Esanland dem translet God nem say na Osanobua e bi.

Olokun

Esu, na di Esan pipul god wey get koni koni way. Di Yoruba pipul an Edo pipul get di sem tradishonal biliv for dis god. Di wod wey bi Esu, Kristen wey bi mishonari dem kom translet am sey na Satan bi di meenin.

Osun, na di god of medisin for di Esan pipul, na hie di pipul wey dia surname na Okosun  kom from, an di meenin na son of medisin.

title: Esan Pipul

text:
Di Edo pipul or Benin pipul na di grup of pipul wey dia horijina home na from Edo Stet for di Souta part of Naija. Dem dey spik di Edo langwej an na dem bi di pikin for pipul wey fom di Benin Empaya. Dem de veri klos an dem rilet wit oda grup-dem wey dey spik Edo languej-dem like: di Afemai, di Esan, Isoko an di Urhobo. 

Benin an Bini na di nem wey di Portugal pipul yus koropshon tek giv dem, na from di wod Ubini wey don dey teh teh from di taim wey di Oba (ruler) Ewuare stil dey for trone. 

Ubini na wod wey di minin na Vexation, wey bi sey na Prince Oranmiyan wey bi pikin to one rish rula for Uhe (Ife), na e yus di wod to diskraib di kind wahala wey e faze wen dem kol am to kom bi king for Benin. Di oda grup-dem wey join wit dem an dey stey togeda wit dem for di senta kom put koropshon for dem to dey kol Ubini kom hard for dem, dey kom stat to dey kol am Bini, an for 1485, for di time wey di pipul wey kom from Portugal stat tu do fine fine beed biznes wit Oba Ewuare dem kom even spoil di nem moh moh kom dey kol am Benin.

How Dey Tek Shie Dia Teritry Dem
Na Naija for Ẹdo Stet yu fit see Ẹdo Pipul, wey dem get dia nem from di rijion wey dey fest stey wen meni of dem stat tu dia tins dem akodin tu history, wey bi Benin City na die sti be di sentra kapita for dia homeland for all di Ẹdo pipul. Dey even get meni klos grub dem wey nie dem an dey rileted tu dem for di boundri wey dia govment rish for Ẹdo Stet. Meni of dis grup dem don trace dia histri go back to di siti senta wey bi Benin City an dem sii sey dem bi Benin pipul. Esampu na dia neboh dem laik di difrent Afemai wey bi smol grup, an di pipul wey dey for Ẹdo Stet an di Esan pipul, di Akoko Ẹdo pipul wey dey for di stet bohda dem. 

Ẹdo Stet na part of bifor bifor Bendel state bifor kolonaizeshon for Naija, dem even no dem sey dem bi Mid-Western Region, for Naija. Dis rijion influens dia kolshor wey mek Ẹdo, Urhobo, Esan an oda pipul wey dey rileted tu Ẹdo kolshor kom resembu diasef.

Dia Dresin
Ẹdo pipul get meni tins wey dem dey yus for fashon an e dey komon for dem tu yus red beed dem, tu dey wieh tin for dia leg round dia anku (anklets), an dem dey wieh klot dem wey dem mek from leef dem (raffia work) an meni oda tins dem laik dat.

Dia Biliv for Tradishon
Ẹdo pipul tradishonal biliv for rilijion mata, tins wey dey insaid dia tradishonal rilijion pass dis awa human wold an na tins dem wey dey for invisibu wold wey eyes no fit see an dem dey intaven for pipul wey dey for di wold mata. Pipul wey dey wohship dem dey faind taim dey mek sakrifais for dem for dia difrent difrent shrine dem. God wey bi Osanobua na di krietor an na e get pawa pass dem all. Him pikin dem wey bi Olokun na dem dey rule all di bodi of wohta, an na dem dey responsibu for prospariti an fatiliti for pipul wey dey wohship dem. Ogun (god of iron), na e anoda pikin wey bi oga for pipul wey dey wohship di god of iron. 

Di nem  Osanobua Noghodua, wey di meenin na God Almighty. Osanobua na wod wey get meni fine fine meenin dem laik tu dey pity for pesin (merciful), e no get wie e stat an e no get wie e end (timeless), (goodness), (justice), an e dey pawaful (sublimity), na e high pas an get pawa pas evri tin (supreme) for wetin Ẹdo pipul biliv, Osanobua get holy karakta wey dem bi omnipresence (orhiole), omniscience (ajoana), an omnipotence (udazi). Dem biliv sey di pawaful God de dey for evriwie for evri taim.

Art an dia Kolshor

Ẹdo tradishon for art mata dey waed an dia wok na tu dey mek tins imej from wud or tu dey yus ston mek tins imej dem (sculptures), tins for awod dem (plaques), an tins wey pesin fit yus kova face (masks) wey dey sho spirishua an tins wey konsan dia histri for dia kolshoral tradishon dem. Som of di Ẹdo pipul art wok wey pipul sabi wey dey imphtant laik di mask of the Queen Mother Idia an di vast collection of historical Edo art pieces called the Benin Bronzes wey bi sey no bi for Naija alon you go see am but dem kari dem tu di oda part for di wold, yu go sii dia art wok dem for di musiom dem laik di  New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art

Brymo wey dem bon Ọlawale Ọlọfọrọ wey im reel nem na Olawale Ibrahim Ashimi for 9 May 1986. Meni pipul sabi am as Brymo an na song raita, na singa for Naija, an na musik pafoma, na aktor, an e stil dey rait buk. Dem bon am for Okokomaiko an na die e grow up, na sins wen e don dey for sekondri skul for 1999 e don dey rekod e musik dem. E sign Im rekod deal wit Chocolate City for 2010 bifor dem akius am for 2013 sey e fail tu pafom wetin e promise di rekod lebel. Brymo rilis his fest rekod albom wey e kol e nem Brymstone for 2007. E rilis his sekond albom for 2012 wey e koll dat one The Son of a Kapenta. E kom leta sing e singu musik dem laik Ara, Good Morning an Go Hard. For 20, October 2013, E rilis his third albom wey bi Merchants, Dealers & Slaves, an na dis two singu song e sing bifor dat taim som pipul wey dey kritisais musik dem giv beta koment for him musik.

For October 2014, Brymo rilis his nomba four studio albom wey bi Tabula Rasa an im musik wey bi Fe Mi na soft tradishonal musik. E rilis his nomba eight musik wey e pick from e oda song dem, e kom do dem togeda for e albom wey e kol Trance, for 8 December 2015. E do di song bikos of meni pipul wey dey for U.S an e konten som of e song wey dey e albom laik Merchants, Dealers & Slaves and Tabula Rasa. Brymo rilis his nomba five studio albom wey e kol Klĭtôrĭs for 9 May 2016; dey nominet am as di best: R&B/Pop Albom for di Headies 2016 an di albom as di albom of di year for di Headies 2018. For march 2018, Brymo rilis his nomba six albom wey pipul tok gud tin about wey  bi Oṣó, wey e mix wit Yoruba song, e sopot di albom wit song laik Heya! an Bá’núsọ. Brymo join bodi wit three memba of Skata Vibration tu fom A.A.A, wey bi band wey bi alternative rock eponymous debut EP wey dem rilis for August 2019.

E rilis his nomba seven albom for studio wey e koll Yellow for 1 April 2020; dem nominet am for di best alternative albom and albom of di year for di Headies 2020. Brymo rilis him song wey no long rish albom but wey e nem am Libel for 5 November 2020. E get faiv track dem,  Na Bigfoot prodiuz all di EP wit 'Deborah Prest wey bi guest singa. For September 2021, Brymo rilis back to back: Èsan and 9, Harmattan & Winter, as him nomba eight an nine albom dem for studio. E rilis his nomba ten albom for studio wey bi Theta for 27 May 2022 wey di albom konten 10 track dem an na for Naija pidgin e rekod all di song dem. Brymo kom show Mansa for poblik an him nomba elevun studio albom as e fest poblik sound pafomans for KAP Hub for March 2023. Im don rilis three buk dem wey bi; Oriri's Plight for (2018), Verses for (2020) an The Bad Tooth for (2022). an e show for di fim dem like Price of Admission for (2021) an Elesin Oba, The King's Horseman for (2022).

Augusta Henriques na Guinea-Bissau wuwan wey dey fight for how beta chenj go fit hapun to envaromet an politis. E na tisha an govamet minista. In 2012, Henriques win di  Ramsar Wetland Conservation Awod. (Manijimet).
For 1991, Henrique join bodi tek fom di hoganasashon Tiniguena. Dis hoganisashon, govamet pioul no dey put mouth inside wetin dey go on inside di hoganasashon.
Tiniguena dey fight for how di envaromet go beta an how komuniti wey de Guinea-Bissau go tek join hand du am.Henriques stil de as one of di fondin advaisa of di "Foundation for Education with Production". Na Patrick Van Rensberg fom dis hoganasashon wey dey helep pipul wey no get moni.

Guinea-Bissau don chuz Henriques mek e go tok for dem in meni intanashonal mitin like International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). E don wok in di Ministri of National Education as Head of Adult Education.

text:
Wota in Afrika na big topik bikos e konsain wie di wota dey kom from, how di wota de rish pipul an how Afrika pioul dey gain for di wota.if we divide all di fresh wota-dem wey de dis wold, Afrika kontinet get onli 9% (pacent) of all di fresh wota wey de di hol wold. If we divide all di pipul-dem wey de dis wold, Afrika kontinet get onli 16% (pacent) of di pipul-dem.
Some of di riva-dem wey de Afrika kontinet bi:
 Riva Congo
 Riva Nile
 Riva Zambezi
 Riva Niger an 
 Lake Victoria.
Na lake Victoria pipul biliv sey bi di sekod lake wey big pass for di wold. Na Afrika kontinet kari nomba two posishon for di kontinet wey wota no tu de. Million of Afrika populashon stil no get plenti wota to drink evri year.

Di risin wey mek wota no de for meni pipul for Afrika bi: Som ples get plenti wota an oda ples no get, Afrika too ova bon an populashon don ova plenti an di nomba three risin bi sey, Afrika pipul no sabi manej how to mek am posibu mek wota rish evribodi. In some pat of Afrika, some aria get plenti wota but na smol pipul dey stey for di aria. For ezampul, 30% of wota wey dey Afrika kom from Congo Basin an na onli 10% of Afrika populashon dey stey dat aria.
Anoda risin wey mek wota no rish evribodi for Afrika bi sey; Rain no dey fall di sem way for difren time in Afrika. In some part of Afrika, wota tu dey dry for graund kwik-kwik an dis one dey mek di pipul no get plenty wota wen dey nid if rain no fall on time. Some pat of Afrika wey pipul dey kol sub-Saharan Africa dey si shege to get wota an dis one dey hafet bizness an how pipul go fit live for dat aria.
Many Agrikolsho bizness in Afrika  dipen sey mek rain fall bifor bizness for fit de ok bikos na online 10% ( picent) of Afrika land dey fit find wota for wit out rain if dey wan yuz am farm.
Afrika kotinet dey sofa for di klimet chenj palava no bi smol. In mani pat ot Afrika, na wota dem dey Tek get eletrisiti. For ezampul, na Kanji Dam dey giv di big big siti wey de Naija eletrisiti. Kanji Dam still dey give some kontri wey near Naija like Niger eletrisiti too. Bikos of dis one, meni pipul don do dia best to sopot mek suo sey di wota fit dey bring eletisiti.

Even as pipul an govamet dey try mek wota in Afrika fit provide fud an eletisiti, dis tin dey hard more more bikos of sey Afrika no get beta instrumet, Afrika neva too divelop to mit di shalenj as populashon for Afrika jos di big more more. For di hol wold, na Afrika kontinet get di problem of mek pipul dey komot for vilej dey pat diasef for siti pass. 
Anoda shalenj wey dey mek Afrika pipul to fit manej dia riva an lake bi sey dos wota dey enta diasef.

Orijin of Afrika wota
 Wota wey de inside ground
One of di way to get wota for Afrika pipul na to dig di one wey de ground. To tok fact, na ground wota dey kip meni afrika pipul alive bikos ground wota de meni ples for Afrika, di ground wota de gud to yuz, an e dey konstat even if weyda no too gud or rain no kwik fall. 
Even sey ground wota de, Afrika pipul no dey tu get klin wota to drink. One risach wey dey du for 2007 tok sey ova 40% (picent) dey yuz ground wota as dia onli way to get wota espeshiali for pipul wey de North an Souta Afrika kontri.
For siti in Afrika, na abaut 39% of pipul dey yuz  pipe wota, but borehole don dey de popula now bikos na 24% of pipul dey yuz borehole to get wota now.

WHO (2006) tok sey, in 2014, onli 16% of di pipul in sub-Saharan Africa get wota wey tap (di tap fit dey inside house or outside house) drink an yuz.
Even for dis pipul sef, di wota fit no dey klin to drink bikos kontaminrshon fit de. Some of di tin wey dey korse kontamineshon bi sey; no moni to mantain di tap, di envaromet fit don hafetdi wota.

For aria wey well de ( or konga), no bodi dey yuz enitin to testdi wota weyda e dey gud or not an meni of dos pipul wey dey drink di well no go skul to ondastand wetin bi testin of wota.
 Wota wey de inside riva, lagoon, lake
one hoganasashon kol WHO in 2015 ripot sey e rish 159 million dey kolet wota wey den neva trit for lake, pond, riva, an stream for di wold. For Afrika, all dos big big riva dem no tu klin bikos of shit, petiro wey don enta di wota, kompini wey dia kemika to find way enta di wota. For ezampul, in Niger Delta wey bi one aria in Naija wey plenti orye kompini de, di wota for dat aria no gud at all bikos di orye don kontaminet am.
title: Water in Africa

text:
Wota skasiti na di wey wota no de to fit mit di way pipul nid wota. Wota go soon hard to get in Afrika by di year 2025. By dis year, if we divadi di populashon of di wold into threr pat, two pat go sofa to see fresh wota. Na dis folorin tins dey mek am hard to get wota in Afrika:
 Afrika pipul don dey ova plenti
 Afrika kontinet no tu get moni to tekia of dia wota
 Klimet Chenj dey hafet Afrika kontinet.
Even sey sub-Saharan Africa dey get plenti rain, di rain get sisin an som time di rain no get patikula time wen e dey fall. Sometime, rain go fall sotey wota go full evriwie an sometime rain no go fall at all.
Bikos of povati wahala, di way Afrika populashon dey plenti an how plenti pipul dey komot from vilej go dey stey for siti,dis one don mek sub-Saharan Africa as di kontinet wey poor pass an wey no divelop at all for di wold.

Di 2012 ripot wey  Fud an Agrikolsho Hoganiseshon give mek am show sey e go hard dem to fit kari dia plan wey dey get to pipul bikos of how to get wota dey hard more more. Dis one na bikos sey agrikolsho an oda tins wey pipul dey du don mek wota for riva dry wel wel.
Di one wey wota dey hard to get for Afrika don dey hafet meni tins. For ezampul, e don dey hafet pipul health ( espeshali wuman-dem an smol pikin-dem),e don dey hafet pipul edukeshon, e dey hafet pipul farm product, e go soon mek some kontri dey fight bikos of wota.

Facebook na intanet site wie pipul fit rait sometin about diasef, luk piksho of dia frend, send mesej an vidio yuzin dia fone or komputa. Na one Amerika tekinoloji kompini get am kol Meta Platforms.Na Mark Zuckerberg wit e oda frend wey de  Harvard Kolej mek Facebook in 2004. Di nem of Mark Zuckerberg frend wey join am mek Facebook bi: Eduardo Saverin, Andrew McCollum, Dustin Moskovitz, an Chris Hughes. Na 2004 dey kreate Facebook. Di word Facebook kom from di komanmet wey Amerika Yunivasiti dey giv studet. Di fest pipul wey yuz Facebook na Harvard studet, but todey, meni Norta Amerika yunivasiti sef dey yuz Facebook. Sins 2006, enibodi wey don rish 13 years of age fit yuz Facebook. In December 2022,Facebook tok sey na 2.96 billion yuza yuz Facebook evri month an if dey sey mek dey chuz di websait wey pipo dey go pass for intanet, na Facebook bi nomba three.

In di 2010s, na Facebook pipo download for dia fone an komputa pass.

text:
Teqball na ball sport wey dem dey pley on top teble wey kurf, na two tins togeda di sport get sepak takraw an table tennis. Di playa fit uze eni of im bodi pley di sport apat fom im arms an hands. Two playas fit pley Teqball as one game, four playas fit pley am as double game. Di pipu wey dey in charj for di wod na International Football of Teqball (FITEQ). Som ogbonge futbola like di game, an dem dey insaid som of di event for di 2021 Asian Beach Games an di  2023 European Games, dem dey try put am insaid Olympic games.

Teqball na sport wey pipu sabi fas fas pas in August 2018 bikos dem sabi di pipu wey dey in cherj FIFEQ by Olympic Committee of Asia (OCA). In June 2019 Association of National Olympic Committee (ANOCA) sabi dem. 

In November 2020 Global Association of International Sports Federation (GAISF) giv dem dia full memba.

Histri
Teqball fest stat in 2012 in Hungary by three pesin wey lik futbol wel wel: bifor bifor ogbonge playa Gábor Borsányi [hu]; Hungarian Biznesman György Gattyán; an komputa pesin Viktor Huszár. Pesin wey tink am na Gábor Borsányi, wey dey pley bol on top teble tennis teble. Hau Dem du di teble tennis teble no dey let am bounc to di playa, so Dem no enjoi di game. Borsányi kon tink am sey if di teble bend smol e go dey bounc wel to di playa, an e go dey eazi to pley wit leg. Afta som years dem du dia own teble for Teqball wit Viktor Huszár, in 2014.

Dem sho di wod di game for Budapest, Hungary on October 18, 2016, by bifor bifor Brazilian playa Ronaldinho.

Rules
Di rules wey dem go folo dey for FITEQ's rules.

''Som of di rules

. Dem fit pley teqball wit bols wey dem dey uze pley footbol, wit size five wey dey offishial.

. Two playas fit pley teqball (Single game) or by four playas (double games)

. Komplete Teqball match dey get best-of-three-set.

. Na wen one playa/team don get 12points bi one set.

. Evri plays/team go get chanc to serv two times.

. Di playa/team dey chenj servifis afta e get four points.

. Dem no gree for eni playa mek e torch bol wit d sem pat of im bodi two times.

. Dem no gree mek u pley bak di bol to oda playa/team wit di sem pat of di bodi two times.

. Playa/team fit torch di bol 3 times wit eni pat of im bodi bifor dem pley am bak to di sekond playa/team, dem no gree mek eni playa uze hand an arm.

.For doubles, a team fit torch di bols 3 times, but e must pas am di bol once to oda team memba.

. Wen dem dey pley, dem no alow eni memba mek e torch teble or oda playa wey dem no dey sem team.

. Wen ball na edgebol, dem go re-pley am

Dia wok an properti
Teqball no bi lik oda sports, di Kain way wey dem uze du dia Teqball teble, na onli Teqball Internashional abi oda kompini wey Teqball Holding SARL tel to mek tebles get rait to dey mek am. Di nem "teqball", na onli pipul wey dem giv rait fit uze am for poblic abi uze am sel maket. Dem du hol di law bikos dem wan mek di sport gro.

Kompetition
Teqball World Championship

Di Teqball World Championship na wetin dem dey du evri year wey FITEQ dey in cherj.

Di Teqball kompetishion get single an double dor man an wuman. Di fest wod Teqbal Championship hapun for Budapest, Hungary 2017 wey kontri wey pas 20 dey insaid. Di one wey dem du for 2018 hapun for Reims France wey 90 playas gada pley insaid.

Di 2019 Teqball World Championship hapun for 6-8 December 2019 insaid Budapest. E rich 160 sport pipul wey kom fom 58 kontris pley insaid single, double an mixed double games.

FITEQ tok sey dem no go du di kompetishion for 2020 Teqball World Championship bikos of COVID-19 wey dey dat time.

Afrika Beach Games
Teqball dey for fest Afrika Beach Games in Sal, Cape Verde on 14-23 July 2019. Na Cameroon win di kop wen dem beat Nigeria for final.

Asian Beach Games & Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Game (AIMAG)
As sport wey Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) sabi, teqball dey insaid di game wey dem go du for Sanya 2020, but di Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) don shift di Sanya Asian Beach Games, wey dem sorpos du for 2-10 April 2021. Na OCA Executive Board mek am bi lik dat, bikos of COVID-19.

Di OCA, Di National Olympic of Thailand an di AIMAG 2021 organising Committee don gree dey di event, wey teqball go dey insaid di sport wey dem go du, go hapun for 10 to 20 March 2022. Di OCA don dey folo Chinese Olympic Committee an di Sanya Asian Beach Games Organising Committee tok sey mek dem gree niu date for di 6th Asian Beach Games, wia teqball go fest dey as sport wey go folo Kolet pris wey dem giv for neck.

European Games
Di European Olympic Committee (EOC) don folo FITEQ tok sey teqball go dey for di fest time insaid European Games in 2023 arenjmet.

Wod arenjmet
FITEQ get wod arenjmet for singles, doubles an Mixed doubles, na hau dem tek du wel for hol FITEQ events dem dey use kakulate di points. Dem dey gada points wey dem get for dem evri time, na im dem dem tek sabi number 1. Di las one na:22 February 2022:

text:
Table tennis, wey dem stil sabi as Ping-pong an whiff-whaff, na racket sport wey kom fom tennis but dey difren bikos of di teble wey dem dey uze pley am. If na one pesin dey pley am or two team, playa dey pley bak to di sekond pesin ova di net wey dey ontop teble wit dia smol racket ontil dem no fit pley bak again, dat go bi point for di oda pesin. Dem dey pley am fas fas, pesin dey cirious wit am bikos u go pley am bak fas fas, an di bol wey dey dey use dey fas sef.

If dem wan pley table tennis na smol ples dem dey pley am bikos di teble no dey tu big, Dem dey pley am insaid haus onda eni weather. Na for di hol wod dem like teble teniss bikos no bi for onli competition sport, u stil fit uze am du exercise an pley am for any age.

Table tennis don bi Olympic sport sins 1988, an di event dey for men's and wumen's single, an men's an wumen's teams wey reples double in 2008.

Pipul wey dey in cherj for di wod na International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF), wey Dem stet for 1926, an rait di rules insaid ITTF handbook. ITTF get 226 members association for di hol wod.

Histri
Di sport stat in Victorian England, na pipul wey get moni wel wel stat am an dem dey pley am afta nait fud as parlour game. Som pipul don tok sey na British military wey dey India for 1860s or 1870s join mek am gro. Dem du one tin for middu wey dey as net, dem du anoda two tins lik buk wey dem dey uze as racket to pley di bol.

Di nem "Ping-pong" wey dem dey kol am na wetin pipul don no bifor J.Jaques & Son Limited mek am dia own rait in 1901. Plenti pipul lik to dey kol di game nem Ping-pong pas mek dem dey kol am wetin Jacques tins, som of di kompini wey dey du tins lik to dey kol di game table tennis.

Anoda tin wey dem add to di game na di Kain bol wey dem dey uze an na James W. Gibbs diskova am for 1901 wen e go US. Na E.C Goodie for 1901, diskova niu rocket wey dem go uze dey pley di game. Plenti pipul don dey sabi table tennis for 1901 sotey dem du kompetition, rait buk about am, an wod championship hapun for 1902. Na hau dem dey tek giv lawn tennis points dem dey uze for am tu.

Na two Association dey for 1902 wey bi: "Ping-pong Association" an "Table tennis Association" for 1910, niu table tennis association kon dey for 1921, dem kol am English tennis Association for 1926. Di International Table tennis Federation (ITTF) folo in 1926. Na for London dem du dia fest wod championship in 1926. In 1933, Di United Table tennis Association, wey dem dey kol USA table tennis now, stat.

In di 1930's, Edgar Snow tok insaid Red Star over China sey som beta pipul  lik di English game of table tennis. For Soviet Union, in di 1930's dem don sabi di sport bikos dem alow mek soldiers dey du Sport, an bikos di game dey hep pesin get beta bodi

text:
YouTube na one intanet online websait wie pipo fit put dia vidio for evribodi to luk am. Na San Bruno, for Kalifonia in Amerika dia hed-ofis de.
YouTube stat to de wok for intanet on February 14, 2005. Di three pipo wey form YouTube bi: Steve Chen, Chad Hurley, an Jawed Karim. Di ona of YouTube bi Google an YouTube bi di sekod intanet websait wey pipo dey go pass. Na Google Search kari nomba one for di websait wey pipo dey go pass. Di nomba of pipul wey dey go YouTube evri month pass 2.5 billion. All dis pipo dey yuz ova 1 billion hours dey luk vidio wey de YouTube evri day. As of May 2019, for one minute, na vidio wey rish 500 hours dey enta YouTube.
Google pay $1.65 billion to tek ova  YouTube in October 2006.Kompini dey yuz YouTube tok abaut dia bizness wey oyinbo pipo dey kol advatais. Afta wen Google don tek ova YouTube, dem kom stat to dey give pipo wey dey put fims or muvee vidio to di websait some moni. Youtube get one ofa wey bi YouTube Premium. Dis ofa bi sey pesin fit pay moni if e no wan dey see advatismet as e dey luk tins for YouTube.
Wen dey kount di moni wey enta YouTube poket in 2022, na $ 29.2 billion. In 2021, di moni wey enta dia poket na $28.8 billion.

Afta wey Google buy YouTube, Google mek suo sey YouTube fit de for fone, fit de some televison netwok an fit de some oda platfom wey e no de bifor. For YouTube, meni katigori of vidio de, like: Muzik vidio, Vidio klip, smol smol fims, Niuz, Vlog, an meni odas .
Na pipo like me an you dey put plenti vidio wey we dey see for YouTube. Some vidio de wey bi sey na Kompini an some pipo wey bi YouTuber put dem.
Meni big big kompini wey dey do fims like Disney, Paramount, NBCUniversal, an Warner Bros.Discovery don get dia own shanel for YouTube so dat dey go dey yuz am advatais.

Dem bon Christopher Oghenebrorie Okotie for 16 June 1958, na Naija pesin wey dey prish for televishon an na pastoh e bi for di Household of God Church International Ministries, wey bi Pentecostal congregation for Lagos sins February 1987.

Im Pasona Laif
Na Francis Idje an Cecilia Okotie bon Okotie for Ethiope-West, for Delta State wey bi bifor bifor Bendel State. Wen him dey stat tu dey grow, he kom dey laik tu dey sing, wen e dey for sekondri skul for Benin City, e dey for di skul musik klob wey dem dey entaten grup of pipul dem from taim to taim. Dat taim e neva tink am sey e wan yus dat e talent wey bi tu dey sing for biznes mata, or tu mek moni, ontil e fest year for yunivesiti wen him papa dai. Na pesin wey laik tu dey du jogging, martial arts, an e laik musik.

Im Edukashon an Karia
He go tu Ẹdo kolej sekondri skul for Benin City. For 1984, he graduet an get digri for law mata for Naija from di University of Nsukka. Okotie komot from skul to fest poshu im musik Karia bifor e kom bak to skul. Na two taim na e he mari an leta for June 24, 2012 he tok sey im no dey wit di sekond waif agen. He go bak to skul to finish e edukashon an e kom graduet wit law digri, for dat sem taim wey e still dey for skul e also komot go dey do im rilijion wok. Okotie dat taim stat tu dey go Grace Fellowship Bible School for Tulsa, wey dey for Oklahoma, an e no kom far, for 1990, he kom establish di annual Karis Awards, wey bi sey na im shorsh dey host am tu sabi an giv Naija sitizin dem money as gift.

For Korona Virus Taim
For August 2020 wey Naija govment tok sey mek dem opun shorsh dem for Naija, an dey make am komposri for shorsh memba dem tu dey yus dia nos kova or dia fez kova, Pastor Okotie komdem di aidia sey tu dey yus nos kova  go shorsh go bi laik sey dem want stat tu dey do wetin don stop tu dey hapun sins di day wey Christ don dai an e even tok sey e go meen tu kriet sepreshon bitwin man an God.

Di Grace or Karis Awod Program
Na one kaind program wey dem dey do evri year tu show pipu pity an hep pipul dem, wey bi sey wetin mek di Lagos pastor dem for di House Hold of God International Ministries dem dey du am bi sey, dem risin am sey sens no dey tu bi beta pesin if yu no mek oda pipul laif beta tu. Na e mek dem dey do di Karis awod, dem yus di awod tek dey rekognaiz pipul wey don du beta tins tu biuld di neshon, wey pipul no sabi dem an dem dey rewod dem fo di beta tin wey dem du tu build di neshon. Som of di pipul wey dey don giv di awod na;

Prof. Chike Obi wey bi mathematician (1996),

D.I.G. Chris Omeben  na retayad poleesman (1997),

Mr. Taiwo Akinwunmi wey disain di nashona flag (1998),

Hogan Bassey na fohma Commonwealth and World boxing champion (1999),

Chief Michael Imodou di Labour leader (2000),

Chief Margaret Ekpo na nationalist and woman activist (2001),

Mallam Aminu Kano na nationalist

Isaac Adaka Boro human rights activist (2005).

Di Grace program dey evun mek kontribushon an dey giv regula moni an matiria tins fo shariti join bodi dem laik di;

SOS Children Village,

the Sunshine Foundation,

Pacelli School for the Blind

Partially Sighted and Little Saints Orphanage,

Spinal Cord Injuries Association of Nigeria, an di Childcare Trust.

Tins Wey E Get
Fo 2011, di join bodi wey bi Forbes estimet tins wey e get sey e rish US$3–10 million.

Wen He Kontes Foh President
Okotie don fes kontes foh President onda di bana wey bi di Justice Party (JP), wey bi sey na Ralph Obiorah kom leed foh di parti, afta him komot from di National Democratic Party (NDP) pramari elekshon dem, Olusegun Obasanjo kom win am foh di elekshon wey hapun foh May 2003. E kom out agen for 2007 onda di platfom for di parti wey him fom for e sef wey bi Fresh Democratic Party (FRESH) and e kom loos tu Umaru Yar'Adua foh di elekshon wey hapun foh May 2007. For 2011, he kom out kom kontes agen na dat taim President Goodluck Jonathan kom win am.

Misunderstanding Wit E Fellow Pastoh
Okotie get poblik katakata wit him fellow Naija Pastoh wey bi T.B Joshua, wey mek e tok sey na pesin wey dey yus konni konni tek dey do majik.

Hilda Effiong Bassey (dem bon am September 20, 1996) wey pipo sabi as Hilda Baci na Naija wuman wey sabi mek fud for pipul to chop an e stil dey akt fims.Hilda Baci bi di fest pesin wey wan mek fud in di kishin for straight 100 hours. Na Hilda win di "Jollof Faceoff " kompetishon wey dey du for August 2021.

How e tek stat life an wok
Na for Nsit Ubium Lokal Govamet wey de Akwa Ibom Stet in Naija dey tek bon Hilda on September 20, 1966. E rid Soshioloji from Madonna Yunivasiti wey de Okija. Hilda get B.Sc in soshioloji. Hilda bi di prisenta of di TV show "Dine on a Budget" wey Pop Central TV, DSTV Channel 189.

Fims-dem wey e don du

Guinness Wold Rekod tori
For March 2023, Hilda tok sey e wan bi di fest pesin wey go yuz plenti time for kishen to dey mek fud for pipo. If Hilda fit du am e nem go enta one buk wey di nem na Guinness Wold Rekod. Di pesin wey get di rekod for di buk wey Hilda wan tek ova d rekod na Lata Tondon. Lata Tondon enta di rekod buk in 2019.
For May 11, 2023, Hilda stat to dey mek fud to break di rekod an e nem di hativiti Cook-a-thon. E break di rekod on May 15, 2023. By di time wey Monday May 15, 2023 araund 7:45 am, r don cook or mek fud for 87 hours 50 miniti an dis one mek am yuz 5 miniti pass Lata Tondon as di onli pesin for rekod to mek fud for that time. Na 96 hours Hilda get for mind to stop, but e kom stop to mek fud afta 100 hours wey e stat.

Wen Hilda stat to mek di fud-dem, meni big big pipo kom sopot an give am mora so dat e no go taya. Some of dem na: Govno of Legos Stet, Babajide Sanwo-Olu; Pastor of Harvester International , Bolaji Idowu; Naija singa-dem Tiwa Savage, Tim Godfrey, Ice Prince.
Di Vais-Presido of Naija, Yemi Osinbajo imsef kom to give Hilda mora for di cookin. Meni Naija pipo rili sopot Hilda an e nem jos de meni sosha midiha wen di cookin stat.
title: Hilda Baci

text:
Ike Ekweremadu (bon 12 May 1962) na Naija politishian an lawya wey kom fom Enugu State  an sarf in di Senate of Nigeria for Enugu West fom 3 June 2003 rich 5 May 2023. Na people's Democratic Party memba, an na bifor bifor Deputy President of the Nigeria Senate  3 times (6th 7th an 8th) Senate. On 23 June 2022, Ekweremadu an im wife get case for insaid UK bikos dem tok sey e wan kari one 21 years old pikin enta UK to komot som pat for im bodi
. Dem leta jorg im kase on 23 March 2023 for Old Bailey, sey na tru sey e get hand insaid di Matta. On May 5 2023, di kourt komfam am sey mek e go prison for Nine years and eight month.

Hau e tek stat life
Dem bon Ike Ekweremadu at Amachara Mpu in Aninri Lokal Govment Aria of Enugu Stet, an na Igbo pesin, E get Bachelor's an Master's degree of in law fom di University of Nigeria, an dey kol am to Nigeria Bar in 1987. E get Doctor of Philosophy degree in law fom di University of Abuja, Nigeria.

Politikal ofis
Na im bi di Executive Chairman of Aninri Lokal Govment Council onda United Nigeria Congress Party (UNCP) in 1997, an win bes Council chairman for dat year.

Senatorial karia
On 12 April 2003, e enta as Naija Senate. In September 2003, as Vice Chairman of di Senate Committee on Informashion, e tok sey dem go du investigashon ontop money wey dem  bifor bifor Federal Capital Territory (FCT) minista Mallam Nasir el-Rufai Kolet for bak wey no rekod am. Ike Ekweremadu an Nasir El-Rufai no dey tu klose, an dey kon cherj El-Rufai wit koropshion kase insaid 2008. In 2005, Ike Ekweremadu no win di Senate President of Nigeria wey e plan to enta, na Senator Kenechukwu Nnamani win am.

In July 2006, as tok tok pesin for di Southern Senators' Forum, e let pipu no sey na lie sey dem don get agrimet to Kari pawa go North insaid 2007 elevation. In September 2006, President Olusegun Obasanjo tel di Senate sey mek dem chek di repot wey Economic and Financial Crime Commission (EFCC) giv on top moni wey dem tok sey forma Vice President Atiku Abubakar no uze wel. Ike Ekweremadu kon tok sey dem go arenj committee wey go luk insaid di matta, but tok sey to komot am go had bikos na 2/3 majority sopot fit komot am. 

Ekweremadu kom bak in di 29 April 2007 Nigeria National Assembly elecshion, an na im enta as deputy senate president. Na im dem giv pawa to dey selet committee chairman wey dey for Southeast. In July 2007, Ekweremadu get hand insaid hau Ojo Maduekwe tek get minister posishon. 

Wen President Umaru Musa Yar'Adua's pasonal Secretary, David Edevbie, get som wahala for British bikos dem tok sey e pak moni wey bi for govment in September 2009. Ekweremadu no gree let pipu no weda e dey sopot am or e no sopot, e jus tok sey e no sabi di koko of di matta. In September 2009, Na Ekweremadu dey insaid chairman wey go du primary eleshon for di People Democratic Party's governor's candidate for Anambra state.

Senatorial elecshion 2011
Na Ike Ekweremadu enta as Senator for Enugu West in di April 2011 elecshions, e get 112,806 votes. Pesin wey folo am na People for Democratic Change candidate (PDC), Jackson Ezeoffor, wey get 7,522 votes.

Senatorial elecshion 2019
On 23 February 2019, na Ekweremadu enta as senate for Enugu West for di fifth time wit 86,088 votes. Pesin wey folo am na Mrs Juliet Ibekaku Nwagwu of di All Progressives Congress (APC) wey get 15,187 votes. 

On 11 June 2019, Ekweremadu no enta as Deputy Senate President of di 9th Senate. Na Ovie Omo-Agege wey get 68 votes enta. Ike Ekweremadu don tok sey e no go for Nigeria Senate in 2023.

ECOWAS
In September 2009, e dey insaid di pipu wey Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) as hoc selet to wok on hau dem go dey folo lor wey Niger Republic get. Na im bi Di fest Deputy Speaker of di ECOWAS parliament an leta bi Speaker for  parliament in August 2011.

Katakata wey hapun for Nuremberg, Germany
On 17 August 2019, wen Ekweremadu go sekond Cultural Festival and Convention wey Ndi-Igbo du for Nuremberg, Germany. Indigenous Peoples of Biafra (IPOB)  korse katakata for dia, dem tok sey Ekweremadu no tok wen govment dey kill Igbo pipu wit di Operations Crocodile Smile an Phyton Dance wey Army dey du for South. Dem troway tins for Ekweremadu bodi, na dat one mek am komot for di ples wey dem dey du Di festival, som tok sey e get wound sef. IPOB oga, Nnamdi Kanu tok sey di tins wey hapun to Ekweremadu na jus to draw dia ear, sey if dem no go stil du di sem tin for som Igbo govonors. Dem karch four pipul wey folo du di katakata an  dem giv dem 20 days of wok for govment bikos dem korse katakata ontop pesin.

2022 UK Bodi Pat kase
On 23 June 2023, dem kari Ekweremadu an im wif, pikin an Dr Obinna Obeta go kourt bikos dem gada aren't to kari one 21 years old boy go UK fom Legos to  komot im Pat of Bodi. On 23 March 2023, Ekweremadu, im wif an Dr Obinna Obeta kourt tok sey na tru sey dem wan komot di boy bodi pat. Pesin wey kari dem go kourt tok sey na 2022 dem kari di boy kom UK to kom komot im Kidney for €80,000 insaid Royal Free Hospital, London. Pesin wey kari dem go kourt stil tok sey na €7,000.an wok for UK dem promis go giv di boy. Dem wan komot am giv dia pikin wey bi girl -wey dem leta sey di girl no no abuat am. On May 5 2023, kourt tell Ekweremadu go uze nine years an eight month for prison. Obeta go uze ten years for prison an Ekweremadu wif go uze four years an six month for prison. On August 2022, dem komfirm am sey Ekweremadu dey HM Prison Wandsworth, Dr Obeta dey HM Prison Belmarsh. Ekweremadu wif dey HM Prison Bronzefield.

Jeremiah Omoto Fufeyin (dem bon am February 15, 1971) na di fonda an di lid pasto of Christ Mercyland Deliverance Ministry (CMDM), wey de Warri in Delta Stet Naija. Fufeyin stat di chorch on April 3, 2010.

How e tek stat life 
Na for Burutu, Warri wey de Delta Stet dey tek bon Jeremiah Omoto Fufeyin on February 15, 1971. Fufeyin papa nem na Livingson Stevenson Toboukeyei an e mama nem na Asetu Fufeyin. Fufeyin papa Mari plenti wife an e papa bon plenti pikin. For di 32 pikin-dem wey Fufeyin papa bon, na Jeremiah bi di nomba 22.
E du e pamari skul for "Zuokumor Primary School "   Burutu L.G.A of Delta Stet bitwin 1981 go rish 1986. Fufeyin kom du e sekodri skul for "Gbese Grammar School" Ojobo bitwin  1986!go rish 1992.

E famili life
Fufeyin wife na Anthonia Fufeyin an e bon five pikin-dem for am.

Wetin pipo dey tok abaut am
Pipo dey tok bad abaut how Fufeyin dey du notis me wen e dey helep pipo. Pipo still dey tok abaut how e prishin na onli on Demon an dilivans. Wen COVID-19 stil de, Fufeyin dash di pipo wey dey wok wit am, di pipo wey dey go e chorch, an Naija govamet moni wey go rish 300 million. For dat time of COVID-19 disis, Fufeyin no gree kolet offerin an tithes bikos e tok sey e wan give pipo bak tins.

Some pipo don tok bad abaut Fufeyin bikos pipo tok sey e yuz e mouth tok sey e na fest bon of T.B. Joshua. E tok sey e no tok so sey e jos dey repriset evri man of God. Meni pipo dey kol Fufeyin nems like: Warri T.B. Joshua, Niger Delta T.B. Joshua, an Ijaw T.B. Joshua. Fufeyin no gree kolet di nem-dem wey pipo dey kol am bikos e tok sey e nem na Jeremiah Omoto Fufeyin.

Wen di Tori dey Niuz sey pasto Suleman Johnson go get sex with one wuman wey no bi e wife, Fufeyin on April 1, 2017 tok sey Suleman Johnson no du dat kind tin.
Fufeyin Kari anoda pasto, pasto Johnmark Ighosotu go kot in April 2022. Di risin bi sey, Fufeyin tok sey pasto Johnmark tok bad tin abaut e nem an sey one pesin menshon e nem sey e folo join du intanet wayo wen di pesin kofess for Johnmark chorch .
Faya kach an skata Fufeyin chorch on 22 March 2023. E tok sey dis faya hapun to e chorch bikos e no wan lisin to wetin God de tell am.

text:
Lata Tondon na India kuk wey kom from Madhya Pradesh. Dem bon ha fo April 15,1980, for September 2019, na shi kolet di wod rekod fo Guinness ontop sey shi kontiniu tu kuk for 87 hawas, 45 minits.

How shi Tek Stat
Dem bon Lata Tondon for 15 April 1980 fo north-easthern pat fo Rewawey bi Madhya Pradesh stet fo India. Shi stat tu dey kuk wen shi still dey yong an na ha granpapa inspaya ha. Akodin tu wetin dey di Hindustan Times, shi praise ha mama an ha moda-inlaw sey na dem tish ha how tu kuk an shi tok sey, na dem mek ha tu be beta kuk. Lata kom go stodi fo skul of kuk wey dey fo London fo di United Kingdom, an shi wok wit French kuk wey bi chef Cloud Bosi an chef Career Jun Tanaka wey bi kuk fo American British television.

Ha Karia
Fo 2018,na shi bi di winna fo intanashona India kuk fo di year. Fo 2019, shi kom set di rekod fo marathon cooking World Guinness .Na shi bi di fest wuman fo di wold tu get di rekod, an na shi still bi di fest wuman wey bi kuk wey enta di Guiness World Record Book. Shi kuk fo 87 hawas 45 minits wey shi no stop na e mek ha set di rekod.

Shi don wok fo India an London wie shi stodi. Lata Tondon na still spika shi bi fo TEDx. Shi don fokos tu promot di rigional cuisine of India, shi don trai tu espand di flavor an style dem fo di wey dem mek di food dem. An shi don evin trai do mek beta way tu dey eet an mek eni food no dey waste wen dem dey kuk.

Honor Wey Shi Don Risiv Dem
Dey don honor Lata Tondon wit difrent difrent awod dem wey show how di Asia Book of Records dem tek rekognaiz ha, awod dem wey bi;

text:
Ahmed Ololade ( dem bon am January 13, 1995) wey pipo sabi wel wel as Asake na Naija Afrobeat singa an song raita. Asake de onda YBNL Nation an Empire Distribution rekod lebel kompini. Di nem Asake wey meni pipo tek no am bi di nem of e mama.

For February 3, 2023, Asake, Kiss Daniel, Snazzy the Optimist, an Lucid bi di nem-dem wey pipo chek dia muzik pass as singa akordin to Audiomack.

How e tek wok
Asake rid akt for Obafemi Awolowo Yunivasiti wey de Naija. E stat to dey rilis muzik in 2008. Na di muzik "Mr Money" mek am blow wel wel. Leta, Asake kom du di remix of "Mr Money" an Zlatan an Peruzzi folo sing for di remix. For February 2022, Naija singa Olamide sahin Asake to e rekod lebel YBNL Records. For dat February, Asake rilis e fest habom Ololade  an inside dat habom di muzik wey mek am popula wel wel "Omo ope de inside. Olamide join sing inside "Omo Ope". Anoda song wey de inside di habom na "Sungba". Asake du di remix of "Sungba" one month leta an e kol Burna boy to join sing inside. Asake in July 2022 sahin wit Empire rekod sey mek dem helep am dey sel e habom.

Na on September 8, 2022 Asake rilis e fest studio habom Mr Money and the Vibe, Seven month afta wey e don rilis e habom EP. Di habom get hit singu like "Terminator", "Peace be unto you" an di "Sungba" remix wit Burna boy. Meni pipo for Naija an overseas like di habom wel wel as di break meni rekod for di wold.
Leta for di year, Asake stat e program to go around di wold to sing an e sel tiket three times sey e go sing for 02 Academy Brixton wey de London. For September 2022, Asake Tom sey e go sing "Mr. Money with the Vibe"' in UK.

Wen last day wey Asake wan finish e show for 02 Brixton Academy, meni pipo get injuri bikos of rush rush wey dem dey di dat day. Dis rush rush kill two pipo; 33 year old Rebecca Ikumelo an di 22 year old Sekwuriti man Gaby Hutchinson.

Asake win di Male MVP awod at di  Soundcity MVP Awod wey dem du for  Eko Convenshon Senta in Legos on February 2023.
For April 2023, Asake tok for  Good Morin Amerika show to diskuss e Muzik.

Some pipo tok sey Asake dey yuz Fuji dey sing e muzik bikos of sey e dey yuz Yoruba an some slang for e song.

Awod-dem wey e don kolet
Asake win di "Best African Artist of the Year" for di Vodafone Ghana Music Awod .

text:
Alex Otti (dem bon am February 18, 1965) na Naija business man, banka, investor, politishan an e like to dash pipo tins. Na Otti Abia pipo chuz to bi dia govnor in di March 18, 2023 govnor eleshon wey hapun for Abia Stet. E bi di forma Manejin Daretor (M.D) of Diamond Bank Plc wey de Naija. Otti yuz di parti All Progressives Grand Alliance (APGA) tek kampain to bi di govnor of Abia Stet. Otti de among di pipo wey dem kontro Thisday niuz-pepa an e dey rait one hatikul evri two monday of di week. Di tahitu of Otti hatikul bi: "Outside The Box".

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na February 18, 1965 dem bon Alex Otti in Umuru, Umuehim vilej in Ehi Na Uguru Kindom, Isiala Ngwa South LGA of Abia Stet. Otti papa na pasto an e nem na Lazarus Weze Otti.
Otti du e sekondri edukeshon for Ngwa Hi Skul, Aba an e finish for Sekondri Teknika Skul, Okpuala Ngwa in Abia Stet. Wen di risot of WAEC wan komot out, na Otti bi di best studet dorin e set. Otti kom enta  Yunivasiti of Port Harcourt to go rid ekonomik. E finish wit Fest klass in ekonomik in 1988 from di yunivasiti.

In 1994, Otti kolet e MBA digree satifiket from di Yunivasiti of Legos.
Otti don go meni intanashonal korse wey inklud: "Executive Development Programmes of the Columbia Business", Stanford Business School", an Wharton Business School ([[University of Pennsylvania|Yunivasiti of Pennsylvania).
E stil du one ezekutiv program at INSEAD, Fontainebleau, France.

In 2009, Babcook Yunivasiti, give Otti "honorary doctorate degree" an in 2012, Yunivasiti of Port Arcourt give am "honorary Doctor of Science" (D.Sc) digri. Otti stil kolet anoda "honorary doctorate degree" from Yunivasiti of Nigeria, Nsukka.

How e tek wok
Otti stat to dey wok for bank in 1989 an na Nigerian International Bank e fest stat. Nigerian International Bank de onda Citibank New York. Na for di hopireshon dipatmet Otti dey wen e de di bank.
Leta, Otti stat to dey wok for Nigerian Intercontinental Merchant Bank Ltd. Wen e dey Intercontinental Bank, Otti wok for dia financial savis dipatmet as also for dia kopuret bankin divishon. In 1992, e join "Societe Bancaire Nigeria Limited" (Merchant Bank), di bank de onda "Banque SBA Paris". In Merchant Bank, e rish di posishon of sinior manija. Ottis kom enta "United Bank for Africa" (UBA) as dia prinsipa manija an na e bi monitor dia banki kopuret secto for di entaya South Divishon. E mejo wok na to mek suo sey di orye an gas biziness gro wel wel. Wen May 2001 rish, Ottis stat to dey wok for "First Bank of Nigeria PLC" as dia hasista jenera manija an e wok na to gro di enaji secto of di bank. By April 2004, Otti don bikom di depoti jenera manija, an one year leta, e vikom ezekutiv dareto, komashiha bankin. Leta, Otttis bikom di ezekutiv dareto south directorate. As ezekutiv dareto south directorate, e dey kontro ova 140 brashis of bank wey de South-South an South Easta pat of Naija.
In March 2011, e kom from "First Bank" enta "Diamond Bank" as dia CEO. Ottis rili helep mek Diamond Bank bi beta bank. Wen di date wey Diamond Bank sahin wit Otti finish, di bank sahin 3 year wit am again in March 2014.

Ottis ritaya by imsef on October 24, 2014 an Uzoma Dozie tek ova as di niu GMD of Bank CEO.
How e tek wok for politis
Ottis komot as pesin wey go like di govno for Abia Stet onda di politika parti APGA. For December 31, 2015, Di "Court of Appeal" komot govno Okezie Ikpeazu wey enta onda PDP parti an tok sey na Ottis win di govno eleshon wey dem du for April 11 an April 25 wey hapun for Abia Stet.
For February 3, 2016, di kot wey hi pas for Naija, "Supreme Court''" no gree as tok sey na Okezie Ikpeazu stil bi di govno of di stet.

Di Nigeria Football Federation( wey dem sabi as Nigeria Football Association til 2008) na im bi Naija futbol govnorin bodi. Dem stat am for 1945 an dem no am as Nigeria national football team in 1949. E join CAF in 1959 an FIFA in 1960. Dia head ofis dey Abuja. 

For 2018 na three league e dey kontrol: Di Nigeria Premier League, Di Amateur League an di Women's League, an five competishion, Federation Cup an Women's Cup folo. Dia nes elecshion na 2022.

Katakata wey hapun wen dem stat am
Pesin wey sabi rait nius wel wel for Naija, Solaja don ci evidens sey na 1933 dem sopos don stat am no bi 1945 wey pipul dey tink.

Solaja menshion two Nigeria Daily times wey tok about di mata, one na 21 July an 21 August 1933.  Di fest na about hau dem dey plan to stat am di oda one na wen dem dey kol pipu to kom join dem. 

Di FA's poblic Affairs Ofisa David Berber, tel pipu sey di FA get pruf sey di Nigerian Football Federation don dey bifor 1945.

2014 palava
On di 9th July 2014, afta di 2014 FIFA Wod cup, Nigeria get suspenshion fom FIFA, wit wetin FIFA tok dem sey di suspenshion na bikos dem kari NFF go kourt kon tel dem mek dia president no kontrol again. 

Nigeria stat to dey pley bak for FIFA competishion in 2014 FIFA U-20 Women's wod cup.

In September, anoda  wahala stat wey mek Nigeria mis 2015 Afrika Cup of Nations, but dem leta setu am, an Nigeria leta go 2014 Africans Women's championship.

Nigeria Football Federation Bill
Rules an lors wey dem go dey folo wey go mek dem komfam Nigeria Football Federation ("NFF ACT"), na wetin National Assembly of Nigeria don tok abuat in 2019. Na for onli mek President Muhammadu Buhari sign am mek e bi lor e remain.

Wai dem Neva sign di NFF Bill
Plenti pipu for Naija wan mek dem sign di Bill, bikos dem tok sey e go hep mek Naija futbol gro. But pipu wey sabi lor tok sey for Naija lor no bi National Assembly sopos put mouth for di mata. An anoda tin bi sey if president sign am na im bi sey FIFA no go tu get pawa ontop am, an dis one no folo for FIFA rules.
