text:
Peter Gene Hernandez (dem bon am October 8 , 1985), dem sabi am for im wok as  Bruno Mars, na American singa, song raita, an rekod produsa. Dem no am wit im stai for stage, an hau e dey du difren musik like pop, R&B, funk, soul, reggae, disco, an rock. Mars dey pafom wit im band, di Hooligans, wey sabi pley difren kain of song wit elektrik guitar, bass, piano, keyboards, drums, an horns, an dem dey hep Mars dans an sing ontop stage. 

Na for Honolulu, Hawaii dem bon am, Mars kon go Los Angeles in 2003 to stat to dey sing. In 2009, e dey insaid pipu wey stat The Smeezingtons, wey hep Mars du beta song wey mek pipu sabi am. Plenti pipu sabi am insaid 2010 wit di song "Nothing on You" wey B.o.b sing an "Billionaire" wey Travia McCoy, wey e sing insaid di two songs, dat sem year Bruno Mars rilis studio album Doo-Wops & Hooligans, wey get pop wit reggae an R&B. Songs wey enta numbs one dey insaid im fest album "Just the way You Are", "Grenade, an "The Lazy songs". Wit di wey e Sabi sing disco, funk, rock, reggae, im sekond album Unorthodox Jukebox (2011) get hol di kain stai e sabi, an na im fest nomba one song for Billboard 200. E stil get two Billboard Hot 100 numba one songs, "Locked Out of Heaven" an "When I was Your Man".

In 2014 Mars dey insaid Mark Ronson's "Uptown Funk", wey top plenti musik chart, e stey fourteen an seven weeks ontop Billboard Hot 100 an di UK single chats. Mars third studio album, di R&B 24 e Magic (2016), kolet seven Grammy awods, e win Album of the Year, Rekod of di Year, an Song of di Year. Di album get som top singles "24 Magic", "That's What I Like", an "Finesse" remix wey e du wit Cardi B. In 2021 Mars an Anderson. Paak, as Silik Sonic, rilis album wey dem gada di togeda An Evening with Silk Sony. Di song get four Grammy Awods. 

Mars don sell ova 130 million rekods for hol di wod, wey mek am pesin wey dey sel pas insaid pipu wey dey sing. Eight of im songs don rich nomba one on Billboard Hot 100 an im sho dey insaid sho wey kom pas. E don kolet 15 Grammy Awods, four Brit Awods, eleven Amerika Music Awods, 13 Soul Train Awods an e get three Guiness Wod rekods. E don sho for Music week best song raitas (2011) an Billboard Greatest of all Time Artist. (2019). Na Mars bi di fest Artist to kolet six Diamond-certified songs in di United States.

Im life an wok
</sub>1985- 2003: Hau e tek stat life an im musik wok.

Peter Gene Hernandez wey dem bon on October 8, 1985, in Honolulu, Hawaii, to Peter Hernandez an Bernadette San Pedro Bayot. Im papa na haf Jewish an haf Puerto Rican orijin, wey kom fom Brooklyn, New York. Mars don tok am bifor sey im fore fada na fom Hungary an Ukraine. Im mama muv fom Phillipines to Hawaii, an dem fit trac am Fillipino an Spain. Im mama an papa meet diasef wen dem dey du sho wia im mama dey danc Hula an im papa dey pley. Na sinc wen e dey two years old dem don dey kol am "Bruno" an na bikos e luk lik one pesin wey dey fight wrestle "Bruno Sammartino".

Mars na one pikin insaid di six pikin wey dia papa an mama bon, na hol of dem lik difren kain of songs. Dia mama na Sabi danc an sing, im papa 
pafom Little Richard's misik, wey dey insaid wetin mek Bruno lik to dey sing. Im Uncle lik to dey du lik Elvis Presley, an e dey tel Bruno wey dey three years to dey pafom song of Elvis Presley an Micheal Jackson. Wen e dey four years old dem dey du sho five days a week wit im famili band, "The Love Notes", an plenti pipu kon sabi am for Hawaii bikos e dey du lik Elvis Presley. Wen e dey five years old e pis for bodi wen e dey pafom Elvis Presley "Can't Help falling in love" (1961), wey mek im papa an mama dey tink weda e fit du misik, but Bruno no stop to dey sing. In 1990 Bruno dey insaid Hawaiian paper Midweek as "Little Elvis" an pafom for 1990 Aloha Bowl.

In 1992, e dey insaid Hooneymoon in Las Vegas fim an Pauley Shore of MTV ask am question on am. Wen Mars dey six years old, e dey insaid The Assensio Hall Show wen e dey smol, e pafom wit di famili band, two shos for one night, e dey hep Frankie Lymon an Little Anthony. Wen im smol, e get smol drum set, guitar, paino, an stil len hau to pley som Oda tins wey Dem dey tek pley songs. When Bruno dey 12 years old im papa an mama no dey togeda, wey mek "The Love Notes" end. Im papa biznes stop.  Na bikos of dat one mek dem no kon dey ci Moni lik bifor. E kon komot for im papa an mama haus wit im broda fada. Dey kon dey sta for one smol plez for Hawaii, for bak of car, on top roof, wia dem dey kip animal, Paradise Park, wey bi wia im papa dey wok bifor e stop. Dem chenj Mars skul bikos dem no dey du am wel for dia, but leta dem sabi am wel for di skul.

Hol di time Mars dey kopi Presley, hep am wel for im wok. E leta dey len guitar afta e ci hau Jimi Hendrix dey uze am. In 2020, e gree sey na im famili hep am for musik, e tok sey wetin mek am who e bi na im famili for Hawaii, sey im dey du plenti sho wit im papa for band's. E stil tok sey na evribodi for im famili sabi sing. Evrione sabi pley one tin wey dem dey uze sing. Wen e go President Theodore Roosevelt High School in Honolulu e sing wit one grup wey bi The School Boys, wey dem du plenti shos an dey open im papa niu band. Dey pafom songs wey the Isley Brothers an di Temptation du. Di singa wen e dey high skul, Dem sabi am wel wel, na im dey stat som big sho an e dey du kopi Micheal Jackson, Dem dey giv am $75 for one sho.

Na afta im sista wey dey sat for Los Angeles pley im demo for Mike Lynn(wey bi di oga for A&R at Dr. Dre's Aftermath Entertainment rekods), Lynn kol Mars kom Los Angeles. In 2003, wey e jus komot for skul, Mars go Los Angeles bikos of im musik wok.  E sta for Mansfield Avenue dat time. E sta wit di nem im papa giv am for smol Bruno, but e put "Mars" join am bikos: E tok sey plenti girls dey ask am for pizza an e no dey get am, nd dat one mek dem tink sey e no dey dis wod, sey im kon tink sey na fom Mars e kom fom. Anoda tin wey mek am get niu nem na bikos e no wan to dey difren, dat time dem dey ci am as anoda Latin singa. Dey trai mek am sing Spanish song sef.

 2004-2010: Prodoshon wok an It's Better If You Don't Understand  

Afta e go Los Angeles, Mars sign rekod kontrat wit Motown rekods in 2004, but di rekod no go wel, wey mek am folo Will.i.am management tok, wey no stil go wel sef. Afta Mars rekod deal no go wel, e no komot for Los Angeles an e leta get anoda kontrat wit Amerika rekod produsa Steve Lindsey an Cameron Strang at Waterside Independent in 2005.

Lindsey sho Mars an im frend wey dey rait song Brody Brown an Jeff Bhasker (wey Mars sabi wen e dey wit Mike Lynn) hep Mars sabi hau to rait pop music an dey difren fom odas. Lindsey tok sey: tek am five years to tich Bruno abaut som oda ogbonge artist wey pipu like dia songs.
title: Bruno Mars

text:
Cornelius Adam Igbudu (1914-1981) wey dem sabi as Adam Igbudu na di lait founding evanjelis of di Anglikan Adam Prishing Sosaiti (A.A.P.S), one evajelikal grup wey bi part of di Naija Anglikan Church. Isaiah Ogedegbe don kol am "Isoko ogbonge evanjelis". E also don kol am "persin wey kari mirakos for inside im bodi", wey dem sabi as persin wey don heal sick pipul.

For 1992, Profesor Michael Y. Nabofa rait one buk abaut im laif and dem dey kol di buk: "Adam: Di Evanjelis".
For May 1998, Profesor Sam U. Erivwo bin rait sey Bishop Agori Iwe, wey live dorin im laif taim, bin hold Cornelius Adam Igbudu "in very high regard".
For August 2022, Linus Edeigba also rait one buk abaut im laif.

Legasi
Today, dem don trace di orijin of som existing Naija independent churches to di evanjelistik ministri of Cornelius Adam Igbudu for di Naija Anglikan Church, and di nems of di churches na God's Grace Ministri wey D. D. Mimeyeraye dey lead (now dem sabi am as D. D. MiyeriJesu) and Niu Glori Revival Ministri wey S. U. Ayanyen dey lead.
To rekonice im evanjelistik achievemet for di Naija Anglikan Church, dem kol Cornelius Adam Igbudu a saint and dem also nem a church afta Igbudu (St. Adam's Anglikan Church for Oghio wey dey for di Olomu aria of Delta Stet).
Dem nem one sekondri skul for Araya (Adam Igbudu Memorial Sekondri Skul) afta Igbudu, inkluding one bibol skul for Emevor (Adam Igbudu Kristen Institute).

Di Anglikan Adam Prishing Sosaiti (A.A.P.S) nor end along wit Cornelius Adam Igbudu for 1981. In fact, e don grow ova di years and, akording to Profesor Sam U. Erivwo, through dis mofmet di Urhobo, di Isoko and di Itsekiri bin witness (and still dey witness) ogbonge revival.

Akording to Profesor Amos Utuama, e don tey since prishing of Bibol hapun for di Isoko neshon bikos as far bak as 1950, dem bin get one ogbonge Evanjelis wey bi di lait Cornelius Adam Igbudu.
Dem tok sey e bin "visit church afta church, win konvats and enkorej bilivas".
Dem also tok sey e bin get disagrimet wit one ogbonge Naija Isoko klerik, Akbishop Christian Aggrey Apena, wey e bin akyuz of "disturbing im ministri" for di Naija Anglikan Church.
Dem also tok sey e bin "leave betalicious legasi for di Christian race for Isoko".

Dem bon Akbishop Cyril Odutemu for May 2, 1972 for one krusade ground dorin di evanjelikal exploits of di lait popular evanjelis, Cornelius Adam Igbudu.
E bin spend 14 months for im mama belle and na di intavenshon of Cornelius Adam Igbudu mek im mama fit push am out for di krusade ground.

text:
Oba Adeyeye Enitan Ogunwusi CFR (dey bon am October 17, 1974) bi di 51 Ooni of Ife an e stil bi di niu Ooni of Ife. Ooni of Ife bi di tradishonal rula an king of di Yoruba kindom of Ile-Ife. Na for 2015 dey mek Ogunwusi di Ooni of Ile-Ife afta wey Oba Okunade Sijuwade kpai. Oba Okunade Sijuwade bi di nomba 50 pesin wey get di taitu Ooni of Ife.

Tori abaut e four-four fada-dem
Oba Adeyeye Enitan Ogunwusi wey pipo sabi as Ojaja II kom from di famili of Giesi, one of di four roya famili of di House of Oranmiyan. E papa gra-fada bi Prince Joseph Olagbaju Adewole Ogunwusi. Prince Joseph Ogunwusi gra-fada bi Oba Orayegba ( pipo sabi am as Ooni Orarigba or Orasigba) Ojaja I. Oba Joseph Ogunwusi bi di 44 Ooni of Ife an e kontro Ife from 1878 go rish 1880.

How e tek go skul
Oguwusi go Subuola Memorial Nursery and Primary School wey de Ibadan. E kom go Layola Kolej, Ibadan but finish e sekondri skul for St. Peters Secondary School, Ile-Ife. Na for St. Peter e tek rait e WAEC. Ogunwusi go rid akauntin from The Polytechnic, Ibadan.
Ogunwusi get honorari Ph.D satifiket in poblik hadiministrashon from  Yunivasiti of Nigeria, Nssuka. Igbinedion Yunivasiti give Ogunwusi a honorari Ph.D in Law.

Oba Ogunwusi bi di shanselor of Yunivasiti of Nigeria, Nssuka.
How e tek wok
Ogunwusi na memba of di Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria. E stil bi associate accounting technician. Ogunwusi bi memba of Institute of Directors. Ogunwusi bi memba of di Global Real Estate Institute''

text:
Death na wen pesin or livin tins stop to dey halife again. Wen livin tins kpai or die, dey start to dey rottin smol smol. To no wen pesin don kpai or die no bi easi tin. Bifor bifor, pipo tink sey na wen pesin hart no beat again or wen pesin no breath again bi death, but di CPR metod don show sey no bi so bikos pipol stil fit live once more even if dat kind tins hapun.

Oda pipo tok sey na wen di brain don kpai bi sey di pesin don kpai bi dat. Oda pipo no gri wit dis one an dey tok sey even if brain stil dey wok but di pesin oda pat of di bodi  wok, di pesin don kpai bi dat.

Meni kolsho biliv sey wen pesin kpai, di pesin go start life for anoda ples an di tinkin bi life afta death. For life afta death, dey biliv sey di pesin go risiv e jojmet weyda e do gud or bad wen e still dey halife for hie.
For som ples, pipo dey do difren tins to honor or respet pipo wen do kpai. Som pipo dey do parti, oda pipo dey put faya for dia dead bodi, an odas dey kari di dead bodi go montain an liv di dead bodi for di montain.

text:
Raymond Anthony Aleogho Dokpesi ( dey bon am 25 October1951 an e Kpai on 29 May 2023) na Naija pesin wey dey into T.V an redio bizness or make mass midi ha biziness. Na Dokpesi get Daar Communications kompini wey dey kontro Africa Independent Television, (AIT). E bi chairman of di hoganisin komitee of di People's Democratic Party wey happun for 2015.

How e tek stat life
Na for Ibadan wey de Naija dey bon Raymond Anthony Dokpesi on 25 October 1951. Dokpesi paret kom from Agenebode wey de Edo Stet. Dokpesi papa an mama bon seven pikin-dem. Dokpesi get six sista.

How e tek go skul
Dokpesi go Loyola kolej Ibadan. Leta, e go Immaculate Conception College (ICC) wey de Benin. For ICC, e bi one of di pipo wey start Ozolua Play House.
Ozolua Play House na dans an drama group. Dokpesi go Yunivasiti of Benin, Edo Stet, but na for e finish e Yunivasiti edukeshon for Yunivasiti of Gdansk in Poland. Na for Yunivasiti of Gdansk Dokpesi tek do e Ph.D in Marine Enjinerin. Dokpesi enjoi free edukeshon fro sekondiri to yunivasiti bikos na halaji Bamanga Tukur dey pay e skul moni.
In di 1990s, di govamet law tok sey na onli dem go dey tok Niuz. For Naija dat time, na onli T.V an redio stashon wey govamet get dey tok Niuz. Wen General Ibrahim Babangida bikom di presidor, e tok sey eni bodi wey get di moni fit get T.V an redio stashon wey dey tok Niuz. Di fest T.V stashon wey pesin wey no de govamet wan get for Naija na Dokpesi stashon, Africa Independent Television, (AIT). AIT bi di fest Satalite Televihon Stashon in Afrika. Na Dokpesi fest stat T.V an redio stashon wey govamet no dey chuk mouth for Naija.
Dokpesi tok sey na e stashon helep arrenj how prisenta dey kolet beta salari wey odas TV stashon like NTA (Nigerian Television Authority) kom kopi leta.

How e tek wok
Dokpesi fest wok as di PA (pasonal hasistas) for halaji Bamaga Tukur. Halaji Bamaga Tukur na one of di jenera manija of NPA ( Nijiria Pot Ortoriti). Dokpesi don also wok as govamet workas in di Fediral Ministri of Transport onda Halaji Umaru Dikko an Jeneral Garba Wushishi.

Africa Ocean Lines
Africa Ocean Lines bi di fest biziness wey Dokpesi fest do. Di kompini bi di fest shipin kompini wey Afrika pesin wan get in di hol of Afrika.Na for 1980s Dokpesi Start Africa Ocean Lines. Di biziness leta skata, but helep Naija shipin indostrie bikos e stat di law wey dey kontro shipin biziness as e dey Nigerian Shipping Act Decree 1986. An dis start di 40:20:20 for load wey dey kom from oyinbo land to Afrika land.

Daar Communications
Dokpesi start di fest redio stashon wey pesin wey no de govamet get Raypower in 1994. In 1996, e start di fest T.V stashon wey no bi govamet stashon in Naija AIT.

Palava abaut am
For 4 October 2010, Dey harest Dokpesi sey e hand de di Abuja car bombing. Afta nine hours wey e enta polis hand,dey kom rilis am mek e dey go. Dokpesi kom kari Naija Polis go kot for wetin dem do am.
Dokpesi komplain to di politika parti wey e de PDP bikos of sey dey chuz Goodluck Jonathan to bi di pesin wey go bi dia kandidet for presidor eleshon.

Sikness an how e tek kpai
For 2020, Dokpesi an memba of e famili kach di Korona vairus, COVID-19 an dey kari dem go  Yunivasiti of Abuja Tishin Hospitu. Dey tel Dokpesi an two of e gran-pikin sey mek dey go home afta wey di disis don komot from dia bodi on 14 May, 2020.
Na Stroke kill Dokpesi on 29 May 2023. Dokpesi na 71 year old wen e kpai.

Awod an Honor
Di vilej wey Dokpesi tek kom give am two shif taitu. Dey menshon Dokpesi nem dorin Dr Kwame Nkrumah lidaship awod serimoni in Accra E nem stil kom out for "Foundation for Excellence in Business Practice" wey hapun for Geneva Switzeland for di wok wey e do for e kompini "Daar Communication"

Olufemi Hakeem Gbajabiamila CFR (dey bon am 25 June 1962) na Naija lorya an politishian. E bi memba of APC. (All Progressive Congress). Na Gbajabiamila bi di Spika of di House of Repisentativ sins 2019.

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Legos in Naija dey tek bon Olufemi Hakeem Gbajabiamila on 25 June 1962. E papa nem na Lateef Gbajabiamila an e mama nem na Olufunke Gbajabiamila. Femi Gbajabiamila go "Mainland Preparatory School" for e pamari skul an Igbobi Kolej for e sekondiri skul. Na for  King William's Kolej wey de Isle of Man, in United Kindom Gbajabiamila tek rait e A-Level ezaminashon.
Gbajabiamila rid Law from di Yunivasiti of Legos an kolet e Bashelor  digree (LL.B) in 1984. Dey kol Gbajabiamila to Naijiria bar in 1984.

Di fest wok wey Gbajabiamila do as lorya na to wok for one law kompini kol Bentley Edu & Co. wey de Legos. E leta go form e law kompini Femi Gbaja & Co. Gbajabiamila kolet e juris Doctor from Atlanta's John Marshall Law School wey de Georgia, USA. E pass di "Georgian bar ezaminashon in 2001 an form law kompini in Atlanta. Wen Gbajabiamila stil dey USA, e put bodi for di eleshon wey Bill Campbell win an Bill Campbell leta kom bi di Mayor of Atlanta.

How e tek join polititis
In 2003, Gbajabiamila win to enta "House of representatives" wey e repriset Surulere I Konstitushon of Legos Stet. Gbajabiamila tok sey wetin Nashonal Hasembi memba dey do as dem dey chenj from one politika parti to anoda no gud. E stil tok sey meni pipo wey dey go vote no get koret informeshon abaut pesin wey dey wan vote for an sey na di pesin wey dia parti chuz dem sef dey chuz wen votin.
Gbajabiamila don bi di Minority Leader foh di House of representatives in di 7th Nashonal Assembli.

E Wayo-Wayo kase
Afta wey dem bon pass di PIB (Petroleum Industry Bill) in August 2021, Gbajabiamila an e frend-dem wey dey mek law na im pipo hakuss sey dey kolet bribe to sopot di law even as Naija pipo no   gree to somtins wey de inside di PIB law. Hakordin to wetin People Gazette tok, Timipre Sylva an Bassey Albert bribe di Sinate with moni wey go pass $10 million. Dat time, Timipre Sylva na Minista of Stet for petirol risosis an Bassey Abert na sinator for Akwa Ibom North-East. Di niuz-pepa tok sey na bitwin  $1.5 million to $2 million go to Gbajabiamila an di sinate presidor Ahmad Lawan.

Awod
In October 2022, forma presidor of Naija, [℅Muhammadu Buhari]] awod Gbajabiamila CFR (Commander of the Federal Republic).

Mallam Nuhu Ribadu (dey bon am for 21 November 1960) na forna Naija polis ofisa an politishan wey don bi Chairman of di "Petroleum Revenue Task Force". Ribadu don wok as di oga pata pata for EFCC (Economic and Financial Crimes Commission). EFCC na one govamet hoganasashon wey dey kach an ponish politishan an pipo wey chop moni or do wayo.

For April 2009, Ribadu bikom visit leshura for di Senta for Gobal Divelopmet.
Ribadu run komot for Naija but e kom bak in 2010. In 2010, Ribadu tel evribodi sey e wan go di presidor posishon with di politika parti ACN (Arkshon Kongress of Naijiria). Na on 14 January 2011 Ribadu kom bi di kandidet of ACN wey go fight to be presidor of Naija in di eleshon.

Ribadu run komot from e parti ACN go anoda parti wey dey in kontro at dat time, PDP bikos e wan yuz PDP tek fight to bi di govno of Adamawa Stet. Adamawa Stet de di " North East"of Naija.

Mercy Nnenda Chinwo na Naija gospe musician, singa, actress, comedian and songwrita.  She start to sing wen she dey for 6 years for her church chidren kwaya. For 2018 she release di hit single "Excess Love".

Eali laif an edukashun 
Mercy Nnenda Chinwo wey dem born on Septemba 5, 1991, for Rivers State. Mercy get her fes skul leevin sertifiket for di Goodwill international skul and her secondary skul edukashun for Paradise international skul. She bi alumna of di International Business Management Institute (IBMI) wea she kollekt degri for Human Resources Management.

Persunal Laif 
She marry on 13th of August 2022 for Port Harcourt to Pastor Blessed Uzochikwa and dem dey live for Lagos, Naija.

Kariya an filantropi 
Chinwo singul 'Excess Love' wey dem release for 2018 bin catch di attentɔn of not onli di Naija gospel miusik industry, but also for internashonal level. Chinwo bin release her first singul, "Testimony" for 2015, and "Igwe". One year afta, wey be 2017, she enta gospel record label.

Chinwo na one gospel music ministar. Since wen she burst enta di gospel scene, she don enta plenti gospel music projekts, wey she don work wit big names like JJ Hairson, Nathaniel Bassey, Chioma Jesus, Banky W, Joe Praize, Samsong, Moses Bliss, Dunsin Oyekan, Preye Odede and plenti odas.

Chinwo other chas-chase dem include acting, entrepreneruship; and humanitarin wok. For 2023, she join bodi wit her bobo start MercyisBlessed Foundation, na NGO wey dey focused on donations to di pipo wey no get plenty and also to dey develop di youths among odas.

Achivments 

 For 2018, Chinwo bin collect award as di Best Gospel Artiste for Climax Awards 2018.
 For 2019, for di first time wey dem do Africa Gospel Awards Festival (AGAFEST 2019), Chinwo be di winner for categories like Africa Gospel New Artiste of the Year, Africa Gospel Female Artiste of the Year, and Africa Gospel Song of the Year (Excess Love).

Emmanuel Chukwuemeka Ejekwu wey pipo sabi wel wel as Mr Funny or Oga Sabinus na Naija pesin wey dey akt fonni tins an aktor.

Hau e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Port Harcourt Mr Funny tek stat e edukeshon an e go Yunivasiti of Port Harcourt go rid "Linguistics and Communication". Mr Funny get e B.Sc digree from di Yunivasiti.

Hau e tek wok
Na for 2015 Mr Funny stat to dey du komendi but pipo start to sabi am wel wel in 2019.

Wen di nem of pipo wey dem wan give awod for di niu 2021 "The Humor Awards Academy" serimoni, Mr Funny nem kom out as one of dos komendia wey fit win di aword. Baskemouth nem sef folo for di katigori.

For 2015 Skul Student Union wik, e rili paform  wel wel  for di wik. Afta dat time, Mr Funny kom stat to dey post e smol smol fonni vidio for soshal midiha.
Na for Instagram e post am pass. Afta wey e don post meni fonni vidio for Instagram, meni pipo kom dey post e vidio for instagram. Mr Funny yuz di one popula an e kom get plenti folowas.

Mr Funny bi di brand ambasedor for one popula bettin site: Oddstackr an meni oda one. Some of di komendia wey Mr Funny dey folo dia footstep bi Mr Ibu an Charles Inojie.

text:
N'Golo Kanté (Dem bon am for 29 March 1991) na ogbenge French futbola wey dey pley as divensiv midfeilder for premier league klob Chelsea an for France Nashona team. Dem sabi am as bes midfielder for wod, dem sabi am bikos of hau e dey tek kolet bol an hau e dey pas bol wel. E go join Saudi Pro League klob  Al-Ittihad on July 1 2023. Kante fest pley for sinior team futbol of Boulogne in 2012, e enta for anoda playa for one Ligue 2 match, an e pley for third division di year wey folo. Afta dat klob e join anoda klob wey dey Ligue 2, Caen on a free transfa, dem finish third wey mek dem kom pley for Ligue 1. E dey wit di klob for anoda one year. In 2015, Kanté join Leicester City for £5.6 million.

Kanté dey insaid Leicester team wey win Premier League championship in 2016. Year wey folo e join Chelsea for £32 million an win di league, na dat one mek am dey insaid playas wey don win league wit difren klob wit Eric Cantonna in 1992 an 1993. Wit Chelsea e don win FA Cup,  di UEFA Europa League, di UEFA Champions League, di UEFA Super Cup, an di FIFA World Cup. Onli am, don win Premier League playa of di season, di PFA playas' of the year, di FWA Futbola of the year, di UEFA  Men's Midfielder of di year an di Troophées UNFP for Bes French playa abroad two times.

Kante fes pley for im kontri France in 2016 an na dem kari sekond at di 2016 European Championship's. In 2017, na Kanté dem giv French  playa if di Year, wey bi fes for playa wey dey premier league in seven years, an twelve month leta e stil dey insaid FIFA Wod Kop winning team.

Im klob wok
Boulogne

Dem bon am for Paris to Malian papa an mama. Kanté stat to dey du im wok wen e dey eight years old for JS Suresnes, e dey dia for ten years. Sekond Coach Pierre Ville tok sey plenti big team no wan buy am bikos of im smol bodi an e no dey lik mek onli am dey again. Dem no gree sign am for Clairefontaine Academy. In 2010, Arsene Wenger wey bi Arsenal manager dat time wan sign Kanté. Suresnes' president (wey bi Wenger best frend) kari am go difren klobs. E join Boulogne risarf team, an fes pley for di team insaid beta match on 18 March 2012, Ligue 2 season, dey lus di match 1-2 to Monaco. E enta for Virgile Reset for di las 11 minutes. 

For di 2012-13 season, e pley for di third Championnat National, an na onli one game e mis. On 10 August, e skore im fes sinior goal, na di goal bi di onli goal wey enta dat day wey dem win Luzenac at di Stade de la Libération. 

Caen

In 2013 e join Ligue 2 Caen an pley hol 38 match for im fes season, na dem kari third for ligue 2 ,wey mek dem kom Ligue 1. Insaid im sekond match e skore goal wey insaid 2-1 game wit Laval; e still skore anoda goal On April 11 2014, insaid 3-2 match wit Istres. 

Season wey folo, Kante pley 37 games as Caen dey  Ligue 1,  e no pley one match bikos of red kard wey e Kolet web dey pley Rennes on 30 August. Bifor dat one e don skore dia 3-0 win wit Elvian. Na e Kolet bol pas for pesin leg insaid Europe for dat season.

Leicester City

Steve Walsh hep Leicester fain Kanté, an na im stil dem sain Rihad Mahrez an Jamie Vardy. On 3 August 2015, e join Leicester onda four year kontrat, for moni wey dem no let pipu no, bit som tok sey e rich £8 million (£5.6 million). E fed pley for dem afta five days web e enta for Jamie Vardy insaid match wey dem win 4-2 wit Sunderland. On 7 November, e skore im fes premier League goal web dem pley wit Watford, dey win di match 2-1 for dia aouse. 

Plenti pipu lik hau e tek pley for Leicester, Som tok sey na bikos e pley wel wel mek Leicester wn 2015-2016 Premier League. In April e dey insaid four playas wey dem chuz fom Leicester wey mek PFA Team of di year. 

Chealsea

2016-2018: League and FA Kop Finals

On 16 July 2016, Kanté sign five years kontrat wit Chealsea wey pay £2million for am. Na Arsenal wan sign am bifor bit dey leta komot hand bikos of sey Di moni tu plenti. Na nomba 7 shirt dem giv Kanté, wey don dey ground sins Remires don komot for Chealsea. 

On 15 August 2016, Kanté pley im fest match web dem pley wit West Ham United. Ontop sey e Kolet yello kard, Kanté hep Chelsea win di match 2-1. Afta 3 months wey e go Chelsea, e pley match wit im bifor bifor team Leicester, na im bi Man if di match afta dey win 3-0. On 23 October, e skore im fest goal for Chealsea insaid 4-0 wey dem beat Manchester United.

On 26 December 2016, na Kanté L'Équipe kol as di sixth bes fotbola of 2016. On March 2013, na Kanté bi di man of di match an e stil skore goal in di 51th minutes, insaid FA quarter final match win wit Manchester United for Stamford Bridge. On 20 April, Kanté nem dey insaid di PFA Team of di year for di sekond season. Na Kanté bi di PFA playas' of di year , di FWA futbola of di year, an di Premier League futbola of di season. Na Kanté bi di fes playa wey win League for England one year an di year wey folo wit two difren klobs, afta Eric Cantona in 1993. Kanté nem dey insaid playas wey go win Ballon d'Or in October 2017. E win prize as FA kop win a, wen e pley for 90 minutes for final wit Manchester United on May 19 2018, na dem win 1-0 for di match. BBC Sport giv Kanté man of di match.

2018-22: European an Champion wod

Kanté sign for 5 years for Chealsea on 23 November 2018, an na im dey Kolet moni pas for di klub. Kanté skore Chealsea fest goal insaid dia 2-1 EFL Kop win wit Tottenham Hotspur, di match finish for 2-2 wey mek dia two pley penalty. Kanté skore im 300th goal for klubs web dem pley wit Burnley 2-2 on 22 April. 

Kanté no stat match wen di 2019 premier League stat bikos of e get wund. E no stil pley for Champions League match wey dem pley wit Valencia. Na onli Kanté skore for Chealsea wen dem pley Liverpool 2-1 for Stamford Bridge on 22 September 2019. Di fes goal wey e skore for Premier League dey insaid goal wey dem wan giv best goal of di month. Kanté skore for Chealsea wen dem pley Manchester City, na 2-1 Manchester City beat dem  on 23 November.

For May 2020, wen COVID 19 dey, Kanté dey du pratis for aouse afta Chelsea don dey du pratis bak. Di klub no fait am dem sopot wetin e du. Kanté pley wel wel web dey stat League wit Brighton & Hove Albion match, Chealsea win di match 3-1 on 14 September 2020.

E sta for Chealsea rich 200 wen dem pley Champions League wit Atletico Madrid. Na dem win di match 1-0 for round of 16. Plenti pipu lik hau e pley wel wel wen dey pley Atletico Madrid an Real Madrid, web dem dey trai enta final. Na Kanté bi man of di match as e win im fest UEFA Champions League web dey beat Manchester United 1-0 in di 2021 UEFA Champions League final for Porto. 

For September 2021, Kanté go du test an dem tel am sey e get COVID-19, wey mek an dey far from pipu for ten days. On 8 October, Kanté nem dey insaid 30 playas wey dem kol dia nem wey fit win Ballon'd'Or. On 13 February 2022, e hep Chealsea win dia fest Wod klub kop wen dey win Palmeres 2-1.

Hau e tek wok for im kontri

Papa an mama wey bon am na fom Mali, wey mek Mali kol am to kom pley for dem insaid 2015 Afrika kop of Nations. Kanté no gree for dem bikos e tok sey e wan fas Ligue 1. Mali stil ask am kom pley for dem in January 2016, e tok sey e neva no wia e go pley weda na France or Mali.

On 17 March 2016, Kanté nem dey for insaid playas wey go pley for France sinior team wey go pley Netherlands an Russia insaid pley pley match. E pley insaid match for dem afta 8 days, wen e enta for Lussana Diarra for half time when dey win Amsterdam Arena 3-2. On im birthday, e skore for im kontri insaid di match wey dem pley wit Russia for Stade de France; anoda birthday pesin for di sem march 29, Damitri Payet tu skore.

On June 10 2016, Kanté pley im fes competishion match for France wen e stat di fes match in Euro 2016 dem pley wit Romania. E pley di hol match for France. On 17 May 2018, e dey insaid 23  French playas wey dem kol for 2018 FIFA Wod Kop. E pley hol di 7 match for France. Na im bi man of di match insaid di match dem pley wit Denmark on 26 June, di match finish 0-0, an on 15 July,  Kanté pley insaid di final match wen dem pley Croatia, na France win di match 4-2. 

In May 2021, France kol Kanté to kom pley for dem insaid UEFA Euro 2020. Kanté mis 2022 Wod Kop bikos e get wund.

Im pasona life
Kanté na Muslim. Na Paris dem bon am to papa an mama wey kom fom Mali in 1980. E gro for one smol plez in Rueil-Malmaison, Hauts-de-Seine. Im papa kpai wen e dey 11 years old an I'm sista kpai bifor dem stat 2018 Wod Kop. 

Kanté sista dey pley for Suresnes. Ronaldo, Ronaldinho, an Diego's Maradonna na playa wey e lik wen e smol. Wen e dey 21 years old, wen e dey pley for Boulogne, e get diploma in Vocational Accounting.

Som pipu lik to dey kol am "NG". Anoda tin wey e lik to dey du na to dey pley tebble tennis. E lik karaoke songs. Kanté bes fud na thieboudienne bikos na wetin e mama lik to dey du for am wen e smol bi dat.

text:
Nasir Ahmad El-Rufai CON (dem bon am for 16 February 1960) na Naija politishian wey don bi govno of Kaduna Stet from 2015 go rish 2023. El-Rufai na bifor bifor minista of di Fediral Kapital Teritiri from 2003 go rish 2007. E don bi daretor of di Dipatmet of Poblik Entaprisis. El-Rufai bi one of di pipo-dem wey form APC (All Progressive Kongress.

How e tek stat life
Na on 16 February 1960 dey bon Nasir Ahmad El-Rufai inside one Fulani famili wey de Daudawa. Daudawa na one Fulani vilej wey de Kaduna. Wen El-Rufai dey  8 year, e papa kpai an dis one mek e onku wey de Kaduna dey tekia of am. Na El-Rufai onku kari am go an pay moni for El-Rufai pamari an sekondiri skul.

Na three wife El-Rufai mari. E fest wife na Hadiza Isma El-Rufai wey bi raita wey dey rait novel. Na El-Rufai fest wife dey kontro di  Yasmin El-Rufai Fondashon (YELF). Di Fondashon na to rimemba dia gel-pikin wey kpai in 2011.

How e tek go skul
E get satifiket of masta digree in Poblik Hadministrashon from  John F. Kennedy Skul of Govamet of Harvard Yunivasiti on June 2009. El-Rufai go Barewa Kolej. Wen e stil be junior for Balewa Kolej dat time, na  former presidor Umaru Yar'Adua bi di house kaptain for di hostel wey El-Rufai stey.

Wen El-Rufai finish di skul in 1976, na im no buk pass an e kolet di awod "Barewa Old Boys Association Academic Achievement" Awod.

El-Rufai go Ahmadu Bello Yunivasiti wey de Zaria. For di Yunivasiti, e kolet Bashelor Digree (B.Sc) in quantity surveying with fest klass honor.

El-Rufai do e masta in Bizness Hadiministrashon  an e finish in 1984 from Ahmadu Bello Yunivasiti. El-Rufai don go meni profeshonal program like Georgetown School of Foreign Service in Georgetown Yunivasiti Georgetown Yunivasiti de Washington, D.C. E don also go meni program on privataliseshon an lidaship.

El-Rufai risiv a Law digree from di Yunivasiti of London on August 2008. E get satifiket of masta digree in Poblik Hadministrashon from  John F. Kennedy Skul of Govamet of Harvard Yunivasiti on June 2009.

How e tek wok
El-Rufai form El-Rufai & Partners, one kwuliti surverin kompini wey dey advais pipo on how dia budin go mit standard budin. El-Rufai form di kompini with three partna an di kompini in 1998. Durin di time wey militiri souja dey kontro Naija from 1983 go rish 1998, El-Rufai & Partner kolet meni budin an sivil enjinerin wok.  Na im stil kolet some kontrat in Abuja an dis kontrat mek dem "young millioniha".

El-Rufai stil get manijimet wok for two intanashonal fone kompini. Di nem of di two kompini na AT &T Netwok sistems intanashonal BV an Motorola Inc.

How e tek join politis

Wen di head of stet, Jeneral Sani Abacha kpai in 1998, di presidor wey tek ova, Jeneral Abdulsalami Abubakar  chuz El-Rufai as di ekonomik advaisa of Naija. Dis wok mek am fit wok with Wold Bank an IMF (Intanashonal Monitori Fund.

Wen di militiri komot for pawa an demokrasi  mek Olusegun Obasanjo di presidor of Naija in 1999, Obasanjo chuz El-Rufai as di daretor of di  Bureau of Poblik Enterprises an seketiri of di Nashonal Kansu of Privataseshon wey e join bodi wok with di dwn Vais Presidet Atiku Abubakar.

El-Rufai tok sey e wan kampain to bikom di govno of  Kaduna Stet.

How e tek riton to politis

El-Rufar waka komot from Naija in 2008 an wen e dey outside di kontri, e jos dey tok bad tins wey Umaru Yar'Adua govamet dey do.

In 2010, El-Rufai kom bak to di kontri an di EFCC (Ekonomik  an Finashial Krime Kommishon harest am kwik-kwik. El-Rufai tok sey e kom bak to Naija bikos e wan wash e nem from di bad bad tins wey pipo dey hakuss am of. For 2011, El-Rufai join di politikal parti CPC (Kongress for Progresiv Chenj). CPC parti sopot Muhammadu Buhari Kampain in di  2011 presidetal eleshon.

For 2013, El-Rufai bikom di deputi nashonal sekretiri of di niu politikal parti APC ( All Progresiv  Kongress). E win di eleshon an e yuz ova 1 millon vote pass di govno of Kaduna Mukhtar Ramalan Yero  wey komot as PDP (Pipo Demokrati Parti).

El-Rufai stil win di sekod term eleshon e enta as govno for di sekod time on 9 March 2019. E yuz ova 200,000 vote tek pass e sekod kandidet.

text:
William Folorunso Kumuyi (dey bon am 6 June 1941) na Naija pastor wey bi di Fonda an general presidet of Dipa Kristen Life Bible Ministri wey de Gbagada,  Legos Stet. Kumuyi don rait meni kristen buks. Na on 6 June 2021 Kumuyi do e 80 years birthday.

How e tek stat life
Na for Erin-Ijesa wen de  Osun Stet in Naija dey tek bon Kumuyi.  E famili na kristen famili. Kumuyi go  Mayflower Skul wey de Ikenne , Ogun Stet an e finish e sekondiri skul edukeshon in 1961. Kumuyi kom go  Yunivasiti of Ibadan fo rid matimatis. E finish with fest-klass an kolet e satifiket in 1967. Na Kumuyi no buk pass for di yunivasiti dat year.

Kumuyi  go rid  Edukeshon korse in  Yunivasiti of Legos. 

Na on April 5, 1964 Kumuyi giv e life to Krist wen e bi 23 years.
Wen Kumuyi wan tok abaut e life wen e dey smol, e tok sey:
E go wake up for morin, rid Bible, sing song to God, an e dey alway go chorch.
Kumuyi tok sey wen e dey sekondiri skul, e no kom biliv sey God de again bikos Kumuyi prinsipal for skul dey tish dem sey God no dey too.

Leta, Kumuyi tok sey e kom stat to dey go chorch difren chorch wey de aria bak.

Kumuyi like to dey rid John Wesley, Charles Finney, an Charles Spurgeon buk dem an dis one helep am wel wel.
Kumuyi papa na memba of Angilika Chorch. For one niuz-pepa wey ue nem na The Sun (Nigeria), di niuz-pepa tok sey Kumuyi na forma memba of Angilika chorch ( di niu nem of di chorch now bi Anglican Communion), Selesiha Chorch of Krist, Scripture Union (SU) muvmet an  Apostolik Faith bifor e form Dipa Life.

How e tek do tishin wok
In 1962, Kumuyi start to tish matimatis for Mayflower Skul di skul wey e tek finish. By 1970, e don bi leshural for Yunivasiti of Legos. 
Pastor Kumuyi do one day program wey e wan tek tok to ova 50,000 young pipo in Legos so dat dey go fit komot bodi from bad bad tins.

How e tek stat kristen ministiri

In 1973 wen Kumuyi still bi leshural for Yunivasiti of Legos, e start to dey diskuss with 15 studet wey kom mit am for Bible  tranin. Na dis Bible tranin kom lid to di fondashon of Dipa Kristen Life Ministiri.

Apostolik chorch tel Kumuyi mek e no dey kom dia chorch again in 1975 bikos Kumuyi dey tish Batisim of di Holi Spirit. E kontiniu dey du e ministiri onti 1982 wey di ministiri komvikom Dipa Life Bible Chorch.

As at 2005, Dipa Life Chorch  don get Ova 800,000 difren aria to woship.

Dipa Life head-ofis dey Gbagada, Legos. Di chorch get a ples wey ova 30,000 pipo fit sit-down an woship God. Pipo wey sabi tins tok sey dat ples bi di nomba four ples wey big pass if dem dey tok about chorch wey get ples wey pipo fit woship.

Wen dey wan opun di big chorch aria wey 30,000 pipo fit woship on 24 April 2018, meni big big pipo kom dia like di vais presidor of Naija, Yemi Osinbajo.

Dipa Life still get oda ples like di "Deeper Life Conference Centre" wey de  Ogun Stet at Kilomita 42, Legos-Ibadan Expressway an IBTC ( International Bible Traning Centre]] wey de Ayobo, Legos.

text:
Ramon Olorunwa Abbas ( dey bon am 11 October 1982) wey pipo no wel wel as Hushpuppi, Hush, or  Ray Hushpuppi na Naija pesin wey like to dey sho-kes wetin e get for sosha midiha like Instagram. Hushpuppi na kriminal wey United Stet give 11 years in prisin. Di kot tok sey Hushpuppi dey do yahoo-yahoo, e yuz wayo kolet moni wey go rish 40 million dorlas from one US law kompini, e yuz wayo transfa $14.7 million from one bank akaunt, an sey e dey plan to thif $124 million from one English Premier League Klub.

Bifor Dubai Polis  kach Hushpuppi an hand-ova  am give United Stet, Hushpuppi dey post piksho an vidio of how e dey spent moni. Di vidio an piksho dey show e motor, e bag, e disaina klot. Hushpuppi dey show wetin e buy from Gucci, Fendi, an Louis Vuitton. E vidio an pisho stil dey show how e de inside helikopta, with pipo wey get nem, with futbola, an Naija politishan.

Hushpuppi tok sey e wok na kontrator wey dey supavais estate.
Hushpuppi get St Kitts and Nevis visa bikos of one wayo marej wey e tek mari one wuman wey kom from St Kitts and Nevis.

Di night wey dey harest Hushpuppi  for di Palazzo Versace Dubai wey e dey stey, Di polis si moni wey pass 150 million dirham ( na like $40 million) for e poket, 13 big motor wey go rish $7 million, 21 laptop, 47 big fone, 15 memori kard, an email of 800,000 pipo an one bag kase wey moni full am.

Na one investigeshon wey oyinbo polis FBI  na e lid to Hushpuppi harest bikos di investigeshon show sey e de among di pipo wey dey put hand for moni wey dey thif yuzin intanet.

How e tek start life
Meni niuz-pepa tok sey na sekod-hand klot (okirika) Hushpuppi dey sel for Legos.  Hushpuppi dey tok about  di time wey e smol wey e no get moni. Mompha, one pesin wey dey helep pipo chenj oyinbo moni for Naija tok sey Hushpuppi papa still dey yuz motor kari pipo for road in Legos.
Wen one Naija niuz-pepa kol The Cable intavihu one of Hushpuppi neibor, di neibor tok sey meni pipo for aria don no Hushpuppi as Yahoo boys an sey Hushpuppi no yuz e moni helep eni of e famili. Di neibor tok sey Hushpuppi no yuz e moni helep eni of e frend an sey, wen pipo dey warm am abaut e life patta, e no hear lisin.

Balogun Afolabi Oluwaloseyi (dem bon am for 12 July 2000) wey pipul sabi wel wel as Seyi Vibez na Naija singa an song raita. Pipul sabi Seyi Vibez afta e rilis di muzik "Chance (Na Ham)" from di sekod muzik habom wey e nem "Billion Dollar Baby". Billion Dollar Baby  habom rish nomba 19 on di UK Afrobit Singu an e rish nomba 7 on di Turn Table Top 100 chart

How e tek stat life
Na for Ketu wey de Legos Stet dey bon Seyi Vibez on 12 July 2000. Seyi Vibez kom komot from Ketu go Ikorudu an na from Ikorodu e tek gro up.
Do fest muzik singu wey e fest sing na "Anybody". Na di muzik "Godsent" mek pipo start to no am smol smol. For di sem year wey e rilis Godsent e rilis e fest habom kol "Nl Seyi No Vibez (NSNV). For 2022, Seyi Vibez rilis e sekod habom "Billion Dollar Baby" an e still rilis e Mixtape "Billion Dollar Baby 2.0".
"Billion Dollar Baby habom rish nomba 1 on di Turntable 50 albums chart. MoreBranches put Seyi Vibez as one of di sistin (16) Afrika muzishian wey for do wel in 2022.

Seyi Vibez rilis e nomba 5 habom kol "Memory Card" an singa wey folo am sing for di habom bi: Amerika rappa YXNG K.A.
Di fest week wey Seyi Vibez rilis di habom, na ova 6.3 million lisin to di habom from intanet an e dominet di "Turntable top 10 chart an Pan African Music nem di habom as one of ten best habom of January 2023.

Zlatan wok with Seyi Vibez to rilis Let There Be Light song on February 2, 2023. Di muzik rish nomba 14 on "Apple Music top 100 Nigeria chart".
OkayAfrica nem "Alaska''", one of di singu from Seyi Vibez as one of di best muzik to kom from Naija

As e mama kpai
For March 16, Seyi Vibez mama kpai. Seyi Vibez no tok wetin kil am but e tok sey e mama death pain am no be smol.

E fight wit Zinoleesky
Zinoleesky an Seyi Vibez no be frend at all. Di two singa dey tok enihow to demsef on soshal midia. Di fight start wen Zinoleesky advais Seyi Vibez sey mek e go bak to di way e dey sing bifor an some advais on how Seyi Vibez muzik fit beta wel wel.

Wetin Zinoleesky tok song no swit Seyi Vibez an e advais am mek e fest wok hard to get niu house bifor tokin to am.

Janani Luwum (dem bon am for 1922 and e kpai for Febuari 16, 1977), wey dem sabi as Janani Jakaliya Luwum, na di lait Akbishop of di Church of Uganda from 1974 to 1977.

For 1971, Idi Amin bin tek ova pawa by force from Milton Obote. Wen e dey in pawa, e yuz im pawa tek kpai meni pipul and som jos dey miss for di kontri.

Janani Luwum, wey bi di Akbishop of Uganda for dat taim, nor dey hapi wit di way pipul wey go against Idi Amin jos dey miss. Im posishon as di Akbishop of Uganda mek e dey hard for am to shut up ova di mata of harsh lidaship of Idi Amin. So, togeda wit orda relijos figors for di kontri, e bin rait one serious leta of protest to Idi Amin, wie e tok sey mek Idi Amin stop all di bad tins wey e dey do to im pipul.

Wen Idi Amin receive di message, e feel sey dem don insult am and e arrest Janani Luwum and quickli arenj wayo trial for am wey find am guilti. Na so di Akbishop Janani Luwum tek kolet bulet wotowoto from Idi Amin men for Febuari 1977.

Since 2015 Uganda dey do poblik holide for evri 16 Febuari, to selibrate di laif of Janani Luwum, wey Isaiah Ogedegbe don kol "di man wey neva mek peace wit oppreshon".

text:
Christian Aggrey Apena (dem bon am for May 16, 1931 and e kpai for Oktoba 10, 2022), wey dem also sabi as Christian Aggrey Ovwoma Apena, na di leit Naija relijos figor wey start di Bethesda Gospo Mishon.
Na im bi di fest ordained Pentikosta Bishop and Akbishop for Delta Stet, Naija.

Apena papa na im bi di fest pastor for di Isoko rijon wey dem ordain for 31 Disemba 1931 and dem almost ordain Apena as Anglikan pastor bifor one relijos katakata mek am komot from di church. Akording to Apena, "I komot from di Anglikan Church bikos I get di Pentikosta spirit wey dem nor get". Wen e still dey di Church of Naija, Apena tok sey e bin get disagrimet wit di lait Evanjelis Cornelius Adam Igbudu wey bin akiuz am of "disturbing im ministri" for di Naija Anglikan Church. Afta e don komot from di Naija Anglikan Church, e bin work wit di lait Akbishop Benson Idahosa for di Church of God Mishon Intanashonal but e leta go im way to start im own ministri.

Ministri
Apena bin start im ministri for im vilej Irri wey dey for di Isoko Saut Lokal Gofmet Aria of Delta Stet, Naija. As persin wey dem dey kol "di papa of Pentikostalism" for Delta Stet, dem sabi am evriwie for ordaining and mentoring meni Naija relijos figors for di stet.
Dem also sabi am evriwie as "a man wey bin spik truth to pawa" and Isaiah Ogedegbe don kol am "a veri hombo man of God wit di betalicious milk of di Word". 

Akording to Delta Stet bifor Gofnor Ifeanyi Okowa, Apena bin leave "di legasi of integriti and koret Bibol tishings". Okowa also tok sey "e bi strong voice for di Kristen komuniti wie e bin tish di word of God witout fear or favour".
Akording to Isaiah Ogedegbe, "For a long taim, e bi a prisha of truth, an ezampo of agape luv, and jeniu humiliti. E dey sefles and komited to im koling".
Anorda persin also tok sey Apena bin "leave behind a legasi of humiliti, integriti, truthfulnes and steadfastnes to God". Dem biliv sey e don fait "a gud fait of feit and komplit im earthli race and mishon".

Dai and beriha
Apena dai jejeli for di earli hours of Monday, 10 Oktoba 2022 wen e bi 91 years.
Tori nor kari am sey e dey sick bifor e kpai.

Di beriha serimoni of di lait Akbishop Christian Aggrey Apena bin tek ples for im vilej Irri from 21 to 24 Disemba 2022. Ogbonge Deltans wey bin attend di beriha na Ifeanyi Okowa, Emmanuel Uduaghan, Ayo Oritsejafor, Stella Omu and meni orda pipul.

text:
Finidi George (dey bon am 15 April 1971) na Naija profeshonal futbol kosh an a forma nashonal playa. Wen Finidi stil bi playa dat time, na right winga e bi. Finidi bi di kosh of Enyimba F.C. ''Enyimba F.C na one Naija Profeshonal Futbol Ligi. 
Wen Finidi don plai ball wel wel for Ajax- wey e tek win eight mejo taitu inkludin di 1995 Shapion ligi, e komot go anoda klub kol Real Betis.
Finidi still plai ball smol for England bifor e kom finali ritaya.
Finidi dey pat of di playa wey plai for Naija futbol tim an e plai in two Wold kup. Wen Finidi dey plai for Naija, e dey put on jersi nomba 7.
Enyimba F.C tok for September 2021 sey Finidi go bi dia tim kosh. Finidi win e fest Naija Premiha Ligi at Onikan Stadiom in Legos on di 11 of June 2023.

Futbol klub wey e don plai for
 Ajax
Finidi wey dey bon for Pot Hakot plai futbol for three klub wen e de Netherlands.
In 1993, Finidi with Nwankwo Kanu sahin for Ajax. Finidi put 4 goal for net as  helep Ajax to win dia Eredivisie taitu for dat year  an Ajax still win di taitu di folorin year.
Ajax still plai two UEFA Shapion Ligi an dey win di 1994-95 tornamet. Ajax win A.C. Milan for di final dat year.
 Real Betis
On di 10 July 1996, Finidi join Real Betis wey de Spain for 1, 024 million pesetas. For Real Betis , Finidi dey mek suo sey e dey score up to ten goal evri sisin. Finidi helep Real Betis finish for di nomba 4 posishon for ligi tebu for e fest year wen e kom di klub.
For dat year wen Finidi kom di klub, e helep Real Betis enta final of Copa del Rey  but F.C. Barcelona. (2-3 afta extra time]].
Na smol rimen Finidi foe go Real Madrid bifor e join Real Betis.

 Mallorca an Ipswichs Town
Afta wey Real Betis don go religashon in 2000,  Finidi stey for one year in spain as e join RCD Mallorca. Finidi leta join Premiha Ligi klub Ipswich Town wey di kosh bak den na George Burley for £3.1 million.

In November 2010, Finidi riton to Betis as dia  daretor of intanashonal futbol.

How e tek plai for Naija
Na in 1991 Finidi fest plai futbol for Naija as Naija wan kwilifil for  Afrika Kup of Neshon. Di futbol mach na bitwin Naija an Burkina Faso. Naija tim win Burkina Faso 7-1. Finidi put one goal for net an e hasist Rashidi Yekini to put three goal for Burkina Faso net.
Finidi dey for di playa-dem wey win  1994 edishon of di tornamet.

Finidi don plai futbol in two FIFA Wold Kup, 1994 an 1998.

Kup an Awod-dem wey e don win

text:
Mele Kolo Kyari OFR ( dey bon am 8 January 1965) na Naija sayentis wey dey dig ground to find miniral risosis. Kyari na also Crude orye maketa an "1st Group Chief executive Officer" (GCEO) of di NNPC  ( Nigerian Nashonal Petirolihom Kompini Limited).
Bifor Kyari bi di oga patapata for NNPC, e don bi di Group Jeneral Manija, Krude Orye Maketin Divishon of di NNPC. Na Kyari still dey go tok for Naija for OPEC ( Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries| Organasashon of Petirolihom Expotin Kontri]] sins 2018.

=How e tek start life an go skul
Na for Maiduguri wey de  Borno Stet dey bon Mele Kolo Kyari on 8 January 1965. E go Govamet Kommuniti Sekondiri Skul Biu wey de Borno Stet bitwin 1977 go rish 1982. Kyari go  Yunivasiti of Maiduguri go rid  Jiholoji an  Earth Sayens in 1987.

How e tek wok
Wen Maikanti Baru ritaya from NNPC, forma presidor Muhammadu Buhari chuz Kyari as di nomba 19 pesin to bi di jeneral manija of NNPC.
In 1991, Kyari join di NNPC prosessin Jiofisist with intagreted Data sarvis limited. Kyari in 1991,  Kyari start to wok as Field Jiologist with Dipatmet of jiolojikal soviho of Nigeria.
In 1998, Kyari wok as "Exploration Geophysicist" with di NAPIMS (Nashonal Petirolium Investimet Manijimet Sarvis]]. Na Kyari kontro di Prodoshon Sharin Kontat Manijimet  in (COMD)  (Krude Orye Maketin Division ) in 2014.
In 2015, dey mek Kyari di Group Jeneral Manija of COMD.

Awod-dem
 Order of the Federal Republic (OFR): In October 2022, President Muhammadu Buhari give a nashonal honour of di Order of the Federal Republic (OFR)" to Kyari.
 Outstanding Employer of The Year 2022 Award: Kyari kolet di outstanding employer of the year 2022 awod wey Trade Union Congress of Nigeria (TUC) do for April 2023.
title: Mele Kyari

text:
Isaiah Ogedegbe (dem bon am for June 14, 1991), wey dem also sabi as Isaiah Oghenevwegba Ogedegbe, na di Naija relijos figor and blogga. Pipul sabi am wel wel for im websait wey dem dey kol "Warri Times".

Isaiah Ogedegbe dey yuz im websait tek rait atikul and puwem abaut ogbonge Naija pipul. Na im bi di persin wey bin rait one puwem abaut Nelson Mandela for Septemba 29, 2022.

Tori don kari am sey Isaiah Ogedegbe bin give koret profesi abaut di Synagogue Church building collapse eight months bifor e hapun. Pipul sabi am evriwie as a persin from Warri wey don give koret profesi abaut meni tins wey don hapun for Naija.

Tori don also kari am sey Isaiah Ogedegbe bin kol di dai of T. B. Joshua "a major blow to Kristeniti" afta e don kpai for 2021.

For June 13, 2023, di day wen pipul selibrate T. B. Joshua 60th birthday for im absence, di Neshon Niuspepa bin ripot sey Isaiah Ogedegbe bin prez di laif of T. B. Joshua and dis na wetin e tok: 

"For shariti, e nor get classmate and I biliv in di grace of God wey dey for im laif. Na im bi mentor to neshons, bishops and pastors and, wit im humiliti, e don affect di world. Na im bi man of preya like David".

How dem tek kari im nem
Isaiah Ogedegbe nem don show for meni intanet online websaits bikos of im media work as a blogga. Som years ago wen e bin ripoblish a tori by one Baba Abiye for Ede wey tok abaut how Joseph Ayo Babalola tek kpai for 1959, na so im nem kom dey trend for di websaits.

For July 11, 2014, im nem enta nius wen e rait one puwem to prez Kefee laif for di day of ha beriha.

For 16 February 2018, dem kari im nem again wen e bin give Kemi Omololu-Olunloyo one online advice sey mek shi bi kiafu how shi rait abaut pipul to avoid katakata.

For 9 June 2020, im nem enta nius again wen Isaiah Ogedegbe show konsan for di kpai of George Floyd and as e dey ves, e kom tok say e si am "as a risent manifestashon of weked racism".

Kontrovasi
Isaiah Ogedegbe wey dem sabi for im profesi abaut di bifor Naija Presidensi, don bikom a viktim of plagiarism.

For 27 Febuari 2017, a ripot by Warri Times mek poblik a case of plagiarism wey konsan one Naija relijos figor.

Isaiah Ogedegbe wey bin kol plagiarism "brain tif", don kondem am bikos e dey rob som pipul of orijinaliti and kredibiliti. Akording to Isaiah Ogedegbe, nowadays som Univasiti students, som relijos figors, som musikshians, som komedians and som ripotas still dey use orda pipul work as if na dem get am.

Pej wey konsan dis one
 Cornelius Adam Igbudu

text:
Moshood Kashimawo Olawale GCFR (dey bon am 24 August 1937 an e kpai on 7 July 1998) wey pipo sabi wel wel as M.K.O. Abiola na Naijá biznesman, poblisha, an di politishan in di  Yorubaland.
Abiola bi di militiri kommanda of di  Oyo kindom. Abiola na big pesin wey kom from Egba tribe.
M.K.O Abiola wan yuz demokrasi enta as presidet for di  1993 Naija presideta eleshon but Ibrahim Babangida kansu di risot of di eleshon. Ibrahim Babangida dat time bi di militiri presidor of Naija. Babangida tok sey e kansu di eleshon risot bikos magomago an wayo de di eleshon. 
For 2018, forma presidor of Naija Muhammadu Buhari awod Abiola di rank wey hi pass for Naija, GCFR ( Grand Kommanda of di Fediral Riploblik). Na pesin wey don bi presidor dem dey give GCFR. Buhari still chenj Naija demokrasi day to June 12.
Abiola an Ibrahim Babangida bi padi padi an pipo tok sey Abiola even helep Babangida to bikom presidor.
Evri korna of Naija na im vote for Abiola. Even difren difren rilijion pipo an some politishan still vote so dat Abiola go fit win di June 12 eleshon.
By di time wey Abiola go kpai in 1998, if Naija pipo wan tok abaut demokrasi, Abiola nem dey folo join.

How e tek start life
Na for Abeokuta , Ogun Stet for Naija dey tek bon Abiola on 24 August 1937. E papa nem na Halaji Alao Salawu Adenekan Abiola an e mama nem na Suliat Wuraola Abiola. Abiola papa dey sell Kokoo an e mama dey sell Kola nut
Abiola bi di nomba twenty-three pikin wey e papa bon but na onli Abiola no kpai from smol pikin. All di oda pikin-dem wey e papa dey bon jos dey kpai wen dem still dey smol. E oda nem "Kashimawo" mins "Mek we still wait an see wetin go happun"'.

Wen Abiola no gri kpai till e rish 15 years old, e peret kom give am anoda nem wey bi "Moshood".
How e tek go skul
Abiola go Afrika Sentra Skul wey de Abeokuta for e pamari edukeshon.
Wen e still smol, Abiola dey helep e papa for di kokoo bizness wey e papa dey do. Afta somtimes, di Kokoo bizness no move again bikos di inspetor tok sey Abiola papa Kokoo no bi orijina Kokoo.
Abiola kom start to dey sell fayawood so dat e go fit sopot e famili. Abiola kom start to gada smol smol pikin-dem togeda wen e de 15 years, an dey go sing for parti so dat pipo fit give dem fud to chop.
Dis tins wey e dey do mek am fit pay e skul moni for Baptist Boys Hi Skul wey de Abeokuta. For di skul magasin kol Trumpeter Abiola bi di editor an Olusegun Obasanjo bi e deputi editor.
Wen Abiola bi 19 years old, e join  Nashonal Kansu of Nigeria an di Kameroon. Dat time, Obafemi Awolowo don get one parti kol Action Group.

Naija govamet give Abiola free edukeshon to go stodi for University of Glasgow in 1960. E rid Akantin from di Yunivasiti an Abiola bikom an Akauntant. Abiola leta bikom a graduate of ICAN ( Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria]].
How e tek wok
Abiola start to dey wok for Barclays Bank wey de Ibadan, Naija  in 1956 as "bank klark"
Afta wen e don wok as bank klark for two years, Abiola komot go join Western Region Finance Corporation  as dia ezekutiv akaunt ofisa.
Na for dis time, Abiola tek get chans go Scotland to rid more buk for Glasgow Yunivasiti.

Wen Abiola kom bak to Naija, e wok as sinior akauntant  at di Yunivasiti of Legos Tishin Hospitu. E komot go anoda kompini kol Plizer. Plizer na one kompini wey de Naija but na US kompini dey kontro am. Abiola komot for Plizer kom join  ITT Korpureshon an e leta bikom di vais-presidet of di korpureshon.
How e tek do politis
Abiola tok for February 1993 sey e wan bi presidor of Naija. E yuz SDP tek kampain.

Wen Abiola dey kampain to bi presidet of Naija, E yuz some slogan like "Farewell to poverty", "At last! Our rays of hope" an di "Burden of Schooling''". Abiola tok sey e go tok with oyinbo kontri mek dem helep ridus di moni wey Naija wan pay dem bak an sey e go manej di lokal moni wey Naija wan pay too.
 June 12 presidenshial eleshon
For di 12 June 1993 presidenshial eleshon kampain, Abiola pik Baba Gana Kingibe as e vais for di eleshon. For di eleshon Abiola win Bashir Tofa of di National Republican Convention.  Meni pipo both for Naija an Oyinbo kontri tok sey di eleshon  dey gud an sey no mago mago or ojoro for di eleshon. Abiola even win  Kano Stet di stet wey e opponet tek kom from. Na Abiola win Abuja, militiri pollin stashon, an ova twenty-four stet wey de di kontri.
For Naija, na pipo wey kom from North meni pass of politis. For Abiola to kom go win dat plenti vote rilis sopris pipo. 

Di fact bi sey,  forma militiri presidor Ibrahim Babangida kansu di risot of di eleshon. Wetin Babangida do so bring plenti fight-fight an wahala an dis one mek jeneral Sani Abacha fight an kolet pawa to kontro di kontri one year leta.
Dis na di risot wey fit bi di one wey Ibrahim Babangida kansu:

For 1994, Abiola go tok sey na im sopoz bi presidet of Naija wen e de Epetedo aria of Legos. Epetedo na one aria of Legos wey yoruba pipo plenti de. Di fact bi sey, Abiola jos kom bak from oyinbo go get bak-up for di eleshon wey jos hapun. 
Afta wey Abiola tok sey na e sopoz bi presidor, Jeneral Sani Abacha send 200 polis motor mek yuz harest am. Di risin wey Abacha give bi sey, Abiola dey dis-loya to di kontri an sey e wan skata di kontri.
Dey kill Abiola wife Halaja Kudirat Abiola in Legos in 1996 bikos e wan mek pipo sopot e hosband wey de prisin.
Na for 4 years Abiola tek de prisin. Nobodi fit kom see am for prisin an na onli Bible, Qur'an de with Abiola. Dey mek suo sey na 14 pipo dey luk am for prisin.

Pope John Paul II , Ark-Bishop Desmond Tutu an meni pipo wey dey fight for human right from all ova di wold beg Naija govamet sey mek dey rilis Abiola. Di fediral govamet tok sey dem go rilis am on one kondishon onli: Mek e no tok abaut di June 12 eleshon again for e life. Di fediral govamet tok sey dem go give am all di moni wey e don loss for di eleshon. Abiola no gree to do dis one an dis one mek am still de prisin.
E pain Abiola wel wel wen e hie sey Kofi Annan an Emeka Anyaoku tok sey e don gree to dat kondishon. Di risin wey mek Kofi Annan an Emeka Anyaoku mit Abiola an tok wit am bi sey, Nobodi for di wold go wan lisin to eni eleshon wey don rish five years.

How e tek kpai
E no tey wey Jeneral Abacha kpai, Abiola sef kpai. Na di day wen federal govamet wan rilis Abiola na im Abiola kpai.
Abiola kpai for di mitin wey e dey do with Amerika ambasedor Thomas Pickering an Susan Rice for govamet guest house in Abuja. Na Rice give Abiola tea wey e drink bifor e kpai for dat mitin. 
Wen doktor for Naija, Kanada an UK chek e dead-bodi, dey see sey Abiola get hart-problem sins.
title: Moshood Abiola

text:
Damini Ebunoluwa Ogulu MFR (dem bon am for 2 July 1991) wey pipul no wel wel as Burna boy na Naija singa, song raita an rekod produsa. Pipo sabi to no Burna Boy as e rilis di muzik "Like to Party" . Like to Party na di lid singu from e fest studio habom L.I.F.E (2013).

Burna Boy sahin with Bad Habit/Atlantic Records wey de United Stet an Warner Music Group intanashonal in 2017.

How e tek start life
Na for Pot Hacot  wey de Riva Stet in Naija dey bon Burna boy on July 2, 1991.
Burna Boy papa nem na Samuel Ogulu an e mama nem na Bose Ogulu. Burna Boy mama dey translet langwej an e papa get welda kompini.
Burna boy gra-pa from e mama side na Benson Idonije wey don bi manija for Fela Kuti bifor bifor.
Na Corona Sekondiri Skul wey de Agbara, Ogun Stet Burna Boy go bifor e kom travu go London go kontiniu e edukeshon. E rid midiha teknoloji an kolsho for Yunivasiti of Sussex from 2009 to 2010. Afta dat, Burna Boy kom bak to Port Harcourt an start to len more abaut midiha for  Rhythm 93.7 FM. Na wen e kom bak to Legos  e tek start e muzik kariha.

How e tek wok
Burna boy gro up for souta Naija an e bigin to mek beat  yuzin FL Studio.
 2012-2015: L.I.F.E an On a Spaceship
Dey rilis Burna Boy fest habom on 12 August 2013 ( dis one na di folo up for e sekod mixtape Burn Identity ). L.I.F.E habom sel 40,000 kopis on di fest day wey e rish maket. "Aristokrat Record" leta sel di maket right of di habom to "Uba Pacific" for #10 million. Some of di muzik wey de di habom na Tonight, Always love You, Run my Race, an Yawa Dey. Na Leriq produs L.I.F.E an somw of di muzikshan wey folo sing for di habom na: 2face Idibia, M.I Abaga, Timaya, Olamide, Reminisce, an Wizkid an meni odas.

text:
Godswill Obot Akpabio CON (dey bon am 9 December 1962) na Naija lorya an politishan. akpabio bi di koret Sineti presidet of Naija. E don bi di minista for Niger Delta Affair from 2019 go rish 2022. Akpabio don bi di govno of  Akwa Ibom Stet from 2007 go rish 2015.

How e tek stat life
Dey bon Godswill Obot Akpabio on 9 December 1962. E papa nem na Obot Akpabio an e mama nem na Lucy Obot Akpabio ( e mama nem bofor e mari na Inyangetor). Akpabio mama kom from Ukana, Ikot Ntuen in Essiem Udim Lokal Govamet Aria. Wen Akpabio stil dey smol, e papa kpai. Na Akpabio mama train am.

How e tek go skul
Akpabio go Methodist Pamari Skul, Ukana, Essien Udim LGA, Akwa Ibom Stet. For e sekondiri skul edukeshon, Akpabio go Fediral Govamet Kolej Pot Hakot,  Riva Stet. For e Yunivasiti edukeshon, Akpabio go  Yunivasiti of Kalabar, Kross Riva Stet. From di Yunivasiti, e rid Law.
Wen Akpabio de sekondiri skul, dey mek am di Senior boy of di skul. Wen Akpabio de Yunivasiti, dey mek am di spika of di house.

E pasonal life
Akpabio granpa, Okuku Udo Akpabio bi di shif Polis ofisa  in Ikot Ekpene  aria wen e de alive. Akpabio onku Dr.I.U. Akpabio bi di Minista of Edukeshon/Intanal Hafihas for di Easta Naija dat time. Justice Nsima Akpabio, wey bi Akpabio korsin bi sineto in di Sekod Naija Riploblik.
Akpabio na kristen an na  Katolik Chorch e dey go. Akpabio wife na Ekaette Unoma Akpabio. Akpabio wife bi di fonda of FLEI (Famili Life Enhasmet Initiative), one hoganaseshon wey dey helep famili-dem to fit live well. Na five pikin Akpabio an e wife get; four boys an one girl.

How e tek wok
Akpabio do smol tisha wok bifor e wok for Paul Usoro and Co., one law kompini wey de Naija.

Akpabio don also wok for EMIS Telikom Limited, One telifone kompini wey de Legos. In 2002, dey mek Akpabio CEO of di Kompini.
Akpabio don bi di Seketiri of ATCOM ( Assosiashon of Telikommunikashon Kompini in Naija]] wen e dey wok as CEO of EMIS.

E wok with govamet
 2002
Govno Obong Victor Attah of Akwa Ibom chuz Akpabio as di kommishonal for Petrolium an Nashoral Risosis. Bitwin 2002 to 2006, na three aria of the ministri, Akpabio kontro:
 Ministri of Petrolium an Nashoral gas
Ministri of Lokal Govamet an Shiftansi Affairs
 Ministri of Lands an Housin.

 2006
Akpabio win di pamari eleshon wey PDP Pipo Demokrasi Parti to bi dia govno kandidet for Akwa Ibom.
 2007
Akpabio win di eleshon to bi di govno of Akwa Ibom. Akwa Ibom win di sekod term eleshon to kontiniu to bi di govno of Akwa Ibom for di sekod time.
 2013
Dey pik Akpabio to bi di chairman of PDP Govno Hasembili

 2015
Akpabio win di eleshon to bi di Sineti of di Akwa Ibom North-West Senatorial District, (Ikot Ekpene)
 2018
Akpabio risain as di lida of Sinetor Minoriti Lida bikos e komot from PDP enta APC.
 2019
Forma presidor Muhammadu Buhari chuz Akpabio to bi di Minista for Niger Delta Affairs.
 2022
Akpabio risain as di Minista for Niger Delta Affairs bikos e wan go for presidet of Naija onda di APC parti. Akpabio gree mek APC chuz Bola Tinubu as dia kandidet.
Akpabio win di pamari eleshon wey APC do for pipo wen wan go for Akwa Ibom North-West Senatorial District
 2023
Akpabio win di PDP kandidet Emmanuel Enoidem  to bi di sineti of Akwa Ibom North-West Senatorial District. Na 115, 401 vote Akpabio get. Emmanuel Enoidem get 69,838 vote.
On 13 June 2023, Akpabio bikom di sineti presidet of Fediral Ripoblik of Naija.

Korupshon kases
EFCC (Economic and Financial Crime Commission|Ekonomik an Finanshial Krime Kommishon]] hakuss Akpabio sey e chop 100 billion wen e bi di govno of Akwa Ibom Stet from 2007 go rish 2015. But di kases no gree enta kot mek joj-dem luk into am.
title: Godswill Akpabio

text:
Oyinkansola Sarah Aderibigbe ( dey bon am 14 June 2002) wey pipo no wel wel as Ayra Starr na Naija muzikshan wey dem bon for Benin. Wen Ayra Starr dey 16 year old, e fest start to dey do fashon with Quove Model bifor e kom enta muzik.
Ayra Starr fest dey sing di song wey oda pipo don sing for Instagram, but leta rilis e sing for Instagram in December 2019. Dis tin wey e do mek Don Jazzy see am an sahin am to e rekod lebel kompini Mavin Rekod. Pipo start to dey no Ayra Starr in 2021 afta wey e rilis one rekod with e nem. Di rekod get one song away wey pipo like wel wel. Di song "away " dey for gud two week as nomba 4 for Naija TurnTable Top 50 Chart. "Away" stil rish nomba 17 on di "Billboard Top Triller Global Chart".     Ayra Starr rilis e komplit tape in 2021 with di nem 19 & Dangerous.

Ayra Starr muzik na Afropop an R & B.  One of di song wey dey di habom Bloody Samaritan rish nomba 1 for Top 50 Chart mekin Ayra Starr di fest fimeli muzikshan wey e muzik wan rish nomba 1 in Top 50 Chart .
Pipo start to no Ayra Starr intanashonal in 2022 wen e rilis di song  Rush. Di song enta meni Billboard for Switzerland, Ireland, an di  United Kindom. For United Kindom , di song rish nomba 24.
Rush, mek Aura Starr bi di fest yongest Afrika Fimeli Singa to mek a song vidio wey ova 100 Million pipo go luk for YouTube. Ayra Starr still bi di fest Naija fimeli singa wey e song wan rish nomba 1 on UK offishal singu chart.

How e tek start life
Na for Cotonou, Benin dey tek bon Ayra Starr on 14 June, 2002. Ayra Starr gro up in Lagos, Naija. Ayra Starr peret kom from Kwara Stet an e peret bon five pikin.

Ayra famili like muzik wel wel an e start to dey like muzik wen e de 10 year old. Ayra Starr de pat of sekondiri skul studet wey dey sing. E sef dey join e broda to rait muzik.

Ayra Starr go Les Cours Sonou Yunivasiti an e get Bashelor Digree in intanashonal rilashon an  politikal sayens. Ayra Starr tok sey bikos of meni pipo wey dey distop  am wen e dey go Yunivasiti bikos of sey e smol for bodi, e dey alway lisin to Nicki Minaj wen e dey go  Yunivasiti.
Ayra Starr mama rili sopot e pikin wen Ayra Starr chuz to bi a singa.
title: Ayra Starr

text:
Abdulrasheed Bawa ( dey bon am 30  April 1980) na Naija pesin wey dey wok for di komitee wey dey kash pipo wey no folo law for Naija. Bawa na di oga patapata for EFCC  Ekonomik an Finashal Krime Kommishon from 24 February 2021go rish 14 June 2023.
Bawa tek ova di posishon of oga patapata of EFCC from Umar Mohammed Abba. Bifor Bawa get dis posishon, e na Deputi Daretor for di anti-graft agency.

Na on 16 February 2021 dey put Bawa nem for di pesin wey go tek ova di oga of EFCC, but di  Nashonal Hasembili chuz am on 24 February 2021.

How e tek start life
Na 30 April 1980 dey bon Abdulrasheed Bawa. E kom from Jega, wey de  Kebbi Stet.

How e tek start life
Na 30 April 1980 dey bon Abdulrasheed Bawa. E kom from Jega, wey de  Kebbi Stet.

How e tek go skul
Bawa go Model pamari skul Birnin-Kebbi an e finish di skul in 1991. Bawa kom finish Govamet Sekondiri Skul, Owerri in 1997.
For 2001, Bawa finish from Usmanu Danfodio Yunivasiti,  Sokoto wey e tek get e  Bachelor of Ekonomik satifiket.
E do e Masta digree from Usmanu Danfodio Yunivasiti wey e tek rid Intanashonal Affairs an Diplomesi in 2012.
Bawa stil dey rid Laws for Yunivasiti of London.
Bawa stil kolet trenin from United States Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), [Financial crimes Enforcement Network]] (FINCEN), an United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC).

How e tek wok
 2014
Na 2014 Bawa join EFCC as di Hasistans  Detective Superintendent (ADS) 
 2015
For October 2015, na Bawa chairman di investigashon kommitee wey handu  Diezani Allson-Madueke. Diezani na di forma Minista of Petiroliom Risosis wey pipo hakus of magomago with govamet moni. Bawa bi di yongest oga patapata wey EFCC wan get.
 2023
For June 2023, Naija presidor Bola Tinubu sospen Bawa bikos e no yuz e posishon as EFCC do beta tins.
title: Abdulrasheed Bawa

text:
Obinna "Obi" Iyiegbu ( dey bon am 12 April 1975) wey pipo sabi wel wel as Obi Cubana na Naija biznes-man, Entatena, an pesin wey like to dash pipo moni an propati. Na Obi Cubana dey kontro di "Cubana Group" kompini.

How e tek start life
Na for Anambra Stet dey bon Obi Cubana on 12 April 1975. Obi Cubana mama nem na Ezinne Iyiegbu. Obi Cubana kom from Oba wey de Idemili South Lokal Govamet in Anambra Stet.

How e tek go skul
Obi Cubana go Sentral Pamari Skul. For e sekondiri skul, e go Dennis Memorial Gramma Skul. Obi Cubana go rid Politikal Sayens for di Yunivasiti of Nigeria, Nsukka. Na in 1998 e finish from di Yunivasiti.
On 26 November 2022, Enugu State University of Technology give am Honorari Doctorate.

How e tek wok
Obi Cubana na bi fonda an oga patapata of di Cubana Group. Obi Cubana start e bizness in 2006 wen e opun one night klub kol Ibiza klub in Abuja. For 2009, Obi Cubana opun one hospitaliti klub kol Cubana in Owerri for Imo Stet.

text:
Tajudeen Abbas (dem bon am for 1 October 1963) na Naijà politishian an na im bi di niu 15 Spika of di haus of Representatives for Naijà sins 2023.

Hau e tek stat life an Skol
Dem bon Abbas on October 1963 for Kwarbai, Zaria Stet, Nigeria. E get Bachelor's digre in biznes Administrashion  an Master's fom Ahmadu Bello Univasiti, Zaria. E leta get doctorate digre in biznes Administrashion fom Usmanu Danfodiyo Univasiti Sokoto.

Hau e tek wok
Abbas stat to dey wok as primari skol ticha. E leta kon wok as lecturer for one Polytechnic. Na lecturer for Kaduna stet Univasiti fom 1983 to 2001. E wok for compini sef as Marketing Manager    for Nigerian Tobacco Distribution Company, wey don chenj to British American Tobacco Company. In 2010 e join politis an na e dey insaid pipu wey dey Haus of Representative in 2011. Abbas na king pikin fom Zazzau Emirates, Zaria, Kaduna Stet.

Hau e tek wok for politis
Abbas join politis in 2010 an e enta as Haus of Representative in 2011. Na im stat lor wey plenti pas in di 8th Assemblies an e get rekod web e stat 74 bills insaid 21 wey dem sign insaid lor for 2019 an 2023. E wok for difren committee for di haus lik Commerce, Finance, Speshial Duties, Defence, Public Procurement, an Nashonal planning an Economic Development Committee. Bifor e enta for spika, na im bi di Haus Committee Chairman for Land transport. Abbas enta as spika of di 10th Assembli wit 353 votes fom 359 votes.

text:
Anthony Oluwafemi Olaseni Joshua OBE (bon 15 octoba 1989
) na british profeshonal boxer. Na two time foma unified world
heavyweight winna, 
wey im get WBA (Super), INF, WBO, and IBO title for two times from 2016 to 2121. For regional level, im get di British an Commonwealth heavyweight titles fom 2015 to 2016.
As pesin wey jost stat, Joshua represent England for 2011  World Championships in di supa heavyweight level an e win a silver medal. E olso represent Great Britain for 2012 Olympics wey bi sey e win gold. For 2014, afta one year wey wey bi sey e don bikom profeshonal, Dem kom give am di awod wey bi
Prospect of the Year by di ring magazine. For 2017, im win one fight wey mek pipul no am wel wel an na against Wladimir Klitschko di fight bikom fight of di year by di  Ring an di Boxing Writers Association of America. Joshua na di sekond English boxer, afta James DeGale wey go win gold medal for Olympicss an World title by a mejor profeshonal sanctioning bodi, an im still bikom di fess English heavyweight wey go du so.

For Octoba 2022,Dem rank Joshua as di World sekond bess aktiv heavyweight by BoxRec third byDi Ring, an fourth by Translational Boxing Ranking Board an ESPN, as wel as di sixth-bess aktiv boxer Pound for Pound by BoxRec. BoxRec don rank am as among di World top 10 heavyweight sins 2014, an dem rank am as no. 1 when 2016 an 2017 finish. Joshua knockouts to win pasentej na 88% an e get ovarol parsentej wey bi 58% for wod heavyweight title fight.

How e tek stat life
Dem bon Anthony Oluwafemi Olaseni Joshua for Octoba 15, 1989 for Watford, Hertfordshire an na di son of Yeta an Robert Joshua. Im mother na Nigerian, an im fada na Nigerian an Irish pesin. Joshua orijin na fom Yoruba pipul for Naija. Im famili memba wey bi Ben Ileyemi wey olso bi profeshonal boxer too. Di two of dem stat to dey fight profeshonali for di sem time for 2013. Joshua yuz som of im years for Naija wen im stil dey smol as a boarding student at Mayflower School for Ikenne. Im papa an mama live diaself wen e dey 12 years old e Kon go bak to UK wen e dey seven years old to join Kings Langley Sekondri Skul. As e dey kontinue to dey gro for Meriden Estate for Garston Hertfordshire, for dat ples all im frens an im foma tisha dey kol am Femi bikos of im middle nem wey bi Oluwafemi. E olso du wel for Football an Athletics  wey kom mek im brek rekod of nine years for im skul for 9 years 100m race rekod wit a time of 11:6 sekons.

Im Pasonal life
Joshua sabi lik to dey pley chess an mek e dey
reed bikos na wetin dey hep am sabi faight wel. 
Na haus e dey hep pipu du bifor e stat to dey faight boxing.  

In 2009, dem put Joshua for prison bikos of faight an som oda krazi tins wey e du. Dem put eletric bag for im leg wen e komot for di prison. 

In March 2011, polis kach Joshua bikos e dey draive kar too fas in Colindale, North London. Dem ci eight ounces (22.68 grams) of cannabis insaid im sport bag. Dem kari am go court bikos e dey kari wetin govarmet don band, na 14 years dem dey giv pesin wey du am for prison. Dem stop Joshua mek e no faight for GB boxing squad an dey giv am 12 months komuniti oda an 100 hours wey go tek wok an dem no go pay am, afta e don tok sey e no du wetin dem tok abaut am. 

Joshua for 2012 tok sey e no dey sopot eni futbol teem, for intavew wey e du for 2017, e tok sey na Watford F.C e dey sopot, an di teem wey e lik pas na Real Madrid bikos of Christiano Ronaldo, Ronaldo dey for Real Madrid dat time. For insaid dat sem intavew e tok sey English futbola Troy Deeney, wey e ci for wia dem dey cut hair na im bes frend. 

Insaid intavew wey e du wit iFL TV in July 2014, Joshua kol Muhammad Ali, Mike Tyson, Larry Holms, Lennox Lewis, an Evander Holyfield nem as di five bes heavyweight boxers of hol time.

Joshua bon one pikin, im nem na "JJ" Joshua, wit dans ticha Nicole Osbourne, in 2015. 

In 2020, tok gud tins abaut im promota Eddie Hean, wey don dey promote am sins 2013.
title: Anthony Joshua

text:
Tiwatope Savage (dem bon am for 5 February 1980), wey plenti pipu sabi for im wok as Tiwa Savage, na Naijà  singa, songraita, an aktres wey som pipu dey kol Queen of Afrobeats. Savage dey sing for Yoruba an English; na Afrobeats, R&B, hip pop an Pop shi dey sing. 

Di Kain wey shi dey tek sing for Naijà don mek shi get plenti awod. 

Dem bon am for Isale Eko, shi go London wen shi dey 11 years old for sekondri skol. Afta five years shi stet dey du muzik wok wit George Micheal George an Mary J Blige. Afta shi folo dem du UK Edition of X Factor an wen shi don finish for Berklee College of Music, Savage sign  for Sony/ATV Music Publishing in 2019. 

As shi ci sey Naijà muzik dey gro wel, Savage kom Naijà bak to du song, kon sign wit Mavin Rekods in 2012. Shi dey insaid Solar Plexus album 2012. 

Im fest Studio album na Once Upon a time wey shi rilis on 3 July 2013. Shi leta kon du "Kele Kele Love", "Love me", "Without My Hearts", "Ife wa gbona" "Folarin", "Olorun Mi", "Eminado". Di album dey insaid album wey fit win Bes album of di year at di  2014 Nigeria Entertainment Awods an for Bes R&B Pop Album for Headies 2014. Savage sekond album wey bi R.E.D, wey shi rilis on 19 December 2015, get tu singles: "My Darling" an "Standing Ovation". In June 2016, Savage du kontrat wit Roc Nation. In September 2017, shi rilis fes EP Sugarcane. R.E.D an Sugarcane dey insaid song wey fit win Bes Album for di Nigeria Entertainment Awods.

In November 2018, Savage win Bes Afrika Act at di 2018 MTV Europe Awods, na shi bi di fest Wuman wey go win di awod. In May 2019 shi let pipu no sey shi don komot for Mavin Rekods an kon sign for Universal Music Group. Savage third studio album na Celia an shi rilis am in August 2020. E get four singles: "Attention", "Dangerous Love", "Koroba", an "Temptation". Di sekond EP wey shi du na Water an Garri, Shi rilis am on 20 August 2021, di EP get Afrobeats, R&B wit soul musik insaid. In March 2022, shi let pipu no sey wod tour go dey for Water and Garri for North America. In July 2022, shi get honory digre fom Universiti of Kent.

Life an hau e tek wok

1980-2009: Hau shi tek stat life an hau e stat wok .

Tiwatope Savage wey dem bon on 5 February 1980, in Isale Eko, Lagos State, Nigeria. Im famili komot for Naijà go London web shi dey 11 years old. Wen shi dey sekondri skul, shi dey insaid skul band. Savage finish fom di Universiti of Kent, an stat wok at Royal Bank of Scotland. Shi folo Micheal George sing wen shi dey 16 years old, an wit som oda ogbonge singa lik Mary J Blige, Chaka Khan, Blu Cantrell, Emma Bunton, Kelly Clarkson, Andrea Brocelli an Ms Dynamite. Savage go Berklee college of music an get digre in music in 2007. 

E du kontrat wit Sony/ATV Music Publishing in 2009. Di kontrat mek am fit rait song for Babyface, Kat Deluna, Fantasia, Monica, an Mya. Song wey shi du for Fantasia mek di song dey insaid song wey fit win Grammy Awods in 2010.

in 2006, Tiwa Savage dey insaid UK Edition of.di X factor, shi rush las nomba 34 an na shi bi di  nomba 12 pesin wey komot. 

2010-2013: Once Upon a Time, rekod an deel.

In December 2011, Savage dey insaid sekond sisin of Nigerian Idol wit IIIRymz. Di fes fim du na wit Joke Silva an Ireti Doyle insaid For Coloured Girls.  Savage stat 323 Entertainment rekod wit im bifor bifor manaja Tunde "Tee Blliz" Balogun, wey dem kon gree to mari on 5 February 2013. Shi join Mavin rekods in 2012 an dey insaid Solar Plexus album. Wen shi dey Berklee e sabi Keith Haris, Derek Pate, Scott Coleman, Radar Ellis, an Darien Dorsey. Wen dem dey ask am abaut im wok e tok sey, shi du wok wit produsa lik Sossick, Chuck Harmony an Warren "Oak" Felder. 

Wen Naijà dey du dia 52nd anniversary, Tiwa Savage pafom "Arise O Compatriots" 
for Ndani. In November 2012, shi sing wit Wake, Timi Dakola, Praiz an Pamela Egoh  on di Oviation Red Carol song "Higher". Savage dey holways hep youth an wuman wey get cansa no hau dey tek no go get di cansa. Shi hep one grup wey dey gada moni du skul for im town. Tiwa sign deel wit MTN Nigeria in July 2013 ,wey rush 30 Million Naira. She also signed endorsement deals  . Shi sign deel wit Pepsi Forte Oil an Maggai tu.

2014 - 2016 :R.E.D an Roc Nation deel.

On 31 January 2014 Tiwa rilis "Love in yellow" wey Spellz produs for am. Tiwa dey insaid Reekado Bankz 2014 song "Turn it up", wey Don Jazzy produs. Mavin rekods rilis anoda song, "Dorobicci" on May 1 2014.

Pasonal life
Savage mari Tunde "Tee Blliz" Balogun. On 23 No ember 2013, dia tu du tradishonal wedin for Lekki. Dem du dia white wedin on 26 April 2014,for Armani Hotel Dubai.On January 1 2015 dem annous sey dem go bon pikin, six month leta dem bon pikin. On 28 April 2016, Balogun tok sey im wiaf waka enihau an im mama na winch. 

On 19 July 2021, Savage papa kpai.
