text:
Mahmood Yakubu (dem bon am for 1962) na Naija professo an e bi di oga of INEC (  Indipendent Nashonal Eletoral Komishon).

How e tek stat life an go skul
Na for Bauchi Stet dey bon Mahmood Yakubu in 1962. Bauchi Stet de di Norta pat of Naija. Yakubu go Kobi Pamari skul for e pamari edukeshon an Govamet Tisha Kolej, Toro for e sekondiri edukeshon.

Yakubu kom go Usmanu Danfodiyo Yunivasiti wey e tek rid History. Yakubu finish from di Yunivasiti in 2015 with  fest-klass digree. As at 2015, na onli Yakubu wan kari fest-klass komot from di dipatmet of History from Usmanu Danfodiyo Yunivasiti.
Yakubu go do e Masta Digree  for Wolfson College, Cambridge an e  finish am in 1987. Yakubu do e Ph.D in  Naija Histri at di  Yunivasiti of Oxford wey e tek finish in 1991. Na Bauchi Govamet sponsor am for Yunivasiti of Cambridge an Yunivasiti of Oxford wey e go rid.

Yakubu do well so tey e win  Ovasee Risach Skolaship three times.  "Association of Commonwealth University" give am Commonwealth Skolaship too.

How e tek wok
Yakubu na leshoral , pesin wey sabi  "guerrilla warfare" tins, an professor of Politika histri an intanashonal stodis at NDA  Nigerian Difens Akedemi

Bifor Yakubu bikom oga patapata for INEC, forma presidor Umaru Musa Yar'Adua don chuz am to bi di ezekutiv seketiri of TETF ( Tertiary Education Trust Fund).Na for 2007 forma presidor chuz am for di posishon.

Yakubu bifor don wok as hasitat Seketiri of Finans an Administrashon for di  2014 Nashonal Konferens , Nigeria. 
In 2013, dey give Yakubu honorari feloship to di "Nigerian Institute of Public Relations".

INEC
Forma Naija presidor  Muhammadu Buhari chuz Mahmood Yakubu as oga patapata for  INEC on 21 October 2015. Yakubu tek-ova from Amina Zakari. Amina Zakari dey wok as hatin chairman of INEC dat time.

text:
Musiliu Akinsanya (dey bon am 14 March 1975) wey pipo no wel wel as MC Olumo na Naija pesin wey bi di oga patapata for Nashonal Union of Road Transpot Workas. Pipo dey tok sey na MC Oluomo  get moni pass for all di Agbero wey de Naija.

How e tek start life an go Skul
Na for Oshodi wey de Legos dey bon MC Oluomo on 14 March 1975. MC Oluomo papa papa-dem kom from Kwara Stet. Wen  MC Oluomo finish pamari skul, e papa wey kpai no mek am fit kontiniu e edukeshon.

MC Oluomo komot for house go dey do bus kondotor wen  bi 13 year old.   Oluomo fest bikom di Oga patapata of Agbero for Oshodi motor pak bifor e bikom di ova all oga of Nashonal Union of Road Transpot Workas in Legos.

For one kampain wey APC ( All Progresive Kongress do for Legos in 2019, dey chuk chuk MC Oluomo with Knife for di kampain. Some pipo dey tok sey na sombodi wey like di Legos govno wey wan komot dat time Akinwumi Ambode do dat tin. Dey sey di rising fit bi sey bikos di parti no gree mek Ambode go for di sekod time as govno.

Palava an Wahala wey dey folo am
Meni vidio wey de soshal midiha on 25 February 2023 sho MC Oluomo wey dey tok sey Igbo wey dey Legos most not vote for Peter Obi  for di 2023 Naija presidential election for Legos.

E pasonal life
MC Oluomo get three wife an e get nine pikin.
title: MC Oluomo

Konga.com parti na Naija E commerce kompani wey Dem opun for July 2012 an dia headquarter dey for Gbagada, Lagos State. Dem dey offer tod parti online market ples an fess parti dairekt retail spanning wit difren difren katigori wey get buyer elektronic, fashion, home propati, books, smol pikin propati,komputa, phones, tablet an tins wey we dey yuz for gadjet, an Dem olso dey giv health care an pasonal care prodot. Di kompani dey olso get logistics savis(EXPRESS) wey dey quickly du diliva goods for costoma.

How e tek stat
Dem  stat Kongo forJuly 2012 an na Sim shagaya, wit 20 staff. Dat time na only for Lagos State dem dey wok an na only baby tins,beauty pasonal care katigori dem dey operate wit but leta leta dem Kon dey operate for oll oda State inside Naija for Desemba 2012. Di fass chenj fit bi bikos of anoda online kompani wey dey du di tin wey dem dey du too wey dem dey kol Jumia.

For 2013 don get $10 million Seria A fom investment AV kinnev an Naspers. Q2 2013, Konga beta tess "Konga mail", wey kom mek Dem opun tod parti ritela dis kom mek Dem dey muv away fom fess parti online ritela model.
title: Konga.com

text:
Government Oweizide Ekpemupolo (dey bon am 12 April 1971) wey pipo no wel wel as Tompolo na forma Naija pesin wey dey fight govamet bikos e wan chenj for Naija Delta. Na Tompolo bi di forma komanda of di Muvmet for di Emasipashon of di Naija Delta. Na Tompolo stil bi di head priest  for  Egbesu god, di Naija Delta god of war.
NNPC give Tompolo wan bizness kontract of 40 billion naira. Di kontact bi sey mek e arenj pipo wey go dey luk orye pipeline so dat boys no go tampa wit am.
Na two time, 2015 an 2019 presidet Muhammadu Buhari rejim wan harest am bikos of how e tek yuz di moni.

How e tek start life
Na for 1971 dey bon Tompolo into di roya famili wey de Okerenkoko. Okerenkoko de Gbaramatu Kindom, Warri South Lokal Govamet aria of Delta Stet.

How e tek go skul
Tompolo do e pamari skul for ''Okepopo Pamari Skul in Warri.

How govamet tek free am
Wen Tompolo bi di oga of MEND, e wahala govamet so tey dey tel am sey if e stop to dey fight dem, dem no go kach am put am for prisin. Tompolo kom gree for wetin govamet tok an govamet kom liv am an e boys dem. Dis tin hapun onda Umaru Musa Yar'Adua time as presidor on June 27, 2009. An na October 4, 2009 Tompolo gree to stop di fight so dat wahala no go dey hapun for Delta Stet. Dis one give govamet shans to fit do wetin dey get for mind to do for di pipo.

Di orda to go kach am
In 2016, forma presidor Muhammadu Buhari tok sey dey wan harest am bikos of sey e dey tiff an sey e dey do magomago with moni. Bifor Buhari tok dis one in 2016, pipo no see am Tompolo sins 2014 an dem no no wie e dey. Na onti 2020 pipo kom see am inside Egbesu shrine. For August 2022, Muhammadu Buhari kom ri-sahin di kontact with Tompolo so dat wahala no go de for kompini wey dey wok with orye for Delta.
title: Tompolo

text:
Beaitiful Nubia na im stej nem bi dat an im ril nem na  Segun Akinlolu (bon 11 Novemba 1968) na Naija pesin wey sabi rait song wey olso sabi kompos song an na band lida.

Beautiful Nubia an di Root Renaissance band na Naija Trandishonal root muzik grup. Na Segun Akinlolu (aka Beautiful Nubia) organize di grup an na im stil bi di lida of di grup. Bikos of dia song pipul don sabi dia grup wel wel.for Naija an oda ples in d world. Segun Akinlolu na advoket for soshia reform an e don du dis wit im trandishonal song. "E don put all im life to dey endure biliv fo power of chenj; dat our society no dey irredeemable an sey evritin fit stil bi koret"

Theme
Most of Beautiful Nubia song na trandishonal an nativ sweet song wey dey pas mesej wey go mek pipul value life, respect nashor an go mek u Sabi how to dey liv wit pipul wey fight no go dey. Im dey olso prish sey eveybodi dey equal an get sem right. Im muzik also dey prish abaut love an endurance an olso tel pipul to Sabi to dey defend anstand for dia right if enibodi wan to dey cheat dem. Im songs transcend parochialism wen Dem go for appeal for African sensibilities an get univasa truth.

How e tek stat life
Dem bon Segun for Ibadan in 1968, an e stat to dey rait song wen e dey very smol. Na for smol e don dey du im traditional song wey dey in fom of oral poetry, tiata, muzik an tradishonal song. For 1997 e Kom out wit EniObanke a muzik prodoshon an maketin
Kompani na onda dis rekod lebel im rilis im fess abom for1997. Na onda dis rekod lebel e don dey du all of im abom. For 2010 di kompini stat im fess ever tradishonal an root song in Naija di one wey dem dey du every year wey dem dey kol EniObanke Muzik Festival(EMUfest) in 1998 di kol all new artis meni yong muzishan wey dey Lagos State wey go dey follo am sing as bak up singa wey im giv di nem di Root Renaissance Band.
title: Beautiful Nubia

text:
Romelu Lukaku Bolingoli dem bon am for 13 May 1993). na Belgian ogbonge futbolar wey dey pley for Seria A klub Inter Milan, na loan e dey fom Chelsea.

Lukaku stat to dey pley for sinior klub wen e dey Anderlecht, wia e win Belgian pro League an na im skore pas for di league. In 2011 e join Chealsea for transfer wey rish £10 million (€12 million), bikos e no dey pley wel wel dem loan am go West Brommich Albion an Everton; in 2014, Lukaku sign for Everton for moni wey rish €28 million, (€32million), na im bi di sekond playa wey skore pas. E pley for Manchester United afta dem buy am wit moni wey rish €75 million (£88 million), afta dat one e kon go Inter Milan in 2019 for moni wey rish €80 million (€68.1 million), wen e no kon setu wel for di klub, e go Inter Milan in 2009, for deel wey rish €80millon (£68.1 million). for di klub e win Serie A league an Serie A Most Valuable Player.

In 2021, Lukaku go Chealsea bak for insaid deel wey rish  €97.5 million (€115.7 million), wey mek mek am seventh playa wey cost pas. di Belgian playa wey cost pas an playa wey cost pas for dat season. 

Belgian playa wey don skore pas, Lukaku stat to dey pley for Belgium sinior team in 2010, an don sho for di konti insaid five competishion:di 2016 an 2020 UEFA European Championship an di 2014, 2018 an 2022 FIFA Wod Cups. Na im win Bronze booth in 2018.

Im klub wok
Hau e tek stat

Lukaku Join Rupel Boom wen e dey five years old. After four season for Rupel Boom, pesin wey dey holways fain playas for Leise ci am kon kari am go dia youth academy. E pley for Lierse fom 2004 go rish 2006, e skore 121 goals insaid 68 match. Wen Lierse relegate, Anderlecht kom buy am go dia klub. Na three years e uze pley as youth playa for Anderlecht, e skore 131 goals insaid 93 match.

Im Pasonal life
Dem bon in Antwerp,. Belgium to Congolese papa an mama. Im papa, Roger Lukaku, na Ogbonge futbola wey pley for Zaire. E get broda wey im nem na Jordan, wey don pley for Anderlecht youth tu. 

Dem uze Lukaku tori du one television sho wey bi De school Van Lukaku (Lukaku School). Wen pipu wey du di television sho go meet am e tok sey, wetin fit mek am  kry wel na wen e rimiba sey e don tay wey e don lik to pley for chealsea. Lukaku fit spik im Langwuej an som  oda langwuej tu lik Dutch, French, English, Portuguese, Italian, Swahili an Congolese Swahili. Pesin wey dey pley bol wey Lukaku lik pas na Didier Drogba.

Lukaku na Catholic, an e dey holways prey bifor an afta match. E go Lourdes in 2014. Lukaku no dey drink alcohol.

Hadiza Bala Usman (dey bon am 2 January 1972) na Naija politishan an di oga patapata (manijin daretor) of Nigerian Port Authority from 2016 go rish 2021.      Hadiza don bi Shiff of Staff to di govno of Kaduna Stet from 2015 go rish 2016.
Hadiza join bodi form di bring Back Our Girls kampain. E stil  bi fondin memba of APC ( All Progresive Parti).

How e tek start life an go skul
Na for 2 January 1976 dey bon Hadiza Bala  Usman in Zaria . Hadiza famili na Fulani wey get pawa wel wel an dem bi Sullubawa tribe. Yusufu Bala Usman wey bi Hadiza papa na leshura an pesin wey dey rait Histri wey dem no wel wel for Zaria. Na Hadiza papa form di "Sental for Demokratik Divelopmet, Risach an Trainin" wey de Zaria. Hadiza great gra-pa ( from e mama side) bi Abdullahi Bayero wey bi di nomba 10 Emir of Kano from 1926 go rish 1953. Hadiza gra-pa ( from e fada side) bi di Durbin Kastina an e onku Usman Nagogo bi di Emir of Kastina
Hadiza gro up inside Ahmadu Bello Yunivasiti Kampos in Zaria bikos e papa na leshoral for di Yunivasiti.Hadiza go di Yunivasiti Staff Pamari Skul. Hadiza stil finish e sekondiri edukeshon for Zaria
Hadiza enta di Yunivasiti in 1996 to rid Bizness Administrashon an e finish e B.Sc in 2000. Hadiza go Yunivasiti of Leed to do e masta digree an e finish am in 2009.

How e tek wok
 1999
Hadiza yuz one year tek wok for di Demokratik Divelopmet an Risach Divelopmet an Risach Trenin wey de Zaria as Risach Hasistant.
 2000-2004
Hadiza wok as Entaprasis Ofisa for Bureau of Poblik Entaprasis from July 2000 go rish August 2004.
 2004-2008
Hadiza wok for UNDP for di  Fediral Kapital Teritiri Hadiminitrashon as speshal Hasistant to di Minista of Projet Impimenteshon from October 2004 go rish January 2008.
 2011
Hadiza kampain to repriset Musawa/Matuzu for Fediral Konstituensi. E yuz CPC (Congress  for Progressive Change/Kongress for Progresive Chenj tek kampain but e no win for di eleshon.
 2011-2015
Hadiza join Good Governance Group/Gud Governance Group in Naija,  one organasashon wey govamet no dey chuk mouth inside. E wok as dia Daretor of  Strateji from 2011 go rish July 2015. Wen Boko Haram kidnap Chikbok skul gel-dem in 2014, Hadiza join bodi tek form di Group "Bring Back our Girl" to fit force di govamet to do sometin abaut di mata. Hadiza helep arrenj how govamet an di peret of dos pikin go fit dey tok.
 2015
Wen Nasir Ahmad el-Rufai bikom di govno of Kaduna Stet, E pik Hadiza as di Shiff of Staff of Kaduna Stet.
 2016
Forma presidet Muhammadu Buhari  chuz Hadiza as di Manijin Daretor of NPA Nigerian Ports Authority in July 2006. Meni pipo tok bad abaut dis bikos dey sey Buhari yuz am fevor e tribe an sey Hadiza no get di sense to fit do di wok.
 2021
Buhari suspend Hadaza mek e no wok as Manijin Daretor of NPA.

Pasonal life
Hadiza na di wife of Tanimu Yakubu Kurfi. E hosband bi di pesin wey dey stodi ekonomik wey wok onda Naija presidor wey kpai  Umaru Musa Yar'adua. Di marej bring two boi-pikin

Awod
Meni pipo tok beta tins abaut e wok for NPA. Hadiza kolet awod as fimeli wey try pass for exekutiv in Poblik Sarvis (Maritime)  in 2021.
title: Hadiza Bala Usman

Micheal Owusu Addo (dem bon am on July 10, 1988)dem sabi am for im wok as Sarkodie na Ghanian singa (rappa), songraita, an e dey du biznes wey kom fom Tema. Di kain wey e dey sing song don mek pipu sabi am wel wel. E don win plenti awod lik; Vodafone Ghana Music Awod for Artist of di Decade, fes winna of BET internashonal flo artist at di 2019 BET Hip Hop Awod. E dey insaid pipu wey mek dem sabi Azonto dans.

Im life an wok
 Hau e tek stat life an wok

Sakordie na nomba four pikin insaid five pikin an dem bon am on July 10, 1988. E gro up for Koforidua bifor im papa an mama kon kari dem go Tema, na Tema e tek go skul. E go Tema Methodist Day Senior High School an stil go IPMC, wia e for tek get digree for graphic design. Sakordie fes stat to dey go smol smol kompetishon lik Adom FM rap kompetishon kasahare level. Na for dia e ci im bifor bifor manaja Duncan Williams of Duncwills Entertainment.

Hau e tek dey hep pipu
On July 13, 2013, Sarkodie stat di Sakordie Foundation, wey  e du to dey hep smol smol pikin wey dia papa an mama no tu get moni. E don go hep dem for Royal Seed Home Orphanage in Kasoa. On December 25, 2014, im foundation stat feed di kids campaign for Tema, Ghana, dem giv plenti smol pikin bags of rice an youghurt.

Im biznes an kompini e du kontrat wit

Na Sarkodie get di Sark by Yaks kompini wey dey du cloth, e stat am on April 27, 2013.. In 2012, Samsung Electronics sho pipu sey Sakordie na dia niu ambassador for Universiti of Ghana, Legion. Sakordie na ambassador for Fanmilk Ghana in 2013. Sarkodie du deel wit Tigo Telecommunications Ghana,  wey sponsor im 2013 Rapperholic tour. Sakordie get endorsement deel wit Standard Chartered Bank. Im bi di ambassador for Guiness Ghana Limited for dia Malt drink. On 30 October 2019, na im bi di ambassador of di year for di year return campaign; dem giv am di awodnat Creative Arts Industry Forum. In 2021, Sarkodie an im pikin dey insaid Pepsodant Ghana's #BrushWithMe campaign. Dem du am to tek tel pipu to dey brush day an naight.

Im Pasonal life
Sarkodie Mari Tracy insaid smol weedin wey e do for Tema, Ghana on 17 July 2018. Na two pikin e bon.

Chukwuebuka Obi-Uchendu (dey bon am 14 July 1982) na  Naija  pesin wey dey tok for redio an Televishon. Ebuka kom from Okija wey de Anambra Stet. Pipo no Ebuka wel wel as di pesin wey dey host Big Broda Naija, Rubbin Mind tok sho for Channels TV . Ebuka stil dey join bodi to host "The Spot and Men's Corner" on Ebonylife Televishon. Ebuka dey helep Budweiser Nigeria, Samsung, Nigeria an 2Sure Nigeria sel dia prodot.

Ebuka win di Outstanding TV Presenter of the Year at di Nigerian Broadkasta Merid Awod for di way e tek wok in Rubbin Minds.

How e tek start life an go skul
Na for Benin Siti, Edo Stet dey bon Ebuka on 14 July 1982. Ebuka papa dey wok for bank an e mama dey wok for hospitu as nurse. Ebuka na di nomba 3 pikin out of di 4 pikin-dem wey e peret bon. E get one elda sista, one elda broda an a yonga broda. Na for Benin Siti Ebuka do e pamari edukeshon. Ebuka do e ezam wey dem dey kol "Common entrance wen e dey pamari 4.
Ebuka folo e famili pak wen dem pak go Abuja. Na for Abuja Ebuka do e sekondiri edukeshon for "Christ The King Kolej", Abuja. E finish di skul in 1997. Ebuka rid law for Yunivasiti of Abuja wey e finish in 2004. In 2005, Ebuka enta Nigerian Law Skul, Bwari, Abuja.
Ebuka in 2010 finish e Masta digree in Washington Kolej of Law of di Amerika Yunivasiti. Di pat of law wey e chuk bodi into na "Intellectual Propati" an Komunikashon law.

How e tek wok
 2006
Ebuka in 2006 enta as one of di 14 pipo-dem wey go de inside di house in Big Broda Nigeria. Na nomba 8 posishon Ebuka kari komot dat time. Na Ebuka do well pass for all di pipo-dem wey do Big Broda Nigeria in 2006.
Dey tok sey na Ebuka go bi di host of di sekod sisin of Big Brods Naija wey dem do in 2017. Na im stil do di third edishon of di sho.

Afta di Big Broda Nigeria wey e do for 2006 finish, Ebuka sahin mek fone kol kompini yuz am tek sel dia prodot. E sahin with Beer  kompini too an e host sho like: Friend or Foe on NTA, The GLO sho on NTA, an Guiness' Greatness TV. Ebuka stil dey rait for Naija  This Day niu-pepa for one side of di niu-pepa kol "Contrast".
 2011
Wen 2011 jeneral eleshon wan start, Ebuka host di fest eva presidental eleshon wey dem wan do for Naija.
 Rubbin Minds and EbonyiLife TV.

 2016

Wen dem wan do Big Broda Naija Sisin 5 Reunion'', some of di fan of di sho tok sey Ebuka no sabi do host wel wel but meni of di fans to sey  e sabi do am wel wel.

text:
Nicolas Jackson (dey bon am 20 June 2001) na futbola wey dem bon for Gambia but e dey play for Senegal nashonal Tim. Jackson dey play front posishon for La Liga klub Villarreal.

How e tek wok  
Na for Banjul wey de Senegal e papa papa-dem kom from. Na for Ziguinchor, Senegal e gro up. Jackson don plai for di lokal side ASC Tilene bifo joinin Casa Sports. Jackson de di Casa Sports tim wey plai 2018-19 Senegal Premier Ligi.
Wen Casa Sports plai 1-1 with AS Pikine on 16 November 2018, na Jackson dey pik as Man of di match.
 Villareal
For September 2019, Jackson sahin to be Villarreal FC playa. E dey plai for dia Juvenil A tim.
 Mirandés
On 5 October 2020, Villarreal FC boro CD Mirandés wey de Segunda División Jackson mek e plai for dem in di 2020-21 Sisin. 13 days leta, e plai di sekod half of di 0-0 match against RCD Mallorca wen e enta for Antonio Caballero.
Na for 28 November 2020 Jackson net q goal in di 1-1 game with CD Castellón. Na di onli goal wey e score bi day as e Tim finish for 10 posishon.

Wen Jackson riton bak to Villarreal FC, e plai for di tim B in Primera Divisíon RFEF. Jackson net 7 goal as e tim promot to di sekod division. On 3 October 2021, e plai e fest La Liga game wen e enta for Arnaut Danjuma in di game wey Villarreal FC tek win Real Betis 2-1.

Jackson net e fest La Liga goal on 13 August 2022 wen e score di fest goal in di 3-0 win against Real Valladolid. 13 days leta, Jackson an Alex Baena enta as pamanet playa for sinior Tim of Villarreal FC.

Villarreal FC redi to sel Jackson for 22.5 million Euro to AFC Bournemouth in January 2023, but di injuries wey Jackson get mek am no fit pass di medikal test wey dem do for am for Bournemouth.

How e tek plai futbol for e kontri
Senegal kol Jackson on November 2018 to kom plai for dem. E join di tim wey plai for Senegal for U-20 Levu. For September 2022, Senegal tim manija Aliou Cissé kol Jackson to kom plai two frend-li game for Senegal. Wen di nel of 26 playa wen wan go 2022 FIFA World Cup kom out on 11 November 2022, Jackson nem de. E enta for Krépin Diatta for di game wey Netherland tek beat Senegal 2-0.

text:
Sergio Ramos García ( dem bon am on 30 March, 1986) na Spanish ogbenge futbola wey dey pley for Ligue1 klub Paris Saint-Germian. Dem sabi am wel on hau e dey tek pley bol, e dey kolet bol fom playas leg wel wel. Plenti pipu tok sey na one of di bes playa bikos e don pley for beta big klubs, e pley for Madrid for sixteen season, e win four Champions League, two UEFA European Championships an di 2010 FIFA Wod Kop wit Spanish nashional team.

E fes stat to dey pley for Sevilla youth academy an e uze two years for sinior team, Ramos komot dia go Real Madrid in 2005. E pley wel wel for Real Madrid wey mek am win 22 honors wey La Liga an four UEFA Champions League dey insaid. Ramos dey insaid playa wey dey pley for bak wey don skore pas. Ramos skore insaid di 2014 UEFA champions League final, e skore for 2016 UEFA champions League final. 

Ramos don win La Liga bes defender five times, an e dey insaid La Liga team of di season in 2015-16. In 2016 e join Paris Saint Germain on free transfer. E dey insaid  UEFA team of di year nine times.

For im kontri, e don pley four Wod Kops an three European Championships. E win di 2010 FIFA Wod Kup an di UEFA European Championship in 2008 an 2012, im nem dey insaid 2010 FIFA Wod Drram Team in 2010 an di UEFA Euro Team of di Tournament in 2012, E fes pley for Spain wen e dey 18 years old an, in 2013, na im smol pas for insaid playas wey don rish 100 caps. Na Ramos bi di playa wey don get caps pas for Spain nashional team an na im bi di kontri ninth playa wey don skore pas. Na im win pas for Spain, e don win 131 match for dem. In February 2023, Ramos tok sey e no dey pley for im kontri again.

Im Pasonal life
Ramos get four pikin wit pesin wey dey tok nius Pilar Rubio, dia two don dey togeda sins September 2012. Ramos mari Pilar Rubio on 15 June 2019.

Dem dey kol am famili man bikos e dey lik to dey togeda wit im broda an im papa an mama. Rene, wey bi Ramo's broda na futbol agent. Ramos lik anoda sport wey bi to dey uze bull faight. 

In June 2014, Na Ramos bi di ambassador for UNICEF Spain.

Tins wey dey for im bodi

Ramos dro som tins for im bodi, hol di tins pas 42, e dro Jesus an Mary, Star of David bikos of im granmama wey kpai, Nana, lion, wolf, map of Spain, American chief, hamsa, FIFA Wod Kup an Champions League Kup, im famili dey insaid wetin e dro tu.

text:
Chike Ezkpeazu Osebuka (dem bon am for January 28, 1993), dem sabi am for im wok as Chike, na Naijà singa, song raita an fim aktor. E dey insaid Naija competishion Project Fame Afrika an e kari sekond on season 1 of di voice Nigeria. Fest fim wey Chike go dey insaid na Battleground wey dem dey holways sho for Africa Magic showcase, na im bi Mayowa Badmus insaid di fim.

Hau e tek stat life an skul
Chike kom fom Onitsha, Anambra stet in Nigeria. Na four pikin im papa an mama bon e dey insaid di four pikin. Chike famili na dem hep am  dey sing. E go Covenant University an get digre in Computer Engineering.

Hau e tek wok
Project Fame

Chike dey insaid project fame West Africa, but e leta komot wen e rish top 10.

The Voice Nigeria

Chike dey insaid The Voice Nigeria afta e sing James Arthur "Roses", e dey for team Patoranking syd. 

Insaid di sho e sing Mario's Let me love you song wit anoda memba for team Patoranking, wey mek am enta nex stage. For di sho e du Dare Art Alade "Not the girl" song. For di sekond stage for di sho e du The Weekend's "Earned it" an na pipu wey dey luk di sho hep am pas di round. 

 Afta di Voice of Africa

2016

Afta di voice Nigeria, E sign for Universal Republic rekod wit som oda pipu wey du di sho. E rilis im fest single Fancy U in December 2016 onda Universal Republic, wit di musik video wey kom out for 2017. Chike na ambassador for Airtel Nigeria.  

2017-2019

In April 2017, Chike nem dey insaid africa magic na im bi Mayowa Badmus in television nem Battleground. Chike kon komot for Universal Republic in November 2017. E rilis im nex single, wey bi "Beautiful people", in February 2018. 

2020

Chike rilis im 14 track album wey bi 'Boo of the Booless.' wen e pafom on di 2020 Big Brother Lockdown TV sho.

2022

In August Chike sel im car for am to rilis album, e kon tel pipu wey lik am sey mek dem no wori wen dey ci am dey uze leg waka.

text:
Akinwunmi Akin Adeshina na Naija economics wey  dey sarf as President of Africa Development Bank. Na im bi bifor bifor Naija Minista of Agriculture an Rural Development. Bifor e enta as Minista in 2020, na im bi di Vice president of policy an partnership for di Alliance for a green Revolution in Africa (AGRA). Na im dem vote for as di President of Africa Development Bank in 2015 an e enta for sekond time in 2020. Na im bi di fest Naija man wey go bi di  
President for di plez.

Hau e tek stat life
Adeshina papa an mama na farma an na for Ibadan Oyo State, dem bon am. E go vilaj skul an get digre in Agricultural Economics with Fest klass Honors fom di University of Ife (wey kon bi Obafemi Awolowo University nau), Nigeria in 1981. Na im bi di fest pesin wey dem go giv distinction for di Univasiti. E go anoda skul for Purdue University, Indiana an kom Nigeria bak in 1984, to mari. E get Ph.D in Agricultural Economics in 1988 fom Purdue, wia e tek get ph.D.

Hau e tek wok
Fom 1990 to 1995, Adeshina sarf as sinior economist at West Africa Rice Development Association (WARDA) in Bourké, Ivory Coast. E wok for Rockefeller Foundation. Fom 2003 to 2008,  na im bi di associte director for food security. 

Na Adeshina bi di Nigeria Agriculture Minista fom 2010 to 2015. Na Adeshina bi Afrika forbes Man of di Year. bikos of e tek arenj Naija Agriculture. E mek farmas ci fertilizer fas. 

In 2010, United Nations Secretary General, Ban Ki-moon, as one of di 17 global leaders, to hep dem for Millennium Development Goals. 

On 28 May 2015, na  Adeshina bi di President of di Africa Development Bank. E stat d posishon for ofis on 1 September 2015. 

In September 2016, Bank ki Moon, wey bi president of United Nations Secretary General, selet Adeshina to sarf as memeba of Lead Group of di Scaling Up Nutrition Movement. In 2007, e win 2017 Wod Food Prize. 

On August 2020, Adeshina enta sekond term as President of di Africa Development Bank for five years.

Im Pasonal life
Wen Adeshina dey Prudence Universiti, Adeshina an im waif wit anoda pipu, stat di Africa Student Fellowship. Im an im waif, Grace get two pikin, Rotimi an Segun.

Hau dem tek sabi am
Adeshina dey insaid top 100 influencial Africans  by New Africa Magazine in 2005.

In 2013, na im bi di forbes Africa Person of the year.

In 2018, e get awod of Honorary Doctorate of Science by di Federal University of Agriculture, Abeokuta Nigeria. 

On May 14 2022, e get awod of Honorary Doctor by Addis Ababa University, Ethiopia, on top of hau e tek wok for Economics.

Honors
2019: Grand Officer of di National Order of Merit of Tunisia.

Wia dem gada di tori

1. Africa Bank Development

2.This is Africa 30 July 2013.
title: Akinwunmi Adeshina

text:
Gbenga Daniel (dey bon am 6 April 1956) na Naija politishan wey bi Sinetor for Ogun  East sins 2023. Na Daniel bi di go no of Ogun Stet from 2003 go rish 2011.
Gbenga Daniel get one kompini Kresta Laurel wey e start in 1990. Di kompini na one mekanika enjineerin kompini. Na Gbenga Daniel stil dey kontro Conference Hotels. Di hotel get plenti branch for Ijebu-Ode, Sagamu, Abeokuta an Isheri pat of Legos. Wen Gbenga Dsniel stil bi govno of Ogun Stet, e join bodi with pipo wey dey du bizness to wok togeda an dis one mek meni bizness kompini kom to Ogun Stet.

How e tek start life
Na for Ibadan, Oyo Stet dey bon Gbenga Daniel on 6 April 1956. E papa nem na Adebola Daniel an e mama nem na Olaitan Daniel. Gbenga Daniel papa kom from Sagamu an e na pasto for Church of the Lord (Aladura). Gbenga Daniel mama kom from Omu-Ijebu an e dey sel tins as treda.

Gbenga Daniel go Baptist Boy Hi Skul, Abeokuta from 1969 go rish 1973. For di skul, na Gbenga Daniel dey go if dey wan do dibet an kompetishon  dis one mek am popula for di skul. Wen Gbenga Daniel finish Baptist Hi Skul, e enta The Polyteknik, Ibadan go rid Basic Studies for e Advanced Level (A' Level). Gbenga Daniel leta enta Yunivasiti of Legos to go stodi enjineerin. Gbenga Daniel no buk wel wel as dey give am free edukeshon . Pipo for skul no Gbenga Daniel as one of di best studet of Prof. Ayodele Awojobi. Wen Gbenga Daniel stil bi studet for Yunivasiti, e join one komitee wey dey sopot Obafemi Awolowo. For dat Komitee, na Gbenga Daniel smol pass for Age. Leta, di Komitee leta bikom di Unity Party of Nigeria (UPN).

Na Prof. Ayodele Awojobi mek Gbenga Daniel like to go stodi Enjineerin for skul. Gbenga Daniel sabi buk nobi smol bikos na im dey win pass for di televishon show "Mastermind".
title: Gbenga Daniel

text:
Akinwunmi Ambode ( dey bon am 14 June 1963) na Naija politishan wey bi bifor bifor govno of Legos Stet from 2015 go rish 2019. Ambode don wok for govamet for 27 years as pesin wey dey advais govamet on moni mata bifor e bikom govno of Legos.
Na APC (All Progresive Parti) Ambode tek enta as govno in April 2015. E win di pesin wey Kari sekod for di eleshon Jimi Agbaje wey yuz PDP (Peoples Democratic Party|Peoples Democratic Parti]]) kampain. Na 150,000 vote Ambode tek pass Jimi Agbaje for dat eleshon.

Ambode enta ofis as govno of Legos on 29 May 2015. E tek ova from Babatunde Fashola. For October 2018, Ambode no win di Pamari eleshon wey APC do to chuz pesin wey dem wan mek e go as govno for di komin eleshon. Na Babajide Sanwo-Olu di parti pik as dia kandidet for di eleshon. E no get opshon Dan to sopot Sanwo-Olu.

How e tek start life
Na for 14 June 1963 dey bon Ambode for Epe general Hospitu. E papa nem na Festus Akinwale Ambode an e mama nem Christianah Oluleye Ambode. Na ten pikin Ambode papa bon.

How e tek go skul
Ambode go Fediral Govamet Kolej Warri, Delta Stet from 1974 to 1981. E go Yunivasiti of Legos from 1981 go rish 1984. Na Hakantin e rid as e finish at age 21.
E do e masta digree in Hakantin from di Yunivasiti of Legos an e kwulify as a chartered Accountant. Ambode get di Fulbright Program to go rid for free for Hubert Humphries Feloship Program in Boston, Massachusetts.
Some of di program wey e go bi:
 Hubert Humphries Felllowship Program
 Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania
 Cranfield School of Management, Cranfield England.
 The Institute of Management Development Lausanne, Switzerland, INSEAD, Singapore.
 John F. Kennedy School of Government for Havard Yunivasiti, Cambridge, USA

How e tek wok
 1988-1991
Ambode bi di hasistat for di pesin wey dey handu moni (assistant treasurer) for Badagry lokal govamet, Legos Stet, Naija from 1988 go rish 1991.
 1991
Dey tranfa Ambode go Shomolu lokal govamet to go wok as pesin wey dey check how Dem dey yuz moni for di lokal govamet  (Auditor). Ambode do dis sem wok for Alimosho lokal govamet.
 2001
Ambode wok as aktin Auditor Jeneral for lokal govamet, Legos Stet. 
 2005
Ambode bikom di pamanet Seketri of di Legos Stet Ministri of Finas
 2006-2012
Ambode wok as Hakantin Jeneral for Legos Stet. For dat posishon, na Ambode dey luk into moni mata for Legos Stet an na ova 1400 hakantat dey wok onda am.

Di kompini wey e fom
Afta wey Ambode don wok for govamet for 27 years, e ritaya in August 2012. Ambode kon start e kompini Brandsmiths Consulting Limited. Di kompini na to advais pipo, kompini an govamet agent on moni mata.

In 2013, Ambode form La Roche Leadership Foundation.

E pasonal life
Ambode mari Bolanle Patience Odukomaiya. Ambode na Kristen.
title: Akinwumi Ambode

Olufemi Hakeem Gbajabiamila (CFR) na Nigeria Lawyer an na politishian wey dem bon foh (25 June 1962), na him bi di Chief of Staff for di Nigeria President for 2023. Him don fes serv as nomba 14 Speaker of the House of Representatives foh Nigeria from 2019 tu 2023.

E Early Laif an Edukashon
Na Lateef Gbajabiamila an Olufunke Gbajabiamila bon Olufemi Femi Hakeem Gbajabiamila foh 25 June 1962 foh Legos, Nigeria. E atend im pramari skul foh Mainland Preparatory School and Igbobi kolej for 1973 wie e finish im sekondri edukashon. And afta, he regista foh King William's College wey bi one island wey dey onda British pawa foh United kingdom wie e get e A-Level. E kom back to Nigeria kom stodi foh di University of Lagos and graduet wit Bashelor foh Law (L.L.B) wit honor for 1983 and dem kol am tu bar foh 1984. He kom go do e Juris Doctor wey bi e fest digri for law foh di Atlanta's John Marshall Law skul wey dey foh Georgia, USA, e pass di Georgian bar exam wey e do for 2001, and e kom stat won law firm foh Atlanta. Wen he bi dey foh USA, he patispet and dey aktiv foh di elekshon wey Bill Campbell wey letah kom bikom di Mayor of Atlanta do.

text:
Miss Universe Nigeria (MUN) na one Naija beauti pajent wey dey hapun evri year. Di pajent na to pik who go go repiset for di Miss Universe. Na Silverbird prodoshon dey arenj Miss Universe Nigeria. Silverbird start dis pajent in 1983. Di sho stop for som time, but kom bak in 2023.

Di pesin wey win di las Miss Universe Nigeria na Hannah Iribhogbe. Na September 2023 e go rimuv e taitu, and MUN go kom riples MBGN

History 
Bifor bifor, na Daily Times pipo dey arenj Miss Nigeria pajent wey dey kari pesin go Miss Universe. Afta Edna Park wey bi Miss Nigeria 1964 wey Daily Times pipo kari go Miss Universe fall dia hand for semi-final, dem stop to dey kari pesin go Miss Universe.

For 1983, afta dem do plenti annasimet,  Omololu Ojehomon win di niu Silverbird beauti pajent "Miss Universe Nigeria", but di fest edishon no gud bikos dem rimuv Ojehomon taitu komot bifor e get opotuniti to go oyinbo kontri go do Miss Universe. For dat niu Miss Universe Nigeria, na Yemi Fawaz kari di nomba 3 posishon, an e tok sey Silverbird no arenj di pajent wel wel. Pipo kom dey tok bad about di sho bikos of how Silverbird tek chuz two pipo to get sekod posishon. Anoda wahala for di sho dat time bi sey, enibodi wey e mama an papa no kom from Naija no go fit bi winna. Fawaz stil tok sey wetin dey vex am pass bi sey Silverbird no dey tekia of pipo wey don win di sho awod afta dia year don finish.

After three years reach, Silverbird president Ben Murray-Bruce bring back di pajent as Most Beautiful Girl in Nigeria'', and na Law student Lynda Chuba-Ikpeazu win am come do Miss Universe for di first time since 23 years. MBGN come get more franchise like Miss World, Miss International, and Miss Supranational, but na only those wey win MBGN fit represent Nigeria abroad. Agbani Darego wey study Computer Science and Mathematics  win Miss World for 2001, and na she become di first Nigerian wey place for Miss Universe that year.

For 2005, Silverbird create different title for MBGN runners-up dem, like MBGN Universe, and MBGN winner pata pata na "MBGN World"; na only Miss World she fit go. Roseline Amusu wey been study Human Science, na she become di first MBGN Universe, but Nigeria no fit place until 2019 when Olutosin Araromi wey dey study Health and Human Services come reach Miss Universe top 20 after 18-years reach.

For 2023, Silverbird come bring back Miss Universe Nigeria, and na Murray-Bruce brother, Guy, talk say Miss Universe rules dey change evri time, na 'im make MUN and MBGN na two different pajent now. MBGN dey promote dat kin' beauty wey Oyinbo too dey like, but, MUN dey accept every contestant, and dem marital status, body type, shade, height or weight no be problem again.
title: Miss Universe Nigeria

text:
Dey bon Wasiu Alabi Pasuma am foh 27th November 1967. Na Mushin Legos stet, e stey from wen he bi dey small till e grow. Na only him mama wey bi Alhaja Adijat Kubura Odetola wey pipul sabi as Iyawo Anobi as he tek dey praise her foh him musik sey na she bi him biggest sopot foh him musik Karia tek care of am.

He go to Muslim mission primary school foh 1973, bifor e kom muv to Nigerian Model High school wie e finish him sekondri skul.

Na since wen he don dey foh sekondri skul na him e don dey do e musik, wai oda student dem dey do tins wey konsan sport mata. Pasuma and som of e friend dem go sit dawn foh one kohna dey sing song on dia own

He stat to write e own song dem foh 1984. Dat time pesin wey e dey look as e role model na K1 De Ultimate bikos e still dey young, na dat sem 1984 e rilis his fest albom wey e nem am TALAZO 84. Meni of e fans dem praise am foh di albom, e kom giv am more pawa tu wan do more. Foh 1993, e kom rilis e fest official musik albom.

E Karia
As pipul stat to rekognaiz e albom wey e rilis for 1993, e don rilis albom dem wey don pass 30. Wey mek Pasuma to fit dey among one of di most Fuji musishian wey dey do well foh Nigeria.
He don even join bodi sing song wit difrent difrent musishian dem like Bola Abimbola and King Sunny Ade. Apart from sey e dey sing, he don join bodi show foh difrent difrent Nigeria fim dem like [Iyanje] and [Alenibare].

Som of E Song Dem=
Foh 2020, He rilis one song wey bi MMM (Money Making Machine). E rilis dis albom foh Covid-19 time, he kom tok sey e do di song to entaten e fans dem since dey don stop pipul to dey gada togeda to dey do big party bikos of di bad disease. Dat Musik wey bi MMM wey e do dat time kom bi one of e biges wok wey e do, e kom mek am dey popular well well again foh meni pipul wey don dey tok sey Fuji musik na one kind musik style wey don old.

Foh 2022, he rilis anoda musik style wey e kol am Afro fuji wey e join bodi togeda kom kolabo wit Qdot, di song nem na Omo Ologo. Afta dat one, e kom go rilis anoda two Fuji musik wey di title na: Legendary and December tonic. E kom kol dem Human nature.

Awod
Foh 6 Sept 2015, Pasuma kom gain pipul atenshon well well, wey mek am win Olamide, Phyno, and Flavour as di Best Indigenous Artist of the year foh di  Nigeria Entertainment Awards.

For 2021, E win di Best International Music Video Award wey Hollywood and African Prestigious Awards (HAPAwards) giv am.

text:
Francis Agoda (dem bon am on April 4, 1979), plenti pipu sabi am for im wok as I Go Dye na Naija pesin wey dey mek pipu laff. E bi raita, e dey tok to advais pipu. E don du plenti sho for Naija lik "I Go Dye Standing".

Tori abaut im life
Hau e tek stat life

Dem bon Francis Agoda on April 4, 1979. In Abraka, Delta State, Nigeria. Wen e dey smol, na im granmama ples for water side wey dey Okpara e stay. Na for im granmama, Queen Agnes, e tek ci wetin pipu dey fes for smol vileji in Nigeria. Na hol di tins e ci mek am dey tok abaut wey dey mek pipu laff an e dey rait am for buk. 

Hau e tek stat to dey mek pipu laff na fom wen e dey primary skul for Ighogbadu primary skul, an College of Commerce, Warri Delta State. Wen e dey skul na memeba of Junior Engineering Technical Society.  In 1992, smol pikin wey e bi, e meet di govnor of Delta State|stet Olorogun Felix Ibru afta e don trai to bi di fes pesin wey go kom fom vilej kon du hovacraft ship, radio, hair drya, projetor, elektrik solar teble fan, an helicopta wey dey fly, na e kon leta bi di onli smol pikin wey go du flying helicopta an muving hovacraft ship. Dem kari am go stodi engineering for New York University for free. 

I Go Dye lik komedi, na im mek pipu sabi am wel wel fas fas. Bikos of di tins e don ci wen e dey gro up for vilej, e uze as pipu tek no am an moni wey e get tek dey hep smol pikin an pipu wey no get.

Hau e tek wok
Na fom im reel nem Agoda, e tek chenj to I Go Dye, wey di mean hau to dey hep yung pipu. 

Wen e dey college, im mama komot am for di United College of Commerce to Essi College, Warri, bikos im broda, wey bi ticha for Essi College dat time, fit dey chek am. 

Wen e dey Essi college, e join SVC wia e tek meet im bes frend, Otagware Onodjeyeke (Ltas) wey dem sabi nau as Igosave. Dia tu dey tok smol nius on Delta Brodcasting Service 1994, wia dem dey tok abaut tins wey dey hapun for Naijà. E get kontart for Prest Motel in Benin City, wia dem dey pay am 1000 naira for one sho.

Afta plenti years wey e don du komedi for plenti ples insaid di kontri, dey kon kol am for Naijà komedi sho wey bi Night of a thosands laughs (year 2000 edition). E dey insaid pipu wey go sel market pas for komedi sho, na wetin Ibaino wey du di sho tok bi dat.E du sho for Opa Williams, wey du Nights of a Thousands Laugh,  wey mek am giv am awod of komedian wey dey difren pas for staj of Nights of a Thousands Laugh for ten years. 

Di fest time wey e go Europe to du plenti sho na wit Ehi Zoya Golden Entertainment (2005), wey mek am go 7 kontris. France (NIDOE) kon leta kol am kom pafom for di UNESCO Cultural Week insaid Paris, France. Niddo Spain leta giv am awod bikos of di kain wey e dey mek pipu sabi Naijà kolture. 

E du sho for Opa Williams, wey du Nights of a 
E dey insaid MTV Afrika Music Awod, e don du sho to open an klose sho for difren ogbonge singa lik Akon, Boyz II Men, 50 Cents,  Rick Ross, Di Game an Kelly Rowland.

Awods
I go dye don win plenti awods, na im win:
. African Bes Komedian
.Di Nigerian in Diaspora Organization of Europe-SPAIN Awod as e tek put bodi to kari Naija kolture up.
. Di Nigerian Bes Komedi Awods (NEA Awods) 
.Delta Role Model Awod 2017
.Nigeria Bes Komedian Awod
.Niddo Spain Awod; as e tek put bodi for Naija kolture an Art .
.UKaid an Youth alive foundation Awod ambassador Awod on #MadAct, mek a difren against koruption Todey; wey Dem du for Naija pensioners.
.Nigeria Army Civil Awods wit di komplement of Chief of Army Staff Lt General TY Burutai.
.United Nations Wod Habitats Ambassador.

Oda tins wey e du
I go dye's komedi brand na I Go Dye Standing. In 2016, I Go Dye sel wel wel for O2 London sho wey e tek du im 20 years on staj. Bifor di I Go Dye wod tour, e pafom for Afrika komedi sho wey MTV Afrika Music Awods dey insaid.  Plenti big pipu lik I go dye sho wey mek politishian, Presidents an oda ogbonge pipu lik to dey kol am. E pafom for di 2018 Nashonal Council of Nigeria Tradishonal rulers, wey dem du for Port Harcourth wit di Sultan of Sokoto, Alhaji Sa'ad Abubakar III, Oni of Ife Adeyeye Ogunwusi, an plenti oda ogbonge pipu. 

E bi Millennium Development Goal ambassador, wey dey wok for United Nations for dem to du wetin dem plan to du. In September 2014, dem ci I Go Dye an Cross Rivers stet Govnor Liyel Imoke, for pisho insaid di Nigerian Ireland Carnival in Dublin.

Hau e tek dey trai chenj tins for beta

Hol wetin I Go Dye don ci for smol mek am wan to dey hep pipu an chenj tins. Dey shot am an som of im frend don kpai bikos dem wan chenj tins. Bikos of wetin e don ci for insaid faight wey hapun insaid 1997 for Warri, wen Itsekiri an ijaw dey faight, e kon du one projet, Peace in sight. Amb I Go Dye du 10 minutes shot film, E du di fim insaid 2004 for United Nations an for Fediral Govment of Nigeria to uze am mek peace an hep smol smol vilej pipu. 

E don uze buk an vidio hep ogbonge pipu. E rait letter wey evribodi ci for di govmet insaid 2017, na wen dem dey du World Youth day e rait am. Di nem wey e giv wetin e rait na "Logic an Reasons Without Guns", e rait am for Naijà Govment an Pipu wey dey faight for govnor an di youth.

Wia dem gada di tori
1. I go Dye: The fabulous lifestyle of a comedian. Vanguardngr.com. 13 September 2014. 

2. Nigeria Army honours I Go Dye.. Vanguard newspaper 3 July 2017.
title: I Go Dye

text:
Peter Okoye wey meni pipul sabi as Mr P na Nigeria singa wey dem bon foh 18, November 1981. He stat to dey popular foh di time of 2000s as di memba of di P-Square wit his twin broda wey meni pipul sabi as Rudeboy, foh 2021 dem awod am wit di honor of doktoh digri from di ESCAE University wey dey foh Benin Republic.

Early Laif an Edukashon
Mr. P an e twin broda wey bi Rudeboy grow up for a big family for Jos wey bi Plateau Stet, Nigeria. Dem bon am foh di family of Josephine Okoye and Mazi Moses Okoye.

Peter and e broda Paul join one musik skul and drama klob, na foh di skul dem stat to len how to dance and how to dey sing, and dey even dey pafom di song of som popular musishian dem like MC Hammer,Bobby Brown and Michael Jackson.

E Karia Foh Solo Musik
Foh 2017, him and e broda wey fom di P-Square band kom skata and dem separate. Mr. P fest drop his solo musik wey e nem am For My Head, Cool It Down foh 2017.

Foh 2018, Mr. P join bodi togeda wit Nyanda of Brick & Lace wey dem sing one song wey dey nem am Wokie Wokie. Foh 2021, Mr. P kom fom e own rekod lebel wey e kol PClassic Label, di rekod lebel don sign Naija aktivis and na   e bi Dj wey dem dey kol DJ Switch, and foh 2021, e rilis e  fest albom wey get 16 trak dem,   e nem am The Prodigal wey e join bodi sing wit singa dem like Tiwa Savage, Simi, Teni, Wande Coal, Tamar Braxton, Singah, Mohombi, DJ Switch, and OvieKelz.

Pasona Laif
Foh 2013, Peter Okoye and e girlfriend dat time wey bi Lola Omotayo giv bet to dia daughter  Aliona foh one hospital wey dey San Francisco foh United States. Wen e rish 17 November 2013 di two of dem kom marri foh di  Ark foh Lekki, Legos stet, Nigeria.

Wie Dem Gada di Tori
title: Peter Okoye

text:
Yusuf Datti Baba-Ahmed ( dey bon am 7 July 1969) na Naija ekonomis an politishan. Baba-Ahmed na bifor bifor Sinetor for Kaduna North in 2011. From 2003 go rish 2007, e na memba of House of Repisentetiv, Na Baba-Ahmed  Lebor Parti (LP) pik to bi di vais presidet for di 2023 presidenshial eleshon with Peter Obi as dia presidenshial kandidet.

Baba-Ahmed kom from Zaria an e go Yunivasiti of Maiduguri. Wen e finish skul, Baba-Ahmed enta bizness an bankin wok bifor leta join politis. Wen Baba-Ahmed stil de House of Reprisentetiv, pipo no am as pesin wey no dey sopot korupshon an pesin wey fight against di Third term Agenda wey forma presidor Olusegun Obasanjo wan do. Wen e finish as memba of House, Baba-Ahmed kontiniu to dey tok an sopot gud govamet as e dey faze e bizness. Na Baba-Ahmed get Baze Yunivasiti.

Baba-Ahmed kom bak to politis in 2010 an e win di  eleshon wey e enta to bi di Sinetor of Kaduna North. Na onli one year e yuz as di tribunal tok sey mago mago dey di eleshon as e komot  in 2011. Wen Baba-Ahmed to win di 2018 pamari eleshon wey PDP do to bi   presidental kandidet, e join Lebor Parti to bi di vais-presidet for Peter Obi in 2022. Wen di risot of di eleshon kom out, Na Bola Tinubu win as presidet of Naija an Kashim Shettima win as e vais-presidet.

How e tek start life an go skul
Yusuf Datt Baba-Ahmed dey among di 33 pikin-dem wey e papa Baba-Ahmed bon. Baba-Ahmed papa na Arab pesin wey dey do sell goat, sheep an cow bizness. Baba-Ahmed papa leta bikom a skolar an pesin wey no Islamic law  wel wel. Baba-Ahmed get B.Sc an M.Sc in Ekonomik from di  yunivasiti of Maiduguri wey de Borno Stet. E don bifor wok for The Nigerian Security Printing and Minting PLC Legos. Na afta dis wok e do last bifor e fest enta politis.

For 2016, wen e stil bi Fediral repisentativ,  Baba-Ahmed get e Ph.D satifiket wen from Yunivasiti of Westminster.

How e tek wok for politis
Na for April 2003 Baba-Ahmed win di eleshon to di Fediral House of Repisentativ for di Zaria Fediral Konstituensi, Kaduna Stet. E yuz ANPP ( All Nigeria Pipo Parti tek kampain an win di eleshon. Pipo like Baba-Ahmed bikos e no dey tek nosens wen e dey politis. E dey among di pipo wey no sopot forma presidor Olusegun Obasanjo for go for di third time as presidor. Baba-Ahmed tok sey e no go kari post for di sekod term bikos som of dem don kolet moni for bak to sopot wetin Obasanjo wan do. For 2007, e kari INEC (Indipedet Nashonal Electoral Kommishon go jog bikos of wetin dey do for eleshon pirod. Baba-Ahmed yuz CPC (Kongress for Progresiv Parti win di Kaduna North Sinetorial eleshon in 2011. CPC na Muhammadu Buhari politika parti.

How e tek sopot edukeshon
Na Baba-Ahmed bi di fonda an Pro-Shasellor of Baze Yunivasiti. Di yunivasiti dey Abuja  for Naija. Na for April 2011 dey opun di yunivasiti.
title: Yusuf Datti Baba-Ahmed

text:
Rashidi Yekini (dey bon am 23 October 1963 an e kpai on 4 May 2012) na Naija futbola wey dey play front posishon. Na Yekini score pass for all di futbola wey don play for Naija. Yekini play futbol for more dan 20 years. Na one klub kol Vitória de Setúbal wey de Portugal e yuz meni of e time play for. Yekini play futbol for oda klub wey de six kontri.

Di tota nomba of goal wey Yekini goal for Naija na 37. E dey for Naija futbol tim wey play for seven mejo kompetishon. Two Wold Kop join for di seven mejo kompetishon wey e play for Naija. Na Yekini score di fest eva goal wey Naija fest goal for di histri of Wold Kop. Wen CAF wan men futbola wey play pass for 1993 for Afrika Futbola of di year in 1993, na Yekini dey chuz.

How e tek play futbol
Yekini peret na Yoruba but na Kaduna dey tek bon am. E start to dey play in Naija Ligi bifor e kom go Ivory Coast go play for Afrika Sport Nashonal. From Ivory Coast, Yekini go Portugal go play for Vitória de Setúbal. Na for dat klub e rili play e best futbol. Yekini win di hiyest goal skoral awod for 1993-1994 Sisin in di Primeira Liga in Portugal. Na 21 goal wey e score mek am win di awod. Bifor di 1993-1994 sisin, Yekini helep e klub komot from sekod divishon kom Primeira Liga with e 34 goal wey e score in 32 game. Na dis one fit mek am win di Afrika best playa awod in 1993. Na Yekini bi di fest Naija playa to win dis awod.

In 1994, Yekini sahin for Olympiacos wey de Greece. Yekini blood  no go with e tim playa an dis one mek am komot for Olympiacos. Yekini play for Sporting de Gijón wey de Spain bifor e kom bak to e forma klub Setúbal. Oda futbol klub wey Yekini play for na Zurich, Club Athlétique Bizertin, an Al-Shabab Riyadh bifor e kom bak to dey play Afrika futbol.

In 2013, Yekini join Julius Berger F.C wey de Naija for Nigeria Shampionship .Yekini join Gateway United FC wen e bi 41 years old on April 2005.

How e tek play futbol for e kontri
Yekini play 62 futbol game for Naija an e score 37 goal. Na e goal pass for Naija. Yekini de di Naija tim wey play 1994 Wold kup an e score Naija eva fest goal for Wold kup in di 3-0 win against Bulgaria. Wen Yekini score dat goal, e hapi sotey wota komot for e two eye. Di one mek pipo dey rimemba di Wold kup til todey.

Yekini dey di futbola tim wey win di  1994 Afrika Kop of Neshon wey hapun for Tunisia. For di kompetishon, na Yekini score di hiyest goal an na im bi di best playa for di kompetishon. Yekini dey di futbola tim wey go Olympic in Seoul 1988.

How e tek kpai
Niuz kari am sey Yekini dey sik for som time. In 2011, ripot for niuz tok sey e dey get smol smol kolo meat for head. Yekini kpai on 4 May 2012 for Ibadan. Na two of e forma futbola  Mutiu Adepoju an Ike Shorunmu break di niuz. Dey beri Yekini for Ira,  Kwara Stet. Na e house kompond dey beri am.
title: Rashidi Yekini

text:
Dem bon Oladapo Olaitan Olaonipekun wey plenti no as Dagrin foh (25 October 1984 - 22 April 2010), he kom from Ogun stet for Nigeria. Na rapa for Nigeria, Dem rilis one fim wey tok about e life wey dem kol Ghetto Dreamz foh 2011.

Early Laif
Olaonipekun house dey foh Meiran, Alagbado, foh Ogun Stet.

Karia
E rilis his fest audio albom wey bi Still on the matter. Foh 2009, e rilis his sekond studio albom wey e kol C.E.O. (Chief Executive Omoita). Foh 2010, dem nominet am foh di Nigerian Entertainment Awards for Best Album wey bi (C.E.O.), Hottest Single "Pon Pon Pon", Best Rap Act and Best Collaboration with vocals. E albom wey bi C.E.O (Chief executive Omota foh English: Chief Executive Thug) win di Hip hop World Award foh 2010 for best rap albom. Na from di albom im song wey bi "Pon Pon Pon", and "Kondo" dey. E wok wit som oda Naija atist dem like {Y.Q, 9ice, M.I, Iceberg Slim, Omobaba, Terry G, Ms Chief, Owen G, K01, code, MISTAR DOLLAR, TMD entertainment, Omawumi, Chudy K, Bigiano, and Konga}. Dem rilis e tord studio albom wey bi "If I Die" afta e don dai.

Im musik style
Dagrin dey among di fest set of pipul wey yus Yoruba and pidjin languej tek rap among Naija singa dem. One jonalis wey bi  tori pesin foh "Premium Times"  Idoko Salihu tok sey as Dagrin dey yus English wit e netiv languej to rap kom mek am transform di Nigeria rap indostri.

Ghetto Dreamz
Ghetto Dreamz, na fim about e laif wey bi sey na Trybson Dudukoko and Doris Simeon wey bi Ademinokan akt as e girlfriend and Dem rilis di fim foh April 2011.

Albom wey e do Dem
Still On The Matter (2006)

If I Die (2011)C.E.O (Chief Executive Omoita) (2009)

If I Die (2011)

Awod and nomineshon dem
E win di awod;
2010 Hip Hop World Awards – Best Rap Album

E Death
Olaonipekun get accident foh April 14, 2010 & e dai afta 8 days, foh 22 April, 2010 dat time e dey di age of 25 yehs wen e get di accident wit moto foh Legos, Nigeria.

Wie Dem Gada di Tori
title: Dagrin

text:
Chukwunonso Tristan "Noni" Madueke (dey bon am 10 March 2002) na England futbols wey dey play for Premier Ligi klub Chelsea. Madueke fit play as winga or as midfida.

How e tek start life
Na Igbo peret bon Madueke an na for Barnet dey bon am. Wen PSV klub sahin am, Madueke an e mama pak komot go one vilej kol Wintelre.

How e tek play futbol
Madueke join Crystal Palace wen e stil bi nine year old an e yuz three yearsbfor di klub. E leta join Tottenham Hotspur wey e kaptain di onda-16 side. Wen Madueke bi 15 years old, e play for di onda-18 side.

 PSV
Madueke sahin three years kontact with PSV. PSV na one klub wey de Holland. Dat time Manchester United wan sahin im but Madueke no gri go.

On  26 August 2019, Madueke play for di sinior tim of PSV wen in di Eerste Divisie . Dey chenj Jong PSV in di 64 minit for Madueke for dat game. MVV Maastricht win PSV 1-0 for dat game.
Madueke play for di fest tim of PSV on 19 January wen dey play 1-1 draw with VVV-Venlo. Madueke kom dey play evritime for PSV in di 2020-21 sisin. For di fest game of 2020-21 sisin, Madueke score wen PSV win Emmen  2-1 on 19 September 2020. Na seven goal e get for dat sisin.

For 7 August 2021, Madueke score two goal in di 4-0 will against Ajax. Na Ajax nomba 18 game wey dey neva loss onti PSV win dem. Madueke sahin anoda kontact win PSV onti  2025. PSV give Madueke jersi nomba 10.

 Chelsea
On 20 January 2023, Chelsea futbol klub sahin Madueke an sey e go de with dem for seven an a half year. Chelsea give PSV £28.5 million. Madueke score e fest gil for Chelsea wen Chelsea win Arsenal 3-1 on 2 May 2023.

How e tek play for Kontri
Madueke don play for England youth tim . E score two goal wen England wan kwulify against Denmark onda-17. E de di tim wey play 2019 Europian Onda-17 Shampionship
Madueke play e onda-18 game for England wen dey play Australia. Na 3-2  England win dem. Na for De Montfork dey play di game on 6 September 2019. Madueke score in di 2-0 against South Korea on 10 September  2019.
On 15 March 2021, Madueke nem de di tim wey go play 2021 UEFA Europian Onda-21 Shampionship
title: Noni Madueke

text:
Dem bon Abdulkadir Balarabe Musa foh (21 August 1936 - 11 November 2020) an na politishian foh Nigeria wey dem elekt as bifor bifor govnor foh Kaduna Stet, na hold ofis foh Nigeria sekond repoblik, from October 1979 go rish 23 June 1981 wen dey impish am komot foh ofis. Foh di nomba four Nigeria repoblik na him bi leeda foh Conference of Nigerian Political Parties (CNPP),wey bi kombineshon of parti wey no bi e parti dem.

E Background
Dem bon Musa foh 21 August 1936 foh Kaya, Kaduna stet. E stodi foh Zaria Middle School from 1947 go rish 1952, and for di institute of Administration, Zaria from 1952 go rish 1953. Im bi akount klak foh 1953 go rosh 1955, and e wok as skul Tisha foh 1955 go rish 1960. He wok as maneja foh difrent difrent akount mata foh di period of 1960 go rish 1975, dat time, im dey stodi foh difrent difrent kolej dem foh London tu fit gain adishonal kwolifikashon dem.

Wen E bi Govnor foh Kaduna Stet
Foh 1979, dem elekt Musa as govnor foh Kaduna Stet onda di platfom wey bi di People Redemption Party wey bi sey na Aminu Kano bi di founda of di parti, wit oda pipul like Abubakar Rimi, Sabo Bakin Zuwo, Abdullahi Aliyu Sumaila, Yusufu Bala Usman, Uche Chukwumerije, and Michael Imoudu, Chinua Achebe, Sule Lamido.  Di chalenj wey di National Party of Nigeria (NPN) chanlenj am no kom dey sosesful. Di parti wey e dey don fest bi part of di PPP parti wey get konekshon wey dey agenst NPN, e kom  leta withdraw small small. Di Kaduna Stet House of Assembly wey bi sey na NPN memba dominet di house, dey kom mek progres foh e matta as e bi govnor. E no kom fit fom eni kabinet bikos e no gri to nominet NPN memba dem and di house no gri aproof his kandidet dem. Di house kom impeach am foh June 1981, wey mek am bi di fest Stet govnor wey dey komot from govnor seat.

Wen  di Kaduna Stet klob wey dey play one game wey dem dey call polo invite Musa no gri go, "e tok sey him no sabi play di game, sey polo game na for oyinbo pipul foh pipul and na foh pipul wey get pawa and foh pipul wey get money".  Musa kom tok sey dem komot am from di govnor seat bikos im bi dey plan am to mek di stet open som small small indostri and di one dem wey big small, and e fit mek di NPN memba dem no get di chans to stat dia own kompani dem. He kom stat di kompani dem wey bi sey na stet get dem, e leta close down di kompani dem bikos di kompani dem no bring profit.
title: Balarabe Musa

text: Godwin Nogheghase Obaseki (bọn 1 July 1957) na Naija politician and biznesman wey dey preside as Governor of Edo Stet. Dem first elect am as governor under the platform of the All Progressive Congress (APC) for the year 2016, where e kom defeat Mr. Osagie Ize-Iyamu of the PDP and e swear in as governor on 12 November 2016. Before e become governor, e bin serve as chairman of the Edo Stet Economic and Strategy Team wey former Governor Adams Oshiomole inaugurate for March 2009.
title: Godwin Obaseki

text:
Abba Alhaji Kyari ( dem bon am 17 March 1975) na Naija Polis Ofisa wey bi di deputi komishonal of polis wey dey on sospenshon.  Kyari no fit do like polis ofisa for now bikos of e mata wey dey kot. Pipo hakus am sey e join bodi to do bad tins with Ramos Abba.(Hushpuppi. Hushpuppi na yahoo Boyz.  Kyari bi memba of IACP ( International Association of Chiefs of Police|Intanashonal Hasosiashon of Shif of Polis]]. Bifor Kyari bikom di IGP-IRT, e don wok for Legos Stet Polis Komand. For Legos Stet Polis Komand, e na Unit Komanda . Dey leta promot Kyari to wok as Ofisa-In-Charge to di polis dipatmet wey no de again, SARS. (Special Anti-Robbery Squard.

How e tek wok
Na for 2000 Kyari enta Polis Akademi wey de Wudil, Kano Stet. Kyari finish di Akademi as  Hasistat Supa-intedet of Polis tranee .        Kyari go do e one year komposiri sarvis for Adamawa Stet Polis Komand . Na Song Polis Divishon e de. Dey leta Kari Kyari mek e bi DCO (Divishonal Krime Ofisa) in Numan Adamawa Stet. E stil wok for Unit Komand 14 PMF Yola.

Kyari kom Legos Stet Polis Komand as 2 IC (sekod in Komand) an leta Ofisa-In- Charge of SARS. Bifor Hushpuppi kess kom up, Kyari don bi di oga patapata of di Inspetor Jeneral of Polis Inteliget Respond Tim in di Nigeria Polis Force wey de Abuja.

E kes wit Hushpuppi         
On 29 July 2021, Niuz kari am sey  Kyari join bodi with di yahoo yahoo boy Hushpuppi to fit yuz wayo kolet $1.1 million from di fonda of one skul wey de Qatari. Hushpuppi now dey for USA prisin as e wan yuz 11 years bikos of di wayo wayo tins wey e don du.

One dokumet wey de kot tok how wahala tek happun bitwin di three yahoo boys Hushpuppi,    Juma an Vincent. Dis wahala mek Vincent go link sekret to one pesin wey Hushpuppi an Juma wan yuz wayo for. Dis tin vex Hushpuppi sotey e kom arenj mek dem harest as put Vincent for prisin in Naija. E bi like sey na Kyari Hushpuppi yuz tek du dis tin. Di pepa wey dey kot stil tok how Kyari tek send e bank akaunt to Hushpuppi mek Hushpuppi give am moni for di wok wey e du to harest Vincent. One Naija intanet Niuz-Pepa kol People Gazette tok how Hushpuppi tek arenj mek Kyari kom mit am for Dubai an how Hushpuppi tek yuz moni welkom am wel wel. Kyari tok for e Facebook an e Instagram akaunt sey na liar bi all dis tins wey pipo dey tok about am. Di People's Gazette tok sey United States Department of Justice don tell Kyari sey mek e kom USA kom ansa for dis tin. Di IGP don sospend Kyari from r di polis wok onti di mata finish.

E kokain kes
On 14 February 2022, one video sho Kyari dey  tok di moni wey e go kolet for 25 Kg of Kokain. E wan give an $61, 400 cash moni. NDLEA  hakuss Kyari an six oda polis ofisa sey dia hand dey kokain bizness . Kyari an four oda polis ofisa tok sey na liar bi dat tin wey NDLEA dey tok about dem.
title: Abba Kyari

text:
Anthony Onyemaechi Elumelu CFR ( dey bon am 22 March 1963) na Naija wey dey stodi bizness mata an e dey dash pupi moni an propati. Na Elumelu bi di oga patapata for Heirs Holdings an stil bi di oga patapata for Transcorp. Elumelu bi di fonda of Di Tony Elumelu Fondashon. For 2020, Elumelu nem de for di 100 pipo for di wold wey popula pass. Na Time niuz-pepa do di list.

How e tek start life
Na for Jos, Plateau Stet, Naija dey bon Elumelu on 22 March 1963. E papa nem na Dominic Elumelu an e mama nem na Suzanne Elumelu. Elumelu papa kom from Aniocha North lokal govamet aria for Delta Stet. Na four five pikin e papa bon. One of e broda bi Ndidi Elumelu wey bi di manoriti lida in di Nigeria Fediral House of Repisentetiv.

How e tek go skul
Elumelu rid Ekonomik for Ambrose Alli Yunivasiti. E kari sekod klass lowa (2:2) komot from di yunivasiti. Elumelu kom go Yunivasiti of Legos go do e Masta  in Ekonomik.
Elumelu give $100 million to  di "ony Elumelu Fondashon" to fit yuz am helep pipo get wok in Afrika for di next 10 years. Na 10,000 pipo di fondashon get for mind to helep get wok.

How e tek wok
In 1997, Elumelu lid one smol group of investor to tek ova Crystal Bank. ( di bank kom leta bikom Standard Trust Bank). Wen e tek kontro  of Crystal Bank, di bank mek more moni. Femi Otedola give  am 20 million Dollars an na dat moni e yuz tek buy UBA.
 United Bank for Africa 
Wen dey join Standard Trust Bank an UBA in 2005, Elumelu bi dia Group Manijin Daretor an e mek suo di bank de for twenty kontri for Afrika, UBA de France, US, an UK. Elumelu stop to bi dia Manijin Daretor in 2010. For now na Elumelu bi di oga patapata for bi board of UBA.
 Heirs Holding
In 2010, Elumelu form Heirs Holdings, wey bi di e famili bizness. In 2010, e stil form di Tony Elumelu Fondashon, one fondashon wey dey sopot pipo wey wan start bizness for Afrika.
 Transcorp Plc
For 14 April 2021, forma vais-presidet Yemi Osinbajo give Elumelu di satifiket wey  mek am fit dey kontro Transcorp Hotel.

Awod wey e don get
 In 2003, Fediral Govamet give am Memba of di Orda of di Fediral Riploblik MFR taitu.
 In 2012, Fediral Govamet give am di Nashonal honor of Komanda of di Orda of di Niger CON for e wok for pravate bizness.
 Daily Times niuz-pepa give am Nigeria Man of di year in 2016
 In 2018 an 2019, e kolet di AABLA (All Afrika Bizness Lida Awod filatropist of di year).

Kano na ɗaya daga cikin manyan birane  a ƙasar Hausa. Kano ita ce cibiyar kasuwanci ta Najeriya gaba ɗaya. Jihar Kano tana da ƙananan hukumomi guda arba'in da huɗu. Kano gari ne da yake da masarauta mai ɗunbun tarihi, mai kwarjini a cikin ƙasashen Hausa da kewaye. Haka kuma Kano gari ne babba wanda  mazauna cikin sa ke magana da harshen Hausa. Kano ita ce gari mafi yawan jama'a a Najeriya gaba ɗaya.

Cikin birnin Kano akwai ƙofofi kamar haka Kofar Gadon Kaya, Kofar Famfo, Kofar Na'isa, Kofar nasarawa, Sabuwar Kofa, Kofar Mazugal, Kofar Dawanau, Kofar Dan Agundi, Kofar Dukawuya, Kofar Ruwa, Kofar Kansakali, Kofar Mata. 

Yawan mutanen da suke garin Kano ya haura kimanin mutane miliyan goma (10,000,000) a kidayar da aka yi a shekara ta alif dubu biyu da shida (2006). Jihar Kano tana da matukar tasiri a yawan mutane a Najeriya, saboda ita ce ta fi kowace jiha yawan mutane a Najeriya. Idan ka zo Kano za ka samu mutane daga ko'ina a fadin duniya, tun daga na kudancin Najeriya, zuwa kasashen dake makwabtaka da Najeriya, haka kuma za ka tarar da mutanen Sin (wato China), da kuma na kasashen Larabawa har da turawan yammacin duniya. Mutanen kano sun shahara wajen addini sosai.

Kano ta yi suna wajen kasuwancin da ta bunƙasa a kai, har ya zamana ana cewa da ita Cibiyar Kasuwanci. Haka kuma, tarihin Kano ya nuna daman can Kano tana da suna wurin cinikayya tsakaninta da mutanen gabas ta tsakiya.

text:
Najeriya (/naˈdʒɪəriyə/) ko Nijeriya (/niˈdʒɪəriyə/) da (turanci: Nigeria), A gwamnatance Tarayyar Najeriya, ƙasa ce da ke a Afirka ta Yamma,  tana da iyaka da kasar, Nijar daga Arewa, Chadi daga Arewa maso gabas, Kamaru daga gabas, Benin daga Yamma, sai daga Kudanci kuma tana a gabar Tekun Atlantika. Jamhuriyar tarayyar Najeriya, ta kunshi jihohi guda 36, Tare da babban birnin tarayya (Federal Capital Territory) Abuja inda fadar shugaban kasar take.

Abuja tana daya daga cikin manyan birane a duniya.

Najeriya ta kasance gida da dama ga 'yan asalin Turawa masu mulkin mallaka, jihohin da suka mallaka tunda (BC), tare da Nok Wayewa ta kasance ita ce karo na farko da Turawan mulkin mallaka suka fara mallakewa a Yammacin Africa a cikin ƙarni na 15 A zamani jihar an samo asali da Birtaniya a cikin ƙarni na 19, yana ɗaukar yanayin na yanzu tare da haɗe yankin Kudancin Najeriya da kuma Kare Arewacin Najeriya a cikin shekara ta alif dubu daya da Dari Tara da goma sha hudu (1914) ta Lord Lugard. Ingilishi ya kafa tsarin gudanarwa da na doka yayin aiwatar da mulkin kai tsaye ta hanyar shugabannin gargajiya. Najeriya ta zama ƙasar tarayyar da ke da ƴanci kai tsaye a ranar 1 ga watan Oktoba, shekarata alif dubu daya da dari tara da sittin (1960). Ta fuskanci yaƙin basasa daga shekara ta alif 1967 zuwa shekara ta alif 1970, sannan a biyo bayan zaɓaɓɓun gwamnatocin farar hula da mulkin kama-karya na soja, har sai an sami tabbatacciyar dimokuradiyya a shekara ta  alif 1999; zaɓen shugaban ƙasa na shekara ta 2015, shi ne karo na farko da shugaban ƙasa mai ci ya faɗi zaɓensa. 

Najeriya ƙasa ce mai yawan Al’umma  da ke zaune, sama da ƙabilu guda Dari biyu da hamsin (250), waɗanda ke magana da yarurruka daban daban guda 500, dukkansu suna ɗauke da al'adu iri daban daban.   Manyan ƙabilun guda uku su ne Hausa – Fulani a Arewa, Yarbawa a Yamma, da kuma Igbo a gabas, waɗanda suka haɗa da kashi 60% na yawan mutanen.  Yaren hukuma shi ne Ingilishi, wanda aka zaɓa don sauƙaƙe haɗin harshe a matakin ƙasa.  Tsarin mulkin Nijeriya ya tabbatar da ƴancin yin addini ;  kuma ƙasa ce dake ɗauke da Al’ummar  musulmai da Kirista, a lokaci guda.  Najeriya ta kasu kashi biyu tsakanin musulmai, waɗanda yawanci ke zaune a arewacin ƙasar, da kuma kiristoci, waɗanda yawanci ke zaune a kudancin ƙasar, tare da ƴan tsirarun da ke yin addinin asali, kamar waɗanda ke cikin ƙabilar Igbo da kuma yarbawa.

Najeriya ita ce ƙasa mafi yawan mutane a Afirka, kuma ƙasa ta bakwai mafi yawan mutane a Duniya, tare da kimanin mutane miliyan 206. Tattalin arziƙinta shine mafi girma a Afirka, kuma shi ne na 26 mafi girma a duniya ta hanyar GDP maras faɗi, kuma na 25 mafi girma daga PPP. Najeriya galibi ana kiranta da "Giant of Africa", ma'ana ƙarfin Afrika saboda yawan jama'a da tattalin arziƙinta,  kuma Bankin Duniya yana ɗaukarta a matsayin kasuwa mai tasowa. Ƙaramar yanki ce a cikin Afirka, matsakaiciyar ƙarfi a cikin al'amuran ƙasa da ƙasa, sannan kuma tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe mafi yawan Al’umma  a duniya. Koyaya, ƙasar tana ƙasa sosai a cikin jerin ƙasashen duniya, kuma har yanzu tana ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe masu rashawa a duniya.   Najeriya memba ce ta kafuwar Tarayyar Afirka, kuma memba ce a ƙungiyoyin ƙasa da ƙasa da dama, waɗanda suka haɗa da Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, ƙungiyar ƙasashen Yammacin Africa (ECOWAS), kungiyar ƙasashe masu arzikin man fetur, (OPEC),  kuma memba na yau da kullum a gamayyar MINT, kuma tana ɗaya daga cikin Ƙasashe goma sha ɗaya masu tashen ƙaruwan tattalin arziƙi wato "Next Eleven".

Ƙirƙira 
Sunan Nijeriya an ɗauke shi daga Kogin Neja wanda ya ratsa ƙasar. Wannan sunan ya samo asali ne a ranar 8 ga watan Janairun  shekara ta1897, ɗan jaridar Ingila Flora Shaw, wanda daga baya ya auri Lord Lugard, mai kula da mulkin mallaka na Burtaniya. Nijar da ke maƙwabtaka da ita sun samo sunan daga wannan kogin. Asalin sunan Nijar, wanda asali ana amfani da shi ne kawai zuwa tsakiyar Kogin Neja, ba tabbas. Wataƙila kalmar ta canza sunan Tuareg egerew n-iger ewen da mazauna ke amfani da shi a tsakiyar kogin da ke kusa da Timbuktu kafin mulkin mallaka na Turai na ƙarni na 19. <ref>The Arabic name nahr al-anhur is a direct translation of the Tuareg.

Tarihi 

Tarihi ya nuna cewar Nijeriya daɗaɗɗar ƙasa ce, kuma tarihi yanuna kasar na nan tun a shekara ta 500 kafin haihuwar Yesu Almasihu wato Annabi Isah (A.S), a wannan lokaci suka samata suna Ƙasar Hausa, addinin musulunci ya shiga Kasar Hausa ne tun karni na goma sha uku miladiya, akarshen karni na goma sha daya zuwa tsakiyar karni na goma sha hudu miladiya, kanim barno suka mamaye Kasar Hausa, kuma fulani sun mamaye kasar Hausa a farkon karni na goma sha tara miladiya har zuwan turawan mulkin malaka suka mamaye Lagos a shekara ta 1881 miladiya, ana cikin Yakin duniya I na farko sai turawan mulkin mallaka suka karo sojojin ruwa saboda suna tsoran jamusawa da ke kamaru kada sumamaye Nijeriya, amma mulkin Nijeriya na farko a hannun turawan Purtgal. A shekara ta 1885 sai turawan Birtaniya suka mamaye duk fadin Nijeria har zuwa 01 ga oktoba 1960 Nijeriya ta samu 'yancin kanta daga  turawan Biritaniya.

Tarayyar Amurka (da Turanci United States of America) ko Amurka ko Amurika ko Amerika ko Haɗin kan Jahohin Amurka jamhoriya ce da ta haɗa jihohi guda hamsin (50), da faɗin ƙasa da manya manyan ƙasashe masu cin gashin kansu guda biyar. Akwai kuma wasu yankunan marasa ƴanci guda 11,  da kuma wasu kananan tsibirai guda 9. Amerika na da faɗin ƙasa da takai sukwaya mil miliyan 3.8 (wato kilo mita 9.8), da kuma adadin mutane miliyan 325, ƙasar amurka itace ƙasa ta uku ko ta huɗu wajen yawan faɗin ƙasa kuma ta uku wajen yawan mutane. Birnin tarayyar ƙasar shine Washinton Gundumar Kolombiya, birni mafi yawan jama'a da girma kuma shine New York. Jihar Alaska itace a gefen kwanar arewa maso yamma na arewacin Amurka, iyaka da ƙasar Kanada daga gabas. Rushewar Tarayyar Soviets yayi sanadiyyar zaman Amurka ƙasa mafi ƙarfin iko a duniya kuma Amurka itace ƙasar da ta gabatar da mulkin demokradiyya a ƙasashen duniya da dama.

Mutanen Paleo-Indian ne suka yi hijira daga ƙasar Rasha zuwa Arewacin Amurka aƙalla shekaru 15,000 da suka wuce. Mulkin mallakar turawan Birtaniya ya fara ne daga ƙarni na 16. juyin juya halin Amurka ya fara ne a shekara ta 1776. An kawo karshen yaƙin ne a shekara ta 1783 bayan kafuwar Tarayyar Amurka. Amurka na amfani da Kundin tsarin mulki na shekara ta 1788, wanda aka sama suna The bill of right. Ƙasar Amurka itace ƙasa mafi ƙarfin iko a Duniya tun bayan rushewar Taraiyar Soviets. Kuma itace ƙasar da ta gabatar da mulkin demokradiyya a wasu daga ƙasashen dake duniya.

ƙasar Amurka itace ta gabatar da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Bankin Duniya, da sauran manyan ƙungiyoyin duniya.Amurka itace kasa mafi ƙarfin tattalin arzikin duniya da siyasa da kuma al'adu.

Isah Almasihu, Mai ceto (hrsh-el|Ἰησοῦς|transl=Iesous); hrsh-he|ישוע|Yēšū́aʿ); -larabci|عيسى|Annabi Isah) , an sansa da Isah na Nazareth da Isah Mai ceto, (Akwai sunaye da dama da ake wa Isah laƙabi da su a cikin littafi mai tsarki na sabon alƙawari. Ya kasance malami ne na Nasara kuma shugaban addini mai da'awa da ya kasance tun a karni na daya. Shi ne mafi darajar dan-Adam a addinin Kiristanci. Yawancin Kirista sun yi imanin cewa shi ne sura na ɗan Adam na Ubangiji da ya zo duniya kuma mai ceto da zai dawo a karshen duniya kamar yadda littafi mai tsarki na tsohon alƙawari ya tabbatar da Alqur'ani.

Yawancin Malamai sun yarda da cewar tarihin rayuwar Isah da tarihin sa,   kamar yadda Richard A. Burridge yace: "Akwai wadanda suke fadin cewar Isah kawai wani kirkira ne da Coci siffanta shi, suna ganin ba wani Isah a zahirin rayuwa. Amma zance ban san wani malami da nake girmamawa ba dana sani, Wanda yake fadin haka a halin yanzu". Robert M. Price bai yarda da cewar an taba yin Isah ba, amma kuma ya yarda da cewar ba Malamai dayawa ba ne suke ganin hakan. James D. G. Dunn yana kiran da'awar cewar  ba'a taba yin Isah a rayuwa ba, a matsayin "da'awa data mutu" aka bar yin ta a yanzu. Michael Grant (a classicist) ya rubuta a 1977, "A shekarun nan, 'babu wani malami mai hankali da zai fara cewa babu tarihin samun Isah' ko at any rate very few, and they have not succeeded in disposing of the much stronger, indeed very abundant, evidence to the contrary". Robert E. Van Voorst yafadi cewa Malaman baibul da kwararrun ýan tarihi suna ganin da'awar da muna cewa ba Isah a matsayin wata da'awa da aka ƙaryata ta. duk da cewar Nemansu akan Isah na Tarihi yayi sanadiyar samun karancin yarda akan Tarihan Dogaro Da Baibul da kuma yadda akayi kokarin zanen Isahn acikin baibul dayayi kama da Isah na Tarihi. Ehrman ya rubuta: "The notion that the Gospel accounts are not completely accurate but still important for the religious truths they try to convey is widely shared in the scholarly world, even though it's not so widely known or believed outside of it." efn|Sanders writes: "The earliest Christians did not write a narrative of Jesus' life, but rather made use of, and thus preserved, individual units—short passages about his words and deeds. These units were later moved and arranged by authors and editors. ... Some material has been revised and some created by early Christians." Jesus was a Galilean Jew who was baptized by John the Baptist and subsequently began his own ministry, preaching his message orally and often being referred to as "rabbi". Jesus debated with fellow Jews on how to best follow God, engaged in healings, taught in parables and gathered followers. He was arrested and tried by the Jewish authorities, turned over to the Roman government, and was subsequently crucified on the order of Pontius Pilate, the Roman prefect. After his death, his followers believed he rose from the dead, and the community they formed eventually became the early Church.

Koyarwar kirista ta tabbatar da imani da yarda da haihuwar Isah sanadiyar ruhine da aka cusa a cikin Mahaifiyarsa ta hannun Holy Spirit, was born of a virgin named Mary, yana nuna miracles, yasamar da coci, yarasu sanadiyar gicciye shi da akayi, a matsayin sadaukar dashi dan cimma atonement, yatashi bayan yamutu, sannan ascended zuwa Heaven, daga nan ne will return. yawancin Christians believe Jesus enables people to be reconciled to God. The Nicene Creed asserts that Jesus will judge the living and the dead either before or after their bodily resurrection, an event tied to the Second Coming of Jesus in Christian eschatology. The great majority of Christians worship Jesus as the incarnation of God the Son, the second of three persons of the Trinity. A minority of Christian denominations reject Trinitarianism, wholly or partly, as non-scriptural.

Jesus also figures in non-Christian religions and new religious movements. In Islam, Jesus (commonly transliterated as (transl|ar|ISO|[[Isa (name)|Isa])) is considered one of God's important prophets and the Messiah. Muslims believe Jesus was a bringer of scripture and was born of a virgin, but was not the Son of God. The Quran states that Jesus himself never claimed divinity. Most Muslims do not believe that he was crucified, but believe that he was physically raised into Heaven by God. In contrast, Judaism rejects the belief that Jesus was the awaited Messiah, arguing that he did not fulfill Messianic prophecies, and was neither divine nor resurrected.

Kiristanci Addini ne na Nasara wanda suka haɗa shi a kowane lungu na Duniya ta hanyar yaki, da wa'azi ga duk jama'ar da suka tunkara. Kuma Addinin kiristanci Addini ne wanda mutane su kayi imanin cewar Allah ɗaya ne, amma sun fi bada fifikon cewar Yesu almasihu ɗan Allah ne.wanda a Addinin Musulunci ake ambatar sa da Annabi Isa (A.S). Kiristoci sun dogara ne ga Injila wato Baibûl a duk abinda sukeyi. Kiristanci addini ne wanda yayi ƙaurin suna a Duniya kuma ya na ƙumshe da ɗariƙoki da dama kamar su: Katolika, Protestan da sauran su.

text:
Zariya (Ko kuma da turanci Zaria, sai kuma Zazzau sunan da ake mata lakabi da shi). Zaria gari ne dake cikin arewacin Najeriya, karamar hukuma ce a cikin jihar Kaduna, tana da iyaka da Funtuwa, babban birnin Kaduna, da kuma Igabi duka a cikin ƙasar Najeriya. A bisa ga ƙidayar jama'a na shekara ta dubu biyu da shida (2006), jimillar mutane dubu dari bakwai da sittin (700060) ne a garin Zariya, amman daga bisani an kimanta yawan su a shekara ta dubu biyu da sha bakwai (2017), ga jimillar mutane miliyan daya (1000000). Birnin Zariya tana da kilomita dari biyu da sittin (260kms) ne daga garin Abuja, kilomita tamanin (80kms) ne daga Zariya, kilomita dari daya da sittin (160) ne daga Kano. garin Zazzau an saka masa suna ne daga Sarauniya Amina.

Tarihi 

Asalin zaria sarakunan hausawa ne ke mulkin su, wanda su ka yi sarauta tun daga shekara ta dubu daya da dari biyar da biyar (1505) zuwa shekarar dubu daya da dari takwas da biyu 1802, A shekara  ta dubu daya da dari takwas da hudu 1804 ne Shehu Usman dan Fodiyo yayi jihadi, inda ya yaki sarkin gobir mai suna Yunfa, a Yakin kwoto, daga nan ne ya fara yada sarautarsa da musulunci zuwa masarautun Hausawa, A garin zariya kuma akwai Malam Musa wanda ya dade yana da’awar zuwa ga addinin musulunci, Malam Musa Bafillatani ne, Jin Jihadin Usman dan Fodiyo yasa shima ya karbi tuta daga Usman dan Fodiyo. Da Malam Musa da Yamusa mutumin fulanin Barno suka doso Zariya suka yaki sarki Makau dan kabilar Hausawa, Makau sai ya gudu shi da mutanensa zuwa Zuba, wani gari ne na Gwari da Koro a yankin Abuja a yau, Malam Musa sai ya zama Sarkin zazzau na farko daga kabilar Fulani, bayan rasuwarsa sai aka naɗa Yamusa a shekarar ta dubu daya dari takwas da ashirin da daya 1821 a matsayin sarkin zazzau, shi kuma fulanin Barno ne, daga nan ne Bare-Bari da Fulanin Mallawa suka fara sarauta a kasar zazzau. (Ihayatu (talk) 21:14, 30 Mayu 2023 (UTC))

Birni ne a kasar Hausa wanda kuma yana daya daga cikin garuruwan da Shehu Usman ya bada tutar addinin musulunci ya tabbata a ciki. Birni ne mai dadin zama saboda yanayinsa gashi kuma babbar cibiyar ilimin addini dana boko a arewacin Najeriya. Wannan gari Allah ya albarkace shi da kasa ta noma da kuma ilimin addinin musulunci dana zamani wanda a dalilin haka ne baki daga makotan garin suke zuwa domin neman ilimi kai harma da na kasashen waje da kuma mutanen garin Zariya su kansu, Wadannan garuruwa a wancen lokacin duka suna karkashin mulkin garin zazzau ne, inda Zariya take a matsayin babban birni, amman yanzu wasu daga cikin wadannan garuruwan basa karkashin zazzau. (Ihayatu (talk) 21:14, 30 Mayu 2023 (UTC))

Mutane 
Asalin mulkin Zariya yana karkashin Sarakunan [Hausawa]] ne, ana kiran garin da zazzau, zakzak ko zegzeg, dukkan wadannan sunayen ana kiran garin zazzau da shi, amman daga bisani sunan zazzau ya canza zuwa Zariya, A inda kuma sarautar aka fi kiranta da zazzau, shiyasa sarkin garin ake kiran shi da sarkin zazzau, mutanen da suka fito daga garin ana kiransu da suna Bazazzagi, jam’i kuma Zazzagawa.. (Ihayatu (talk) 21:14, 30 Mayu 2023 (UTC))

Sarauta 
Asalin mulkin Zariya tana karkashin Sarakunan hausawa ne, wadanda ke mulkan masarautan Zazzau, amma daga baya sarakunan Mallawa da fulani suka hada hannu da karfi suka yaki sarakunan hausawa a shekarar 1804. Sarakunan Hausawa na farko sun rayu ne a karni na 15, wadanda a wannan lokacin ba'a iya tina shekarun da sukayi sarauta, amman sarakunan hausawa na biyu sunyi mulki ne a karni na 16, inda aka taskace shekarun mulkin su, har zuwa lokacin da sarakunan Fulani suka yake su, sarkin su na karshe shine Makau a Zariya, a Gobir kuma shine Yunfa.
